katham ? 'tasya navatiśatam (190) stotrīyāḥ' ityamidhāya āha (tāsāṃ madhye) yāḥ aśītiśatam (stotrīyāḥ) : tāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśat : [ṣaṭtriṃśat : ] virājaḥ, ṣaṭ ṛtavaḥ, ṛtuṣveva virājaḥ pratiṣṭhitanti [6x6 = 36] ityevaṃ virāṭstaṃstutisāma (stotrīyāṇām) |
tataḥ pakṣādāha 'atha yāḥ (pariśiṣṭāḥ) daśa (stotrīyāḥ) : eṣā vā ātmanyā (ātmapratiṣṭhāpanī) virāṭ' iti tā daśa (stotrīyāḥ) : gavādibhiḥ (daśabhirmadhyaiḥ) stūyante |
kiṃ tat (tarhi udāharaṇam ?), ādhvaryave yadi īdṛśaṃ vākyam, tat draṣṭavyam |
'tasya dvādaśaśatam' iti (vākye) yadi tasya iti ṛtuviśeṣaṇaṃ syāt apravṛttiviśeṣakasamarthakaṃ syāt |

kutaḥ ? tacchabdena gavādyaḥ sarve parāmṛśyante, paṣṭyā teṣāmeva guṇabhūtā saṃkhyā vidhīyate |
nanu gavā- dibhiḥ (bahubhiḥ) saṃbandhe teṣām iti bahuvacanaṃ prāpnoti |
gavādyo'tra (saṃkhyāṃ prati) pradhānabhūtāḥ (tacchabdena) uddiyante, uddiyamānasya ca saṃkhyā na vivakṣyate gṛhasyeva |
athavā tantrasaṃbandho'yam, sā dakṣiṇā, tasya dvādaśaśata miti |
evamapi (yadyapi dakṣiṇāṃ prati gavādervidhānam, tathāpi ) saṃkhyā guṇabhūtā dravyāṇi prati (ṣaṣṭhyantasya) śabdasya sāmyāt |
ekasya kasya cit dvādaśa- śataṃ syāt |
dakṣiṇā tu saṃkhyāviśiṣṭā codyate, na gavā- dayaḥ |

gavādiṣu tasya dvādaśaśata miti naika- vacanaṃ na syāt |

avivakṣite'pi vacane yā saṃkhyā''nūyate, tena vacanena bhavitavyam |
yathā lakṣaṇatvenāpi ucyamāne brāhmaṇajātīyo na hantavya iti, na dvivacanāntena nirdeśo bhavati 'brāhmaṇo na hantavyo' iti |
bahuṣu vā ekavacanaṃ bhavati, na tu ekasmin bahuṣu ca dvivacanaṃ bhavati |

athāpi vākya- bhedamīkṛtya tacchabdasya ( taduddeśena ) saṃkhyā vidhī- yate, tathāpi dakṣiṇāyāḥ ( saṃkhyā ) anaṅgam ( syāt , tāṃ prati ) avidhīyamānatvāt ' tatraikamavamajā''jñamiti cet ' ( 4|1|5|11 ) ( ityuktvāt |

tatra vākyabhedādayo doṣāḥ ( tatraikam ityatra ) uktāḥ; te ihāpi bhaveyuḥ |
tasmāt gavādayaḥ, saṃkhyā, tacchabdaśca ( iti tritaya- mapi dakṣiṇāṃ prati vidhīyate ) |

yasya vā saṃnidhāne syāt, vākyato hyabhi- saṃbandhaḥ |
vrīhīṇāṃ dvādaśaśatena protsāhyate, tasya kiṃ sā dakṣiṇā bhavet |
brīhījānānāmapi dvādaśaśataṃ yāṃ ca yāvatīṃ balamātrāṃ karoti |
sa eva hi puruṣaḥ kaṃ cit prati balīyān, kaṃ cit prati abalaḥ |

3|1|13-15. jyotiṣṭome digavibhāga: jyotiṣṭome dīkṣaṇīyā''dīkṣaṇīyām ādau ārambhaṇīye- ṣṭiṃ kartavyam |
na tu daṇḍādimātreṇa, ataḥ dīkṣaṇīyā'nte dīkṣita- dharmānuṣṭhānam |
bhāṣyam-- jyotiṣṭome śrūyate 'āgnāvaiṣṇavamekā- daśakapālaṃ nirvapedīkṣiyamāṇaḥ' iti |
tathā 'daṇḍena dīkṣayati, mekhalayā dīkṣayati, kṛṣṇājinana dīkṣayati' ityevamādi |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ sarvaidīkṣito bhavati, athavā iṣyante dīkṣitaḥ iti |
dīkṣāsaṃvandho bhavati, daṇḍena dīkṣa- yati, dīkṣāmasya karotītyarthaḥ |
yadīṣyante dīkṣitaḥ syāt kathamasya daṇḍena dīkṣāṃ kuryāt |
na ca saṃbhavati samuccaye vikalpo nyāyyaḥ |
tasmādiśeṣe'pi dīkṣāsaṃvandhavācye prayogavacane saha ekavākyatā ityāvedanekāle dīkṣitaḥ syān |
ṭup-- 'daṇḍena dīkṣayati' daṇḍena dīkṣāṃ nirvartayati iti (tṛtīyānirdeśāt) dīkṣā'rthaḥ (daṇḍaḥ) |
yadi hi āgnā- vaiṣṇavena dīkṣitaḥ syāt (tataḥ) 'daṇḍena dīkṣayati' iti nocyeta |
tasmāt na sa tāvatrā dīkṣitaḥ (kintu sarvānte) |
tatra yāvat (sādhanam) āgnā- yate, tāvatā dīkṣito bhavati (naikadeśena) |
āha, karaṇavibhaktinirdeśāt itaretaranirapekṣāṇāṃ dīkṣākaraṇatā avagamyate yathā vrīhīṇāṃ (yavanirapekṣāṇāṃ puroḍāśa- karaṇatā) |
teṣāṃ (vrīhīṇāṃ) dṛṣṭopakāritvāt vikalpa iti cet tanna, brīhivatsamuccayena (api) śakyate puroḍāśo nirvartitum |
kiṃ tarhi ?) karaṇavibhaktistu yavanirapekṣāṇāṃ puroḍāśaprakṛtitvena pratipādayati |
tasya (vrīhibhiḥ iti) karaṇa- vibhaktyā niyatatā kṛtā (vrīhibhireva yatraiva vā iti) |
daṇḍādīnāṃ tu anavagataṃ tādarthyam (daṇḍena dīkṣayatvā) karaṇavibhaktyā (apūrvam) kriyate |
(tathāpi kathaṃ samuccayaḥ, tatrāha--) atra prayogavacanena sarvai upasaṃhiṣyante (samuccitāḥ) |
yadi tasyā uttarakāle dīkṣitaḥ, evaṃ sā dīkṣiya- māṇasyaḥ tasmādvākyādavagamyate bhavati tadā dīkṣitaḥ iti |
dīkṣākāraṇe padārthe nirvṛtte kimiti na dīkṣitaḥ syāt |
vākye hi nirapekṣaṃ dīkṣitaḥ iti jñāpayati |
yattu dīkṣā- saṃvandho daṇḍena dīkṣayatīti, kathaṃ sa dīkṣitatve syāditi |
yattu, anantaraṃ dīkṣitaśabdo nāstīti, na śabdasya aprayogaḥ |
anyena ca dīkṣitaḥ ityavagamyate vākyena 'āgnā- vaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapedīkṣiyamāṇaḥ' iti |
yacca āvedanakāle dīkṣitaśabda iti, iṣyante'pi dīkṣitasyāsau avigrahaḥ |
yataḥ ekaṃ dīkṣā- kāraṇamyadīkṣitaṃ saṃpādayati iti gamyate |
uttaramāha--) samarpaṇādikāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ aśravaṇāt na jñāyate kāṃ kriyāṃ sādhayantaḥ saṃskārārthā pratipadyante (daṇḍadayaḥ iti) |
(kiñca) dīkṣiyamāṇaḥ iti yo dīkṣāmāpnumicchati, tasya dīkṣaṇīyā upāyatvena vidhīyate (nānyathā) |
(samākhyānaṃ ca tadvat iti sūtrārthamāha--) yadi ca anayaiva dīkṣā kriyate, tataḥ asyāḥ (dīkṣaṇīyā iti) samākhyā yujyate (nānyathā) |
(iṣyante vā iti sūtrārthe saṃkṣipya lakṣaṇasaṃrvandhaṃ cintāyāḥ darśayati--) iṣyante agnihotrādīni na kāryāṇi ityaṃ kramalakṣaṇa- saṃvandhaḥ |

kasmāt ? samākhyānaṃ ca tadvaditi yadat nyāya upadiṣṭaḥ |
katham ? dīkṣaṇīyeti tādarthyakarī samākhyā bhavati yathā sthānīyam, bhojanīyaṃ ceti |
tasmācca paśyāmaḥ irdīkṣaṇīyārthā, iṣyante ca pravṛttiriti |
daṇḍādiyakriyārūpaṃ (daṇḍādi tu akriyā- rūpaṃ iti paccheda-) tadvyañjanatayocyate |
soma-- yathā cayanamātrāt nāyicitvam evamihi- mātrāt na dīkṣitatvamiti pratyavasthānāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu-- sarvaiḥ iṣṭivadādibhiḥ dīkṣā'misaṃvandhāt āvedanāt pareṇa āvedanādanantaraṃ dīkṣitaḥ syāt |
'enapā dvitīyā' (pā0 2|1|13) ityatra 'pañcamyapi dṛśyate' iti vaktavyaṃ kalpayitvā 'pareṇa āve- danāt' iti prayogaḥ samarthanīyaḥ |
prayojanaṃ tu-- dīkṣāmātraṃṇaiva dīkṣitadharmāḥ pravartan- iti pūrvapakṣe |
' bhāṭṭa-- 'āgnāvaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati dīkṣiyamāṇaḥ' iti dīkṣaṇīyeṣṭyāvadīkṣā'thaivaṃ laṭ- pratyayasya kriyā'rthāyāṃ kriyāyāmapade vihitasya śravaṇā- davagamyate |
'daṇḍena dīkṣayati, mekhalayā dīkṣayati, kṛṣṇājinānā dīkṣayati' ityādinā tṛtīyayaiva daṇḍādīnāṃ dīkṣārthatvam |
na ca daṇḍādīnāmanabhiṣaktakāryatvam, dīkṣā- 'bhisyekaśrutatvāt anekeṣu dīkṣayatipadeṣu tallakṣa- ṇāyā prāmāṇāvāca |
kiñca adṛṣṭarūpamayamiyamaparigrahā- nukūlayogyatārūpāyāḥ dīkṣāyāḥ abhisyancitaṃ tāvadanu- mityāmikā, daṇḍādīnāṃ vyabhicaritatvāt |
astu vā dīkṣaṇīyāyā eva dīkṣotpādakatvam, tathāpi na tadante dīkṣitadharmā yamaniyamādayaḥ |
tatra 'dīkṣito'si, dīkṣitavādaṃ vada, satyameva vada mānutama' ityāvedanapreṣaṇadaṇḍādi- dānottarameva yamaniyamaparigrahavidhānāt |
ata eva yamaniyamaparigraha eva dīkṣiti pārthasārathilekhanamanupapannām |
āvedanapreṣe dīkṣāsaṃvandhottarakālaṃ yamaniyamaparigrahābhidhānāt svayameva dīkṣāyā ada
siddharūpatvācca daṇḍādīnāṃ na kriyānyāpya- tvajñānamantareṇa dīkṣā'rthatvasaṃbhavaḥ |
na ca prathamāvagata- prayojakavyāpārārthatvameva ' vacasaiva kārayati ' ityādipat tallakṣmu iti vācyam |

tadarthaṃ dīkṣāyāḥ phalībhūta- yamanidhayamaparigrahopayogidīkṣitatvajñānajanakatvaiva dīkṣa- ṇīyā'rthatvaṃ dīkṣā'rthatvameva vā aṅgīkartumucitam, 'agman' iti mantrasya yāgaphalaprakāśakatayā yāgāṅgatvamiva |
ata eva paramparāsaṃbandhasya saṃvandhividhayaiva bodhopapatterna lakṣaṇā'pi |
tattadvidhantareva ca daṇḍādīnāṃ dhāraṇakaṇṭhyanādirūpakriyāvidhānāt nākriyā''viṣṭhānāṃ smārakatvasaṃbhava
( evaṃ ca ' tutho vo viśvedā vibhajatu ' iti mantra- varṇo na pākṣiko bhavati |
yatra tu ekameva dravyaṃ dakṣiṇā, yathā ' dhenurdakṣiṇā ' ityādi, tatra avibhavaiva dānaṃ gatyabhāvāt |
bhāṣyam-- asti ca parikriyārthe dānam, na dharma- mātram |
parikriyārthe ca bhartrā bhṛtyena saha pariṇatavyam |
yadi ca pariṣadaṃ prati uccyeta, paricchacca vibhajeta, na svāminā saha apaṇīṣyata |
yathā loke kāṣṭhāvaprabhṛtibhyo yadīyate, tatra kāṣṭhāvahāḥ svāminā saha paṇyante |
tebhyaḥ svāmī vibhajya nirdiṣṭāti, idaṃ tvamṛmidaṃ tvamṛmīti |
bhāṣyam-- api ca darśayati vibhāgam, yad vibhāgāmidhāyinaṃ mantramāmananti |
' abhīṣaḍeve dadāti, abhimukhā- neva pitṛn prīṇāti |
antaḥ- sadasi āsīnebhyo yathāśraddhaṃ prāptarkebhyo dadāti ' iti |
tena teṣāṃ pradhānatvād bahulaṃ na vivakṣitam ||
sūtrā- rthastu-- tatra gavādiṣu dānaṃ vibhāgena syāt pradhānānām ṛtvigyo deyānāṃ vibhāgānāṃ bhinnatvāt vibhajya dānaṃ vinā tenatena ṛtvijā tasyatasya saṃśrayantyu- maśakyatvāt iti |
atra ( mūle ) pariṣadaḥ uddeśena kriyamāṇasya dānavaṃ mukhyameva aṅgīkṛtya tasya ānatya- yaṃtvam ṛtvigyupayogakṣamaṃ vinā na nirvahati iti tanni- rvāhaya pratyekaṃ dānamupapāditam |
prabhākaraistu paropakāra- kṣamalābhāvena parastvāpattiparyantatvāmāvāt pariṣadi dānaṃ tyāgamātram, na tu mukhyaṃ dānamityuktam |
vi-- ' godāne vihite svecchayā niyatir''nnime- 'pi kim ? avibhāge vibhāgo vā, niyamānukti- 'grimaḥ |
' ' tutho vo viśvedā vibhajatu ' iti mantre vibhāga- liṅgam |
( bho gāvaḥ, vaḥ yuṣmān tutho nāma devaḥ vibhajatu iti mantrārthaḥ |
) bhāṭṭa-- seyaṃ dakṣiṇā ṛtvigyo dīyamānā vibhajya deyā, na veti cintāyām |
' ṛtvigyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti ' iti dānājñatvena ṛtvigbahutvasya vivakṣitatvāt samudi- tebhyaḥ avibhavaiva deyā |
na cāvibhavadāne parastvā- nupapatterdānaparyāyānāpattiḥ : ' dhenurdakṣiṇā ' ityādī avi- bhājyadravyaikyake saṃsṛṣṭaparatvopacitatvāt ihāpi tathopati- saṃbhavena tadupapatteḥ |

vastutastu ṛtvijāmiha uddeśyatvena tadgatanahutvasāhityayoḥ avikṣitatvāt ' puṣa- dājyenānuyājān yajati ' itivat pratipradhānaṃ guṇavṛtti- nyāyena pratyekamekaikasya samastadakṣiṇāsaṃbandhāvagateḥ na vibhāgaprasaktiḥ |
iti prāpte, nātra ṛtvijāṃ caturthyā bhāvavatrūpeṇaivāvagateḥ, tasyāḥ saṃpradānakārakavāci- tvena lakṣaṇāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt |

ato ' vedavide gāṃ dadāti ' ityatra gopradānobhayaviśiṣṭadānasya svargārthatva- vat ṛtvigyobhayaviśiṣṭadakṣiṇādānasya vaiguṇyādivat padāntarakalpanā ṛtvigāgamanārthatvapratīteḥ ṛtvigata- bahutvasāhityādervidhitvāt pratyekaṃ samastadakṣiṇā- vṛttiḥ |
ata evobhayatrāpi gavādidravyasya dvikarmakatvamabhiyā saktavat karaṇatvalakṣaṇaiva |
kiñca, dakṣiṇāyā vākyāntare jauhavīpabhadāditvat upanayā ekā eva prayājādyadeśonneva ṛtviguddeśena viniyogāt avayavaśa eva pratyekānvayaḥ iti na pratyekaṃ samastadakṣiṇā''vṛttiḥ |
ataḥ samudi- tebhya eva ṛtvigyaḥ sarvatra dakṣiṇādānam |
nahi ' dhenurdakṣiṇā ' ityādau ekenyadā avibhājyātvavat anvāhāyādau

evaṃ ca sarvatra bahuvacanatvāt samuditebhya eva dāne prakte ' tutho vo viśvedā vibhajatu ' iti mantravarṇabalāt ' agnīdhe dadāti, hotre udgātre ' ityādi- pramāṇabalācca gamakarasattve vibhajyaiva dānam |
' jyotiṣṭome dvādaśaśatadakṣiṇāyāḥ arthinaḥ : tṛtīyinaḥ pādinaḥ : iti samākhyā''nurodhena vibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ ||
bhāṣyam-- jyotiṣṭome samāmnāyate ' gauśvā- śvaścāśvataraśca ' iti |
idamānīṃ śāṃyyakaṃ kiṃ samo vibhāgaḥ ; uta karmakṛtaṃ vaiṣamyam, uta śabdakṛtamiti |
kiṃ prāptam ? samo bhāgaḥ syāt, aśrutvādādiśeṣasya |
yatra viśeṣo na śrūyate, tatra samo vibhāgo bhavitumarhati |
kathamiva ? ekasmai sarve dātavyaṃ prāpnoti, yadi aparasmai dātavyaṃ na bhavati |
tatra yāvati ekasmai dīyamāne nyaḥ saṃvi- bhajyate, tāvattvamekasmai na dātavyam |
du-- samaṃ syādaśrutatvāt iti prasaktānuprasaktena vibhāgo'pyalaṃ ca |
yo bahu karma karoti, tasmai bahu mṛtidīyete |
atulyāḥ syuḥ parikraye, viṣama'srayā vidhi- śrutau, parikriyācca karmaṇyapapadyate, darśanād viśeṣasya tathā''bhyudaye |
ke cidarthinaḥ, ke cit tṛtīyinaḥ, ke cit pādinaḥ |
evaṃ tṛtīyinaḥ pādina iti dīkṣāvidhiśrutau samākhyāyante |
vā parikriyāt karmakṛte vaiṣamye nopa- padyate |
' adhvaryurhṛpati dīkṣayitvā brāhmaṇaṃ dīkṣayati, tata udgā- tāram, tato hotāram |
tatastat pratiprasthātā dīkṣayitvā arthino dīkṣayati, brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaṃ brahmaṇaḥ, prastotāra- mudgātuḥ, maitrāvaruṇaṃ hotṛḥ |
tatastata neṣṭā dīkṣayitvā tṛtīyino dīkṣayati, agnīdhaṃ brahman : pratihartāramudgātuḥ, acchāvākaṃ hotṛḥ |
tatastatanneṣṭā dīkṣayitvā pādino dīkṣayati, potāraṃ brahmaṇaḥ, subrahmaṇyamudgātuḥ, āśvastaṃ hotuḥ |
iti arthinaḥ, tṛtīyinaḥ, pādinaḥ iti dvāda- śāhe anuvādaḥ |
yadi prakṛtau yathāsamākhyam amīṣā- mime bhāgāḥ, tato dvādaśāhade darśanamupapadyate |
tasmāt arthādibhiḥ samākhyānāt samākhyāśrutikṛtaṃ vaiṣamyaṃ bhavitumarhatīti |
soma-- pūrvādhikaraṇe vibhāge pratipādite tannirvaha- katvena idaṃ cintyate iti saṃgatiḥ |
vi-- ' sa vibhāgaḥ samo no vā, viśeṣāśravaṇāt samaḥ |
vaiṣamyaṃ syād yathā''yāsam, maivaṃ tat syāt samākhyāyā ||
' bhāṭṭa-- vibhāgo'pi avati niyāmakaṃ sarvatra samānaḥ eva |
some tu satrayadīkṣākramavibhāgāye vākye ' arthinastṛtīyinaḥ pādinaḥ ' iti śrutasamākhyābala-
aśādau tu samuditebhyo dānam, taiḥ slecchyā sāmyena prayāsānurūpyeṇa vā vibhāgaḥ kāryaḥ |
'agnidai savane viharanti' ityādinā vihitaṃ dhiṣṇyānāṃ viharaṇamauttaravedikadeva syāt |
iti prāpte, 'agnīd dhiṣṇyān viharati' iti niyamanādāgnīdhrīyasyāpi āhavanīyadevalena homa- saṃyogopapatteḥ |
mānayā ekavākyatāyāṃ ca satyām anyānyaṅgāni nākā- ṅkṣyante |
nanu evaṃ sati pūrvābhyāṃ śaṃkhviḍā'ntā na kaṃcidartham abhyadhikaṃ bādhayatīti |
nahi tasyārthaṃ pṛthag vākyam, yasyārthakyaṃ parijīhīrṣyate |
sā ca (klṛptopakārā vidhīyamānā) ājyabhāgavat nirākāṅkṣī- karoti prāyaṇīyām |
tatra pūrvasyām (śaṃkhvantāyām) gṛhyamāṇāyāmuttarasya śaṃkhyoḥ prāk ye padārthāḥ kartavyā avagatāḥ, te bādhyeran |
uttarasyāṃ tu (gṛhyamāṇāyāṃ) na kiñcit bādhitaṃ bhavati, śabdārthasya saṃpādita eva |
nuyājavajaṃ kṛtsnasaṃkhyatvamapīti cintāyām, ādya- punarupeyate iti |
yat somārthe tadevetaratra prasaṅgāt kāryaṃ sādhayati |
sādhayet, yadi kamārthatā tasya jñātā bhavet |

śā-- prākṛtaṃ vratopāyanaṃ kartavyaṃ neti vicāre, kartavyamiti prāpte, somārthe'pi tenaiva vrate satyavadana- brahmacaryādisaṃkalpasyeṇa ā samāteḥ avisṛṣṭena prasaṅgāt siddheḥ, na punarupāyanaṃ kartavyam |
soma-- anvādhānasya dṛṣṭārthatvāt akartavyatve'pi vratopāyanasya adṛṣṭārthatvāt kartavyam, ityucyate saṃgatiḥ |
vi-- vratopāyanameṣyasti na vā, codakato'sti tat, upetasyāparityāge virodhānnāsti tat punaḥ |
bhāṭṭa-- darśapūrṇamāsayoreva 'agne vratapate' iti- mantreṇa vratagrahaṇamāmnātam |
satyavadanaṃ hi 'sa vai satyameva vadet' iti śatapathe vihitam, sa iti katpādānena kṛtayukpuruṣa- dharmaḥ |
ata eva 'nānṛtaṃ vadet' iti śuddhakṛtadharmatvāt saṃyogāntaram |
evam 'sa brahmacārī abhadhumāṃāśī syāt' iti brahmacaryavidhāvapi jñeyam |
sthyupagamanamāṃsa- pratiṣedhastu śākhā'ntarīyaḥ iti na virodhaḥ |
tadidamapi vrataṃ somāgneṣṭipakṣādiṣu na kāryam, dīkṣaṇīyottaraṃ somārthe kṛtenaiva dīkṣāvratagrahaṇena ā''vaśyamavisṛṣṭena prasaṅga- siddheḥ |
na caihikasaumikavratakaraṇayoḥ : vijātīyādṛṣṭa- janakayoḥ : kathaṃ prasaṅgaḥ, vijātīyayorapi tantreṇa pari- pālitayoḥ : vijātīyādṛṣṭajanakalopapatteḥ |

ata eva satya- vadananiyamādiparipālanasya tantratve'pi somārthe kṛtenaiva tasaṃkalpena tasyārthasiddheḥ na pṛthaksaṃkalpakaraṇam, sakṛt saṃkalpitasya punaḥsaṃkalpavaiyarthyāt, vratavartamānadaśāyāṃ 'vrataṃ cariṣyāmi' iti mantraliṅgānuppatteśca |
na ca yāvajjīvaṃ puruṣārthe satyavadananiyamasaṃkalpe kṛte'pi yathā darśapūrṇamāsajyotitomādau punastasaṃkalpakaraṇam, tathā
somārthatayā kṛte'pi tasaṃkalpe tadaṅgeṣvādiṣu punasta- saṃkalpakaraṇaṃ na vivakṣyate iti vācyam |
puruṣārthatayā kṛtasyāpi saṃkalpasya ṛtvarthatayā punaḥkaraṇe bādhakābhāvāt, satyavadananiyamasye'pi brahmacaryādisadhāraṇavratasāmānya- saṃkalpe bādhakābhāvācca |
prakṛte tu sāmānyasaṃkalpasyaiva kṛtatvāt iṣṭyādyarthe punaḥkaraṇaṃ viruddhamiti viśeṣaḥ |

na ca evamapi somārthasya vratasya kartṛsaṃskāradvārā aṅgapradhāna- sādhāraṇatayā iṣṭyādyarthatve'pi sannāt mahādevidvadaupa- deśikena vratasaṃkalpena aiṣṭikasya bādha eva syāt na prasaṅgaḥ iti vācyam |
'dīkṣāḥ somasya' iti vacanena yama- niyamaparigrahasyavratasvarūpatvāt dīkṣāyāḥ pradhānamātrārtha- tvena aṅgasādhāraṇatvābhāvāt |
dīkṣaṇīyāyāṃ tu somārthavratasaṃkalpasya dīkṣaṇīyottaratvāt prasaṅganupapatteryuktau aiṣṭikavratagrahaṇa- tadvisargau |
jyoti- ṣṭome bahiṣpavamānaṃ nāma stotraṃ prātaḥsadhane |
bhā. 6|1|17-21 49-56, jyotiṣṭome 'bārhadviraṃ brāhmaṇasya brahmasāma kuryāt, pārthurasaṃ rājanyasya, rāyovājīyaṃ vaiśyasya' |
jyotiṣṭome bṛhatīvicārapaṅktyareva pramatha- nena saṃpādite bārhate tṛce rauravaudhāyajasāmno- rgānam |
asti jyotiṣṭomaḥ 'jyoti- ṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta' iti |
tatra 'tricchandā āvāpo mārthadinaḥ pavamānaḥ pañcasāmā, gāyatrāmīye gāyane tṛce bhavataḥ, rauravaudhāyajaye bārhate tṛce, auśanamanyaṃ triṣṭupsu' iti |
yadetat rauravaṃ yaudhājayaṃ ca dve sāmanī, tayoḥ pūrvā bṛhatī 'punānaḥ soma dhārayāpo vasāno arpati |
ā ratanā yonimṛtasya sīdantyusto deva hiraṇyayaḥ |
uttarā vicārapaddhatiḥ : 'duhāna uhardinyaṃ madhya priyaṃ prāṇaṃ sahasyamāsadat |

( iti ) tadatra saṃśayaḥ : kimanvayoḥ : utpattivṛhatyoḥ : āgamanaṃ kṛtvā sāmāsu gānaṃ kartavyam, uta yā''sau pūrvī bṛhatī uttarā ca vicārapaddhatiḥ : tayoḥ prathamane tṛcakrame kṛtvā bṛhatīkāraṃ gānaṃ kartavyamiti |
kiṃ prāptam ? anye bṛhatyo āgamana- yitve iti |
bhāṣyam-- evaṃ ca sve chandasi prakṛte gānaṃ bhaviṣyati |
bhāṣyam-- evaṃ ca pragāthaśabda upapanno bhaviṣyati |
kiṃ liṅgaṃ bhavataḥ ? evamāha, 'bahiṣpavamāne mārthadinaṃ savanam' iti |
kathaṃ kṛtvā liṅgam ? yadi pramathane bṛhatīkāraṃ gānaṃ kriyate, tataḥ sarvasmin savane yā ṛcaḥ samāmnātāḥ, tāḥ paṭhiṣyanti |
tadidaṃ nirdiśyate 'gāyatrāmīye gāyane tṛce bhavataḥ : tāḥ ṣaḍ gāyatryaḥ |
atha, hotuḥ pṛṣṭhe bṛhatī rathaṃtare vā saptadaśastome kriyamāṇe pañca bṛhatyo bhavanti |
katham ? eṣā hi tatra triṣṭutiḥ 'pañcamyo hiṃ karoti sa tisṛbhiḥ, sa arūyā, sa ekayā |
pañcamyo hiṃ karoti sa ekayā, sa tisṛbhiḥ, sa ekayā |
saptamyo hiṃ karoti sa ekayā, sa tisṛbhiḥ, sa tisṛbhiḥ' iti |
tatra bṛhatībhistisṛbhiḥ prathamam ekayā ca kakubhā punaśca ekayā kakubhā |
tataḥ punarekayā bṛhatyā tisṛbhiḥ kakubhiḥ, ekayā ca kakubhā |
tataḥ punarekayā bṛhatyā, punaśca tisṛbhiḥ kakubhiḥ, punaśca tisṛbhiḥ kakubhiḥ iti |
evaṃ pañca bṛhatyaḥ dvādaśa kakubhaḥ iti |
tābhiśca bṛhatībhiḥ saha ekādaśa bṛhatyo bhavanti |
tataḥ ṣaṇṇāṃ gāyatrīṇāṃ catasro gāyatryaḥ dvādaśabhiḥ kakubhiḥ dvādaśa bṛhatyo bhavanti, evaṃ trayoviṃśatirbhavanti |
tato vāmadevye saptadaśakā gāyatryaḥ, pāvamānībhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ gāyatrībhyām avaśiṣṭābhyāṃ saha ekonaviṃśatigāyatryo bhavanti |
tato naubhasakāleyoḥ ekatra saptadaśa bṛhatyaḥ, ekatra saptadaśa, tataścatriṃśat |
pūrvasaṃkalitābhiḥ trayoviṃśatyā bṛhatībhiḥ saptapañcāśat bṛhatyo bhavanti |
yāstā ekonaviṃśatigāyatryaḥ, tāsāṃ saptapañcāśatā gāyatrīpādaiḥ saha saptapañcāśat bṛhatyaḥ sapta- pañcāśat triṣṭubho bhavanti |
pāvamānībhiḥ triṣṭubhiḥ saha ṣaṭtriṣṭubhaḥ iti siddhaṃ bhavati |
atha bṛhadrathaṃtaryoḥ utpattiḥkakubhorāgamaḥ kriyate, tato yāḥ savane sāmnātāḥ, na tāḥ ṣaṭtriṣṭubhiḥ |
ye te dve savane kakubhau asamnāte ānīyate tadyordaśakṛtvaḥ prayogaḥ |
yāstā ṛcaḥ savane sāmnātāḥ, tā iha savanaśabdenocyante, na karmaṇi savanaśabdaprayogaḥ |
tatra hi triṣu savaneṣu bahvyaḥ triṣṭubho bhavanti |
tasmāt yā'sau pūrvā bṛhatī uttarā ca viṣṭārapaṅktiḥ, tatra prathamaṃ kṛtvā gāyanamiti |
dup— 'ṣaṭtriṣṭubho mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanam, ( ityetat darśanaṃ prathamane avakalpate, nopattiṣṭubahoḥ ānayane ) |
'na atra karmaṇi savanaśabdaḥ ' ( 'na karmaṇi savanaśabdaprayogaḥ ' iti tu bhāṣyavākyaṃ durastham |

tat nyāyācche— ) yadi karmaṇi ( karmāṅgabhūtāsu ṛkṣu ) savanaśabdaḥ ( vartate ) tathā sati ( savana- śabdasya savanatrayavācitvāt ) jyotiṣṭomamātre pravṛttaḥ na mādhyaṃdine ( śabdena ) viśiṣṭaṃ śakyate |
tatra ayaṃ prayogaḥ ( eva ) na syāt ( 'ṣaṭtriṣṭubho mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanam' iti, bahvīnāṃ triṣṭubhāṃ bhāvāt ) |
yadi savana- śabdo na karmaṇi ( vartate kintu lakṣaṇayā savanaṅgabhūtāsu ṛkṣu ), tathā sati ( triṣṭupśabdasya savanaśabdena ) sāmānādhikaraṇyamupapadyate |

yadi ca ( triṣṭupśabdasya ) lakṣaṇayā savanaśabdaḥ ( vartate ṣaṭtriṣṭupśabdasannidhi mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanamiti ) tathā sati ācārye hotre audgātre ca bahvyaḥ triṣṭubho bhaveyuḥ ( mādhyaṃdine savane ), tathā sati 'ṣaṭtriṣṭubho mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanam' iti ( prayogaḥ ) na syāt |
( tasmāt yāḥ sāmavede mādhyaṃdinaprakaraṇe sāmānnātā ṛcaḥ tadabhiprāyamidaṃ vacanam ) |
apica 'ṣaṭtriṣṭubho mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanam' iti savanaśabdaḥ ( karmāṅgabhūtāsu ṛkṣu śrūyamāṇaḥ āmāntāsu ( eva ) vartate |
yadi ca utpattiṣṭubahoḥ ānīyatām, ( tataḥ ) dāśatayībhyaḥ āgamaḥ syāt, ( tatra ) tayoḥ prakaraṇa- saṃbandhaḥ kartavyaḥ |
tacca utpattiṣṭubahoḥ ānīya- mānayoḥ: 'ṣaṭtriṣṭubhaḥ' iti asaṃbaddham ( syāt, ) pragāthavacanaṃ ca ( asaṃbaddhaṃ syāt ) |
soma— mādhyaṃdinasavane pavamānastomekaṃ, catvāri pṛṣṭhāni ityevaṃ pañca stotrāṇi |
tatra pavamānaḥ pañcadaśa- stomaḥ, pṛṣṭhāni saptadaśastomāni |
tāsāṃ kāścit paṭhitāḥ, kāścit prapaṭhana- labdhāḥ : kāścidabhyāsalabdhāḥ |
tatra dvādaśa kakubhaḥ ; aṣṭā- viṃśatyakṣarāḥ, trayoviṃśatigāyatryaḥ : caturviṃśatyakṣarāḥ, pañca- catvāriṃśat bṛhatyaḥ : ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣarāḥ, tisraḥ triṣṭubhaḥ : catuścatvāriṃśadakṣarāḥ |
tatra dvādaśāpi kakubhaḥ : dvādaśabhi- gāyatryaiḥ saṃyojitāḥ satyaḥ : dvādaśa triṣṭubhaḥ saṃpadyante |
evaṃ ca tripadā aṣṭau gāyatryaḥ vyatītāḥ |
avaśiṣṭāḥ pañcadaśa gāyatryaḥ, tāsāṃ pañcacatvāriṃśat pādāḥ |
tāvadbhiḥ pādaiḥ pañcacatvāriṃśat bṛhatyaḥ saṃyojitāḥ : pañca- catvāriṃśat triṣṭubhaḥ saṃpadyante |
āmnātāśca tisraḥ ityevaṃ ṣaṣṭiḥ triṣṭubhaḥ saṃpannāḥ |
' mādhyaṃ- dinapavamāne trīṇi sūktāni 'uccā te jātam' ityekram, tatra tisro gāyatryaḥ |
'pra tu drava parikoṣām' iti tṛtīyam, tatra tisrastriṣṭubhaḥ |
pṛṣṭhastomeṣu 'abhi tvā śūra' iti pragātharūpaṃ prathamaṃ sūktam, tatra pūrvā bṛhatī, uttarā paṅktiḥ ( satobṛhatī ) |
'taṃ vo dasmṛtīpaham' iti tṛtīyaṃ pragātharūpam, tatra bṛhatīstotrabṛhatī |
prathame sūkte gāyatram āmīyatvaṃ ceti sāmanī |
jyotiṣṭome eva mādhyaṃdinapava- māne 'triścandā āvāpo mādhyaṃdinaḥ pavamānaḥ pañca- sāmā' iti śrutam |
tadarthavivaraṇāni ca 'gāyatrā- mahīyatve gāyatratve bhavataḥ, rauravaudhājayau vā'īte tuce bhavataḥ, auśanamalaṃ triṣṭup ( triṣṭup )' iti |
tatra rauravaudhājayayoḥ pūrvā bṛhatī uttarā viṣṭārapaṅktiḥ : samā- mnātā |
tadiha viśiṣyaiva 'vā'īte tuce vā'īta- tṛcavāmnānāt uttare dve bṛhatīcchandaske eva samānite |
iti prāpte, nātra rauravaudhājayayordevena vā'ītiḥ; yone- stādṛśyāḥ prāptatvāt |
ata eva na viśiṣṭadeśena sāmadvaya- vidhiḥ |
tatra tucoddeśena bṛhatīcchandaskavidhiḥ paraṃ bhavet, so'pi avacchedakāvacchedena vā sāmānādhikaraṇyena vā ubhayathā'pyasaṃbhavaḥ |
evaṃ ca vastutastat prāptatvāt etāni vākyāni pūrvavākyārthavivaraṇānīti anuvādā- kāni ityeva dhyeyam |
nahi etāni uttarāsu sāma- prāptyāni iti keṣāṃ cidapi viduṣāṃ yuktam, 'yadyonyām' ityanenaiva tāmpāte |
na caivaṃ 'vā'īte' iti vacanasya yonivṛhatītvenaiva upa- patteḥ prayanaye pramāṇabhāvaḥ, tucavargatvaprapannasaraṇādi- naiva tatsiddheḥ |
evaṃ ca prathitabṛhatītvasya avaccheda- kāvacchedena viśeṣaṇopapattāvapi lakṣaṇā''pace : tathā nāśritamiti dhyeyam |

tatra ādyāṃ bṛhatīṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣarāṃ paṭhitvā tadanyapādasya dvirāvṛttyā uttarāyāḥ : viṣṭārapaṅkteḥ catvāriṃśadakṣarāyāḥ : ādyārthena ekā bṛhatī, tadanya- pādasya dvirāvṛttyā dvitīyārthatvena aparā, ityevarūpaṃ prathamaṃ bodhyam |
atra sarvatra alpāntaratvāt kiñci- dakṣaranyūnatve'pi na tacchandasvarūpavighātaḥ |
yatu bhāṣyakāreṇa ( ityuktam iti dūramanvayaḥ :) 'ṣaṭtriṣṭubho mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanam' iti liṅgamapi prathamane etorapacyate |
tathāhi, mādhyaṃdine savane pañca stotrāṇi eko mādhyaṃdinaḥ pavamānaḥ pañcadaśastomaḥ, samadaśāni catvāri pṛṣṭhāni |
tatra pavamāne gāyatra- āmīyatvasāmnoḥ : ṣaḍ gāyatryaḥ : rauravaudhājayayoḥ : ṣaḍ bṛhatyaḥ, auśanasāmnaḥ : tisraḥ : triṣṭubhaḥ |
hotuḥ pṛṣṭhe pañca bṛhatyaḥ : dvādaśa kakubhaḥ, viṣṭutiprakāre tathaivāmnānena tucasya tāvadārambhasyāsāt |
maitrāvaruṇapṛṣṭhe saptadaśa gāyatryaḥ, brāhmaṇācchaṃsisvāhākṛpṛṣṭhopari saptadaśasaptadaśa bṛhatyaḥ : ekaikatryāmbhāsatenaiva |
evaṃ pañcacatvāriṃśad bṛhatyo mukhyāḥ, ṣaṇṇāṃ gāyatrīṇāṃ caturviṃśatyakṣarāṇāṃ tripādāṃ madhye catasṛṇāṃ gāyatrīṇāṃ dvādaśabhirakṣaraiḥ : pādaiḥ sahitā dvādaśa |
pūrvoktā aṣṭāviṃśatyakṣarāḥ kakubho dvādaśa ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣarātmikā bṛhatyo bhavanti |

tadevaṃ saptapañcā- śat bṛhatyaḥ : tā etāḥ ṣaṇṇāṃ gāyatrīṇāṃ madhye ava- śiṣṭābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ gāyatrībhyāṃ saha saptadaśabhiḥ gāyatrībhiḥ : ekaikena pādena militāḥ : saptapañcāśat bṛhatyaḥ : catuścatvāriṃśadakṣarātmikāḥ saptapañcāśat triṣṭubho bhavanti |
anyathā pañcāne anyāsāṃ bṛhatīnām, hotuḥ pṛṣṭhe ca anyāsāṃ kakubhāṃ dāśatayībhyaḥ samānayane ṣaṭ‌saṃkhyanupapatteḥ |
atra hi na 'ṣaṭtriṃśat‌bhiḥ mādhyandinaṃ savanam' iti yathāśrutaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇya- mupapadyate, bādhārta |
ato jaghanyamādhyandinasavanapade eva lakṣaṇāmaṅgīkṛtya mādhyandinasavanasambhṛtā yāḥ sāmavede samāmnātāḥ, tāḥ bahiḥ ityarthāvagateḥ dāśatayībhyaḥ samānayane liṅganupapatteḥ |
" ityuktaṃ tat lakṣaṇāyā āvaśyakatve lāghavāt mādhyandinasavanastotrīyāṇāmeva lakṣaṇāt ānītānāmapi tattvopapatteḥ upekṣitam |
9. oṃ jyotiṣṭome bṛhadrathaṃtaryoḥ svayontyuttarā- prathanane saṃpāditayoḥ kakubhoriva gānam ||
bhāṣyam-- jyotiṣṭome śrūyate 'bṛhat pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' 'rayaṃtaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' iti |
rathaṃtarasya yonirbṛhatī 'abhi tvā śūra nonumo'ḍugdhā iva dhenavaḥ |
tasmāt sati ca asati ca dravye yājyākrayaṇamanuṣṭhātavyamiti |
atha yaduktaṃ lokavaditi, loke karma arthalakṣaṇaṃ bhavati, na śabdalakṣaṇam |
yathā artha:, tathā kriyate, na yathā śabda: |
vede tu śabdenaiva artha: avagamyate, tathaiva anuṣṭheyamiti |
ṭup-- prakaraṇamānāt apūrveprayuktaṃ tannimittaṃ ca iti uttara: ( pakṣa: ) |
soma-- ihāpi sāmānyaśrute: viśeṣeṣu avirodhāt viśeṣaviṣayatvam iti pratyakṣatvāt saṃgati: |
itha- mārjitameva dravyamapūrve sādhayati, nānyat iti niyama: |
jyotiṣṭome yājamānā: dharmā: bhoktṛtvāṃśena kevalapradhānārthā:, na tu kartṛtvāṃśena aṅgapradhānārthā: |
jyotiṣṭome ye darśapūrṇamāsavikārā:, teṣu yājamāna- mantrāṇāṃ nātideśa:, 'yaśo babhūva sa ā babhūva' iti yājamānamantrasya punarvidhāne gṛhamedhīyājamānayāpena taditaraparisaṃkhyāsiddhe: |
iti prāpte, sutasakṣānumantrā- thatvena tasya punarvidhāne'pi ādhyabhāgayoriva prakṛti- klṛptopakārārthatvena tadabhāvācca parisaṃkhyātvam |
bhāṣyam-- sahatvasya prāpaka: prayogavacana: anu- grahīṣyate iti padārthena anusamaya: |
bhakṣaṇaṃ vidyate, uta bhakṣaṇamanyatra prāthamyamātraṃ vidyate iti vicāraḥ |

kiṃ prāptam ? 'na cedanyena śiṣṭāḥ' (2| 4|69) iti (nyāyena) kathañcit anubādatve saṃbhavati viśiṣṭavidhānānupapatteḥ, prāthamyañca aprāpta- tvāt tadanuvādena bhakṣaṇavidhānāsaṃbhavāt, evaṃ vacanaṃ vyajyate 'yo vaṣaṭkurvaibhaḥ' sa prathamaḥ' |
nanu ca aprāptatvāt bhakṣo'pi anuvadituṃ na śakyate (uttaram-) samākhyāyā prāptatvāt anuvādo gamyate |
asti hi tasya (vaṣaṭkartuḥ) samākhyāyā camaseṣu bhakṣaḥ, sa śakyaḥ anuvaditum |
teṣāṃ ca (camasināṃ madhye) yo yadā vaṣaṭ karoti, sa tadā prathamo bhakṣyate |
tatra etat syāt, yoṣu camasāntareṣu ca prāthamyābhāt anuvādo nopapadyate |
nahi avaśyaṃ yadeva sarvatra prāptam, tadeva anuvaditavyam, sarvānuvādānāṃ yathāsaṃbhavaṃ prāpyapekṣa
12|11|126. jyotiṣṭome vaisarja nādihomeṣu ājyameva, na somaḥ ||
‘ vaisarja nāni juhoti ’ ityādimivirhitānāṃ saumi- kānāṃ darvihomāṇāṃ dravyākāṅkṣatvāt prakṛtaḥ soma eva vahyardhatvāt niyamyate |

iti prāpte, somadravyasya kati- payakāryeṣu āhavanīyādine taditareṣu tadabhāvavadhnanāt ājyasyaiva kośādī haviḥpadena nirdeśena tasya anā- diṣṭadravye pravṛtteḥ, ‘ ājyaṃ havirnādeśe ’ iti smṛtyā anumaterājyenaiva te homa bhaveyuḥ |
ata eva dhiṣṇya- vyāghāraṇasaṃtāpena ‘ ājyena pālītvataṃ śrīṇāti ’ ityatra ājyasya siddhavakṛtya anuvāda upapannaḥ |
jyotiṣṭome ‘ vrataṃ kuṇuta ’ iti mantraḥ payaḥpāna- rūpavratasaṃpādanapraiṣe anvitaḥ, na tu vāgvimoke |
‘ vrataṃ kuṇute vācaṃ visṛjati ’ iti vāgvisargakāle praiṣa- pāṭhaḥ |
āgnīdhrāderapi yajñatatvādihomādhikaraṇatvena āhava- nīyatvāvaśyambhāvāt auttaravedikadeva tasya praṇayanam |
‘ āgniprathamāḥ prāśno'bhiprājanti somaprathamā vā ’ iti śrutau prājña iti prāgābhimukhyena gamanavidhānāt |

‘ āgnīdhrāmābhyāṃ praṇīya- mānābhyāmanubrūhi ’ ityatra dvaṃdvāvagatasya agnipraṇayanasoma- rājapraṇayanayoḥ sāhityasya cānurodhena śālāmukhī yasyamī- vartitasolatāyā iva tadantarvartitana eva agneḥ praṇayanaṃ gārhapatyāpādānakatvādeva āgnīdhrīyasyā āhavanī- yaikadeśatvameveti na tasya homādhikaraṇatvam |
auttara- vedikāmipraṇayanottaramapi āgnīdhrīyapraṇayanaparyantam āhava- nīyāṃśasya iha sattvādeva āhavanīyāt ilyapādānātve- noktiḥ |
‘ eṣo'ta ūrdhvam ’ iti smṛtirapi āgnīdhrīya- praṇayanottarakālapareti tu bhāṣyam |
jyotiṣṭome ‘ śukrāgrān grahān gṛhṇīyādabhicarataḥ, manthyagrān gṛhṇīyādabhicaryamāṇasya ’ atra śukrādīnāṃ na dhārāgrahatvam |
sa cāpakarṣo dhārāgrāhado na tu sarvādā |
10|5|22, jyotiṣṭome śukrāgratvaṃ bṛhatsāmatve ‘ yadi bṛhatsāma śukrāgrān ’ grahān gṛhṇīyāt |
bhā. 3|7|21-24, jyotiṣṭome ṣoḍaśī tṛtīya- savane eva grāhyaḥ |
jyotiṣṭome ṣoḍaśī śrutaḥ agviṣṭome eva niviśate, na vikṛtau |
vi. 10|5|9, jyotiṣṭome ṣoḍaśisaṃsthe prātaragnihotra- prabhṛti pratihomānāmanuṣṭhānam |
jyotiṣṭome saṃdarśanaṃ śrutaṃ saṃkhāsyu sateṣu ca niviśate, na prakṛtau |
vā. 3|3|1124-31 jyotiṣṭome ‘ sa vaiva syāt ’ iti prāja- hitavādaḥ ||

‘ yasyaiṣa dhiṣṇyo vidhīyate so'nudhyāyati ’ ityā- dinā ‘ yajamānaṃ vā etadvikarṣante yadāhavanīyāt paśu- śrapaṇaṃ haranti, sa vaiva svāgnirmenvya vā kuryād yajamānasya sāmatvāya ’ ityantena paśuśrapaṇayo'rnirṇayyate |
tatra sa vaiva syāt ityanena āhavanīya evocyate |
‘ yaja- māno vā āhavanīyaḥ ’ ityupakāntatvena tasyaiva buddhistha- tvāt |
iti prāpte, prājahita eva tatpadenocyate, nirmenvyena saha tulyakoṭikavikalpikasāmarthyāt |
vaidikamanthya eva vā svālaukikamanthyatve veti tadarthāt |
āhava- nīyaharaṇe yajamānasya vikarṣaṇaṃ syāditi vinindya- yajamānasya ātmalābhāya vidhīyamānasya agneḥ āhava- nīyātiriktatvāvaśyambhāvācca |
jyotiṣṭome satyavacanādinivṛttena dārśikaṃ vrataṃ prasaṅga- siddham |
vi. 11|1|12, jyotiṣṭome sadaso nīca- mānādau dhṛṣṭyādikāmanā yājamānī, na tu ārvijī |
2|8|6, jyoti- ṣṭome saḍomaṇḍapopasthānaṃ prakṛtyā aindrayā ṛcā kartavyam, na tu dāśatayīsthayā kayācit |
4|3|15, jyotiṣṭome savanīyapaśupuroḍāśānāṃ savanīyapaśutantramadhyapātitvāt paśuḥ tantrī, puroḍāśaśca prasaṅgī |
jyotiṣṭome savanīyapuroḍāśānāṃ savanatraya- gatānāṃ kālabhedenānuṣṭhānamedāt tadīyahaviṣkṛdāhānamantrasya āvṛttiḥ |
vi. 11|1|21, jyotiṣṭome savanīya- puroḍāśeṣu anuyājaiḥ saha piṣṭalepaphlīkaraṇahomayo- notkarṣaḥ |
5|1|15. jyotiṣṭome sādanasaṃmārgādayo grahadharmāḥ savana- śraye'pi kartavyāḥ |
vi. 3|6|9. jyotiṣṭome sutyā parvaṇi, dīkṣaṇīyeṣṭistataḥ pūrvameva aparvaṇi kartavyā |
bhā. 12|1 9|29, jyotiṣṭome subrahmaṇyā''hvānārthe nigade ‘ indrāgaccha, hariva āgaccha, medhātithemeṣa, vṛṣaṇaśva mene, gauravaskandin, ahalyāyai jāra ’ ityādimantraḥ aindraḥ |
vikṛtau tu agniṣṭuti āgneyī subrahmaṇyā bhavati |
tena tatra ‘ agra āgaccha ’ iti ūhaḥ kartavyaḥ samavetāttvāt |
‘ harivaḥ, medhātithemeṣa ’ ityādī tu nohaḥ asama- vetāttve'pi stutiparatvāt |
yājñikāstu ‘ agra āgaccha rohitaśva bṛhadmāno dhūmaketo jātavedo vicaraṇe ’ iti ūhaṃ kurvanti |

‘ sūryeṇa juhoti ’ ityatra prakṛtasarpasya dhiṣyāṇāṃ vyāghāraṇe'pi prakṛtatvāt grahacamasamānyatarasin-karaṇatvena prāpte, ‘ droṇakalaśāt paripluvayā rājanamādāya prayahṇā- sīno dhiṣṇyān vyāghārayati ’ iti śrutau ādānakaraṇa- tvena upasthitāyāḥ paripluvāyā eva vyāghāraṇe'pi karaṇatvam |
saṃkarṣa. 3|2|19. jyotiṣṭome ‘ somena yajeta ’ atra yajatiḥ apūrvasya karmaṇo vidhāyakaḥ |
na tu ‘ aindravāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti ’ ‘ maitrāvaruṇaṃ gṛhṇāti ’ ityādīnāṃ karmaṇāṃ samudāyasyā- nuvādakaḥ |
bhā. 2|1|6|17-20, jyotiṣṭome ‘ somena yajeta ’ ‘ dakṣiṇāṃ juhoti ’ ‘ hiraṇmayātreya dadāti ’ ityatra pratiśabdam apūrvabhedaḥ |
jyotiṣṭome somasya mānamupāvaharaṇaṃ ca vāsasā kartavyam ||
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ yatrakaccit mānaṃ yenakenacit upāvaharaṇaṃ kāryam, uta vāsasi mānaṃ vāsasā ca upāvaharaṇamiti |
kiṃ prāptam ? arthāta yatrakaccit mānam, yenakenacit upāvaharaṇam |
vacanāt vāsasi mānam, vāsasā copāva- haraṇam |
yacca prāptamuttaraviṣayatvayā kīrtyate, na tatra pūrvottarapakṣāmyāṃ prayojanamiti |
bhāṭṭa— (20-21-23 iti śrīṇyapi bhāṣya- sthāni adhikaraṇāni atra ekīkṛtāni iti jñeyam ) jyotiṣṭome ‘vāsasi minoti, vāsasā copāvaharati’ iti vacanāt somamānāpavaharaṇe vāsaḥsādhanake |
aha- geṇe ca pratyahaṃ somopāvaharaṇārthaṃ vāsomedaḥ syāt |
havirdhānaśakṭe hi sthāpitaḥ somaḥ yāvān ekasyāhaḥ paryāptaḥ, tāvān pratyahaṃ vāsasā upāvahartavyaḥ |
avaśiṣṭaśca śakṭe eva vāsasā upanadaḥ sthāpyaḥ |
tataśca iha arthāt vāso'ntaraṃ prāguttamāt utpāditavyam, uttama tu prakṛtitvat mānavakhaṇḍena |
na ca prāguttamamapi ekameva mānavakhāt bhinnaṃ vaktramupādāya tenaiva pratya- mupāvaharaṇaṃ kartavyamiti vācyam |
tasya ca maitrāvaruṇadaṇḍānvayena (4|2|6 ) grāvastotrīyā'nuṣṭhumāvatrāṇastadudghājaka- tvena prāyahikatvāt havyabhāvāt |
vakrāntarāṇyapi ca na mānakāle eva upādeyāni |

prakṛtau hi saukaryāt kraya- kālīnamānavāsasaiva upanadasya abhivaṣavelāyāṃ tenaiva vāsasā upāvaharaṇaṃ kṛtam, na tu eva sa śāstrārthaḥ ataśca mānakāle tāvadgrahaṇe pramāṇābhāvāt upāva- haraṇakāle eva tadupādānam |
jyotiṣṭome somāme pūtīkāḥ ādārāḥ phālgu- nāni vā pratinidhiḥ |
tatra somasya pūtīkādīnāṃ ca na vaikalpikatvam |
vi. 6|3|13, jyotiṣṭome somakrayaḥ ajā- hiraṇyādibhiḥ daśābhirdravyaiḥ kriyate |
12|4|13, jyotiṣṭome somadravyasya arthāpatyā pākṣikaprāptasya ‘somena yajeta’ iti niyamavidhiḥ |
4|2|9. jyoti- ṣṭome somapravaṇe ‘anaḍvāhau yunakti’ iti dvivacanaṃ vivakṣitameva |
bhāṣyam— idaṃ saṃdihyate kiṃ yaḥkaścit anujñāpa- yitavyaḥ, uta samānapātraḥ iti |
anujñāpanasya ca etat rūpam, yatra anyena kartavyam anyaścikīrṣet, saḥ ‘anumanyasva’ iti brūte, sahabhojanādi vā ācaritukām : cittamanya anukūlayati ( iti ) |
nahi tatra anyena kartavyam anyo vā cikīrṣati, sahabhojanādvā padārthe samānayati |
ekapātre tu some sādhāraṇaṃ saṃskārtavye, nyāyena samo vibhāgaḥ prāpnoti |
tatra avibhajya pīya- māne kadācit anyena pātavyam anyaḥ pibet |
tatra anujñāpanaṃ saṃbhavati ‘tvayā ardhaṃ pātavyaṃ mayā ardham, kadācit aham abhyadhikaṃ nyūnaṃ vā pibeyam, tat anujñātumarhasi’ iti |
‘ekapātre vā pānaṃ tvayā saha ācaran ahaṃ tava cittaprasādanaṃ nyāyyam’ |
vā— yadi etadantāprāptaṃ vidhīyeta, tato yataḥ:- kutaścit prārthyat |
tasya yādṛśe vipaye prāptiḥ, sā na nivāryate |
samānapātrāṇāṃ tu ‘samaṃ syācchrutatvāt’ ityanena nyāyena samavibhāge sati vaidhyamabhakṣako anujñāpya kāryam |
satyapi somena anucchicchatve tatkṛte cāṣṭadoṣābhāve, pratyakṣeṇaiva sahabhojanāt vyalīkotpatterupapatteḥ |
sūtrā- rthastu- tat anuṣṭhānam ekapātrāmeva syāt |
bhāṭṭa— seyamanujñā yasya ekasminneva pātre bhakṣasaktiḥ tathaiva grāhyā dṛṣṭārthatālābhāt, bhāgādhikyādiprasaṅga- nimittakalahachānnivṛttyarthatvāt |
ata eva yatra ekasmin pātre eka eva bhakṣayitā, tatra naiva anujñāgrahaṇam |
jyotiṣṭome somabhakṣe anujñāyāḥ yācane dāne ca arthānusāreṇa mantrakramaḥ |
bhāṣyam— etadagatam ‘tadupahūta upahavya’ ityanena anujñāpye iti |
atha prativacane saṃdehaḥ kiṃ laukikaṃ prativacanam, uta etadevaiti |
kiṃ prāptam ? etad vaidikaṃ praśne viniyuktam |
yat asya pūrvam ‘upahūtaḥ’ iti prativacanasya samartham, tat prativacanakāryaṃ bhaviṣyati |
pūrve hi praśnena bhavitavyam, tataḥ prativacanena |
vā— vadanam iti vā pāṭhaḥ ( sūtre ) |
arthakramena pāṭhakramaṃ bādhitvā ‘upahūtaḥ’ ityevam abhyanujñāyāṃ prayoktavyaḥ |
soma— mantreṇa anujñāne ukte tatra mantraniyama- vicārāt saṃgatiḥ |
katham ? ‘havirdhāne prāvabhiriṣupa āhavanīye hutvā pratyahaḥ paretya sadasi bhakṣān bhakṣayanti’ iti |
na tāvadeśa kramo vidhīyate home nivṛtte tato bhakṣaṇamiti |
dvayośca kramorvidhānāt, abhiśutya hutveti vākyaṃ bhidyeta |
na ca makṣaṇābhāvena homāmiṣavau codyete abhiśavasya homādyarthatvāt, homaśca phalyārthatvāt |
ye abhiśuṣṇanti juhvati ca, te bhakṣyantīti |
katham ? evaṃ hi āha ‘havirdhāne prāvabhiriṣupa āhavanīye hutvā pratyahaḥ paretya sadasi bhakṣān bhakṣayanti’ iti |
tatra homāmiṣavau tāvat saguṇau prāptau na vidhīyete |
dīkṣāvākyavat ( ‘adhvaryuryajamānaṃ dīkṣayitvā brahmāṇaṃ dīkṣayati’ ityādi- vākyavat ) kramārthā śrutiḥ : iti cet, tatra nāsti |
nahi hutasya abhiśavaḥ saṃbhavati, na ca bhakṣitasya somaḥ |
āhavanīyedeśāt sadaḥ ( dvitīyāntamidam ) āgacchantaḥ pratyahaḥ eva pratipadyante |
hotrādīnāṃ ca sadasi dharmaprabhṛteḥ avaśyaṃ vaṣaṭkārasamāravyā- nimittabhakṣārthaṃ sadaḥ ( sadasi ityarthaḥ ) somā ānetavyāḥ |
tatra hutvā abhiṣupya ityetadupādānasya etat prayojanam, kathaṃ nāma tatsamāna- kartṛko bhakṣaḥ sidhyediti |
bhakṣasya ca somasaṃskāramavagatameva iti nāṅgatvāmitarasaṃbandha- śravaṇam |
kiṃvā'bhiṣavahomī ca, tatrādyo'stvūyā diśā li, havirdhāne'bhiṣupyāya hutvā sadasi bhakṣayet |
) bhāṭṭa— idamaparaṃ bhakṣasya nimittam 'havirdhāne āśvabhirabhiṣupyāhavanīye hutvā pratyakṣaṃḥ pareṇa sadasi bhakṣān bhakṣayanti' iti |
atra havirdhānādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ guṇānāṃ vidhyānatvāt arthāta prāptatvāt kevalaṃ homā- bhiṣavabhakṣamānakartṛkaṃ bhakṣamātre aprāptaṃ vidheyam |
yadyapi cā hariyojanādau homābhiṣavabhakṣamānakartṛpi bhakṣaṇaṃ prāptam, tathāpi abyuttyānuvāde vākyavaidhavyapatteḥ tasya vidheyatā |
sā ca na pūrvavihitamevabhikṣu, sarvatra utpatti- śiṣṭaviśeṣavihitakartṛntarāvāt |
ataśca homābhiṣava- samānakartṛkaṃ bhakṣaṇāntarameva vidhīyate, kartṛrupaguṇānu- rodhena vā aveṣṭivat ṣaṭkārabhakṣasyaiva prayogabhedamātram |
na ca utpattau niyāmakatvāt ; prāthamyasyaivotpatyanvayino vaṣaṭkāravākye niyāmakatvāt |
prāthamyasyāpi prayogānvaye tu karmāntarameva iti dhyeyam |
atra ca home abhiṣavabhakṣamānakartṛkatvasya adhvaryavasamākhyātvadeva prāpte pradhānānyasya abhyāhitatvācca bhakṣe eva abhiṣavabhakṣa- kartṛkatvaṃ homābhakṣamānakartṛkatvat vidhīyate |
ataśca yo yadabhyāse homābhiṣavabhyakartā adhvaryuḥ prati- praśāstā anyo vā grahe camase vā, sa tatra bhakṣayet |
varaṇadikaṃ hi kṛtyardhatāt tadaṅgapadārthakaraṇāya puruṣānupādātuṃ kriyate|
vikrayastu avihitatvāt vihitakrayānyathā'nupa- pattyā āvaśyaka'pi doṣasvīkāreṇa rāgataḥ pravṛttapuruṣa- kartṛkavikrayopajīvanenāpi krayasiddheḥ nākṣepācca anaṅgam|
katham ? naitadevaṃ saṃbadhyate, abhipyuta tato hutvā tato bhakṣyadeti|
nānena abhipavasva homasva na kramaḥ kīyate, abhipyu ye juhvati, te bhakṣyantīti|
vākyaṃ dhyeyaṃ midhyeta, abhipyuta bhakṣyanti, hutvā bhakṣyantīti|
tasmāt homāmiṣavayoḥ parasparaṃ saṃbandho nāstīti ekenāpi bhakṣaṇaṃ saṃcavyeta, apareṇāpi abhipyuta bhakṣya- yantīti|

dup-- (havirdhāne grāvabhirabhipyuta ityādi vākyam abhipavahomasaṃmānakartṛkabhakṣaṇavidhāyakamiti tṛtīye [ 3|5|12|32 ] sādhitam, iha ca tadeva upodghāta- tvena smārayati-) satyapi padārthārbhidhāne (yadyapi bahavaḥ padārthāḥ homāmiṣavatatkramapralayamanādayaḥ abhi- pīyante tathāpi) homāmiṣavayoḥ kramo na vidhīyate (homāmiṣavo tatkramaśca na vidhīyante ityarthaḥ), artha
athavā sāmānyaṃ tasmiṃśca viśeṣe anyasmiṃśca ityevaṃ saṃdigdham |
yadi varmādidhi- karaṇatā eṣu homeṣu śrūyate, sā pakṣe na bhavati iti vikalpamāśrayatā pramāṇāpekṣā kalpayitavyā |
atha varmādha- dhikaraṇatā eṣu na śrūyate, tataḥ pakṣe sā bhavati iti pramāṇāpaiva |
atrocyate arthāta pakṣe bhāvaḥ, sa cārtho homanivṛttiḥ āhavanīyateti, tanna |
yadi homanivṛttimātraṃ kartavyam, tata āhavanīyenāpi arthāt sidhyet |
yadyapi varmādhikaraṇatā'pi vidhī- yate home, guṇabhūtatvāt homaṃ samīcīnaṃ karoti |
tasmin anupasaṃhriyamāṇe, na yathāśrutaṃ kṛtaṃ syāt |
saṃbandhe'pi vidhīyamāne dravyaṃ vidhīyate ekaṃ sādhyam, ekaṃ sādhanam |
saṃbandhe- 'pi ca śrayamāṇe avaśyopādāttavyo bhavati homaḥ |
kathamaprāptiḥ ? varmādhikaraṇatāyāṃ satyām āhavanīyādhikaraṇatāyāṃ jñānaṃ karaṇaṃ ca prati asaṃbhavāt |
yadi varmādhikaraṇamapi jñāyate, na tadāhavanīyādhi- karaṇaṃ śakyaṃ jñātuṃ kartuṃ vā |
yathā śakyate tathā kartavyam, ityāsyātāthau bhaviṣyati |
syādeta- devaṃ yadi varmādibādhāmantareṇa āhavanīyopadeśo nāvakalpeta |
dvedhā hi śakyate kartuṃ varmādi bādhayitvā, parihṛtya vā |
tatra bādhārthāṃ varmaṇi iti pratyayaḥ apahṛyate |
aśakyau'sau kartumapi kalpi kiṃ na bhavati |
āha, yo'yaṃ sāmānyapratyaya ucyate sa sarveṣu viśeṣeṣu kāryamāsañjati |
evaṃ cet varmādihomeṣu cānyatra ca tena āhavanīyo vihitaḥ |
tatra yo varmādi- home āhavanīyapratyayaḥ, sa na śakyaḥ parihartum |
yadi cābhidevad, ajāyate gavi nāvakalpeta, pūrva- darśanābhāvāt |
abhivadan vā na mukhyayā vṛtyā abhivadet |
tasmāt varmādihome śrutyā varmādiṣu prāpteṣu aśakya āhavanīyo vidhātuṃ ceti |
nanu viparītamāpi etat syāt, āhavanīye prāpte varmā- dipratyayo na śakya iti |
bhavedevam, kintu viśeṣe varmādipratyayaḥ śrautaḥ, āhavanīyapratyayo lakṣaṇayā |
home hi sa viśiṣṭe vidhīyate, na ahome etat viśeṣayati |
tasmādvarmādihomaṃ varjayitvā anyeṣu homeṣu āhavanīyaḥ kariṣyate iti |

idānīṃ prāsavāṣṭrapā- nyāt sāmānyasya viśeṣeṇa bādhaścintyate ) nanu adṛṣṭā- rthatvāt padārthaniyoḥ na vikalpaḥ, na vādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ ( kintu samuccaya eva virodhābhāvāt tena anārabhyamadhi- karaṇam ) |
katham ? ( adṛṣṭārthatā ? uttaram -) yāga ādhāraṃ nākṣipatti, vinā'pyādhāreṇa sidhyamāna- tvāt |
yadi ca ( ādhāram ) ākṣipeta, ( tathā sati ) āhavanīyo niyamyeta |
yathā 'āgneyo'ṣṭākapālo bhavati' ( aṣṭākapālena yatkiñcit prakṛti-) dravyākṣiptam, tatra brīhayo niyamyante |
iha ( tu ) ādhāraḥ vacanasāmarthyāt vidhīyate ( na tu ākṣito
tasmāt yathā prāyājāḥ ( adṛṣṭena upakurvanti -) nopahomādibhiḥ ( saha ) vikalpyante, na ca bādhyābādhakabhāvaḥ |
tathā ca na devatā''śiśraddhakriyāṇāṃ pratinidhiḥ ityuktam ( 6|3|150 ) |
tena pratinidhikaṇḍānyaye sthite ( 6|4|13-17 ) ( samuccayasyaiva yuktatvāt ) katha- midam ( adhikaraṇaṃ ) ārabhyate ? ucyate, satyam |
' āgneyo'ṣṭākapālo bhavati ' iti ( anena ) yathā dravyākṣepaḥ, tathā na ( yāgena ) ākṣita āhavanīyaḥ; tathāpi na anākāṅkṣitaḥ saṃbadhyate |
( tathāhi ) ' yadāhavanīye ' iti ( sasampannam ) sākāṅkṣam ' juhoti ' iti ( anena ) nirākāṅkṣīkriyate, juhoti ityāpi ( sākāṅkṣam ) āhavanīyena ( nirākāṅkṣī- kriyate ) |

yadi ( hi atra ) ākāṅkṣā na syāt ( tathā sati ' yadāhavanīye juhoti ' iti ) saṃbandha eva na syāt ( tena ādhāratvena ākāṅkṣatvāt tataḥ ) tataḥ sa ca ( āhavanīyaḥ ) vidhīya- mānaḥ ( homasya ) dṛṣṭenaiva upakaroti, dravyadānasya ādhāratāṃ pratipadyate |

( tena dṛṣṭayorapi padārthava- nīyayoḥ ādhāratvāt tasya ca dṛṣṭatvāt na samuccayaḥ iti dṛṣṭārthatāṃ matvā codayati ) evaṃ varmādimāne sidhyato bādhavikalpau, pratinidhistu prāpnoti ( dṛṣṭārthatvāt ) dravyāntaravaditi |
tatra ( hi ) ' āgneyo'ṣṭākapālo bhavati ' iti yāgaḥ phale coditaḥ |
( tatra ) yadā brīhayo na santi prakānte karmaṇi, tadā''pi yāgacodanā ( tannirvṛttyartham ) dravyamā- kṣipatti |
yadā tu ( prakānte karmaṇi ) āhavanīyo nāsti, tadā ( yāga- codanā ) nākṣipatyāhavanīyam ( vinā'pi tena yāgasyopapatteḥ ) |
nanu anena nyāyena ( yāgacodanayā anākṣitatvāt na pratinidhiḥ iti ) devatāyāḥ pratinidhiḥ prāpnoti ( yāgena ākṣitatvāt ) |
yadi ( mukhya- ) devatāśabdo na smaryate ( tatastasya ) sādṛśyameva na jñāyate ( iyaśakaya- tvāt pratinidhiḥ ) |
atha ( tu ) smaryate ( tathā sati labdhe mukhye ) sa evoccāraṇīyaḥ ( na pratinidhirti ) |

idaṃ mataṃ dūṣayati -) evaṃ varyamāne yadā brīhayo naṣṭāḥ prakānte karmaṇi ( tatra ) vacanasāmarthyāt yāgaḥ avaśyaṃ samāpanīyaḥ, na ca brīhīna sarti, teṣāṃ cāsaraṇāt na śaknoti sādṛśyaṃ saṃpādayitum, īdṛśyāvasthāyāṃ yāgo naiva kāryaḥ |
na ca īdṛśī avasthā nāsti iti ( pratyava- sthātavyam ) |
tasmāt ( sādṛśyābhāvāt devatāyāḥ pratinidhirnāsti iti -) etadayuktam |
tena anyā apyuktaḥ ( devatāyāḥ prati- nidhibhāve ) vaktravyā |
( prakṛtamupasaṃharati -) tena ( adṛṣṭā- rthatvāt ) āhavanīyasya ( yāgacodanayā ) anā- kṣepāt pratinidhikaṇḍena nedaṃ viruddham |
apica āhavanīyaḥ padānirapekṣaḥ saptamyā ādhāratvaṃ pratipadyate, padamapi āhavanīyanirapekṣam, ( tasmādapi asamuccayaḥ ) |
yathā ' brīhibhiḥ ' iti ( karaṇa- ) vibhaktiḥ brīhīna yavanirapekṣān pratipādayati yathā ' yavaiḥ ' iti |

tatra yaḥ samuccayaṃ kuryāt, nāsau puroḍāśaṃ na nirvartayati ( śakyo hi miśrairapi puroḍāśo nirvarta- yitum ) kintu vākyena yo'rthaḥ pratipāditaḥ ( nairapekṣya- rūpaḥ ) taṃ bādheta ( tena śabdādeva tatra vikalpaḥ, na vastusvabhāvāt ) |
evamihāpi ( anirapekṣatvāt ) ( miśrāmyāmapi ) puroḍāśo nirvartate ( eva ), na ( tu ) pratyakṣavirodhaḥ ( kaścidasti ) |
padārthanīyayoḥ samuccaye ( sati ) pade vā āhavanīyo nikṣiṣyeta, āhavanīyo vā padam |
yadā āhavanīyaḥ ( pade nikṣiptaḥ homasya ) adhikaraṇam ( bhavati ) tadā padamadhikaraṇaṃ na syāt |
evaṃ pade'pi ( homādhāre vaktavyam ) tasmāt na vastuto na śabdena padārthanīyayoḥ samuccayaḥ ghaṭate |
' yade juhoti ' ' varmani juhoti ' iti juhotiśravaṇaṃ tulyāhavanīyapadayoḥ |
tasmāt ( sāmānya- viśeṣabhāvāt ) bādhyābādhakabhāvo na ghaṭate |
'gārhapatye patnīsaṃyājān juhoti' atra patnīsaṃyājaśabdo (yāga-) viśeṣaṃ brūte |
yathā 'dadhi brāhmaṇebhyo dīyatāṃ takraṃ kauṇḍinyāya' iti |
(nyāyaṃ dṛṣṭānte tāvat darśayati-) tatra brāhmaṇaśabdena (brāhmaṇa-) jātiḥ varṇaiṣāpattā (nyakttvaṃ lakṣyante) kauṇḍinye vyaktireva (varṇaiṣāpattā) |
yathā golam aśvādibhyo vyatiricyate śāvaleyādīn anveti |
na ca (īdṛśam) kauṇḍinye vastu vidyate (avāntarasāmānyam,) yat pratyakṣaṃ gṛhītvā śabdaḥ pravartate |
apica vākyārthe padavacanamidaṃ ( 'kuṇḍina- syāpatyaṃ gotram' iti) vākyārthaścet (padasya vācyaḥ, tathā sati) na (idaṃ) sāmānyaṃ pratipādayati |
nahi jātiḥ kuṇḍinasthā- patyaṃ bhavati) tasmāt viśeṣa eva (anena) śabdocyate |
tatra ca anantarameva kāryam (abhidheyaṃ hi śabdasya anantara- manvahitam) |
itarasmin (sāmānyaśāstre) sāmānyena (kāryayogau) viśeṣaḥ (paścāt lakṣaṇā) prakaraṇādibhiḥ (sahāyaiḥ) avacchettavyaḥ |
tasmāt tatra viprakarṣaḥ, iha tu sannikarṣaḥ |
(dārṣṭāntikena nyāyaṃ yojayati-) anena nyāyena (patnīsaṃyājeṣu viśeṣaśrutena) gārhapatyena āhavanīyo bādhyate |
ayanā idamevodāharaṇam (saṃbhavati, atrāpi asyaiva bādhabādhakabhāvaḥ asyaiva sāmānyaviśeṣaśabde) |
tatra āhavanīyo na śakyate vidhātum, padena homasya nyātattvāt |
āhavanīyo vidhīyamānaḥ utpattivākyena yādṛśā homā avagatāḥ, tānanuya vidhī- yate |
tatra śuddheṣu (ādhāreṣu homeṣu) vidhātuṃ (āhavanīyo yujyate, yogyatvāt |
adhikaraṇopadeśe (ye sādhikaraṇa evātpannāḥ, teṣu) na ghaṭate ayogyatvāt |
tasmāt atrāpi asyaiva bādhaḥ, iti āhavanīyaśāstraṃ viṣayāntaraparaṃ bhavati |
nāsti liṅgādidacd bādho nāpi bādho- 'tideśavat' iti (padāhavanīyostulyatvatvāt vikalpa eva yuktaḥ |
' patnīsaṃyājādiṣu śrutvā śrīprāptaṃ gārhapatyādikam, lakṣaṇyā mantharaprāpta- māhavanīyaṃ nirūṇaddhi iti bādhaḥ |
soma — sūtrārthastu- aviśeṣeṇa yacchāstraṃ tasya ārāt dūre viśeṣaśiṣṭaṃ syāt, viśeṣaviṣaye sāmānya- śāstraṃ na pravartate iti yāvat |
yataḥ sāmānyaśāstraṃ kiṃ yāvadiśeṣaviṣayam ityevaṃ saṃdigdhatvena vilambitam, vikalpasyānyāyyatvācca iti |
' bhāṭṭa — sāmānyaśāstrasya klaptatve'pi taddhitāhavanī- yādyapekṣayā viśeṣaśāstravihitapadādeḥ prābalyameva |

na ca homasyārthaṃ vinā''kṣepamātratayā upapatteḥ padāhava- nīyasyāpi adṛṣṭārthatve saptamyantatvena adhikaraṇatayaiva tajjana- nāt ubhayośca nirapekṣayoḥ pramitahomādhikaraṇatvānyathā- 'nupapattyā virodhavyāvaśyakatvena sāmānyaśāstrasya taddiṣaye bādhopapatteḥ |

sāmānyaśāstraṃ taccihyajuhoteḥ homasāmānya- vācitvāt vyaktilakṣaṇayā tadacchinnavyaktimātre āhava- nīyaṃ vidadhat śakyasaṃbandhāllocanena nirjñātasaṃbandhaśakala- vyaktilakṣaṇapūrvakaṃ yāvat padahomamadhikṛtya lakṣyeta tāvat vijātīyahome padasya vihitatvāt tenaiva nirākāṅkṣaḥ pada- homo nāhavanīyaṃ gṛhṇāti |
yadyapi ca vijātīyahomo'pi juhotinā lakṣya eva, lakṣyatvā''cchedakavaijātyasyāpi tatra lakṣaṇā, juhoteḥ vyāpakabhūtahomasāmānyavācitvāt
tathāpi tasya vidhinatvena jhaṭityu- pasthitatvāt prābalyam |
atra hi padaviśiṣṭo vijātīya- homaḥ eva vidhīyate |
yadyapi ca vākyāntareṇa homaprāptirbhavet tathāpi tanmātrānuvādena prākaraṇikavākyena padidhānāt, prākaraṇikatvādi tasya prābalyam, niravakāśatvādi ca tat |
āntimātraṃ tu etat vākyādarśanajanitam, tadvākyadarśane sati bādhyate ityuktadāt |
evaṃ viśeṣavicinā sāmānyavidhivat sāmānyaniṣedho- 'pi bādhyate iti bodhyam |
ata eva 'na hiṃsyāt' iti niṣedho vihitahiṃsāyāṃ na pravartate, tasya vihitāti- rikte sāvakāśatvāt |
nanu niṣedhasya saṃkoce pramāṇā- bhāvaḥ, tena hiṃsāmātrasya pāpasādhanatvāvagatāvapi vidhinā vaidhahiṃsāyāṃ sarvatra upakārāt hi sādhanatvāvagatau bādhakā- bhāvāt |
ata eva laukikahiṃsāyāmapi tādṛśānarthyaṃ balavadveṣābhāvadaśāyāṃ tātkālikatve rāgau- tkaṭyamayāne dṛśyate eva pravṛttiḥ |
sarvatraiva hi pravarta- nāyāstadviṣaye yāgādau vastuto yo rāgautkaṭyaviṣayaḥ svargādiḥ |
niṣedhena ca sva- viṣaye hiṃsādau vastuto yo dveṣotkaṭyaviṣayaḥ pāpadiḥ, tatsādhanatvamātramanumīyate |
rāgadveṣayo rautkaṭyaṃ tu janmā- ntarīyakarmavaśāt kadācitkamite na tatra vidhiniṣedhayo- rvyāpāraḥ |
tadyāpārabhūtayośca pāpasādhanatvasvargasādhana- tvayoḥ tātkālikasukhaduḥkhāsādhanatvavat naiva kaści- dvirodhaḥ |
ato daikṣayādyadiṣuhiṃsāyāḥ satyapi pratyavāyaśabdena ca ṛtūpakāramityādisādhanatvāvirodhāt na niṣedhasya tadātiriktaviṣayatvam |
yatrāpi nityapuṇyayāga- sthale akaraṇe pratyavāyaśravaṇam, tatrāpi karaṇe svalpaḥ pratyavāyaḥ akaraṇe bhūyān, ityevaṃ kalpanāt pravṛttyupapatteḥ na ko'pi virodhaḥ |
ata eva 'japyenaiva tu saṃsidhyed brāhmaṇo nātra saṃśayaḥ |
ata eva sāṅkalyā- nām ayameva siddhānta iti cet |
satyam ayamapiprāyo jaiminivāsapraśnānām, 'dharmeṇa pāpamapanudati' 'pravṛtti- saṃjñake dharme phalamambudayaḥ paraḥ |
na hi dharmādbhavet kiñcit pāpaṃ narakadaṃ ca cit |
ityādyasaṃkucadadṛṣṭi- śrutismṛtipurāṇetihāsavaśāt pāpājanakatvavyāpyaṃ dharma- tvam, pāpajanakatvavyāpyaṃ cādharmatvaṃ pratīyate |
ata eva kaiścidyathāvidhiḥ 'yatkarmavidhineṣedhaśca tasya liṅga- vācyatvamapi aṅgīkriyate |

ataśca vidhivisthale pravartaneyā icchādhanatvānumānavat tena pāpajanakatvasyāpyanumānāt tadvirodhena niṣedhaḥ tadātiriktaviṣayaḥ eva pāpajanakatvaṃ kalpayan tadatiriktaviṣayaḥ : saṃpadyate, iti siddho- 'pi trāpi viśeṣavicinā sāmānyaniṣedhasya saṃkocātmako bādhaḥ |
viśeṣaniṣedhena paraṃ sāmānyavidherna saṃkocaḥ, apitu vikalpaḥ : ityuktam, na tu vaiparītye'pi |
ata eva vyāsasūtraṃ 'aśuddhamiti cenna śabdāt' (3|1|25 brasū.) iti |
10. jyotiṣṭomādau sāmidhinye 'agnipomīyasya paśupuroḍāśamanu devasuvāṃ havīṃṣi nirvapati' eṣāmaṣṭānāṃ haviṣāṃ puroḍāśadhamaiḥ prasaṅgasiddhiḥ, na tu haviṣāṃ svadharmā'nuṣṭhānam |
bhāṣyam-- jyotiṣṭome śrūyate 'payo vrataṃ brāhmaṇasya, yavāgū rājanyasya, āmiṣā vaiśyasya' iti |
suvaṃ ca sucaśca samuddhi, patnī saṃnahyatyenodehi' ( ājyena udehi ) iti |
tathā vājapeye śrūyate, 'darbhamayaṃ vāso bhavati' iti |
paśau saṃśatahomaḥ, 'yathapaśu- māyumakṛtoro ( akṛta uraḥ ) vā padirāhate, agnirmā tasmādenaso viśānmuñcatvaṃhasaḥ' iti |
tathā 'yo'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ' iti vacanam |
teṣu saṃdehaḥ kiṃ yasyāparaṃ bhojanaṃ na vidyate, sa payo vratayet yavāgumāmiṣkāṃ vā, uta vidyamāne'pi |
tathā, yaḥ apreṣitaḥ praiṣārthaṃ na pratipadyate, sa preṣitavyaḥ, uta pratipadyamāne'pīti |
tathā, yasya sūtramayaṃ vāso nāsti, sa darbhamayaṃ paridadhīta, uta vidyamāne'pīti |
tathā yasya paśurmāyuṃ kuryāt, uro vā padirhyāt, sa etena mantreṇa juhuyāt, utānyo'pīti |
tathā yo dveṣṭi kaṃ cintyena ca dviṣyate, sa eva mantra
prathamaṃ tāvat dīkṣaṇīyāyāḥ yājurveda- diktvāt ṣāḍguṇyaṃ prāpnuvan prāsam, tacca codakaprāptena prāk sviṣṭakṛtaḥ prathamasthāne, madhyamena iḍāyāḥ, śeṣaṃ tṛtīyasthāne ityanena bādhyate |

yadyapi ubhayorapi vāca- nikātvaṃ viśeṣaviṣayatvaṃ ca tulyaṃ yatkiñcicchandasya prāti- svikarūpeṇaiva aśeṣapadārthābhivācitvāt, tathāpi yatki- ñcidityasya sāvakāśātvāt 'yāvatyā' ityādisvareṇaiva bādhyo yuktaḥ |
tathāca dīkṣaṇīyādi- śabdānāṃ pradhānamātravācakatvā tanmātra eva 'yāvatyā' iti svaraḥ, agneṣu tu yatkiñcicchandaprāpitaṣāḍguṇyameva bhavati |
medanahomasya dṛṣṭarūpa- kapālajanakatvasya bādhitatvāt ārādupakārakatvamiti viśeṣaḥ |
ata eva anutpādanaprayojanābhāvāt agni- hotre hute etadaprāpyasthityevaṃprāyaiḥ : 'ahute agnihotre' ityanuvādaḥ |
medanahomastu kapālakāryai niṣpanne'pi udghā- sanāt pūrvaṃ mantreṇeti viśeṣaḥ |
sarvathā darśāye praṇīta- syāpi agneḥ agnihotropayogitvāt nimittasaṃskārayoḥ ubhayorapi sattvena tadarthaṃ kartavyaiva iṣṭiḥ |
na ca tathāpi daśādau vaiṣamyamatroddaraṇābhāvāt udghṛtāgnināśā- bhāvena nimittābhāvaḥ; udghṛtatvasya havirbhavyatvavat agniviśeṣatvena avivakṣitatvāt |
iti prāpte, nātra udghṛtatvaṃ uddeśyaviśeṣaṇam, kariṣyamāṇaprayogopayogya- dughṛtatvāvacchinnapratiyogitākavināśasya nimitta
( vyaktiviśeṣadeśena vidhīyamānena śrautena ) takṣadānena kauṇḍinyāya ' iti |
( tadevāha - ) na ca kauṇḍinye vastu vyaktāveva kriyākriye |
śabdārthe saṃbhavāttena vidyate avāntarasāmānyaṃ, yat pratyayena gṛhītvā śabdaḥ kimarthaṃ vicāraṇā |
dadhi vibhremya ityādau phalaṃ apica vākyārthet na sāmānyaṃ pratyāyayati |
vyaktipakṣe vikalpaḥ syāt dviśeṣa eva śabdenocyate |
tatra cānantare eva kāryam, kauṇḍinye dadhitakrayoḥ |
nahi ekasyaiva śāstrasya kiñcit viśeṣaśrutena gārhapatyena ( patnīsaṃyajeṣu ) āhavanīyo prati sannādaḥ, kiñcit prati asattvamiti yujyate |
ṭup. 10|8|16 pṛ. 2072-73. tena ' dadhi brāhmaṇebhyo dīyatāṃ takraṃ kauṇḍinyāya ' ityādau takrakauṇḍinyanyāyaḥ |
' vyavahārā hi dṛśyante pratibrāhmaṇaṃ śāstrābhāvāt ekaṃ śāstram |
dadhitakrādidānādau kauṇḍinye nāsti ityucyate, tato mātrādiṣvapi apra- kauṇḍinyabrāhmaṇādiṣu |
atha ' tat prati nāsti, itarān prati asti ' itye- ratnākara. śrovā. vanavāde 15. tadapi ekavastuni vipralipsedhāmākam |
na cātra pratipattibhedo vidyate, yena saṃtravyahaṇagrahaṇāt avirodhaḥ syāt |
na ca sakṛdgrahyamāṇatvāt śāstrabhedo'vagamyate, yena ' anyasya sattvam anyasya cāsattvam ' ityami- dhīyeta |
vyaktipakṣe ca kadācidadṛṣṭatvāt, ākṛtipakṣe tu viṣayaikatvāt yugapadekameva śāstraṃ pravartate |
tasmāt śāstrāntaraṃ ananyagati dṛṣṭvā mṛgatṛṣṇā''dideva sāmānyapaṭṭabuddheḥ ' mameyaṃ bhrāntiḥ pūrvametadviṣayapari- kalpanayā jātā ' ityavatiṣṭhate |
tasmāt mātrādiprāsi- velāyāmupajātā'pi kauṇḍinyabuddhiḥ bhrāntiriti niścitya phalavimuttvādanubandhamarthaṃ vādhitaṃ manyate |
' yato bhavatu evaṃvidheṣu ' brāhmaṇebhyo dadhi dīyatāṃ takraṃ kauṇḍinyāya ' iti |

tatra takravibhinaṃ dadhividhimapekṣate pravartitum, iha tu ( yajatiṣu yeyajāmahaṃ karoti nāñu- yājeṣu ityatra ) prāptipūrvakatvāt pratiṣedhasya yeyajāmahasya cānyato'prāpteḥ tanniṣedhena niṣedhaprāptau tadvidhipekṣa- ṇīyaḥ |
gṛhanirmāṇādi laukikaṃ karma prārabdhaṃ sat samāpanīyameveti na niyamaḥ |
bhāṣyam - kena cit gṛhamupakrāntaṃ bhavati śakaṭaṃ rayo vā |
vītā asya phlecchā, avānoti vā phalam |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ tena niyogataḥ parisamāpayitavyam, uta icchayā utsraṣṭavyamiti |
kiṃ prāptam ? loke karmāṇi eñjātīyāni upakramya parisamāpayitavyāni |
yathaiva vaidikāni, tathaiva tāni niyogataḥ parisamāpanīyāni |
atrāpi devatāvyāpāraḥ aṅgīkriyate pūrvasyāṃ diśi etā devatāḥ itarāsu etā iti |
yathā śāstrakṛte devatāvyāpāre upakramya aparisamāpyamāne śiṣṭavigarhaṇam, evamihāpi bhavitumarhati |
bhāṣyam - teṣāṃ ca laukikānāmaparādhe taistakṣabhiḥ prāyaścittaśāstramāmnāyate |
prāyaścittaṃ ca yadi adṛṣṭārtham, na śāstrādate |
atha prasaṅgaparihārārtham, tato'pi ādhatamaiva taditi gamyate |
aśāstrā tūpasaṃprāptiḥ; śāstraṃ syānna prakalpakaṃ, tasmādarthena gamyatāprāpte vā śāstramarthavat |
na ca smṛti- mantareṇa takṣaṇāṃ grantha upapadyate iti |
ata ucyate, bhavatyatra smṛtiḥ; evamidaṃ gṛhādikarma ramaṇīyaṃ bhavatīti |
yā cāsau ramaṇī- yatā, sā antareṇāpi śāstraṃ jñātum |
yadi antareṇa śāstraṃ na prāpyeta, tataḥ śāstramarthavaditi prakalpyeta |
śāstrokte ca sāmi- kṛte tyakte atyantaṃ śiṣṭā gṛhyante, devatāśca |
na tu atrāpi devatāḥ parigṛhyītāḥ, asyāṃ diśīyaṃ devatā yakṣyate, asyāmitimiti |
puruṣamatha devatāḥ śiṣṭāḥ smaryante, na gṛhamanu |
śā - ( siddhāntastu - ) ' aśāstrādeva hi prāpti- rdṛṣṭārtheṣu gṛhādiṣu |
tena śāstraṃ na kalpyeta puruṣārthā hi devatā |
sūtrārthastu- loke karmāṇi gṛhādīni vedavat samāp yāni |
puruṣa- madhikurvanti iti adhipuruṣajñānaṃ laukikakarmāṇi, teṣāṃ jñānaṃ tata eva śāstrādeva iti hetoḥ iti |
vi - ' samāpyamamāpyaṃ vā laukikaṃ, śāstra- kalpanāt |
bhāṭṭa - laukikasya tu gṛhakarmadeḥ aśāstrī- yatvāt aśāstrīyatāpane ca śiṣṭavigarhaṇābhāvān prayo- jakāmāvena akṣamāpanam |
na ca tasyāpi śilpaśruti- mūlatvāt śāstrīyatvam, tasyāḥ arthasukhādivaśavartitayā lokikatvena śrutimūlakatvābhāvāt |
yat gṛhakaraṇādā- śritaṃ puruṣārthe naimittikaṃ vāstuśantyādikaṃ ' āre bhagne indrāvaharbandhyaḥ, pāyasaṃ brāhmaṇo bhojayitavyaḥ ' ityādi ca, tasya śāstrīyatvameva samāpanam |
yahādi- karmaṇaḥ takṣaśāstramapi pāyasya takṣaśāstrānumitavedavihita- tvāt prakāntanāmāvaśyakaṃ samāpanaṃ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
adṛṣṭārthavāstupūjāyāḥ dṛṣṭārthagṛhakarmārthatvāt tadā- śrita puruṣārthatve iti vāstupūjāsamenāpi gṛhakarmaṇe na devatā''śrayatvam |
gṛhasyādau āre bhagne indrāvaharbandhyaḥ iti prāyaścittavidhānamapi puruṣārthameva iti talhadāpi gṛhakarmaṇo na śāstrīyatvaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
takṣasūtraṃ ( takṣaṇaḥ sūtraṃ śāstraṃ ) na cedamalakama, kintu anvayavyatirekakuśalapuruṣopekṣāmūlakam |
taduktaṃ kiñci- dāratvaṃ tadavaśyaṃ samāpanīyameveti na niyamaḥ, dṛṣṭadoṣā- bhāvāt |
mavatyatra smṛtiḥ, evamidaṃ gṛhādikarma ramaṇīyaṃ bhavatīti |
yā cāsau ramaṇīyatā sā antareṇāpi śāstraṃ śakyā jñātuṃ ca samarthyate |
bhā. 6|2|4|18. takṣasmṛtau rathagṛhanirmāṇādirūpaṃ laukikaṃ karma prati- pāditam |
sā ca smṛtirna vedamulā kāryakṣamatvasya ramaṇīyatvādeśca dṛṣṭaprayojanasya anvayavyatirekābhyāmeva siddhupāyatvāt |
takṣasmṛtyuktaṃ ca karma avaśyaṃ samāpanīya- meveti na niyamaḥ |
takṣaṇaṃ yūpasaṃskāraḥ paśumede'pi tantreṇa kartavyo yūpakāle eva jyotiṣṭome |
' dīkṣāsu yūpaṃ chinatti krītvā vā rājani ' |
