1|2|12 pṛ. 166. saṃkṣepapradarśanapūrvakavistāravacane vyākhyātaḥ; pratipādanasaukarya 'taṇḍulān pinaṣṭi' iti peṣaṇasya niyama- śrotṛṣva pratipattisaukarya prayojanaṃ 'tadidaṃ viduṣāṃ' iti vidhiḥ, nānuvādaḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
thaṃm, agniśca sarvārtha: iti ādhānasyaiva sarvārthatvamuktaṃ padasya guṇavacanatvāt āgneyapuroḍāśasyaiva caturdhākaraṇa- |
sūtraṃ tu vidhānāthaṃ taddhitānte āgneyapade avi- |
oṃ 'tathā āgne phalārthe nimitte chāyā bhāgāt tadaninābhūtatvāt dravyadevatāsaṃbandhityāgāyāsya |
gandha ityanūpayete evaṃ dharmaṃ caryamāṇaṃ arthī anū- karma guṇāśca agnipuroḍāśādyo viśiṣṭavidhinā vidhī- |
tat karma guṇā: (ca) na cedanyena śiṣṭā: |
māneṣu ṛtuṣu, taptayogamadhye samuccitānuṣṭheyai: kaiścana vihitā ityartha: |
na ca niyamasya aprāptatvāt niyamārtho'yaṃ vidhiriti vaktavyam, niyamasyāśrutatvāt |
nahi atra niyamā- bhidhāyakaḥ kaścicchabdaḥ śrūyate |
kiñca vaitupāyatvena avaghātasya prāptatvāt upāyāntaranivṛttirūpo niyamo vaktavyaḥ |
tathā ca sati śabdāntareṇa parisaṃkhyāva uktā bhavet |
ayocyate, na vayaṃ niyamasya śabdatvaṃ anyanivṛttirūpatvaṃ vā brūmaḥ |
tadatra avaghātasya apūrvasādhanatvamabhimataṃ yat vidijñāpyaṃ kiṃ prayājādivat sākṣādeva apūrvajanakatvam, apūrvāya vaitupyajanakatvaṃ vā ? na tāvat sākṣāt, siddhāntinā tadanabhyupagamāt |
nāpi apūrvāya vaitupyajanakatvam, tathāpi lokata eva prāptatvāt |
yaiḥ āghānāvahanādikarmabhiḥ dravyaṃ abhiśrīdādi cikīrṣvate utpādituṃ saṃskṛtaṃ vikṛtaṃ āyuṃ vā iṣyate, tatra karmaṇi guṇaḥ guṇabhāvaḥ pratīyeta |
tatra hi dravyaṃ saṃskārya- tayā pradhānam |
arthāt tādṛśānāṃ guṇakarmaṇāṃ bodhakāni ādācīta avahanti ityādīni ākhyātāni guṇabhūtāni |
vaidravyamupādyate yathā āghānena agnayaḥ kriyante, varaṇena ṛtvijaḥ saṃskriyante, avahantinā brīhayaḥ peṣaṇena vā taṇḍulā vikriyante tāni guṇabhūtāni prayojanavaddravya- saṃskṛterīpsitatvāt |
tāni dvaidhaṃ iti (nyāyena) abhyādhānena dravyaṃ cikīrṣvate |
dṛṣṭa eva saṃskāraḥ ameḥ ( 'āghā- dāhṛtya avadadhāt' ityādī ) |

etena hadai saṃbhavati adṛṣṭakalpanāyā anyāyatayā iti nyāyasya tānidvaidhau vyupādane'pi akarmakāle prayogabalāt avaśyamadṛṣṭārtha- tvamiti śaṅkānirākaraṇārthatvena asya (jñānasya) athaivedhaṃ iti sūcitam |
bhāṣyam- avagatametad bhāvanāyāḥ karmaṇo vācakā iti |
bahuprakāraśca bhāvaśabdāḥ yajati, juhoti, dadāti ityevaṃprakārāḥ, dogdhi, pinaṣṭi, vilāpayati ityevamādayaśca |
teṣu saṃdehaḥ kiṃ sarve pradhānakarmaṇo vidhāyakāḥ, uta kecit saṃskārakarmaṇaḥ iti |
māvārthatvāt viśeṣataḥ sarve pradhānakarme vācakā iti prāptam, tato brūmaḥ |
dvipakārāṇi, kānicit pradhānakarmaṇo vācakāni, kānicit saṃskārakarmaṇaḥ |
evamapi sarvāṇi arthavanti, arthavattve sati sarvebhyo na śakyamapyatraṃ kalpayitum |
vā- emākhyātamaidānusāreṇa apūrvamedānugame sarvatra prāpte tadapavādārthaṃ guṇapradhānavivekaārambhaḥ |
prayojanaṃ tu pūrvasmin pakṣe preyaśce'pi carau brīhayaḥ upādhyā avaghātādyarthatvena, siddhānte notpādyāḥ |
vā- yaiḥ punaḥ dravyaṃ upādyate yathā āghānena amayaḥ avāpyante kriyante vā, yathā varaṇena ṛtvijaḥ saṃskriyante, yathā avahantinā brīhayaḥ, peṣaṇena taṇḍulāḥ ( taṇḍula- piṣṭāni ) |
yadā (tu) dṛṣṭārthamevārthaṃ ca ubhayathā- 'pi tulyavat anuṣṭhīyeta, tadā kiṃ prayojanaṃ cintāyāḥ |
preyaśce'pi carau atideśaprāpto brīhisādhanaka eva avahantiḥ kartavyaḥ pūrvapakṣe |
kutaḥ ? 'pradhāne hi śrutaṃ dravyaṃ nāṅgadravyasya bādhakam |
prayājeyajyā- vat tena hantau syād brīhivādhanam ||
' nanu ca pūrvapakṣe'pi pradhānaprayuktabrīhā- śrayatvena prakṛtau aprayojakatvāt preyaśce carau pradhānena aprāptamānān brīhīna avaghāto na labhate |
' 'brīhimibajeta' 'brīhīnavahanti' iti tulye codane, tatra iyaṃ prayojikā iyaṃ na iti nāsti viśeṣahetuḥ |
na ca paḍakarmavat (ekāhayanyāḥ saptamapadavat) paraprayuktaprakṛtau- hāyanyadhīnanirākāṅkṣatvam |
na ca asmin pakṣe niyogato yāgārthā eva brīhayaḥ avahantavyāḥ, laukikairapi karmasiddhayaviśeṣāt |
na cātra prakṛtagrahaṇe pramāṇam, prakaraṇasya aviśeṣakatvāt |
( nairākāṅkṣye adhikārā navamādhikaraṇasūtre viśeṣakalpanirāsāt na prakṛtagrahaṇe pramāṇamityarthaḥ |
saṃskārapakṣe tu laukikānāmānarthakyena (ānandaśramīye tu ānarthakye na iti mudritam |
vayaṃ tu tṛtīyāntaṃ manyāmaha ) asaṃsakāryatvāt apūrvasādhanaviśeṣatvena kathañcit prakṛtagrahaṇaṃ kleśena bhaviṣyati |
na ca ārādupakārakatve avahanteḥ yāgasyaiva laukikaiḥ sādhyamānasya kiñcidā- narthakyaṃ iti śrautatvāt brīhimātrāgrahaṇeyameva yuktam |
(svayaṃ prayojanāntarāṇyāha-) dharmamātraṃ ca tadā avahantiḥ sarvauṣadhāvahantivat sakṛdeva ca kartavyaḥ, na ā taṇḍulanivṛtteḥ |
sānāyyopāṃśuyājādyasamam cāsya prakaraṇāviśeṣāt tathā bhavati, iti tadadhikāraiṣapi prayojyaḥ ityādi prayojanāni |
ādiśabdāt yavapakṣe'pi brīhīmātrameva avaghātaḥ, trayāṇā- meva ca iti prayojanadvayam |
sūtrārthastu- tāni ākhyātāni guṇakarmapratipādakāni pradhānakarmapratipādakāni ityevaṃ dvaidha dvidhā iti |
haṭṭe tupa- vimoke tu nāpūrve dravyatantrataḥ |
' bhāṭṭa- 'brīhīnavahanti' ityādi pūrvaveda ava- ghātasya phalabhāvanākaraṇatvamavivādam |
nāpi pakṣe dalanādepi arthaprāptatvena tadāhantiphalako niyamaḥ, tasyāpi vaiphalyāt |
na ca tasmādarthātyam, adṛṣṭasya avaśyakalpa- nīyatve śābdāvaghātādeva tatkalpanāt |
tadapi cādṛṣṭaṃ na brīhiniṣṭhaṃ, tattvāvacchinnaṃ prati ātmatvena samavāyikāraṇatvāt |
ataḥ pūrvaveda brīhaya eva avaghātāstathā iti brīhi- viśeṣodbhavatvāt evaṃ adṛṣṭārthamādupakārakatvena vidhī- yate |
iti prāpte, dṛṣṭe saṃbhavati adṛṣṭasya anyāyatatvāt vitupībhāvaḥ eva avaghātaphalam |
na ca tasyādepadeva prāptatvena vidhivaiyarthyam, dalanādyupāyantarasya adṛṣṭaphalaka-
ata eva kṛṣṇalacarau avaghātābhāve tasya lopaḥ |
ataśca ākṣepatitvatvāt dalanādi- jyāvṛttilakṣaṇo niyamaḥ phalam |
vaidhyarthyañca tu avaghātādeva vrīhi- niṣṭhādṛṣṭasyāpi upattikalpanānniravakartavyā |
tadadṛṣṭasya ca janyatvamātra lāghavāt kalpyate, na tu prayojakatvamapi, dṛṣṭarūpe vaituṣye eva tatkalpanāt |
ārthikavidhvantarakalpanāt ekayā dvitīyayaiva vā janyadvayokteḥ nānekoddeśyatā |
tattadadṛṣṭasya ca dvitīyādidharmigrāhakapramāṇena vrīhādinniṣṭatvasyaiva avagateḥ tattvenaiva samatvādhikaraṇatā, nātmatvena |
ataśca avaghātasya adṛṣṭavitṛṣībhāvoddeśyatayā apūrvasādhanībhūta- vrīhibhedena vidhānāt siddhaṃ saṃskārakarmatvam |
prayojanaṃ yāgārthavrīhyapekṣayā brīhyantaramavaghātādyupapādeyaṃ pūrvapakṣe, siddhānte neti |
bhāvāthīdhikaraṇe apūrve siddham, ghātārthasya apūrva- janakatve dravyādestadartheti ca, tadapavādādye tāni- dvaidhādhikaraṇam |
kau. 2|1|4|7 tānidvaidhādhikaraṇe dṛṣṭopakārakaṃ guṇakarma, adṛṣṭopakārakaṃ pradhānakarma ityuktam |
ku. satyapi apūrvaprayuktatve apūrvārthatvamavaghātāde- rmantrāṇāṃ ca na pratyājādivadadṛṣṭadvārā, tānidvaidhamantrā- dhikaraṇādau nirastatvāt, kintu vrīhyanyādidvārā |
bhāṭṭadīpikāyāṃ kutūhale ca 'amathya svakāla- tvāt' iti sūtraṃ pṛthaktvena gṛhītvā antarāgarbhaṇī- nyāyena adhikaraṇāntarameva kṛtam |
pūrvapakṣaṃ utsṛṣṭaṃ gṛhītvā siddhāntaparatvenaiva tat svīkṛtam |
vārtika- kārairapi 'adhikaraṇāntarasūtroktanyāyapratipāditānumita- pūrvapakṣaḥ siddhānta evāyaṃ sūtravākyabhedenocyate' ityu- ktam |
tena bhāṭṭa-ku-bhaṭṭa bhinnaṃ sūtraṃ vārtikakārā na manyante |
bhāṣye'pi 'amathya sarvāthā iti samadhi- gatametat' ityuktvā siddhāntameva tasya sūtravākyasya svīkṛtam |
uttarasūtreṇa agniviṣaye kimapi nokte ityapi ca tadanusāreṇa yuktameva |
parantu 'amathya svakālatvāt' iti vākyaśca bhinnasūtratvaṃ bhāṣyavārtika- kārau na manyete |
jyotiṣṭome ye ṛtvijaḥ svāmisamadaśāḥ ityuktāḥ te sarve sarvārthāḥ syuḥ |
yāgakarmasu yo yat kartumicchati śaknoti ca, sa tat kuryāt |
atra siddhāntaḥ uttarasūtre bhaviṣyati 'taṃsaṃyogāt karmaṇaḥ' ityatra |
atra antarāgarbhaṇī- nyāyena agniviṣayaṃ siddhāntamāha - 'amathya svakāla- tvāt' iti |
atra utsṛṣṭaḥ parvapakṣaḥ - 'amathya āhavanī- yādayaḥ na sarvārthāḥ; kintu prakṛtyarthā eva |
vikṛtyarthatva- syāpi svīkāre tu prakṛtitvād vikṛtiḥ iti codakenāpi prāpyā dviruktatvadoṣaḥ' iti |
kutaḥ ? svakālatvāt vasantādiḥ ṛtuḥ: kṛṣikādīni nakṣatrāṇi ca agnīnāṃ svaḥ kālaḥ |
svīyaḥ kāle yeṣāmādhānārthe vihitaḥ te svakālā amathya |
tatsayogāt karmaṇo vyavasthā syāt saṃyogasyā- rthavattvāt ||
tatsayogāt adhvaryuhotrādiviśiṣṭapuruṣaiḥ viśiṣṭakarmaṇaḥ saṃyogāt, samākhyā''dibhiḥ tādṛśasya saṃyogasya jñāta- tvāt vyavasthaiva, nādhyavasthā |
evaṃ saṃyogasya karmapuruṣa- saṃyogasya arthavattvāt phalasya siddhervyavasthaiva |
adhvarya- syāṃ hi saṃyogo niṣphalaḥ syāt |
karma adhvaryuṇaiva kartavyam, na hotrā nodgātrā |
hautra- samākhyaṃ śastrādyanuvacanādi karma hotaiva kartavyam, nādhva- ryuṇā nodgātrā |
stotragānarūpamaudgātramastraṃ karma udgātrā kartavyam, nādhvaryuṇā na hotā iti sā vyavasthā |
atra sudhā - taiḥ ṛtvibhiḥ karmaṇaḥ saṃyogāt yathāsamākhyaṃ vyavasthā syāt |

vyavasthitasaṃbhave vikalpyā- pādakāvyasthitaśāstrārthayogena liṅgaprakaraṇapekṣitavyavasthā- samarthakatayā hautrādisamākhyā'''khyasya hautratvikasaṃyogasya tadvirodhābhāve śrutikalpatvopapatteḥ viniyogādarthā- vattvāt - iti |
'taṃ yathāyathopāste tadeva bhavati' iti nyāyena utkṛṣṭhopāsanāt utkṛṣṭhameva phalaṃ mokṣārthaṃ bhavatyeva |
'tenotpayaḥ' iti nyāyena apūrvārambhakatvaṃ na saṃbhavati ityāśaṅkya |
'tena hyannaṃ kriyate' iti 'sūryeṇa juhoti' iti vidheḥ arthavādaḥ |
'tasmāt ekaṃ sāma tṛce kriyate stotrīyam' ityatra nanu samākhyāmapi ṛcamanu trividhavidhānaṃ dṛṣṭam |
ke. 'tasmāt kāle eva dadyāt kāle na dadyāt' ayaṃ abhyanujñārūpaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ |
) bāla. pṛ. 33 'tasmāt svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ' iti anārabhya vidhīyate |
ṣoḍaśī grahaḥ ukthyād āgrayaṇāt pātrāt sākṣāt grahītavyaḥ, uta āgrayaṇādeva iti vicāre siddhānte- nopakramate |
tasya ṣoḍaśino nāma grahasya āgrayaṇāt pātrāt grahaṇaṃ kartavyam |
vacanāt iti padaṃ uttarasūtrāt ākṛṣyate apakṛṣyate |
ṣoḍaśino grahasya āgrayaṇāt pātrāt ukthyācca pātrāt grahaṇaṃ kartavyam |
'āgrayaṇād gṛhṇāti ṣoḍa- śinam' iti 'ukthyād gṛhṇāti ṣoḍaśinam' iti ca vacanāt |
nanu tarhi āgrayaṇāt ukthyācca pātrāt abhyāsena ṣoḍaśī grahaḥ pṛthak grāhyaḥ |
kutaḥ ? 'yat parāṅmukhayyācchiguhlāti ṣoḍaśinam' iti vaca- nāt |
tādarthyāt parāk- śabdasya tadarthatvāt 'parācīḥ sāmidhenīrvāha' anabhyāsā iti gamyate |
evaṃ parākśabdāt pātrādvāt abhyāsena pṛthak grahaṇaṃ nopapadyate |
tasmāt ukthyā- grayaṇābhyāṃ pātrābhyāṃ sakāśāt sakṛdeva ṣoḍaśī grāhyaḥ |
itaśca ṣoḍaśī grahaḥ ukthyāt āgrayaṇācca grāhyaḥ |
'vicchindanti ha vā etadukthyam, yadukthyāni ṣoḍaśinaṃ ca tataḥ praṇayanti' tataḥ ukthyāt pātrasya apādānatvaṃ darśayati |
tasmāt ukthyāt āgrayaṇācceti ubhābhyāṃ ṣoḍaśī grahītavyaḥ |
'yat parāṅmukhayyācchiguhlāti ṣoḍaśinam' iti parākśabdasya deśavācitvāt kālavācitvāt ityarthaḥ |
ukthyādanantaraṃ ṣoḍaśī grāhyaḥ ityukte ukthyasya apādānatvaṃ nāsti |
tasmāt ukthyānantaraṃ āgrayaṇāt ṣoḍaśī grāhya ityeva |
punarādheyavat, yathā 'parāṅgamyādhadhāt punaradadhāti' iti kālasaṃyoge pañcamī nāpādāne, eva-
tasmāt ṣoḍaśī āgrayaṇādeva grāhyaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā 'vicchidanti ha vā etaduktham, yadukthāni ṣoḍaśinaṃ ca tataḥ praṇayanti' iti viccheda-vacanāt ukthasya apādānatvamiti, tanna |
ukthavicchedo nāma pracārakāle trīn uktha-grahān praṇayanti tadanantaraṃ ṣoḍaśinaṃ praṇayanti iti |
'tataḥ praṇayanti' ityapi pañcamī nāpādāne, kintu kālasambandhe eva, tataḥ ukthaprayaṇādanantaraṃ ṣoḍaśinaṃ praṇayanti iti |
tasmāt āgrayaṇādeva ṣoḍaśino grahaṇaṃ nokthyādapi iti siddhāntaḥ |
pūrvādhikaraṇe svāmisadanāmmṛttvijāṃ samākhyā-''dinā tattat yāgakarmasu saṃyuktatvajñānāt vyavasthā ityu-ktam |
upadeśasamākhyānena upa-deśena 'tasmānmaitrāvaruṇaḥ preṣyati ca anu cāha (anvāha ca)' 'pratiprasthātā magninaṃ juhoti' ityādinā, neṣṭrīyā potrīyā ityādinā samākhyānena ca nirdeśo bhavati |

atra sudhā - 'karmasamūhasya ādhvaryavādisamākhyā-nāt kacidapi bādhe samākhyaiva sarvatra aprāmāṇya-patteḥ viśeṣasamākhyāyā bādhāyogāmāśaṅkya maitrāvaruṇādi-vākyena vāghasya ādhvaryyādi kāryatvāt sudhīrūpadadhāti iti-vat bhūmnā ādhvaryyādimāsamārūpāpratyakṣajīkaraṇa parihṛtaṃ tasya ādhvaryyādimāsatvātsyāpi karmaṇaḥ yathā maitrā-varṇopadeśena karnantaropadeśaśūnyebhyaḥ karmabhyaḥ niṣkṛṣya karnantardeśanā, tathā viśeṣaviṣayatvāt saṃkocacchattinā āsyāvanena viśeṣavācyā śrutyebhyaḥ niṣkṛṣya
atra vārttikaṃ (3|7|124 sūtre) samākhyayostu virodhe sāmānyaviśeṣa-samākhyayoḥ sūtravada eva bādho bhaviṣyati 'tasyopadeśa-samākhyānena nirdeśaḥ' iti |
atra somanāthī- tasyo-padeśena vacanena viśeṣasamākhyānena nirdeśo niṣkarṣaḥ apavāda iti yāvat |
prābhākarairidaṃ sūtraṃ sāmānya-samākhyāyāḥ vacanaviśeṣasamākhyābhyāṃ bādhantyutpādanāyai adhikāraṇāntaratvena vyākhyātam |
samā-khyāyāḥ vacanāpekṣayā sāmānyasya viśeṣāpekṣayā ca durbalatvasya anyatra siddhatvena pūrvapakṣānugametat |
yāgīyakarmasu ādhvaryyādimākhyāyā adhvaryyādīnāṃ vyavasthā niyama ityetadavadatā upadeśasamākhyā-nābhyāṃ viśeṣapanīyam |
tadattū ādhvaryyādimāsamārūpāt potrīyādi-viśeṣasamākhyāvat 'yatra hetuḥ prātaranuvākamanubruvataḥ upaśṛṇuyāt' iti liṅgaṃ haive prātaranuvāke samākhyāyā prāpte hotāraṃ darśayati |
tathā 'udnīya udgātṛṇām, ṛcaḥ praṇava ukthaśaṃsinām (hotṛṇāṃ udnīyaḥ), pratigaro'-dhvaryūṇām (udnīyaḥ)' |
tathā 'yo vā'dhvaryoḥ svaṃ veda svānneva bhavati, etad adhvaryoḥ svaṃ, yadāśavayati' iti ca liṅgaṃ tatra karmaṇi tanmṛttvijaṃ viśeṣato darśayati |
tasmāt viśeṣasamākhyāyā viśeṣato ṛtvijāṃ karmasu vyavasthā niyamaḥ |
atra sudhā - yathā ādhvaryyādimākhyānāt karmaṇaḥ adhvaryyādikartṛvyavasthā, yathā ca viśeṣasamākhyānena karnantaradeśanā tathā liṅgadarśanaṃ (viśeṣato niyāmakam) iti |
yadyapi 'āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvā' ityanena dvayamapi prātaḥsavanaṃ āśvinagrahottarakālatvaṃ ca vidhīyata, tathāpi vidhāyakasya ekapadāt anusārāt 'tasyatasyopadeśyeta' ityetadā-pattināsti |
tasya dhenuriti gavāṃ prakṛtau vibhaktaṃ coditatvāt tatsāmānyāt tadvikāraḥ syād yatheṣṭguṇaśabdena |
'atheṣa bhuva~śvadevaḥ trivṛdeva sarvaḥ, tasya viśvavataḥ stotrīyā dhenurdakṣiṇā' iti bhūnāma ekādaḥ kratuḥ |
yeyaṃ 'tasya dhenuḥ' iti dhenuḥ śrutā, sā prākṛtīnāṃ dakṣiṇānāṃ madhye gavāmeva nivartikā, nāśvādīnām |
prakṛtau dakṣiṇānāṃ vibhaktaṃ yathā syāttathā coditatvāt, aśvo dakṣiṇā, aśvataro dakṣiṇā iti pratyekaṃ dakṣiṇātvamuktam |
atra bhūnāmni kratau tu gavāmeva dhenuśca viśeṣa ucyate gauraiva tenānanyā |
evaṃ ca tatsāmānyāt govvasāmānyāt dhenuḥ tadvikāraḥ; govikāraḥ; syāt adhenunāṃ gavāṃ bādhaḥ syāt |
yathā iṣṭiḥ; aiṣṭikau vidhantaḥ guṇaśabdena 'sauryaṃ caruṃ nirvapet' iti nirvāpaśabdena niyamyate tadvat |
tasmāt jyotiṣṭomagatāḥ sarvā dakṣiṇāḥ bhūnāmni kratau syuḥ; gāvastu dhenavaḥ dugdhadāḥ syuḥ iti viśeṣaḥ |
athavā 'tasya dhenuḥ' ityekavacanāt jyoti-ṣṭomikīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ gavāṃ sthāne ekā dhenaurdakṣiṇā aśvādayastu yathāprakṛti iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
sarvasya vā kratusaṃyogādekatvād dakṣiṇārthasya, guṇānāṃ kāryaikatvādye vikṛtau śrutibhatā syāt, tayā samavāyāddhi karmabhiḥ |
bhūnāmni kratau vihitā yā dhenurdakṣiṇā, sā sarvasya krutādakṣiṇasya nivartikā |
kratusaṃyogāt 'tasya dhenu-rdakṣiṇā' iti anupaṅgayuktavākye tattadoktasya kratusthasya kratoḥ dhenurdakṣiṇā saṃbandhāt |

jyotiṣṭome tāvat gavāśvādīnāṃ tilamādhāntānāṃ daśānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ samudāya eva ekaṃ dakṣiṇātvam, na tu pratyekaṃ pṛthak dakṣiṇātvam, gauśca aśvaśca daśamiśraśabdaiḥ sarveṣāṃ samudāyamuddiśya ekadakṣiṇatvavidhānāt |
tādṛśyāḥ dakṣiṇāyāḥ prākṛtyāḥ bhūnāmni vikṛtau vihitayā ekayā dhenvā bādhaḥ; ekatvaṃ dakṣiṇārthasya, dakṣiṇāyā yo'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ ṛtvigamanaṃ tasya ekatvam, na nānātvam |

guṇānāṃ kāryaikatvāt, dakṣiṇāyā ye guṇāḥ gavāśvādayaḥ tilamādhāntāḥ teṣāmapi kāryaikatvāt, dakṣiṇātvarūpakāryaikatvāt vikṛtau manābhina kratau arthe ṛtvigamanarūpe śrutibhūtaṃ 'tasya dhenurdakṣiṇā' iti śrutivihitaṃ dhenvekaṃ samartha syāt |
tayā dhenudakṣiṇayā hi yasmāt karmabhiḥ sākamṛtvijāṃ samavāyāt saṃbandhāt tasmāt dhenuḥ sarvasya krutādakṣiṇasya bādhikā |
'tasya dhenuḥ' iti sūtre 'yatheṣṭguṇaśabdena' iti vikṛtīṣṭāntaḥ : pūrvapakṣiṇā pradarśitaḥ tasya vaiṣamyāt siddhāntī |
codanānāṃ sauryādivikṛtīṣṭi-codanānāṃ anāśrayāt anāśrayaṇāt asvīkārāt pratyakṣoddiṣṭadharmaviśeṣabhāvāt nirvāpaliṅgena prakṛtīṣṭi-vidhitasya niyamaḥ syāt |
bhūnāmni kratau tu gavādināmekaṃ kāryaṃ dakṣiṇātvam, tasmiṃśca śrutibhūtā ekā dhenuḥ; codanāprāptāṃ sarvāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ nivartayitumarhati |
tasmāt ekā dhenuḥ kṛtsnāṃ prākṛtīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ nivartayati iti siddhāntaḥ |
tasya dhenuriti gavāṃ prakṛtau vibhaktaṃ (-kaṃ) coditatvāt sāmānyāt (tatsāmānyāt) tadvikāraḥ syād yatheṣṭguṇaśabdena |
'eṣa bhuva~śvadevaḥ trivṛdeva sarvaḥ tasya viśvavataḥ stotrīyā dhenurdakṣiṇā' ityādāhya ki dhenurvā nivartikā, uta kṛtsnāyā dakṣiṇāyāḥ |

iti saṃdehe yacchabdayogaḥ prāthamyamityādyuddeśalakṣaṇam ' ityanena nyāyena dakṣiṇāsaṃbandhe prathamaṃ gavādināmupādānena uddeśya-tyāgatvāt uddeśyagatasya ca śabdoktatvāpi sāhityasya avivakṣitatvāt pratyekaṃ dakṣiṇātvāttaḥ golaikyātsama-vetadogrītvādinā dhenuśabdena gavāmeva dogdhrīṇāṃ nivṛttipratīteḥ : ekavacanena ca dvādaśaśatasaṃkhyānivṛtti-pratīteḥ yathā 'sauryaṃ caruṃ nirvapet' iti nirvāpalakṣaṇaguṇa-śabdena aiṣṭikau vidhanto niyamyate, tathā dhenuśabdena gomātranivṛtteḥ nāśvādinivṛttiḥ : iti pūrvapakṣayitvā kṛtsnāyā dakṣiṇāyā nivṛttiḥ iti siddhāntitam |
tasya nimittaparīṣṭiḥ | 1|1|3 | codanālakṣaṇasūtreṇa śrutyarthyāṃ vedārthasvarūpam, tatra ca pramāṇaṃ pratijñātam |
tatra kiṃ svarūpaṃ tāvad bhedābheda- rūpeṇa kathyatām, uta pramāṇatayā hetūḥ iti saṃśaye pradhānatvāt svarūpasya, tadeva bhedābhedabhyāṃ katha- nīyam |
iti prāpte, bhedābhedanirṇayasya anapekṣatvasvaya- pekṣātvāt prāmāṇye helyapekṣaṃ adhunā kathanīyamiti sūtreṇa kathyate |
ṛju. pṛ. 33. 🜂 tasya nimittaparīṣṭiḥ | 1|1|3 | anena sūtreṇa dharmapramāṇaparīkṣāpratijñā kṛtā |
tasya dharmasya yāni nimittāni jñāpakāni pramāṇāni, teṣāṃ parīṣṭiḥ paryeṣaṇā samyak parīkṣā ‘kariṣyate’ iti śeṣaḥ |
ke. tasya nimittaparīṣṭiḥ | dharmaṃ vedaḥ pramāṇaṃ ityuktam |
tat saṃbhavati na vā iti parīkṣā pratyakṣādīnāṃ dharmaprāmāṇya- saṃbhavanirūpaṇadvārā kriyate ityarthaḥ |
maṇi. pṛ. 19. tasya prathamam ’ ityupakramya ‘nodyanmādityā- mīkṣeta ’ iti śrūyate |

🜂 teṣāmarthena saṃbandhaḥ | 3|1|4 | darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ: nirvāpaprokṣaṇāvahananādayaḥ auṣadha- dharmāḥ, upavanavilāpanagrahaṇāsādanādayaḥ ājyadharmāḥ, śākhā''haraṇe vasāpākaraṇaṃ gavāṃ prasthāpanaṃ ityādayaḥ sāṃnāyyadharmāḥ śrutāḥ |
te kiṃ sarvaṃ sarvatra kartavyāḥ, uta ye yārthavantaḥ te tatra kartavyāḥ iti vicāre siddhānta- māha |
teṣāṃ arthena ādināṃ dharmāṇāṃ arthena prayojanena saṃbandhaḥ syāt |
yasya yatra prayojanasādhakatvaṃ sa tatra kartavyaḥ iti |
vihitastu sarvadharmaḥ syāt, saṃyogata'- viśeṣatvāt prakaraṇāviśeṣācca |
apūrvasādhanatvena yaḥ kaścit dharmo vihitaḥ, sa sarvo'pi sarvadharmaḥ aupadhasāṃnāyyānāṃ sarvaijāmeva dharmaḥ syāt |
saṃyogataḥ apūrvasaṃyogasya aviśeṣāt samānatvāt, prakaraṇāviśeṣācca darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇapāṭhasya samānatvāt |

ājyadharmāṇāṃmutpavanādīnāṃ auṣadhe sāṃnāyye ca, auṣadhadharmāṇāṃ avahananādīnāṃ ājye sāṃnāyye ca, sāṃnāyyadharmāṇāṃ vasāpākaraṇādīnāṃ ājye auṣadhe ca arthalopāt arthasya dṛṣṭasya phalasya lopāt abhāvāt akarma akriyā syāt |
kintu yatra yasya phalaṃ tatraiva sa kartavyaḥ |
phalaṃ tu saha ceṣṭayā, śabdārtho'bhāvād viprayoge syāt |
nanu avaghātādīnāṃ ājyādau vidhivaśāt adṛṣṭaṃ prayojanaṃ kalpyatāṃ iti cet tatrāha |
ceṣṭayā anuṣṭhānena saha sahitaṃ tadanvaya- hitotsarakālaṃ phalaṃ vaitubyādi upalabhyate |
yadā ceṣṭayā avaghātādikriyā saha śruteṣu vrīhyādiṣu vaitubyādi phalaṃ dṛṣṭārthe upalabhyate |
dṛṣṭasya phalasya viprayoge anupalabdhau abhāvāt dṛṣṭaphalasya abhāvāniścayāt śabdārthaḥ vidhivikalpyaḥ adṛṣṭopakāraḥ syāt |
prakṛte tu dṛṣṭasya sattvāt nādṛ- kalpanā |
nanu prakaraṇāviśeṣāt sakalāvāntarapūrvāṇāṃ dharmaprayojakatvaṃ syāt iti cet tatrāpyāha |
‘viprayoge avāntarapūrvasyābhāve sati, paramāpūrvasya ca dharmasya vyavasthāpakatvābhāvāt śabdārthaḥ brīhādiṣvasya ājyā- dirapi arthaḥ syāt saṃbhāvyeta paramāpūrvasādhanātvāviśe- pāt |
kintu ceṣṭayā avaghātādikriyā saha śruteṣu vrīhādiṣu taṇḍulapiṣṭādipraṇāḍyā, tattadyāga- janamantrāpūrvaṃ nāma phalamasti |
teṣāmarthādhikaraṇam | 3|1|4|7 | apekṣitaḥ nājyasāṃnāyyābhyāṃ ityapekṣitavidheḥ ana- pekṣitavidhānadaurbalyānenāpi avaghātasya auṣadhadravya- mātraśeṣatvaṃ darśitam |
darśapūrṇa- māsayoḥ vrīhi-ājya-sāṃnāyyadharmāḥ vyavasthitā eva, na saṃkīrṇā bhavanti |
bhāṣyam -— sto darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta’ iti |
tatra śrūyante dharmāḥ nirvapaṇaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ avahananamityevamādaya auṣadhadharmāḥ |
tathā śākhā''haraṇaṃ, gavāṃ prasthāpanaṃ, gavāṃ prasthāpanamityeva- mādayo'pi sāṃnāyyadharmāḥ |
teṣu saṃdehaḥ kiṃ sarve, auṣadhe ājye sāṃnāyye ca kartavyāḥ, uta ye yatra kriyamāṇā arthavantaḥ te tatra kartavyā iti |
ye yatra kriyamāṇāḥ prayojanavantaḥ, te tatra kartavyāḥ |
pratha- nādaya ājyasāṃnāyyayoḥ anuṣakārakā iti na tatra karaṇīyāḥ |
etadeva na jānīmaḥ śrūyante, na śrūyante iti |
yadyapi śrūyeran tathāpi anupa- kārakatvācca kartavyaṃ bhaveyuḥ |
tatra triṣu adhikaraṇeṣu krameṇa saṃskāradravyaguṇānāṃ viniyogaḥ kathyate |
tatrāpi kila prathame liṅgena, dvitīye vākyena, tṛtīye śrutyā viniyoga iti kecit |
yadyapi atra vicitrapramāṇavyāpāraparāmarśaḥ, tathāpi śruti- viniyogaḥ evātra pāde, liṅgādiviniyogastu dvitīya- mī. ko. 234 pādāt prabhṛti bhaviṣyatītyuktam |
‘nanu saṃyuktā evaite’ iti siddhāntavādī śrutibalena saṃśayamākṣipatti |
paraḥ punaḥ padāntarasaṃbandhakṛtaṃ vrīhādi- saṃbandhaṃ śuddhāvaghātavidhinā bādhyamānaṃ manyamānaḥ āha- ‘avaghātādayastu padārthā vidhīyante śrutyā’ iti tathaitadayuktamiva |
kutaḥ ? ‘prayujyate padaṃ kiñcid vinā nahi padāntarāt |
’ nahi vrīhādibhiḥ saṃbandha- mānā avaghātādayaḥ nāvaghātādayo bhavanti |
yadi hi evaṃ bhaveyuḥ, tataḥ śrutiviruddhatvāt vākyaṃ bādhyeta |
atra punaḥ; kevalanāmeva avaghātādīnāmubhayatāmavaśyakartavyatā avaśyameva saṃbandhayantare kāryāḥ |
nahi bhavatyapase'pi ava- ghātādayaḥ kevalāḥ kriyante |
athāpi kiñcidvākya saṃbandhaḥ kriyate, tathāpi kleśaḥ |
atha ārādupakāraka- tvena pradhānasaṃbandhaḥ iṣyate, tatrāpi viprakarṣaḥ |
atha tu naiva kenacit saṃbadhyate, tato vidhānārthaikyaprasaṅgaḥ |
tena evaṃ vyākhyeyam’ — vākya- bhedadekatvasaṃdehāttra saṃśayaḥ |
’ naiva atra ayaṃ pūrvapakṣahetuḥḥ ‘avaghātādayaḥ padārthāḥ svatantrāḥ śrutyā vidhīyante, vākyena va
yadya tat apūrvasādhanālakṣaṇamātmakaṃ vākyam, tat prakaraṇaviśeṣāt yathā auṣadhe, tathā ājyasāṃnāthyayorapi aviśi- ṣṭam |
tatra kimekaṃ darśapūrṇa- māsāparvaṃ dharmāṇāṃ prayojakam, uta anekam |
yadā'pi anekam, tadā'pi kimapūrvamātram, uta kiñcideva iti |
yadi ekamapūrvaṃ sarvāṇi vā sarveṣāṃ prayojakāni, tataḥ saṃkaro dharmāṇām |
atha tu anekapūrvake kiñcideva prayojakam, tataḥ pratyekaṃ vyavasthā iti |
tatra siddhāntanaiva tāvat upakramate ‘teṣāmarthena saṃbandhaḥ’ ( iti ) |
yadyapi tāvat kevala-( prokṣatā ityādi- )padavācyāḥ thūyeran, tathāpi ka kriyeran ityapekṣite, ‘yatra kriyamāṇāḥ prayojanavantaḥ’ bhavanti, tatra kartavyāḥ |
' apūrvatarasādhanatvāt apratītiḥ; evaṃ ekāpūrvasambandhe'pi brīhilaikāryameva tadapūrvakāratvābhāvāt athavā, tata ete sarvatra vihitā bhaveyuḥ; yadi kṣugādīnāmagrahaṇaṃ |
yattu tasminneva apūrve samānakārakatvena paramāpūrvaprayuktāḥ, sarvāpūrvaprayuktā vā syuḥ |
tadā ca upakariṣyati, tasya bhaviṣyatyeva dharmaḥ: yathā yavānām |
evaṃ te bhaveyuḥ; yadi bhikṣāṇi brīhyādikamapūrvāṇi sarve caitat navame vistareṇa vakṣyāmaḥ |
(āgneyādijanyotpatyapūrvāṇi) na syuḥ; yadi ca eṣām śā-- 'ekameva phalāpūrva phalasyaikasya siddhaye |
tāni tu kalpyaṃ nānyāni dharmāṇāṃ tādarthyāt saṃkaro bhavet |
' yadyapi ca eṣāṃ sākṣātaphalatvam, tathāpi svarūpa- tasmāt yathā-saṃyogaṃ vyavasthā |
na ca soma - svarūpajñānānantaraṃ prāptāvaro'yaṃ vicāraḥ |
tasmānna niṣphalatvāt aprayojakaṃ bhavati, sūtrāttheṣu-- teṣāṃ saṃskārāṇāṃ arthena dṛṣṭaprayojanavaśena yat atyantaniṣphalaṃ tannirapekṣam (ajñanirapekṣam) vyavasthā saṃbandhaḥ iti |
sāṃkarya- pūrvāṇi tu paramāpūrvasiddhayyatvāt pāraṃparyeṇa phalavanti |
, na ca dharmebhyaḥ prāk siddhāni nirjñātaupayapari- avāntarapūrvasyatvāt sākṣāt tenaiva saṃgato |
' sā śrutiḥ yacca yeṣu dharmeṣu vidhīyamāneṣu apūrvamupasthite, tat teṣāṃ prakaraṇāt uttamā baliṣṭhā |
brīhyādibhyaśca bhāṭṭa-- tadevamaṅgatve nirūpite śrutyādīni ṣaṭ svakarmasādhyameva apūrvamupasthite nānyat, asaṃbandhāt |

tatra śrutīnāṃ aṅgatvaghaṭakībhūto- ataśca avaghātādyaḥ tadeva ekamapūrva prāpya uddeśyatvakṛtikārakatvayoreva anyatarasya prādhānyena vācakaḥ arthavanto jātāḥ na paramāpūrva karmāntaraparva vā śabdaḥ |
yasmāt avahananādi ceṣṭayā saha niṣṭhātvādinā'gṛhyatvaṃ prādhānyaneti |
tasya kārakatva- śruteṣu brīhyādiṣveva svāpūrvasādhanatvena vidheḥ phalaṃ viśiṣṭadravyavācitvena prādhānyena kārakatvātvābhāvāt |

yadi tu tatra ata eva 'prokṣitāmyāmūlakhalusāmyāvahananti' 'vāraṇo apūrva na syāt, tataḥ arthāt adṛṣṭaṃ kalpyeta, brīhyādi- yaśāccara' : ityādi vākyīyaḥ eva viniyogaḥ, śabdaiḥ anupasthāpite'pi upakāraḥ prayojakaḥ kalpyeta |
atra dvitīyā uddeśyatvarā satī prokṣaṇāderaṅgatve asti tu tat |
vastutastu īpsitatvāt uddeśyatayā sādhyatā- sūtramapi evam - viprayoge taṇḍulādiṣvākhyasya mātravācidvitīyāvācyatvāt nāpi mukhyā śrutiḥ |
apūrvasya prayojanābhāvāt sāṃnāyyādisambandho'pi vyahita- apitu bhākta eva tatra śrutivyavahāraḥ, īpsitatvāṃśe paramāpūrvadvāreṇa karmāntarapūrvadvāreṇa vā śabdārthaḥ lakṣaṇā'ṅgīkārāt |
pratyāsannāpūrvadvāre vā na śabdaḥ tāvantaṃ khedaṃ lakṣaṇe deyam |
evaṃ yatrāpi vibhaktyā sādhanatā eva ca vivakṣyante, na tu sādhanatā'vacchedakā- lakṣaṇyathya kārakāntarapratipādanam, tatrāpi vākyīya eva dīnyapi |
tena yāgavatpuroḍāśavrīhīlābhāyameva na viniyogaḥ, na śrutaḥ |
yathā ca brīhiyavayoḥ kāraṇātābhede'pi yatra- draṣṭavyam |
tadevaṃ śrutiviniyojakatve tadbhūtādhikaraṇenaiva sādhāraṇyam, tathā kaustubhe vistaraḥ |
tatra navamādau siddhe adhunā gauṇamukhyasādhāraṇaśrutiviniyogopayoga- copapādyate |
teṣu kiṃ sarvasādhāraṇamavaghātādau uddeśyatā'vacchedakam, ājya-oṣadhi-sāṃnāyyadharmāṇāṃmutpatyapūrvaprayukta- uta ājyādiṣvanyādṛśam ? evamanyatrāpīti vicāraḥ |
tayā yathāyogaṃ vyavasthā tṛtīyā-(3|1|4) siddhāmaṅgīkṛtya, tatra na tāvat śrutaṃ brīhilādikameva uddeśyatā'vacchedakam, utpatyapūrvasādhanatvasya sukhādiṣvapi satvāt ati- ānarthakyāpatteḥ |
avaghātaprokṣaṇādiyatirekeṇāpi prasaṅgamāśaṅkya nirākriyate iti 'teṣāmarthādhikaraṇena' brīhilāvacchinnāderyājamānatvāt yatheṣu anāpatteśca |
soma. 1|1|5. 'teṣāmarthena ato namāyādhikaraṇanyāyena brīhilāvikṣayā apūrva- saṃbandhaḥ' ityādibhiḥ 'timiridhikaraṇaiḥ' saṃskāradravya- sādhanatvalakṣaṇā āvaśyakatvāt |
tatra phalaprayāsaśca- guṇānāṃ śrutaśeṣatvena vyavasthā abhihitā |

tvāt ekatvāt ārādupakārakeṣu klaptaprayojakatvaśakti- ku. 3|1|7|13. 'teṣāmarthādhikaraṇe (3|1|4|7-10) mattvācca paramāpūrvasya tsādhanatvameva pradeyaghaṭakatvasaṃbandhena saṃskāraviniyogaḥ : kathyate |
vā. 3|1|4 pṛ. 665. ata eva na bāhyaniyamayādo'pi |
ata uddeśyatā'vacchedaka- 'ārupyasāmyuttvena kathaṃ prati karaṇatvāsaṃbhavena, 'sarvasādhāraṇatvāt ājyādiṣvapi avaghātādeḥ 'teṣāmarthena saṃbandhaḥ' ityādhikaraṇe 'vihitastu sarva- saṃkaraḥ |
tathātve dharmaḥ syāt saṃyogato'viśeṣāt' iti pūrvapakṣasūtrokta- brīhilādivivakṣayā āvaśyakatvena nīvārādiṣu anāpatteḥ |
nyāyena (prakṛtāpūrvasādhanaṃ varjayitvā sarvatra sarve dharmāḥ iti prāpte, yadyapi vidhiḥ aviśeṣaprayattaḥ syāt, saṃbadhyante) prakṛtāpūrvasādhanadravyamātre niveśo yujyate |
tathāpi dṛṣṭārthatve niyamavidhilāghavāccānurodhena viśeṣe ku. 3|1|6|12 pṛ. 252. # yatra tu brīhyādi- vyavasthāpyate, kimuta yadā so'pi viśeṣaprayattaḥ eva |
vākye kāraṇatādvayaṃ pramāṇasiddham, tatraiva āgneyādau brīhyādipade pratyāsattyā āgneyādyutpatyapūrvasādhanatvasyaiva vaijātyakalparna iti teṣāmarthādhikaraṇe vakṣyate |
tasyāpi aniśritaprakārakatvena dharmaprayojaka- kau. 2|1|4|9 pṛ. 67. brīhyādivākyaikalakṣaṇasādhanatve tvopapatteḥ |
ānarthakyābhāvena tadatikramakāraṇābhāvāt, vyabhicāraparihārāya āgneyopāṃśuyājādiṣyāpyo dharmo'stīti paraṃparāyā phalavattvāt |
ato brīhiyena brīhisādhanāni teṣāmarthādhikaraṇe (3|1|4|7-10) kaustubhe uktam |

yāni āgneyādīmīyandrādīmyutpatyapūrvāṇi, tanninnakārya- bhāṭṭa. 5|1|4. brīhibhyajeta iti śāstrāvagataṃ yaddhaviḥ tānirūpitayāgādiṣṭhaprakāratāsamānādhikaraṇakāryatāniru- prakṛtitayā apūrvasādhanam, tatra avaghātaparyavasānena pitapadeyaprakṛtibhūtataṇḍuladravyāpārasādhanatāvādimānyā- aṣṭāṅkatvaṃ teṣāmarthādhikaraṇe-karītyā pratyāsattitvena śrayatvasyaiva uddeśyatā'vacchedakatvena vivakṣitatvāt ājyādiṣu avāntarapūrvaprayuktatvādvā na sāṅkaryam |
atra ca apūrvatvasya ekānugama-kāmāve'pi na tāvat sarvasāmava-ghātādīnāṃ apūrvatvamapahāya ekapadopādānāt vākyabhedaḥ |
tattavyāpāra- svargārthatvaṃ śaṅkituṃ śakyam, brīhyādipadena pratyāsannatayā teṣāmarthādhikaraṇa-
ṛca ityasti vede 'ahe budhniya mantraṃ me gopāya yampaśyallaividā viduḥ |
ṛcalakṣaṇakā ṛcaḥ iti prāsaṅgikamantravicāraṃ parisamāpya idānīṃ mantraviśeṣaścatuṛcyajuḥsāmapadārthanirūpaṇaṃ anu- prasaṅgena kriyate |
atrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣo'bhisandhiḥ, yatrārthena pādavyavasthā sā ṛgiti ṛllakṣaṇamuktam |
'agniḥ pūrvairmiḥ' ityatra kriyāpadābhāvena arthāvaccheda- niyatadhanapādavyavasthāpyatirekeṇāpi ṛgarthanāt |
ataḥ anirūpaṇameva ṛkpadārthasya ityevaṃ prāpte, abhīdhīyate |
pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtreṇa prāptaṃ apivā itiśabdena nirasyan siddhāntamāha |
upāyena upanayanena saha ete dharmāḥ pravartai- ran, vedatulyatvāt vidhāyakāḥ smṛteḥ |
tasmin pūrvasūtokte saurye carau peṣaṇaṃ syāt |
anartha- lopāt arthalopāmāt devatāsaṃpradānātprayojana- lopābhāvāt, peṣaṇe kṛte'pi devatāyai dātuṃ śakyatvāt |
saurye carau peṣaṇasya akriyā na kriyā na karta- vyatā |
apūpe puroḍāśe kartavye tasya hetuḥ peṣaṇam |
peṣaṇe kṛte tu viśadatā na syāt, khalatiḥ syāt |
tasmāt carau kartavye na peṣaṇamiti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. oṃ tasmin vidite sarvaṃ viditaṃ bhavatīti nyāyaḥ |
ayamarthaḥ - 'viduro maitreyasamīpe gatvā sarvajñatāsiddhayai bahu pṛṣṭavān |
tatra, tasmin- vidite sarvaṃ viditaṃ bhavatīti nyāyena bhagavaccaritra jñāte sarvaṃ jñātaṃ bhavati' ityuktamiti |
tasmin pūrvasūtokte jvalato vṛkṣāt āhmata caṇakādibharjanapātrāt sutasān, prādāt dāvāmervā āhṛtya ukhāyāṃ sthāpite agnau saṃskārakarma ādhānādayaḥ saṃskārāḥ kartavyāḥ |
yataḥ sarvakarmāṇi saṃskārāḥ śiṣṭāḥ vihitāḥ, idānīṃ ca ukhye evāgnau sarvakarmāṇi kriyante |
ādhānasaṃskṛtasya nityāgneḥ sthāne ayamasaṃskṛtaḥ ukhyo'gniḥ śrutaḥ |
darvihomaḥ somavikāro vā apūrvo veti vicāre pūrva- pakṣamāha |
tasmin darvihome somaḥ pravartaita saumiko vidhyantaḥ syāt |
na vā svāhākāreṇa saṃyogād vaṣaṭkārasya ca nirdeśāt, tantra tena vipratiṣedhāt |
'pṛthivyai svāhā antarikṣāya svāhā' iti svāhākāreṇa saṃyogāt |
some hi vaṣaṭkāro bhavati, darvihome tu svāhākāro vidyate |
evaṃ sati saumike tantre svīkṛte tena vaṣaṭkāreṇa svāhākārasya vipratiṣedhāt vipratiṣedha- prasaṅgāt na saumiko vidhyanto darvihome |
etena svāhākāreṇa vaṣaṭkārasya vipratiṣedhāt na tatra saumiko vidhyanta iti tantrārthaḥ |
darvihomaḥ apūrva eva na somavikāra iti siddhānte hetvantaramāha |
darvihome na saumiko vidhyantaḥ; kintu apūrvamityatra liṅgasya darśanaṃ bhavati |
vidhāya ājyavidhipare vākye 'ghṛtena cāvāpṛthivī āpuṇethā miti antarā karṇau juhoti ā mūlādanvavakṣāya- yati, bhūmigate svāhā karoti' iti |
saumiko yadi vidhyanto vaṣaṭkārastato bhavet, na svāhākāraḥ |
hutamājyaṃ yathā śākhādvārā bhūmau gataṃ syāt, tathā bhūyo hotavyam |
bhūmi- gate cājye sati svāhākāraḥ paṭhanīyaḥ, na tu prāgeva homakāle iti śrutyarthaḥ |
uttarārthastu svāhākāro yathā sāmadasyaṃ, tatrā- vipratiṣiddhā punaḥ pravṛttirliṅgadarśanāt paśuvat |
darvihome somavidhyanto nāstītyatra siddhāntinā liṅga- darśanamuktam, tatpariharati pūrvapakṣī |
yathā sāmadasya- manārambhādhītaṃ sāmidhenīsāsadasyaṃ prakṛtiṃ gacchati |
tatra prākaraṇikena pāścadasyena bādhitaṃ sat vikṛtitu gatam |

tathaiva 'svāhākāreṇa vaṣaṭkāreṇa vā devebhyo haviḥ pradīyate' iti anārambhādhītaḥ svāhākāraḥ darśapūrṇamāsau homaṃ ca prakṛtiṃ nividhvaḥ vaṣaṭkāreṇopārūḍhaḥ tadarthaṃ somavarja anyāni pradānāni upasaṃkrāmati |
tatra evaṃ sati audu- mbarīhomādau saumikavidhyantasya pravṛttiḥ apratiṣiddhā na viruddhā |
yathā śrutasāmidhenīsāsadasye paśau prayājādiliṅgadarśanāt darśapūrṇamāsadharmapravṛttiḥ na viruddhā, sāsadasyasya vācanikatvāt |
tadvat audu- mbarīhome vācanikatvāt svāhākāraṃ prati liṅgadarśanāt na saumikadharmapravṛttirvidhyiṣyate |
darvihome somavidhyantaḥ; svāhākārastu uttarārthaḥ iti pūrvapakṣī yadāha tatraivāha |
svāhākāraḥ anuttarārthaḥ na uttarārthaḥ na vaṣaṭ- kārasyutpadanārthaḥ |
yadi prakṛtau svāhākāraḥ sārthakaḥ na syāt tadā tena anarthakatvāt nirava- kāśatvena balavattvāt prākṛtasya saumikasya vaṣaṭkārasya sāvakāśāt uparodhaḥ syāt bādhaḥ syāt |
anuttarārtha- tvācca darvihomānāṃ somapūrvatvābhāve 'bhūmigate svāhā karoti' iti liṅgaṃ bhavatyeva |
prakṛtāvapi darśapūrṇamāsayorapi vikṛtāviva nāriṣṭhahomādau niveśo na saṃbhavati |
tatrāpi aviśeṣeṇa vihito vaṣaṭkāra eva prāpnoti |
tasmāt svāhākāra uttarārtha eva bhavati vikṛtyarthaḥ |
svāhākārasya nāriṣṭhahomādau vaṣaṭ- kāreṇa na bādhaḥ |
prakaraṇena nāriṣṭhahomeṣu vaṣaṭkāraḥ prāptaḥ; nāriṣṭhahomamantraiḥ ekavākyatvāt svāhākāro vākyena prāptaḥ |
evaṃ vākyaprakaraṇayoḥ saṃnipāte prāpte uktaṃ samavāye pāradaurbalyaṃ śrutiliṅgasūtre tṛtīyādhyāye |
tasmāt svāhākārasya prakṛtau niveśāt sa na vikṛtyarthaḥ |
taccodanā veṣṭeḥ pravṛttatvāt tad vidhiḥ syāt |
darvihomeṣu nāriṣṭhahomavidhyantaḥ astu iti pakṣāntara- māha |
vāśabdaḥ somavidhyantapakṣaṃ apūrvapakṣaṃ ca vyāva- rtayati |
iṣṭeḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ saṃbandhinau taccodanā juhoticodanā nāriṣṭhahodanā, sarveṣu sarvapaśuṣu ca pravṛttatvāt tat tatra vāstuhome vidhiḥ syāt, vidhīyate iti vidhiḥ, vidhīyamānā syāt vihitā syāt |
vāstu- home darśapūrṇamāsagatanāriṣṭhacodanā pravartaita anyatra pravṛtta- tvādityarthaḥ |
darvihomeṣu nāriṣṭhahomavidhyantaḥ syāt iti pakṣāntare hetvantaramāha |
yaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ saḥ nāriṣṭhahomaprakṛtitvāt vyambakeṣu prāptānāṃ imādīnāṃ pratiṣedhako vidhiḥ syāt |
pratiṣedhaśca prāptiṃ darśayan nāriṣṭhavikṛtitvameva vyambakānāṃ sādhayati |
tasmāt darvihomeṣu nāriṣṭhadharmaprāptau yat liṅgamuktam 'yadi kīṭo'vapadyeta' 'antaḥparidhi ninayet' 'antarvedi tiṣṭhan sāvitrāṇi juhoti' ityādi, tat yuktameva |
na vākyaśeṣatvāt, guṇārthe ca samādhānaṃ, nānātve nopapadyate |
vyambakeṣu 'nemāvāhaiḥ saṃjñāhate, na prajāyā ijyante' ityādiḥ nāriṣṭhahomavṛttitvena prāptānāmimāvāhairdīnāṃ pratiṣedhako vidhiriti śaṅkāṃ tṛtīyapakṣeṇa pariharati |
'ādityaṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapet punaretya gṛheṣu' ityasya vidheḥ 'aprati- ṣṭhitā vai vyambakā nemāvāhaiḥ saṃjñāhate' ityādivākyaṃ vākyaśeṣaḥ arthavādaḥ
pacciḥ ( vikalpaḥ ) smṛtyācārayoḥ syāt, na tu |
tatra kecit dīrghaśuke yavaśabdaṃ prayuñjate, ācārasya daurbalyam |
varāhaśabdaṃ kecit sūkare, kecit oṃ teṣvadarśanād virodhasya samā vipratipattiḥ |
atra saṃgatilobhāt prabhākareṇa bhāṣya- prājāpatyān saṃcinoti’ iti tatratatra śrutam |
yavaśabdaṃ kecit dīrghaśukre saktuṣu prayuñjate, kecit |
evaṃ hi manyate, nirapekṣaśāstradvayavihitayor vrīhiyavayo- priyaṅguṣu |
midaṃ vākyaṃ na anādhṛtaṃ dīrghaśukapriyaṅgarūpomayārtha- jambvām |
tatra anuṣṭhāne niścitaṃ kiṃ grāhyamiti vicāre |
caikasya mukhyatvam, aparasya gauṇatvamiti nirdhārayituṃ prāmāṇikatvena virodhasya arthādanāt samaiva vipratipattiḥ |
kintu bhāṣyakāramate vāruṇa- pūrvapakṣaṃ vāśabdena nirasyan siddhāntamāha |
śāstre vartamānā yā viśiṣṭā pratipattiḥ pratīyateḥ saiva |
vārtikakāramate tu yavamatamīmiddhiḥ audumbaryāḥ prokṣaṇe svīkāryā syāt |
priyajñacapi prayogadarśanāt arthāpatyā tatrāpi śaktiḥ kalpanīyā iti vaktavyam |
yataḥ tatsiddhinyāyenaiva (1412123-1) gauṇaśāstraṇayenaiva priyajñe prayogasya anyathāsiddhatvena arthāpatteḥ pariṣyāditi |
tattai śrutaṃ iti mantre 'tasmai śrutaṃ' ityādiḥ ūhaḥ na kartavyaḥ sācasve trivatsakhāṇḍamantre |
tatra yāvat yāge samantrakaṃ karma yājamānaṃ nāma, tat sarvaṃ palyāḥ na bhavati |

kintu āśīḥ : āśīrvācakā mantrāḥ (vārtike tu āśīḥ :- śabdena keśadhamyupanādayaḥ saṃskārā lakṣyante ityuktam ) 'āyudāṃ ame'syāyurme dehi' ityādayaḥ, brahmacaryaṃ ca, yacca 'patnī saṃnahyati' 'patnīṃ vācayati' ityādi patnīmadhikṛtya yāvaduktam, tat sarvaṃ patnyā kartavyam, netat |
tasmāt tasyāḥ patnyāḥ yāvaduktaṃ āśīḥ brahmacaryaṃ ca, tatraivādhikāraḥ |
pavamāneṣṭyartheḥ agniḥ kimādhānapavamāneṣṭisaṃskṛtaḥ syāt, kevalādhānasaṃskṛto vā iti saṃdehaḥ pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
tāsāṃ pavamāneṣṭimadhikṛtya yo'gniḥ, sa prakṛtitaḥ syāt |
darśapūrṇamāsaprakṛtau tāvat agniḥ kevalena ādhānena pavamāneṣṭima saṃskṛta eva bhavati |
vikṛtiśca prakṛtitvat bhavati iti, prakṛtau yādṛśo'gniḥ, tādṛśa eva prakṛtitaḥ prāto'gniḥ : tāsāmagnīnāṃ syāt |
prayājavat, yathā prakṛtau prayājā bhavanti iti pavamāneṣṭivi prakṛtita- vadvāt prayājāḥ bhavanti, tadvat abhirapi iti |
ādhānasyapavamāneṣṭināgniḥ pavamāneṣṭisaṃskṛtaḥ syāt itipūrvapakṣasya nirākaraṇārtho vāśabdaḥ |
na pavamāneṣṭinā- magniḥ pavamāneṣṭisaṃskṛto bhavati, kintu kevalādhānasaṃskṛta evāgniḥ tāsām |
kutaḥ ? tāsāṃ pavamāneṣṭinā tadarthatvāt anyathātvāt agnisaṃskārārthatvāt |
pavamāneṣṭyarthe pavamāne- ṣṭikaraṇe tu anavasthā syāt |
tasmāt pavamāneṣṭināgniḥ kevalādhānasaṃskṛta eva syāt iti siddhāntaḥ |
tasyāṃ tu syāt prayājavat' ityetadadhikaraṇa- nyāyena pavamānahaviḥsaṃskṛtābhidhāvat tāsāṃ (pava- māneṣṭināṃ ) asti nāsti iti vicāraḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsayordvena vihitārambhāṅgatvena vidhāyaka- mekameva vākyam 'āgneyavaiṣṇavekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet darśapūrṇamāsāvārambhayamānaḥ' iti |
tasmāt ārambhaṇīyā'rthe ārambhaṇīyā na kartavyā iti siddhāntaḥ |
tadantamapakarṣe syāt ityanena nyāyena prayājāpakarṣe ādhārādīnāṃ yathā apakarṣaḥ, (anena nyāyārthaḥ uktaḥ |
) tathā abhiṣekāpakarṣe videvādīnāmapakarṣaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
adhvarakalpāyām 'purā vācaḥ pravaditornirvapet' atra sarvairvāvāpakarṣe tadantāpakarṣanyāyena nirvapānta- padārthānāṃ sarvaprayogīyāṇāṃ tantreṇa karaṇam, iti prāte... |
bhāṭṭa. 11|2|13. 'dīkṣāsu yūpaṃ chinatti' ityapakṛṣyamāṇaṃ agnīṣomīyādīn apakarṣati tadantā- pakarṣanyāyāt iti prāpte |
sa ca pratikṛṣyamāṇaḥ tadantāpakarṣanyāyāt tataḥ prāco 'pi padārthānapakarṣati iti ārambhatvāt ubhayoḥ samānatantraḥ, ityādi prāte |
bhāṭṭa. 11|2|13. tadantalatadādi- tvaniyāmakaḥ pūrvottarapadārthayoḥ krama eva |
tena jyotiṣṭome agnīṣomīyapaśoḥ prayājāntānāmapakarṣaḥ ; savanīye ca anuyājāntānāmapakarṣaḥ |
( 3|2|7 bra. ) iti nyāyena samarthyamānā prayāgā- tmano viśuddhiḥ |
( tadabhāvaḥ tataḥ : jāgratsvapnayorbhāvaḥ nāḍīṣu cakārāt purīti ātmani na jīve saṃpanne bhavati |
kutaḥ ? tacchruteḥ 'āsu tadā nāḍīṣu suto bhavati' 'purītāti śete' 'ya eṣo'tahṛdaya ākāśaḥ, tasmin śete' iti śrutibhyaḥ iti akṣarārthaḥ |
yathā sarveṣāṃ brahmādidevānāmamīśvaratvāt tadabhinnatve anyonyamapyabheda iti bhāvaḥ |
agniṣṭome ekaṃ sāma tuce pratyucaṃ parisamāptaṃ geyaṃ ityavagatam |
tadabhyāsaḥ pratyucaṃ tasya sāmnaḥ abhyāsaḥ samāsu samānacchandaskāsu tisṛṣu ṛkṣu kartavyaḥ syāt, na samāsu viṣamāsu vā aniya- mena |
agniṣṭome pratyucaṃ parisamāptaṃ geyaṃ sāma samāna- cchandaskāveva tisṛṣu ṛkṣu geyaṃ ityatra liṅgasya darśanaṃ bhavati 'khyālyāṃ sakhi avadhīyate ityāhuḥ; yad bṛhat gāyatrīṣu kriyate' iti |

'tvāmiddhi havāmahe' iti ekatriṃśadakṣarāyāmuci utpannaṃ bṛhat sāma gāyatrīṣu catu- viṃśatyakṣarāsu gātavyaṃ iti yat, tat sālyāṃ alpapari- māṇāyāṃ sakhi ūruḥ adhikaparimāṇaḥ pākāyarthe ava- hitaḥ syāt tadat bhavet |
nahi alpe mahān ava- syāt śaknoti iti hi tatroktam |
tasmāt viṣama- cchandaskāsu sāma na geyamiti siddhaṃ bhavati |
bhāṣyīyāṃ varṇakāntaraṃ tu 'naikoccāvi- karaṇam' ityatra draṣṭavyam |
dvādaśāhe caturthe'hani naikoccaṃ nāma sāma 'viśvāḥ putanā abhibhūtaraṃ naram' ityetāyāṃ atijagatyāmutpannam |
uttare dve ṛcau tu 'nemi namanti cakṣuṣā' iti 'samī rebhāso akṣaran' iti ca bṛhatyau |
tatra vicāryate kimantye dve atijagatyau kutaścidupādāya samāsaiva naikoccaṃ gātavyam, kiṃvā viṣamatveveti |
tadabhyāsaḥ tasya naikoccasāmnaḥ abhyāsaḥ samāsu syāt |
viśvāḥ putanā ityekā svaivā ati- jagatī, anye ca dve atijagatyāveva dāśatayībhya āgamayya tāsu tisṛṣu naiśokaṃ gātavyamiti |
'atijagatoṣu stuvanti' iti bahuvacanarūpasya liṅga darśanāt samākhyeya |
uttarā- granthe pāṭhanimittāt āntarāttyaṃ bahvoreva uttarāt syāt, tatra śrautapāṭhanimittena naimittikam |
nātra dve atijagatyau kutaścit āgamamityatra, pāṭhaśruterbalīyastvāt |
nanu yadi naiśokaṃ viṣamacchandake tṛce gīyate, tadā tṛce iti saṃkhyāvācaka: śabda: anupanapanna: syāt iti cenna |
nanu tathāpi 'ati- jagatīṣu stuvanti' iti atijagatīśabdasya bahuvacanaṃ nopapadyate iti cet, tatrāha tadabhyāsa: iti |
'ekaviṃśa: ṣoḍaśī' iti ṣoḍaśini sarvāṇyeva stotrāṇi ekaviṃśāni bhavanti, tatra naiśoka'pi sāmani saskṛt: abhyasyamāne evaṃ sati atijagatīṣu satī sattasaṃkhyāmāpadyate |
evaṃ sati atijagatīṣu iti bahuvacanamupapadyate eva |
ayedānīṃ kiṃ vivakṣitavacanā mantrā:, uta aviva- kṣitavacanā iti kimarthaprakāśane yāge upakurvanti, uta uccāraṇamātreṇeti |

atra prabhākareṇa saṃgatilobhāt itthamupavarṇitamadhikaraṇam- 'uru prathā uru prathasveti puroḍāśaṃ prathayati' ityatra 'uru prathā uru prathasva' iti mantrasya yadi artho vivakṣita:, tadā tasyārthā- deva liṅgāt puroḍāśaprathane tasya viniyogasiddhe: 'puro- ḍāśaṃ prathayati' iti tadarthaśāstramavivakṣitārthe syāt |
atha tadarthaśāstraṃ vivakṣitārtham, tadā mantrasya aviva- kṣitārthatā, iti parasparavyāghātāt aprāmāṇyaṃ codanāyā: |
siddhāntastu, kiñcitkarasya kiñcitkāryaṃ kiñcit-kriyādvāreṇa viniyogo bhavati |
yathā ava- ghātasya kiñcitkarasya kiñcitkāryaṃ vrīhau dvitīyā'bhidheya- phalabhāgitārūpakriyādvāreṇa |
tena yatra etat tritayaṃ śrutito'vagamyate, tatra śrutita eva viniyogāvagamo bhavati |
iha puna: 'iti puroḍāśaṃ prathayati' iti śruti itkaraṇena kiñcitkaro mantra: pratīyate |
puroḍāśaṃ prathayate iti puroḍāśaprathanaṃ kiñcitkāryaṃ prakāśanaṃ ca kiñcit-kriyāviśeṣa: śrute: |
pratīyate tu mantrasya abhidhānasāmarthyarūpān liṅgāt abhidhāyakasya mantrasya kiñcitkaratā |
abhidheyasya kiñcitkāryatayā, abhidhānasya ca prakāśanarūpasya kiñcitkriyātvamiti |
tena mantraliṅgādeva tritayopasthite: mantraliṅgeva puro- ḍāśaprathane mantraviniyogakrama: |
tathā ca sati 'puro- ḍāśaṃ prathayati' iti śruti: anuvādidaiva |

yatra tu śrutyaiva tritayopasthiti: yathā 'aindryā gārhapatyamupa- tiṣṭhate' iti aindrīmantrasya kiñcitkāryatayā, upapadyetya tiṣṭhate: prakāśanārthatvāt prakāśanasya kiñcitkriyātva- miti, tatra śrutireva viniyojikā |
na ca iha mantra- liṅgasya viniyojakatvāt śrutervaiyarthyam, anvitakārya- pratipādanenaiva prayojanavattvāt |
nahi sarvameva anvita- kāryapratipādanāt anyat prayojanamasti |
anuvāde'pi tat anyāhatameva iti na parasparavyāghātāt aprāmāṇyaṃ codanāyā iti |
mantrasya tu sāmarthyānusāreṇa kalpanīya: śrutyā viniyoga: |
tadarthaśāstraṃ tu śrutirūpatayā svata eva viniyojakam |

pūrvapakṣokta: parasparavyāghātāstu kuta: ? na ca vācyam 'yadyapi adhyāpanavidhiprayukkamadhyayanam, tathāpi nānta- rīyakatayā gamyamānasyārthasyāpi antaraṅgatayā adhyeya- dhikāraparyavasānāttamapekṣisata adhyayanavidhinā vivakṣi- tatvāt kṛtsnasyaiva mantrasya vivakṣitārthatvena bhavati' vyāghātā: ' iti, nirvāpamantre 'devasya tvā savitu: prasave' ityādināmavivakṣitārthanāmapi darśanāt |
yathā ca tepāmuccāraṇaṃ humādipadānāṃ coccāraṇaṃ prayogasamavetārthā-
bhāvena arhārtham, tathā tadarthaśāstreṇa tādrūpyapari- cchedāt atrāpi arhārthameva mantroccāraṇamiti yuktam |
bhavatu vā mantrasya vivakṣitārthatve tatkārita eva mantra- viniyoga:, tathāpi tadarthaśāstrasya na avivakṣitārthatvam |
yata: arthavādādhikaraṇe eva etannirūpitaṃ yat 'vidhi- prāptaprāptasyānuvādakasyāpi arthavādasya adhyayanavidhi- vaśāt anuvādakatvenaiva vivakṣitārthatvam' (iti) |
ata: tulyanyāyatayā tenaiva gatatvāt tulyārthayo: mantratadartha- śāstrayo: anyatarasya anuvādakatvena vivakṣitārthatve sati yadetat vyāghātābhidhānam, tat pūrvaparāvahitasyaiva iti yatkiñcit etat |

arthavādānāṃ vidheyastyupayogadvāreṇa prāmāṇye nirū- pite sati idānīṃ mantrāṇāṃ vihitārthaprakāśanopayogadvāreṇa prāmāṇye pratipādayitavye kiṃ vivakṣitārthā mantrā:, uta avivakṣitārthā iti nirūpyate |
na tāvat vihitārthaprakāśane mantrāṇāṃ ṛtū- payoga: saṃbhavati, dhyānādibhirapi tadupapatte: mantrasyai- vyarthāt, viparītatvācca |
ayaṃ hi prathamamavagate tadācaka- śabdasmaraṇaṃ bhavati |
sa cedartha: prathamamavagata eva, kiṃ mantrena |
na ca 'mantrasmāritudhāneva ṛtūpakāra: sidhyati' iti niyama: saṃbhavati, yato vivakṣitārthatve sati mantrāṇāṃ avaghātādivat niyāmakakalpanāpatti: |

yadi hi 'uru prathā uru prathasva' iti mantro vivakṣitārtha: syāt, tadā tamidhānasāmarthyādeva puroḍāśaprathane vina- yogasiddhe: 'anena mantreṇa puroḍāśaṃ prathayati' iti viniyogaśruti: anarthikā bhavet |
taduktaṃ bhāṣye (1214131 pṛ. 145) 'sākṣaścat anyena nīyate, nunamarthāṃ na paśyati' iti |
kiñca kaścita mantraliṅgaviparītasyaiva śrutyā viniyogo dṛśyate yathā aindrīmantrasya gārhapatye |
evaṃ nirvāpamantre 'devasya tvā savitu: prasave' ityādināmaprayoga- samavetārthānāṃ avayavamavivakṣitārthatvaṃ vaktavyam |
tathā mī. ko. 236 humādipadānāṃ ca arthābhāvāt avivakṣitārthatvaṃ siddha- meva |
tena yatrāpi artho'vagamyate, tatrāpi apekṣyate: anyata: siddhatvena uktatvāt avivakṣitārthatvaṃ siddhameva mantrāṇāmiti |
ata: prakaraṇapaṭhitānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ ca mantrāṇāṃ yathāsaṃbhavaṃ śrutivākyaprakaraṇādibhivini- yuktānāṃ pradhānavidhinā svarūpameva aṅgīkṛtam |
tacca svarūpaṃ akriyārūpatvāt yadyapi na itikartavyatāmadhi- kurute, tathāpi svarūpādvārthe avaśyamabhyupetavyoccāraṇa- kriyādvāreṇa kārakatvenaiva svīkriyate |
nanu apekṣitā- rthāvabodhārtha: adhyayanavidhi: kṛtsnasvādhyāyasya vivakṣitā- rthatvamāpādayan mantrasya avivakṣitārthatve virudhyeta |
ayathā mantrāṇāme'pi apekṣitāva- bodhārthaṃ eva adhyayanavidhi: |
tat atrāpi tadarthaśāstrādibhi: mukhyārthatvānupa- patte: pratipādakatvena mukhyārthatveva svarūpameva mantrā lakṣayanti |
tacca svarūpaṃ dṛṣṭasaṃbhavāt uccāraṇadvāreṇa adṛṣṭena upakaraṇaṃ kratū upayujyate iti bhavati atrāpi adhyayanavidhi: apekṣitāvabodhopapattalam |
nanu bhinnārthe lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvo bhavati yathā prāśastyārthavādayo: |
iha tu tadeva mantrasvarūpaṃ lakṣyaṃ lakṣakamiti svātmani itivirodhāt na saṃbhavati |
yathā hi asya pramāṇatvaṃ rūpam, tathā prameyatvamapi asya astyeva |
tena pramāṇatvena rūpeṇa lakṣakatvam, prameyatvena ca lakṣyatvaṃ iti kimapyanupapannam |
etena 'śābdānvayo- 'nvayāt' kathamaśābdasya mantrasya śābdakatvabhāvanā''- nvaya: ' ityetadapi pratyuktam |
ekasyaiva mantrasya pratipādya- pratipādakarūpeṇa lakṣaṇayā śābdatvasya uktatvāt ityetat tadarthaśāstrādibhi: avivakṣitārthatvena mantrāṇāmadṛṣṭārtha- tvameva |
na tatra svarūpanāthātvam, mantrasamānāyyatainaiva pāṭhena tasya siddhatvāt |
tena ṛtaprayogajñāpanārthameva tat iti niśvī- yate |
ṛtaprayogaśca teṣāṃ prayājādivākyavat nārthamarpa- ṇena, nivṛttanyāyāṇāṃ tadarthasya vidhivyākhyādevāgate |
tacca svarūpaṃ svayamakriyātvāt yadyapi netikartavyatārūpeṇa prakaraṇena gṛhyate, tathāpi kārakatvena rūpeṇa grahītuṃ śakyate eva |
kiṃ karthatasya kārakatvamityapekṣāyām, 'yat śaknuyāt' iti dṛṣṭakalpanānusaṃdhāne vākyārthapratītiḥ |
mantravākyārthaśca pratītaḥ san ekadeśadhāreṇāpi śaknoti tat smārayitum, iti vihitapadārthasaraṇaphala- vākyārthajñānameva kurvatāṃ bhavati prakaraṇena kārakatvā grahaṇam |
tena uccāraṇameva eṣāṃ svarūpāmicchatye prayoga- kāle avaśyakaraṇīyam, na tu prayājādivākyānāmapi prakaraṇagrahaṇam, teṣāṃ svarūpasyānahāditi viśeṣaḥ |

yadi tu smṛtiphalamapekṣyeta dṛṣṭamarthajñānaṃ nopalabhyeta, tadā kevalādṛṣṭoccāraṇakriyayaiva asya kārakatvaṃ bhavedapi, sati tu paraṃparayā'pi dṛṣṭalame nādṛṣṭakalpanā upapatti- matī iti vivakṣitārthā eva mantrā iti |
na ca dhyānādibhirapi smaraṇopapattau mantravaiyarthyam, niyamā- dṛṣṭenaiva arthavattvāt |
yathā hi prakārāntareṇāpi vaituṣya- siddhau niyamārthaḥ avaghātādividhiḥ arthavān bhavati, tathā ayamapi iti nānupapannam |
ataḥ vivakṣitārthe- tvāmantrāṇāṃ na svādhyāyāvināśāya mantrādhyayanam |
nanu kathaṃ tarhi siddhānte'pi aśābdasya mantrasya ṛtu- bhāvanā samanvayaḥ ? tatra kecit śābdatvasiddhayarthaṃ siddhānte'pi lakṣaṇyā svarūparatvaṃ vadanti, tadayuktam |
mukhyārthaparityāgena tatsaṃbaddhopapādakāntarakalpanā hi lakṣaṇā iti lakṣaṇātattvam |
na cātra pūrvapakṣavādimate iva siddhānte'pi mukhyārthaparityāgo'sti, vivakṣitārthatvā- mantrāṇām |
kintu prayogabhāvanā anuṣṭheyasmṛtimatareṇa anupapadyamānā prakaraṇamātmanārthavattvāya smṛtisamarthe mantrameva smṛtihetutayā aṅgīkurute |
tacca mantrasya aśābdatve na saṃbhavati iti tadarthe śrutārthapatyā tatpara- śabdakalpanāmeva ucitam |
viśvajitdādau iva upapādakatvena tarkiṃtasya svārthasya tatparaśabdakalpane, iti nānupapannam |
na ca tadarthaśāstrādibhiḥ avivakṣitārthatvam, tadarthaśāstrā- ścaiva abhāvāt; tatra 'barhirdevasadanaṃ dāmi' ityādī tāvat tatsaṃbhāvanaiva na samasti |
yatrāpi tatsaṃbhāvanā samasti abhyādānādamantreṣu, tatrāpi na śrutermantravini- yojakatvam |
kiṃ tarhi ? sāmarthyato mantrāḥ tadādāne prāptāḥ 'tāṃ caturbhirmādatte' iti śrutyā catuḥsaṃkhyā'pi ādāne vihitā |
tathokta ekādaśinyā'nye sati arthaika- hāyanīnyāyena parasparaniyame sati 'samuccitaireva caturbhi- mantraiḥ ādāne kartavyam' iti vākyārthaḥ saṃpadyate |
evam 'imā- magman raśanāmṛtyetyasyābhimānādatte' ityādī ca mantrasya sāmarthyataḥ gardabharaśanāyāmapi prāptirbhavet |

tathāpi liṅgaviniyogasya śrutyanumāne viprakṛṣṭatvāt 'ityasyābhimānādatte' iti pratyakṣaśrutiśādeva mantrasya aśaraśanāyāṃ viniyogāt mantraprakaraṇinoḥ nairākāṅkṣye sati na liṅgadvāreṇa sāmānyaśrutikalpanam |
kintu vinā- 'pi vidhinā prāpyataḥ kiṃ vidhinā iti prayojanagave- ṣaṇāyaṃ liṅgasya raśanāmātrāviṣayatvāt gardabharaśanāyāmapi mantrasaptau tannimittaiva prayojanam |
taduktaṃ grahādhikaraṇe 'rūpakaraṇadvārā śrutivat prakalpyate (yāvattu kalpyate iti mūle) |
tāvat pratyakṣyā śrutyā vidhiḥ śīghraṃ samāpyate |
prayojanaṃ vidheḥ kiṃ syādityati tu nirū- paṇe |
'uda prathā ura prathasvati puroḍāśaṃ prathayati, yakṣyata iti prajā paśubhiḥ
prathayati' ityatra tu puroḍāśaprathanameva aprāptaṃ vidhīyate |
na ca puroḍāśānyathā'nupapattyā prāptatvat prathanami- theyam, aprathitenāpi tvarāviśeṣavaśāt piṣṭakaniṣpatti- darśanāt |
prathanavidhau tu tasya avadyakartavyatvāt mantrasyāpi liṅgataḥ tanmayākathaṃ bhavati |
udāharaṇa- ntarāṇi bhāṣyāvārtikayoreva sugamānīti neha pradarśayante |
yatra punaḥ śrautaviniyogavaśādeva mantrasya tanmayākathana- sāmarthye dhurayantareṇāpi kalpanīyam, tatraiva śrute- rviniyojakatvam |
yathā 'ainyā gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhate' iti, 'dhānyamasi dhinuhi devān iti dadhadi tadupalā- nāvapati' ityādī |

nirvāpamantrādau tu devasyātvādidānāṃ asamavetārthatve'pi ekavākyabhāvabalena evaṃbhūtārtha- prakāśanainaiva smāritānāṃ vidheyārthānāmanuṣṭhānamṛdayāya iti niyāmakameva atrāpi dṛṣṭānurodhāt kalpanīyam |
yathā prokṣitābhyāmeva ulūkhalamusalābhyāmeva tadaiva vitubairhibhiḥ niṣpāditaḥ puroḍāśaḥ apūrvasādhanaṃ iti prokṣaṇamapi niyāmakaṃadhapatitam, tathaivāpi |
tena humā- dīnāmeva paraṃ arthabhāvena avivakṣitārthatvāt adṛṣṭārthameva viniyogaḥ : svādhyāyakaraṇārthe cādhyayanavidhinā pāṭhaḥ na tu anyatrāpīti |
nanu bhavatu vivakṣitārthatvam, prāmāṇyaṃ tu katham, vidhuddeśāvagatāthānuvādena anadhigatārthagatṛtvātvāt |
'ya evaṃ vidvān paurṇamāsīṃ yajate' 'ya evaṃ vidvān amāvāsyāṃ yajate' ityādī anuvādarūpatvena tadbhāvāt |
tacca paraṃparayā viddha- dākyasyaiva mantrasyāsti iti kimanupapannam |
prayojanam - yadi avivakṣitārthā mantrāḥ, tadā dhyānādibhiraiva saṃsmṛtānāmanānuṣṭhānam |
sūtraṃ tu - nahi laukika- vākyānāṃ mantravākyānāṃ ca kaścit viśeṣo'sti, yena pratīyamāno'pyartho na vivakṣyate iti |
'yo nāma kaści- diha saṃkalitaṃ prameya granthāntare likhati vā vadati svayaṃ vā |
markṛtetāmanugṛhītya, sa kīrtilopāt niḥsaṃtati- rjāgati janmaśatāni bhūyāt |
' iti bālavalmī- bhujaṅgāparanāmno bhavadevasya kṛtau tautātimata- tilake prathamasyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ |
mantrāḥ avivakṣitavacanāḥ uccāraṇamātreṇa upakurvanti iti pūrvapakṣe prathamaṃ hetumāha |
te ca liṅgadeva ādāne prāptāḥ vacanena vidhī- yante 'tāṃ caturbhirmādatte' iti |
vacanena viśeṣato vidhānāt mantrā avivakṣitārthā iti jñāpyate |
evam 'imāmagman raśanāmṛtasya' iti mantrasya 'imāma- gṛbhṇan raśanāmṛtyetyasyābhimānādatte' iti śāstraṃ vidhāyakam |
evam 'uda prathasvora te yaśasvatiḥ prathatām' iti mantrasya viniyojakaṃ śāstram 'uda prathasvati puroḍāśaṃ prathayati, yajñapatimeva tat prathayati' iti |
tadidaṃ mantrāṇāṃ vivakṣitārthatve liṅgadeva viniyogasiddheḥ anarthakam |
tasmāt avivakṣitārthā mantrā iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
tena ānandāśramīyabhāṣya- pustakamudraṇamanusṛtya khaṇḍaśo gṛhītvā vyākhyātamasmābhiḥ |
sūtrasvarūpaviṣaye adhikaṃ tu asmadīye mīmāṃsādarśane prakṛtaprameyasūtramakhaṇḍaṭippaṇyāṃ draṣṭavyam |
padasamūhātmaka mantravākyasya padakramaniyamādapi liṅgāt nārthaprakāśanādarthatvaṃ mantrāṇām |
adṛṣṭārthatve tu yathākramameva prayuktā adṛṣṭamadṛṣṭe nānyathā, iti krama- niyamaḥ arthavān |
buddhasya śāstrāntareṇa jñātasyaivārthasya viṣaye śāstrāt śāsanāt saṃpreṣavidhānāt 'amīdanīn vihara' iti |
avidyamānavacanānmantrānarthakyaṃ avidyamānasya vacanāt pratipādanāt yacca sādhanabhūtaḥ padārthaḥ : mantreṇa prakāśyatebhyaḥ |
na ca kaścit tādṛśo'sti padārthaḥ, yādṛśaṃ mantro'bhidhāti 'catvāri śṛṅgā trayo asya pādā' ityādiḥ |
nahi catuḥśṛṅgaṃ tripādaṃ diśiraskaṃ saptahastaṃ kiñcit yajñasādhanamasti |
acetane arthasya bandhanāt saṃśravakaraṇāt pratipādanāt 'oṣadhe trāyasvainam' iti 'śṛṇota grāvāṇaḥ' iti ca |
aditiraiva dyauḥ satī saiva antarikṣaṃ iti ko jātu śraddadhyāt |
evam 'eko rudro na dvitīyo'vatasthe' ityuktvā 'sahasrāṇi sahasraśo ye rudrā adhi bhūmyām' ityāha |
vaṭoḥ svādhyāyakāle saṃnidhau kācit avahananaṃ karoti |
yathā 'suṇveva jambharī turpharītū' 'indraḥ somasya kāṇukā' 'āvṛtūdāt kṣetriyadhavāda vṛṣā' ityādiḥ |
yathā 'kiṃ te kurvanti kīṭakeṣu gāvaḥ' iti |
yadi abhidhānārthaḥ prāk prama-gandāt nāyaṃ mantro bhūtapūrvaḥ iti gamyeta |
uccāraṇamātreṇa yāgasyopakurvanto mantrāḥ avi-vakṣitārthāḥ iti navamidaṃhetubhiḥ |
prāptaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ tubhandena nirasyan āha siddhāntī |
vākyārthaḥ pratīyamānaḥ kriyāsambandharūpaḥ loke vede ca aviśiṣṭaḥ na bhinnaḥ, kintu samāna eva |
sa yathaiva loke vivakṣitaḥ tathaiva vede'pi bhavitumarhati |
anyādānamantrāṇāṃ caturṇāṃ liṅgadeva viniyoge siddhe 'tāṃ caturbhirātatte' iti punaḥśrutiḥ guṇārthena catuṣvasyarūpaguṇalābhaprayojanāya |
mantraliṅgenaiva raśanā''dāne prāptasya mantrasya vidhānaṃ gardabharaśanātaḥ |
'uru pratha uru prathasveti puroḍāśaṃ prathayati' iti mantravidhivākye pūrvapakṣiṇā punaruktā doṣo dattaḥ |
mantrāṇāṃ niyatākṣarapadakramavattvena anarthakatvaṃ iti pūrvapakṣiṇā uktam, tannirasanārthe sūtram |
paraṃ dvitīya-sūtroktaṃ mantreṣu kramaviśiṣṭākṣarapadyamānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ sārthaka-mapi niyamādṛṣṭakalpanāyā pūrvapakṣiṇā'pi svīkāryatathā aviruddhaṃ na viruddham |
buddhaśāstrāt iti sūtroktāṃ pūrvapakṣasaṅkhyāṃ siddhāntī nirākaroti |
'yeyaṃ saṃpreṣe 'amīdanīn vihara' ityatra buddhabodhanārthamarthajñānamarthāṃmarhā abhihitā, ''ḍapi anupālambhaḥ |
avidyamānavacanāt iti sūtreṇa acetanārthavacanāt iti sūtreṇa ca kṛtasya ākṣepasya nirāsārthaṃ siddhānta-sūtram |
abhidhāne'bhidhīyate anena ityabhidhānam 'catvāri śṛṅgā' iti mantraḥ |
tasmin vidyamānaḥ pada-samūhaḥ arthavādaḥ, gauṇyā dhṛtyā rūpakeṇa stutiparaḥ |
evam 'oṣadhe trāyasvainam' 'śṛṇota grāvāṇaḥ' ityatrāpi acetānāṃ caitanyamāropya cetanatvasya abhidhāne pratipādane sati vākye artha-vādaḥ |
arthavipratiṣedhāya iti sūtroktāṃ pūrvapakṣasaṅkhyāṃ siddhāntī pariharati |
'aditidyauraditirantarikṣam' ityatra avi-pratiṣedhaḥ syāt vipratiṣedhaḥ virodho nāsti |
guṇāt guṇavādāt 'tvameva mātā ca pitā tvameva' itivat stutyarthatvāt na doṣaḥ |
svādhyāyavadavacanāt iti, sūtroktāṃ pūrvapakṣasaṅkhyāṃ siddhāntī apahastayati |
vidyāyāḥ arthajñānasya avacanaṃ anabhyāsaḥ : mantrāṇāmavivakṣitārthatve liṅgaṃ na bhavati |
kiṃvā asayogāt abhyāsasyopayogo vinā'pi karmakāli-kasya arthajñānasya sukaratvāt |
vidyākāle saṃnihitasyāpi laukikāvahananarūpasya arthasya yat mantreṇa avacanaṃ anabhidhānam, tat tasya karmānarthakatvāt yuktam |
avijñeyāt iti sūtroktāṃ pūrvapakṣasaṅkhyāṃ nirākartuṃ siddhāntasūtram |
'suṇveva jambharī turpharītū' ityādī sata: vidyamānasyāpi arthasya śāstrābhyāsābhāvāt avijñānamalpavidāṃ yuktam |
anityasaṃyogāt iti sūtroktāṃ pūrvapakṣasaṅkhyāṃ siddhāntī dūṣayati |
yo'yaṃ kīṭakamamagandaiścālādibhiḥ anityaiḥ saṃyogaḥ mantrānarthakye liṅgatvena śaṅkitaḥ saḥ asāmiḥ uktaḥ |
āmīśramupatiṣṭhate' ityādi āgneyādiviśeṣopādānena mantrāṇāṃ abhidevatāprakāśakatvena liṅgena upadeśaḥ vidhiḥ tat mantrajātaṃ arthavat sārthakaṃ iti gamyati |
'teṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ arthaḥ yathā asti tathā liṅgopadeśo bhavati' |
ūhaḥ tat mantrāṇāṃ arthavat vivakṣitārthatvaṃ iti gama- yati |
'na pitā vardhate na mātā' iti dvivahupaśuke abhigrubhe mātṛ- pitṛśabdayoḥ dvivahuvacanāntatvena ūho niṣiddhaḥ |
nirarthakatve tu ūhasya prāpyabhāvena niṣedho vyartha eva syāt |
tatratatra paryāyeḥ avayavyākhyāna- nirvacanādibhiḥ arthakathanaparaṃ darśayati iti vārtikam |
'śataṃ himāḥ, śataṃ varṣāṇi jīvāsamitye- devāha' ityādayaḥ |
ke. tadarthaśāstratvalakṣaṇasya doṣasya parihārakaṃ mantrādhikaraṇaṃ guṇavidhirūpaṃ parisaṃkhyārūpaṃ arthavādarūpaṃ coktam |
bhā. 4|1|4|139-45. yadaiva 'ainyā' ityuktam, tadaiva tadarthaśāstranyāyena indrayatiriktaḥ ko'pi upasthātavyaḥ, sa ca liṅgāmyedrivirodhī ityetat pratīyate |
tacchabdena 'aupabhṛtaṃ' tatheti cet ' iti suśruvat aupabhṛtaṃ nirdiṣṭaye |
tat aupabhṛtamājyaṃ aṣṭasaṃkhyameva haviḥ syāt, na tu caturgṛhītadvayam |
juhāṃ bhavaṃ jauhavam, tasya jauhavasa aupabhasya ājyena anugrahāt anugrahakaraṇāt prajāhomeṣu sahāyakaraṇāt hetoḥ caturgṛhītatvamapi uktam |
neda- mahaṃsaṃkhyamekaṃ haviḥ, kintu ekaṃ caturgṛhītaṃ haviḥ; puna- raparamapi caturgṛhītam |
evaṃ dvayoreva caturgṛhītayoḥ hetu- sāmarthyaṃ bhavati, evaṃ hetuḥ samartho bhavati |
ātithyāyāṃ caturgṛhītājyāni bhavanti' ityuktvā 'naṣṭrān- yājān yakṣyan bhavati' iti hetumupanyasyati |
asatsvapi anuyājeṣu aṣṭagṛhītamevetibhṛt bhavet, yadā aṣṭasaṃkhyā guṇabhūtā, na tadā dvayoścaturgṛhītayoḥ sato'pi 'catu- rgṛhītānyājyāni' iti ājyeṣu bahuvacanamupapadyate |
tasyaitasya hetoḥ sāmarthye dvayoreva caturgṛhītamevati, na tu aṣṭagṛhīte ekasmin |
nanu tarhi 'aṣṭau upabhṛti' iti aṣṭatvaśravaṇaṃ katham ? ucyate |
aṣṭa- gṛhītaṃ hi grahaṇe caturgṛhītaṃ ca hote |
upabhṛti dve caturgṛhīte eva, tatra ekaṃ caturgṛhītaṃ prajāyārtham, aparamanuyājārtham |
ke. tadagame hi tad dṛśyate iti nyāyaḥ |
bhā. 4|1|5|15. ( hi yasmāt tadagame tasya ekavacanākhyasya śabdasya āgame sati tat ekatvaṃ dṛśyate 'paśumānaya' ityatra |
'paśū ānaya' ityatra tu ekavacanāgame ekatvaṃ na dṛśyate |
) 'na kevalaṃ etāveva anvayavyatirekau yau paraspara- parityāgena lakṣyate, tasminneva pade tadagame hi tad dṛśyate ityanena nyāyena viveko'vadhāryate |

vā. 2|1|12 pṛ. 381. atra sudhā - dhātuparyāge'pi pratyayaśravaṇakāle dhātuśravaṇābhāve'pi bhāvanāpratīteḥ, dhātuśravaṇakāle ca pratyayaśravaṇābhāve tadapratīteḥ ityetat 'tadagame hi0' iti nyāyena nirṇayo bhaviṣyati iti |
pṛ. 567. tadagame hi dṛśyate iti nyāyaḥ |

yathā dṛśyate hi tailādau anudabhūtarūpodbhūtasparśatve'pi'vavagāme saṃtāpo- palabhyiriti tadmame eva na tailādidhamaiḥ, tathā jāgradādau buddhau satyāṃ duḥkhaḥkhādayo dṛśyante, suṣuptyādau tanniṣṭau nopalabhyante atastaddharmā eva nādharmadharmāḥ, suṣuptāvapi upalabdhaprasaṅgāt iti |
379. ākhyātavācyaiva bhāvanā, na dhātuvācyā, prādhānyena pratīyamānasya vyāpārasya dhātvarthatvāt : 'tadagame hi dṛśyate' iti nyāyaviruddhatvāt iti mīmāṃsakāḥ |
apakarṣaḥ' iti ( tadādi vā'bhisaṃbandhāditi ) nyāya- śarīram |
tasmāt alpaādarśa bhojanapūrvabhāvīpāsana- homadevatācanavaiśvadevapakarṣasya bhojanapakarṣaviṣāyaka- vākyaviṣayatāmapi darśayati |
puruṣārthacintāmaṇau ekā- daśyām pṛ. 211-12 vāpeye tatra paryuktitā- nutsṛjati, brahmāsāmyamate |
tadā ca taduttarajñānāmutkarṣaḥ ' tadādi vā0 ' iti nyāyādeva labhyate |
jyoti- ṣṭome savanīya paśau anuyājasūkvākayaryuvākādīnā- mutkarṣaḥ |
prakṛtiprāpta dharma utkṛṣyamāṇaḥ tadādyutkarṣa karoti nāpūrvaḥ iti kecit |
‘tadukte śravaṇāt’ iti sūtrakāreṇocyamānaṃ tatraiva samarthayiṣyāmaha, yathā devatoddeśena khalvayāgamātraṃ yāgaḥ, devatoddeśyasyānastvadravyasyeṣṭau juhotiḥ |
vā. 3|4|14|1 pṛ. 981. X tadutpattestu nivṛttistatkṛtatvāt syāt |
cāturmāsyeṣu pāśukeṣu madhye parvaṇi ‘paridhau paśuṃ niyuñjīta’ iti śrūyate |
tatra paridhau yūpadharmāḥ kartavyā na veti vicāre pūrvādhikaraṇapakṣeṇa pūrvapakṣamāha |
tadutpatteḥ tasya paridheḥ āhavanīyaparidhānārthatvena utpatteḥ paridhau yūpadharmāṇāṃ nivṛttiḥ syāt pravṛttiḥ syāt |
yūpa- dharmāṇāṃ tatkṛtatvāt paśuvacanātpūrvaprayuktatvāt paridheśca atāhaśatvāt |
tasmāt paridhau yūpadharmā na syuḥ : iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
paśudhnatvarūpasya arthasya prayojanasya paridhau api sattvāt |
ālyā caivaṃ tadāveśād vikṛtau syādapūrva- tvāt |
paridhau madhye sthūle yūpadharmāḥ kartavyā ityuktam |
nanu evaṃ sati ‘upāyājyāmānāyānubrūhi’ ityatra ‘paridhaye- 'jyamānāyānubrūhi’ ityetau'pi kartavyaḥ syāt |
tadāveśāt yūpadharmāviśāt paridhau, evaṃ ākhyā ca yūpa ityevaṃ ākhyā'pi vā yūpaśabdo bhavitumarhati |
tathā ca yathāpaṭhita eva praipamantro bhaviṣyati nohitavye |
vikṛtau ca vikṛtau'pi cāturmāsyaparvaṇi prakṛtāviva paridhau yūpaśabdo bhaviṣyati |
apūrvatvāt tadāveśāt evaṃ vikṛtau ca ākhyā syāt ityanvayaḥ |
cakāro bhinnakramaḥ vikṛtau ityasmādupariṣṭāt saṃbadhyate vikṛtau api ityarthaḥ |
ke. X tadutsarge karmāṇi puruṣārthāya, śāstrasyā- natiśaṅkayatvācca dravyaṃ cikīṣyate, tenārthanā- misaṃbandhāt kriyāyāṃ puruṣārthati |
‘nehetottantamaditītya’ ityādinā prajāpatitratapurā karmāṇi ṛtvarthāni iti utsūtre pūrvapakṣe siddhāntasūtram |
neheta ityasya nañaḥ paryudāsātthaṃ gṛhītvā dhātunā anvayaḥ kartavyaḥ |
evaṃ ca neheta ityasya anīkṣaṇa- saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt ityarthaḥ |
tathā ca tadutsarge tasyāḥ prīteḥ utsarge abhāve'pi karmāṇi aniśakṣaṇasaṃkalpādīni puruṣārthāni syuḥ, na ṛtvarthāni |
śāstrasya puruṣārthatā- bodhakasya ‘tasya vratam’ ityasya anatiśaṅkayatvāt atiśaṅkayatvābhāvāt |
nanu evaṃ puruṣārthatve phalakalpanāgauravaṃ prasajyeta iti cenna |

etāvatā haitaśāḍa- yukto bhavati iti śāstrasya ‘etāvatā anīkṣaṇasaṃkalpā- dinā hetunā, enasā pāpena ayukte vimukto bhavati’ iti pāpakṣayakṣaṇaphalabodhakasya vartamānapadārthāyuktesyāpi atiśaṅkayatvābhāvāt |
nanu anīkṣaṇasya puruṣārthatve'pi ṛtvarthamapi syāditi cet tatrāha - na dravyaṃ cikī- ṣyate iti |
dravyaṃ ṛtasaṃbandhi aniśakṣaṇādibhiḥ karmabhiḥ na cikīṣyate na kartumiṣyate na saṃskriyate |
nanu neheta ityasya ākhyātāsya kartṛvācakatvābhāvena puruṣasya upa- sthitirabhāvāt kathamaniśakṣaṇasya puruṣārthatvabodha iti cet tatrāha - tenetyādi |

yataḥ puruṣārthatvaṃ sādhitaṃ ṛtvarthatvaṃ ca nirākṛtam, tena hetunā arthena anīkṣaṇena puruṣasya bhāvanā''kṣitasya abhisaṃtogāt kartṛtvena saṃbandhāt kriyāyāmanīkṣaṇasaṃkalparūpāyāṃ upakramagatā ‘tasya vratam’ iti tacchabdarūpā puruṣa śrutiḥ upapadyate |

yadi prajāpatitratāni puruṣārthāni, tarhi ‘samidho yajati’ ityādiḥ śāstrasya prajāpatitrata- śāstreṇa aviśeṣāt tadvadeva samidādau api yathāśruti ‘yat prajājanājā ijyante varma vā etat kriyate’ ityādiśrutyanusāreṇa phalāni syuḥ |
na cet, na prajāpatitratānyapi puruṣārthāni iti svīkāryam |
‘noccantāmādityamīkṣeta’ ityādinā prajāpatitratāni na ṛtvarthāni kitu puruṣārthāni iti pratipādanāyarthaṃ siddhāntasūtramidam |
kāraṇagrahaṇe prajāpatitratānāṃ ṛtvarthatve prakaraṇadārūpasya kāraṇasya pramāṇasya agrahaṇe grahaṇābhāve darśanābhāve sati tadarthe puruṣārthameva tat vratajāta syāt |
pramāṇābhāvācca prajāpatitratasya arthasya ṛtunā anamisaṃbandhāt saṃbandhābhāvāt |
lokabhūteṣu lokasiddheṣu karmasu prayojanavatsu uttèṣu tatsaṃbandhau yat phalena asaṃyuktaṃ śrūyate, tat tadaṅgaṃ vijñāyate |
‘snānaṃ kuru pākaṃ kuru’ ityukte snānaṃ pākāya iti jñāyate |
kevalam ‘snānaṃ kuru’ ityukte svatantraphalakameva snānaṃ jñāyate |
tathā ca lokabhūteṣu karmasu tathā jñānāt prajāpatitratāni puruṣārthānyeva |
(yāvā- pṛthivyāyekakapāle aṣṭākapālasya prathamapālavidhvantasya pravṛttiḥ, āśvinadvikapāle ādimakapāladayavidhvantasya pravṛttiḥ itītyayā āditaḥ pravṛttiḥ; anyasya lopaḥ ityarthaḥ |
X tadekadeśabhūtaṃ tadgrahaṇe gṛhyate iti nyāyaḥ |
tadyathā - gaṅgā yamunāṃ praviṣṭā, anekā nadyaḥ gaṅgā- yamunāgrahaṇe gṛhyante, tathā devadattāsya garbho devadattā- grahaṇe gṛhyate |
‘yasmāt pratyayavidhiḥ’ (pā0 1|4|13) iti sūtrabhāṣye ayaṃ nyāya uktaḥ |
ityātma- vādoktanyāyavārtikāt śarīrātmanoḥ svāsvāmibhāva- vyavasthānāt vyavasthā |
svetaiḥ ityatra śvetaiḥ iti mūle pāṭhaḥ |
su. pṛ. 620. X tatkālā tvāvartata, prayogato viśeṣasaṃyo- gāt’ ( 11|3|11|22 ) iti nyāyena pañcadaśa- rātre, ‘yā tāvat vasatīvarīgrahaṇottarakā subrahmaṇyā, sā pratidivasaṃ kriyate’ |
dup. 12|1|122. X tatkālā tvāvartata, prayogato viśeṣasaṃyo- gāt |
tatkālā prayogakālā sutyākālā tu subrahmaṇyā pratyahamāvartata dvādaśāha |
prayogataḥ prayogeṇa viśeṣataḥ saṃyogāt ‘atha suyāmāgaccha’ iti hi paṭhyate |
sutyākālīnā subrahmaṇyā aprayogāṅgaṃ prayogasya aṅgaṃ na bhavati |
‘atha suyāmāgaccha’ ityatra ‘atha’ iti anaṅgamam, ‘suyāmāgaccha’ iti tu tantre'pi avasthitam |
prayoga- nirdeśāt ‘atha suyāmāgaccha’ iti subrahmaṇyāmantre prayogasya nirdeśāt |
kartṛ- bhedavat, sākamedheṣu dakṣiṇe uttare ca vihāre kartumede kurvanti, evaṃ prakṛte'pi dakṣiṇa vihāre nopa- subrahmaṇyā prayogāntare nokariṣyati |
ādhānena yat bhūtaṃ siddhaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ daivataṃ indrasvarūpam, tathaiva uttareṣu sarveṣvapi ahaḥsu snānāt vidyamānatvāt |
abhivat agneḥ snānāt yathā ādhānasya āvṛttiḥ |
sakṛtkṛtena ādhānasya saṃskṛtasya agneḥ agnihotrādikarmasu vidyamānatvāt yathā nāvartyate tadvat subrahmaṇyā''pi nāvartanīyā |
iti cet pūrvapakṣī brūyāt taṃ pratibrūyāt tadapavargastadarthatvāditi |
sakṛdādhānajanya- saṃskārasaṃskṛtāyāḥ viśiṣṭāyāḥ devatāyāḥ apavargaḥ samāptirbhavati |
prathamasyāhaḥ apavargaṃ tadahaḥpaṭhitasubrahmaṇyā- janyasaṃskārasyāpi apavarge viśeṣaṇāpavargeṇa viśiṣṭāyā devatāyāḥ api apavargo bhavatyeva |
kathaṃ tadapavarga iti cet tadarthatvāt ityāha |
pṛ. 1188. tadgrahaṇād ( 3|2|3|51 ) ityadhikaraṇe vaikṛtapradhānaṃ prayogavacanaṃ codakajīvakatvatā durbalaṃ iti vakṣyate |

( sāmavedatantro'pi śyenenaḥ na udāttami- reva kartavyaḥ, yajurvedatantro'pi ca vākyeyaḥ na adhvaryu- mireva kartavyaḥ, kintu svadharmaḥ svaiḥ codakaprāptairdharmaiḥ saṃyuktaḥ syāt, tadgrahaṇāt prākṛtadharmagrahaṇāt |
tasmāt sarvairliṅgimirliṅgivā dyena vājepeyaśca kartavyaḥ iti akṣarārthaḥ ) |
ku. 3|2|3|18. tadgrahaṇād ityetat bādhidhvā pradhāna-(veda) samākhyāyata evaṃ prakṛtau vikṛtau ca kartā prāpnoti |

pṛ. 819. adhikaroti iti nyupatyā adhikārayanḍoktasya codakasya balīya- stvāt samarthatvamupapādayitum 'tadgrahaṇādvā svadharmaḥ syāt' ityanena nayena prayogavacanasya codakāpekṣatvena durbalatvamuktam |

su. 3|17 pṛ. 49. iṣṭipaśu- bandhādīnāmetasminneva prākṛte svarathye (mandra-madhyama- uttamarūpe) prāpnuvati pratyalopadeśena pradhānavedasvara- prasaktau 'tadgrahaṇād svadharmaḥ syāt' ityanena nayena prayogavacanasya codakāpekṣatvena durbalatvāt codakaprāpita- svaragrahaṇemeveṣṭam |
vā. 3|2|3 pṛ. 811. ka punaridānīṃ nānāvedasvarasyākāśo bhaviṣyati ? ucyate, 'tadgrahaṇād' itivat kalpanīyaḥ |
yat prākṛta- svarāyuktāyāṃ vikṛtau vedāntarīyama apūrvamaṅgaṃ codyate iti |
mantragato bhāvaśabdo vidhāyako na veti vicā- ritam |
kiñca 'adye budhiya mantraṃ me gopāya yamṛṣayyavidā viduḥ |
ṛcaḥ sāmāni yajūṃṣi sā hi śrīmatā satām !!' ityatra mantra uktaḥ |
taccodakeṣu tasya abhidhānasya anuṣṭheyārthaprakāśakasya codakeṣu prayojakeṣu vākyeṣu mantrākhyā mantra iti ākhyā jñāyatvā |
tathā ca anuṣṭheyārthasārakavedavākyatvaṃ mantratvamiti mantra- lakṣaṇam |
mantratvena śiṣṭairuktā mantrāḥ iti tu sāmānya- lakṣaṇam |
kāryapravṛttivelāyāṃ tattannimittasya asaṃhitāne'pi tattadvacanasāmarthyāt bhūtapūrvamapi tādṛśadharmamādāya tatkartavyaṃ nīyam |
tattadvacanasāmarthyasyasiddhaye brāhmaṇe'pi tasya bhāvāt, mantreṣu ca keṣucidabhāvāt |
tena sarvaiṣāmeva tadvyabhicārāt anekārthatvameva mantra- śabdasyeti |
bhavedevaṃ yadi atra vṛddhopadeśo na syāt |
tathāhi, yeṣu vākyeṣu vṛddhāḥ prayuñjate 'mantrāndhīyandhe' ya 'mantrāndhyāpayam' : 'mantrā vartante' iti |
tena mantrasaṃhitāpāṭhādīnāṃ vyabhicāre'pi adhyāpakavṛddhā yatra mantraśabdaṃ prayuñjate, te mantrā iti bhavati vyavasthā |
te mantrā nāmidhānaṃ hi mantrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sthitam !!' iti |
('padaṃ sthitam' ityatra 'padaṃ smṛtam' iti mūle pāṭhaḥ) |
taduktaṃ bhāṣye- 'ākṣepe cāpavāde ca prāpyāṃ lakṣaṇakarma |
prayojanaṃ na vaktavyaṃ yacca kṛtvā pravartate' iti |
sūtraṃ tu— tadanuṣṭhīyamānakamābhidhānaṃ prayojanaṃ yeṣāṃ vākyānāṃ tāni tathoktāni |
( śekhara. pṛ. 274 ) tattvena aparijñāto'rthaḥ anuṣṭhīyamānaḥ vihanti anuṣṭhātāram |

'svarā vā eṣā yajñasya, tasmāt yatkiñcit prācīna- madhīpomīyāt tenopāṃśu caranti' ityudāhṛtya, yajña- bhāgadharmā vā etadupāṃśutvam, padārthadharmo vā iti sandigdhe, yajña phalavatvena dharmapṛṣṭhasaptamārtha |

'yajñasya yat prācīnam' iti vyavahitenāpi yajñaśabdena prācīna- śabdasya anvayapratīteḥ śrutvā ca prāgdeśavācinaḥ prācīnaśabdasya lakṣaṇayā taddeśapadārthaparatvāt yajña- bhāgadharmātvam ( iti ) pūrvapakṣayitvā, prācīnaśabdasya vīpsā kiñcicchicchandasamimivyāhatyacchandaanvayāt vīpsāyāśca bahuviṣayatvena ekasmin deśe anupapatteḥ lakṣaṇayā amīṣomīyaprāgdeśapadārthaparatvasya nyāyatvāt padārthadharmatā iti siddhāntayitum 'tadeśānām' iti sūtre aṅgapradhānasaṃghātasya yajñaśabdavācyatvābhāvāt sāṅgapradhāna- saṃghātasyaivātra prāgdeśāvayavaḥ aṅgājñātasya yajñayavatvatvā- yogena prācīnayajñaśabdanvaye'pi avaya
pṛ. 150. tatpuruṣasya svapadārthe prādhānyāt anyapadārthapradhānacaturthīpekṣā balīyastvam |

su. pṛ. 1141. 'tatpuruṣe tulyārthatṛtīyāsaptamyupa- mānādyai' (pā. 6|2|2 tulyārtha: śabdā:, tṛtīyā, saptamī, upamānam, anyayam, dvitīyā, kṛtyapratyayāśca sapta ete pūrvapadabhūtā: tatpuruṣe prakṛtyā ) |
bhāṭṭa. 3|1|8. niṣādasthapatyadhikaraṇe lakṣaṇā''patyā tatpuruṣāpekṣayā karmadhārayasya prābalya- muktam |
maṇi. pṛ. 149. tatpuruṣalakṣaṇam , tatpuruṣārthavicāraśca 'samāsavāda:' iti bindau maṇigranthe draṣṭavyam |
'agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāma:' 'āghārāmāghāra- yati' iti ca samānamanti |
tatra saṃśaya: kimagnihotra- śabda: ādhāraśabdaśca guṇavidhi:, uta karmanāmadheyamiti |
udbhidadhikaraṇe yaugikaśabdānāṃ ( rūḍhānāṃ ) citrā''- dhikaraṇe ca saṃvijñāyikaśabdānāṃ nāmadheyatvaṃ nirūpya idānīṃ yaugikaśabdeṣveva keṣucit viśeṣeṇa guṇavidhimāśaṅkya nāmadheyatvaṃ nyupyate |
adhikāravākyasya phalasaṃbandharūpasya pūrvapade'pi utpatti- vākyavaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt mādhyekaraṇe vicāraviṣābhipreto'pada- saṃbandhitāmātreṇodāhṛtam |
agnihotrapadasya tu siddhānte'pi agnaye hotraṃ asmin iti matvarthīyasamānārthabahuvrīhi samāsavyutpatte: matvartha- lakṣaṇādoṣābhāvāt caturthībhakterdevatāvidhitvameva |

sati ca guṇavidhitve 'yadyame ca prajāpataye ca sāyaṃ juhoti' iti 'yat sūryāya ca prajāpataye ca prātarjuhoti' iti prakaraṇaprātayorhomayormeyasya sāyahome agne: prāptatvāt prāta- home eva agnidevatāvidhānamidam |
na ca prātarhomavākya- meva guṇavidhāyakam, agnihotravākyaṃ cotpattiparaṃ iti vaktavyam |
yato'tra anekaguṇānāmupādānaṃ pratīyate, teṣāṃ ca prāpte karmaṇi vidhātumaśakyatvāt atraiva viśiṣṭavidhinā karmotpatti:, agnihotravākye eva ca guṇavidhānamiti |

'yat sūryāya ca prajāpataye ca' iti caṃkāradvayamatra śrūyate anyatara- samuccayasya ekenaiva caṃkāreṇa siddhatvāt agatyā sāyahoma- vākye cakāradvayasya itaretarasamuccayaparatvam, iha puna: agnidevatopanāyakasya vākyasya saṃbhavāt tatsamuccayārtha- tvameva dvitīyacakāraśravaṇasya, iti nānupapannaṃ devatāntara- vidhānam |
tathā 'āghārāmāghārayati' ityatra āghāryate ityanayā vyutpattyā kṣaraṇayogadravyamājyaprabhṛti 'āghāra:' iti pratīyate |

tacca 'āghāram' iti dvitīyāśrutyā āghāraṇa- kriyāsatkāryatvenavāgamyamānaṃ bhakṣaṇayuktaphalamasavat amiṣavabhuktikatvavacca prayojanamapekṣate, prakaraṇe cāśruta- dravyamupāṃguyājatvaṃ karma sākāṅkṣam |
ata: śrutārthā- patti kalpitaviniyogavidhivinā tatraiva vidhīyate iti |
na ca upāṃśuyāja- syāpi 'sarvasmai vā etadyajñāya gṛhyate yadghavājyamājyam' ityanenaiva ājyasya prāpte: nirākāṅkṣatvāt anarthakamāghāra- vākyena dravyavidhānamiti vācyam |
yata: 'sarvasmai vā etadyajñāya gṛhyate' ityasya vākyasya dravyarahitā''pradhāna- viṣayatvena sāvakāśatvāt, asya ca prakaraṇe adravyaka- pradhānamātraviṣayatvāt anenaiva upāṃśuyājadravyavidhānamiti |

na ca vācyam, dvitīyāśruti: sakṛnmātrādekakapālādiṣu saṃskārārthaṃ vyabhicarati, ata: kathaṃ tadalena ājyasya:- prabhṛtīnāṃ saṃskārārthatvam, kathaṃ ca tatpapastathyaṃ kāryāntaro- payogimiti, yata: tatraivatat dravyaṃ niranvayavināśāt kāryāntaropayogi na saṃbhavati |
atra puna: āghāraṇasya dravyaikadeśākaraṇarūpatvāt kṣaritaikadeśasya dravyasya kāryā- ntaropayogo nānupapanna: |
iṣṭaṃ caitat laukike'pi pānādau upayogyamāṇasya dravyadravyasya īpsārakṣaṇasaṃskāra: ; ityupāṃśu- yāje eva guṇavidhānam |
adhikārārthatvaṃ pravṛttiviśeṣakatvaṃ cānuṣaṅgaṃ bhavati iti guṇavidhānameveti |

bhavedevaṃ yadi agnihotrapadaṃ agnaye hotramasmin iti nyupyatyā caturthīsamāsena pariṇamyeta, kintu agnerhotram, agnī hotram, iti ṣaṣṭhīsaptamīsamāsayo: saṃbhāvitatvāt saṃdigdhāgnihotrapadaṃ na vidheyībhūtāgnidevatāsamarpakaṃ bhavati |
saṃbhavati tu kutaścidvākyāt prāptamagnidevatābhūtaṃ pravṛttinimittīkṛtya homavidhī nāmadheyamiti, iti tadarthe vākyāntaramapekṣate |
asi ca mantravākyaṃ vākya- viniyuktam 'agnirjyotirjyotiragni: svāheti sāyaṃ juhoti' ityagnidevatāsamarpakam |
atastallakṣaṇamevāgni nimittīkṛtya agnihotrapadaṃ nāmadheyamiti tadavacchinnaṃ eva homo vidhīyate, na tvanyatra guṇe vidhīyate |
nanu pūrvapakṣī prātarhome guṇavidhiṃ manyate davihome vā |

na brūmo yatra pūrvapakṣyabhimatau guṇavidhi:, tatrāsau anyena prāpta iti, kintu yasya guṇasya upādānasāmarthyāt dhātvarthā- duccāryate vidhi:, asau śrautātparyārthādeva śāstrāttara- prāpto'gni: nāmapravṛttinimittatvenānavadyaṃ śakyate, kiṃ śrutiparityāgeneti |
na cedanyena śiṣṭā: syustatprayatthaṃ ceti cottaram |
ata: 'agni- hotraṃ juhoti' ityetadvākyaṃ nāmavācyakarmopapādakameva, na tu prātarhome, na ca davidravyahome, nāpi viśiṣṭa- vidhinā devatāvidhāyakam |
na ca 'yadyame ca' iti vākyadvayameva homavidhāyakamiti vācyam |

tatrāpi prāpte karmaṇi anekaguṇavidhānā- saṃbhavāt agnisūryeṇaiva mantravākyaprāptatvāt sāyaṃ prāta: - kālayośca 'sāyaṃ juhoti' 'prātarjuhoti' iti vākyadvaya- lyatvāt prajāpatayeva eko devatātvena vākyadvaye vidhīyate, anyat sarvamanudyate iti |
tathā 'āghārāmāghārayati' ityatrāpi āghāryate iti nyupatyā āghāraṇayogyaṃ anirūpitaviśeṣaṃ payaādi dravyadravyameva pratīyate |

dravyaviśeṣārthatve ca prakaraṇanirīkṣaṇe 'upastṛṇan abhighārayan ājyasyaiva yajan' iti vākya- balena 'sarvasmai vā etadyajñāya gṛhyate yad dhruvāmājyam' ityanena vā viśeṣaprāptau tāmyāmeva asaṃdigdhābhyāṃ sāvakāśatve'pi upāṃśuyāje dravyaviśeṣaprāpte: etadvidhānaṃ vyarthameva saṃdigdhāgnihotradevatādhārapadasya nāghāradravya- viśiṣṭamāghāraṇaṃ vidhīyate iti saṃbhavati |
tathā 'caturgṛhītaṃ vā etadbhūtaṃ tasyāghāramāghārya' ityanenaiva ājyadravyaprāpte: tadvidhānavaiyarthyaṃ ca |
saṃbhavati ca āghāramāghāra: iti bhāvavyutpattyā karmanāmadheyam |
tacca karma 'indra ucchvo'dhvara ityaghāramā- ghārayati' iti mantraviniyogasāmarthyāt labdhendradevatā- saṃbandham |
tathā caturgṛhītavākyāvagatadravyasaṃbaddhaṃ sat samarūpameva āghāranāmādheyaṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhimiti avadhāryate |
prayojanam-- pūrvapakṣe prātarhomasya davihomasya vā agnidevatvam |
sūtraṃ tu-- tattvalyaṃ tadprāpakaṃ agnihotrapadena āghārapadena ca yadvidhāyatvaṃ tadvidhāyakamiti yāvat |
'agnihotraṃ juhoti' , 'āghārāmāghārayati' iti agnihotraśabda: āghāraśabdaśca guṇavidhi:, uta karmanāmadheyamiti vicāre siddhāntamāha |
yo guṇaḥ abhirūpaḥ ājyarūpo vā, taṃ guṇaṃ prabandhe vidhatte |
ca prajāpataye ca sāyaṃ juhoti' iti devatāvidhānam, |
tathā ādhāyate iti ādhāraḥ iti kṣārasamartha |
sā ca kriyātvāt karaṇamantareṇānupapannā, iti kṛti- |
samavāyāt sādhyābhidhāyinī dvitīyā sādhanameveva sādhyalakṣaṇakāryasya svasiddhyarthaṃ svadhāvārthapravṛttakṛti- |
soma - iha guṇavidhitve'pi na vākyabhedaḥ ityu- bandhitvena karaṇatayā'pi saṃbadhyate |
sūtrārthastu- tasya vidhisita- vyāpyatvaṃ hi karaṇatvam |
guṇasya prakhyaṃ grāhakaṃ anyat śāstraṃ yatra, tadapi deśapravṛttakṛtivyāpyasya karaṇatvamiti |
viṣayatayā karaṇatayā ca anvīyate ” iti vadanti |
vidheyau tanmataṃ nirasyati-) etena (dhātvarthasya karaṇatayā sādhya- |
, agnaye hotrameteti tayā cānvayanirāsanena ) ye dhātvarthasya viṣayatayā karaṇa- |
guṇo vidheyo nāmatve rūpaṃ na syāt tvena cānvayaṃ manyante, te nirākṛtāḥ |
caturgṛhītavākyoktaṃ sādhyatvamapi tārthākamasti, iti guṇavidhirapi vineva |
nāsādhite hi dhātvarthe karaṇatvaṃ dhātvarthalakṣaṇatayā, vinā ca vairūpyeṇa syāt, iti samasta- |
sādhyatāṃ vakti saṃskāro naivāśaṅkyaḥ meva nāmadheyapratipādanamanupapannaṃ syāt (yadyapi tanmate |
bhāṭṭa - iha rūḍhānāṃ yaugikānāṃ vā saṃbhavaprāptikānām tathāpi karaṇatvaṃ vinā anupapadyamāno vidhiraiva sādhyatvaṃ |
'agnihotraṃ juhoti' 'āghāramāghārayati' 'samidho yajati' vinā karaṇatvānupapatteḥ sādhyatvamapi ākṣipyate, iti sādhya- |
ityādī agnihotrādipadānāṃ guṇavidhitvam, karmanāmadheyaṃ svamapi aupādānikaṃ syāt, iti sādhyamiti bhāvaḥ |
na ca atha viṣayatvena karaṇatvapara eva śabdaḥ tataḥ anya- |
agnihotrapade 'agnaye pareṇa śāstreṇa upāyamātratvenopāttaṃ viṣayatvaṃ na śāstrārthaḥ |
hotramasmin' iti nyutpatyā upasarjane'rtheḥ agnidevatā syāt, atatparatvāt |
vidhīyate ! na ca 'yadagnaye ca prajāpataye ca sāyaṃ juhoti' śāstrārthatve'nupādānāt virodhaprasaṅgāt ) ! atha śabda eva |
ityanena tasyāḥ prāstatvādidhānam, tatrānekaguṇopādānena prathamaṃ viṣayatayā abhidhāya punaḥ karaṇatayā'pi abhidhatte, |
viśiṣṭakarmāntaravidherāvaśyakatvāt etadvākyavihitakarmaṇi kathaṃ sakṛduccarito dvirabhidadhyāt, abhidhāne vā sādhyatva- |
ato yatra dadhauhomādau āgneyo mantraḥ mapi punarabhidhatte, nahi niyāmakamāsti 'dvirevābhidhatte, |
na ca tena tatprāptisaṃbhavaḥ, māntravarṇikavidheḥ akalpanīya- iti nyāyāt |
āghārapade'pi dvitīyāntā- ataḥ karaṇatvenānvayo vācyaḥ, na viṣayatvena ityuktā |
kṣaraṇāravyaḥ saṃskāraḥ ; taduddeśena vidhīyate, aviniyuktasya kathaṃ dvitīyāśrutinirdeśaḥ ( 'āghāramāghārayati' |
prakaraṇakalpitavākyena upāśyāgā''ghāra- 'agnihotraṃ juhoti' ityatra ) iti vaktavyam |
'caturgṛhīta vā etadabhūta, tasyāghāra- asti tāvadārthikaṃ dhātvarthasya sādhyatvam, asādhitasya |
iti prāpte, mantravarṇakalpavidhineva prātisaṃbhave asya pūrvavṛttavidhi-
upattaśiṣṭaguṇāvarodhasahakṛtena vidhyāpādakadhātvarthavidheau anyāvyayatvaṃ na tāvat davī- |
prakṛtinimittasaṃpādanadvārā vā avagantavyā, na tu śuddhena 'agnidyotiṣyotirimiḥ svāhā' iti vacanena vini- |
devaśandasya klṛptatāmapi devatāviśeṣalakṣi pratipatya viśva- sāyaṃ juhoti, yat sūryāya ca prajāpataye ca prātaḥ' ityatra |
māpādya devaśandasya ca devatāparatvamaṅgīkṛtya prakṛtāgnyādi- nam |
sarvadevatākatvasya akṣarapi yāgeṣu pravṛttinimittatva- rdevatātvam, tathā 'agnidyotiṣyotirimiḥ sūryaḥ svāheti |
maṅgīkriyate' iti pakṣe ) nādavayaṃ tatpratyanyāyasya sāyaṃ juhoti, sūryo jyotiṣyotirimiḥ svāheti prātaḥ' |
pṛ. 251, na ca saṃjñāyā api prakṛte (samit svam) |
'pi tavyanyāyasya (tavyanyāyasya) guṇavidhitrāprati- nipātopasargādyatvena nyupapannatvāt na vidheyatekatā |
śā. 1|4|4. upāṃśuyāje 'sarvasmai vā etad yajñāya gṛhyate, yad |
tavyanyāyasvarūpaṃ 'vighisitaguṇaprāpti śāstramanyad dhruvāmājāmyam' ityanenaiva dravyadravyasya prāstatvāt prayājo- |
tasmāt tatprāptaṃ yatheti nāmatvamiṣyate' deśena saṃskāravidhāne dvitīyavidhivikārāpatteḥ lāghavāt |
(atha ye padārthāḥ tavyanyāyena sādhyante, te homa eva |
na tu iti māntravarṇikenadevatāyāḥ; 'caturgṛhīta vai' ityanena |
'athāto'gnimiśrihomenānuyanti' atra agni- dvitīyā karaṇatvalakṣaṇā arthā iti na virodhaḥ |
pṛ. 65, agniṣṭutpadam 'āgneyīṣu stuvate' tavyanyāyasya karmāntarasiddhayyuttarakālaḥ saṃbhava- |
iti vacanāt agnidevatamantrasādhyastotrāṅgatvān śrapi tataḥ pūrvamanupasthitaṃ nāmadheyabodhakaḥ |
'agnihotraṃ juhoti' ityasyotpattividhitvam sahakārisahakṛta śuddha vā guṇavidhisaṃbhavasaṃpādakatva- |
sāhasī. 823. caturdhī- tatyupacaturthīgarbhabahuvrīhyorasaṃbhavāt (agnihotraśabde) naiyamike nāmadheyatvapakṣe tatsaṃbhavaḥ tatravyadhikaraṇe prapañcitaḥ |
soma. 7131. āgneyo'ṣṭākapālaḥ ? ityatra mantravarṇikadevatāprāpterasaṃbhavāt nedam (āgneya- padam ) tatravyanyāyena nāmadheyam |
kau. 1|4|7|9 pṛ. 230. āgneyādīnāṃ aṣṭānāṃ yāgānāṃ nāmadheyaṃ vaiśvadevaśandaḥ (cāturmāsyeṣu prathame parvaṇi ) utpattiśiṣṭadevatā'varodhasaṅkaṭāttatravyanyāyāt |

caturavatta- vākyāt homaniṣpattāvapi āgneyādiśabdānāṃ kathaṃ tannā- matā ityāśaṅkya, kramaviniyuktamantravaśāt devatāprāpteḥ tatravyanyāyenaiva (teṣāṃ tannāmatā) |
su. pṛ. 448. anu āvārakarmaṇo dravyadevatā yatrarūpatayāḥ tatravyadhikaraṇe abhihitatvāt |
pṛ. 761. tatravya- dhikaraṇe ādhāraśabdaḥ kṣāraśiraskatvātgamyate vartate ityavocāma |
ku. 2|3|12|20. saṃjñatvaṃ ca grahaṇasya (adābhādigrahaṇasya ) grāhyasaṃskāratvaprasiddheḥ jyotiṣṭomājñattātvena tadīyasomasaṃskārārthatvapratīteḥ śakyārthasya tatravyanyāyena prāptatvāt |
kau. 2|1|12|20 pṛ. 63. nanu dakṣiṇayanottarakāle etadahoma- (dākṣiṇahoma-) vidhānāt krameṇaiva dakṣiṇākālava- prāpteḥ tatravyanyāyena dakṣiṇāśabdasya nāmatvāt guṇavidhivaṃ nāsti ityāśaṅkyate |
su. pṛ. 701. nanu agnihotrādināmavat dadhipadasyāpi vaika- lpikatvādrāpteḥ (darendriyakāmasya ityatra ) tatravya- nyāyena nāmadheyopapatteḥ vidhānāttvārthatvāyogyāt |
vratarājaḥ. paurṇamāsī-amāvāsyā- śabdaḥ 'paurṇamāsyā paurṇamāsyā yajeta' 'amāvāsyāyā- mamāvāsyā yajeta' iti vākyadvayaprāptapaurṇamāsya- māvāsyākālayogena tatravyanyāyena nāmadheyam |

1|4|15 pṛ. 218. na samidādidevatānāṃ yājyā- mantravarṇairaiva saṃbhavaprāptikatvāt agnihotraṃ juhotītivat tatravyanyāyaviṣayatvopapattiḥ 'vasantaṛtūnāṃ prīṇāmi' ityādyanumantraṇamantraiḥ vasantādidevatānāṃ prāptisaṃbhavena samidādīnāṃ nityāprāptyabhāvāt |
