atrāpi 'yat triṣu yūpeṣu ālameta vahirvā asmāt indriyaṃ vīryaṃ dadhyāt, bhrātṛvyamasya janayet, ekayūpe ālameta' iti yūpatrivaṃ pratiṣidhya ekaṃ yūpaṃ sautrāmaṇyāṃ vidadhāti |
anyatra tu paśugaṇeṣu pratipaśu yūpo bhidyate |
tathā ca paśugaṇeṣu ekādaśineṣu ca pratipaśu yūpabhedaḥ samānaṃ liṅgam |
evaṃ ca pratipaśu ye yūpāḥ te pratipaśu- yūpapadadarśanāt liṅgāt gaṇeṣu paśugaṇeṣu tatravṛttiḥ syāt aikādaśinapaśuvidhinatasya pravṛttiḥ syāt |
evaṃ ca paśu- gaṇānāṃ ekādaśināḥ paśavaḥ prakṛtiḥ |
ke. tatravṛttyā tu tantrasya niyamaḥ syāt, yathā pāśukaṃ sūktavākena |

yathā pāśukaṃ sūktavākena sūktavākasya prepeṇa vaiśvadhikena 'ayaṃ sutāsutī yajamānaḥ' ityanena niyataṃ tadat |

āgneye vaiśvadevikasya tantrasya cāvāputhinyena tantrena na niyamaḥ syāt |

āgṇaye cāvāputhinyasya ekakapāle sapuṣpaṃ vahiḥ na śāstralakṣaṇaṃ kiñcu codakaprāptam |

3|2|1|34 brasa. sthānivadbhāvenaiva tanmadhyapatita- napuṃsake vyāghrapadāṃ variṣṭhaḥ !!' ityādyanvākhyānavidhānam, |

stadgrahaṇena gṛhyate iti nyāyāt dhātugrahaṇe nakārākāraḥ
nirvapet abhicaran, sārasvatyājyabhāgā syāt, bārhaspatya- atyantagrahaṇe siddhe tadvaiyarthyāpattiḥ |
vikārasya dharmaḥ pūrvaṃ kartavyaḥ, uta upāṃśuyājavikārasya garbhiṇīstho garbho garbhiṇīgrahaṇena gṛhyate, gaṅgāstho ghaṭo |
adhvarakalpayāṃ dharmānnuṣṭhānaṃ yathāpradhānaṃ pradhānakramamanusṛtya bhāṣyagranthena patitapadārthatvena ca uktanyāyena tattvato- |
pratyakṣaḥ carasattvākaḥ tanmadhyapatita eva tadgrahaṇena gṛhyate, |
ādau sārasvatasya paścāt bārhaspatyasyeti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
mukhyakramasya aṅgakramasya ca virodhe sati yathāprakṛti tārthyāt |
codakaḥ prayogavacanād balavattara iti oṃ tadyuktaṃ ca kālabhedāt |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ upāṃśuyāje tadgraha indryavat codakena prāpyate |
'tāvanmātramīṣomo' jāgaraṇena ca jāgaraṇaṃ na dārśike prasajyate |
iti vākyaṃ tu purākalpasūpo'rthavādaḥ : na vidhisarūpaḥ |
yadi tāvat yajñajñānāṃ rakṣaṇāya apramādāyai tato dīkṣā- |

agniṣṭome prātaḥsavane aindravāyavamaitrāvaruṇadayaḥ daśa somagrahā āmnātāḥ; mādhyaṃdine savane śukrāmanthinau āgrayaṇaḥ ityādayaḥ ekādaśa grahāḥ; tṛtīyasavane ca ādityaḥ āgrayaṇaḥ ityādayaḥ pañcadaśaḥ grahāḥ |
grahadharmā khalu sādanaṃ daśāpavitreṇa saṃmārjanamityādayaḥ prātaḥsavane eva āmnātāḥ |
tatra mādhyaṃdinīyeṣu tātīryavanīyeṣu graheṣu grahadharmā bhavanti na vā iti saṃdehe, bhavanti iti siddhāntapratipādanāya sūtramidam |
savanāntare prātaḥsavanāt anyat yat mādhyaṃdinaṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca savanam, tatrāpi yat grahāṇāmānamānam, tat tadvat prātaḥsavanāgrahamamānavat ahadharmaviśiṣṭameva jñeyam |
athavā prathamānirdeśena dravyamapi prastutya paścāt tatsādhyopanyāsaḥ saṃbhavati, iti ete'pi udāha- raṇameva |
yatvayopādānena karmaṇi pravṛttau ca atyantaviprakṛṣṭā gauṇatā syāt |
sādhanaṃ hi pratītau atyantavinā- bhāvāt svasādhayāṃ kriyāṃ akṣaleśena pratipādayati vinaiva matublopena |
' guṇavidhau hi svārthapari- tyāgena śyenapadaṃ tadantaḥkṛtalakṣaṇaṃ lakṣyati |
bhavatastu śyenārthā- nupayogāt ādita eva sādṛśyavivakṣayā padaṃ pravṛtta- mityupamāt śrutibādhaprasaṅgaḥ |
' śyenādivākyeṣu hi 'yathā vai śyeno nipatya ādatte, evamayamapi' ityu- pamāt na stutirlabhyate |
guṇavidhāne ca śyenadravyaṃ vidhīyate, iti tadeva stotavyam |
na ca tasya ātmanaiva upamānaṃ yuktam |
bhavati hi loke kālpanika avasthā''digatabhedābhidhāya evamapi stutiḥ saṃbhavati, bhede na yuktā |
( śrutirhi nāmadheyatve, lakṣaṇā guṇavidhau iti bhāṣyaṃ yathā'rthamanupapattimeti matvā anyathā vyācaṣṭe-) nāmadheyatve tu yāgasyenasya dravya- śyenopamayopapatteḥ āñjasyam |
itarathā hi dvau matyartha- vatyarthau lakṣayitavyau, kālpanika bhedaḥ iti gauravam |
na ca yāgastutyā tadāśritadravyastavanamavakalpate, yāga- vidheḥ anirākṛtatvāt |
abhidheyagatā hi stutiḥ anyatra saṃcāyeta, yāgastu svayameva vidhibhāk atra iti na dravyaṃ stūyate vidhīyate vā |
punarapi ca yāgena dravyalakṣaṇān viprakṛṣṭā, samabhivyāhārāt dravyadeva yāgavacanatvaṃ mukhyam |
guṇavacane- śyenaśca matublopaḥ saṃbhavet (tadasyāstyasmin iti pāṇi- sūtre 'guṇavacanebhyo matupo luk' iti vārtikam ) na dravyavacanebhyaḥ |
matyarthalakṣaṇā ca svayaṃ kalpanīyā, klṛptastu yadarthaḥ 'yathā vai śyenaḥ' ityādinā |
śā- iha rūḍhaśabdā eva vākyabhedarahitāḥ tadyāpa- deśavantaḥ udāharaṇam |
sūtre ca tacchabdena 'yasmin guṇe- padeśaḥ' iti prakṛto guṇe nirdiṣṭaye |
tataśca tasmāt vidheyatvamimatāt guṇāt vyapadeśaḥ medena nirdeśaḥ ) |
5. soma- sūtrārthastu- tasya guṇasya vyapadeśo yasmin śyenādipade, tadapi nāmadheyaṃ syāt iti |
vidhīyate pakṣirūpo nāma vā tasya karmaṇaḥ ||
, yathā vai śyena ityuktā hyupa- mānopeyatā |
naikasmin tena gauṇā''sya vṛttyā syāt karmaṇamatā ||
5. bhāṭṭa- 'śyenābhicaran yajeta' ityādī pūrvokta- bādhakābhāvāt prasiddheḥ śyenādipadānāṃ guṇavidhitvameva |
prakṛtasomayāgāśrito guṇaḥ phaloddeśena vidhīyate viśiṣṭa- karmāntaraṃ vā |
na caivam 'yathā vai śyeno nipatādase, evamayaṃ dviṣantaṃ ātyarthaṃ nipatādase' ityarthavāde svasyaiva sopamānatvānupapattiḥ, upakramanirṇītavidhinurodhena upa- saṃhārārthavādasya anyathā nevatvāt |
'te tadvilāsā iva tadvilāsāḥ' ityādivat ananyalakṣyārasya abhede anuguṇatvāt |
tadadaṃ bhūyo'nyathaiva nyāyyatvāt upakramasya evaikasmin pade rūpakavidhayā lutopamānavidhayā vā gauṇī vṛttimaṅgīkṛtya nāmadheyatvaṃ dvitīyavidhivārāpādakaṃ yukta- māśrayitum |
arthavādastu rūpakāpekṣitāsahayopāda- nārthaḥ san vinaiva lakṣaṇāṃ pūrṇopamānavidhayā vidheyayāga-
5. tadvyapadeśaḥ ca ityadhikaraṇe 'yathā vai śyeno nipatādase evamayaṃ dviṣantaṃ ātyarthaṃ nipatādase yamabhi- carati śyenena' ityayamupamānārthavādaḥ ityuktam |
bāla. pṛ. 58. arthavādānāṃ avayavārthaparatvābhāve 'tad- vyapadeśaṃ ca' ityadhikaraṇavirodhaḥ |
tatra vākyaviśeṣa- siddhāṃ gauṇīṃ vṛttimāśritya nāmadheyatvavyavasthāpanāt |
ku. 1|2|188. 'āgneyo'ṣṭākapālo'māvāsyāyāṃ' ityādī viśiṣṭavidhvīkaraṇe vākyabhedābhāvāt tadvyapadeśa- nyāyasya śaṅkitumapyāvaśyakatvāt |
bhāṭṭa. 4|1|10. tacchabdārthaṃ svavākyopasthitaṃ yacchabda eva niyamena apekṣate 'yena karmaṇā īrset tatra jayān juhuyāt' ityādau tathaiva nyutpattirarthāt |
ityatra upadadhateau saṃbhavanadavadasya karmaṇaḥ vidheyatva- niṣedhāt (somena yajeta iti) somavākye yāgavidhiḥ |
su. pṛ. 790. bhāṣyāntarakṛdbhiḥ prakaraṇāntaratvāt vinā phalādīnāṃ bhedakatvamuktamapi na dṛṣṭaṃ 'tatsanidhe saṃnidhau tvavibhāgāt, tatsanidherguṇāṃrthena punaḥ śrutiḥ' ityādi |
vā. 2|3|13|16. tatsaṃtrayoge puruṣendriyāṇāṃ buddhijanama sat pratyakṣam' ( 1|1|4 sūtre ) |
yadiyaṃ vijñānamucyate tenaiva indriyasaṃprayoge indriyāṇāṃ yā puruṣasya buddhirjanyate tat sat pratyakṣam |
yattu anyasaṃprayoge śuktikāsaṃprayoge anyaviṣayaṃ rajata- grāhi vijñānamucyate na tat pratyakṣam |
kathaṃ punaragamyate 'idamanyasaṃprayoge, idaṃ nānya- saṃprayoge' iti |
ataḥ śuktikā- viṣayameva idamapi jñānam, yato rajata miti śuktikāmeva vyapadiśati |
yasmāt śuktikāsaṃprayukte cakṣuṣi 'rajata- saṃnikṛṣṭaṃ me cakṣuḥ' iti manyate |
( tatprayoge - satsaṃ- prayoge iti, sat pratyakṣaṃ-tat pratyakṣaṃ iti matabhedena pāṭhabhedaḥ) |

ṛju. pṛ. 46. tatsaṃyogāt ṛtusdāsyaḥ ( 2|3|10|23 ) iti nyāyena sānnidhyakṛtoreva cinotyarthatvāt (tena cayanasaṃskṛtena jvalanena saṃyogān ṛtuḥ yāgaḥ tadākhyaḥ abhiśabdavācyaḥ iti nyāyasūtrākṣarāthaḥ) |
su. pṛ. 1544. tatsāmānyāditereṣu tathātvaṃ iti nyāyaḥ |
kuntāna praveśaya, yaṣṭīḥ praveśaya ityādiṣu spaṣṭo'yaṃ nyāyaḥ|
yajamānavat kāryasiddhau abhyahitaḥ prastaraḥ (tatsiddhiḥ iti sūtrameva sūtraikadeśo vā)|
tatsiddhiḥ mukhyasya siddhiḥ kāryam, tatkāryakaratvamiti yāvat|
soma. tatsiddhiḥ tasmā- dhanarthaṃ śabdasya kvacit pravṛttehetuḥ|
'yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ' atra yāgasādhanatvaṃ yajamānasya guṇaḥ, sa ca prastare vartate iti prastare yajamānapadasya pravṛttiḥ|
tatra vyākhyāyakāryye pratyekaṃ prathamāntasūtropanyāso bhāṣye kṛtaḥ|
sa kiṃ guṇavidhiḥ, utārthavādaḥ? iti vicāre siddhāntaḥ|
tatsiddhiḥ tasya yajamānaguṇasya yāgasādhanatvasya prastareṇa siddhiḥ|
iti yāgasādhanatvena guṇena yajamānaśabdaḥ prastare samānādhikaraṇatayā pravṛttaḥ|
bhāṣyam- 'yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ,' 'yajamāna eka- kapālaḥ' ityādi samāmnāyate|
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ yajamānaḥ prastara ityeṣa guṇavidhiḥ, kimarthavāda syāt|
tathā yaja- māna ekakapāla iti tāvat prāptam? guṇavidhi- riti|
yadi vidhiḥ syāt prastarakāryaṃ yajamāno niyamyeta, yajamānakāryaṃ vā
'prastare juhumāsādayati, sarvā vā sucaḥ' iti yajamāne juhusādāyeta sarvā vā suca iti|
tathā sati na yājamānaṃ śakyate kartum, dakṣiṇato brahmayajamānī āsāte karmaṇaḥ kriyamāṇasya, iti|
na ca prastaro yājamānaṃ śaknoti kartum|
tathā yadi yajamānaḥ ekakapālakārya viniyujyeta sarvahutaḥ kriyate|
kiṃ tarhi? arthavādaḥ; yajamāno jñāyate eva, prastaraḥ ekakapālaḥ iti ca (jñāyate eva)|
nāhi prastara eka- kapālo vā yajamānaḥ, na ca yajamānaḥ ekakapāle saṃskṛtaḥ puroḍāśaḥ, prathamo vā kuśamuṣṭirlūnaḥ|
tathā yaja- mānaḥ ekakapālaḥ sarvahutaḥ kartavyaḥ, sragvā āhavanīyaḥ, tatra pratiṣṭhāpito bhavati, iti|
kathamaguṇa- vacano guṇaṃ brūyāt? svārthāmidhāneneti brūmaḥ|
śabdā na svārthe hivā guṇeṣu vartante|
na ca sahakārī api hi kadācit rogeṇopahataḥ siṃhāḥ putraḥ siṃha eva|
sarvasiddhyuktiṣu yajamānamya, tadvacanaḥ śabda iti sthito nyāyaḥ|
na cāvati siddhe parikalpatayā pravartate, kalpanāyā aśakyatvāt|
kathaṃ nu svārthāmi- dhānena pratyayavyasyeti cet|
siṃha iti nirṇayāte, prastarakāritā tatra prāyeṇa, iti pratyayakārīti gamyate, arthapratyayasāmarthyāt|
yo hi manyate prasaṅgā- kāriṇaṃ pratyayeyemiti, sa yadi siṃhaśabdamuccārayati sidhyatyasa iṣṭamapimetam|
siṃhārthaḥ pratītaḥ prastarakārīti saṃbandhāt itaramarthaṃ pratyāyayati|
iha tu yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ, yaja- māna ekakapālaḥ iti kīdṛśo guṇasaṃbandhaḥ pratīyate? tatsiddhikara iti|
anyo'pi yastasya kāryasiddhiṃ karoti, sa tasmincarite hṛdayamāgacchati yathā rājā paṭṭigaṇaka iti|
evamihāpi yajamānakāryaṃ prastaraikakapālau sādhayataḥ, tau yajamāne pratīte pratīyate|
tasmāt tau yajamānaśabdena pratyāyyete, kathaṃ śruto syātāṃ barhiṣa upasādāne sarvahome ceti|
arthavādaprasaṅgāt tadupakāriguṇa- vādavidhi (vādāvadhi) tallakṣaṇaṃ tatra noktam, idānī- mabhidhīyate|
na ca tatraiva 'rūpāt prāyāt' 'dūra- bhūyastvāt' (1|2|1|11-12) iti nimittaṃ kathitam|
kathaṃ tarhi? iha siddham, tatra udāhṛtārthavādaviṣayavyavahārārthe nītam|
na ca sahacaraṇa- sthānādīni anyānyapi akṣapādapravṛttibhiḥ gauṇanimittāni uktāni (nyāyadarśanaṃ 2|1|60 'gauṇavṛttinimittāni' iti vindo draṣṭavyam)|
loke ca dṛśyate 'yaṣṭīḥ praveśaya' 'mañcāḥ krośanti' 'aśvasaṅkhyeṇa amuko rājā jitaḥ' iti|
athavā gauṇyāḥ vṛtteḥ: iha nimittamabhidhīyate, na lakṣaṇāyāḥ|
' tatra yathaiva ākṛtivacanaḥ śabdaḥ tatsaha- caritāṃ vyaktiṃ lakṣayati, tathaiva yaṣṭimañcāśabdādyaḥ tāḥsaṃbaddhapuruṣalakṣaṇā''rthā bhavanti|
'agnimāṇavakaḥ' iti tu na abhigvāvinābhāvena māṇavakaḥ pratīyate, kiṃ tarhi? 'vahitvakṣitārthatvāt yat paiṅgalyādi gamyate|
' sarvatra ca tatsiddhikarādī imeva prastarayaṣṭī yajamānādiśabdānāṃ vṛttiḥ, iti te udāhṛtāḥ|

atrāpi ca sāmānādhikaraṇyāt ekatarasya nāmadheyatvam, nimittābhāvāt anekaśakti- kalpanābhyāñca tadanupapattyā kāryalakṣaṇādāra prayojana- vattvatvena guṇavidhitvam, aśaktervā tadasaṃbhavāt artha- vādatvamiti trayaḥ eva pakṣāḥ|
na kā cit prastara- yajamānayoḥ itaretarasamabhihāreṇa stutiḥ pratīyate|
na ca stotumapi paraśabdaḥ paratra vartate|
na ca pravṛttasya prayojanaṃ anyat kārya- lakṣaṇātaḥ|
tasmāt 'yo hotā so'dhvaryuḥ' ityādi- vat anyataraḥ kāryalakṣaṇā syāt|
tatrāpi 'mukhyaṃ vā pūrvvacodanāt' (1|2|1|12-13) iti yajamānaśabdaḥ svārthavṛttaḥ, prastaraśabdaḥ juhvāraṇādikāryalakṣaṇārthaḥ; iti guṇavidhiḥ|
' ekakapālavat 'sūktavākena prastaraṃ praharati' iti yajamāne prahiyamāṇe (agnī prakṣite) sarva- tantravilopaprasaṅgaḥ|
kathaṃ punaḥ paraśabdasya patra samānādhikaraṇyam, kimākārā vā stutiriti|
yajamāno hi sarvārthahitaḥ, tadarthatvāt barhiṣaḥ upari prastaraḥ sādayitavyaḥ, svargāvena saṃstute ca āhavanīye sakalo yajamānaḥ āropito bhavati ekakapālena akhaṇḍitena iti stutiḥ|
'kathaṃ aguṇavacanaḥ?' iti (bhāṣye) vācakatvaṃ abhyupetaṃ manyamānasya praśnaḥ|
siddhāntastu-- ajahatsvārthāḥ sarvāḥ śabdapravṛttayaḥ, pūrva- śaktyanusārasaṃbhave śaktyantarakalpane pramāṇābhāvāt|

saṃbha- vati ca tatra vihitatvāgatatvetyuktayathāsthitaprastarakāri- tvāvacchedakadharmapratyayāt devadattapratyayaḥ, iti pūrvva śakti- nimittam, iti na saṃśayahetutvena vyavahārocchedātkāraṇaṃ prasiddhahānāprasiddhakalpane āśrayaṇīyam|
anyeṣāṃ tu darśanam, sarve eva hi siṃhādiśabdāḥ jātiguṇakriyāsamudāya- vācinaḥ|
samastārthasaṃbhave devadattādiṣu katipayaguṇakriyā- yogāt upacaryante iti|
pratyakṣa mukhya tameva, na devadattādiṣviva siṃhaśabdāt upacaritaḥ |
kriyā- guṇānāṃ ca ānantyāt na śakyaḥ prativyakti saṃbandhaḥ anubhavitum |
' na ca asāmānyāt sāmānyaṃ śakyate kalpayitum, jātyantare'pi kacit kāsāṃcit sadbhāvāt |
' nahi ana- bhihitaṃ siṃhatvaṃ guṇakriyāṇāṃ vyavacchedakaṃ bhavati, apratīteḥ |
abhihitaṃ cet pratyāyadeva aśeṣaguṇakriyā- 'vagamāt abhidhānaśaktyanvayasāt, iti samudāyācīnāṃ ekadeśeṣu na gauṇatvasaṃbhavaḥ |
tasya etanmatam, na kaṃcana paraśabdaḥ tathā jātyā sva- nivandhanabhūtā vinā atyantānabhidheyakriyāguṇāmātradvāre anyatra vartitumahati |
na ca siṃhaśabdena apravartamāne 'siṃho devadattaḥ' iti sāmānādhikaraṇyaprayogo ghaṭate |
vācyamāsāya śabdā nāṃ svayameva pravarta- nam |
' siṃhādisahakriyāguṇadarśanena hi devadattādayaḥ sāmastyaparikalpanayā sārūpyaṃ āpadyante |
yatra tu sa eva artho na samāropyate, tatra mukhyaḥ ityadoṣaḥ |
' yadā tāvat anyā mṛgatṛṣṇāyāṃ toyamadhyā- ropya śabdaṃ prayujyate, tadā ubhayoḥ mukhyārthavyavasthāna- rūpeṇa toyapratīteḥ bhrāntimukhyatvam |
(bhrāntyā adhya- sito mukhyaḥ bhrāntimukhyaḥ iti śākapārthivādivat madhyamapadalopī samāsaḥ |

athāpi vaktā vivekī san itarasvanāthe prayukte, (atra ānandāśramīye caukhambīye ca 'itaravacanārthe' ityeva pāṭhaḥ, tathāpi sudhāyāṃ 'śrotupratāraṇāya' iti 'śrotujanārthenaiva' iti ca spaṣṭatvāt 'itaravaśva- nāthe' ityeva pāṭho niścīyate) śrotā ca na vividhakte (vicir pṛthagbhāve rucādiḥ) tadā'pi ekasya vivekena adhyāropābhāvāt, itarasya bhrāntyā adhya- sānāt (atra ānandāśramīye 'itarasyānyādhya- sānāt' iti, caukhambīye ca 'itarasya anyādhya- sānāt' iti saṃdhamakṛtvā mudritam |

tathāpi sudhāyāṃ 'nanu dvayoḥ śrotuśca vā bhrānto āropabhāve'pi bhrāntyā pratāraṇārthena vā paraśabdasya paratra prayogopapatteḥ' ityu- ttarāvaraṇalekhanāt 'itarasya bhrāntyā adhyavasānāt' ityeva vārtikapāṭhe niścīyate) naikampi gauṇalo- papattiḥ |
yadā tu dvāvapi bhrāntau, tadā ubhayoḥ sāha- śyādi nimittāntartivalatārthavyavasānāt āropābhāvaḥ |
(sāhaśyaṃ ādipadopātto vā sāhaśyahetuḥ guṇayogaḥ nimittaṃ yasya yatyarthasya [ vatipratyayārthasya ] tasya paratra paraśabdapravṛttau nimittatvena adhyavasānāt nāropakalpanā yuktā ityarthaḥ |
su. pṛ. 501) tathāhi 'dvāvapi prati- padyete siṃhapuṃsorviviktatām |
' yathaiva hi ahaṣṭānā- marthānāṃ tiktamadhurādīnāṃ na kathaṃvidapi pratīyabhāvāt parāmarśadhyāropaṇām, evaṃ sadaśānāmāpi vivekajñānaṃ nopa- padyate |
nahi arthavyavasānāt anyādṛśaṃ nāma jñānaṃ vyavahārāṅgaṃ bhavatīti |
kiṃca 'śabda eva yadā tāvat nimitto na vartate |
' na ca arhatā buddhiḥ ātmākāramatranubhavatī jāyate ' ityuktaṃ śrutyavāde |
api ca 'pūrvānubhūta arthaḥ smaryate prathamaṃ padāt |
sarvathā tāvat ayaṃ gauṇamukhyavibhāgaḥ śrotṛṇāmartha- viśeṣāvadhāraṇe vyāpriyate |
te ca padavelāyāṃ anadhyā- ropitasvārthavṛtti eva siṃhādipadavyavasāya devadattādi- padasāmānādhikaraṇyānyā'nupapattyā gauṇatāṃ kalpayanti |
tatra caiṣāṃ svayamanorūpaiva siṃhatvaṃ tatsāhaśyadādipratīti- rbhavati |
sā ca kiṃ śabdāt atha arthāt iti anvicchatāṃ anvayatirekābhyāṃ ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyena arthāt iti niścayo jāyate |
jāyate, na tvyukte'rthe siṃhaśabde śrute'pi naḥ |
' yadā ca śrotṛṇāṃ svayamadhyāropābhāvaḥ, tadā vaktavyaṃ naiva eṣāmevaṃ kalpanā bhavati yathā 'nyūnamena siṃhatvaṃ adhyāropitam' iti |
kathaṃ tarhi ? 'vihatvāvinābhūtānekakriyāguṇa- samudāyaḥ anena vivakṣitaḥ, yangauravabhayāt na svairami- dhānairbravīti' |
na cāsya samastasya kiṃcidekaṃ vācakaṃ padamasti, tena anabhibhāvitā kathaṃ nu siṃhatvāt tapyatītibhavet iti tat tāvadamidhīyate |
yataḥ sthitvā śabdaśaktyā puṃsāṃ vyavahāraḥ, na taddarśana śaktyantaropajana iti |
vede sā na kathaṃcit syādadhyāropa- yiturvina |
' tasmāt guṇapravṛttiprayojanaḥ gauṇaḥ ityeva lakṣaṇaṃ nyāyyaṃ nānyathā |
(guṇayoganimittāyāḥ śabda- pravṛtteḥ gauṇatvena ihatvāt vācyāguṇānāṃ prabhatānāmarthāntare vṛttiyogaḥ prayojanaṃ pravṛttau nimittaṃ yasya, sa gauṇaḥ |
prayojanaśabdena prayujyate anena iti nyutpatyā nimittamuktam |
nanu evaṃ sati lapuṣpādīnāṃ svārthāvināmṛtaguṇā- bhāvāt gauṇayogābhāvaprasaṅgaḥ (tathā ca anyātiḥ |
sāṃkhyādikalpitapradhānaniṣedhe ca bauddhādeḥ vinā adhyāropeṇa prayogāsaṃbhavaḥ |
anabhyupagame hi pratiṣedhā- narthakyam, abhyupagate tadirodhaḥ syāt, adhyāropita- niṣedhe tu adopaḥ |
' (guṇo rūpa sattā ca prajñāte yasya iti vigrahaḥ |

) yasmāt 'lapuṣpasyānī ātmā' 'lapuṣpaṃ bhavasiddhāntaḥ' ityādiprayogaḥ, tatra katarat lapuṣpaṃ anyat tvayā siṃhavat avadhāritaṃ yadyathā- ropyeta, tena lapuṣpasvarūpameva tāvat adhyāropātmaka- mī. ko. 240
na ca etasya loke gauṇatvapratītiḥ, sakhyārthāntarabhāvāt |
prathamapratītatvāt hi lapuṣpādi- svarūpaṃ na mukhyatvāt apaiti |
yatra tu adhyāropyate, sa gauṇaḥ, na yaḥ adhyāropyate |
lapuṣpaṃ ca āropyamāṇaṃ viṣayāntarābhāvāt svayameva adhyāropyate vā |
tatra etat syāt, vidyamānaghaṭādirūpaṃ tatra adhyāropyate, (vidyamānasya ghaṭādeḥ yat sadpam, tat tatra lapuṣpādau āropyate) na gauṇatvamiti |
avaśyaṃ hi yādṛk saṃbandhakāle arthaḥ anubhūtaḥ, tādṛk uttakāleṃ grahītavyam |
na ca śaśaviṣāṇādyarthaḥ sadpena anubhūtapūrvaḥ : na ca arthā- ntaradapragrahaṇe lapuṣpādeḥ saṃbandho gṛhyate |
yayoḥ tada- yavayavayoḥ arthasaṃbandhaḥ anubhūtaḥ, tayornaiva gauṇatvam, mukhyātmanā avabodhāt |
kathaṃ tarhi 'śaśaviṣāṇaṃ nāsti' ityucyate ? (sadpena apratītasya aprasakta- tvāt niṣedho na yujyate |
' tenaiva adhyāropyate iti cet (yena kāraṇena etat vastughnyā sadasattve virudhyete, tenaiva kāraṇena sadpatvaṃ āropyate), na |
na ca anyasadbhāvena anyasya adhyāropaḥ : asaṃsa- bandhāt |
kathaṃ ūṣarakhaṇḍāvena toyarūpādhyāropaḥ : iti cet, pradeśāntare toyasadbhāvapratītervaiṣamyam |
kathaṃ tarhi śaśa- viṣāṇaṃ nāstīti prayogaḥ ? 1 pūrvaiveva abhāve avagate nāstiśabdaḥ anuvādakaḥ iti kecita (śaśaviṣāṇa- śabdena abhāvāvagamāt nāstiśabdasya anuvādalopa- pattiḥ iti) |
athavā sāmānyena prāgabhāvādiṣu nāstiśabdaḥ pravartamānaḥ śaśaviṣāṇaśabdena viśeṣyate, na śaśaviṣāṇam, anyabhicārāt tena ityadoṣaḥ |
athavā, yena avayavāvau gṛhītau, samāsācca rājapuruṣādi- vat sāmānyatodṛṣṭena ṣaṣṭhyarthasmṛtiḥ prasaktā, na kadā- cit śaśaḥ śaṅkarahitatvena avadhāritapūrvaḥ, tasya etat
(śaśaśṛṅgaṃ nāsti ityasya śaśasya śṛṅgena saṃsargo nāsti ityarthaḥ |

svamatena samāsārthakatayārthatvaṃ nāstiśabdāsya dyotitatvāt - ) athavā vinaiva samāsena śaśaṃ adhikaraṇatvena nirdiṣṭaṃ viṣāṇaṃ ca gavādigataṃ vinaiva adhyāropeṇa anyayoḥ saṃsargo nāsti iti kathyate tenaiva anubhūtasaṃbandhasya ( puruṣasya ) śaśaviṣāṇaśabdaḥ tameva abhāvaṃ gamayiṣyati ( 'ityetadarthe nāstiśabdaprayogaḥ |
'kriyāyāṃ kriyārthā- yām' iti laṭaḥ kriyārthakriyopapadanimittatvāt ' gamayiṣyati' iti 'etadartham' ityau labhyate |

athavā śaśamūrcchavartināṃ pṛthivya- vyavayavānāmuparyupari cīyamānānāṃ daḍhīghartaviśeṣarūpeṇa pariṇatānāṃ nīcairdhuttakāreṇa yat avasthānam, so'sya vākyasya ( śaśaviṣāṇaṃ nāsti ityasya ) adhyāsamantareṇa

ityatra na tāvadvidhiḥ śrūyate, na ca 'yo hotā so'- dhvaryuḥ' ityādiṣviva gatyantarāsaṃbhavena kalpayituṃ śakyate, 'prastaramuttaraṃ barhiṣaḥ sādayati' 'ekakapālaṃ sarvahutaṃ karoti' ityedādiśeṣatvena arthavādatvenaiva gatisaṃbha- vāt|
evaṃ ca sati ekavākyatvenaivopapatteḥ vākya- bhedo'pi na bhaviṣyati|
na ca pravṛttinimittaṃ vinā paraśabdaḥ paratra kathaṃ prayujyate iti vācyam|
nanu guṇo'pi na kaścit sādhāraṇo yajamānaśabdenābhidhīyate ityuktam|
lakṣaṇayā svābhidheyārthasyaivānupasthitamevārthe śabdo viparyya- karoti, yathā gaṅgāśabdaḥ svārthasaṃbaddhameva tīram|
cchabdasya samudāyadhāreṇa samudāyaviṣayatvāt samudāyasya ca prāṇabhṛdaprāṇabhṛtsādhāraṇatvāt prāṇabhṛcchabdasya gauṇatve- 'pi svārthaparityāgaḥ |
evaṃ suṣidasyāpi samudāya- viṣayatvāt svārthaparityāga eva |
⚶ prayojanaṃ- suṣidaprasiddhidvaireṇopādānaṃ kartavyaṃ yadi pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ, yadi siddhāntaḥ suṣidasuṣidaprāṇabhṛnman- riti |
'tatsiddhi-jāti-sārūpya-praśaṃsā-bhūma-liṅga- samavāyā iti guṇāśrayāḥ' ityekaṃ sūtraṃ (1|4|23) 'tatsiddhipeṭikā' ityucyate |
atra yogavibhāgaṃ kṛtvā ṣaḍadhikaraṇeṣu ṣaṭ gauṇavṛttinimittāni uktāni iti peṭikā ityucyate |
ke. ⚳ gauṇyāḥ vṛtternimittapratipādanadvārā gauṇīvṛtti- lakṣaṇaṃ anena (tatsiddhi- ) sūtreṇa abhīdhīyate |
1|4|132 pṛ. 268, vaiśvānarādhikaraṇa- nyupāditāguṇavṛtteḥ ākṣepasamādhānārthaṃ asya sūtrasya ( tatsiddhisūtrasya ) |
1|4|132 pṛ. 268. ⚲ tatsiddhisūtre siddhe gauṇe tannimittabhedaḥ svārthapari- tyāgavṛttitvaṃ ca vyākhyātaṃ iti ayaṃ (3|2|1-2) arthāt vicāraḥ pūrvaṃ pratyetavyaḥ |
vā. 3|2|1 pṛ. 746. lakṣaṇāgauṇayoḥ tatsiddhisūtre arthāntara- śaktipūrvakasya vakṣyamāṇatvena |
1|3|84 pṛ. 110. ⚱ tatsiddhisūtroktaiḥ saha nava gauṇapakṣā draṣṭavyāḥ |
tasmāt arthānusāreṇa ṣoḍaśa ṛtvijaḥ varītavyāḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
atra sudhā-- na ādhvaryavādikarmamedanimittaḥ adhvaryādi saṃjñābhedaḥ, yasmāt utpattau kartṛpādanādhaye varaṇe asau saṃjñābheda āmnātaḥ iti sūtrārthaḥ |

punaśca sudhā-- ekasya punaḥpunarvaraṇayoge'pi ‘ṛtvijo gṛṇīte’ ityasya varaṇotpattividhine varaṇa- medābhāvāt ekasmin varaṇe adhvaryādivākyavihitānāṃ varaṇīyānāṃ samuccayāyogāt, ‘ṛtvijaḥ’ iti bahutvasya ca uddeśyaviśeṣaṇatvena avivakṣitatvāt, parikalpa- nyāthā'nupapattyā ca ṛtvijaḥ : camasādhvaryuhutavat aprāptoddeśyaviśeṣaṇatvābhāvāt adhvaryādiśabdānāṃ bhinna- puruṣasamarpakatvena ekasya kasyacit dharmanimittatvāt bhinnapuruṣasamarpakatvābhāve vā yāvatkartavyaṃ ekasya
' sarvaibhyo darśapūrṇamāsau ' ' sarvaibhyo jyotiṣṭomaḥ ' iti yat darśapūrṇamāsādeḥ sarvakāmavamuktam, tat kiṃ sakṛtprayoge, uta paryāyeṇa iti vicāre pūrvapakṣasūtra-midam |
tatra darśapūrṇamāsākhye jyotiṣṭomākhye ca karmaṇi sakṛt prayukte sarve kāmā bhaveyuḥ yogapathena |
aviśeṣāt viśeṣasya anuktvāt, ' sarvaibhyaḥ ' iti sarvaśabdaprayogāt |
sauryādiṣu kāmyeṣu karmasu ye brahmavarcasādayaḥ kāmāḥ śrutāḥ te sarve tatra paraloke syuḥ neha loke |
iha loke na labhyate tathā brahmavarcasādayo'pi iha nopalabhyante |
yogaḥ saṃbandhaḥ, sa ca paurvāparya rūpaḥ paryāyo vivakṣitaḥ |
yogena paryāyeṇa siddhiḥ tatphalasya lābhaḥ syāt |
ekena prayogeṇa ekasya phalasya siddhiḥ, apareṇa aparasya ekasya, iti paryāyeṇa sarvakāmatvam |
sarveṣāṃ yugapad-tpattirnāsti iti utpattyasaṃyogi, na utpattyasaṃyogi, utpatyasaṃyogi, tasya bhāvaḥ, tasmāt |
athavā utpattau utpattividhau asaṃyogitvāt sarveṣāṃ kāmānāṃ saṃbandho nāsti, na śrutaḥ ityarthaḥ |
kāmānāṃ karmaṇāṃ ye brahmavarcasādayaḥ kāmāḥ, te svargavat iha loke nopalabhyante tasmāt maraṇottarameva anyajanmani te labhyante iti pūrvasūtreṇa pūrvapakṣe prāpte siddhāntaḥ |
arthasya phalasya tu upasthitā vartamānajanmanā asaṃyogi-tvāt saṃbandhasya anuktvāt sati pratibandhe anya-janmani kāmyaṃ phalaṃ labhyate |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ ' mice juhoti ' ' skanne juhoti ' iti śrutam |

yathā sāyaṃprātarādikāle āgateāgate agnihotrahomādi āvartate, tathā antaḥkratu kratumadhye prayuktāni medanahomādīnyapi prāpteprāpte medanacchedādau nimitte naimittiko homo'pi āvartanīyaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
antaḥkratuyuktāni iti subodhini-nyāyam, antaḥkratusaṃyuktāni iti kutūhale ca pāṭhaḥ |
abhiṣekamātrāpakarṣaḥ, na tu tadanyasya ' tathā'pūrva ' iti nyāyāt |
' kṛtadeśāstu pūrveṣām ' ityatra aprākṛtānāmapi videnādīnāṃ apakarṣavarṇane ' tathā-'pūrvam ' ityasya viśiṣṭaviṣayavyākhyānāt |
sā amāvāsyāyāṃ pratikṛṣyate ' pūrvedhuramāvāsyāyāṃ vediṃ karoti ' iti |
sā apakṛṣyamāṇā tato'rvācīnān padārthān apakarṣati na veti vicāre prayogasaṃbandhāt apakarṣati iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
pūrve na bhavati iti apūrve prakṛtibhūtaṃ karma amāvāsyā |
lakṣaṇāyā amāvāsyāyāṃ vediḥ tathā'pyautprāptikavat arvācīnān padārthāṃn nāpakarṣati |
havirabhivāsanaṃ haviḥ puroḍāśasya darmaiḥ abhito jvalanaṃ ulmukaiḥ paritāpanam, upari sāṅgarasya bhasmanaḥ abhyūhanaṃ ca |
dyāmākāmayane ' vāso dakṣiṇā ' nīhāragrayaṇe ca ' vatsaḥ prathamajo dakṣiṇā ' iti śrūyate |
tayośca vāso-vatsayoḥ anvāhāryadharmāḥ kartavyāḥ, pākastu na kartavya ityuktam |
annakāritatvāt annena kāritatvāt annaprayuktatvāt iti pūrvasūtrādanuvartanīyam |
bhakṣaṇīyasya svādutāsaṃpādanārtha hi abhighāraṇaṃ bhavati, vāsovatsayostu annatvameva nāstīti abhighāraṇamapi na kartavyamiti siddhāntaḥ |
pūrvasūtrāt saṃyogitvāt itipadam, pūrvatarasūtrāt pradhānasya iti padaṃ cānuvartate |
' caturhotrā paurṇamāsīmimṛśeta, pañcahotrā amāvāsyāyām ' iti viṣayavākyamatra |
caturhotramantreṇa paurṇamāsīgatapradhānahaviḥ abhigharśanaṃ hastena sparśanaṃ kartavyam |
idamamigharśanaṃ kiṃ pradhānamātram, uta aṅga-pradhānānāmiti saṃśaye abhigharśanaṃ pradhānasyaiva nāṅgānām |
pradhānasya abhidhānena paurṇamāsī amāvāsyā iti pradhānasyaivābhidhānāt ityarthaḥ |
' paurṇamāsīmimṛśeta, amāvāsyāmimṛśeta ' iti abhighānaṃ sarvārthapradhānārtham, na pradhānamātrārtham |
' paurṇamāsīm, amāvāsyām ' iti dvitīyā'ntena sāṅgapradhānānāṃ saṃskāryatvamuktvā abhi-gharśanaṃ sarvārthamiti siddhāntaḥ |
atra saptamamadhyāyāṃ sutrābhyāṃ ekamadhikaraṇaṃ tṛtīyam, ahamadaśamābhyāṃ ca caturthamadhikaraṇaṃ iti vibhāgo draṣṭavyaḥ |
sauryaṃ caruṃ tu tathā abhyūhanaṃ na kartavyam |

' tathā-'vabhṛthaḥ somāt ' iti saptamādhikaraṇe vakṣyamāṇaumikā-vabhṛthabhāvanādharmātideśāvicāraṇātva ana-vabhṛtha atideśāyoge'pi svaśabdenopadiṣṭasya svadharma-saṃnidhāpakāt kāmyaguṇāśrayabhūtāmihotrādivat ati-deśanimittamabhipretya avabhṛthanāmnaḥ atideśakāloktyu-papatteḥ |
varuṇapraghāseṣu ' vāruṇyā niṣkāsena tuṣaiśca avabhṛthaṃ yanti ' iti śrūyate |
atra darśapūrṇamāsāttike codakaprāpte apāṃ nyuseke tuṣaniṣkāsavidhiḥ; kiṃvā saumikādavabhṛthāt dharmātideśaḥ |
yathā ṣaḍdaśāt pṛṣṭhānāmatideśaḥ; tathā somāt avabhṛthaḥ avabhṛthadharmaḥ vāruṇaprāghāsike anyabhaye bhavabhṛthanāmnā atidiśyate, avabhṛthaśabdāsāmānyāt |
varuṇapraghāseṣu ' vāruṇyā niṣkāsena tuṣaiśca avabhṛthaṃ yanti ' ityatra prakṛteḥ darśapūrṇamāsarūpāyāḥ sakāśāt codakaprāpte apāṃ nyuseke avabhṛthasya niṣkāsatuṣa-rūpasya guṇasya vidhiḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ yo'yamapāṃ vyutsekaḥ praṇītānidhanayanam, tatra avabhṛthatvaṃ bhaktyā uktam, praśaṃsātvo'yam ' eṣa vai darśapūrṇa-māsayobhavabhṛthaḥ ' iti |

varuṇapraghāsagatādhvaryu saumikāvabhṛthāt dharmātideśaḥ ityatra ‘nāyadī juhoti, na sāma gāyati, na vā gamanamantraṃ japati’ iti keṣāṃcit saumikāvabhṛdhadharmāṇāṃ pratiṣedhaṃ bruvan itaradharmāṇāṃ prāptiṃ darśayati |
etasmāt liṅga- darśanāt avabhṛdhanāmanā saumikāvabhṛthāt dharmaprāptiḥ vāruṇaprāghāsike'dhvaryu iti siddhāntaḥ |
tatra ājyabhāgāgniḥ ājyabhāgadevatārūpaḥ agniḥ, tathā pūrvādhikaraṇoktamaprayājavat saṃskārakarma syāt |
āgneya ājyabhāgaḥ na pradhānāmeḥ saṃskārakarma, kintu ārādupakārakaṃ karma |
pradhānāgneḥ sakāśāt ājya- bhāgāgniḥ devatā''ntaraṃ syāt |
vyapadeśāt ‘agnima āvaha, somamāvaha, agnimāvaha’ iti somena vyavahitaṃ agnidvayaṃ vyapadiśati |
tasmāt āgneya ājyabhāgaḥ ārādupakārakaḥ ājyabhāgāgniśca pradhānāgnerdevatā''ntaraṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
kiṃca ādhārī ājya- bhāgau iti ārādupakārakāṇi karmaṇyabhihitāni |
tadvataḥ āgneya ājyabhāgo'pi ārādupakāraka eva syāt |
tasmāt ājyabhāgāgniḥ pradhānāgnerbhinnaḥ āgneya ājyabhāgaśca na saṃskārakarma kintu ārādupakārakaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
pūrvasūtre vyapa- deśo liṅgamuktam, atra sūtre samatvaṃ nyāya uktaḥ |
(12|1|16) ityasyā- dhikaraṇe itikaraṇasya śruticvaṃ nirastaṃ śāstradīpikā- yām |
yathā aindrī apyarthe viniyujyate tathā āhvānaṃ haviṣkṛ- nmantro'pi apyarthe viniyujyate iti pūrvapakṣasūtrārthaḥ |
tathāśabdānukṛṣṭasya vacanāt iti tṛtīyasūtrāvayavasya śruteḥ ityarthaḥ : śrute. pṛ. 1092.
atra haviṣkṛdehi iti avadhnan havi- ṣkṛdehi iti mantreṇa avaghātaṃ kurvan ityanvayaḥ; kiṃvā avadhnan avahananakāle haviṣkṛdehīti āhvayati itya- nvayaḥ |
evaṃ mantraḥ iti upadiśyate, avaghnanniti kālaṃ vā lakṣayati iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
yathā aindrī gārhapatyaṃ prati upadiśyate tathā āhvānamapi haviṣkṛdehi iti āhvānamantro'pi avadhnan iti prati upadiśyate |
nāyaṃ vidhiḥ avaghāte mantraviniyojakaḥ; kintu kālavidhiḥ kālānu- vādapūrvakaḥ trirabhyāsavidhirayam |
kālasya mantrasya ca coditatvāt arthata eva prāptatvāt |
na avaghāte mantravidhiḥ, coditatvāt tri- rabhyāsasyaivātra vākye vidhānāt |
āhāne avaghātakālo na vidhātavyaḥ avahananakāle eva sahāyāhānasya apekṣitasya prāptatvena arthasiddhatvāt |
najaḥ āvṛttyā avahananyitanena avahananakālaṃ lakṣayitvā kāla- saṃgrahavidhirapi na, kālasaṃgrahasya trirabhyāsasya vidhāne vākyabhedāt |
haviṣkṛt; avahananakāle āhānasya lokataḥ coditatvāt jñātatvāt trirabhyāsamātra- vidhiḥ |
nanu yathā patnī haviḥ karoti, tathā avahananakriyā- 'pi haviḥ karoti iti rūpādeva avahanane mantre prāpte kevalaṃ trirabhyāsimeva vakṣyati ‘haviṣkṛdehīti triravadhnan āhvayati’ iti vākyam |
ehi iti para- preṣaṇarūpamathayamapuruṣasya haviṣkṛt iti saṃvodhanasya ca acetane avaghāte asaṃbhavena mantrasya avahanane asaṃbhavāt |
tasmāt guṇābhāvāt cetanatvasya guṇasya avahanane abhāvāt na avahananamano'yam |
‘vāgvai haviṣkṛt vācamevaitadāhvayati’ iti śrīliṅga- śabdavācyatvāt liṅgādapi vāmūpatayā haviṣkṛt stotuṃ śakyā |
tatra mantrasya patnyāhānājñatve ghaṭate, na tu ava- ghātaparatve |
na niyogataḥ avahanane strīliṅgaḥ, puṃliṅgo'pi avaghāta iti, napuṃsakaliṅgo'pi karma iti |
api ca patnyāḥ svarūpeṇa sādṛśyamavahanteḥ pararūpeṇa śabdena |

‘haviṣkṛdehīti triravadhnan āhvayati’ ityanena mantrasya avaghātābhyāsa upadeśe sati ‘atha radho divaḥ sapannaṃ vadhyatāmityavahanati’ ‘apa hatā yātudhānā ityavahanti’ iti vidheḥ anyasya vidheḥ kopo virodhaḥ syāt |
tasmāt avadhnan iti kālalakṣaṇārthaḥ; avaghātakāle haviṣkṛdehi iti mantreṇa patnī trirāhvayati ityarthaḥ |
sūrya ādityo bhāskaraḥ savitā divākara iti sūryamidhānāni prasiddhāni |
saurye carau sarve nigadāḥ prākṛtāḥ codaka- prāptāḥ |
teṣu kena śabdena devatānirdeśaḥ kartavyaḥ iti vicāre siddhāntamāha |
uttasyāṃ tatau saurye tatprakṛti- tvāt āgneyaprakṛtitvāt tathā syāt codanāgatasūrya- śabdoccāraṇaṃ syāt |
‘uttiṣṭhannaha-amīdagnīn vihara’ iti, ‘vrataṃ kuruteti vācaṃ visṛjati’ iti ca jyotiṣṭome śrūyate |
atra utthāne vāgvisarjane ca mantrayopadeśaḥ, uta kālārthaḥ saṃyogaḥ |
iti vicāre ‘amīdagnīn vihara’ iti mantreṇa utthātavyam |
‘vrataṃ kuruta’ iti mantreṇa vāgvisargaḥ kartavyaḥ iti pūrvapakṣe siddhāntaṃ pūrvādhikaraṇā- tideśenāha |

yathā ‘haviṣkṛdehi’ iti mantrasya mukhye'rthe āhāne viniyogaḥ; tathā atra ‘amīdagnīn vihara’ itimantrasya mukhye arthe agniviharaṇasaṃpreṣe, ‘vrataṃ kuruta’ itimantrasya ca vratakaraṇapreṣe viniyogaḥ |
utthānaṃ ca visarjanaṃ ca tayoḥ samāhāraḥ tasmin |
utthāne utthānavākye visarjane visarjanavākye ca śrūyamāṇo mantraḥ mukhye'rthe viniyujyate ityarthaḥ |
utthānakāle ‘amīdagnīn vihara’ iti praiṣamāha, vāgvisargakāle ‘vrataṃ kuruta’ iti praiṣamāha |
yathā avaghātaḥ, tathā utthānavisarjane api pūrvapakṣe mantraprāptaye, siddhānte tu aprāptaye ityevamatideśaḥ |

notthānavisarjanākhyena agnīda-vratamantro vidhīyate, kintu agniviharaṇe preṣaṇā- khyatvena liṅgāt prāptasya agnimantrasya utthānakalatvam, vāgamaniyamasamāptyakhyatvena ca prāptasya vāgvisargasya vrata- bhakṣaṇapreṣaṇajñabhramantroccāraṇakālatvaṃ vidhīyate |
vidhimantra- pāṭhakramābhyāṃ ca utthānavratamantrayoḥ viśiṣṭakālatvena avagatatvāt coditatvāt agnimantratvāgnīdavisarga- lakṣaṇaśaktirasti ityevaṃ siddhāntasūtrayojanā |
pūrvapakṣe śrutyā gauṇe mantraviniyogaḥ; siddhānte liṅgamukhye |
yadapi vedavihitakriyāsarvārthatvaṃ prakṛtivikṛtyoḥ, tadapi ‘agnimapanidhāya stuvate’ ityādyudāhṛtya ‘viśaye0 na vaidika0 tathotpattiḥ |
oṃ tathaikāryavikāre prākṛtasyāpravṛttiḥ, pravṛttau hi vikalpaḥ syāt |
tatra ekārthavikāre ekārthaśrau vikāra ekārtha- vikāraḥ, audumbarasya lādirena saha ekaḥ samāno'rthaḥ phalaṃ pañcavannam, vikārasya lādirādivācakaśca audu- mbaraḥ |
tasmin ekārthavikāre tathā pūrvādhikaraṇe yathā prākṛtasya dravyadevatāsya apravṛttiḥ, tadvat somāpauṣṇe audumbare pravṛtte sati prākṛtasya lādirādeḥ apravṛttiḥ na pravṛttiḥ |
hi yasmāt vikalpaḥ syāt codakaprāptasya pratyakṣaśrutasya ca |
'audumbaro yūpo bhavati' iti vaikṛtī śrutiḥ, 'prakṛtitvat' iti ca codakaśrutiḥ |
iti yāvatyaḥ śrutayaḥ, tāvanto yūpāḥ iti avyayībhāvaḥ samāsaḥ |
tathā ca śrutidvayānusāreṇa audumbaratvādiryoḥ samuccayaḥ syāt ubhayasmin saha niyujyatāṃ paśuḥ |
prakṛtau audumbarasya aśabdatvāt, vikṛtau ca lādirasya aśabdatvāt |
avidyamāno vidhāyakaḥ śabdo yasya tat aśabdam, tādṛśatvāt vidhāyakaśabdābhāvāt |
tasmāt vaikṛtena audumbareṇa prākṛtasya yūpadravyasya bādhaḥ |
idaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvādhikaraṇaśeṣatvena vyākhyāya adhikaraṇā- ntaratvenāpi bhāṣye vyākhyāyate |
'vasante prātarāgneyī kṛṣṇagrīvāmālabhate' evaṃ grīṣme śaradi ceti tisro gā vidhāya vākyaśeṣe 'garbhiyo bhavanti' ityuktam |
tathā 'aśva ṛṣabhaṃ vṛṣṇivarṣataḥ puruṣate prājāpatyāḥ' kutaḥ ? arthasaṃyogāt arthasya phalasya yajamānena sambandhāt |
tathā ca yadi kāmayeta yajamānaḥ, tataḥ adhvaryuḥ nīcairminuyāt iti vaiyadhikaraṇyenāpi uktaśrutau ekavākyatvam |
svāmini kāmayamāne yadi adhvaryuḥ svāmyarthe kāmayeta iti sāmānādhikaraṇyenāpi eka- vākyatā saṃbhavati |

atra sudhā- sadomānasya ādhvaryavatve'pi tadā- śritaguṇāvacchinnāyāḥ bhāvanāyāḥ svāmyupakārārthasado- mānāśritatvasāmarthyātsyāt liṅgāt svāmyupakārārthatvā- vagateḥ tasyaiva kāmitatvāt samākhyāyāśca pradhānabhūta- kartṛniyamātkavayogāt na bhāvanākārī niyamyate iti |
jyotiṣṭome 'yadi kāmayeta' ityādivākyoktaḥ kāmaḥ yajamānaḥ iti pūrvasūtreṇa siddhānte ukte kacit tadapavādaḥ anena sūtreṇa ucyate |
'udgātā ātmane vā yajamānāya vā kāmaṃ kāmayate tamāgayāti' iti yajamānāt pṛthak 'ātmane' iti padena ṛtvijo vyapa- deśaḥ |
tatra tādṛśāt vyapadeśāt itareṣāṃ yajamānadanyeṣāṃ ṛtvijāmeva kāmaḥ syāt |
tādṛśavyapadeśābhāve tu yajamāna eva kāmaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
iti vidhāya vākyaśeṣe 'muṣkarā bhavanti sendriyatvāya' ityuktam |
) tena tatra strītvaṃ puṃstvaṃ ca vivakṣitamiti niścayaḥ |
ṛtapeye śrūyate 'audumbaraḥ somacamaso dakṣiṇā, sa priyāya sagotrāya brahmaṇe deyaḥ' iti |
ayaṃ somacamasaḥ brahmasaṃyogāt brahmabhāgasya nivartakaḥ, na kṛtsnakratu- dakṣiṇāyāḥ |
tathā yathā 'khajamudrātre' iti udgāt- saṃyogāt khak udgātbhāgamātrasya nivartikā tadvat |
ṛtapeye dakṣiṇātvena śrūyamāṇaḥ somacamasaḥ na kevalaṃ brahmabhāgasya nivartakaḥ iti vāśabdena pūrvapakṣe vyāvartayati |
somacamasaḥ sarvavikāraḥ kṛtsnāyāḥ ṛtu- dakṣiṇāyāḥ nivartakaḥ |
evamāmnāyate 'ṛtaṃ vai somaḥ anṛtaṃ paśavaḥ; yat paśūn dadyāt so'nṛtaṃ kuryāt, audumbaraḥ soma- camaso dakṣiṇā' |
somacamasadāne paśavo na dīyante iti gamyate |
brahmadānamātrasya nivartakatve sati anyebhyaḥ paśavo dīyeran tena anṛtaṃ syāt |

ṛtapeye 'ṛtaṃ vai somaḥ paśo'nṛtam, yat paśūn dadyāt so'nṛtaṃ kuryāt, audumbaraḥ somacamaso dakṣiṇā' ityatra 'yat brahmaṇe paśūn dadyāt iti paśūnāṃ brahmadāne svīkṛto'pi avaśiṣṭaṃ paśupratiṣedhātvādaḥ samāna eva |
tasmāt brahmaṇe paśavo na deyāḥ kintu somacamasa eva iti somacamasaḥ brahmabhāganivartakaḥ iti svīkāre'pi paśupratiṣedhopapatteḥ |
somacamasaḥ brahma- bhāgasyaiva nivartakaḥ na kṛtsnadakṣiṇāyāḥ iti cet pūrvapakṣī brūyāt |
utsargasya ṛtvarthatvāt, pratiṣiddhasya karma syānna ca gauṇaḥ prayojanamarthaḥ sa dakṣiṇānāṃ syāt |
kratau mādhyaṃdine savane barhiṣi yāvadīyate sā sarvā ekā dakṣiṇā |
'somacamaso dakṣiṇā' ityuktvāt ṛtapeye sā sarvā dakṣiṇā somacamasa eva |
tathāca utsargasya dānasya somacamasadānasya ṛtvarthatvāt sarvakratu- dakṣiṇādānārhatvāt somacamasaḥ kṛtsnakratudakṣiṇāyā nivartako bhavati |
yadi tu brahmaṇo'nyebhyaḥ paśavo dīyeran tadā 'yat paśūn dadyāt, so'nṛtaṃ kuryāt' iti prati- ṣiddhasya paśudānasya karma syāt tasmāt kartavyam |
kiñca yo brahmabhāgo na sā dakṣiṇā, kintu dakṣiṇāvayavaḥ kaścit |
na ca sa gauṇo'rthaḥ dakṣiṇānāṃ prayojanaṃ syāt |
sarveṣāṃ ṛtvijāmānamanaṃ dakṣiṇānāṃ prayojanaṃ na brahmamātramananam |
tasmāt soma- camasaḥ kṛtsnakratudakṣiṇāyā nivartakaḥ na tu brahmabhāga- mātrasya |

yadi tu somacamasaḥ brahmaṇaḥ bhāgasyaiva nivartakaḥ syāt, tadā tadūnaṃ tena brahmabhāgena ūnaṃ nyūnaṃ dakṣiṇādravyaṃ tadvikāraḥ sarvakratudakṣiṇāyāḥ vikāraḥ bādhakaḥ syāt brahmabhāgaṃ varjayitvā itarebhya ṛtvigbhyaḥ itarā sarvā dakṣiṇā dātavyā syāt |
sarve vā ṛtudakṣiṇāṃ soma- camasena nivalante, puruṣapanayāt sarvebhyaḥ paśyebhyaḥ dakṣiṇāyāḥ apanayāt |
kutaḥ ? tāsāṃ dakṣiṇānāṃ sarva- ṛtvijāṃ ānamanena kratupradhānatvāt |
tasmāt sarva- dakṣiṇāne ekaḥ somacamasa eva deyaḥ |
so'pi ca brahmaṇe eva nānyasmai kasmaicana |
tasmāt sarveśāmaṅgānāṃ tantraṃ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
adhvarakalpāyāṃ yadyapi prātaḥ madhyaṃdine sāyaṃ iti yāgatrayam, tathāpi 'saiṣā'dhvarakalpā nāmeṣṭiḥ' iti ekavat ekatvena śrutiḥ śravaṇaṃ bhavati |
athavā karmapṛthaktvāt, teṣāṃ ca tantravidhā- nāt, sāṅgānāmupadeśaḥ syāt |
āmā- vaiṣṇavaśarasvatādīnāṃ karmaṇāṃ pṛthaktvāt, teṣāṃ ca karmaṇāṃ prātaḥ madhyaṃdine sāyaṃ iti nānākāleṣu tantrasya aṅgakalāpasya vidhānāt sāṅgānāmeva trayāṇāṃ yāgānāṃ upadeśaḥ syāt |
prathamasya prātaḥkālīnasya karmaṇaḥ yo nirvāpaḥ, tasyaitat kālavacanaṃ 'purā vācaḥ pravaditornirvapet' iti |
iṣṭiśabdaḥ eka- vacanāntaḥ phalaikatvāt, phalaikatvena karmaikatvāt |
tasmāt adhvarakalpāyāṃ prātarādikālabhedena kartavyānāṃ trayāṇāṃṇāmadhye aṅgānāṃ medenānuṣṭhānam |
ke. tathā svāmina: : phalasamavāyāt, phalasya karmayogitvāt |
yathā devatāmiśradakriyāṇāṃ na pratinidhiḥ tathā svāminaḥ yajamānasyāpi na pratinidhiḥ |
phalasamavāyāt svāmina eva karmaṇaḥ phalena samavāyāt saṃbandhāt, phalasya karmayogitvāt phalaṃ karmaṇā yujyate |
pakṣadvayadoṣasāmyanirāsārthe deśalakṣaṇayāt śiṣyeṇa ekavākyatvāt iti akārampreśa- śūnyatvāvavacchyākhyā'thai 'ardhamantavedaṃ' ityādi bhāṣyaṃ iti |
ke. 'tathā yūyasya vediḥ' ityādhikaraṇe 'ardhamantaveda ardhe bahiveṃdi' iti samudāyena deśaviśeṣo lakṣyate iti bhāṣyavārtikādiṣu dhvanitam |
some dīkṣaṇīyā''diṣu dārśapūrṇamāsikaṃ vrataṃ codaka- prāptaṃ na kartavyaṃ tathā agnyanvādhānavat |

anye tu kutracitsamāso- carabhāvapratyayasya padārthatāvacchedakadvayasāmānyādhikaraṇye śaktiḥ; loke pācakatvaṃ aupagavatvaṃ nīlotpalatvaṃ ityādau, vede ca vaiśvadevītvaṃ niṣādasthapatitvaṃ ityādī prākṛtpuruṣatvayoḥ, upagusaṃbandhatvāpattayoḥ; nīla- tvopalavayoḥ; viśvadevadevatākatvāmityādyoḥ; niṣādatva- khapatitvayośca sāmānyādhikaraṇyasya viśeṣaṇatayā bhānāt iti āhuḥ |
anye tu sāmānyādhikaraṇyasya uttarapadārtha- tā'vacchedakaviśeṣaṇatayā bhānam |
pratyayānāṃ prakṛtyarthānvitasvārthabodhakatva- niyamāt, pratyayārthaprādhānyaniyamasya bhāvapratyayārthāti- riktasamāsādyatiriktaparatvāt |
tena nīlatvasamāsādhi- karaṇamutpalatvaṃ iti bodhaḥ ( nīlotpalam ityatra ) ityāhuḥ |
pare tu nīlādipadasya tatsamavāyini lakṣaṇā, amedaḥ saṃsargaḥ, nīlatvasamāsavācyabhinnasamavetatvopala- iti bodha ityāhuḥ |
paiśvadevī ityāditaddhitasya devatatva- viśiṣṭe sarvanāmārthe śaktiḥ |
evaṃ ca prātipadikārtha- viśvadevānāṃ devatatvaṃ, devatatvasya ca nirūpakatvena sarva- nāmārthadravyaviśeṣaṇatvena anvayaḥ |
āmīkṣāpade tu prakāraviśeṣopa- sthāpane taddhitasya tātparyagrāhakatvaṃ iti prājñaḥ |
kecittu taddhitasya sarvanāmārthe śaktiḥ; devatatve tu niruḍhalakṣaṇā |
kuprāyānāṃ āśrayavācināṃ kṛtāvibha viśvadevaprati- padikārthasya lakṣitadevatatve anvayaḥ nyutpattivaicitryāt ityāhuḥ |
pare tu devatatvameva taddhitārthaḥ; sarvanāmārthasya vyakti- nyāyena vācyaḥ ityāhuḥ |
apare tu taddhitane anirdhā- ritaviśeṣadravyasāmānyāpratīteḥ na dravyaviśeṣavācitvam, kiṃtu āmīkṣāpade dravyaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ ityāhuḥ |
maṇi. pṛ. 161-162. taddhitārthena sākāṅkṣasya asaṃnbandhaḥ, evaṃ samāse'pi |
vā. 414|16 pṛ. 341. taddhitadvitīyayorviprapattī taddhitaḥ samajaso dvitīyā vā iti saṃdehaḥ aindrādhikaraṇe ( 3|2|13 ) |
su. pṛ. 1087. taddhitanirdeśena hi prātipadikārthasya saṃkhyā- viśeṣāmibhyaktirbhavati |
tatra prātipadikārthānanyathā- saṃbhavāt ekavacanāntena vigraho bhavati |
vāla. pṛ. 181. taddhitavat samāsasya sāpekṣeṣu apravṛtteḥ |
ye hi vibhaktiyācyā arthā bhavanti, taddhitabhakti- samarthamya eva tebhyaḥ taddhitavidhānaṃ dṛśyate 'taddhati tena krītaṃ, tasmai hitam, tata āgataḥ, tasyāpatyam, tatra bhavaḥ' iti |
vā. 2|4|10 pṛ. 492. taddhitaśruteḥ kārakaśrutirbalīyasī iti 'aindrā- gārhapatyam' ityatra mantrasya gārhapatyatvameva, nendrā- tvam |
pādeṣu akṣarāṇi 1|1|2|6 udā0 pra yā ghoṣe bhagavān ( ṛsaṃ. 1|120|9 ) |
yathā tantavaḥ sūtrāṇāṃ bahūnāṃ militāni kāryaṃ sādhayanti, tathā mahānto'pi militāḥ svakāryaṃ sādhayantīti bhāvaḥ |
tārkikamate tantuṣu naṣṭeṣvapi kṣaṇaṃ paṭastiṣṭhati, tathā jīvanmuktiḥ |
( tantraṃ nāma ) tantraṃ tadyena sakṛt kṛtaṃ sarveṣāmupākaroti |
yatra tu anyāyena anye anyo- pakāraḥ tatra prasaṅgaḥ |
tanyate vistāryate bahunāmupakāro yena sakṛtpavartanena, tadidam |
yathā bahūnāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ madhye pradīpatesvā- mupakaroti |
tantraṃ dvidhā bhavati pratyekaṃ vā samudāye vā vākyaparisamāptau ākhyātaguṇatva- prādhānyāpekṣayā |
evameva prasaṅgāt syād vidyamāne svake vidhau |
' ( iti bhāṣyoktalakṣaṇaślokasyāyamarthaḥ -) yat aṅgamanuṣṭhīyamānaṃ agrahyamāṇaviśeṣatvāt anekaśeṣi- sādhāraṇam, tatra tantram, yathā āgneyādiṣu prayājādeḥ |
yattu anuṣṭhīyamānaṃ parārthatvena grahyamāṇaviśeṣatve'pi parasyo- pakārakam, tatra paropajīvyatvaṃ prayojakaḥ |
yatra tu svavidheḥ prayojakatvaśaktisaptañcāveda'pi parārthopajīvanam, tatra prasaṅgaḥ ityarthaḥ |
evaṃ ca 'parārthe tvaprayojakaḥ' ityatra svavidheḥ prayojakatvaśaktyā'nye ityarthā labhyate iti bodhyam |
sa yeṣāṃ pradhānānāṃ tāni tantrīṇi pradhānāni |
( yat tantrena kriyate, yasya vā tantraṃ tat varṇakrameṇocyate |
tantraṃ na iti tu tataḥ paraṃ niveśyate ) |
bhā. 1|13| 1|26. tantraṃ aṅgāni paurṇamāsyāṃ trayāṇāṃ pradhānānāṃ ekakālasaṃyogāt |
tantraṃ abhivardhanamantraḥ : 'undvīrojo dhatte' iti jyotiṣṭome saṃtānenāmivarṣanasthale |
bhā. 1|14|1 50, tantraṃ amedhyapratimantramantraḥ : ('avacche cakṣuḥ iti ) jyotiṣṭome ekadā anekamedhyadarśane |
1|14| 1750, tantraṃ avaghātamantrasya 'ava rakṣo divaḥ sapatnaṃ vadhayāsam' iti darśapūrṇamāsayoḥḥ mūsalaprahārane- tve'pi |
1|14|12|42, tantraṃ ādhārādīnāmajñānāṃ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ, na pratipradhānaṃ medaḥ |
5|2|6|12-15, tantraṃ kaṇḍūyanamantraḥ : ('kṛṣiṣu syāmakṛṣe' iti ) yugapad anekakṛṇḍūyane'pi |
sati saṃbhave ta eva kartāra iti vārtikam |
bhā. 1|12|10|44-48, tantraṃ kummīśūlavapāśrapaṇīnāṃ aikādaśineṣu vibhinnadevatākeṣvapi paśuṣu sajātīyeṣu |
bhāṣyam— vājapeye prājāpatye paśuṣu kumbhāḥ śūlasya vapāśrapaṇyāśca tantrabhāvaḥ syāt, vibhutvāt |
vibhavatyekā kummī sarvapaśūnāmannadānānāṃ śrapaṇe, śūlaṃ hṛdayānām, vapāśrapaṇī vapānām |
soma— pākautkarṣasiddheḥ dṛṣṭārthasya kummāderna- tantratā ityucyateḥ saṃgatiḥ |
na caikadevatve'pi avadānādeḥ kramānuṣṭhānasya asaṃskārāpekṣitvānnā kāryaṃ tantratvamiti vācyam |
' bhāṭṭa— ekadevatveṣu ekaśātīyeṣu ca prājāpatyādi- paśuṣu prayogavidhivyavagataśrapaṇādiyaugapadyatarodhena kummī- śūlavapāśrapaṇīnāṃ mahatparimāṇānaṅgīkāreṇa tantrameva śrapaṇādi |
nahi teṣāṃ prakṛtau kaścit parimāṇaviśeṣa upāttaḥ; yena tacchiṣyā kummādimedo'ṅgīkriyeta |
teṣāṃ svargaḥ phalaṃ śrūyate 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' iti |
sa kiṃ teṣāṃ tantreṇa bhavati, uta medeneti |
nanu ca naivātra svargaḥ phalaṃ śrūyate |
svargakāmapadena tāvat puruṣo'midhīyate, yajetetya- nenāpi yāgānivṛttiḥ, tayorvākyena saṃbandhaḥ |
na khalu kaścit puruṣaḥ svargakāmo nāma asti |
nanu ca yasya svargaṃ kāmaḥ, sa svargakāma iti |
etadeva na jānīmaḥ, kasya svargaṃ kāma iti |
ya eva hi svargakāmaḥ sa eva asargakāmo bhavatīti |
atrāpi na kaścit kālaviśeṣo'sti, yasmin niyamena svargakāmaḥ syāt |
sarveṣu kāleṣu sarve kāmā aniyamena utpadyante |
evaṃ tarhi naivāyaṃ puruṣopadeśaḥ, nāpi kālopa- deśaḥ |
tāni yadi nimitte vidhīyante, nityatvameṣāṃ vihanyeta |
liṅgāni ca, 'apa vā eṣa svargallokāccavyate yo darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ san paurṇamāsī- mamāvāsyāṃ vā'tipātayet' ityevamādīni |
svargakāmo yajeteti, yadi vā svargakāmo yāgāya upadiśyate, yathā lohitoṣṇīṣāḥ pracaranti |
yadi vā yāgaḥ svargakāmāya yathā malinaḥ snāyāt, bubhukṣito'śnīyāditi |
tatra yadi svargakāmaḥ karmaṇe upadiśyate, upadiṣṭo'pi na pravartate |
atha yāgaḥ svargakāmārthaḥ, tato'sau puruṣasyo- pakaroti, taṃ puruṣaḥ svārthena karotīti |
apica yāgavigho śryarthaḥ parigṛhīto bhaviṣyati, svargakāmavigho vākyārthaḥ |
sa yadi putrā- grādyādīnāmantama karoti, tataḥ svargakāmaśabdaḥ avivakṣitārthaḥ puruṣamātravacano bhavati |
anantareṇāpi hi tadbhavacanaṃ puruṣamātraṃ ākhyātādeva gamyate |
kiṃ tantraṃ eṣāṃ phalam, uta medeneti |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? imāni āgneyādīni pradhānāni parasparasāpekṣābhiḥ codanābhiḥ pṛthagbhūtāni utpannāni pṛthageva phalamākāṅkṣanti |
tasaṃnidhau svargadi phalaṃ śrayamāṇaṃ medena ākāṅkṣita- tvāt medenaiva saṃbadhyate |
prayojanābhi- saṃbandhāt pṛthak satāṃ tataḥ syādekakarmatvadāmi- saṃyogāt |
pṛthagbhūtānāmapi eteṣāṃ āgneyādīnāṃ tataḥ syāt aikakarmyam |
tat prati eteṣāṃ sametānāṃ saṃbandhāt saṃyogāt ityarthaḥ |
aikakarmyaṃ iti, karmaśabdena atra phalamucyate kriyate iti |
tat yeṣāmekaṃ karmāṇi, teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ aikakarmyam, ekaphalamityarthaḥ |
kathaṃ punarjñāyate sametānāmāgneyādīnāṃ phalena yogaḥ iti, ekaśabdasaṃyogāt |
ya eṣāṃ sametānāṃ ekaḥ śabdo vācakaḥ, tena etāni abhidhāya phalasaṃbandhaḥ kṛtaḥ 'darśa- pūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmaḥ' iti |
ataḥ samuditebhyaḥ phalaṃ gamyate, na medena |
yathā 'grāmeṇa taḍāgaḥ kṣeyaḥ' 'grāmeṇa taḍāgaḥ kṣeyaḥ' iti āmaśabdena samudāyavacanena saṃyujya kupo vidhīyamānaḥ : samuditaiḥ puruṣaiḥ ekaḥ khanyate, na pratipuruṣaṃ kūpabhedaḥ, evamihāpi |
tatra abhyuccayo nāma na kiñcit vastusvarūpaṃ ( śāstrameyama ) vidhyate |
kintu upahomaḥ : anugrājā na bādhante iti bādhyābhāvamātra abhyuccayaḥ ityucyate |
codakaprāptānāṃ pratyakṣavihitānāṃ ca padārthānāṃ iyattā cintitā |
iha tu ( idānīm ) ekādaśe iyattāviśeṣa- śrūyate |
yatra trayo yāgāḥ ( pradhānabhūtāḥ ) śrūyante, tatra seyamittā kiṃ tantreṇa ( bhavati ), uta āghṛtyā iti |
nanu daśamānantaraṃ ajñānāṃ tantrāvāpacintā yuktā, teṣāṃ eva daśame ) iyattā'vadhāraṇāt |
prathame adhikaraṇe phalaṃ cintyate, tacca iyattā na bhavati |
( tatāhi, ) kiṃ ekaikasya phalaṃ uta sahatānām, iti kīdṛśaḥ daśama- saṃbandhaḥ ( syāt ) |
yadi samuditānāmekaṃ phalam, tataḥ tantrāvāpacintā ghaṭate |
atha ekaikasya phalam, tataḥ tantraṃ nāsyeva ( phalavantaratvat meda eva syāt ) tasmāt ( upodghāta rūpaṃ ) prathamādhikaraṇamārabhyate tantrāvāpasiddhaye |
dvitīyādīnyapi ( tat-) praṣaṅgeṇa ( ārabhyante ) kiṃ sahatāni ajñāni eka ṛtūpakāraṃ kurvanti, uta nirapekṣāṇi iti |

( bhāṣyakāreṇa sautraṃ vicāramupamṛnya coditaṃ nanu naivātra svargaḥ phalaṃ śrūyate iti, tasyārthamāha-) 'yajeta' ityanena ākṣitaḥ kartā, sa viśeṣyate svargakāmaśabdena ( puruṣavacanena ), yathā 'rājā rājasūyena yajeta' iti ( rājā iti viśeṣa- ṇam ) |
viśeṣaṇaṃ ca ( kāma : rājatvavat ) karmāṅgaṃ bhavati iti |

( uttarabhāṣyasyārthamāha-) evaṃ evaṃ ca ( kartṛ- viśeṣaṇatve abhyupagamyamāne ) yadi svarga ( eva kaścit ) nityaṃ kāmyate, nānyāni brahmavarcasādīni, tathā sati asādhāraṇatvāt viśeṣaṇamavakalpate ( svargameva yaḥ kāma- yate iti ) |
yadi vā ( kaścit ) svargaṃ na kadācit kāmyate, tathāpi taṃ ( asargakāmaṃ ) apekṣya viśeṣaṇaṃ ghaṭate svargakāma eva yaḥ iti |
kiṃtu īdṛśo'pi nāsti, yo na kadācit svargaṃ kāmayate |
atocyate, ( sa eva ) yasyāṃ velāyāṃ svargakāmaḥ : ( svargameva kāmayate ) tasyāṃ velāyāṃ darśapūrṇa- māsādīni kariṣyati ( tena kāladvāreṇa viśeṣaṇatvaṃ yujyate ) |
yāvat ( puruṣaḥ ) śāstraṃ pradhānaṃ nirvartayati, tāvat aneka kāmā utpadyante ( dīrghakāle ) |
yadi ca śuddhameva svargaṃ kāmayeta, tatha ( sati bhavante ) yathāśruto darśapūrṇamāsau kṛtau syātām netarathā |
na ca īdṛśaḥ kaścit vidyate ( yo yāvajjīvaṃ svargameva kāmayate ) |
( bhāṣyakāreṇa 'phalakāmo nimittaṃ bhavatu ityāhaṅka- nityānityasaṃyogavirodhatvāt parihāro'mihitaḥ, tamādhi pati-) yo'yaṃ nityānityavirodhaḥ : uktaḥ, na nopapadyate |

katham ? yasyāpi ( mate ) svargakāmaśabdena phalamabhidhīyate, tasyāpi nityānityavirodho bhavatyeva ( tathāhi, ) darśapūrṇamāsau yāvajjīvaṃ kartavyo jñātau punaḥ : kāmena kartavyau iti ( virodhāt ) na kaścit nimittena ( phalasya ) viśeṣo'sti |
( katham ? ) āgneyāda- utyāhaḥ, teṣāmupattivacane na nityatvamavagamyate, : kāmyatvam |

te tu ( svarūpamātreṇa ) viparītamānā ekena vākyena yāvajjīvaṃ prati vidhīyante, apareṇa svarga- na ca yāvajjīva-svargakāmacodanayoḥ parasparasāpekṣā vidyate yena ye eva yāvajjīvike ( prayoge ) kartavyaḥ : te eva kāmye'pi kartavyaḥ iti ( avagamāt virodhaḥ syāt ) tasmāt kāmyanityābhyām ( anyonyamapekṣāmāṇābhyām ) utpattiḥ apekṣitānyā ( ityavirodhaḥ ) |
tasasyantena nimittamucyate yathā 'minne juhoti' iti, yadyuttena vā 'yajñobhayam' iti |
na cāyaṃ tasasyantaḥ, na ca yadyuttena yuktaḥ |
tasmāt ( nimittanāmiyāt ) anena svargaṃ kāmaya mānaḥ puruṣaḥ abhidhīyate |
sa ca puruṣa kiṃ sādhyatvena svargaṃ kāmayate, uta sādhanatvena iti dviprakārā'pi kāmanā asti |
yadi ayaṃ sādhanatvena svargamicchati, tathā sati ( pūrvoktena nyāyena viśeṣaṇa paratave sthite svargakāmādhikārapuruṣapakṣanyāyāt ) prīti viśiṣṭena yāgaḥ sādhanīyaḥ : ( bhavati ) tadā ca
yo hi ayaṃ svargakāmaśabdaḥ, sa sādhanavacanaḥ|
(na phalavacanaḥ iti-) anenāpi prakāreṇa anārabdhamadhyadhikaraṇam (phalābhāvena tantrāvāpacintā'nupapatteḥ)|
kiṃ kāraṇam? sarve hyevaṃ kāmayante, svargo me syāditi! sādhye ca mukhyā kāmanā, sādhane tu nāntarīyakī, sādhanena vinā sādhyāsaṃbhavāt|
tasmāt sādhane yā kāmanā, sā gauṇī|
sa cākṣitaḥ kimarthaṃ prathamaṃ pūrayati? yadi ca kiṃmayo yāgena pūryeta, tadā coditamapi yāgaṃ na kaścit kuryāt|
tasmāt svarge sādhanatvaṃ kāmyate, tena lakṣaṇa-yopāyaḥ ākṣitaḥ|
atra (bhāṣya-) granthaḥ ya eṣāṃ samuditānāṃ ekaḥ śabdo vācakaḥ, tena etāni abhidhāya phalasaṃbandhaḥ kṛtaḥ|
ḍāśe ca guṇena kālena ca vikāraḥ |
tantramadhye vidhānāt pāśukasya tantra madhye puroḍāśasya |
paśoḥ puroḍāśasya ca prakṛtitvaṃ kriyante aṅgāni |
sakaletikartavyatā śrāddhaṃ paradine tu pitṛyajñaḥ, kāla- |
pāśukaṃ tantraṃ puroḍāśe prasajyate iti siddhāntaḥ |
ṛtvija upavasanti' iti vacanāt kvacit ṛtvijā- |
ajñāni kiṃ paśoḥ pṛthak kartavyāni, uta paśoraṅgānyeva |
tmakānaśanarūpaṃ tapaḥ phalasiddhi, tasya bhāvaḥ phalasiddhitvaṃ |
jyotiṣṭome uktaṃ anaśanarūpaṃ tapaḥ samākhyānāt tasmādyājamānaṃ tapa iti |
ādhvaryavaṃ iti yat pūrvapakṣiṇā uktaṃ tannirāsārthaṃ tṛtīyā- vā— tapaso duḥkhatvāt kartā guṇabhūtaḥ dhikaraṇasya idamitamaṃ sūtram |
akharvoḥ parikrītatvena samākhyānyā niyamyate ityāśaṅkāṃ nivartayati |
yasmāt ida- guṇatvāt tapasaḥ phalasādhanatvena pradhānabhūtayajamānagāmi- mapi saṃskāravat phalapratigrahaṇayogyatvaṃ karoti |
yajamānasya tvāt vedena ādhvaryavena ādhvaryavasamākhyāyā vyavasthā ca yogyatvaṃ apratibaddhaṃ kartavyaṃ na ṛtvijaḥ; tasmāt yāja- na syāt |
yogyatā ca sarvatraiva dviprākārā, doṣāpanayena ( idaṃ sūtraṃ adhikaraṇāntaraparamapi ) |
yo hi jyoti- jyotiṣṭome 'iha nāśnāti ' ityādi tapaḥ kāyaśoṣaṇaṃ ṣṭomādi karoti, tasya ekānte asmin anyasmin vā karma ādhvaryavaṃ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ, yājamānaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
tapasaḥ prativandhanivṛttirūpaphalārthatve saṃbhavati nāpūrva- te ca anapanītāḥ ṛtuviparītaphalabhogadānāt rūpādṛṣṭasaṃskārārthaṃ kalpanīyamiti |
tatra prakaraṇaśrutasya duḥkhalanāt adharmasya kāryavirodhinaḥ tapasā apanayanam |
tapasaḥ avaśyaṃ kratuṃ prati kathaṃcit upakārakatvaṃ kalpa- vā. 3|8|13 |
tapaḥ saṃskāravat yajamānasya phala- meva jyāyaḥ |
śakyaṃ hi duḥkhalanāt adharmasya kārya- pratigrahaṇayogyatvaṃ karoti |
upavāsa rūpaṃ duḥkhena alpenāpi mahate duḥkhāntarasya pravṛttaḥ san tapo yājamānaṃ narvijām |
adharmaḥ vināśayate iti vacanāt gamyate, tathaivātra draṣṭa- tapaśva phalasiddhistvāllokavat |
yāni tu akarmajñbhūtatvena tapāṃsi śrūyante phala- bhāṣyam— tapaḥ śrūyate - 'iha nāśnāti, vyahaṃ saṃbandhāni vā, teṣāṃ phalasādhanasya aparasa abhāvatvāt nāśnāti ' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimarthivaṃ tapaḥ, pratibandhanirākaraṇapekṣā nāsti, iti svargādyeva kalpyate |
kiṃ prāptam ? samākhyānāt ārtvijaṃ yāni tu prāyaścittapāṇi, teṣāṃ doṣāpahāramātreṇa phalam, tapaḥ iti prāptam |
evaṃ prāpte, brūmaḥ : yājamānaṃ tapaḥ iti na sarvatra ekarūpatvaṃ adhyavasātavyam |
adharmo yāga- bhāṣyam— etameva artha vākyaśeṣo'pi dyotayati phalasya pratibandhako bhavati |
tasmin ' yadā vai puruṣe na kiṃcana antarbhavati, yadā asya sati na śreyo bhavitumarhati |
kṛṣṇaṃ cakṣuṣo naśyati, atha medhyatamaḥ ' iti |
tasmāt duḥkhaphala- anaśanaḥ, tadā medhāīḥ ' iti |
tyāgaṃ kartumarhaḥ tapasā kriyate, iti vākyaśeṣo taditi evaṃ dṛṣṭārthaṃ bhavati, nādṛṣṭaṃ kalpayitavyam |
tasmāt yājamānaṃ tapaḥ phalabhogena kṣīṇe adharme apratibaddho yāgaḥ phalaṃ iti |
svajanakībhūtapāpanāśakāṃvasyāpi klaptatayā kevalaṃ tatpāpasya bhāṣyam— kiṃ eṣa etatsargaḥ sarve tapo yājamāna- somaphalapratibandhakatvābhāvamātrakalpanāyā aśanābhāvasya yajña- miti |
yatra vacanam, tatra ṛtvijāṃ mānaniṣṭhāphalapratibandhakatvābhāvasaṃpādakatvameva ' yadā anaśana- yathā ' sarve ṛtvijaḥ upavasanti ' iti |
vā— varadānavat etat dravyam ' ṛtvijaḥ upa- ataśca tasya liṅgādeva yajamānamāṣṭhinvam |

dupakārakatvapakṣe aśanasya kratuvaiguṇyajanakatvam, tasya vi. 8|2|4, tate payasi dadhyānayati sā ca phalapratibandhakatvaṃ ityādi kalpanāpekṣayā lāghavena vaiśvadevyāmiṣa vājinam ' ityatra dravyadevatā- aśānābhāvasya duḥjanakatvā klaptatvāt, taduḥlasya ca lakṣaṇapadedāt karmabhedaḥ : cāturmāsyavaiśvadevaparvaṇi |
palāśadyamaleṃ upalabdhamānaṃ mahat tamo na nirguṇam |
kṛṣṇarūpasya gandhādya- saptabhiḥ sahitamayāṃ hastābhyāṃ udbhula saptapadāni kāryamavādhinaḥ |
dāhasphoṭābhāve śuddhiḥ anyathā bandhaḥ ca nikhilaguṇavirahiṇo na dravyatvam |
tadidaṃ tatparaśugrahaṇaṃ bhāve'pi anāśrayasya na saṃbhavati |
na ca pṛthivyādi- chāndogyopaniṣadi ṣaṣṭhādhyāye ṣoḍaśe khaṇḍe paṭhitam |
ke. dravyasyāśrayaḥ, tadāśrayatve tadguṇānāṃ tatsahacarītānāṃ tatrāṣṭatilanyāyaḥ |
mano'pi ca tathāhi 'sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vā'pi tāṃ vā ṣoḍaśāṅgulam |
pūrayet ghṛtatailābhyāṃ viṃśatyā tu palaistu tat |
tasmānna tamo nāma kiñcidasti suvarṇamāṣakaṃ tasmin sattute nikṣipet tat |
atha ca tamastmālanīlamupa- ṅguliyogena uddharet tamāṣakama |
karāgraṃ yo na dhunayād lamāmahe ityabhimāno laukikānāṃ ālokadarśane |
na cā- tamaḥ dravyaṃ iti mīmāṃsakāḥ |
na ca tadabhāve pramīyamāṇamapyahyamarhati, ati- mānenātyantamuṭṭhīḥ |
sa tu nūnaṃ tamaḥ paśyedīpenottama- prasaṅgāt |
na ca tamasi pramāṇānupalambheḥ pramā prathamā tejasā ||
ayamupamarporupamardakabhāve asyopalambhiriti cet ? na, ihāpi samānatvāt |
na kila andhakāro nāma tattvato'sti, samastasañjñākāratvāspade pramitikāryadarśanāt pramāṇā- tatapatyo vā |
ntaramanupalabhyapūrvamapi, na punastatra anyato'nupalambhāt taiva viśvasya saṃgrahaḥ |
tatra dravyatve tamaḥ pṛthivyādīnā- spaṣṭadṛṣṭakāryaviparyayo yujyate |
astu vā cakṣurevāsya manyatamamamadya vā ? na tāvadanyatamam |
na ca nimīlitākṣasya paṭalavato vā tadāsti, tamasu caturdaśaguṇe, tejasi ca ekādaśaguṇe, mātari- api tu pihitam |
kathaṃ tarhi pihitaṃ ghaṭādāviva bāhye śvani ca navaguṇe, manasi ca aṣṭaguṇe, nabhasi ca tamasi pravartata iti cet ? mā pravartitam |
kiṃ nicchinnam ? ṣaḍguṇe dikkālayośca pañcaguṇayoravināśinoḥ ananta- paricchetyati hi tacchāyā pakṣamaṇoḥ paṭalasya vā ayāsannā- bhāvāt |
mapi pidhāṇuṇī paṭalakṣmaṇī paṭalacchidya tāmavekṣate cakṣuḥ,
tacca rūpaviśeṣe sati anekadravyatvā- prabhavati, na tu tacchāyāyāṃ tadvirodhinyāṃ kevalasyaiva tatra mahattvāccākṣuṣamiti na tadapyanyavaktavyati |

kāryadarśanonneyatvāt sūkṣmamapi cedhīka- divāmbhasaṃbhavaḥ śāśvatikavirodhe sati tejasi, na jātu tvādi cakṣurācchādakatvāt anubhavamānamatimahat sparśavedravanmudrādidhāte paripaninī kumbhārambha- anavadhi cakāsti tathaivamapi |
tadbhāve eva hi divā'pi nirastatejasi giriguhāyāmāramante eva vā varamupalambhakāntarakalpanā ityuktam |
na tāmasāḥ paramāṇo'vayavinamāramante dīnāṃ tamaḥ ? nanu dravyameva, kālimaguṇāśālitvāt sparśavirahādāmanano'vayavamavat |
prayojakam, arūpāṇāmapi pavanaparamāṇūnāṃ sparśavaddravyā- asejoriva svetimā |
evaṃ saṃkhyā api 'ekatvādikā rambhadarśanāt asparśānāṃ ca ātmamanasāṃ tadabhāvāt parimāṇam, tat caturvidham |
pṛthivyādyaṇunāmiva tat kimata bhavataḥ tamaḥparamāṇavaḥ santi na vā ? sani tamo'ṇunāmapyanumānāt |
pṛthaktvasaṃyogavibhāgaparatvā- cet kathaṃ tadavayavināmābhāvaḥ ? tadvāvalakṣaṇatvāt paramāṇu paratvasaṃskārāśca pañcavidhamapi karma adhyakṣamīkṣate yathāha bhāvasya |
asattve vā tamaḥparamāṇūnāṃ kathaṃ na hetorāśraya- atramabhagavān vārtikakāraḥ |
tucchasya ahetutvāt kalpanā''ropita chāyāyāḥ kāṣṇryamityevaṃ purāṇe bhṛguṇaśruteḥ ||
na jātu samāropita bhṛguṇasya kāṣṇryasya chāyāyāntyataraśruteḥ ityarthaḥ |
dehānuvartinī paramāṇu asatsu āśrayāsiddhatayā bhavatisiddhiḥ, na chāyā na vastutvādinā bhavet ||
na ca svataḥ aprasiddhasya satyamapi paraprasiddhau sādhanālatvam pṛthivyādīnāmantyatamam |
na tāvat kṛṣṇarūpasya tamaḥ svayamapratītasya parapratyāyanārhatvāt |
toyatejasoḥ sitatvāt, evaṃ pavanā- tāvatparā'siddhaḥ svayaṃ siddho tu kā kriyā ||

bhā. 6|1|2|4-5, tiryagbhyaḥ āsannaṃ phalaṃ cetayante na kālāntaraphalaṃ prārthayante |
bhāṭa. tiraścāṃ śrutādyarthaḥ kadācidapi nāsti śabdavyutpattinibandhana- tvāt tasyāḥ |
adhikāro nāsti tiraścāṃ devānāmanuṣyaṇāṃ vanaspatīnāṃ ca karmasu |
bhāṣyam-- idamāmamananti ‘darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svarga- kāmo yajeta’ ‘jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta’ ityeva- mādi |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ yāvat kiṃcit sattvaṃ tat sarva- madhikṛtya etaducyate, uta samarthamadhikṛtyeta |
nanu vṛkṣādayo na kiṃcit kāmayante kathaṃ teṣāmadhikāraḥ syāt |
evaṃ hi dṛśyate dharmopatasāḥ chāyāmupasarpanti, śītena pīḍitā ātapam |
āha, nanu tiryagjñaḥ āsannaṃ phalaṃ cetayante, na kālāntaraphalaṃ prārtha- yante |
liṅgāni ca vede bhavanti ‘devā vai satramāsata’ ityevādīni devatānāṃ ṛṣīṇāṃ vanaspatīnāṃ adhikāraṃ darśayanti |
nanu kātsyena vidhi- mupasaṃhartuṃ na śaknuvanti ityanadhikṛtāḥ |
tatra yaḥ anupadaviṣṇu- kramādikaḥ sa kevalaṃ yāgaṃ kariṣyati, kastasya doṣaḥ |
dravyaparigrahe'pi devagrāmaḥ, hastigrāmaḥ, ṛṣabhagrāmaḥ ityupacārāt astyeveti |
na caita- dasti tiryagādīnāmapi adhikāra iti |
kasya tarhi ? yaḥ samarthaḥ kutsnaṃ karma abhinivartayitum |
na caite śaknuvanti tiryagādayaḥ kutsnaṃ karmabhinivartayitum |
tassāt eṣāṃ na sukhasādhyapāyāḥ karma iti |
kathaṃ yo na śakyate kartum, saḥ abhyupāyaḥ syāditi |
na bhṛgvādayo bhṛgvā- dibhiḥ sagotrā bhavanti |
na devānāṃ devatāntarābhāvāt iti, yeṣāṃ śabda eva devatā teṣā- mapi ayukto granthaḥ |
( śakyate hi indreṇāpi indra- śabdoccāraṇena haviṣyakam |
bhāṣyam-- apica tiryagjño na kālāntaraphalenārthinaḥ ( janmāntarīyaphalena ityarthaḥ ) āsannaṃ hi te kāmayante |
nanu ca uktaṃ kālāntaraphalārthinaḥ tiraścaḥ paśyāmaḥ śunaḥ śyenān caturdaśyāmupavasataḥ copavasataḥ iti |
ye vedamadhīyate te etadviduḥ idaṃ karmaṃ kṛtvā idaṃ phalamamutra prāpnotīti |
kathaṃ punarvidyate kāle rogo bhavataḥ ? ucyate |
niyatakāla api rogā bhavanti yathā tṛtīyakāśātturyakāśceti |
nahi ete dravyaṃ svecchayā upayuñjānā dṛśyante |
yattu devagrāmo hastigrāma iti, upacāramātraṃ tat |
yāni punaḥ liṅgāni ‘devā vai satramāsata’ ityevādīni, artha- vādāste vidhiprarocanāthāḥ |
na ca vidheḥ vidhinā ekavākyabhāvo bhavati vacana- vyaktibhedāt |
itthaṃ nāma satramāsitvānyāni, yat kṛtakṛtyā api āsate devāḥ, āsaccetanā api tiryagjñaḥ, acetanā api vanaspatayaḥ |
guṇā yāgaṃ prati upadiśyante, na kartāraṃ prati |
tena yāgamātre kriyamāṇe vaiguṇyaṃ iti na phalasaṃbandhaḥ syāt |
kathaṃ punaḥ yāgaṃ prati upadiśyate iti cet, itikartavyatākāṅkṣasya yāgavacanasya antikān upanipātitāḥ |
itarathā hi kartuṃ adhikurvastu guṇavacaneṣu anivṛttā- kāṅkṣaṃ phalavacanaṃ anarthakameva syāt |
atha etadeva vākyaṃ samarthānāṃ saguṇaṃ karma vidhāsyati
sahasrasaṃvatsaraṃ karma na niyogato divaseṣu kalpayitavyaṃ iti pūrvapakṣe tadāyuṣāṃ devatādīnāṃ saṃbhavāt iti, siddhānte tadasaṃbhavāt iti divaseṣveva kalpayitavyaṃ iti |
kratuṃ prati vidhisteṣāṃ tādṛśaṃ taṃ ca śaknuvan |

vi-- 'anyāderasyau no vā, svargecchutvāt sa vidyate |
bhāṭṭa-- siddhe adhikāre sa kepāmiti cintyate |
na ca tiraścāṃ svargādikāmānāṃ saṃbhavaḥ; parakīyecchāyāḥ apratyakṣatvena tadabhāvāniścayānupapatteḥ |
na ca sāṅkarasāsāmarthyāt anadhikāraḥ; śakyamātrasyaiva karaṇāpatteḥ |
iti prāpte, bhāvanāyā aṃśatrayānvayottaraṃ paścāt - vidhivalena adhikārikalpanāt pūrvavattātadvyapadhānānuṣṭhānasamarthatvāt na tiraścāmadhikāraḥ |
ṛṣyādīnāṃ tu anāditvāt saṃsārasya pravara- varaṇādau ṛṣyantarasyāpi saṃbhavāt adhikāro'styeveti bhāṣyoktaṃ anadhikārapratipādanaṃ anādaraṇīyam |
tiryagādhikaraṇe gandharvādīnāṃ adhikāro nirākṛto'pi sahasrasaṃvatsare satre śrutibalāt svīkāryaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
ekādaśe sarveṣā- majñānāṃ sāhityena kratupakārajanakatvasya sthāpayiṣyamāṇatvāt tiryagādhikaraṇe yathāviniyogaṃ adhikārakalpanāsya sthitatvāt bhāṭṭa. 6|1|1 |
sūtrakārasya devatāvigrahā- dikamabhimataṃ vārtikābhimataṃ ceti ṣaṣṭhe tiryagādhikaraṇe prapañcayiṣyate |
tiryagādipratītiṣu śabdaśrutyāsu indriyasya arthe eva sāmarthyamavagatam |
'tiraścīno vitato raśmireṣāmamaghaḥ svidāsatītyupari svidāsatītyu' ṛśaṃsaṃ. 10|129|5 pūrvārdhaḥ |
iti eṣāṃ kavayo manīṣā iti pūrvasyāmṛci nirdiṣṭāṃ kavīnāṃ raśmiḥ tiraścīno vitataḥ |
kiṃ adhaḥ āsīt, uta upari iti svicchabdayogāt plutyā ca saṃśayaḥ |
yathā tilataṇḍulamānayetyukte asaṃspṛṣṭā tilāni taṇḍulāni cānītāni bhavanti, tathā saṃsṛṣṭānyapi tilataṇḍulāni vā ānītāni, tathā prakṛte'pi |
'tisra eva sāhāyyopasadaḥ dvādaśāhīnasya' iti vākye tritvameva sarvadoṣarahitatvāt vidhīyate, dvādaśatvaṃ tu ahīnasaṃnidhatvāccāvagatameva prāptaṃ aucityarupeṇa asya stutyarthe nītvādidavat anuyate |
tisṛṣu pratyekaṃ gīyamānaṃ sāma samāsleva geyam |
'tīrthe snāti' iti tīrthaviśeṣaṇaṃ sukhāvatara- tvāt duḥkhāvatarāhradā nivartayati |
san tīrthaviśeṣaṃ dharmasādhanaṃ kadācit brūte 'tīrthayātrāṃ gataḥ' iti |
tīrthaśabdo'pi tīrthyamātrameva brūte 'tīrthayātrāṃ gataḥ' iti tu uktvā kānicittīrthāni anukrāntāni, yato'sau taddeśiśārtho vijñāyate |
yatra tu kevalaḥ prayujyate tatra tīrthyamātrameva brūte |
yathā tīrthe snāti, tīrthameva samānānāṃ bhavati iti |
'tumo ha mujyamaśnonomedhe rayiṃ na kaścinmamavaḥ avāhāḥ |
he aśvinī tamu nāma kaścit rājā mujyu- nāmānaṃ svaputraṃ umedhe samudre avāhāḥ |
bāhyāmāsa iti tiḍāṃ tiḍo bhavanti iti prathamapuruṣārthamadhyamaḥ |
nakārasya upamārthatvāt yathā kaścit mamuvān āsannamaraṇaḥ |
rayiṃ dhanaṃ samudre vāhayati iti dṛṣṭāntaḥ |
taṃ mujyuṃ ātmantīmiḥ iḍābhiḥ antarikṣapṛṣṭhaiḥ ākāśagāmibhiḥ apodakāmiḥ : nirjalābhiḥ nobhiḥ yuvāṃ ūhathuḥ samudrāt uttarayāmāsathuḥ iti |
tumun pratyayaḥ 'tumunṇvulau kriyāyāṃ kriyārthāyām' iti (pā0 3|3|10) nihitaḥ |
(kriyārthāyāṃ kriyāyāmapade bhaviṣyati arthe dhātoḥ etau (kṛṣṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ yāti, kṛṣṇaṃ darśako yāti ) |
ekasya śikṣyasya unnama- nādyena vyāpāreṇa itaraśikṣyasya adhonayanamapi bhavati |
'athavā' ityādinā (vārtike) 'vicinā tvekavākyatvāt' ityetadeva sūtraṃ pramādapāṭha- tvāśaṅkānirākaraṇe'pi yojimata |
vidhyaikavākyatvena tulyatvayā arthavattvāvagamāt pramādapāṭhatvanirākaraṇe eva hetvantarasamuccayārthaḥ tulyaṃ ca iti caśabdaḥ |
agniṣṭome trayaḥ paśavaḥ āgnīṣomīyaḥ savanīyaḥ anubandhyaśceti |
tatra sutyādināt avyavahite prācīne aupavasathye dine āgnīṣomīyaḥ paśurlabhyate |
tatraiva ca upakāraṇādayaḥ paśudharmā api āmnātāḥ |
tatraiva ca dharmokeḥ prāk 'āgneyaḥ paśurlabhyate' ityā-dinā savanīyāḥ paśavo'pi āmnātāḥ |
tatra upakāraṇādayo ye paśudharmā vihitāḥ, te kiṃ trayāṇāmapi paśūnāmeva vidhīyante, uta āgnīṣomīyasavanīyayordvayoreva, kiṃvā āgnīṣomīyasya ekasyaiveti itarayostu codakenaiva syuḥ iti |
tatra prakṛtena prathamasūtreṇa āyaḥ pakṣaḥ upa- nyastaḥ |
prakaraṇāviśeṣāt iti hetorādyasya ca dvitīyo'pi pakṣa upanyasta iti kecit |
yathāśrutabhāṣyeṇa tu sūtreṇa prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ, utsūtraṃ dvitīyaḥ pakṣa upanyasta iti spaṣṭam |
vārtikakāreṇa tu utsūtraṃ prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ, sūtreṇa tu dvitīyaḥ pakṣa iti pratipāditam |
athavā vidhiśabdena paravarthe vidhīyate iti upakaraṇādiḥ paśudharmaṃ bodhyate |
tathā ca paśuvidhiḥ upakaraṇādiḥ paśudharmaḥ sarveṣāṃ ayāṇāmapi paśūnāṃ tulyaḥ syāt |
tasmāt paśudharmātho dharmevidhiḥ iti prathamaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ |
upakaraṇadayaḥ paśudharmāmeva paśūnāmaye syuḥ iti prathamaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ pūrvasūtreṇoktaḥ |
tatra viśeṣamuktvā dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ anena sūtreṇocyate |
prakaraṇāt sthānācca anuṣṭhānatvādeyācca paśudharmāḥ pūrvasya prathamasya agnī- ṣomīyasya bhaveyuḥ |
anunyasya agnīṣomaprakaraṇasthe- 'pi sthānābhāvāt na tasya paśudharmā vidhīyante iti spaṣṭam |
yadyapi savanīyasya samānadeśatvaṃ kathaṃcit saṃbhavati tathāpi nānuṣṭhānasādeśyaṃ iti na tasyāpi te dharmāḥ, kiṃtu agnīṣomīyasyaiveti |
upakaraṇadayaḥ paśudharmāḥ agnīṣomīyasyaiva na tu savanīyasyeti vaktuṃ śakyam |

ekeṣāṃ keṣāṃcit śākhināṃ śraye thaḥ aupavasathyāt agnīṣomīya- paśudināt uttaredine vidhīyate 'āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvā tridhṛtā (triguṇyā raśanayā) yūpaṃ parivīya (veṣṭayitvā) āgneyaṃ savanīyaṃ paśumupākaroti' iti vacanena |
nanu tarhi aupavasathye'hani savanīyapaśvāmnāyaśrutiḥ kimarthā ? ucyate |
tatra savanīyapaśoḥ śrovidhāne sati punaḥśrutiḥ, savanīyasya prākṛtaśrutiḥ, aupavasathye'hani śrutiḥ, guṇārthā |
nindādvārā 'vapayā prātaḥsavane caranti puro- ḍāśena mādhyaṃdine aṅgaistṛtīyasavane' ityanena ekavākyatāṃ gatvā vapāpracārarūpaguṇasya vidhānārthā bhavati |
nindā- śrutiśca savanīyaṃ paśuṃ saṃkīrtya 'yathā vai māsyo'- vidito janamavadhuṇute, evamete'prajñāyamānā janamavadhuṇute' iti paṭhitā |

yathā vai kila jalasya sthale matsyaḥ vicaran janaiḥ anavadhāritagatiḥ prekṣakajanamavadhuṇute ' kimiti gataḥ kivā tataḥ' iti saṃdehaṃ kṣipati, tathā 'ete paśavaḥ ka kriyantām, ebhiḥ kathaṃ savanāni paśumanti bhavanti' iti nirṇayābhāvena saṃśayamutpādayantī iti nindāśrutyarthaḥ |
eṣā nindāśrutiḥ aupavasathye'hani śrutā'pi tataḥ utkṛṣṭā satī 'vapayā prātaḥsavane caranti' iti śrutyā ekavākyatāṃ gatvā vapāpracārarūpaguṇavidhāne śeṣabhūtā bhavati |
tena jñāyate paśudharmāḥ agnīṣomīyasyaiva na tu śrovihitasya savanīyasyeti |
ekeṣāṃ śākhināṃ savanīyaḥ paśuḥ śvaḥ vidhīyate |
tatra eva punaḥśrutiḥ guṇārthā vapāpracārarūpaguṇavidhānaśeṣaḥ iti sūtrasya śabdārthaḥ |

agnīṣome aupavasathye- 'hani savanīyapaśūnāṃ āmnāyāt tatraiva ca upakaraṇādīnāṃ paśudharmāṇāmuktatvāt te paśudharmāḥ savanīyasya paśoreva syuḥ, kiṃvā tathaiva paṭhitasya agnīṣomīyasya savanīyasya ceti ubhayoḥ syuḥ |
nanu tarhi 'āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvā tridhṛtā yūpaṃ parivīya āgneyaṃ savanīyaṃ paśumupākaroti' iti vākyaṃ kimarthamiti cet |
tena guṇena vapāpracārarūpeṇa savanīyaḥ paśuḥ dvitīyai sutyādine utkṛṣṭhaḥ utkarṣaṃ prāpitaḥ |
tasya ca vapāpracāreṇa utkṛṣṭhasya paśoḥ kālasya aniyame prāpte 'āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvā' ityā- dinā vākyena kālavidhiḥ kālaviśeṣasya vidhānaṃ kriyate, tena vākyena niyataḥ kālo vidhīyate |
tathā ca kāla- viśeṣavidhānārthe tadvākyam, na vyartha ityarthaḥ |
paraṃtu upakaraṇam, yūpe niyojanam, śamitṛśālāyāṃ nayanam, saṃjñapanam, viśasanam, vapoddharaṇaṃ ityādayaḥ paśudharmāḥ savanīyasyaiva |
vapāpracārasya utkarṣe'pi vapāyāḥ ekadeśatvāt vapāpracārādīnāṃ uttareṣāmajñānāṃ utkarṣaḥ syāt, tathāpi vapāpracārāt prāktanānāṃ upakaraṇādi- vapoddharaṇānāṃ utkarṣo naiva syāt |
'āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvā' ityādinā vākyena tu upakaraṇādīnāṃ sarveṣāmeva
tasmāt aupa- vasathye ahani āmnātāḥ upakaraṇādayaḥ paśudharmāḥ na savanīyasya bhavitumarhanti, kiṃtu agnīṣomīyasyaiva |
nanu upakaraṇāsya 'āśvinaṃ graham' ityanena sutyādine utkarṣe vihite vapādihitasya sarvasyaiva savanīyapaśoḥ arthena artheva utkarṣaḥ siddho bhavati |
evaṃ ca 'āśvinaṃ graham' iti savanīyasya paśoḥ kālavidhiḥ saṃbhavati |
'muṣṭinā vidhāya vapoddharaṇaṃ āsīta ā vapāhomāt' iti śrūyate |
na ca pūrvaiyuḥ vapoddharaṇaṃ muṣṭinā vidhāya sutyādine prātaḥsavanaparyantaṃ āsīnatvena avasthātuṃ śakyate |
tathā ca upakaraṇādayaḥ sarve dharmāḥ utkarṣeṇa sutyādinesya savanīyapaśoreva syuḥ na pūrvadinasya agnīṣomīyasya paśoḥ |
'muṣṭinā vidhāya vapoddharaṇaṃ, āsīta ā vapāhomāt' iti śrutyā yadi virodho bhavet tadā arthena utkṛṣṭhasya kālavidhiḥ saṃmānyeta, na tu śrutyā vipratiṣedho'sti |

aupavasathye'hani upakaraṇādīni visahanaparyantāni ajñānāṃ kṛtāni syuḥ vapāpracāraśca sutyādine prātaḥsavane kariṣyate tadā, yadyapi pañcapraharaparyantaṃ śamitā vapo- ddharaṇasthānaṃ muṣṭinā vidhāya āsītuṃ na śakyatvāt tataśca 'muṣṭinā vidhāya' ityanayā śrutyā vipratiṣedhaḥ virodhaḥ syāt |
paraṃtu tṛṇamuṣṭinā parṇamuṣṭinā vā vidhāya śamitā śvaḥ vapāpracāraparyantaṃ udāsīnaḥ syāt iti śakyate vaktum, tadā ca na śrutivirodhaḥ |
tathā ca na arthena utkṛṣṭhasya kālavidhiḥ |
tataśca upakaraṇādīni sarveṣveva ajñānāṃ śvaḥ sutyādine eva kartavyāni |
evaṃ ca paśudharmāḥ sarve na savanīyasya paśoḥ, kiṃtu agnīṣomīyasyeti siddhāntī |
sthānāt samānadeśāt upakaraṇādayo dharmāḥ pūrvasya agnīṣomīyasyaiva bhavanti |

agnīṣome aupa- vasathye ahani āmnātāḥ paśudharmāḥ tasminneva ahani āmnātasyāpi savanīyasya paśorna bhavanti kiṃtu agnī- ṣomīyasyaiva ityasminnarthe 'vapayā prātaḥsavane caranti, puroḍāśena mādhyaṃdine savane, aṅgaistṛtīyasavane' iti sutyādine paśupuroḍāśarūpaliṅgaṃ dṛśyate |
sa ca agnīṣomīyeṇa saṃskṛtaṃ śaknoti nāmim |
tasmāt puroḍāśadarśanāt liṅgāt agnīṣomīyasyaiva paśudharmāḥ sava
tulyayo: ekadeśe utkṛṣṭhe (anyatra nīte ) nyūnaṃ aparo'pi ekadeśaḥ utkṛṣṭhate iti nyāyaḥ |
tatra na nyāyaḥ kramate 'tulyayo: ekadeśe' iti |
bhā. 4|4|4|11. tulyānāṃ ca tulyavadakramaṇaṃ bhavati, yathā 'devā ṛṣayo gandharvāste'nyata āsan, asurā rakṣāṃsi piśācāste'nyata āsan' iti |
bhā. 4|4|1|18. atulyānāmapi tulyavadakramaṇaṃ bhavati, yathā 'devā manuṣyā pitaraste'nyata āsan' iti |
4|4|1|18. tulyānāṃ tu yaugapadyaṃ ityadhikaraṇe aṅgānuṣṭhānatantratā vakṣyate |
su. pṛ. 733. tulyeṣu nādhikāraḥ syāt ( 9|1|5|19 ) ityatra nai
ityanena saṃbadhyate, evaṃ sati kriyāyāṃ trisaṃkhyayā vihitā bhavati |
tatra khapadagatasya kiñcit vidhāyakena vihitaṃ bhavati |
itarathā ṛcaḥ saṃkhyāyāśca saṃbandhasya padāntara- gatena śabdena bhāvanā ucyeta, taṃyā arthavipakarṣaḥ syāt |
āha, nanu trisaṃkhyayā ṛkśabdenaiva atra saṃbadhyate |
anyathā asati sāmarthye samāsaḥ eva na syāditi |
na brūmo na saṃbadhyate iti, saṃbadhyate eva, samāsaśca bhavati |
sa tu samāsaśabdaḥ sāmanirvṛttī upadiśyate iti |
tatra triśabdasya ṛkśabdasya ca artho nirvṛttau upadiṣṭo bhavati |
ṛci sāma nirvartayitavyam, evaṃ tāḥ tisra ṛco bhavanti, na nyūnāḥ |
itarasmin pakṣe abhyāsaḥ trisaṃkhyayā saṃbadhyate, tatra sāma kriyate iti lakṣaṇā syāt, abhyāsānirvṛttau sāmanirvṛttiśabdo bhavet |
stotrasādhanatā carcā pratyekaṃ, na tu sahaḥ ||
soma- pūrvādhikaraṇoktaṃ sāmnāṃ ṛgamimañjakatvaṃ upajīvya atra pratyacaṃ parisamāpya geyaṃ iti siddhāntapravṛtteḥ (upajīvyopajīvakabhāvaḥ) saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu- tuce nyāsajya gānaṃ syāt 'sāma kriyate' iti sāmanirvṛtteḥ śrutatvāt, tatraiva tritvānyāt |
yadā tuce kriyate ityanena triśabdaṛkśabdārthayoḥ saṃbandha- vidhāne padapadasaṃbhapavidhānāt vākyaṃ syāt, kriyate iti dhātvarthasāmakaraṇe tritvavidhāne tu śrutyanugrahaḥ iti |
vi- 'aṃraiḥ sāmadhe (sāma ṛkṣu) kṛtsnaṃ vā pratyacaṃ, tisṛbhiḥ śruteḥ |
putreṇa sahāgataḥ ityādī ca ekābhisambandhavattvaṃ ityādi yogyatānusāraṇa bodhyam |
atra ca akṣiniṣṭhāṅgatvasya paraṃparāsambandhena caitre prakāratā |
‘yenāṅgavikāraḥ’ ityanuśāsanāt yena aṅgena vikṛtena aṅgino vikāro lakṣyate tatstṛtīyā syāt ityarthakāt ‘akṣaṇā kāṇaḥ’ ityādī tṛtīyā |
atra ca akṣisambandhacakṣurgolakaparam, vṛttitvaṃ tṛtīyārthaḥ; kāṇapadaṃ cakṣurūpatvadolakatvaparam |
cakṣurgolakavṛttitvacakṣurūpatva- vadolakatvān iti bodhaḥ ! tṛtīyārthairvṛttitvasya tena sambandhena bhāvanāyāmanvayāt |
‘tṛttikāma: pacet’ ityatra pratyayārthakāryatvasya prakṛtyai pāke anvayaḥ |
tṛptiprasādī devatā'stivasādhako ‘tṛpta aina- mindraḥ pranayā paśumistarpayati’ iti, iti cen |
ke. taittarīyaḥ, kārīrīvākyāni adhīyānāḥ bhūmau bhojanamācaranti apare śāstrino nācaranti |
bhā. 2|4| 2|8 pṛ. 632. taittarīyaireva āpastambīyabaudhāyanīya dharmegṛhyasūtre pratipanne |
taittarīya- kasa avāntarabhedaḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ sūtrabhedaḥ sṛṣṭamedasa ṣaṭchatva baudhāyanīyaṃ āpastambīyaṃ satyāṣādīyaṃ vaikhānasīyaṃ bhāra- dvājīyaṃ vāghulaṃ ceti |
vā. 3|1|2|16. taitti- rīyaśākhāvākyena aśrapratigrahediḥ dātuḥ siddhā |
yathā tailapānaṃ ghṛtapānaṃ vā bhakṣitave'pi sati kālāntare meṣāsmṛtibalapuṣṭyādīni phalāni karoti |
atra bhramaḥ taila- pānasyāpi na kālāntare phalaṃ bhavati |
vā. 3|2|1|19 pṛ. 770. tyajeḥ vibhāgānkūle vyāpāro vācyaḥ |
rahasya. pṛ. 114. tyajedekaṃ kulasyārthe iti nyāyaḥ |
yatrobhaya- koṭikasaṃśaye ekatra vahyaihāniḥ dvitīyasvīkāre tu ekārthehāniḥ, tatra dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ svīkārya iti bhāvaḥ |
sāhastī. 188. ‘ākāśasachichatrāt’ ityadhikaraṇe bahunāmanu- grahāya ‘tyajedekaṃ kulasyārthe’ iti nyāyena ākāśa- śrutirekā anyā nīyate, bahuvādhasya anyāyyatvāt iti sādhitam |
bahunāmahamanugrahāya aindrī subrahmaṇyā kāryā ‘tyajedekaṃ kulasyārthe’ iti nyāyena bahudhamapi prābalyakāraṇam |
vi. 12|120. yatra tu darśanipātaḥ tatra anyatareṇa kṛtārthatvāt avaśyavāheye anyatarasmin bhūyasāmanugraho yuktaḥ ‘tyaje- dekaṃ kulasyārthe’ itivat, vidhipramayaḥ parityajyate |
vā. 12|2|17 pṛ. 116. tyāgaḥ ca devatā ca juhotisyale adṛṣṭavidhayā ārādupakārako prakṣepeṇa saha sampradāno vā |
bhā. 3|8|3|10, tyāgaḥ na mama iti śakyate videśa- sthenāpi kartum |
su. pṛ. 1534, tyāgaḥ homa- kālīnaḥ ‘na mama’ iti svārthaviniyogāhetyasvatva- nivṛtyātmakaḥ |
tyāge āvāhanādi- nigadeṣu agnīṣomīyapaśau paśupuroḍāśājñchriṣṭhadaye, nirguṇasyaivāgremidhānam |
etāvān viśeṣaḥ yat paraprayuktadravyadevopajīvitvena paraprayuktabhāvāve svātantryena tacchadravyadevatā sraipatvaṃ nāsti |
bhāṭa. 4|1|7, tyāgāṃśaḥ yāgehomādau ārā- dupakārakaḥ, na tu dravyadevatā''dau saṃnipatyopakārakaḥ |
4|1|7, tyāgāṃśasya viśeṣyatayā pratītasya prakṣepā- yajñatve pramāṇabhāvaḥ |

aparasmin sādyaske 'strī gauḥ somakrayaṇī, vyāvṛttā hyeṣā spardhā' ityuktam |
tatra yataḥ strī gauḥ nikhilasomakrayasādhanaṃ bādhitvā sarvasthāne sthitā, ataḥ spardhā-kalaho nivṛttaḥ iti tadarthaḥ |
tathā ca itarasādyaske yathā strī gauḥ sarvabādhikā, tathā prathame sādyaske sāṇḍo gauḥ nikhilakrayasādhanabādhakaḥ iti liṅgadarśanamuktam |
trivatsena sāṇḍena sādyaske somakrayārthe vihitena prākṛtasarvakrayadravyasya bādhaḥ |
trivatse sarvakrayadravyāṇāpye yathā āruṇyasya niṣedhaḥ tathā kaustubhe draṣṭavyam |
sādyaske trivatsena sāṇḍena somakrayaṇena prākṛtasya kṛtsnasya krayasādhanasya bādhaḥ ||
santi krayārthāni dravyāṇi codakaprāptāni 'ajayā krīṇāti, hiraṇyena krīṇāti, ṛṣabheṇa krīṇāti, aśvaśaphena krīṇāti, vāsasā krīṇāti' ityevamādīni |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ trivatsaḥ ṛṣabhasya nivartakaḥ, athavā sarveṣāṃ krayārthānāṃ dravyāṇā- miti |
pratyakṣaḥ sa krīṇātinā saṃśrayate, tena codakaprāptaṃ nivartayati |
tasmāt kṛtsnasya krayasya krayārthasya nivartaka iti |
bhāṣyam- evaṃ ca kṛtvā liṅgaṃ darśayati |
aparasmin sādyaske 'strī gauḥ somakrayaṇī vyāvṛttā hyeṣā spardhā' iti |
yadi sarvasya krayasya nivartikā strī gauḥ, tadā taṃ sadṛśa spardhā bhavet |
tatrāsyāṃ vartamānāyāṃ spardhāyām 'vyāvṛttā hyeṣā spardhā', iti nopapadyate |
yadi trivatsaḥ sarveṣāṃ nivartakaḥ, tadā taṃ apavādamānā sādyaskāntare strīgavī śrayamāṇā kevalā syāt |
itarathā hi kevalasya ṛṣabhasya apavādhitāraṃ trivatsaṃ nivartayantī sakṣmdhayatitā spardhetāpi |
tatra 'vyāvṛttā hyeṣā spardhā' iti vacanaṃ nāvakalpate |
soma - trivatsaśca kṛtsnasya nivartakaḥ iti sūtrārthaḥ |
vi-- 'trivatsenarṣabho bādhyaḥ : kṛtsnaṃ vā kraya- sādhanam |
bhāṭṭa-- sādyaske 'trivatsaḥ sāṇḍaḥ somakrayaṇaḥ' ityatra 'kartavyaḥ' iti kriyāpadādhyāhārādavagabhyabhāve tadupacārabhāvanāyāṃ aprāptasya trivatsasya tāvat vidheyatva- māvaśyakam |

tacca yadi tāvat krayoddeśena vidhīyate, tadā ṛṣabhadupaṃsiva ajādiṣu strītvapi prasaktau sāṇḍa- śabdasya avadyutānuvādatvāpatteḥ, viśiṣṭadeśe ca vākya- krīṇāti' ityanena kraye api prāptatvāt somakrayaṇaḥ ityanuvādamātram |
na ca sāṇḍasya abhīṣomīyādāvapi sacena tatra trivattvaprasakteḥ tasyāpi avadyutānuvādā- pattiḥ, āvaśyakye anyatarasya avadyutānuvāde jaghanya- syaiva tadocityāt |
ataśca sarvatraiva trivattvavidhānāt kasyāpi dravyasya anidhutiḥ |
iti prāpte, na krayoddeśena trivatsalamātraṃ vidhīyate, yena sāṇḍādipade avadyutā- nuvādasyāpattiḥ |
api tu trivatsavapuṃgavaikāvaśiṣṭadravyā- ntarasya krayoddeśena vidhiḥ trivatsādidrayakaraṇatvāt |
ata eva ekākhyāpi vidhānāt sarvakravyeṣu pratyekaṃ na trivatsa- tvāderniveśaḥ |

na ca ekasyāpi pratikriyaṃ niveśā- patterna sarvakrayeṣu ekadravyatāsiddhiḥ; tathātve dravyabahutvāt bahuvacanaprasaṅgena ekatvasya kramasamudāye eva prayājekā- daśalavanayena vidheyatvāt ekadravyatvasiddhiḥ |

ata eva puṃstvānurodhena hiraṇyādibhyāvṛttāvapi gotvādyanayoḥ dvayormadhye gotvasya anekakrayasādhanatvena bhūyo'nugrahasya nyāyatvāt tenaiva krayāntare prasaṅgasiddhau ajatvasyāpi bādhāt 'gotvāvacchinnaḥ eva pumān trivatsaḥ ekaḥ sarva- krayeṣu draṣṭavyaḥ' iti kaustubhe vyaktam |
ata eva 'somakrayaṇī vyāvṛttā dveṣatāṃ spardhatāṃ' ityādi nikāyabhūte agnime yāge dravyā- ntarābhāvāt spardhamānānuvādo'pi saṃgacchate |
yatra punarvedaprasiddhārthaparigraho na saṃbhavatyeva, yathā 'trivṛtā yūpaṃ parivīya āgneyaṃ savanīyaṃ paśumupākaroti' ityādiṣu, tatra lokaprasiddhārthasyaiva kāraḥ |
evaṃ carvvavālaśabdayorapi uktanyāyena veda- prasiddhārthasyaiva apūrvvasiddhayupāyatvam, na laukikasya |

su. pṛ. 1141. traiśoke sāma dvādaśāha caturthe'hani |
tasya yoniḥ 'viśvāḥ pūtanāḥ' (sāmasaṃ. 370, 930) iti ati- mī. ko. 248
uttare ca ṛcau 'nemi namanti' (931) samu remāso (932) iti bṛhatyau |
dvādaśāhapṛṣṭhayaṣaḍahe caturthe'hani traiśokaṃ sāma uttaragranthapaṭhitayoreva geyam, na tu atijagatī anne ||
bhāṣyam-- evaṃ vā asti dvādaśāhaḥ; 'dvādaśāhena prajākāmaṃ yājayet' iti |
tatra caturthe'hani traiśokaṃ nāma sāma, atijagatyāmutpannam |
atijagatī 'viśvāḥ pūtanā abhibhūtaraṃ sahaṃ sasṛjatkṣurindaṃ jajanuśca rājase |
kṛtvā variṣṭhaṃ vara āmurīmatomojiṣṭhaṃ tavasaṃ tarasvinam ||
tayoḥ pūrvā 'nemi namanti cakṣā medha vibhā amikṣā |
yudītavo vo aduho'pi karṇe tarasvinaḥ; samukramabhiḥ ||
sarpati yadī vṛṣe ghṛtatrato hojasā samūtibhiḥ ||
tatra eṣoḍyathaḥ sāṃśayikaḥ: kimantye atijagatyau upādāya samāsu geyam, uta ye eva te uttare bṛhatyau, ete eva upādāya viṣamāsveva gātavyamiti |
viśeṣaḥ alpatvaṃ nyūnatvam ) mā bhūtāṃ iti anye utpattiyau upādāya etat sāma samāsveva abhyasitavya iti |
bhāṣyam-- liṅgaṃ khalvapi asminnarthe darśayati 'atijagatyī stuvanti' iti |
bhāṣyam-- naimittikaṃ tu uttarātvaṃ ānantyāt uttarāpāṭhanimittaṃ ānantyaṃ sati pratīyate |
bhāṣyam-- evaṃ ca samānadevatāke traiśoke tṛce, iti tanśabdenopacāro yukto bhaviṣyati |
atrāha, aya yaduktam 'atijagatoṣu stuvanti' iti śabdopacārāt atijagati bahuvacaṃ darśa- yati iti, tat parihartavyam |
'ekaviṃśaḥ ṣoḍaśī' iti ekaviṃśatikṛtvaḥ ṣoḍaśini abhyasyamānā traiśokābhyāsaḥ |
tatra saptakṛtvaḥ atijagatyāṃ abhyasyamānāyāṃ 'atijagatoṣu stuvanti' iti vacanaṃ upapadyate iti |
dupa-- (atra bhāṣyaṃ--) 'ekaviṃśatikṛtvaḥ ṣoḍaśini abhyasyamāne traiśoksya abhyāsaḥ' |
'ekaviṃśaḥ ṣoḍaśī' iti (vacanāt) sarvastotrāṇi ṣoḍaśini ekaviṃśāni bhavanti |
stotrāntareṣu tu abhyāsenaiva) tatra ekaviṃśatisampattaye (brahmasāmni abhyasyamāne tatrābhyanasya) naiśokasya saptakṛtvaḥ abhyāsaḥ |
' ('traiśoke sāmni samāsu gānasya sati dve atijagatyau dāśatayībhyaḥ āneye, athavā tat uttarayorbṛhayoreva gīyate iti saṃśayaḥ |
) bhāṭṭa-- evaṃ vā dvādaśāhe ṣaḍahagataṃ caturthamahaḥ 'eka- viṃśaḥ ṣoḍaśī vairājaṃ sāma' ityāmnātam |
atra prakṛti- prāptasarvastotreṣu ekaviṃśaḥ stomaḥ, ṣoḍaśiśaṃsā, pṛṣṭhastotre ca vairājaṃ sāma, ityanekaguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ karma vihitam |
tatra ca 'traiśokaṃ nāma brahmasāma atijagatoṣu stuvīta' iti brāhmaṇācchaṃsistotre traiśokaṃ sāma vihitam |

tatrātijagattyā- mupapannam, uttarāmnāye cottare dve bṛhayo, tatra saṃśarapari- hārārthamuttarānagranthapaṭhitavorapi uttarayoḥ vācastomādau sārthakyamaṅgīkṛtya atijagatyāveva dve dāśatayībhyaḥ samānīya samāsveva gānam |
na ca prakaraṇena nyāyabādhaḥ, 'atijagatoṣu stuvīta' iti atijagatyatibahutvavidhinā nyāyasyojībanāt |
na ca prāta- stotrānuvādena traiśokātijagatyatibahutvavidhāne vākyabhedaḥ, atideśapravṛtteḥ pūrvamasya pravṛttyā viśiṣṭastotravidhupapatteḥ |
ata eva 'yadyonāmya' iti sāmānyavacanaṃ sāmānyatara- viṣayam |
iti prāpte, bahiṣpavamānātiriktotre eka- viṃśastomānurodhena ṛgabhyāsadvayakatvāt ekasyā apyatijagatyāḥ saptakṛtvaḥ āvṛtterbahutva prāsatā'nu- vādopapatteḥ |
asya sāmamātraviṣayatvāttaccātragranthapaṭhita- bṛhatīprakaraṇānurodhena nyāyasya bādhāt saṃśaramapi svīkṛtya bṛhatīreva geyam |
