vāyavāgratāyāḥ śukrāgratāyāśca punaḥśravaṇaṃ na parisaṃkhyātuṃ nārthavādārtham, kintu samānavidhyartham |
yadyapi navasu ahaḥsu nava santi amratvāni, tathāpi trayāṇāṃ aindravāyavāgraśukrāgraāgrayaṇapraṇavānāṃ trimyāsāt navatvaṃ iti yuktaḥ yanīkāvyavahāraḥ |
dvitīye pañcame ahame cāhani aindravāyavāgratvam, tṛtīye ṣaṣṭhe navame cāhani śukrāgratvam, caturthe saptame ekādaśe cāhani āgrayaṇatvaṃ iti yanīkā |
yathā asminneva gavāmayane ekādaśinī abhyasyamānā daṇḍakalitavadabhyasyate, na svasthānavivṛddhayeti |
aindra- vāyavāgraṃ prathamaṃ bhavati, taccāhaḥ, nāheḥ saṃghātaḥ; iti vākyaṃ bhidyate |
dup- ataḥ paraṃ jyanīkā'dhikaraṇaṃ vyākhyāyate ( iti mudrite |
ahani ityayamartho labhyate eva ( yajñabhāgo hi aharātmakaḥ, iti tadagrahamanubhavadaḥ ) |
yadi ca ahariti vivakṣyeta ( tato viśiṣṭānuvādāt ) vākyaṃ bhidyate |
pṛṣṭhāvṛttau cāprayaṇasya darśanāt trayastriṃśe, parivṛttau punaraindravāyavaḥ syāt |
kutaḥ ? uttarasmin pakṣasi pṛṣṭhyāvṛttau āgrayaṇātayā darśanaṃ bhavati trayastriṃśe'hani |
katham ? 'jagatī vai cchandāṃsi pratyavarohanti, āgrayaṇaṃ vai grahāḥ, bṛhat pṛṣṭhāni, trayastriṃśa stomāḥ' iti |
tadetat svasthāna- vivṛddhau avakalpate, na daṇḍakalitavadāvṛttau |
katham ? pūrvasmin pakṣasi jyanīkā triḥ parivartate |
tatra prathame navamabhāge trayastriṃśamahariti kṛtvā āgrayaṇāṃ bhavati |
katham ? trivṛta ārabhya navakairahaḥsu saṃkalpyamāneṣu pūrvasmin pakṣasi sata pariśiṣyante |
tatra saptame aindrāvāyavāgrā, śukrāgro vijuvān, āgrayaṇāgraḥ prathamaḥ kharasāmā, tato viśvajititi jyanīkā samāptā |
dup- yasya daṇḍakalitavat āvṛttiḥ, tasya etat ( trayastriṃśe ahani āgrayaṇāgrā- ) darśanaṃ nopapadyate |
kathaṃ ? asmin ( hi ) gavāmayane aśītiśata ( 180 ahani ) pūrve pakṣaḥ |
madhye vijuvān adhikamahaḥ ) tatra pūrvapakṣasi ( prathamaṃ tāvat ) jyanīkā niviśate |
) sā ( ca tatra ) niviśamānā āce dve ahanī varjayitvā bhavati |
śiṣṭeṣu ( ca ) ahaḥsu niviśamānāyāḥ ( ekonaviṃśati- vāramāvṛttāyāḥ ) sapta ( ahani ) pariśiṣyante |
tasminna ( saptame ahani ) pūrva pakṣaḥ samāptam |

tataḥ ( navamo bhavati ) prathamaḥ kharasāmā āgrayaṇāgraḥ, dvitīyaḥ kharasāmā aindrāvāyavāgraḥ, tṛtīyaḥ kharasāmā śukrāgraḥ, tato viśvajit āgrayaṇāgraḥ, tataḥ ( pṛṣṭhyaḥ ) ṣaḍahaḥ āvṛttaḥ prayujyate |
tasya āvṛttasya prathamaṃ trayastriṃśamahaḥ ( bhavati ) tat aindrāvāyavāgraṃ prāpnoti |
( iti ) evaṃ ( idaṃ ) darśanaṃ nopapadyate ( pūrvapakṣasi ) daṇḍakalitadāvṛttau, ( svasthāna- vivṛddhau tu upapadyate ) |
yadidaṃ vyākhyānaṃ bhāṣyakāreṇa kṛtam, idaṃ nopapadyate |
katham ? asmin ( hi ) gavāmayane jyanīkā ( prāpya- māṇā ) codakena prāpyate ( na nāmadheyāt, nāpi pratyakṣa- vacanāt bhāṣyakāramate |
'pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ' iti ( atrāpi ) nāmadheyena ( prasiddha- ) ṣaḍahasaṃbandhinī ( eva ) grahāgratā ( prāpnoti |
tathā ) abhiplave ca ( jyotirgāṃrāyuḥ ityevamādi- ) nāmadheyena aikāhiko vidhvantaḥ prāpnoti |
( jyotirgāṃrāyuḥ gaurāyurvvotiḥ iti hi abhiplavaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ |
tatra jyotiṣṭoma yumeṣu bṛhat ayumeṣu rathantaram |
ekāheṣu ca jyotiṣṭomāt rathantarasāmne aindrāvāyavā bṛhatsāmeṣu ca śukrāgratā |
tena abhiplave ṣaḍahe tayoreva vyatiṣaṅgeṇa pravṛttiḥ, na jyanīkāyāḥ |
( tadevamiha jyanīkā'bhāvāt adhi- karaṇaṃ ) evamidaṃ nopapadyate |
( abhyupetyāpyadhikaraṇopa- pattiṃ liṅganupapattimāha- ) yadyapi codakena ( jyanīkā- ) prāptiḥ syāt, tathāpi daśarātrasya dharmāḥ ( vikṛtiṣu ) atidiśyante ityuktam ( 10|5|4|12 ) |
daśarātra- pravṛttau ca pūrvasmin pakṣasi ( bhāgadhamapakṣe'pi ) daśadhā vibhāgaḥ prāpnoti |
( navarātrāpravṛttau hi navadhā vibhāgaḥ prāpnuyāt nava navarātrāḥ pravartante |
daśarātrapravṛttau tu daśadhāvibhakte pūrvasmin pakṣasi ) daśame ( bhāge ) aindrāvāyavāgratā ( prāpnoti |
tataśca ) uttare pakṣasi ( āvṛtte kriyamāṇe ) sa eva ( bhāgaḥ ) prathama- mārabhyate |
tatra aindrāvāyavāgratā prāpnoti trayastriṃśe ahani ( siddhānte'pi |
( yadyapi navarātraḥ pravartate, tathāpi ko'yaṃ viśeṣaḥ ( bhāṣyakāreṇa kṛtaḥ ) |
ekasya ( pūrvapakṣṇaḥ ādyamahardvayaṃ varjayitvā abhiplavādyāt ahaḥ ) miśrataḥ ārabhya gaṇanā, aparasya ( siddhāntinaḥ ) prāyaṇīyāt ārabhya, ( ṣoḍaśaṃ niṣpadyamāno viśeṣaḥ |
( yathā hi pūrvapakṣe prāyaṇīyāccaturviṃśayoḥ aindrāvāyavāgratāyāḥ pratyakṣavacana- vihitatvāt trivṛtaḥ ārabhya gaṇanā, tathā siddhānte'pi |
( tadā hi siddhānte'pi jyanīkā na pūrvasmin pakṣasi samāpyate, uttarasminnapi ahardvayamaharvāpnoti bhāgasāmyā- rtham |

) arthaṃ ca ( aparo ) viśeṣaḥ ( bhāṣyakāreṇa liṅgaṃ darśayatā pakṣadvayasya ) darśitaḥ, ekasya ( pūrvapakṣṇaḥ āvṛttivacanaṃ atanīkṛtya ) kṛtsnaṃ gavāmayanamadhikṛtya gaṇanā, aparasya ( tu siddhāntinaḥ ) pūrvasminneva pakṣasi gaṇanā |
( evaṃ bhāṣyamākṣipya svayamihanī adhikaraṇaṃ liṅgaṃ ca samarthayate- ) atrocyate |
yadi codakena jyanīkā prāpyate, tathā sati ete doṣā bhaveyuḥ |
eṣā tu gavāmayane pratyakṣa vacanena vidhīyate |
gavāmayane ca dharmā vidhīyamānā avāntaraprakaraṇe pūrvasmin pakṣasi niviśānte, na kṛtsne ( gavāmayane ) |
asaṃbhavāt bhaveyuḥ ( kṛtsne gavāmayane avāntaraprakaraṇaṃ bādhitvā prāpnuyuḥ ) |
saṃbhavati ca ( atra madhyame pūrvasminneva pakṣasi ) avā- ntaraprakaraṇe ( jyanīkāyāḥ ) niveśaḥ |
pūrvapakṣavādinastu daṇḍakalitavadāvṛttiḥ pūrvasmin pakṣasi na samāpyate |
tasya ( hi ādyamahardvayaṃ varjayitvā ) trivṛta ārabhya gaṇanā pravartate, ādyayoḥ ( prāyaṇīyacaturviṃśayoḥ ahoḥ ) aindra- vāyavāgratāyāḥ pratyakṣāmanāt |
ādau cārabhamāṇasya dvitīye ( ahani ) śukrāgratā syāt |
tasyā dvitīyāyāmapi āvṛttau sāvakāśatā ) viśeṣeṇa ( tu svachandaneva ) aindrāvāyavāgratā ( vihitā ), sāmānyācca viśeṣo balīyān |
tasmāt tṛtīyāt ( ahaḥ ) ārabhya tasya gaṇanā ( tena pūrvasmin pakṣasi na samāpyate kintu viju- vantaṃ uttare ca pakṣasi ādyamaharvāpnoti ) |
siddhānte tu avirodhāt prathamādeva ( prāyaṇīyādahaḥ ) ārabhya gaṇanā ghaṭate ) |
atra codyate, jyotirādaya upyamānā ( eva ) viśeṣanāmadheyena dharmān gṛhṇata eva utpadyante yathā kuṇḍapāyināmadheye agnihotram |
jyanīkā tu atra saṅghāta- dharmatvena prāpnoti |
) tena nāmadheyāt trayastriṃśe ahani pūrvapakṣa- vādino'pi āgrayaṇāgratā labhyate iti ) ucyate |
atra paurvāparyācco bhavati yathā vikṛtau dakṣiṇasyānaṃ codakena prāptaṃ ( prākṛtaṃ ) bādhitvā niviśate virodhāt |
evamihāpi tryanīkā nāmadheyaprāptaṃ bādhitvaiva niviśate yathā apacchede pūrvanaimittikaṃ uttareṇa (naimittikene) virodhe (sati) bādhyate |

athavā (nāmnāḥ paścātkā- līnatvaṃ) yadā (hi) yāgaḥ phale codito bhavati, tadā (eva) dharmākāṃkṣā (notpattisamaye) etasyāṃ (laghuphalakatvena dharmākāṃkṣā-) avasthāyāṃ kiṃ codakena dharmāḥ, uta nāmadheyena iti cintāyāṃ (pratyakṣatvena) nāmadheyena dharmaprāptiḥ (bhavati) |
tryanīkāṃ tu gṛhan na lakṣaṇayā (āgrayaṇā''khya-) dharmaprāptiṃ karoti, (kiṃtu) upadeśenaiva gṛhṇāti |
bhāṣyam-- liṅgaṃ khalvapi evamarthaṃ darśayati, yathā daṇḍakalitavat ekādaśinā āvartante iti |
'prāṇā vā ekādaśināḥ', yadaikādaśinīmīyuḥ : ahānyatiricyante pañcavo vā' iti |
svasthānaviśuddhau nāstyatirekaḥ, daṇḍa- kalitavadvāvṛttau nyūnatā atiriktā vā bhavati |
śā-- bhāṣyakāreṇa prāyaṇīyodayanīyamadhyavartinīṃ dvādaśāhikīṃ tryanīkāṃ codakaprāptāmāśritya vicāritaṃ kiṃ daṇḍakalitavat āvartanīyā, kiṃvā navānāmi- anīkānāṃ svesve sthāne viśuddhiḥ iti |
(tadarthe kimime dharmāḥ prakṛtau aharpūrvapramuktāḥ, uta paramāpūrvepramuktāḥ |
tadarthe ca kimagrahaṇena vivakṣitam, uta na iti saṃśayaniṣkarṣaḥ |

navabhikṣāprāptiranekānyāni na pūryante iti athasryakartanyāyāmāvṛttau kiṃ navasu dineṣu navāgratāḥ kṛtvā punaranyeṣu navasu kartavyāḥ ityevaṃ daṇḍa- kalitavadvāvṛttiḥ ? uta pūrvasya pakṣo navadhā vibhāgaṃ kṛtvā viṃśatimuttamake, (180÷20 = 9) ekai- kasminbhāge ekaikāgratā ? iti svasthānaviśuddhiḥ |
iti cintāyām, ahaḥśabdaśravaṇāt tasyaiva ca phalasādhana- tvāt taduddeśenaiva agratā vidhīyate |
na caivaṃ sarvāṃsāmagratānāṃ sarveṣvahaḥ prāpyatvāpattiḥ, sthānakrameṇa prathamasulāyāṃ prathamāgratayā ete prāpte |
ataśca navabhi- rayatābhiḥ navahasu anuṣṭhiteṣu punaridameva vacanamupa- tiṣṭhate ityato daṇḍakalitavadvāvṛttiḥ |
iti prāpte, sthāna- krameṇaideyavācyasya ahaḥpadasya prakaraṇasya ca saṃkoce pramāṇābhāvāt |
anyathā brīhīṇāmāgneyādyarthaṃ yavānāṃ cāmīpomīyāṅgatvamiti vyavasthāpyate; sarveṣvahaḥ su ekaikā- gratā āpadyeta |
na ceṣṭāpattiḥ, prathamaśadādyahardvayorvidhi- nava kasya ca vaiyarthyāpatteḥ |
ato lāghavāt prathamapadaṃ atha- śabdo'tītadvitīyapādaṃ ca uddeśyasamarpakam |
ataśca pūrvapakṣa pakṣo navadhā vibhāgaṃ kṛtvā ekasmin viṃśatidinātmake bhāge ekaikāgratā vidhīyate |
prakṛte ca bhāgadharmatvāt paramāpūrveprayuktatvam, ataḥ svasthānaviśuddhiḥ |
evaṃ cottare pakṣasi pañcame pāḍahike tryaṃśe'hisi āgrayaṇāgradarśanaṃ 'jagato vai chandāṃsi pratyavarohanti, āgrayaṇā graḥ, bṛhat pṛṣṭhāni, tryaṃśeṇa stomāḥ' ityupapadyate bhavati |
tathāhi, svasthānaviśuddhau pūrvasminne pakṣasi saṃpūrṇa tryanīkā samāpyate |
yacca pūrvasmin pakṣasi ānulomyenānuṣṭhitaṃ tadahaṃ taduttare pakṣasi prātilomyena kartavyatā ādyuttaṃ 'pakṣa upayanti' iti vacanena vihitam |
atra hi na punaḥkaraṇa- mātrarūpā āvṛttirvidhīyate, apitu 'ṣaḍbhirita māseradhvānaṃ yānti, ṣaḍbhiḥ punarāyānti' iti vacanāntarānusārāt prātilomyarūpā |
ata eva pūrvasmin pakṣasi ṣaḍahe 'gāyatraṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ jāgataṃ gāyatraṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ jāgatam' ityevakrameṇa ṣaḍahi dināni, teṣāṃ prātilomye ṣaḍahyaṃ dinaṃ jāgataṃ saṃpadyate |
tathā pūrvasmin pakṣasi ṣaḍahe prathamadine rathaṃtaram, uttaredine bṛhadityevakrameṇa ṣaḍe bṛhat, tasya prātilomye ādye bṛhat saṃpadyate |
tathā tasminneva ṣaḍahe krameṇa triṣṭupstomasadaśaekaviṃśatrivaṇatryaviṃśastomake ṣaḍahaḥ tryaviṃśastomakama, tasya prātilomye ādye tathā saṃpadyate |
ataśca tadeva tryanīkāyāṃ api prātilomyenānuṣṭhāne uttarasya pakṣataḥ pūrvasmin viṃśatidinātmake bhāge āgrayaṇāgratā jāyate iti liṅgamupapadyate |
daṇḍakalita- vadvāvṛttau tu pūrvasmin pakṣasi ādyadinadvaye punarviśiṣya aindravāyavāgratvasya vidhānāt tryanīkā tṛtīyadinamā- rabhya pravartate |
tataśca tasyā ekonaviṃśativāramāvṛttyāḥ punarapi saptadinānvayaviśaṣyante iti pūrvasmin pakṣasi tryanīkābhāsiḥ |
tena sāmarthyāmkena liṅgena pūrvapakṣā- vāntaraprakaraṇaṃ bādhitvā mahāprakaraṇādayaṃ gavāmayanahaṃ saṃpadyate |
tadā ca prātilomyavidhiḥ asyāṃ na pravartate |
tataśca viśvavantaṃ svarasāmādyaṃ ca gṛhītvā tryanīkāsamāptiḥ |
tataḥ punastathaiva tryanīkā'nuṣṭhāne dvitīyamaindravāyavāgraṃ tṛtīyaṃ śukrāgram, viśvajit, āgrayaṇāgraṃ ṣaḍahyamaindravāyavāgraṃ prāpnotīti liṅgānuṣapattiḥ |

na ca evaṃ siddhānte tryanīkāvidhinaiva pūrvapakṣaḥ prathamabhāgāntargatayorāyayoḥ prāya- ṇīyacaturviṃśayohoḥ aindravāyavāgratvaprāptisaṃdeheḥ : punastayo- raindravāyavāgratvavidhiḥ vyartha iti vācyam |
tryanīkāvidhinā bhāgadharmatvena paramāpūrveprayuktatvena prāpyamānāyā api aindra- vāyavāgratāyāḥ tatadaharpūrvaprayuktatvasya vidhānāt |
taphalañca nātideśādeśanā tanmātravikāre ekāhādau asatyapi rathaṃtarasāmatve aindravāyavāgratvaniyamasiddhiḥ |
ataḥ svasthānaviśuddhayā viṃśatirātmake bhāge aindravāyavā- gratvasya aupadeśikatva niveśāt tatadahaḥ su atideśika- taccadatrāpi : iti vādhopayogitā'pi |

yattu bhāṣyakāreṇopadeśikīṃ nyanīkāmuktvātha ātideśikīṃ dvādaśāhikīṃ navāhaḥsaṃbandhinīṃ nyanīkāṃ gāvāmayanikūparvapakṣe prāsāmudāhṛtya daṇḍakalitavadāvṛttyā pūrvapakṣaṃ kṛtvā pūrvavedava svasthānaviśiṣṭasiddhānto liṅga- darśanāṃ ca vyākhyātam |
dvādaśāhāntargatadaśāha- prabhṛtereva sarvavikṛtiṣu sādhitatvena navāhaḥsaṃbandhinīkā- mātraprāpterupapattisattvāt |
ataḥ daśānamagratānāṃ pūrva- smin daśadhā vibhāge daśamo bhāgaḥ aṣṭādaśa- dinātmakaḥ aindravāyavāgraḥ syāt, prakṛtau daśamasya aindra- vāyavāgratvāt |
tataścottarasmin pakṣeti prātilomye prathamo bhāga aindravāyavāgraḥ prāpnotīti siddhānte'pi āgrayaṇāgratā'nupapattiḥ |
vastutastu ātideśikyanī- kāyāḥ pūrvapakṣeva prāptau pramāṇabhāvaḥ |
kṛtsne hi gavā- mayane sā prāpyate |
atastasya kṛtsnasya navāha daśā vā vibhā
tathā, 'yajjuhuyādadyapūrvāmāhutīrjuhuyāt, yatra juhuyā- dagniḥ parā patet' iti |
itthaṃ tūṣṇīhomaḥ praśastaḥ, yadasmin kriyamāṇe ubhāvāpi doṣau parihṛtau bhavataḥ iti |
soma- pūrvavadiha vikalpasyāntaḥ siddhatvātvāt pratiṣedhasya nānarthakyaṃ ityuditeḥ (pratyudāharaṇa-) saṃgatiḥ |
mādhavīye vedabhāṣye "asmin (tūṣṇī-) home agnihotraśabdena prasiddhāmihotradharmāḥ prāpnuvanti |
tatra yajuṣā homapakṣe kriyamāṇe 'sūryo jyotiḥ' iti mantraḥ syāt |
prasiddhāmihotrasya ca sāyamupakramatvāt tatra prāthamikaprayoge 'agnirjyotiḥ' iti mantreṇa sāyaṃ hutvā paścāt prātaḥkāle 'sūryo jyotiḥ' iti mantreṇa homaḥ ityevaṃ kramaḥ |
iha tu ādāveva sūryo jyotirititenā- tūṣṇīne prakṛtikṛtakramābhāvāt ayathāpūrva syāt" iti vyākhyātam |
nahi atra kuṇḍapāyināmayanagatāgnihotre iva viśuddhe'gnihotraśabdaḥ śrūyate yena dharmātideśatvaṃ syāt, kintu arthavāde, arthavādagatasya ca nāmno nātideśākatvaṃ stutyarthīyāt |
yathā 'eṣa vai darśapūrṇamāsayoravabhṛthaḥ' itpāṃ nyuseke evāvabhṛthaśabdasya na dharmātideśatvam |
yathā vā 'somo vai vājinaṃ surā somaḥ' : 'upaśayo yūpaḥ' ityādīnām |
kiñca ayaṃ tūṣṇīhomaḥ agnihotrakāḥ, tathā ca 'agmaye hotramasmin' iti yaugikābhāvāt prāpaṇīyā- ditvat nātideśākatvam |
evaṃ ca prākṛtahomavikāratvā''yane yājñikānāṃ tadīyadharmā'nuṣṭhānamapi cintyam |
sūtrārthastu- pūrvairjitalā- hyudāharaṇaiḥ homābhighāraṇayorekatra tulyakālatvāt tulya- vyāpāratvāt anyaśeṣatvāt iti yāvat |
bhāṭṭa- ādhane 'hotavyamagnihotraṃ na hotavyamiti mīmāṃsante brahmavādinaḥ |
yad yajuṣā juhuyādapūrvā- māhutīrjuhuyāt, yatra juhuyādagniḥ parāpatet, tūṣṇīmeva juhoti' iti śrutam |
tathā cāturmāsyeṣu tryambakahoma- madhikṛtya 'abhighāryābhighāryā iti mīmāṃsante, yadamighārayet rudrāyāsye paśūcchindayāt |
hotavyaṃ na hotavyaṃ abhi- ghāryā anabhighāryā iti vidhipratiṣedhaśrutrādikalpaḥ |
na ca vikalpe pakṣadvayāvalambanena prayogakāle mīmāṃsopapatteḥ anyatarasya vidheyatve ekapakṣavalambitvayā mīmāṃsā'nu- papattiriti vācyam |
ataśca vicārapūrvakasya tasyānte niṣkāya- katvāt stutyupapattiḥ |
etādṛśo'yaṃ homo'bhighāraṇaṃ ca yadopadiṣṭamapi bahutaraguṇavattvāt kartavyameva |
home tu naiva kaściddoṣa iti stutiḥ |
atra ca tryambakahomasya darvīhoma- tvena apūrvatvādvaidhumevābhighāraṇaṃ vidhīyate |
śāstradīpiko- karītyā vidhitattve'pi sā tasyā ādhānadvārā abhi- prayojakatvena abhisaṃbandhivā''viśeṣāt prāpaṇīyā''divadanati- deśākatvācca |
bhāṣyam- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śrūyate 'ārpayeyaṃ vṛṇīte, ekaṃ vṛṇīte, dvau vṛṇīte, trīn vṛṇīte, na caturo vṛṇīte, na pañcātivṛṇīte' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ : kiṃ ārpayeyasya adhikāraḥ, uta neti |
tacca darśayati 'ekaṃ vṛṇīte, dvau vṛṇīte' iti |
tathā pratiṣedhati 'na caturo vṛṇīte, na pañcātivṛṇīte' iti |
nanu stutyā vidhāyaste, yayā trīn vṛṇīte iti |
'na caturo vṛṇīte, na pañcātivṛṇīte' iti nityānuvādo bhaviṣyati |
dup- 'ārpayeyaṃ vṛṇīte' iti sāmānyena (ārpayeya- varaṇasya) vidhiḥ |
athavā sāmānyena vihite (sati varaṇe) ekatvādiviḥ viśeṣyate |
'ārpayeyaṃ vṛṇīte' (iti sāmānyaṃ viśeṣaṃ prati-) sākāṅkṣaṃ trīn vṛṇīte iti vākyāt tritvena viśeṣyate |
itarathā (yadi ekatvā''dyapi vidhīyeta, tataḥ :) vākyabhedaḥ aṣṭakalpanā aśruta- (vidhi-) kalpanā ca (prasajyeta) |
sāmānyena vidhiḥ : ekatvādayaḥ arthavādāḥ iti cet, evamapi caturā- dipratiṣedhāt vākyabhedaḥ sthita eva |
asatpakṣe punaḥ (ārpayeyaṃ vṛṇīte, kiṃ saṃkhyam ? trīn, iti) eka- vākyatvāt na kaścit doṣaḥ |
trīṇi ārpayeyāṇi ya saṃpādayituṃ śaknoti, saḥ adhikriyate |
na ca īdṛk vākya 'ārpayeya eva adhikriyate' iti |
nanu idamevāsi 'trīn vṛṇīte' iti, (uttaram-) trīn yaḥ saṃpāda- yituṃ śaknoti, tasya varaṇamucyate |
na 'yasya ārpayeya iti guruvākyaṃ bhavati, anapekṣitaśca saṃbandhaḥ (syāt) (codayati-) 'na pañcātivṛṇīte' iti pañcātikramaṇa pratiṣedhāt idamavagamyate asti pañcānāṃ varaṇaṃ iti naitadevam |
na ca anumānena śakyaḥ śāstrārthaḥ anuṣṭhātum |
manuvattve tu yasyā ekaḥ, yasyāpi pañca, tasyāpi sakṛdeva uccāraṇaṃ 'manuvat iti |
śā- ekaṃ dvau trīn pañca vā vṛṇānaḥ adhikriyata iti prāpte, abhīdhīyate |
' soma- pañcāpyarpayeyayoḥ apratisamādheyā''vata asāmarthyābhāvāt asti adhikāraḥ iti pratyavasthāna- saṃgatiḥ |
catuḥpañcāpayeyādīnāṃ svīkaraṇamiṣye ṛṣipraya varaṇe adhikāraḥ : siddhānte saṃmataḥ |
vi- 'vidhivaraṇa ekādāvapi syāt trika e- vā |
tasmāt karmaṇi adhikurvan yajamānaḥ : trīneva uccārayet na nyūnaṃ nāyadhikaṃ iti tātparyarthaḥ |
bhāṭṭa- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ : 'ārpayeyaṃ vṛṇīte, ekaṃ vṛṇīte, dvau vṛṇīte, trīn vṛṇīte, na caturo vṛṇīte, pañcāti vṛṇīte' iti śrutam |
tatra tāvat ekaṃ vidhāya- anye anuvādāḥ |
'na caturo vṛṇīte' ityādyapi nityānu- vāda: tadartha eva |
api tu 'atha haike manuvat ityekādhaiyaṃ sārvavarṇikaṃ pratidiśanti' iti vacanāntaravihitamanu- vatpakṣavathaiva |
'apivā ekaṃ dvau trīn pañca vṛṇīte, na caturo vṛṇīte na pañcā vṛṇīte'
atra ājyasaṃkhyā yāgāntarameva, na tu tvāṣṭra pratinidhiḥ |
bhāṣyam-- tvāṣṭra pālītvataṃ vidhāya idamyucyate ' yatparyabhikṛtaṃ pālītvamatutsṛjanti' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ ki tvāṣṭrasya paryabhikṛtasya utsargo vidhīyate, uta tasmāt yāgāntaramiti |
yadi 'paryabhikṛtamutsṛjanti' iti padadvayaṃ parasparaṃ saṃbadvam, tataḥ tvāṣṭrotsargaḥ |
atha pālītvataśabdaḥ utsṛjatātena saṃbadhyate, tato yāgāntaram |
api ca tvāṣṭra utsargaṃ vidhīyamāne paryabhikṛtamiti viśeṣaṇaṃ nāvakalpeta |
ato brūmaḥ paryabhi- kṛtasya pālītvatā vidhīyate, sa eva yāga iti |
na karmāntaram, pūrvasyaiva utsṛjatātena avacchedya vidhīyate |
kimiva bhaviṣyati ? yajjimattā tāvat kalpayitavyā na bhaviṣyati |
utsṛjatiśabdaśca śrutyā utsarge vidadhat vākyena na bādhito bhaviṣyati |
karmā- ntarapakṣe vākyena pālītvatāt vidhīyamānāyā arthāt prāpta utsargo dhātunā anūyeta |
api ca paryabhikṛta pālītvatā pūrvasya viditaiva, sā vidhātuṃ na śakyate |
yattuktaṃ tvāṣṭra utsarge vidhīyamāne paryabhikṛtamiti viśeṣaṇaṃ tāvat nāva- kalpeteti |
ata eva tvāṣṭraḥ pālītvata ubhaya- viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaḥ kevalena pālītvataśabdena lakṣaṇayā anūyeta iti na doṣaḥ |
vā-- etenaiva adhikāreṇa utsṛjatirāpi yajimadabhi- dhāno na veti vicāryate |
'tvāṣṭraṃ pālītvatamālabhate' ityevaṃ yāgaṃ punarāmnāyate 'paryabhikṛtaṃ pālītvata- mutsṛjanti' iti |
tatra guṇavidhiḥ, uta karmāntaramiti vacanavyakttidvayapratibhānena saṃdehe sati, vākyaśvetālabha- bhadeva viśeṣakeḥ dravyadevatāsaṃbandhaviṣayatvena karmāntara- tvam |
' yadi hi atrāpi pūrvavadeva ubhe viśeṣaṇe śrayeyātāṃ tatastadeva karmeti vijñāyeta |
na tu atra mahendrasya indrapagāthe kaścidapi pratyabhiśānaleo'stīti devatā'ntarasaṃyogā- dapi vājinayāgavat bhidyate |
pālītvatodeśena ca utsṛ- jyamānārthe vidhīyamāne paryabhikaraṇatvāviśeṣaṇāt vākyaṃ bhidyeta |
prāptaḥ eva ca tasya utpattivākyena utsargaḥ iti vyarthā punaḥśrutiḥ bhavet |
na ca paryabhikaraṇavidhānena anarthaḥ, tasya atideśenaiva prāptatvāt |
na ca tvāṣṭrapālītvatavidhiḥ vaikalpikaḥ śakya āśrayitum, upattikāvākyaśeṣatva- virodhāt |
na ca prākṛtaklaptopakārakevalaparyabhikaraṇapunaḥ- śrutyā gṛhamedhīyatvat apūrvatā śakyā darśayituṃ siddhava- dupasarjanabhūtaparyabhikaraṇanirdeśāt |
na ca paryabhikaraṇaśabdaḥ tadantāyā añjarītervācakaḥ, yena tanmātragrahaṇakṣayaṇāt uttarakarmāvacchedo vijñāyate (yeta) na cāsau kālasya vaktā, yena paryabhikāle eva utsṛjati iti kalpyeta |
na ca lakṣaṇa''śrayaṇehetuḥ, śrutyā'pi vākyasamavāyo- papatteḥ |
saṃdeha: kimājyaṃ pūrvasmin pratinidhibhūtam, athavā ājyadravyakaṃ pūrvasāt karmāntare vidhīyate iti |
tat ājyena saṃsthāpaya- tīti paśoḥ kāryaṃ ājyaṃ śrutaṃ bhavatīti |
dravyotsargavacanaṃ pratyathe, śeṣaśabde vā aparihṛṣṭe punarasamāptaṃ pūrvakarma ityāśaṅkyate |
tena manyāmahe yat pūrvaṃ paśunā ārabdham, tat utsṛṣṭe paśau ājyena parisamā- pyate iti |
apūrvasya atra karmaṇaḥ ucyamānasya ārambhaḥ eva vaktavyo bhavati |
yattu anabhidhāya ārambhaṃ pari- samāptireva ucyate, tataḥ avagacchāmaḥ, pūrvasyaiva pari- samāptiḥ nāpūrve karma codyate iti |
nanūktaṃ dravyotsarge śeṣavacane vā aparihṛṣṭe pūrvakarmaṇaḥ samāsirāśaṅkitā bhavati |
avaśyaṃ kaścit dhātuḥ saṃpūrṇo bhāva- vacanaśca prayoktavya iti |
tatra aviruddho bhāvanāyāmubhya- mānāyāṃ arthaprāptaḥ saṃsthāpayatiḥ ālabhatiriva prayujyate |
tasmāt yayā anye nirvapatyādayaḥ karmāntaravidhāne bhavanti, evaṃ taiḥ aviśiṣṭatvāt saṃsthāpayatirapi bhavitumarhatīti |
anijyāṃ ca vanaspateḥ prasiddhāṃ tena darśayati |
bhāṣyam-- prasiddhāṃ vanaspateḥ anijyāṃ ata eva darśayati |

katham ? 'yat tvaṣṭāraṃ ca vanaspatimāvāhayasi, athavaitau yakṣyasi, tvāṣṭrī navamī prayājejyā, vānaspatyā daśamī, atraiva etāviṣṭhau vidyāt' iti aṅgāntareṇa anugrahaṃ bruvan vanaspatījyāyāḥ abhāvaṃ darśayati |
śeṣaparisamāptau satyāṃ 'vanaspatiṃ juhoti' iti vanaspa- tijyā kriyate |
atha parisamāptaṃ pūrvaṃ karma, tato hutā syāt, tatra abhāvadarśanamupapadyate |
bhāṣyam-- atha yaduktaṃ 'saṃsthāpayati iti ca apūrve nopapadyate' iti, tat parihartavyam |
asaṃsthāyāṃ saṃsthāvacanametat, tadapi pūrve pālitamiti samānadevatvāt samāptisāhaśyaṃ jñāyate |
tatra tat pānī- vatamārambham, iha parisamāptamiti |
sa eṣa sādṛśyāt saṃsthāpayatīti śabdaḥ avakalpate iti |
soma-- pūrvādhikaraṇe 'ājyena śeṣaṃ saṃsthāpayati' iti idaṃ liṅgadarśanameva prasaktam, tatra ca yāgāntara- vidhitve eva tasya liṅgasyopapatte iti tasya yāgāntara- vidhitvasamarthanāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu-ājyena śeṣaṃ saṃsthāpayati ityatra ājyaṃ pratinidhiḥ syāt paśudravyasya utsṛṣṭatvena karmaṇaḥ dravyāpekṣatvāt iti |
tatra hi 'pardhami- kṛtaṃ pānīvatamutsṛjati' ityuktvā 'ājyena śeṣaṃ saṃsthā- payati' iti śrutam |
apūrvatve hi śeṣasaṃsthā''nupapatteḥ pardhamīkaraṇavākye pardhamīkaraṇavākye'vahitottarameva pradhāna- yāgakartavyatā apakṛṣya vidhīyate |
tatkaraṇe ca viśvasa- nādipadārthalope'pi anyā''lope pramāṇābhāvāt śeṣaṃ yat sviṣṭhakṛtprayājādi tat ājyena saṃsthāpayatīti vidhīyate |
yadyapi ca prayājādau ājyaṃ prāptameva, tathāpi sviṣṭhakṛdana- spatiyāgadau ājyavidhirna virudhyate |

na ca viśvasanā- bhāvādeva jyaṅgāsaṃbhavāt 'yasya sarvāṇi havīṃṣi' ityanenaiva sviṣṭhakṛtpapi ājyaprāptiḥ śaṅkayā, nāśādinimittā- bhāvena tatprāpteḥ, viśvasanasya aṅgapradhānasādhāraṇyena jyaṅgā- rthamapi prāpyupapatteśca, vanaspatigādau ājyavidherapi upapatteśca |
nahyatra karmāntare kiñcit pramāṇamasti, pratyuta śeṣasaṃsthādyoḥ anupapattiḥ |

iti prāpte, 'yat tvaṣṭāraṃ ca vanaspatimāvāhayasi athavaitau yakṣyasi' iti pṛṣṭe 'tvāṣṭrī navamī prayājejyā, vānaspatyā daśamī atraivaitau iṣṭau nidhāt' iti vanaspatigāsya aṅgāntareṇa anugrahavacanena abhāvāvagateḥ, tasya ca apūrvalambantareṇa anupapatterna pūrvavākye pradhānakarmamātravidhiḥ; api tu tadantāṅgītavidhireva apūrvatvaphalakaḥ |
yadyapi ca akriyamāṇasya vanaspatigāsya devatā''vāhane'pi naiva prāpyate, tathāpi siddhavannirdeśādanupapatteśca āvāhanā- vidhikalpanā |
tvaṣṭustu pradhānadevatātvādeva āvāhanāvarodhaḥ, prakṣepābhāvābhiprāyeṇa ca navamyā anugraha iti |
ataśca pūrvakarmaṇi śeṣābhāvena ājyavidhānānupapatteḥ guṇāt karmāntaramevedaṃ ājyadravyakaṃ anuṣaktanīvedeva upāṃśu- yājaprakṛtikam |
śeṣasaṃsthāśabdau tu pūrvasya karmaṇaḥ asamāptaprayatā kathañcit anuvādako iti |

tvāṣṭrapālīvatapaśuyāgasya pūrvasya karmaṇaḥ 'pardhamīkṛtaṃ pānīvatamutsṛjati' ityanena pardhamīkaraṇānta- syaiva paryavasānavidhānāt pratyānugrahārthe saṃsthāpayatipareṇa pañcamalakāreṇa 'ājyena karoti' ityājyaviśiṣṭakarmā- ntaravidhivadagateḥ śeṣaśabdasya ekāvayavagatopayuktayāvayā- nyāyavattvādājyaviśiṣṭāyāgatvāt taddetakopādhvanito- payuktapānīvatapaśuyāgājyayāgāgye karmāntare tvaṣṭra- panīdevatvasāmyāt tattvadaśe vā śeṣaśabdaprayogaḥ iti navamāntye vakṣyate |
yathā śakunigrāhakasya śakuniṃ jighṛkṣataḥ chadmanā gatirbhavati, śanaiḥ pādanyāsaḥ, dṛṣṭipraṇidhānam, aśabdakaraṇaṃ ca kathamanavabuddhaḥ śakuni- rgṛhyateti |
daṃpatī ubhāvapi svavanto (dravyavanto) ityevaṃ tāvata sthitam |
ataḥ avadayaṃ ca saha palyā yakṣyam |
yada āmayadoṣāt māṃsaṃ vratakārye upādīyate, tadā tad dakṣiṇāgnau śrapayitavyam |
varuṇapraghāseṣu dvau āhavanīyau tatra dakṣiṇe amau uttare''viva sarvaṃ ajñātāta pṛthak kriyate |
dakṣiṇavihāre kartavyāyāḥ māsya āmiṣāyāḥ phalaṃ prati acodanā, na codanā, : vidhānam |
kiṃtu varuṇapraghāsān prati mārutyāśraudanā tathā ca karmaṇaḥ acodanāt aṅgānāṃ prāptireva nāsti kutastantram |
paurṇamāsyāṃ 'paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsā yajeta' iti na tāvat karma phalaṃ prati codyate, atha ca sāṅgaprāyaḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ kriyate, evamihāpi |
yajeta ityā- khyātena .prayogacodanā paurṇamāsyāḥ prayogasya codanā kṛtā, prayogaśca aṅgapradhānānāṃ bhavati |
tathā paurṇamāsīvat iha mārutyāmapi ‘aṣṭāvaśvayukttare vihāraṃ havīṃṣyāsādayati, mālṭīmeva pratiprakhyātā dakṣiṇasmin ’ iti āsādayati-śabdena nirvapet ālameta itivat lakṣaṇayā yāga eva codyate |
paurṇamāsyāṃ yajeta iti padena yāga ucyate |
‘mārutī pratiprakhyātā āsādayati ’ iti āsāda- yati-padena na yāga ucyate kiṃtu āsādanaṃ sthāpanam |
yadyapi āsādayatiśabdena āsādanamucyate tathāpi tat homārthameva nādṛṣṭārtham |
uttareṇa ‘aṣṭāvattare vihāre havīṃṣyāsādayati ’ ityanena uttaravihāraviṣayakeṇa vākyena saha ‘mārutīmeva pratiprakhyātā dakṣiṇasmin ’ iti dakṣiṇavihāraviṣayakavākyasya eka- vākyatvāt |
tathā ca ubhayatrāpi āsādayati-padena uktamāsādanaṃ homārthameva |
vastutastu āsādayati-padena homārthasya āsādanasya avācyatvāt ihaviṣāṃ vedyāmāsādanasya prakṛtita eva prāptatvāt |
tasmāt āsādayati-padena nirvapet ālameta itivat lakṣaṇayā yāga evocyate |
āsādayati-padaṃ lakṣaṇayā yāgaprayogaparaṃ ityatra tātparya- grāhakamāha siddhāntī |
‘yadevādhvaryuḥ karoti, tat prati- prakhyātā karoti ’ iti āmnāyasya vedasya vacanaṃ tadvat uttaravihāravat dakṣiṇe vihāre'pi anuṣṭhānaṃ brūte |
tasmāt dakṣiṇavihāre'pi ajñānāṃ pṛthaganuṣṭhānaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
dakṣiṇadeśāṃnirgataḥ prāṅmukha vā udaṅmukha vā avasthitaḥ āhīnebukādīn karotyeva |
vi. 1|3|5 varṇakaṃ 2. dakṣiṇavihāre kriyamāṇamārutyarthe pṛthaganuṣṭhānaṃ varuṇapraghāseṣu cāturmāsyeṣu |
bhā. 1|2|1|13-43, dakṣiṇavihāre pratiprakhyātā adhvaryoḥ mantroccāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ varuṇapraghāseṣu cāturmāsyeṣu |
1|2|1|9|18, dakṣiṇavihāre mārutyasya haviṣyo'rthena varuṇapraghāseṣu agnimanyathāḥ punarvidhānaṃ cāturmāsyeṣu |
dakṣiṇā ayutaṃ abhi- becanīye rājasūyāntargataṃ somāyāge |
vi. 1|1|42, dakṣiṇā aśvamedhe ‘hiraṇmayo prākāśo adhvaryave dadāti ’ |
anyeyyastu ṛtvigbhyaḥ yathāyathaṃ deyameva, na tasya bādhaḥ |
anayā prākṛtasya anvāhārthasya nivṛttiḥ ( atra dayāmākāgrayaṇe vāso dakṣiṇā, brīhyāgrayaṇe ca vatsaḥ prathamajo dakṣiṇā ) |

yatra hi pādikamapi ahaḥ na labhyate na sā dakṣiṇā bhavati |
na hi sā tasmin karmaṇi dakṣaṃ karoti |
dakṣa balam yā na āśitamabhavaṃ ( ahorātrayorjaṭharapūrtiparyāsam karoti nāsau calakaraṇī |
tasmāt yā na āśitamabhava nāsau dakṣiṇā |
tasmāt āśitamabhavaṃ yad dravyam, sā bhūti sā dakṣiṇā |
dakṣiṇā rāja sūyate prathame trike ‘saumāpauṣṇa ekādaśakapālaḥ aindrā pauṣṇaścaraḥ, pauṣṇaścaraḥ śyāmo dakṣiṇā ’ iti |
dvitīyaṃ tu trike ‘āmāvaiṣṇava ekādaśakapālaḥ, aindrāvaiṣṇavaścaruḥ vaiṣṇavikapālaḥ, vāmano dakṣiṇā ’ iti |
bhā. 10|3|5|30-33, dakṣiṇā naimittikā ekādirupayā jyotiṣṭome nityaprayogīya- dvādaśaśatasaṃkhyāmātra vācaḥ yathā somāpadvāre |

dakṣiṇā saumikyā somādveṣṭisu śeṣa- bhakṣaṇāṃ prasaṅgasiddhināsti |

10|3|13|53-55. dakṣiṇāyāḥ bhṛti- rūpatvaṃ vedavākyadevāvagamyate 'dīkṣitamadīkṣitā dakṣiṇā- parikrītā ṛtvijo yājayeyuḥ' iti |
vi. 10|28. dakṣiṇānāṃ aparimitatvaṃ pūrvoktāt saṃkhyā'nantaraṃ ādhāne |

dakṣiṇānāṃ dakṣiṇadāduttaradeśe nayanaṃ pratyahaṃ vibhajya pauṇḍarīke |

12|4|15. dvādaśaśataṃ gāvaḥ ityudāhṛtaśrutivākye gośabdā- bhāve'pi tatra nirdiṣṭā dvādaśasaṃkhyā 'gośvāśvataraśva gardabhaśca' ityādi pūrvasaṃdarbhaprakṛtaviṣayā iti dakṣiṇā- 'dhikaraṇe nirṇītatvāt gāvaḥ ityuktam |
parimalaḥ. 3|3|12 vas. dakṣiṇā'ntargatagoṣveva dvādaśaśatasaṃkhyāniveśaḥ na tu aśvādau jyotiṣṭome |
bhā. 6|7|78-83. 'dakṣiṇācāreṇa kartavyam' ityādismṛtiḥ vedā- viruddhatvāt pramāṇam |
bhā. 1|3|15-7. dakṣiṇāmnānāṃ vikṛtau codakena prāptaṃ bādhitvā niveśite virodhāt |
11|4|5|18. dakṣiṇākāle yat svaṃ, tat pratīyate taddāna- saṃyogāt |
viśvajiti adhvare dakṣiṇākāle dakṣiṇādānakāle mādhyaṃdine savane yat svaṃ svīyaṃ dhanam, tat sarvaṃ sarvasva- śabdena pratīyate |
'sarvasvaṃ dadāti' iti sarvasvaśabdena dakṣiṇākāle svatvena vidyamānasyaiva deyatvena uktatvāt |
tena bhūtasya bhaviṣyato vā na deyatā kathaṃcidapi |
ke. dakṣiṇākāle vidyamānasyaiva sarvasvasya viśvajiti dānam |
bhā. 10|2|15|45-46, dakṣiṇādānaṃ ṛtvikpari- krayārthe udavasānīye, tasya satrāntratvāt |
ubhayasamuccaye siddhe, yā adhikā dakṣiṇā dīyate sā yathā pratijanikā syāt, tathā deyā, 'yo'gniṃ cinute taṃ dakṣiṇāmiḥ rādhayet' iti śruteḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 11|18. dakṣiṇādānena karmakaraṇāmṛtvijāṃ parikrayaḥ yajamānena kartavyaḥ |
dakṣiṇādānasya 3|8|1, dakṣiṇādānasya yajamānakarmatve'pi vacanāt kacit svayamātṛṇṇākhyeṣakopadhāne gotryadānamadhyayoḥ karma |
bhāṣyam- asti jyotiṣṭomaḥ 'jyotiṣṭomena svarga- kāmo yajeta' iti |
tatredaṃ samāmananti 'gośvāśvaśva- taraśva gardabhaścāśvāśvayava vrīhayaśca tilāśca māṣāśca tasya dvādaśaśataṃ dakṣiṇā' |
idaṃ cāparaṃ śrūyate, 'ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ dānaṃ dharmamātram, uta ṛtvigdānamiti |
ṛtvigdānaṃ kartavyamathaiva te dadātītyete, iti sāmarthyādeva na āna- manādi |
api ca karmānurūpamapi dākṣiṇyaṃ kacit śrūyate, vaidhātavīyāyāṃ sahasram, ṛtapeye somamadasaḥ |
api ca yajñocanīcaṇyapaṇyaṃ kriyate, sa parikrayo bhavati, na yatra niyataparimāṇaṃ dānam |
kacicca śrūyate 'daṇḍaḥ, upānahī, śuṣkā iti; sā hi dakṣiṇā' iti |
tatra dṛṣṭaṃ prayojanamujjhya na śakyamahaṃ kalpayitum |
anena niyatena niyataguṇakena dānena ānamyamā ṛtvijaḥ abhyudayakāriṇo bhavanti |
katham ? ānamya guṇabhūtaḥ tyāgaścetyate, na pradhānabhūtaḥ |
apica bhavati tatra yā yāvatī ca ānamanamātrā |
loke''pi hi kāṣṭhavāhaprabhṛti- yadīyata, tadasaṃkīrtita'pi parikraye, ānamanārthame bhavati |
bhāṣyam- dakṣiṇāyāyuccavanāca liṅgāt parikrayā dānamiti paśyāmaḥ |
dakṣiṇāyuktā vahanti ṛtvija iti na cānyenānamyeta parikrayāt karmaṇaḥ |
kutaḥ ? nānyena parikrayaṃ parārthaṃ paraḥ pravartate |
bhāṣyam- parikrītavacanaṃ bhavati, tenāyam dolyate 'dīkṣitamadīkṣitā dakṣiṇāparikrītā ṛtvi yājayanti' iti |
'yajño vai devatā na samabhavat, taṃ bhūtvā samabhāvayan |
yadbhūtvā vanute yajñasya bhṛtye dvādaśaśatīdīkṣito bhṛti vannīta' iti yajñārthe yaddiṣṭaṃ ṛtvijaḥ parikrayetum, anyacca yajñā sādhayitum, tasminneva bhṛtivacanam |
'yathā vai dāśahāro naiṣkṛtyena niṣkṛtanabhūtaḥ karmayoge vartate, evaṃ vā ete yajñasya ṛtvijaḥ' iti |
yathā'sau, evamṛtvija iti bruvan parikrayārthe dānaṃ darśayati |
soma- nyāyeścādhopa ṛtvijasya satre na bādhaḥ |
ityarthite : sūtrārthastu-ṛtvigbhyo dānaṃ dharmamātramadṛṣṭārthameva syāt, dadātisāmarthyāt, dadātīti samānapalakṣaṇaśrutisāmarthyena dānasyaiva kartavyatvāva- gamāditi |
vacanāt tena satreṣu svāmināṃ na bhṛtiḥ kaścit |
' evaṃ ca sati satre ṛtvijāṃ yajamānatvāt bhṛtirūpā dakṣiṇā na kā'pi deyā iyetat vicāraphalaṃ draṣṭavyam |
bhāṭṭa- 'ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti' iti tatratatra śrutaṃ dakṣiṇādānaṃ narādupakārakam, api tu dṛṣṭārthatva- lābhāya apekṣitatatyameva |
ataḥ satre svata evānatatvena na tasiddhayarthe dakṣiṇādānamiti siddham |
ata eva 'nātra gordīyate' iti nityānuvāde'pi vidhvantaraśeṣatvāt saṃgacchate |
bhā. 10|2|7|62. dakṣiṇābhedena kartṛṇāṃ medāt ajñāni micyante |
upacitagatena dakṣiṇābhedena prayogamedā- vagamāt ajñānī medaḥ |
vāmanakrītāḥ pūrvasya trisaṃyuktasya kartāraḥ, anaṅgaṃ te uttarasya trisaṃyu- kasya |
śyāmaparikrītāḥ uttarasya trisaṃyuktasya kartāraḥ, te'pi anaṅgaṃ pūrvasya |
bhā. 11|4|12, dakṣiṇā- medaminnānāṃ āgnāvaiṣṇavādīnāṃ medenānuṣṭhānaṃ rājasūye |
atra āpastambasūtraṃ ( tai. saṃ. bhāṣye 113|6 ) itthaṃ - dakṣiṇākāle satadaśa rathān dadāti, satadaśa anāṃsi, satadaśāśvān, satadaśa hastinaḥ, satadaśa niṣkān satadaśa dāsīḥ |
satadaśa vāsāṃsi, satadaśa gavāṃ śatāni iti |
dakṣiṇārūpāṇāṃ gavāśvāśvatarādimāṣāntānāṃ saṅkhyā ekā dakṣiṇā jyoti- ṣṭome |
yadā dravye upasarja- nībhūtaḥ, tadā dravyasyaiva yalliṅgasaṅkhyaṃ tadeva labhate |
dakṣiṇāśabdasya dakṣiṇā'vayave brahmabhāge niveśamāno gauṇaḥ syāt |
na ca vidyamāne mukhye gauṇa upādīyate |
saṃkarpa. gataśriyāṃ tu karmakāle gārhapatyāt pratyuddharaṇa- 3|2|6, dakṣiṇāgneḥ karmakāle gārhapatyāt pratyuddharaṇa- meva, na tu punaḥ punarādhānam |
'dakṣiṇāgnau anvāhārya ( nāma dakṣiṇāyai caruṃ ) pacanti' ata evātrau 'anvāhāryapacanaḥ' ityucyate |
dakṣiṇāgnau kartavyau piṣṭalepakaraṇa- homo khyānāveva jyotiṣṭome āgnimāttādūrdhvamanujā-
yathā pūrve tamo'vagāhate, apa praviśati, gāṃ ca sarve ca vārayati, avalambanaṃ bhavati |
daṇḍasya bhūtabhābhyupayogi tvena saṃbhavatyapi bhāṣyatve maitrāvaruṇāya iti caturthya 'daṇḍī praiṣānnāha' iti praiṣāṇuvacanakartṛtvena bhābhyu payogitvena maitrāvaruṇasyaivābhyupagamyam |
yathā daṇḍadaṇḍāpānāṃ daṇḍā nayanāt avaśyamānayanam, tathā yugandavahādīnāni iti kecidāhuḥ |
vastutastu ekatra sthāpitayordaṇḍā pūpayoḥ yadā apūpo nāsti daṇḍastu mukhairbhavati vartate tatra yathā mūṣakāṇāṃ duṣkaradaṇḍabhakṣaṇasiddhau taḥsahacaritā pūpabhakṣaṇamapi sidhyati iti |
sthāvarasya tu sarvasya na pitā : pitāmahaḥ |
' iti smṛtau sthāvaragrahaṇāt nindhanadvipayo daṇḍāpūpanyāyāt dānādiniṣedhasiddhiriti |
tasmāt laukikaparamārthajagatameva idaṃpadāspade svarūpeṇa niṣidhyate ityeva tattvaprācāmācāryāṇāṃ vācāmarthaḥ |
tatra amavādhavaidhadhikaraṇyādidopastu daṇḍāpūpanyāyena mamanu- kūla eveti |
daṇḍā- pūpikanyāye 'keśarinamapi hanyāt' ityādi keśari- hantyavaṃ, anyeṣāṃ satvānāṃ ca hantuṃ labhyate |
kaimu- tikanyāye tu anyāye tātparyaṃ paryavasīyate svāye niṣedhaśca bhavati |
tadyathā kaściducyate anuvākaḥ triḥ paṭhyatāṃ iti |
yathā dagdhānīndhanāni yena so'gniryathā svayameva praśāmyatīti |
agninā dagdhe'pi paṭe yathā cihnaṃ dagdhaṃ na bhavati, evaṃ nahe'pi sarvapadārthe abhimāno vidyate eva, evaṃviṣaye'yaṃ pravartate iti |
ata eva avidyā dagdhapaṭanyāyena tāvat tiṣṭhati ityapi nirastam |
na ca dagdhapaṭanyāyena jīvanmuktasya dehendriyādibhedajñānasaṃbhava iti vācyam |
yathā patrasya dagdhe'pi pūrvā- kāreṇāvasthānaṃ gṛhyate, evaṃ yatra vastuno dāhe'pi tadākāra- pratītiḥ, tatrāsya pravṛttiḥ |
yathā dagdhasya bījasya nāṅkurotpādakatā, evamavivekanāśe na saṃsāravṛkṣaprarohaḥ ityevaṃ yatra vivakṣā, tatrāsya pravṛttiriti |
yathā dagdharajjuḥ pūrvavat triguṇatvā- dirūpeṇa pratīyamānā'pi niḥsārā budhyate budhaiḥ, tathā prapañcaṃ saṃsāraṃ pratīyamānamapi niḥsāraṃ vetti budha iti |
' yathā gargāḥ śataṃ daṇḍayantīti gargasamudāye daṇḍaḥ |
daṇḍaḥ dīkṣāsaṃskāravyañjakaḥ na tu yajamānasya saṃskārakaḥ |
bhā. 10|5|25|83. daṇḍakalitavat abhyāsaḥ gavā- mayane dvādaśāhāt prāptāsu vyanīkāsu pūrvapakṣe svasthāna- vivṛddhyā siddhānte |
yo hyucyate 'trinuvākaḥ paṭhyatām' iti sa āditā ārabhya parisamāpya punarādita ārabhate iti daṇḍakalitavadāhutiḥ |
5|3|12|3 yathā daṇḍena bhūmadeśaṃ saṃmimānaḥ puruṣaḥ āmulāgraṃ kṛtsnaṃ daṇḍaṃ punaḥpunaḥ pātayati, na tu daṇḍasya pratyavayavaṃ putrāvṛtti karoti tadvat |
vi. 5|3|2. daṇḍakalitavat na upasadāṃ ṣaṭtvādisaṃkhyasampattiḥ, kiṃtu svasthānavivṛddhyā agni- cayane |
bhā. 5|3|13. daṇḍakalitavat: pratiṣedho yathā karmapradīpe 'yajñanīye- 'hi somaśraddhāruṇyāṃ diśi dṛśyate |
atra pūrvadine anvādhāne daṇḍavidhiva kalpyaḥ, tena tu niṣedhaḥ kalpyate |
yathā daṇḍacakrastailalidā- ghaṃṭatvācenakcharmavicchinnaṃ prati kāraṇatvam, evaṃ vivakṣāyā- masya pravṛttiḥ |
etena kāvyamātre adṛṣṭasya kāraṇatā, adṛṣṭyābhyapratibhānāṃ ca daṇḍacakranyāyena kāraṇateti kāvyaprakāśoktiḥ parāsteti gāgābhaṭṭāḥ |
daṇḍadānaṃ maitrāvaruṇāya agnīṣomīyavikāre niruḍha- paśau asatyapi daṇḍotpatyupādānayoḥ prayojakam, tatpālanasya tu aprayojakaṃ tadabhāvāt |
bāla. pṛ. 107. daṇḍadānaṃ maitrāvaruṇasatkārāyā arthakarma, na tu pratipattiḥ |
jyotiṣome maitrā- varuṇāya daṇḍadānaṃ saṃskārakamarthakarma, na pratipattiḥ |
yā taṇvai, yā tūṇve, yā vīṇāyām |
tathā 'krīte some maitrāvaruṇāya daṇḍaṃ prayacchati' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ dīkṣitadhāraṇe śeṣabhūtasya maitrā- varuṇadhāraṇaṃ pratipattiḥ athavā arthakarmeti |
'daṇḍena dīkṣayati' iti śeṣabhūtasya anyatra vyāpāre pratipattinyāyā |
yathā 'cātvāle kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāṃ prāsyati' iti kaṇḍyane śeṣabhūtāyāḥ prāsanaṃ pratipattiḥ |
ṭup- dānasya maitrāvaruṇaḥ prayojakaḥ, kṛṣṇaviṣāṇā cātvāle pratipādyā iti pratipattiḥ |
kiṃ somalisānāṃ avabhṛthagamanaṃ pratipādanam, uta arthakarmeti ( 4|2|18 ityatra ) |
deśārthyā avabhṛtha- śrutiḥ ( ityukte ) deśasaṃbandhāt ( deśaprapañcāt ) anyo- 'pi deśaḥ ( samādiḥ manasi ) viparītavarmanaḥ ( kālaḥ kartā ca ) cintyate kiman
bhāṭṭa— some 'daṇḍena dīkṣayati' ityanena daṇḍasya dīkṣā'bhivyañjakatvaṃ vidhāya 'krīte some maitrāvaruṇāya daṇḍaṃ prayacchati' iti śrutam|
tatra pūrvavadeva dvitīyā- saṃyogāt maitrāvaruṇasaṃbandhidānaṃ daṇḍapratipattiḥ|
ata eva dīkṣitadaṇḍasya dānamātreṇa pratipattisiddhernārthavat sa eva daṇḍo 'daṇḍī preṣānanvāha' ityanena preṣānuvacane viniyujyate|
tena na preṣānuvacanaṃ daṇḍasya prayojakamiti niruddhapakṣādavāpi na tadanuṣṭheyam|

iti prāpte, 'karmaṇā yamabhipreti sa saṃpradānam' iti smṛtyā kriyāṃ prati vyāpyamānaṃ karmakārakaṃ pratyapi saṃpradānasya vyādhyamānatvāttvervinicchalena kasya- cidvyāpyamānasya īpsitatve kalpamāne 'vyāpyavyāpyasya sutarāṃ vyāpyatvam' iti nyāyena maitrāvaruṇasya eva upayogāddeśyatvam|
yadyevaṃ cālambhanaṃ daṇḍasya prayojanamiti nādṛṣṭārtha- tvamapi|
na caivaṃ 'daṇḍa' iti dvitīyā'nupapattiḥ; saktuvat karaṇatvalakṣaṇārthatvāt|
yattu mūle anīpsita- karmatvena tadupapattirityuktam, tat śruterapi 'tṛtīyā ca hocchandasi' ityādismṛtyā sakarmakatvāt|
sakṛdapi tadāpatteḥ anīpsitakarmatve'pi ca uddeśyatvekamanimitta- avāt vā daṇḍasya anīpsitakarmatvenaiva anvayaḥ|
saṃpra- dānasya tu satyapi prādhānye saṃpradānatvenaiva anvayācca dvikarmakatvātpattirapi bodhyam|
ataśca daṇḍaviśiṣṭa- dānasya upayogāpekṣāyāṃ 'daṇḍī preṣānanvāha' ityādinā preṣānuvacanethatvena viniyujyate|
ato niruddhapakṣādau dīkṣāsomabhāvāde'pi daṇḍadānānuṣṭhānaṃ tasya preṣānu- vacanaprayuktatvāttupapannam|
dānasya daṇḍaṃ prati arthakarmatve- 'pi dīkṣādaṇḍasya kathaṃ dānāṅgatvam|
nahi svatvatyāge kṛte yajamāne svayaṃ punargrahaṇe śakyam|
daṇḍakārye dīkṣā'bhivyañjakāllamvanaṃ na paraprāptiḥ; yenopā- dānalakṣaṇānurodhena prakṛtaḥ|
na ca dāna- vidhimanurodhena kāryasaṃkocaḥ; tasya laukikadaṇḍe'pi upa- padyate|
śrautavidhairyatkarmatve'pi asaṅka- prayājaśeṣābhidhāraṇanyāyena ārthikadānapratipattidhanvantara- kalpatayā prakṛte'pi kāryasaṃkocopapattiḥ|
na cātra madhye pratipatyapekṣā'bhāvena kalpakābhāvāttanyāyavilakṣaṇam, dānavidherdaṇḍāntaraprayojakatvaśaktikalpanābhiyā kārya- saṃkocamaṅgīkṛtyā madhye tadapekṣopapatteḥ|
dṛṣṭa loke anyānurodhenāpi avaśyapekṣitaviṣaye svakāryasaṃkocena akāle eva tadapakarṣaḥ|
śakyate cātra svavākyātgāsya maitrāvaruṇopakārakatvābhāvāt tadaṃśe daṇḍapratiparthyatvaṃ vaktum|

atra eva sarve sarveṣāṃ daṇḍānāṃ dānam, evaṃ ca paramayukttadaṇḍajīvivāca śrautadānavidheḥ preṣānuvacanā- devaṃ dīkṣādaṇḍasyeṣṭe daṇḍāntarānākṣepakatvam, tantrāśādau tu daṇḍāntarākṣepakatvaṃ akṣāmyañjananyāyena (4|1|10) iṣṭameva|
śrautadānavidhau ekākṣaśravaṇādekadaṇḍadānameva maitrāvaruṇopakārakatvamiti sarve preṣānuvacane eka daṇḍa ityapi bodhyam|
idaṃ ca dīkṣitadaṇḍaprāpakavacanasya pārtha- sārathyadīmīmāṃsaikairilikhitatvāt tadabhāvamabhipretyo- ktam|

vastutastu taittirīyaśākhāyām 'yadīkṣitadaṇḍaṃ prayacchati' iti sārthavādavākyatvāntaraśravaṇāt 'krīte' iti dīkṣitadaṇḍarahitavākye pratipattivvinyatatvakalpane'pi na kṣatiḥ; taittirīyavākyenaiva maitrāvaruṇapadāśravaṇena dānasya pratipattisiddheḥ|
krītavākye tu maitrāvaruṇapada- śravaṇena tadvādhāttvānyāyeḥ tadupakārārthatvameva|
ataśca taittirīyavākye yacchateḥ saṃpradānāpekṣāyāṃ krītavākye satvatantradaṇḍasyekṣatvakalpanāgauravaparihārāt paraspara- pekṣatayā dīkṣitadaṇḍasyaiva maitrāvaruṇopakārārthatvasiddhiḥ|
na ca taittirīyavākye krītavākyavihitadaṇḍe eva dīkṣāsaṃbandha- vidhānopapatteḥ na pratipattivākyamiti vācyam|
ataḥ ubhayatrāpi dānavidhiḥ; tatra ca dīkṣitadaṇḍayuktavākye pratipattividhiraiva, saṃpradānāśravaṇāt dīkṣitapadaśravaṇācca|
tathathā kaṅkaṭakāya dadham, nāpitāya dadhaṃ iti |
bhā. 10|8|2|32. dadhi agnihotrahome nityaṃ naimittikaṃ ca ubhaya- vidham |
8|2|3|16. ‘dadhi madhu ghṛtamāpo dhānāstaṇḍulāsta- staṃsuṣṭaṃ prājāpatyam’ ityatra madhuni udake ca ājyadharmāḥ kartavyāḥ |
vi. 8|1|19. dabhendriyakāmasya juhuyāt iti agnihotrāt na karmāntaram |
vi. 2|2|11. dabhendriyakāmasya juhu- yāt ityatra prakaraṇaprāptamapi sannaṃ homameva dhāturunadati, na vidhānārthamapi anyadeva gamanādi dhātvarthāntaraṃ bravīti |
vā. 3|2|7|4 pṛ. 722. dabhendriyakāmasya juhu- yāt ityatra homasaṃbandhāt dadhyāderguṇāt phalaṃ na tu dadhi- guṇakaṃ homāntaram |
bhā. 2|2|125, ‘dadhnā juhuyāt’ iti na karmāntaram, kiṃtu agnihotre eva guṇavidhiḥ vaikalpikaḥ |
vāla. pṛ. 140. ‘dadhnā juhuyāt’ ityādi dadhyādidravyasya akriyārūpatve'pi kriyāviśeṣatayā vidheyatā |
vi. 5|1|1 varṇaka 2, ‘dadhnā juhuyāt’ ‘dabhendriyakāmasya’ iti vākyābhyāṃ agnihotre dadhnaḥ kāmyatvaṃ nityatvaṃ cāviddham |
4|3|3, ‘dadhnā juhuyāt’, ‘śrīhibhiryajeta’ ityādi dadho trīhīṇāṃ ca guṇatvena vidhiḥ, yāganāmātvātsaṃbhavāt |
9|1|8. dadhnaḥ avadānābhighāraṇādanāni paścāt āgne- yasya tu pūrvam, mukhyakramasya pravṛttikamāt balīyastvāt |

bhā. 5|4|2|4-4. dadhnaḥ ekasya krayārthatve puruṣārthatve ca ‘dadhnā juhoti’ ‘dabhendriyakāmasya juhuyāt’ iti saṃyoga- pṛthaktvaṃ kāraṇaṃ ityukte, ‘śeṣa iti cet’ (4|3|6) iti sūtreṇa ‘dadhnā juhoti’ iti vihitasya dadhnaḥ phalā- pekṣayā itareṇa indriyaphalavakteḥ ekavākyatvāt saṃyoga- pṛthaktvābhāvāmāśaṅkaya, ‘nāryapṛthaktvāt’ (4|3|7) iti sūtreṇa homāthatvena vihitasya dadhnaḥ phalākāṅkṣatvāt ekavākyatvābhāvaṃ vakṣyati |
su. pṛ. 827. dadhnaḥ eṣa svabhāvaḥ, yat pūrvairguruprakrāntaṃ aparedyurabhinivartate |
ayaṃ agnīṣomīyaḥ paśuḥ, sāṃnāyyamadhye yat dadhi tasya dadhnaḥ vikāraḥ syāt |
na dadhi prakṛtiḥ, kiṃtu payoḥ prakṛtiḥ payaḥ, kālasāmānyāt |
payasaḥ paśoḥ ānantarya avyavahitatvam, dadhastu payasā vyavahitatvam |
‘etasmā- dapi hetoḥ payaḥ antaraṅgaṃ bhavati iti tadeva paśoḥ prakṛtiḥ, na dadhi |
nanu agnīṣomīyasya paśoḥ payo na prakṛtiḥ payo hi dravam |
na, yadyapi paśo kiṃyāścit bhāgaḥ ghanaḥ, tathāpi kiṃyāścit bhāgaḥ dravoḍapi vartata eva |
iti payasaḥ dravatvaṃ paśordravatvaṃ aviśiṣṭaṃ samānameva |
tassāt agnīṣomīyasya paśoḥ aiṣṭikasāṃnāyyaika- deśasya payaso vidhyantaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. dadhani ijyārthe praṇītāpadharmāḥ pāke upakurvanti |
sāmidhenīṣu- ‘ṛci praṇavaṃ dadhāti’ iti vidhānāt prayujyamante praṇavaḥ prayojyaḥ |
sa ca kuṇḍavadaranyāyena ṛgakṣarasaṃmiśro vā dadhnisitānyāyena tatsaṃmiśro veti dadhrā'pi saṃbhavati |
bhā. 9|4|14-42, ‘dadhaścaram’ iti dadhani pradeyadharmā na bhaveyuḥ |
agnihotre ‘dadhnā juhoti’ iti nityārthe sat, ‘dabhendriyakāmasya juhuyāt’ iti naimittikārtham |
yadudeśapravṛtta- kṛtivyāpyaṃ yasya, tat tasya prayojyam |
nanu dadhikṣīranyāyatvaṃ svasva- rūpaparityāgarūpāntarapariṇāmaḥ iti cet |
(dadhirūpaparityāgapūrvakaḥ dadhirūpeṇa kṣīrasya pariṇāmo bhavati na svarūpaparityāga) |
etadapūrvaviṣaye'syaḥ pūrva pāṭhāt ‘jyeṣṭho vā eṣa grahāṇām’ iti śrutyā'pi sarvagrahaprāthyokteḥ |

prathamotpannasyaiva jyeṣṭhatvena vyavahārāt iti prāpte, brāhmaṇa- kramānmantrakramasya balavatvāt upāṃśādimantrottarameva dadhi- ahamantrapāṭhāt praśaṃsāyāmeva jyeṣṭhatvavidhānena ‘jyeṣṭhā vā etā brāhmaṇāḥ vidāmakan’ ityādāviva jyeṣṭhatvasya prāthamyavācakatvābhāvāt upāṃśādibhyaḥ parata eva tadijyā |
eta eva gavāmayanatve dadhigrahasyāpradarśanārthaḥ athaivādaḥ ‘yathā gāvaḥ saṃjānānāḥ saṃgacchamānāḥ saṃgamyā- nyonyaṃ ghnanti’ ityādiḥ saṃgacchate |

ke. dadhigrahaḥ nitya eva jyotiṣṭome ‘yāṃ vai kācidadhvaryurdevatāmantaritaḥ tasya āvṛcchayate, yat prājāpatyaṃ dadhigrahaṃ gṛhṇāti, śamayatye vainam’ ‘jyeṣṭho vā eṣa grahāṇām’ iti devatākṣobha tatsamādhānopanyāsastu vidhyedadhigrahastathye arthavādaḥ vi. 4|4|15.

tatrāya eva ‘dadhigrahaṃ gṛhṇīyāt paśukāmasya’ iti paṭhite vidhe api utkanayāyena karmāntaratve prāpte, lāghavāt phaloddeśena dhātvarthavidhimātram, guṇapadaṃ tu anuvāda vihitasya punaḥphalāya vidhānāt saṃyogapṛthaktvena aindra vāyavyāvatavat nityakāmyatvam |
jyotiṣṭome ‘prājāpatyaṃ dadhigrahaṃ gṛhṇāti’ iti śrutam ṣoḍaśaṃ dadhigrahaḥ kiṃ nityaḥ naimittiko veti vicāraḥ |
śrutisaṃyogāt ‘yāṃ vai kācidadhvaryu yajamānaśca devatāmantaritaḥ tasyā āvṛcchayate, yat prājāpatyaṃ grahaṃ gṛhṇāti śamayatyevainam’ iti śrutyā saṃyogāna śrutyā nimittatvena uktatvāt |
‘jyeṣṭho vā eṣa grahā yaddigrahaḥ’ iti dadhigrahe jyeṣṭhaśabdaprayogāt |
‘sarveṣāṃ vaitad devāna rūpam, yadeṣa grahaḥ’ iti dadhigrahasya sarvadevatārūpatāya uktatvāt nityatvamasya |
nityo vā syādarthavādāt tayoḥ karmaṇya- sambandhād, bhaṅgilābhānttarāyasya |
dadhigrahaḥ nitya eva syāt jyeṣṭhaśabdarūpāt sarvadevatāsārūpyapāca arthavādāt |
yattu prathamapūrvapakṣe śrutisaṃyoge uktaḥ tatrāha, karmaśabdenātra kriyate iti karmamyutpatyā phalaṃ gṛhyate |
tayoḥ adhvaryuyajamānayoḥ karmaṇi devatāntaraya- prayuktadoṣaparihārarūpe kadācitke phale dadhigrahasya sādhana- tayā asambandhāt saṃndhābhāvāt nityānityasaṃyoga- virodhāt |
tathā ca nitya eva dadhigrahaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
jyotiṣṭome śrutaṃ 'yāṃ vā adhvaryur yajamānaśca devatāntaritaḥ tasyā āvṛtyasye yat prājāpatyaṃ dadhigrahaṃ gṛhṇāti śamayatyenām' iti |
atra devatāntarāyo nimittaṃ pūrvapakṣavat cchandatvāt iti pūrvapakṣe, siddhānti- tam |
akartusamānādhikaraṇasya yacchandasya nimittatā pratipādakatvābhāvāt arthavādamātraṃ antarāyaśravaṇaṃ iti nityo dadhigrahaḥ iti |
bāla. pṛ. 55. dadhigrahasya ijyā upāṃśvādibhyaḥ parata eva |
bhāṣyam-- jyotiṣṭome śrūyate 'yāṃ vai kāṃci- dadhvaryur yajamānaśca devatāntaritasyā āvṛtyasye, yat prājāpatyaṃ dadhigrahaṃ gṛhṇāti, śamayatyenām' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ nityo dadhigrahaḥ, uta naimittika iti |
kiṃ prāptam ? dadhigraho naimittikaḥ syāt, śrutisaṃyogāt |
bhāṣyam-- yaduktaṃ naimittika iti, tat gṛhyate kintu nityaśca |
jyeṣṭhaśabdo bhavati, 'jyeṣṭho vā eṣa grahāṇāṃ yasyaiva gṛhyate, jyeṣṭhameva gacchati' iti |
vinā'pi nimittena prahītavyaḥ; nimitte- nāpi punariti |
bhāṣyam-- sarvarūpatā ca śrūyate 'sarveṣāṃ vaitaddevānāṃ, rūpaṃ yadeṣa graho, yasyaiṣa gṛhyate sarvaṇyeva rūpāṇi paśu- nāmupatiṣṭhante' iti |
nahi devatārūpamasmākaṃ kiñcidanyat pratyakṣam, anyadato nityatvāt |
nityo vā syādarthavādāt tayoḥ karmaṇyasambandhād, bhaṅgistvāccānttarāyasya |
bhāṣyam-- yadyuktaṃ nityo naimittikaśceti, tatra nitya eva syāt |
yaduktaṃ devatā'- ntarāye nimitte śrūyate iti |
nahi etat śrūyate adhvaryuṇā devatā antara- tasya yajamānena veti |
na caivaṃ śabdo'sti, 'antarāye sati dadhigraho grahītavyaḥ' iti |
vinaiva saṃyogena dadhigrahasya grahaṇam, antarāyasamādhānaṃ tu asya prayojanamiti |
tatra prayojane anityavādat grahaṇe nityavaccu- tirbādhyate |
bhaṅgī cānttarāyaḥ : anilo nitya- pratīsāryai saṃkīryate |
tasmānna doṣaḥ : nitya eva dadhigraha iti |
ata āha-- na caivaṃ śabdo'sti yo nimittaṃ pratipādayatīti |
ato yadā jyotiṣṭomastadā nimittasya vidyamānatvāt grahaṇam |
anityasya ca (anta- rāyasya ) artheneti pūrvamuttareṇa na saṃdhyate |
na cedak vacanamasti, antarāyaḥ kārya iti, yena karma gṛhyeta taccobhayamapi nāstītyuktameva |
tasmādabhyarūpaḥ syāt nanvevaṃ nitya eva saḥ |
soma-- āmanahomānāṃ phalaśrutisaṃyogābhāvāt phalārthatvāve'pi dadhigrahasya nimittaśrutisaṃyogāt naimittikatvaṃ iti pratyavasthānaṃ saṃgatiḥ |
' bhāṭṭa-- home 'yāṃ vai kāṃścit adhvaryuśca yajamānaśca devatāntaritasyā āvṛtyasye prājāpatyaṃ dadhigrahaṃ gṛhṇīyāt' iti dadhigraho naimittika eva |

yadyapi cāyaṃ yacchando na nimittatvapratipādakaḥ, devatāpadasamabhi- vyāhṛtasya antarāyanimittatvapratipādakatvāt, devatā- yāśca antarāyānvitāyā nityāyāḥ svarūpeṇa nimittatvā- yogācca, tathāpi devatā'ntarāyanimittadoṣaparihāraphala- vattvāt, tasya ca kādācitkatvānnittikatvam |
'jyeṣṭho ha vā eṣa grahāṇāṃ yadgrahaḥ' iti tu vaiguṇaparihārārthatvenāpi śreṣṭhatvādyupapannam |
iti prāpte, na tāvadarthavādikaṃ phalaṃ paryamanīyaśāyavirodhāt |
artha- vādānyavastu yatra devatābhāve pradhānasyaiva lopāpatteḥ tanni- mittakamapi vaiguṇyaṃ parihriyate, tatra itarāṅgavaiguṇyaparihāre pradhānasādaguṇyaṃ vā kā saṃbhavānevaṃ nānupanaḥ |

na ca antarāyajanitavaiguṇyadhvaṃsasya klaptatvena taṃ pratyeva ādha- vādikasya janakatvasya kalpanayopapattau dvārībhūtādaṣṭā- kalpane gauravamiti vācyam, jyeṣṭhatvasaṃstavarūpasya ājyasya nupapatteḥ, pakṣadvaye'pi anyatārthavādasya anājñātvāvaśya- tvena prakaraṇapāṭhasya pākṣikatvaparihārārthe antarāyārthavā- syaiva tadaucityāt |
ato devatā'ntarāyanimitta- vaiguṇyasya dadhigraheṇa parihartumaśakyatvācca nityameva dadhigrahaḥ |

' oṃ dadhigrahavikāraḥ ājyasomamahataṃ karmāntaram dadhigrahameva prakṛtyāmnātam 'ājyagrahaṃ gṛhṇīyāt' iti tejaskāmasya, somagrahaṃ gṛhṇīyāt brahmavarcasakāmasya' iti nityatvena dadhnaḥ karaṇena prāptau tadapavādena tadabhāvābhi- phalāya guṇavidhī etau indriyakāmavākyavat |

īdṛ- prāpte, 'dadhnandriyakāmasya' ityatra dṛśyate tṛtīyayā guṇasyaiva phalabhāvanākaraṇatve'pi : guṇaphalasaṃbandhavidhāne'pi ājya- somayorgrahaṇe grahapadena samastayoḥ tatraiva karaṇatvena dhālya- syaiva phalabhāvanākaraṇatayā dadhigrahavikṛtibhūtayoḥ kāmya- grahayoḥ karmāntaratveva imau vidhī |
saṃkarṣa. 3|1|9. oṃ dadhigrahavikāre somamahe na somadharmāḥ |
dadhigrahavikāre'pi somagrahe somadharmā bhaveyuḥ 'somaṃ krīṇāti' ityādisomavidhiṣu apūrvasādhanasome deśena dharmavidhānāt |
iti prāpte, 'somena yajeta' iyāṃ vidhigavyāpūrvasādhanatvasyaiva uddeśyatā''vacchedakatayā pravṛ- titasya evaṃ dharmaprāpteḥ yāgasya kathambhāvākāṅkṣatayā ca tatra somadharmāḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 3|1|11. oṃ dadhigrahavikāre somamahe somadharmābhāve'' abhiṣavasyāpaḥ |
uktanyāyenaiva abhiṣavasyāpi aprāptatvāt somalata- śumireva yāgaḥ kāryaḥ |
iti prāpte, catuḥśaktanā pātre grahaṇasya prakṛtitaḥ prāptatvāt tasya ca prathamānyanyāyena dra- dravyasādhanatvena vyavasthitatvāt, pātratvādeva prakṛtāya
sāndrataradadhna eva karanatvena niyamayituṃ yuktatvena ārthika- tvātvāt codakato'pi dravyanyāghāratvadadhaiva pātraprāpte- rabhivatsākṣepaḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 3|3|2. oṃ dadhimahāvikṛtibhūtau kāmyau karmāntarabhūtau soma- mahājyagrahau |
saṃkarṣa. 3|3|9. oṃ dadhitāpuṣaṃ jvara iti nyāyaḥ |
(dadhisahite nṛpuse nāma phale bhakṣite dhātuvaipamyotpatyā jvaraḥ saṃjāyate) |

oṃ dadhinyāyena mahāvrate kāmyena 'agni naro dīdhitibhiḥ' iti āśyakaśāstrai sūktaprayogena puruṣā- rthena krudarapi niṣyadhate ityevameva sūktasya codakapratyakṣa- vacanābhyāṃ ubhayārthatvamaviruddham |
aiāsā. 1|3|12-14 nahi atra ( 'trivṛdagniṣṭudagniṣṭomaḥ tasya vāyavyāsu' ityatra ) dadhinyāyena ( 4|3|15-7 ) guṇasyotpattau anvaya- yogyatvam |

kau. 2|1|12|6 pṛ. 280, revatī- mātraṃ prāptāmiśrastotropyanuvādena vidheyaṃ phaloddeśena yāgaviniyogaśca iti vākyabhedatādavasthyāt dadhinyāyena atra lāghavāt guṇaphalasaṃvandhavidhiva ( pūrvapakṣe ) |
2|1|12|6 pṛ. 280. lāghavāt guṇa eva revatya- dhikaraṇavāravantīyākhyaḥ revatyākhya eva aprāptatvāt phaloddeśena vidhiyate iti dvitīyaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ |
( abhyuditeṣṭau yāgārthayorapi dadhipayasoḥ saha śrapayati iti prākaraṇikena vākyena taṇḍulaiḥ saha śrapaṇavidhānena prasaṅgāt praṇītākāryāpannatvena taddharmāḥ prāpnuvanti) |
vā. 2|1|12|27 pṛ. 555. oṃ dadhipayasī pratyakṣo jvaraḥ iti nyāyaḥ |
dadhiḥ ghātukamāyudham vi. 3|15|9. damyantī nalasya patnī |
vā. 3|4|119. daridrasyāpi dhanārjanottaramadhikāraḥ karmasu vi. 6|1|8. darpaṇapratibimbanyāyaḥ |
ayaṃ yādṛśaṃ mu darpaṇe paśyati, tādṛśameva dṛśyate iti viṣaye pravartate sāhastrī. 886. darbhīḥ daśavidhāḥ |
godhumā vrīhayo mauñjā daśa darbhā salbajāḥ ||
'kuśāḥ kāśa śaro gundo yavā dūrvā'tha valbajāḥ |
vi. 3|12|1. darbhaiḥ vedisaraṇādyarthaṃ minnaiḥ vidhuti pavitraṃ ca kartavyam |
bhā. 3|17|132 na tairava darbhaiḥ prayogāntaramapi kriyate |
vi. 3|4|4. darbhāna lavane pratilavanaṃ 'barhidevachadanaṃ dāmi' iti lavanamantra āvṛttiḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
bhā. 1|14|144-45 darbhapiñjūleḥ pāvayati' atropyativākyagatā 'pi saṃkhyā karmagatā na bhavati, tena karmamedo nāsti tatra |
bhā. 5|12|4-6. darbhamantrayoḥ ( darbha mantrasya ca ) prākṛtaye vājapeye māhendrastotrākaraṇasādhanabhūtena rathaghoṣādi vāghaḥ |
darbhamayādivaccaṃ kāpa śādivatve satyapi paridheyaṃ apūrvārthatvāt |
vi. 6|8|9 darbhamayaṃ vāsaḥ patnī paridhatte mahāvrate |

bhā. 10|4|13-15. bhāṭṭa-- 'yaḥ paśukāmaḥ syāt so'māvāsyāmiṣṭvā vatsānapākuryāt, ye ṣoḍaśāstānagraye sanimete'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet, ye madhyamāstān viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāya śṛte carum, ye svividhāstānindrāya dātre dadhaśrum' itya- trāpi yadyapi apanayavidyabhāvāt karmāntaratvaṃ ṣaṣṭhe upa- pāditam, tathāpi abhyuditeṣṭitvaśrutitvāt vatsāpā- karaṇaśruti
bhāṣyam-- evaṃ cet paśyasi 'nāriṣṭhahomeṣu pārṣaṇa- homyośca svāhākārasya niveśa:' iti, prakṛtāvāpi nāriṣṭhahomādau nāsya niveśo ghaṭate |
'nāsya yajño vyadhate, prajāpatau pratiṣṭhita' iti svāhākāra pāṭhene prāptaṃ bādhyate, pāṭhe hi ānumāniko vidhiḥ pratyakṣena vidhinā bādhyate |
na cet tatrāpi niveśaḥ, uttarārtha eva svāhākāro bhavati vikṛtyarthaḥ ||
bhāṣyam-- atrāha naitadyuktaṃ 'vaṣaṭkāreṇa svāhākāro bādhyate' iti |
kutaḥ ? yataḥ ṛkte śrutyādīnāṃ samavāye parasya daurbalyam |
prakaraṇena vaṣaṭkāraḥ prāpnoti nāriṣṭhahomeṣu, tanmantrapadeḥ ekavākyatvāt svāhākāraḥ |
nanu svāhākārasya upariṣṭāt pradānārthau vaṣaṭkāraḥ prayojyate (svāhākāro'ṣṭa iti) |
na khalu svāhākāreṇaiva pradānaṃ nirvartitam, kathamavihitaḥ pradānārthe svāhākāraḥ pradānārthe nirvartayiṣyati |
katham ? 'svāhākāreṇa vā vaṣaṭkāreṇa vā devebhyo haviḥ pradīyate' iti |
nanu ubhayoḥ svāhākāravaṣaṭkārayoḥ prakṛtau āmnātāt anārabhyādhītasya ānarthakyam, ata ucyate, pradānārthatāmanayorvidhāsyati |
juhoti- codanā ye darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ aṅkarmaviśeṣāḥ, te darvi- homeṣu pravartan |
kasmāt kāraṇāt ? te hi pravṛttarmāṇaḥ sarveṣu sarvapaśu-meṣu pravartamānā dṛṣṭāḥ |
yasya ca dharmaḥ prāyeṇa dṛṣṭaḥ, sa tasya adṛśyamāno'pi anumīyate |
yathā yaḥ parārthān prāyeṇa karoti, anyasminnapi parārthakaraṇe sa eva saṃbhāvyate |
bhāṣyam-- śabdasāmarthyaṃ ca codanāsāmānyaṃ darvi- homānām |
nāriṣṭhahome'pi hi juhoticodanā 'nāriṣṭhān juhoti' 'minne juhoti' iti |
bhāṣyam-- liṅgaṃ caitamaye darśayati yathā nāriṣṭha- homapūrvatvaṃ darvihomānāmiti |
kiṃ liṅgaṃ bhavati ? agni- hotre śrūyate 'yadi kīṭo'vapadyeta, antaḥparidhi ninayet' iti |
tathā agrau śrūyate 'antarvedi tiṣṭhan sāvitrāṇi juhoti' iti |
yadi teṣāṃ dharmāḥ pravartan, tataḥ etat darśanamupapadyate |
bhāṣyam-- yadetat guṇārthe nāriṣṭhahomāyeṃ darśana- mupadiṣṭaṃ nāriṣṭhahomānāṃ pravṛttau ityarthaḥ, adarśanaṃ tat, asādhakamidityarthaḥ |
kutaḥ ? tatra abhāvasya hetutvāt nyamyakeṣu 'apratiṣṭhitā vai vyambakā ityucyate |
nedhamā- barhiḥ saṃhanyate, na prajāyā ijyante, nānuyājā ijyante na sāmidhenīranvāha' iti apratiṣṭhitatvaṃ vyambakāṇāṃ pratijñāya tadupapādanāyai idhamādinābhāvāt hetutvenopadiṣṭe |
yadi ca nāriṣṭhahomāḥ pravartan, tataḥ aṅgapradhānārthatvāt idhamādirdharmāḥ sāmidhenīnāṃ ca vyambakeṣu bhāva eva syāt |
tatrāyaṃ tadabhāvaḥ asattvāt hetutvena na yujyate |
atha kasmāt vidhinaṃ bhavati ? nāriṣṭhahomaprakṛtitvāt prāsānāmidhamādīnāṃ pratiṣedhako vidhiḥ san apūrvamarthaṃ vidhāsyati, anuvādaḥ apravṛttiviśeṣakaḥ, anarthakaḥ syāt |
na, vākyaśeṣatvād guṇārthe ca samādhānaṃ nanātve nopapadyate |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? anyo- 'tra vidhirānnātaḥ 'ādityaṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapet punaretya gṛheṣu' iti, tasya vākyaśeṣo'yam |

'apratiṣṭhitā vai vyambakāḥ' iti doṣamanukīrtya idaṃ śrūyate 'ādityaṃ (aditidevatākam) ghṛte caruṃ nirvapet punaretya gṛheṣu' iti 'iyaṃ vā aditiḥ, iyaṃ pratiṣṭhā, yadādityaḥ asyāmeva pratiṣṭhita' iti |
tadetat tasya doṣasya parihārārthamiti vijñāyate, atastena saha ekavākyatā yāti |
tanmadhye ca ye idhamādyabhāvavacanāḥ, te'pi tanvehā eva samuccāraṇāt nyāyyāḥ |
te yadi vidhayaḥ kalperan pṛthak vākyāni bhaveyuḥ, tatra ekavākyatvaṃ bādhyate |
atha ko'tra viśeṣaḥ, yat 'samāne liṅgatve antaḥparidhidarśanaṃ asādhakam, itarat sādhakam iti |
bhāṣyam-- yeṣāṃ vā yāgānāṃ aparayoḥ agnyoḥ homaḥ, teṣāṃ pravṛttiḥ syāt patnīyayājānāmityarthaḥ |
tatra virodho nāsti, yo nāriṣṭha- homānāṃ pravṛttau uktaḥ 'tatrābhāvasya hetutvāt' iti |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? yataḥ tatra auṣadhāni cocyante darvihome, yathā, vyambakeṣu puroḍāśaḥ karambhapātrāṇi taṇḍulāḥ ityemādīni |
anuṣṭhīyamānā vā aprākṛtakāryāḥ syuḥ, tatra codako bādhyate |
yājyā'nuvāka api mantrāntareṇa nirvartyante, vaṣaṭkāraḥ svāhākāreṇa (sūtradvayena patnīsaṃyājaprakṛtitvaṃ nirastam |
yaḥ patnīsaṃyājānāṃ pravṛttau doṣa ukto dharmāṇāṃ anarthakyam tadatra nāsti |
kutaḥ ? yataḥ prati patikarmaṇī etau homau, darvihomāśca pradhānakarmāṇi teṣāṃ dūrato medaḥ |
yathoktam 'auṣadhadharmāḥ śakyāsta kartum' iti, pratipattitvāt tenaiva prayojakāveva nirvapaṇādīna dharmāṇām |
ataḥ tatkṛtitvaṃ tenaiva nyāyena nopadhadharmā nāpi prayojanavat |
tasmātpūrvaḥ saṃnipāte virodhinamapravṛttiḥ pratīyeta, vidhyu tapattitvavacanādarthasyāpariṇeyatvāt, vacanā datideśaḥ syāt |
bhāṣyam-- atha kasmāt ubhayasādhanānāṃ liṅgānāṃ bhāve apravṛttireva pratīyate, na punaḥ pravṛtti riti |
saṃnipāte virodhināmeteṣāṃ liṅgānāṃ pravṛttiḥ pratyetuṃ na nyāyyā |
asattvaṃ ca vyavasthitaḥ; ve cit darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ paṭhyante kecit some |
yatra paṭhitāḥ, tato'nya pariṇīyamāneṣu prakaraṇaṃ bādhyate |
tatrāha, kimatha etadapsargaḥ, sarvatra aprāpti riti |
asati evaṃ vi vacane apūrva iti |
kīṭo'vapadheta, antaḥparidhi ninayet 'antarvedi tiṣṭhan sāvitrāṇi juhoti iti, tayoḥ kaḥ samādhiḥ ? ucyate |
'yathā rajanī me kaṇḍūpati, tilako me spandate iti rāgāmāce tilakābhāve ca taddeśalakṣaṇayā bhavanti vakkāraḥ iti |
bhāṭṭa-- anāramya 'svāhākāreṇa vā vaṣaṭkāreṇa vā devihomo haviḥ pradīyate' iti śrutam|
tena ca vākyabhedamāśritya svāhākāravaṣaṭkārayoḥ devakarmāṅgatvena vidhiḥ vikalpaśca nyāyādeva prāptaḥ|
punaśca keṣucit darvhihomeśu 'pṛthivyai svāhā antarikṣāya svāhā' iti svāhākāraḥ śrutaḥ|
iti prāpte, vidhāyaka mantrayoḥ svarūpeṇa upasaṃhārayogāt mantrakalpasyāhakāravidhinā upasaṃhāro vācyaḥ|
nātopasaṃhāraḥ, apitu svāhākāraśabda niyamaḥ eva iti prāpteḥ|
vastutastu 'yājyāyā adhi vaṣaṭ karoti' iti vacanena vaṣaṭkārasya yājyottarakālatvavidhānāt yatra yājyāmātrakaraṇaṃ yāgaḥ, tatra vaṣaṭkāra eva niyataḥ|
yatra tu yājyābhinnamantrakaraṇatvam, tatra pariśeṣāt svāhākāra eva iti vyavasthitavikalpa eva tayoḥ|
evaṃ ca 'pṛthivyai svāhā' ityādī svāhākārapāṭho mantratvasiddhayarthaḥ|
ata eva yanna svāhākāro na paṭhitaḥ, tatra uktavidhitaḥ svāhākāravidhāne'pi na tasya mantratvam, tadgranthe mantraśeṣaprāyaścittaṃ vā, na tu tatra svāhākārasvāhābhāvaḥ|
ata eva audumbarīhomādau mantre tathātābhāve'pi 'mantreṇa audumbarīkeṃ homaṃ kṛtvā bhūmigate svāhākāraḥ' iti svāhākārānuvādena kālavidhiḥ svāhākāraprāptau upapadyate|
kacicca homaviśeṣe 'na svāhā karoti' iti tatparyantādeśo'pi upapadyate|
darvhihomeśu 'caturgṛhītaṃ juhoti' ityatra prathamaṃ gṛhītenāpi homasambhavāt prathamapaṭhitanyāyenaiva saṃkhyā niyamyate|
darvhihomeśuḥ pūrvamagnisandhanasya āvaśyakatve'pi na tatra samidhakṣepaniyamaḥ|

iti prāpte, agnihotraprakaraṇe 'yadekāṃ samidha- mādāya dve āhutī juhoti' iti vidhāya 'kasyāṃ samidhi dvitīyāmāhutiṃ juhoti' iti praśnarūpeṇa pratyāhuti ekaikasamidhādhānasya āvaśyakatvāprāptāt nāni- yamaḥ|
aniyamena prāptasyārthasya arthavādādinā niyama- nasya bahuśo dṛṣṭatvāt|
ata eva etasya agni- hotraprakaraṇatvād arthavādācca na niyāmakateti keṣāṃ- cinmataṃ bhāṣye eva nirastam|
darvhihomeśu 'mine juhoti' ityādijuhoticodanā- vihiteṣu avihitetikartavyatākeṣvapi prakṛtiviśeṣāni- rdhāraṇāt niyatavidhyantātideśānupapatteḥ|

aniyamasarvāti- deśayośca aṣṭamadhye nirākṛtatvāt apūrvatvena adhamānte vakṣyamāṇeṣu yāvacchrutasya dravyadevatādeḥ itikrtavyatā- jātasya saṃnipyopakāritvena niyamāpūrvadārā karaṇāpūrvo- tpattimātre paryavasāyitayā anyamācāritasyāpi agatyā ārādupakārakāṅgāsādhyakaraṇānugrahasādhanatvamapi kalpitam|
darvhihomeśu 'caturgṛhītaṃ juhoti' ityādi niyamānu- palambhān amitavatsaṃkhyākagṛhīte 'prāpte prathamaṃ gṛhītenāpi homasambhavāt prathamapaṭhitanyāyenaiva saṃkhyā niyamyate|
ata eva 'caturjuhyati, dvirjuhoti' iti vidhāya 'atha kathaṃ dve āhutī bhavataḥ' ityādinā'nyatasya homa- catuṣkasya āvaśyakatā ghanitopapadyate|
bhā. 10|8|10|20-22. darvhihomeśu svarūpaniṣadpānātiriktaḥ tathā vyāpāro na śrūyate, nāpi atideśena tat prāpyate|
yāgīyānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ tāvajjāti- deśaḥ, yāgatvena homatvena ca vailakṣaṇyatvāt|
nāpi homī- yānām, kasya homasya dharmaḥ; kasmin home pravartate iti viśeṣanirṇaye pramāṇābhāvāt|
(agnihotra-traiyyamba- nāriṣṭhānāṃ dharmacatvādiṣovatvāditi bhāvaḥ) ato dharme- prāpyatvāt 'darvhihomeḥ iha bhāvayet katham' ityu-
bhāṣyam-- 'yadekyā juhuyāt, darvhihomaṃ kuryāt' iti śrayate|
dravyopadeśo'- vagamyate, dravyaṃ homo darvhihoma iti|
kiṃ kāraṇam ? laukikānāṃ tāvadācāragṛhītā darbhaiḥ 'yanmṛtvā mūladaṇḍayā darbhyā juhoti' iti|
yatkāraṇaṃ suvādīnāṃ vidhāyakaḥ śabdo- 'sti, 'suveṇa juhoti' iti, na tu darbhaiḥ|
bhāṣyam-- athocyeta agnihaviṣoḥ kāryaṃ darvhi- rbhaviṣyati|
darvhau homo darvhihomaḥ, darvaivā homo darvhihoma iti|
yathā pātrakāye darvhirna yujyate, tathā agnihaviṣoḥ kārye'pi|
bhāṣyam-- uktaṃ cāssāmiḥ agreḥ kārye anyata dravyamasamartham|
na caitat kārye anyat dravyaṃ śakyati kartumiti|
artha- vādagatasya darvhihomaśabdasya ātideśikatvātprasaṅgena apa- vādārthatvābhāvāt|
vi-- 'darvhihome guṇo nāma vā, guṇo dadhihomavat|
bhāṭṭa-- tadevaṃ siddhe'tideśe darvhihomeṣu tadapavādaṃ vaktuṃ darvhihomaśabdārtho nirūpyate|
tatra na tāvadayaṃ darvhi- rahasya guṇasya vidhiriti śaṅkituṃ śakyam, somādivat vidhivyākhye śravaṇābhāvena vidhāyakatvaśaṅkā'''nupapatteḥ|

na ca vāstuhomīyaguṇavidhivyarthavāde 'yadekyā juhuyādarvhihomaṃ kuryāt' ityatra śrutasya darvhihomapadasya ghṛtādipadavat padāntarakalpanāyā vidhāyakatvasaṃbhavaḥ; 'puro'nuvākyāmantrasya yājyā juhoti' iti ṛgdvayarūpaguṇavidherapekṣābhāvāt na ca siddhatvirdeśā'''nupapatyā'''upari hi devebhye dhārayati' iti vākyāntarakalpanāyā homadeśenaiva darvhi- vidhāyakatvam|
vāstuhome tāvat sucaḥ pratyakṣaśiṣṭatve- vidhātumaśakyatvāt, homāntareṣvapi sārteṣu 'nyagrodhasya mūladaṇḍayā darbhyā juhoti' iti smārtavacanenaiva tasmāteḥ
śrauteṣvapi ‘suveṇa juhoti, camasena juhoti, juhvā juhoti’ ityādinā tatratatra tatpātrāntarasadbhāvācca |
ataśca tannyāyena guṇavidhitvānupapatteḥ darviśabda pātrāntara upalakṣaṇamaṅgīkṛtya ekadeśapravṛttinimittena vā tasyādyahomamātrasyedaṃ nāmadheyam |
’ yadi kenacidupadeśena vā (pramāṇam) na labhāmahe, tato darvihomanyāyena (8|4|111, 5-9) vidhyuddeśasyaiva ce śaktī kalpayiṣyāmaḥ |
sthālīpākaḥ, aṣṭakāḥ, agnihotram, nāriṣṭahomāḥ ityādayo laukikā vaidikāśca homā darvihomāḥ |
evaṃ jyāḥ, abhyātānāḥ, rāṣṭrabhṛtaśca darvihomā eva |
vi. 8|4|1,4. darvihomaśabdaḥ smārtānāṃ śrautānāṃ ca karmaṇāṃ nāmadheyam ||
bhāṣyam-- yadā karmanāmadheyam, tadā cintyate kiṃ laukikānāṃ smārtānāṃ karmaṇāmidāṃ nāmadheyaṃ darvi- homaśabdaḥ, uta sarveṣāmeva laukikānāṃ vaidikānāṃ ceti |
sa khalu darvihomaśabdo laukikānāṃ karmaṇāṃ nāmadheyaṃ syāt |
‘śinīnāṃ darvihomiko brāhmaṇaḥ, ambaṣṭhānāṃ darvihomiko brāhmaṇaḥ’ iti |
yaśca yat karoti, sa tena ākhyāyate |
yadi cākādīnāṃ nāma- dheyametat, tatasteṣāṃ kartā dāvahomisamākhyā- marhatīti |
bhāṣyam-- sarveṣāṃ laukikānāṃ vaidikānāṃ ca nāma- dheyametat |
nanu viparītameta- darśanam, yadekayā juhvyādarvihomaṃ kuryāt, adarvihomaṃ santamityāpadyate |
yadi darvihoma evādyau, tata ekayā dvābhyāṃ ca hūyamāno darvihoma eva bhavati |
yadi laukikānāmeva nāmadheyam, na vaidikānām, tata ekayā'pi hūyamāno'sau naiva darvihomo bhavati alaukikatvāt, tanaitadavacanaṃ nopapadyate yadekayā juhvyādarvihomaṃ kuryāditi |
tatrāyaṃ prakṛtadvitīyādhikaraṇe- payuktaṃ pṛthak kṛtvā asāmīra niveśyate |
) tatrāpi yathaiva smārtānāṃ pārvaṇasthālīpākānāṃ kartari dārvi- homika iti prayogadarśanāt pravṛttinimittasadbhāvācca teṣāṃ nāmadheyam, tathaiva vāstūhame prayogāt śrautānāmapi |
na ca vāstuhomasya ekayā ṛcā karaṇe darvihomatva- prasaktyamidhānāt vastuto darvihomatvābhāvāt |
darvihomapadasya smārta- nāmatve vāstuhome ekayā ṛcā kriyamāṇe'pi darvi- homatvābhāvāpatteḥ |
idānīṃ cintyate kiṃ yajati- codanānāṃ juhoticodanānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ nāmadheyam, uta juhoticodanānāmeveti |
tadbhāvāt ( darśa bhāvāt ) tarkātparyasya lakṣaṇaṃ nāsti |
na ( ca ) darśa pratiṣidhya pañcaśarāvo vidhīyate |
tatra irāpadasya girāpadaṃ kāryaṃ lakṣayati pratiṣidhyamānam, eva- miha nāsti ( pratiṣedho, yena kāryaṃ lakṣyeta ) |
yathāśrutakatvāt ( yathāśrutena dravyeṇa akara- ṇāt darśasya yaḥ - ) doṣa upajāyate, tannirātāpekṣayāṃ vidhīyamānam ( karma ) tadoṣapattisamādhānārthatvena ( darśana - ) ekavākyatāṃ yāti |
'syādevaṃ yadyamāvāsyā nivṛttā, na tu sā tathā |
’ nanu avadānādiḥ pradānāntaḥ ekaḥ padārthaḥ ityuktam, tatra kutaḥ kramavicāraḥ ? evaṃ tarhi kṛtvācintā astu |
yathā dadhnaḥ pāṭhadāryāśca pūrvaṃ dharmā dohanādayaḥ, paścādā- gneyasya nirvāpādayaḥ |
tataścitakramena ca havirāsādana- prayājaśeṣāmidhāraṇādisvikachadavadānādīnyapi kartavyatvena prāptāni mukhyakramāt prathamamāgneyasya kāryāṇi, paścādagnaḥ |
pradhānānāṃ hi pāṭhādeva prathamamāgneyasya, paścāt sāṃnāyya- syānuṣṭhānam |

yadyapi ca āsādānādīnāṃ yājyā'nuvākyā- pravṛttikramāt tācchyānuṣṭhānamapi prasajyate iti bhūtabhāvi- pravṛttikramāsyāniyamaprasaktau mukhyakramasya niyāmakatva- mātramiti nedaṃ virodhādehāraṇaṃ saṃbhavati, tathāpi anya- detāhasodāharaṇaṃ mṛgyam |
atra na pradhānāvadhāna- mudāharaṇam, tasya pradānaikapadārthatvasya sthāpitatvāt |
darśai ātaścanaṃ dadhnaḥ grahakālī- tvena pūrvaidyurityarthasiddham |
mīnmā. darśai dohaḥ dadhyarthaḥ, dadhnaḥ grahakālasādhyatvena pūrvaidyuritya- siddham |
vi. 6|1|9, darśai dohaḥ nityāmihotrādau yajñopavītinā kāryaḥ |

darśai śākhā''haraṇadyo dharmauḥ dohadvayārthī eva, na kevalaṃ sāyaṃ dohārthauḥ |
bhāṣyam- asti sāyaṃ dohaḥ, tathā'sti prātardohaḥ |
santi tu dohadharmāḥ śālāharaṇam, gavāṃ prasthāpanam, prasāvanam, godohanamityevamādayaḥ |
te kiṃ sāyaṃ dohārthāḥ uta ubhayārthā iti |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? dohayostayoḥḥ asaṃyuktaṃ dharmaḥ śrutaṃ bhavet |
kasmāt ? sāyaṃ dohasya hi krame aupavasathye'hani śākhāharaṇādīn samānamanti |
tasmāt kramāt sāyaṃ dohārthau iti dohadharmā |
vā- evaṃ kramasyāvirodhaṃ darśayitvā idānīṃ virodhaṃ darśayati |
api ca, na sāyaṃ dohasya pūrvedyurāmnānam |
katham ? evamāmananti, ‘aindraṃ dadha- māvāsyāyām’ ‘aindraṃ payo'māvāsyāyām’ iti |
amā- vāsyāyāṃ hi ubhayaṃ sāṅgaṃ codyate |
svabhāva eṣa dadhnaḥ; yat pūrvedyu- rūpakāntaṃ aperedyurabhinivartate |
tassāt sāyaṃ dohasya krame āmnātā ityedeva tāvannāsti |
vā- pradhānaṃ dharmadeśe kriyamāṇaṃ kramaṃ pratipadyate |
dadhiyāgastu amā- vāsyāyāṃ paṭhyate kriyate ca |
dadhitva- siddhayarthāstu kecit dharmāḥ pūrvedyuḥ kriyante |
na ca te śākhā''haraṇādīnāṃ grāhakāḥ : guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvā- dasaṃbhavaḥ : iti sthitatvāt |
tasmādubhayārthasya śākhā- haraṇādervacanāt pūrvedyuḥ karaṇaṃ na dadhyarthatvāt ityadoṣaḥ |
soma- prayojanam- pūrvedyuḥ prātardohārthye vatsā- pākaraṇaṃ śāvyathaiva kartavyaṃ iti niyamābhāvaḥ |
tathā sāyaṃ- dohinyanyataraṃ śālānāśai prātardohārthe na śālā'ntaraṃ saṃpādyam, siddhānte tu tadubhayaviṣayaḥ : iti |
sūtrārthastu- dohayoḥḥ kālabhedāt sāyaṃ dohasya sthānam, na prātardohasya |
prātaśca santi vā, sāyaṃ sthānāt tu pūrvavat sthitāḥ ||
’ bhāṭṭa- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ dadhi pūrvedyuḥ aparedyuśca payaḥ |
prāpte, yadyapi sthānaṃ bhavet, tathāpi prakaraṇena vaddhāhaḥ |
na hi atra pūrvavat klṛptopakāravādinā prakaraṇabhāvaḥ śaktituṃ śakyaḥ |
dadhasthu vidyamānamapi na āna- rthakyamiyā apūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇatātparyakam |
na ca smārakavidhayaiva dadhaiva yāgopasthiteḥ sthānaśaṅkā, tādṛśo- pasthiteḥ naiyāyikānāṃ grāhakatvānupapatteḥ |
kiñca dohadharmāḥ paredhurevāmnātāḥ, tatraiva bhāṣyāpekṣāyāṃ prakaraṇādubhayārthatvena avagamyamānāḥ |

' 9. darśa śākhāchedanādīnāṃ upaveṣo na prayojakaḥ; kintu vatsāpākaraṇaṃ prayojakam |
darśa śākhāchedane - apākaraṇa - parivāsanānāṃ vatsāpākaraṇameva prayojakam, na kapālopadhānamapi |
tathā chedanādīnāṃ arthatvameva, na tu mūlārthatvamapi |
tatra śrūyate 'saha śākhayā prastaraṃ praharati' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ śālā prastarasyāṅgabhūtā, aṅgaprayojana- saṃbandhasthoḥ ? atha kālārthaḥ saṃyogaḥ; prastarapraharaṇakāle śākhā prahartavyeti |
kiṃ prāptam ? prastare śālā śrayaṇa- vat |
kutaḥ ? saha śākhayā prastaraṃ praharatīti sahayukte apradhāne tṛtīyā vibhakti- rbhavati |
sahayoge ca tṛtīyā guṇataḥ; dvitīyā pradhānataḥ |
nanu na śākhayā prastarasya kaścidupakāraḥ kriyate |
satyaṃ na dṛṣṭaṃ kriyate kintu adṛṣṭaṃ kriyate |
athavā śākhā- praharaṇe kādhikāra iti saṃbandhaḥ |
tasya praharaṇamapi viśiṣṭe kāle vākyāntareṇa vihitam |
idānīṃ punaḥ kiṃ guṇabhūtā codyate, uta pratipādyate iti |
yā ca yāvatī ca mātrā deśāntara- saṃyogasya, na dṛṣṭaṃ kiñcidasti |
nanu tṛtīyā apradhāne bhavati, sā ca śākhā- yām |
yā asau śākhāyāṃ tṛtīyā, sā dvitīyā'rthe |
yā ca prastare dvitīyā, sā tṛtīyā'rthe |
kathamavagamyate ? sahayoga eṣaḥ; ekasmin kāle ubhaya- mapi prahartavyamiti |
atra yasya niśitaḥ kālaḥ, tasyā- nuvādaḥ |
nanu ca 'ahayukte'pradhāne' iti sahayoge eva tṛtīyā |
yathaivaṃ, tataḥ śākhāyā api yajo guṇabhāvaḥ prastaravat syāt |
athavā prastarasya yajvaṅkatvena nirdeśāt yaji- rūpam |
ataḥ praharatimātre śuddhe sahayoga iti sūktam |
bhāṣyam-- na ca śākhayā prastarasyopakāro dṛṣṭaḥ kriyate |
bhāṣyam-- kiṃ bhavati prayojanam, yadi prastarasya guṇabhūtā, tathāpi prastarapraharaṇakāle śākhā prakṣipyate iti |
yadi prastarasya prahiyamāṇasya aṅgabhūtā śākhā, tato vinā prastareṇa na prahartavyā bhavati |
atha anaṅga- bhūtā, vināpi prastareṇa prahartavyā |
tasmācca viprayoge syāt, tasmādeva kāraṇāt prastaraviyoge'pi śākhāyāḥ praharaṇaṃ syāditi |
ṭup-- yadi prastarasya guṇabhūtā śākhā, tato vinā śākhayā prastaro na prahartavyaḥ iti vyākhyāsyam |
prātaḥsayanīyeṣu (puroḍāśeṣu) prastaraṃ vinā na prahartavyā śākhā pūrvapakṣe |
bhāṣyam-- yathā pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ tathā sati, sāṃnāyye sati asati ca śākhā vidyate iti, upaveṣaḥ sati cāsati ca syāt |
yathā tu siddhāntaḥ, tathā sāṃnāyyapathe śākhā satī hi pratipādyate, iti tatraiva upaveṣo nānyatreti |

bhāṣyam— darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ idamamnāyate 'puroḍāśābhyāmeva asomayājinaṃ yājayet, yāvato āmeya-śraidhāmaśca' iti |
tatraiva saṃśayaḥ ki adhikāraśruti-vākyaśeṣo'yam 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' iti itī ābhyāṃ puroḍāśābhyāmasomayājī yajeta |

atha kimadhikāvyaḥ: karmāntarayotpattiḥ aparābhyāmeva-jātīyakābhyāṃ puroḍāśābhyāṃ yajeteti, athavā aṅkakarturupadeśaḥ ābhyāṃ puroḍāśābhyāmityukta yājayediti, athavā asomayātkāle ābhyāṃ yajeteti kāleādeśaḥ; uttaindrāgnasya vidhiśreyaśca cānuvādaḥ; athavā ubhayorenuvāda ityete pakṣāḥ |
yadetat svargakāmo yajeteti, tasya śeṣaḥ, ābhyāṃ puroḍāśābhyāṃ-somayājī svargakāmo yajeteti |
tatra somayājino vā na puroḍāśau, asoma-yājino vā na sānāyyam |
yadi puroḍāśau adhikṛtya asomayājī vidhīyate, tato nāsomayājī sānāyye |
atha asomayājinamadhikṛtya puroḍāśau vidhīyyete, tathā na somayājinaḥ puroḍāśau |
yaste na duhyeta katamañcanāha tasmai māṃ brūyā nidhipāya brahman ||
ye śucimeva vidyā iti vaditavye yameva vidyāḥ śuci-miti |
yathā vaiśyastome adhikāraśrutiśeṣaḥ 'vaiśyo vaiśyastomena yajeta' iti, tadadnatrāpi adhikāraśrutiśeṣa eveti |
nityo hi darśapūrṇamāsau 'yāvajjīvaṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta' iti |
naivamisaṃbandhaḥ kriyate 'yāvato puroḍāśau darśapūrṇamāsayorvihitau, tau prati asomayājī
kathaṃ tarhi ? asomayājī yaḥ svargakāmaḥ, sa āgneyaṃ kuryātadaindrāgnaṃ ca ityete karmaṇī vidhīyate |
yathā kṣīrena bhuktvā deva-dattaḥ kṣīreṇa bhuñjīteti |

na ca darśapūrṇamāsaikadeśabhūtau puroḍāśau phalasya sādhako bhavataḥ |
na ca tatra kiñcidekaṃ nityamanityena saṃbadhyate |
api ca nityānityayorviruddhaḥ saṃbandhaḥ abhyupagato na bhaviṣyati |
apivā vihitatvād guṇārthāyāṃ puna:śrutau sandehe śrutidvidavārtha syād yathā'nabhipretasyā''gneyo darśanādekadevate |
vihito hi asau ubhayatra 'yadāgneyo'ṣṭākapālo'mā- vāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ cācyuto bhavati' iti |

tasya darśanaṃ ca 'āgneyaṃ caturdhā karoti' iti |

kuta: ? bādarāyaṇa ācārya manyate sma, prāgapi somayāgāt sāṃnāyyavidhiriti |
asoma- yājino'pi sāṃnāyyaṃ śrūyate, tadu saṃnayediti |
nāpyadhikayo: karmaṇorutpatti:, na vā āgneyasyānuvāda:, aindrāmya vidhi: |

śeṣa: syāt tacchruter (2) maivaṃ kātsnyaṃ- nityavattvāt ||

) bhāṭṭa— darśapūrṇamāsayo: 'nāsomayājī saṃnayet' ityasomayājina: sāṃnāyyaparyudāsa: śruta: |
