aindrāmya 'aindrāmyamekādaśakapālaṃ niṣedhamā- vāsyāyāmasaṃnayata:' iti sāṃnāyyābhāva eva vihitatvā- daucityena stutyupapatte: |
tatra puroḍāśābhyāmeva asomayājī adhi- kriyate na sāṃnāyyeneti prathama: pakṣa: |
paryudāsavidhinā- evāsādhatva siddhe: 'tadu saṃnayet' iti śākhā'ntara- vacanena asomayājino'pi sāṃnāyyavidhānāt puroḍāśa-
somayājina: āgneyābhāvaprasaṅgāt, sāṃnāyyasya soma- yājino niyatatvena ca tadabhāvavihitaindrāmyasya somayājina: prasaktyabhāvāt etatpakṣānupapatte: karmāntaraṃ vidhīyate iti tṛtīya: |
karmāntaratve pramāṇābhāvāt evakāraśravaṇācca tadupapatte: yājanavidhiriti caturtha: |
phalaśravaṇāt rāgata: prāptatvāt etatpakṣasyāpi anupapatte: asomayāga- kāle puroḍāśāviti kālavidhiraiva śreyāniti pañcama: |

tadapi aindrāmyasya asomayāgakāle eva prāptatvāt āgneyasya ca asomayāgakālavidhau somayājina: pratiṣedhāpatte: acyutatvākyāgatasarvadevatātvatvāccāpatte: arthavāda evāyaṃ ityodumbarādhikaraṇasiddhamiti kṛtvācintodāttam |
' 16. darśapūrṇamāsayo: ' āgneyo'ṣṭākapāla: ' atra āgneyaśabdo na karmanāmadheyam, kintu devatāvidhāyaka: |
tatra nigameṣu agnerabhidhānaṃ vidhi- śabdenaiva agniśabdena, nānyena śucyādinā |
darśa- pūrṇamāsayo: ' āgneyo'ṣṭākapālo'māvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ cācyuto bhavati' iti vidhāya puna:śrūyate ' āgneyo- 'ṣṭākapālo'māvāsyāyāṃ bhavati' iti |
tatra āgneyasya na dvirabhyāsa:, puna:śrutistu aindrāmyastulyārthā |
bhā. 2|3|14|27-29, darśapūrṇamāsayo: āgneya: puro- ḍāśa: upāṃśuyāja: agnīṣomīya: puroḍāśa: aindraṃ dadhi aindraṃ paya: āghāro ājyabhāgau sviṣṭakṛt patnīsaṃyājā: ( iti yāgā bhavanti ) |
darśa- pūrṇamāsayo: āgneyaṃ avadāya hutvā paścāt agnīṣomī- yāde: avadānahomau iti avadānasya pradhānānānusamaya: |
vi. 5|1|4, darśapūrṇamāsayo: ' āgneyaṃ caturdhā karoti' iti caturdhākaraṇaṃ āgneyasyaiva, na tu aindrāmmī- yomīyayo: |
darśapūrṇamāsayo āgneyasya puroḍāśasya adhvarakalpatvārthatvasya viṃkāra:, upāṃśuyājasya ca sārasvatamājī vikāra: |
darśapūrṇamāsayo: āgneyasya prayājaśeṣā- ṇāmabhighāraṇaṃ prathamaṃ mukhyakramāt, tata: sāṃnāyyasya ke. 5|1|7|4 |
darśapūrṇamāsayo: āgneyasya prāthamya- nāmīpomīyasya, brāhmaṇapāṭhasya anyathātve'pi ( taistaiṃ 2|5|2 ) |
darśapūrṇamāsayo: āgneyāgnīṣomīyapuro ḍāśayo: muṣṭikapālopadhāna-avadāneṣu samudāyānusamaya: samudāyānusamayanyāya: |
1|1|2|1 -1,2-4, darśapūrṇamāsayo: āgneyādīnāṃ samudātāna eka: svarga: phalam |
darśapūrṇamāsayo: āgneyādipradhānabhede'pi deśakālakartṛkatvāt āghārādyajñānāṃ tantreṇā nuṣṭhānam ||
bhāṣyam— darśapūrṇamāsayo: pradhānāni āgneyādīni teṣāmaṅgāni āghārādīni |
teṣu cintyate kiṃ tasyata pradhānasya medenāṅgāni prayogā:, athavā sarveṣāṃ tantreṇeti atha tatra kiṃ vṛttam ? 'ṛtuvaccānumānāmeṣā phalabhū syāt' iti ( 1|1|1|29 ) |
tatra kṛtsno darśa pūrṇamāsau uddiśya kṛtā vṛttā |
kiṃ prāptam ? pradhānakarmārthatvādjñānāṃ tadvedā karmabheda: prayoge syāt |
aṅgānāṃ prayoge meda: syāt kuta: ? pradhānakarmārthatvāt |
aṅgasaṃbandhe ca pradhānānāṃ sahatvaṃ na vivakṣyate |
na ca abhīpyamānasyārthasya guṇo vivakṣito bhavati |
evaṃ cet ekaikasya pradhānasya aṅgai: saṃbandha: kartavya: |
tāni yadi sakṛt kriyeran, na vimāgamena saṃbadhyeran |
yathā prāyaṇīyodaya- nīyayo: ekādaśinyā: samastaiśca saṃbandha: kartavya ityuktam, vidhestvevaśrutitvādityatra |
dup- ( nanu 'anabhyāso vā prayogavacanaikatvāt' ityatra ( 1|1|17|19 ) aṅgānāṃ sakṛdanuṣṭhānamupasam |
kimatra cintyate ? ata āha-) bhāvanāyā itikartavyatā karaṇamanugṛhṇatī saṃbadhyate |
idānīṃ tu vicāryate, kiṃ āgneyādīnāṃ tantreṇa itikartavyatā upakaroti, uta medeneti |
katham ? āgneyādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ ( tāvat ) iti- kartavyatā upakaroti |
upakāravelāyāṃ ca pradhānabhūtānāṃ teṣāṃ sāhityamavivakṣitam ( uddeśyagatatvāt ) |
tasmāt ekaikasya ( eva ) upakaroti, na saṃhatānāṃ iti pūrva: pakṣa: |
tatra yadi tantramaṅgāni syu:, tata: akṛtvā āgneyaṃ agnīṣomīya: prakānta: syāt |
atha tu bheda:, tata: sāṅgamāgneyaṃ apaṇujya agnīṣomīya: sāṅga: prakānta: kriyate iti nāsti kramakopa: |
apara āha yadi tantraṃ bhavedyuraṅgāni, tato yāvat tantrūnapāt āgneyasya upakaroti, tāvat samidhā agnīṣomīyasya upakartavyam |
apica aṅgārādhenādīni saṃsparśādīni ( ca - ) pratipradhānaṃ micyante |
na caiṣa pakṣa: śreyān, meda: iti |
kiṃ tarhi ? yaugapadyaṃ sakṛt prayoga: syāt |
sakṛdeva prayuktāni aṅgāni sarvai: pradhānai: yugapat saṃbadhyante |
tulyānāṃ ekaśabdopadeśānāṃ ca eda- madhye prati viśoṣāgrahaṇāt |
imāni kartuto deśata: kālataśca tulyāni 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta' 'paurṇamāsyā paurṇamāsyā yajeta' 'amāvāsyāyāmamāvāsyayā yajeta' iti |
pradhānaiśca saha aṅgānāṃ ekadeśakālakartṛkatvaṃ vakṣyati 'aṅgāni tu vidhānatvāt pradhānenopadidhyeran' ityatra |
ekena ca śabdena pradhānāni phalaṃ prati upadiśāni 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' iti |
sarvaiścikīrṣayā tu ādhārādīnāṃ kriyamāṇānāṃ tulyakartrādīnāṃ na dṛśyate viśeṣa: |
bhāṣyam- yacca 'kramakopaśca yaugapadye syāt' iti, tatra brūma: |
tasmāt teṣāṃ prayoge krama:, kuta: kramakopa iti |
yacca upakāre kramakopa iti, tatrāpi na ādhāra: kṛtamātra eka pradhānaiṣu upakaroti |
yat kāraṇaṃ tasmin kāle pradhānā- nyeva na santi |
yadā tu sarvāṇyaṅgāni kṛtāni, tadā tajjanyāpūrvāṇi saṃbhya pradhāneṣu upakurvanti |
bhāṣyam- tathā ca anyārthadarśanaṃ bhavati yathā nyāya upadiṣṭa: iti kāmukāyana ācāryoṃ manyate sma |
kiṃ punastat ? 'caturdaśa paurṇamāsyāmāhutayo hūyante, trayodaśa amāvāsyāyām' iti |
yadi āvṛtti: syāt na trayodaśa caturdaśa vā vyavatiṣṭheran |
bhāṣyam- yacca 'saṃsparśavat ārādupakāriṇāmapi āvṛttirastu' iti, tatra brūma: |
sa hi nyāya: 'saṃbhya- kāriṇāṃ sahakriyā' iti |
aśaktestu dharmasaṃsparśeṣu ānupūrvye syāt, medena kriyā |
na śakyate ekasmāt aṅgārāpohanena sarveṣāṃ pāka: kartum |
na ca ekasmin puroḍāśe prathite sarve prathitā bhavanti |
tata evaṃ pratyakṣopakāriṇa: prati- pradhānamāvṛtti: syāt |
yasya samīpe kṛta:, tadartha iti gamyate viśeṣa: |
ādhārādīni ājya- bhāgāntāni āgneyasya, snigdhakṛdādīni agnīṣomīyasya iti gṛhyamāṇe viśeṣa meda: |
tasmāt upāṃśuyājādīnāṃ samīpe prāk ādhārādīni, ūrdhvaṃ skhigdhakṛdādīni kartavyāni |
( atra yadyapi sūtre bhāṣyaramme ca asaṃspṛṣṭa: iti pāṭha:, asmadīye mīmāṃsādarśane'pi tathaiva, tathāpi bhāṣyante 'saṃsparśabhi: ' ityuktvāt 'asaṃspṛṣṭa: ' ityeva pāṭha āvaśyaka: |
vivalakaroye'pi sūtrabhāṣyayo: asaṃspṛṣṭa: ityeva, vi. śā. vṛ. ya-saṃmataśca |
bhāṣyam- yaduktaṃ 'yasya saṃnidhau prayuktāni, tasyemāni iti gṛhyate viśeṣa:, tasmāt tadāvṛtti: ' iti, naitat yuktam |
vibhaviṣyanti etāni ekasyāpi saṃnidhau kriyamāṇāni sarveṣāmupakartum |
tathathā pradīpa: ekasmin pradeśe bhuñjānānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ekasya saṃnidhau prajvalita: sarveṣāmupakāraṃ karotīti |
yadi sakṛt kṛta: sarvaṃ prakāśayati, sakṛt kriyate |
ayeha vidhita: upakāra: anukāro vā gamyate, na pratyakṣena |
saṃnidhānāt viśeṣagrahaṇatā gamyate 'yasya saṃnidhau prayukta:, tasyopakaroti' iti |
bhāṣyam- atha yaduktam 'sakṛdvidhyāṃ kāmukāyana ācāryoṃ mene caturdaśa trayodaśa ityādiparimāṇasya virodhāt' iti, tasya ka: parihāra: ? ābhāṣā'ntaṃ sūtram |
yadā etat sthitam 'yatsaṃnidhau yat kṛtam, tadarthameva tat' iti, tadā āvṛtti: aṅgānāṃ prayoga: |
caturdaśa paurṇamāsyāṃ āhuti- vighaya: trayodaśa amāvāsyāyāmiti |
naitat saṃkhyāvidhā- nam, pracayanaiva saṃkhyāyā: prāptatvāt |
āhutividhīnāṃ ca iyaṃ saṃkhyā vihitā, nāhutīnām |
bhāṣyam- tantreṇa prayogaṃ bādarāyaṇe manyate sma |
sarveṣāṃ pradhānānāṃ avi- bhaktā prakriyā saṃbhyakāritva ityuktam |
tatra aidamadhye prati na dṛśyate viśeṣa: |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? viśeṣo yaḥ saṃnidhimatraḥ, sa prakaraṇe bādhyate |
yathā vidhau tulyatvāt prakaraṇasya sarvāniha aṅgāni vijñāyante, na yasya saṃnidhau tadarthāni, kramasya prakaraṇa bādhitatvāt |
yadā'pi sarvārthāḥ, tadā'pi ekasya kasyacit avaśyaṃ saṃnidhau kartavyaḥ |
tasmānna viśeṣaḥ saṃnidheḥ ekāntataḥ sādhyaḥ avacārayitum |
tat anāghṛttau sarvataḥ prāsāyāṃ parisaṃkhyārthe bhavati 'ihaiva sahatvam, nānyatra' ityucyate |
māsayoḥ 'āhāryapurīṣāṃ paśukāmasya vediṃ kuryāt' iti puruṣārtham, na kratvartham |
bhā. 4|1|22|2 varṇakaṃ 2. oṃ darśapūrṇamāsayorijyāḥ iti nyāyaḥ |
caturdhopāyanyāyena darśapūrṇamāsālyānā- meva yāgānāṃ prādhānyāt netareṣāmaṅgatvāt samaprādhānya- siddhiḥ |

darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ āgneyaḥ puroḍāśaḥ, agnīṣomīyaḥ puroḍāśaḥ, ājyenopāṃśuyājaḥ, aindrāgnaḥ puroḍāśaḥ, dadhipayo rūpaṃ sāṃnāyyam, āghārī ājyabhāgau prayājāḥ anuyājāḥ patnīsaṃyājāḥ samiṣṭayajuḥ sviṣṭakṛt, iti yāgāḥ śrutāḥ |
te kiṃ sarve eva pradhānabhūtāḥ, uta tatra kecit guṇabhūtāḥ iti vicāre pūrvapakṣayati |
darśapūrṇa- māsayoḥ yāgayoḥ yāvataḥ ijyāḥ tāni sarvāṇyeva pradhānani syuḥ |
aviśeṣāt sarveṣāṃ svargaphalakatvasya yāga- tvasya ca samānatvāt |
adhiyā'ṅgāni kānicid, yeṣvaṅgatvena saṃstutiḥ, sāmānyato hyamisaṃstavaḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ āghārājyāgmaprayājādayo yāgāḥ āgneyādivat pradhānameva syāt rājasūyavat iti pūrvapakṣe sati siddhāntasūtramidam |
na sarveṣvaiva rājasūyādikkatu vartamānaḥ sarve yāgāḥ pradhānam, kintu kānicit āghārādigāyāḥ aṅgāni syuḥ, na pradhānam |
'amīṣū yā etasya yajñasya, yadāpārī' 'caturbhī vā etau yajñasya, yadāyabhāgā' ityādiḥ saṃstutiḥ |
hi yasmāt amisaṃstavaḥ aṅgānāṃ sāmānyaḥ, sāmānyadharmaḥ, aṅgānāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇe amisaṃstṛtatvaṃ ityarthaḥ |
tasmāt āghārājyābhāgā- dayaḥ yāgā api aṅgemeva, na pradhānam |
'prayājeprayāje kṛṣmalaṃ juhoti' iti sauryayāge kṛṣṇalavidhānāya prayājānuvādasya anyārthasya kṛṣṇalavidhānārthasya darśanaṃ bhavati |
tasmāt kānicidaṅgāni, na sarve yāgāḥ pradhānāni |
aviśiṣṭaṃ tu kāraṇam, pradhāneṣu guṇasya vidyamānatvāt |
teṣāmaṅgatva- siddhaye saṃstavarūpaṃ uktaṃ kāraṇaṃ tu pradhānaṣvapi āgneyā- diṣu aviśiṣṭaṃ samānameva 'śiro vā etadyajñasya yadāgneyaḥ' ityādiśruteḥ |
siddhānte 'tathā cānyārthadarśanaṃ' iti yaduktam, tatra pūrvapakṣī brūte |
prayājādīnāṃ aṅgatvavacane nyāye vā anukte sati anyārthadarśanaṃ na aṅgatvasya sādhakam |
yattu darśitam 'prayājeprayāje kṛṣṇalaṃ juhoti' iti, tat parārtham |
prākṛtāt prayājāt anyasyaiva prayājasya aprākṛtasya vidhānārtha tat |
tasmāt sarvāṇi pradhānāni iti punaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ |
pṛthaktve tvabhidhānaniniveśaḥ śrutito vyapa- deśācca, tatpunarmulyalakṣaṇaṃ yatphalavattvam, tatsaṃ- nidhānasaṃyuk tadaṅgaṃ syād, bhāgitvāt kāraṇa- syāśrutānvayasambandhaḥ |
tatra phalavanti pradhānāni, itarāṇi tu aṅgāni |
tatra trikadvayaṃ phalavat āgneyopāṃśuyājā- bhīmīyānāmekaṃ trikaṃ paurṇamāsīsaṃjñakam |
darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ iti dvivacanena trikadvayena uktakrameṇa uktayordvayornirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ |
tadetadāha, 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' iti śrutitaḥ śravaṇāt, darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ iti dvivacanena vyapadeśācca abhidhānayoḥ |
darśa iti pūrṇamāsa iti nāmadheyayoḥ pṛthaktve minne trikadvaye niveśaḥ prayogaḥ |
yat phalavattvam, tat punaḥ mukhyalakṣaṇaṃ mukhyasya pradhānasya lakṣaṇam |
atha aṅgalakṣaṇamāha, tatsaṃnidhau phalavatsaṃnidhau yat phalena asaṃyukttam, tat aṅgaṃ syāt |
aśrutasya anyasaṃbandhaḥ prayājādīnāṃ pradhāna- phalādyanvena kenacit phalena saha saṃbandhaḥ na śrutaḥ |
evaṃ 'phalavatsaṃnidhau aphalaṃ tadaṅgam' iti aṅgalakṣaṇasya uktatvāt prayājādīnāṃ aphalatvāt aṅgatvameva teṣāṃ svīkāryam, na pradhānatvam |
'caturhotrā paurṇamāsībhimiśret, pañcahotrā'māvāsyām' iti abhimarśanādayo guṇāḥ nāmasaṃyuktāḥ |
paurṇamāsī amāvāsyā iti nāmabhyāṃ saṃyuktā vidhīyante |
te ca vibhayaḥ pradhānaṣvevopapadyante nāṅgeṣu upapadyante |
pūrvapakṣiṇā yaduktam 'aviśiṣṭaṃ tu kāraṇam' iti tat pariharati |
anyaiḥ puruṣārthayaiḥ pūrṇamāsasya aṅgānāṃ āgneyādīnāmavayavānāṃ abhimarśaḥ evaṃpūpā kāraṇaśrutiḥ, sā āgneyādīnāṃ pradhānatve'pi tulyā |
yāgāvayavānāṃ puruṣāvayavatveḥ stutiḥḥ āgneyādīnāṃ pradhānatve'pi yujyate iti bhāvaḥ |
sā ca stutiḥ 'śiro vā etad yajñasya yadāgneyaḥ, hṛdayamapāṃśuyājaḥ, pādāvagnīṣomīyaḥ' iti |
'aviśiṣṭaṃ tu kāraṇaṃ0' iti sūtroktasya samādhānaṃ 'tulyā ca kāraṇaśrutiḥ0' iti anvayahitapūrvasūtreṇa yaduktam, tatraiva viśeṣapratipādanāya prakṛtaṃ sūtram |
yo'yaṃ paurṇamāsyaṅgānāmisaṃbandhaḥ puruṣāṅgaiḥ saha uktaḥ, saḥ abhisaṃbandhaḥ upapattavyaḥ |
yathā jāyamānasya puruṣasya agre śiro jāyate, madhye madhyama, paścāt pādau, evaṃ āgneyāḥ agrataḥ, upāṃśuyājo madhye, agnī- ṣomīyaḥ paścāditi |
tathāya āgne- yādiprādhānye āghārādīnāṃ cāṅgatve anyārthadarśanamapi bhavati 'caturdaśa paurṇamāsyāmāhuto hūyante, trayodaśāmā vāsyāyām' iti |
pañca prayājāḥ, dvāvājyabhāgau, āgneyo pāṃśuyājāgnīṣomīyādayaḥ, trayo'nuyājāḥ |
pañca prayājāḥ, dvāvājyabhāgau āgneyaḥ, sāṃnāyyam, sviṣṭakṛt iti trīṇi, trayo'nuyājā iti trayodaśa āhutayaḥ amāvāsyāyām |
evaṃ sati āghārādayo'pi yadi pradhānaṃ syāt, tadā teṣāṃ dve paurṇamāse āvṛttiḥ syāt |
ke. darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ iḍe dve anuyājānāṃ purastādeka paścādaparā |
yadyapi tadaṅgaḥ bahuyajamānake vikāre nāhi tabhyaḥ |
atha iḍādibhakṣārtha matvasya nāśe tattvadrūpa eva |
6|4|2, darśapūrṇa māsayoḥ iḍābhakṣaḥ, prāśitramakṣaḥ, caturdhākaraṇabhakṣaḥ śaṃyuvākakālīnau bhakṣaścaturdhābhakṣasiddhaye catvā upahārā upadiṣṭāḥ |
kṛṣṇaleṣu tu brahmaviśayāṇāṃ teṣāmupa hārāṇāṃ sahabhāva uktaḥ |
10|2|4, darśapūrṇamāsayo idhmaḥ 'trīn paridhīn 0' ityādimantrepetāmiḥ kriyāmi sidhyati |
10|1|9, darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'iṣe tvā iti śālāṃ chinatti, ūrjaṃ tvā ityanumārṣṭi' iti artha bhedena vākyabhedāt mantrabhedaḥ |
2|1|16, darśapūrṇa māsayoḥ ukhā'dhidhryaṇaṃ 'vatsaṃ copavatsati ukha cādhiśrayati' iti dvādaśadvagataṃ prathamaṃ dvaṃdvam |
bhā. 5|4|6|19-21, diṣu ca upakāryamapekṣamāṇeṣu agniṣyāvasthe evopakāre |
'ulūkhalaṃ ca musalaṃ ca' prakaraṇāt tādarthya pratīyate |
3|1|9. darśapūrṇamāsayo: māsayo: upabhṛti caturgṛhītadvayaṃ vidheyam, na tu ada- |
yāvat darśapūrṇa- māṣāparve nimittam, tāvat naimittikene ( anuṣṭhāpyena homena ) bhavitavyam |
( kutaḥ ?) nimittena ( apū- rveṇa ) prayojyatvāt homasya |
medanaṃ ca tatra kadā- cit ( na tu nityam |
tathāpi kim ? ityata āha-) tatra upakāryasya ( bhinnasya ) anityatvāt prayojakasya ( ca apūrvasya ) nityatvāt nityānityasaṃyogavirodhaḥ |
medanasya ( tu ) nimittatve ( sati ) bhinnena ( nimi- ttena ) home prayakte ( sati ) apūrvasya tādarthyam, ityadoṣaḥ |

pūrvoktasyaiva vyatirekamāha - ) nimittatādarthyonityatvāt asti saṃbandhaḥ ( nimittamanuṣṭhāpakam, tādarthyamiti phalam ) yathā jīvanaṃ nimittaṃ ( agnihotra - ) homaṃ prayukte, sa ( ca upātta - ) doṣopaghātārthaḥ |
( atra likhite ‘ yathā jīvanaṃ nimittaṃ puruṣadoṣasya tatra prāyaścittaṃ vrataṃ homaṃ prayukte sa doṣopaghātārthe; ’ iti pāṭhaḥ |
paraṃtu nāsau ) tatraranānusārī ) tatra jīvanasya puruṣadoṣasya ca ( pūrvopāttasya ) vidyamānatvāt aviruddhaḥ saṃbandhaḥ |
( dvayorapi ( prayojakaphalayoḥ ) anityayoḥ asti saṃbandhaḥ yathā brahmatyādi anityaṃ nimittaṃ puruṣadoṣa ( anityaḥ ), tatra prāyaścittaṃ brahmatyāyuktaṃ doṣanirghātaya ca ( iti nāsti virodhaḥ |
) tasmāt upakārye ( phale yāvanmayo- jakaṃ ) vidyamāne asti saṃbandhaḥ |
iha ( tu ) upakārye ( bhinnam ) kadācit ( prayojakaṃ tu apūrva nityam, iti virodhaḥ ) |
( bhāṣyaṃ vyācaṣṭe - ) na śakyaṃ nityasyo- pakartuṃ iti homo na śaknoti nityamupakartum, upa- kāryasya ( bhinnasya nityam - ) abhāvāt |
tena nityamupa- kuryāt ( iti vacanaṃ pralāpa eva iti bhāṣyam - ) iti darśapūrṇamāṣāparve bravīti |
( katham ?) nitya- mupakuryāt iti ( homam - ) prayojyanam ( apūrve bravīti bhāṣyakāraḥ iti ) |
tasmāt ( tadupakāryasya nityārthatvā- nupapatteḥ ) kapālādibhiḥ medanaṃ nimittam |
guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvāt vacanāt vyapāyaḥ syāt |
bhāṣyam - asati vacane na guṇo guṇārtho bhavitu- marhati |
bhinnasya ādhārabhāve hi na homāntaraṃ vidhīyate |
pradhānasya hi tadā bhinno guṇa iti gamyate |
tatra āhavanīyasaṃyogo bādhyeta ' vacanādvikalpa iti cet, na nimittatvena saṃbhavāt |
yayucyeta, nimitta- pade'pi na homāntaram, prakṛtasyaiva homasya nimittaṃ vidhīyeteti |
yadi hi vidhīyeta, nimittameva tanna syāt |
yadi ca yasyāpi nimittaṃ so'pi uddiśyeta, tatra dvayordvidyamānayoḥ saṃbandha eva na syāt |
dupa - ( kathaṃ nimittapakṣe dvayoḥ pradhānārthatvamiti- cet, tatrāha - ) prakaraṇatāt pradhānārtho homaḥ bhinnamapi ( homaṃ ) prayojyaṃ ( apūrva ) praṇāḍyā tadarthameva ( ato na bhijñārtho homaḥ ) |
na ca kapālādyatvena homasya pratipādakaṃ vacanamasti, ( ' bhinne juhoti ' ityatra tādarthyapratipādikāyāḥ ) dvitīyāvibhakterabhāvāt |
na ca bhinnasya pratyakṣato doṣa upalabhyate, yena ( dvitīyā- yāmasyāmapi dṛṣṭārthatvāt ) doṣanirghātārtho homaḥ syāt ( tasmāt bhinnārthaḥ ) |
na ca bhinnabhādhāratvena upa- diśyate ( ādhārabhāvena iti bhāṣye ) |
nanu pūrvameva ' na guṇo guṇārtho bhavitumarhati ' iti siddhe kutaḥ śaṅkā, ata āha - ) śrutisaṃbhavamātreṇa ( śrutisaṃbhavamātreṇa iti ratnam - ) upanyasyate |
saṃbhavati hi saptamī nimitte ādhāre ca |
( nirākaraṇabhāṣyaṃ arthataḥ anu- saṃdhatte - ) ādhāraḥ san āgneyādīnāṃ ( eva praka- raṇāt aṅgam ) syāt, nāṅgānām |
na ca karmāntaram ( viśiṣṭavidheranyāyatvāt ) āhavanīyasaṃyogo bādhyate |
iti pākṣikaṃ bādhagāha na tu nityam |
( parastu - ) bādhamabhipretya ( aṅgīkṛtya ) āha vacanāt vikalpa iti cet |
( vacanabalāt pākṣiko bādho hrīhiyavā- diṣviva na doṣaḥ |
idaṃ vikalpāmidhānamākṣipyati - ) ayukto'yaṃ vikalpaḥ bhinnasya prakaraṇavattvāt, āhava- nīyasya ca anārambhādhīyatvāt |
tadyathā ( prakaraṇa- saṃbandhenaiva ) pāñchadayena sādaśyam ( anārabhyādhītam ) bādhyate, evamihāpi ( āhavanīyasya bhinnena bādha eva, na vikalpaḥ |
) kiñca āhavanīyasya anyatra ( homā- ntare'pi ) kṛtārthatvāt |
bhinnasya tu ( prakṛtahomānuvādena vidhīyamānasya ) anyatrānavakāśatvāt tadupamardenaiva ( āhavanīyopamardenaiva ) padavat niveśaḥ |
tasmāt vikalpābhidhānaṃ abhyupetyavādena ( bhāṣyakāreṇa uktam, vikalpo'pi satyāṃ gatau ayuktaḥ, asti ca gatiḥ : nimittatvenāpi saṃbhavāt iti ) |
kecidāhuḥ: yukta evāyaṃ vikalpaḥ, ubhayoḥ ( bhinnā- havanīyayoḥ ) vākyena juhotisaṃbandhāt |
( nanu bhinnasya prakaraṇamastītyuktam, ata āha - ) na prakaraṇāt kiñcit abhyadhikam ( labhyate vākyabalīyastvāt |
pāñchadaya- sādaśyayoḥ : tarhi katham ? tatrāha - ) tatra sāmidhenī- ( mātra - ) saṃbandhe ( saṃkhyayoḥ ) ānarthakyāt apūrva- saṃbandhaḥ ( avaśyam ) eṣitavyaḥ |

tatra ekatra ( pāñcha- dasya ) prakaraṇena ( apūrvasaṃbandhaḥ ) klṛptaḥ, itarasya ( tu sādaśyasya ) anyamicaritakratusaṃbandhasāmidhenī- dvāreṇa ) klṛptaḥ; iti ( saṃbandhasya ) viprakarṣāt pāñcha- dasyena sādaśyaṃ bādhyate, ( vikṛtiṣu sādaśyasya kṛtārthatvāt |
) ( kiñca ) tadarthatve ca na śāstraṃ niyamana kāraṇam, anugrahādvā śāstrasya ( nahi pramāṇānu- ahārthaḥ prekṣavatāṃ prayāsaḥ, kintu samīhitaprāpyarthaḥ |
tasmāt ) pramāṇān yasya bādho gamyate, sa bādhyate |
iha ( tu ) juhotiśabdaḥ : samānaḥ ( bhinnasya āhavanīyasya ca ) |
nanu ' pade juhoti ' ityatra ( api ) saptamī juhotiśabdayoḥ : tulyatvāt padena āhavanīyasya ( syāt ) |
utpattivākyaśiṣṭena vākyāntara- śiṣṭaṃ bādhyate, padaṃ ca uttivākyaśiṣṭam |
( vākyā- ntaraśiṣṭa āhavanīyaḥ, tenāsau padena bādhyate |

āhavanīya- vākyamapi na tatra vidāhatītyāha - ) kiñca homena ādhārasya ( āhavanīyasya ) anapekṣitatvāt vākyena asau ( ādhāraḥ ) nīyamānaḥ ( dīyamānaḥ : iti likhite pāṭhaḥ ), ye śuddhāḥ ( utpannāḥ agnihotrādayaḥ ) homāḥ tānanya āhavanīyaḥ ādhāro vidhīyate, na ( tu ) re ( padahomādayaḥ : upyamānā eva ) ādhāraluptāḥ ( tānanya ) |
bhāṣyam - - ayyocceta, evamupāyaṃ tat kapālaṃ saṃdhī yate |
' gāyatryā tvā śatākṣarā saṃdhīta ' iti tat kapālaṃ saṃdhiyāmiti |
bhāṣyam - - na medanasya śeṣabhūtaṃ yujyate, na tat saṃdhātuṃ śakyate homena mantreṇa vā |
bhāṣyam - - sarvanāśe ca śrūyate ' bhinne kapālamap praharati ' iti |
tasmānnimittakaṃ karmāṅgam, bhinne juhotīti śā - - ' tatraikadeśabhedasya nityatvāt nimittatā |
dvitīyapakṣavādī tu manyate ' homo'yaṃ bhinnasaṃskāro bhedadoṣanirbarhaṇāt |
tasmāt yadā kiyatā'pi aśena medaṃ bhavati tadaiva homaḥ |
saṃskāratve hi bhinnasya nimittatvaṃ na labhyate |

soma - pūrvatra kādācikānāṃ anyeṣāṃ (ṛtviga- bhinnānāṃ) agraṇe'pi iha kṛtsnameda eva grāhyaḥ iti pratyavasthānāt, bhakṣaṇasya dravyasaṃskārakatvat homasya bhinna- saṃskārakatvam, iti pratyavaśānācca saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrātstha ekadeśe'pi bhinne prāyaścittaṃ syāt arthasya medanasya tatrāpi samavāyāt iti |
nimittatā samā bhaṅge gharṣe vā'to dvayorhutiḥ |
' bhāṭṭa- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ prāyaścittādhikāre 'bhinne juhoti, skanne juhoti' iti śrutam |

tatra kṛtsnamede evadam, utaikadeśamede eva, utobhayatrāpīti cintāyām, dvayoḥ saṃgharte sati ekadeśabhedasya arjananīyatvena nitya- tvāt nimittatvānupapatteḥ sarvamede evadaṃ cūrṇatādaśāyāṃ prāyaścittamiti prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ |

saṃgharteṇa katipayavayavānāṃ cūrṇībhāve'pi bhinnabhinnā iti pratīyamānatvāt kapālādi- sthūlavayavavibhāge eva medanapratīteḥ tasyaivānityatvena sarvamedanavat ekadeśamedanasyāpi nimittatvopapatteḥ tatrai- vāyaṃ homaḥ |
ayaṃ hi medanasya nimittatve'pi homasya prayojanāpekṣāyāṃ saṃnilopakārakatvalābhāya bhinnakapāla- saṃskārārthaḥ |
kapāle hi medanena uktaparimāṇāghāt vaiguṇya- prasaktau taparihārarūpaḥ homena saṃskāro nānupanaḥ |
tasya cānupapukkasa saṃskārayogāt sarvamedena ca upayogā- yogāt ekadeśamedanameva nimittam |
astu vā saptamī iyaṃ saṃskāratvapareva, na tu nimittatvārthikā'pi |
na ca bhinnasya kādācitkatvāt nityānityasaṃyogavirodhaḥ, rathaṃ- tarasya kādācitkatve'pi saṃmīlana ādidharmavidhivadupapatteḥ |
iti prāpte, bhābhyapayogitve bhūtopayogitve vā tasyopa- dhānādavasthatve 'bhinnaṃ kapālamamuṣ prakṣipatī, anyadupa- dadhāti' iti vākyavirodhāt nāyaṃ svatantro homo bhinna- saṃskārakaḥ |
etena prākaraṇikahomānuvādena laukikasya bhinnakapālasyaiva adhikaraṇatvena vidhiḥ |
homasya prākaraṇikasya kapālopadhānāottaratvāt 'anyadupa- dhāti' ityasya vaidhyarthapatteḥ prāyaścittasyā'nupapatteśca |
ata evadaṃ karmāntaram, tatra naimittikaṃ ārādupakārakaṃ ṛtuvaiguṇyaparihārāyai ṛtvigghatvena vidhīyate |
' darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ kapālopadhānam 'adhi ca vapate kapālāni copadadhāti' iti dvādaśadvandvamecca ekam |
5|2|3, darśa- pūrṇamāsayoḥ kartau sapnīka eka eva puruṣaḥ |
bhā. 6|2| 23-13, darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ katoraḥ te eva vā anye vā aniyamaḥ punaḥ prayoge |
ke. 11|3|12|135, darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ kāmyasāmidhenīṣu saṃkhyāvṛddhau āgamane saṃkhyāpūraṇam |
tatra sāyaṃ prātaḥkāle prāpte jīvatā karma kartavyam, iti kālārthaḥ saṃyogaḥ |
śā. 6|2|7, darśa- pūrṇamāsayoḥ kālabhedāt aṅgapravṛttiḥ iṣṭirājasyūyādhi- karaṇe (11|2|12) siddhāntitā |
su. pṛ. 779, darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ kumbhādipātrabhedane ājyādi- skandane ca homo vihitaḥ 'bhinne juhoti' 'skanne juhoti' iti |
sa ca nimittācca āvartanīyaḥ; na tu sakṛdeva |
vi. 6|2|9, darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'kṛṣṇājinaṃ ca śammā ca' yajñāyudham |
bhā. 4|1|2|2 varṇakaṃ 2, darśapūrṇa- māsayoḥ 'godohanena paśukāmasya praṇayet' iti vihitaṃ godohanaṃ prakṛtāveva niviśate |

bhā. 10|8|12|19-32, darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ caturthottaṃmayoḥ prayājayoḥ prati samā- nayati ityukte sati 'atihāye'tho bahiḥ prati samānayati' ityucyate, tena barhiṣaścaturthatāṃ darśayati iti śrautaḥ kramaḥ |
vi. 10|1|11 varṇakaṃ 3, darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ caturthakaraṇottaraṃ 'idaṃ brahmaṇaḥ' ityādinā māganadeśaḥ bhakṣaṇārthaḥ |
ke. 3|4|14|48-51, darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ caturthakaraṇavidhau āgneyaśabdena dvidevatyo na gṛhyate kintu āgneya eva kevalaḥ |
vā. 3|1|16|26-27, darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'caturhotrā paurṇamāsīmabhimṛśet, pañcahotrā amāvāsyām' iti abhimarśanaṃ aṅgadvipāṃ pradhānahaviṣāṃ ca, na pradhānahavimātrameva |
9|1|11-19, darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ jāgaraṇa aupavasathyāṃ rātrau kartavyam, tacca rakṣārthameṣṭavyaṃ vā |
vi. 12|1|8, darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ jāghanī śāstreṇa nocyate 'evaṃ paśaurniṣvanyā jāghanyā patnī- saṃyājayantyaḥ' iti |
sā saṃbhavati kṛtveti ānīya- mānā patnīsaṃyājārtham |
bhā. 3|1|123, darśa- pūrṇamāsayoḥ 'jāghanyā patnīḥ saṃyājayanti' atra jāghanī krayādinā saṃpādya yāgaḥ kartavyaḥ |
vi. 3|1|16, darśapūrṇa- māsayoḥ 'jāghanyā patnīḥ saṃyājayanti' iti arthakarma |
nahi tatra kācit śeṣabhūtā jāghanī asti |
laukikyā- stu tatra ājyena saha vikalpaḥ |
bhā. 12|4| 6|10, darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ juhūḥ parṇamayī palāśakāṣṭha- janyā ityarthaḥ |
avyabhicaritaṛtusaṃjñakadharmābhi juhūhetuḥ : palāśavṛkṣaḥ vākyena vidhīyate 'yasya parṇamayī juhūrbhavati' iti |
vi. 3| 6|1, darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ juhvayāṃ caturthavāramājyaṃ grāhyaṃ ājyagrahaṇakāle 'caturjuhvāṃ gṛhṇāti' |
1|1|4|15, darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ jummā- yām 'mayi dakṣakratū' iti mantraḥ paṭhanīyaḥ |
sa ca mantrapāṭhaḥ kratvarthaḥ : kratuyuktapuruṣadharmo vā, na puruṣārthaḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ jauhavājyaṃ prayājārtham, aupabhṛtājyaṃ ca prayājānuyājārtham |
bhāṣyam-- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śrūyate 'caturjuhvāṃ gṛhṇāti, aṣṭāvupabhṛti' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ jauhavamopabhṛtaṃ cobhayaṃ ubhayārthaṃ prayājemya anuyājemya (iti), uta jauhavaṃ prayājebhyaḥ, aupabhṛtamanuyājebhyaḥ |
kutaḥ ? yadyat ājyena kriyate, tasmai- tasmai bhavitumarhati, aviśeṣāt |
(samānayanasya aupabhṛtājyaprayojakatve sādhite tatsaṅgena aupabhṛtasya tādarthyaṃ cintyate, tatprasaṅgasaṅgena ca jauhavasya śrauvasya ceti) |
tasya ājyaprayojakatve sthite cāsmin pūrvā- dhikaraṇārambhaḥ |

iti prāpte, satyapi vede samidādipadānāmisāmānādhikaraṇye indramahendrādhikaraṇanyāyena samidādipadaiḥ tatprakāśanatānupa- pattiḥ |

na ca pūrṇamāsādiśabdavat pārṇahomayorivāve'pi tadartha- syāpi āgneyeḥ uddeśāṃśaviśavaśabdapratipādyatvasaṃbandhena uddeśyasaṃbandhitvāt pārṇahomasyasaṃskārakatvavat ihāpi samidā- dipadasya devatātve tatpratipādyatvasye : saṃskārakatvopapattiḥ iti vācyam |

tatrāve'pi 'samidho ama ājyasya viyantu, tanūnapādama ājyasya vetu' ityādimantravarṇeṣu agneḥ saṃbodhanena tato bhinnasyaiva samidādipadārthasya kriyā''nvayapratīteḥ : samidādipadasya agnipratipādakatvā bhāvāt abhisaṃskārakatve paśo atideśānupapatteḥ |
yattu itaraprayājānāṃ ārādupakārakatve'pi samidādyasya saminva- nāṅkabhūtasamissaṃskārakatvamiti, tanna |
tathātve 'yo vai prayājānāṃ mithunaṃ veda, samidho bahiriva yajati' iti liṅgānupapatteḥ |
atra hi ivaśabdena vastuto bahutvavā bhāvena āropitaṃ bahutvamiti sūcyate |

na ca tat saminvanāhyasmin yujyate, vastuta eva tāvat bahutvān ārādupakārakatvapaṣe tu satyapi bahutvavantāntasamidapadasya devatātve prātipadikārthajñānena ekasyaiva samidādyasya siddho liṅgaraśena yukto bahutvāropaḥ |
tasmāt catvāro'pi prayājāḥ ārādupakāraka eveti na vikṛtau ūhi tavyāḥ |
pāṭhakramādhikaraṇam bhā. 5|1|4|4, darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ prayājeṣu vākyapāṭhe- pratītasya kramasya niyamo'sti |
darśapūrṇamāsayo prayājādīnāṃ sarveṣāmaṅgānāṃ pradhānasamudāye eka evopakāro mukhyaḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ prayāja- dvyārthaṃ samānayanaṃ aupabhṛtājyasya prayojakam |
bhā. 4|1|15|40-41, darśa- pūrṇamāsayoḥ prayājavākye śrūyate, 'abhigrāmaṃ juhoti abhijihye' iti |
tasya abhikramaṇasya prayājeṣveṣa niveśaḥ, na sarveṣmin prakaraṇe |
3|1|19-20, darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ prayājaśeṣeṇa havirabhighāraṇārthaṃ śeṣadhāraṇārthaṃ pṛthak na kartavye prayājaśeṣebhiradhāraṇāya |
4|1|13-39, darśa- pūrṇamāsayoḥ prayogabhedena sarve kāmāḥ, na tu ekenaiva prayogeṇa |
1|4|12, darśapūrṇamāsayo: prastarasya praharaṇaṃ ‘āśīrbhi: prastaraṃ praharati’ (āśīrbhi: sūktavākena) |
1|3|15|12. darśapūrṇamāsayo: prastarasya praharaṇaṃ ‘saha śākhyā prastaraṃ praharati’ |
9|1|15. darśapūrṇamāsayo: prāggharṣa ceti somasya ho kālo|
ḍup. 5|4|136. darśapūrṇa- māsayo: ‘prācīmāharati’ iti śālāvāda:; na digvāda:|
bhā. 4|2|27, darśa- pūrṇamāsayo: prāśitrāvadānaṃ sarvebhya eva, na kevalaṃ āgneyādeva |
3|1|9|26. darśapūrṇamāsayo: prāśitrādibhakṣaṇaṃ ṛtvigbhireva kartavyam, na yajamānena |
tatra praiṣā: samā- mnātā: ‘prokṣaṇīrāsādaya, idhmabarhirupasādaya, suvaṃca suvacca saṃmṛḍḍhi, patnī saṃnahya''sajyenodehi’ iti |
tatra saṃdeha: kiṃ ya eva praiṣe, sa eva praiṣārthe, utā'nya praiṣe'nyaśca praiṣārthe, iti |
prāptakāle'pi sati yuṣmadādiṣveva upapadeṣu madhyamadyo vyavasthā |
yadā tava prāpta- kāla iti vivakṣyate tadā yuṣmadyeva madhyama:; nāsmadi śeṣe vā |
yadā salu kriyāyā: prāsa: kāla: ityetāvat vivakṣyate, na tava mama veti, na tadā yuṣmadādīnāmu- rodhena madhyamadyo bhavitumarhati |
na cedaṃ yugapat vivakṣituṃ śakyate, padārthasya prāpta: kāla: tava ceti |
tena yadi vā nijñāte padārthakāle ‘tava kāla:’ iti śakyate vaditum, yadi vā taveti niśitaṃ ‘padārthasya kāla:’ iti |
tatra padārthasya kālo vaditavya:; na tu yuṣmadarthasya |
sa hi kartavya: ityavagata:; na tu yuṣmadarthastathā |
parasmin hi praiṣe upapadyate, nāmni iti |
tasmāt yuṣmadartho gamyamāno na vivakṣita: ityucyate |
vā -- praiṣasya praiṣārthasya ca ādhvaryavasamākhyātādya- tvāt adhvaryuprayojyatve avadhārite kathamātmana: praiṣa: iti cedāha - naivāyaṃ praiṣa:, kiṃ tarhi ? prāptakālatāyāṃ loṭaṃ vakṣyāma: iti |
praiṣavādī tu āha, pratyāgam- viṣayā cet prāptakālatā vivakṣitā, hanta uttamapuruṣeṇa bhavitavyam |
praiṣe tu svabhānata: paraviṣayatvāt sulabha iti |
parastu āha, yadā samākhyā''dyatvāt samānakartṛtvāt praiṣa- buddhirapanītā, tadā prāptakālamamidhīyamānaṃ kiṃ kriyāṇā- mamidhīyatām, uta kartṛṇāmiti, kriyāṇā ityeva gamyate |
tā: hi coditatvāt prayojanavatya: prathamata: prītā: |
ākhyāteṣu ca prathamāde: puruṣasya kasyacit avaśyambhāvāt nānta- rīyakaka eva madhyamapuruṣo bhaviṣyati |
yadi ca kartu: prāptakālamucyate, tata: ‘kiṃ kartṛm’ iti sākāṅkṣameva syāt |
atha ‘prokṣaṇyāsādanādi kartum’ iti (adhyāhriyate), tathā viśiṣṭārthapraiṣaṇāt vākyabheda: syāt |
athāpi praiṣo'yaṃ āśrīyate, tathāpi ātmānameva kathañcit śarīraśarīrino: avasthā- 'ntarāṇāṃ vā medena preṣakaṃ praiṣaṃ ca vyapadekṣyati |
praiṣeṣu ca itaramanya: kuryāt iti saṃtraya: |
itaramanya: iti pūrvasūtrādanuccat, kuryāt iti adhyā- hṛtam ) kuta: ? svabhāvenaiva teṣāṃ paraviṣayatvāt pari- krayavat |
tatra naivāyaṃ praiṣa iti, tadyuktam, mantrarūpadeva praiṣapratyayopapatte: |
yo hi samānakartṛkatayā taṃ bādhate, tena samākhyāyā liṅgaṃ bādhitaṃ syāt |
na ca prāptakālatāyā liṅga- virodha: parihriyate, madhyamapuruṣasya asannidhānāt |
na ca śabdāntareṇa anupāttā kriyā evaṃ śakyate vaktuṃ ‘tava prāpta: kāla:’ iti |
yadyapi ca śakyate, tathāpi na dṛṣṭa: kaści- dartha: syāt cetanavivakṣayāt aihasya prayogasya |
tataśca yadyapi prāptakālatāyāmeva loṭ, tathāpi parasyaiva sā kathyate iti parādhikāro nivartate |
na ca ekapadatvāt anekatorthai: vākyaṃ bhinnatti |
na ca īdṛśaṃ viśiṣṭavidhānaṃ kacit nābhyupagantavyam |
prāptakālatve ca kriyāyuṣmadarthayo: pṛthaktvāt medena śakti: kalpyeta |
praiṣe tu tasya nityameva yuṣmadarthaviṣayatvāt madhyamapuruṣa: anuvāda: |
tasmāt liṅgena samākhyā- bādhāt anya: praiṣa:, anyaśca praiṣārtha: |
soma-- pūrvatra vacanabalāt āsideśasya prākṛta- samākhyālavdhasya kartṛrvādhe'pi, iha vacanābhāvāt na samākhyālavdhakartṛbādha: |
sūtrārthastu- praiṣeṣu praiṣārthamanya: kuryāt, teṣāṃ svabhāvata: paraviṣayatvāditi |
bhāṭṭa-- ‘prokṣaṇīrāsādaya’ ityādaya: praiṣā:, praiṣārthaśca prokṣaṇyāsādanadaya: samākhyānāt adhvaryave ekena kartavyā: |
na ca svasmin svasya praiṣānupapatti: ‘ceto dhṛtvā vidhyete’ ityādiviva svasminnapi svasyo- padeśasambhavāt |
vastuto naivāyaṃ praiṣa:, api tu ‘praiṣāti- sargaprāptakāleṣu kṛtyāśca’ (pā0 3|1|163) (kṛtya- pratyayā: loṭ ca eteṣu artheṣu syu: |
) iti cakrāreṇa loṭo'pi prāptakālatāyāṃ vidhānāt prāptakālatāyāmeva loṭ |
athavā ‘he prokṣaṇyāsādana tava prāta: kāla:’ iti kriyāyāṃ cetanatvādhyāropeṇa sa: |
yatra tu ‘agnīdhnīn vihara’ ityevaṃ praiṣa:, tatrāstu saṃbodhanatānu- rodhena praiṣārthasya āśrībhrkartṛkatvam |
vastutastu ‘he agnīt mamāgniṃviharaṇasya prāta: kāla:’ iti vyākhyātuṃ śakyatvāt na tatrāpi samākhyābādha: |

iti prāpte, samākhyā'nurodhena madhyamapuruṣasya sādhutvena kriyāyāṃ caitanyādhyāropeṇa vyākhyāne pramāṇābhāvāt saṃbodhana- madhyamayośca ahryārthatvāpatte: praiṣatvasamākhyānāpatteśca prāptakālārthatvānupapatte: praiṣasyāpi asmin aupacāri- katvāpattyā ekatrādhvaryūsamākhyāyādhena ubhayorbhinnakartṛ- katvameva |
darśapūrṇamāsayo: prokṣaṇaṃ na brīhirūpaprayuktam, kintu apūrvaprayuktam |
bhā. 9|1|11-19, darśa- pūrṇamāsayo: prokṣaṇādīni ghanipatyopakārakāṇi apūrva- prayuktāni |
1|4|189, darśapūrṇamāsayo: prokṣaṇyā- sādanādi karma nādhvaryo:, kintu agnīdha: |
9|1|34-5, darśapūrṇamāsayo: phalabhāvanāyāṃ aṅgopakāra upayujyate, nāpūrvasya phalasyo- tpattau |
yadyapūrvaṃ phaleṃ aṅgeprayuktam, aṅgatvameva tat syāt |
11|1|1735. darśapūrṇamāsayo: phalīkaraṇahoma: ‘ame'danvādyo’ iti mantreṇa anuṣṭhāyate dakṣiṇāgnī |
bhā. 1|1|17 36-37. darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ barhiḥ dvividhaṃ mukhyaṃ gauṇaṃ ca |
vi. 3|2|1. darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ barhiḥ barhirdharmāḥ vediḥ vedidharmāśca aṅgapradhānārthāḥ, na kevalaṃ pradhānārthāḥ |
bhā. 3|1| 1|1-5. darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ barhiḥ (mukhyaṃ) ‘yajñasya ghoṣadasi’ ityasminnanuvāke ( taisaṃ. 1|1|2) praukairmantraiḥ dātreṇa chitvā saṃpādyate |

ekaprayogavidhiparigṛhīteṣu padārthānusamaye sati prakṛtau pāṭhena klṛptakramayopaskāraṇaniyojanayo: aupadeśikapaśu- sāhityānurodhena ṣoḍaśakṣaṇavyadhāne'pi tadadhikyavyadhāne pramāṇābhāvāt, yenaiva krameṇopākaraṇam, tenaiva krameṇa niyojanamiti pravṛttiḥkramo yukta:|

prakṛte tu ekaprayāja- gatayornānāśākhāsvānumantraṇayo: pāṭhyābhāvena aklṛpta- kramatvāt, satyapi ca sarvaprayājānāmekaprayogavidhiparigrahe padārthānusamayāsaṃbhavāt ekaikasmin prayāje dvayordvayormantrayo: patnīgatatvācca prayājāntarīyamantrasya prayājāntarīyamantra pravṛttikrama: |

na ca nānāśākhāsthayo: klṛptakramatvābhāve'pi ekāśākhāsthatvena pañcānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ pāṭhena klṛptakramatvāt śāstrā'ntareyye'pi aniyatatvavaśāne pravṛttiḥkramavādhā- pattiḥ, pañcānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ pañcaprayājāṅgatvena ekaśeṣatva- tvābhāvāt avāntaraprayogavidhibhedena bhinnaprayogavidhi- parigṛhītānāṃ pāṭhena kramāniyamāt |
iṣyate ca pañcā- kānuyājānāṃ aiṣṭikapaśuṣṭeiṣaphalakaraṇahomasya ca mahā- prayogamaikye'pi bhinnāvāntaraprayogavidhiparigṛhītatvena aklṛptakramatvam |
5. darśapūrṇamāsayo: yājyā'nuvākyā'smindimantrapāṭha- balāt āgneyapuroḍāśasya avadānādipradānāntaṃ kṛtvā paścāt sāṃnāyye tadanuṣṭhīyate |
vi. 5|4|2, darśapūrṇa- māsayo: yājyāpāṭhastiṣṭhatā kārya:, anuvākyāpāṭhastu āsīnena |
anvāhati ca śāstravat karma syāccodanā'- ntarāt |
tatra saṃśaya: kiṃ yājyā- puro'nuvākyānvācanaṃ pradhānakarma, uta saṃskārakarma iti |
yadi saṃskārakarma, tato rupādeva tayorvacanaṃ prāpnoti, puna: 'anvāha' iti vacanamanarthakam |
nahi anyathā tasya kartavyatā gamyate iti |
yathā stotraśastre, stauti śaṃsatīti kartavyatā'vagamāt pradhānakarmaṇī evamihāpi draṣṭavyam |
kutaḥ ? coditasyārthasya ya: śabda:, sa tadarthārtho bhavati |
sūtrā- rthastu-anvāhati vidhīyamānamavacanaṃ adṛṣṭakarma syāt codanā'ntarāt adṛṣṭārthatayā vidhānabalāt śaśvat iti |
bhāṭṭa— yājyā'nuvākyayorliṅgāt devatāprakāśanārtha- tvasaṃbhave'pi 'tiṣṭhan yājyānvāha, āsīna: puro'nu- vākyām' ityādivacanārthasyaprasaṅgāt stotraśastrāṇāmiva anuvacanasya adṛṣṭārthatvam |
nahi anuvacananuvādena atra guṇavidhi: saṃbhavati, atiprasaṅgāt kāryapatte: |
dṛṣṭārthatve dvayorvikalpā- patte: 'āsīna: puro'nuvākyam' ityatra yājyāpuro'nu- tvasyāpi vidhau vākyabhedapatte: |
vacanasya adṛṣṭārthatvāt na devatā''nyatve vikṛtī prākṛta- yājyā'nuvākyayorvācyaḥ, apitu vaikṛtayājyā'nuvākyā- pāṭhasattve tena samuccaya eva |

iti prāpte, yadyapi liṅgakalpyavidhipravṛtte: pūrve etaddidhapañcamīkṛtya viśiṣṭānuvacanavidhei: syāt, tathāpi iṣṭe saṃbhavati adṛṣṭa- kalpanasya anyāyyatvāt devatāsaṃskārārthatvameva anuvacanasya bhavet, na tu adṛṣṭārthatvam |
na ca yājyākarmakapraiṣe tadāpattiḥ, 'hotāraṃ preṣyati' iti hotureva praiṣe karmatvena yājyāyā- statkarmatvābhāvāt |
'puro'nuvākyāmanubrūya yājyā yajati' iti vākyāntareṇaiva samuccayapratīte: nāsīnavākye pura:padārthanirṇayāśaṅkā |
ato dṛṣṭārthatvāt yukta eva vikṛtau bādha: |
tat jyotiṣṭome aiṣṭikeṣu karmasu saumikena prasaṅgasiddham |
darśapūrṇamāsayo: lyanamanyasya mukhye kuśe eva viniyoga: |
darśapūrṇamāsayo: vatsopāsarjanaukhādhiśrayaṇānīti dvādaśa dvaṃdvāni adhvaryo: karma, na yajamānasya |
ke. 3|8|19-21. darśapūrṇamāsayo: vāgyama: 'yaśaṃ tanviṣyantī adhvaryu- yajamānau vācyaṃ yacchataḥ |
' atra vāgyamasya paramāpūrve na prayojakam, kintu haviṣkṛdāhāne vāgyamasya vihitatvāt āhānāt prāk ye prokṣaṇādaya: padārthā: tadīyāpūrve
vi. 9|1|7, darśapūrṇamāsayo: vidvadvākyaṃ 'ya evaṃ vidvān paurṇamāsīṃ yajate' 'ya evaṃ vidvānamāvāsyāṃ yajate' iti samudāyānuvādakam |
2|2|3. darśapūrṇamāsayo: vidvadvākyadvaye kālayoganimitta- nāmadheyatvacchedena yajai: kālayogāgibhāvasyavāsāyāt bhinnavākyavihitānāmapi ekakālānvayāt samudāya: saṃbhavati |
darśapūrṇamāsayo: 'vatsānuṃ paśukāmasya vedaṃ kuryāt' iti puruṣārtham, na kravartham |

bhā. 4|1|21 varṇaka 2. darśapūrṇa- māsayo: vedadvayavihiteṣu aṅgeṣu nānāvedasvare prokte guṇamukhyatvakrimanāyena yājurvedikapradhānadharma: upāṃśutvaṃ prāpnoti, tato vācanika: svaro bhavati 'mandrā ājyabhāgāntam, paraṃ madhyamayā, uttamayā anuyājādi' iti |
darśapūrṇamāsayo: vedavedīdvayabharhaṇādīnāṃ svaskāle karaṇam, na tu pradhāna kāle |
darśapūrṇamāsayo: vediṃ 'devasya tvā savitu: prasave iti snati' |
darśapūrṇamāsayo: vede: 'pūrvedyu ramāvāsyāyāṃ vediṃ karoti' iti pūrvedyupakalpe: |
darśapūrṇamāsayo: vedyā: tri: prokṣaṇaṃ 'vedirasi barhiṣe tvā' iti mantrasya prathamaprokṣaṇe pāṭha ekadaiva, na pratiprokṣaṇaṃ mantrāvṛtti: ; vederatvāt prokṣaṇāvṛttistu vācanikī |
vi. 11|4|16, darśa pūrṇamāsayo: vedikaraṇadau 'yo'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣma:' iti mantro dveṣābhāve'pi paṭhanīya: ; apūrvārtha tvāt |
darśapūrṇamāsayo: vediparigraha: (vedimāpanaṃ prātha mikam) 'spyena vediṃ parilikhan parigṛhṇāti'
bhā. 11|4|14|49-50, darśapūrṇa- māsayo: vedirbāhirādaya: padārthā: sarvāṅgapradhāna- havirdharmā: na pradhānamātrā: |
mudhimeyā 3|7|1|19-5. darśapūrṇamāsayo: vedistaraṇe 'tridhātu pañcadhātu vā vediṃ stṛṇāti' iti tatra pratidhātu staraṇa- mantrāvṛtti: |
mudhimeyā daṃbho: ekadhena eka: dhātu: iṣyuyyate |
vi. 11|4|19, darśapūrṇamāsayo: vedistaraṇe mantra: 'stṛṇīta varhi: paridhatta vediṃ jāmiṃ mā hiṃsīratu yā śayānā |
dabhai: stṛṇīta harite: suparṇairnidhakā ime yajamānasya bhrame |
tatra modre caro 'puṇḍarīkai: stṛṇīta harite:' ityuha: kartavya: |
ke. 3|6| 3120. darśapūrṇamāsayo: 'vaidhānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapedamāvāsyāṃ vā paurṇamāsī vā'tipātaṃ svakāle akaraṇam |
vi. 1|2|3|5, darśapūrṇa- māsayo: vaiśvānareṣṭi: patnīsaṃyājeṣu kapālamihome prāyaścittam |
bhāṣyam-- darśapūrṇamāsayo: śrūyate 'barhiṣā vai paurṇamāse vratamupayanti, vatseramāvāsyāyām' iti |
tatra saṃdeha: kiṃ vatsasādhanakaṃ vrataṃ vidhīyate, uta vatsasya kāla: iti, atha vatso matrā''ptamiti |
kiṃ prāptam ? vatsasādhanakaṃ vrataṃ vidhīyate iti |
amāvāsyāyāṃ vatsetaṃ kuryāt iti vatsasaṃyoga: apūrvai: sa vidhīyate |
tasmiṃśca vidhīyamāne ubhayamapi vihitaṃ bhavati, vatso vrataṃ ca |
bhāṣyam-- yathoktasya vā vacanāntareṇa prāptasya vratasya kāle'yaṃ vidhīyate |
katham ? 'amādhamamāsaṃ bahusarpiṣkaṃ vrataṃ vratayati' iti vihitaṃ pūrvaṃ vratam |
bhāṣyam-- na ca śakyo'tārtha: parimātum, vatsena vratamupayanti |
kiṃ vatso'tra vratitavya: ? evaṃ vatsena vratamupagataṃ bhavati |
kiṃ vatsena hastāsthānīyena vratayitavya- miti, evaṃ tadupayataṃ bhavati |
uta vatsa sannidhāya anya- detadupayeyāditi, naiva vyavasthitaṃ śāstrārtha: |
naivārtha: paricchidyate, vrate kiṃ vatsena kriyate iti |
tathā vatso vratena saṃdhayamāna: iṣṭa: syāt apārathaṃtāmāpayeta |
bhāṣyam-- yaduktaṃ vihitatvāt vratasyānuvāda iti, tanna |
vatse aṅge vidhīyamāne ubhayamapi vihitaṃ bhavati, vatso vrataṃ ca |
bhāṣyam-- na ca śakyo vatso'tra vratayitum |
prasthāpya (sthāyīya) rūpo guṇa: phalalāya vidhīyate, na |
iti phalaviśeṣāya guṇaviśeṣavidhi: , na tu saṃkramamya: |
darśapūrṇamāsayo: saṃmārjanaṃ paryagnikaraṇaṃ ca guṇakarma, na |
triruttamān' iti vidhānāt āvṛttyā pañcadaśa saṃpadyate |
darśapūrṇamāsāmyāṃ yajeta' iti deśasya niyamavidhi: na tu |
'same yajeta iti deśasya saṃbandha: karmaṇā saha vidhīyate |
āgamanena saṃkhyā pūrayitavyā, uta abhyāsena, uta |
prathamottamayo: tri: abhyāsa anuṣṭheya: , tena saṃkhyā pūrva- |
abhyāsena hi pūrvamāṇā na ṇāmjñatyena syāt |
prathamottame ca trimyasitavye saṃkhyā ca pūrayitavyā |
yaśca arthādapi kṛta: , na sa codanārtha: |
āgamanena vā saṃkhyāyā pūrayitavyāyāṃ abhyāsa ukta: |
tasmāt nānenābhyāsena saṃkhyā pūrayitavyeti codaka āha |
bhāṭṭa— ' ekaviṃśatimanbūyāt pratiṣṭhākāmasya ' ityādinā yatra sāmidhenīvṛddhi: śrutā, tatra nyāyaprāpto- 'pi āgamo na pravartate |
prakṛtau ' tri: prathamāmanvāha tricattamām ' iti vacanena ekādaśasaṃkhyāyāṃ paṭhitānā- mṛcāṃ prathamottamayo: yāvatpañcadaśasaṃkhyāparipūrrbhyāsa- vidhānena āgamabhāvādbhavate: |

na cānena prathamottamayo: tribhyāsamātravidhānena tato'dhikānāmāgamabhāvā:, tribhyāsāvadhau adṛṣṭārthatvāpatte: anena vacanena prayāja- śeṣābhidhāraṇanyāyena lakṣaṇāyā ' pañcadaśa sāmidhenīrū- brūyāt ' iti vihitapañcadaśasaṃpattyarthena abhyāsamātra- vidhānāt |
ekādaśānāṃ hi ṛcāṃ prathamottamayo: yāva- tsaṃkhyāsaṃpattyabhyāse ' samaṃ syādaśrutatvāt ' iti nyāyena pratyekaṃ tribhyāsa eva saṃpadyate |
ata eva dvicaturabhyāse- nāpi saṃkhyāsaṃpattisiddhe: tribhyānuvādānupapattiriti pārtha- sārathyuktamapāstam |
ataśca lakṣaṇayā yāvatsaṃkhyāsaṃpatti- prathamottamame abhyaset itivākyārthāvagamāt ekaviṃśa- tyādisaṃpattyarthamapi tayorevābhyāsa: |
na ca prathamottamayo: uddeśyatve tadanekatvanimitto vākyabheda:, ' ardhamantarvedi ' ititrat tadubhayatvasya lakṣaṇā uddeśyatā'vacchedakatvāt |

iti prāpte, niṣpādakapratyadhikaraṇanyāyena adṛṣṭārthatvā- pattāvapi lakṣaṇāyā anyāyatvāt prayājaśeṣābhidhāraṇa- nyāyasyāpi ata eva asminnarthe'pyapādāt kriyā- padānupadreṇa apyatra vākyadvayena prathamānuddeśena tribhyāsa eva vidhīyate |
ata eva ekādaśānāmuccāṃ prathamottamayo: tristribhyāse pañcadaśasaṃkhyāsaṃpatte: vastuta: ' pañcadaśa sāmi- dhenīranūyāt ' ityatra naiva saṃkhyā vidhīyate ityuktaṃ kaustubhe |
ata: pañcadaśasaṃkhyāyā aprāptatvāt tatsaṃpattya- rthatvena lakṣaṇāyā abhyāsavidhirupapatte: tribhyāsa: evānena vidhīyate |
' tā: pañcadaśa saṃpadyante ' iti tu ' tri: prathamāmanvāha ' ityasyārthavādamātramiti dhyeyam |
ataśca ekaviṃśatyādavāpi prathamottamame tribhyāsasya avaśiṣṭāṇāṃ prākṛtādhikānāmāgama: iti siddham |
' darśapūrṇamāsayo: sāmidhenīnāṃ sthānaṃ āhavanīyāgne: paścimo deśa: |
ci. 3177, darśapūrṇamāsayo: sāmidhenīṣu ' ekaviṃśatimanbūyāt pratiṣṭhākāmasya ' iti |
5|3|3. darśapūrṇamāsayo: sāmidhenītribhyāsa: prathamo- ttamasthānadharma:, na tu pravovājādiśrvaviśeṣadharma: |
tatra sāmidhenī: prakṛtyucyate ' tri: prathamāmanvāha, tricattamāmanvāha ' iti |
tatra eṣo'yaṃ: saṃśayika: kiṃ ṛgdharma eṣa: yatratatrasthā pravovājā tribhyāsitavyā, uta sthānadharma: yā anyā''pi prathamamucyate sā tribhyāsitavyeti |
yadi evamabhisaṃndha: kriyate yā asau uccaritānāṃ sāmidhenīnāṃ prathamamucaritā sā tribhyāsitavyeti, tata: pravovājā: ṛco dharma: |
atha evaṃ vijñāyate prāthamyasaṃyuktaṃ tribhyāsādi, tato vacanasya sthānadharmatā |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? ṛco dharma iti |
yadi tadviśeṣaṇaṃ prāthamyaṃ syāt, tato liṅgaviśeṣanirdeśa: avakalpate, sā'pi hi abhyāsena saṃbandhasthe |
aya prathamamanbuvatā tribhyāsitavyamiti, tato vyaktiviśeṣo na vivakṣyeta, tatra klīliṅgaviśeṣa- nirdeśo nopapadyate |
api ca vākyabheda: prasajyeta prathamamuktaṃ tribhyāsitavyam, prathamamuktā ṛk tribhyāsa- sitavyeti |
matpakṣe puna: prāthamyalakṣitāyā ṛco dharma ucyate |
api ca śrutyā prāthamyena klī saṃbadhyate, vākyena abhyāsa: |
yo'yaṃ sāmidhenīnāṃ prathamāyā: tribhyāsa: ucyate, sa prathama-
sthānanimitto dharma:, na ṛca: kasyāścit jātinimitta: |
kuta: ? na hi klīliṅge ṛgvede prathamā nāma kācit ṛk vidyate, yā tribhyāsyeta, tatra prāthamyamupalakṣaṇārthaṃ syāt |
itarasmin pakṣe śruti: na lakṣaṇā, śrutiśca jyāyasī lakṣaṇāyā: |
atha yaduktaṃ ' klīliṅganirdeśāt abhyāsapakṣe eva śruti:, vākyaṃ ca na bhidyate, klīliṅgopapattiśca ' iti |
guṇavacanānāṃ hi śabdānāṃ āśrayato liṅgavacanāni bhavanti iti aviśeṣamāṇāyāmapi vyaktau yat avaśyaṃ prāptaṃ liṅgam, tadāśrayabhūtaṃ guṇasya bhavati |
avidhi- site'pi tasmin liṅgaviśeṣanirdeśa: anuvādabhūto bhavatyeva |
yathā śukla: pumān, śuklā strī, śuklaṃ napuṃ- sakam |
śukla: eka:, śuklo dvau, śuklā bahava: iti |
śuklāṃ śāṭīmānayeti yadyapi śāṭyādyānayanaṃ na vidhīyate, śuklasaṃbandhadharmāviccā bhavati, na tatra liṅgena viśeṣaṇaṃ kriyate, tathāpi anuvādabhūta: klīliṅganirdeśo bhavatyeva ' śuklāmānaya ' iti |
evaṃ ca sati yadyapi prāthamyasya klīliṅga- saṃbandha: śrauta:, tathāpi prāthamyasya abhyāsena saṃbandha:, na liṅgasya |
yadi liṅgasya etena saṃbandha: abhīyite, prāthamyasya anuvādatā kalpyeta |
api ca naivātra vivaditavyaṃ prātipadikaviśeṣaṇaṃ hi klīśabda: ' striyāṃ yat prātipadikaṃ vartate tata: dvādādaya: ' iti |
na viśeṣaṇasya padāntareṇa saṃbandho bhavati yathā ' rājapuruṣo gacchati ' iti |
yadā tu prāthamyasya abhyāsena saṃbandha:, tatra prāptamanūyate klīvam |
yāni sāmidhenīṣu vacanāni, ṛcastā:, klīliṅgaśca ṛkśabda: |
tatra yat prathamaṃ vacanam, tasyāśraya: ṛk |
guṇavacanānāṃ ca śabdānāmāśrayato liṅgavacanāni bhavanti iti aviśeṣitāyāmapi ṛci klīliṅgaṃ bhaviṣyati |
yat prathamavacanaṃ tat trirāha iti strī ca sā ṛk sāmidhenī |
tasmāt ' tri: prathamāmanvāha ' iti prāptasya liṅgasya anuvāda: |
' tri: prathamāmanvāha, tricattamām, tā: pañcadaśa saṃpadyante ' iti pañcadaśānāṃ sāmidhenīnāṃ saṃpatte tricaṃtanamucyamānaṃ paripūrṇāyā ṛco bhavati, na ṛgavayava: |
tasmāt prāptānanuvādo liṅgasya iti prāthamyasya dharma: na ṛca: |
' soma— pūrvatra yathā apekṣitavicilemena patnī- saṃyājāntavatmuttamayajñe ityuktam, evaṃ pāścadasyasiddhaye apekṣita: ṛgbhyāsa eva vidhīyate iti pratipādānāt saṃgati: |
sūtrārthastu- sāmidhenīnāṃ madhye prathamottmā- bhyāsa: prāthamyasaṃbandhāt prathamaśabdena upasthitatvādvā sthānadharma: iti |
' sthānāntare paṭhitāyā: ' pra vo vājā: ' ityasyā ṛca: nāstyabhyāsa: |
bhāṭṭa— darśapūrṇamāsayo: sāmidhenīvāntaraprakaraṇe ' tri: prathamāmanvāha tricattamām ' iti śrutam |
tatrānuvacanaṃ tāvat prakaraṇaprāptamanujñate, tribhyāsamātraṃ tu vidhīyate |
tatrāpi prathamamiti viśeṣaṇārthaṃ prāthamyaviśiṣṭamabhidhatte śuklā- dipadavat |
tatra viśeṣyaṃ klīliṅganirdeśāt sāmidhenī- prakaraṇāt ṛgeva |
prāthamyarūpaviśeṣayogācca ṛgviśeṣa- pratītirbhavati, na tu pravovājāditvaprakārikā upasthiti: |
na tu tadupalakṣitapravo- vājāditvaṃ vinā kāraṇaṃ lakṣaṇāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvādityādivāda- meva |

prathamāsakte ānarthakye prasakte apūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇayā apūrvasādhanabhūtāmisandhi- prakāśakaṛkcamātralakṣaṇe atiprasaṅgapatte:, tannirākaraṇārthaṃ uddeśyatā'vacchedakatve ṛkcatvaviśeṣaṇatathā pravovājādi- tvasya vivakṣaṇam, uta prāthamyasya iti cintāyām, prāthamyarūpasya aśrutasya uddeśyatāvacchedakasya grahītvā- diyat apūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇopayogiśakyatvopasthitau upaśrīṇa- tvena niṣkṛtāpūrvasādhanatvarūpoddeśyatā'vacchedakatvopaveśe
iti prāpte, atiprasaṅgapari- hārārthamavayavakalpyena kacit tattadādhārakāhanatvāti- riktena viśeṣaṇe upasthitatvāt upakṣīṇenāpi prāyasyaiva viśeṣaṇaṃ na tu anusthityetana pravojādyatvena|
avāghātādau tu taṇḍulaniṣvattivyāpakasādhanatāmātreṇaiva uddeśyatvaparva- vasānāt yavānāṃ dharmāṅgatvena vyavasthādhāraṇakalpane'pi ca vākyatvedharyābhāvāt nātiprasaṅgaparihārāyai brīhivi- praveśaḥ|
prakṛte tu atiprasaṅgāṅgīkāre prathamautpāpada- ghaṭitavākyadvayaidharyāpatteḥ 'tāḥ pañcadaśa saṃpadyante' ityevādānupatteśca viśeṣaṇavivakṣā āvaśyakī|
māsayoḥ suvajyuhapabhṛddhṛpavāṇāṃ phalaśrutiḥ phalārthavādaḥ, na tu phalavidhiḥ |
bhā. 4|1|1|1-3. darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ svargaḥ phalam, tacca na vidheyaṃ saundaryāt svayaṃ pravṛtteḥ |
bhā. 3|4|1|9, darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ sviṣṭakṛt puroḍāśasya na prayojakaḥ |
ke. 4|1|7|18-20, darśa- pūrṇamāsayoḥ sviṣṭakṛdādiśeṣa- karmāṇi sarvebhyo havirbhyaḥ anuṣṭheyāni, naikasmāt kasmāccit |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ sviṣṭakṛdādiśeṣakarmāṇāṃ eka- syādeva cet prāthamikadeva |
bhā. 3|4|16|46-47. darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ sviṣṭa- kṛdādiśeṣakāryaṃ śrautāvyena na kāryam, uttarārdhadi- kāryāntarasadbhāvāt |
bhā. 3|5|1 | 1-12, darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ sviṣṭakṛdyāgaḥ anuyājeṣu saṃskārakaḥ na ārādupakārakaḥ |
10|4|1|9|138. darśa- pūrṇamāsayoḥ haviṣāṃ śrapaṇaṃ gārhapatye śrutam |
itarathā vinā vākyena phalaṃ kalpayitavyaṃ syāt |
tasmāt vākyaṃ phalā- bhāvenaiva bādhitam, itiktvā prakaraṇamanugrahīṣyatīti |
bhāṣyam-- na ca tadvikāraḥ agnihotraṃ jyotiṣṭomo vā, na darśapūrṇamāsavikāraḥ |
yadi tadvikāro bhavet, tatrāpi skanne bhinne vā prāyaścittaṃ syāditi |
śā-- gataṃ prāsaṅgikaṃ ( 6|5|8-14 ) punaḥ prāya- ścittādhikāramanusandhatte |
soma-- sūtrārthastu-- adhikāre darśapūrṇamāsādi- prakaraṇe śrutaṃ prāyaścittaṃ doṣasāmānyāt sarvatra syāditi |
vi-- 'bhinne hotre yatratatra prakṛte vā, nimittataḥ |
' bhaṭṭa-- 'bhinne juhoti' ityādi prāyaścittaṃ naimittikamapi phalapekṣāyāt prakaraṇāt katvaṅgam |
nimitta- mapi bhedanādikaṃ na laukikapālādeḥ, prāyaścittasāmānyā- calena ṛtvijbhuktakapālādibhedananimittatve'pyaparihārya- tvasyaiva kalpane svatantrādṛṣṭakalpane gauravāt |
darśapūrṇamāsākhyasya ekasyaiva karmaṇaḥ ayanādi- śabdavācyādṛṣṭaguṇayogena anekadākṣayaṇādisaṃkṣepa- pattiḥ |
bhāṣyakāroktam, tatrāha--) vākyakaraṇasamākhyābhiḥ 'ebhiḥ ( ṛtvigbhireva ) maśritanyam' ityasyāpi ( kartṛ-- ) niyamaśca dṛṣṭameva prayojanam |
tadanu niṣpannaṃ ( uktaprayojanānuniṣpanna ) apekṣyāha ( bhāṣyakāraḥ ) : taddhi bhakṣaṇaṃ puruṣasaṃskārārtha iti |
yājñikaistu ( kriyā- prayojanaṃ dravyasaṃskāraḥ niyamaprayojanaṃ tu kartṛsaṃskāraḥ iti ) vivekamāgrahītvā 'bhakṣāḥ puruṣasaṃskārāḥ' ityādyuktam |
bhāṣyam-- yattu dravyadānamātraṃ pradhāne nirdiśyate, tadvacanaprāmāṇyāt parisaṃkhyānāyate |
pari- saṃkhyāyāṃ trayo doṣāḥ : svārthahānam, asyārthaparigrahaḥ, prāptavādhaśceti |
bhāṣyam-- atha yaduktaṃ aśvamedhe virodhaḥ syāt bahutvāt bhakṣāṇāmiti |
arthāt sarve bhakṣayantaḥ aśvamedhaṃ na samāpayeyuḥ |
soma-- sūtrārthastu-- śeṣabhakṣaḥ anyaiḥ kāryaḥ 'yaja- mānapañcamā idamam' iti nirdeśāt |
yathā sarvasya home prāpte dravyadānamātraṃ nirdeśād homaḥ, tadvat iti |
tatredābhakṣe 'yajamānapañcamāḥ iḍāṃ bhakṣayanti' iti śrutāḥ kartāraḥ |
tathā prāśitrabhakṣe 'prāśitraṃ brahmaṇaḥ pariharati' iti śrutaḥ |
śaṃyuvākakālabhakṣe tu 'haviḥśeṣān bhakṣayanti' ityāmnātena bahutvavacanena ācāryavacanasamākhyāyā'pi karmakaratvāt sarve ṛtvijo bhavanti |
na ca ihābhakṣe nyāyaprāptikalpunaḥśravaṇasya parisaṃkhyā''tvāt śaṃyuvāka- kālabhakṣe tadanya eva bhaveyuriti vācyam |
ṛtvijāṃ prāptatve'pi aprāptayajamānasāhityasya tatra vidhīyetena tasya makṣāntare ṛtvikaparisaṃkhyārthatvābhāvāt |
atra hi iḍādiśeṣa kartṛviśiṣṭabhakṣāntaravidhāne'pi viśeṣaṇavidhi- velāyāṃ prāptaprāptavivekana bhakṣo yajamānasāhityena ca vidhīyate |
ṛtvijāṃ tu bhakṣasya prayājaśeṣābhidhāraṇa- nyāyena kartṛsaṃskāratvāpi bhakṣayamāṇatvena ānarthakya- tvāt prāśitrabhakṣe na vidhānam, svata eva ānarthakyāt aprāptaṃ yajamānasāhityaṃ tu vidhīyate |
yadi tu kariṣya- māṇakarmaṇi balādhānārthatvamapi bhakṣasyeti vibhāvyate, tadā astu yajamānapañcamagrahaṇaṃ patnīparigrahārtham |

sarvathā makṣāntare kartṛparisaṃkhyā''tvāt śaṃyuvākakāla- bhakṣe ṛtvija eva kartāraḥ ; asmin pakṣe tasmin patnīyajamānayoranivṛttiḥ ; 'atraiva ṛtvijo haviḥśeṣān bhakṣayanti' iti kalpasūtrakāravacanādavagantavyā |
bhā. 1|14|4|47-48, darśapūrṇa- māsādī nīcārādipratinidhiṣvapi avaghātādimukhya- dharmā'nuṣṭhānam |
3|6|14|37-39. darśapūrṇamāsādī nīvārasaṃkalpottaramapi brīhime brīhya eva grāhyā na nīvārāḥ |
bhāṣyam- naitadasti agnīdhaḥ preṣaḥ; adhvaryoḥ praipārtha iti |
evamadhvaryuṇā preṣaḥ praipārthaśca ubhayapi kṛto bhaviṣyataḥ |
kimasya mukhyatvam ? yadanena sarve kartavyaṃ samākhyānāt iti |
atha yaduktaṃ 'adhvaryuḥ pracaritā dṛśyate' iti, taducyate |
satyaṃ dṛśyate, na tu asya praipārthakaraṇe pramāṇamasti cintyamānam |
yasya hi darśanasya pramāṇaṃ nāsti, bhyāmohaḥ saḥ |
ādhvaryave vede samāmnātān padārthān karoti iti kṛtvā adhvaryuiratyucyate āmīdhra iti |
tasmāt ādhvaryavaḥ preṣaḥ, āmīdhraḥ praipārtha iti |
vā-'mukhyaṃ vā pūrvacodanāt' iti prāthamyāt preṣe samākhyātaḥ kartā yuktaḥ |
tasmistu prayukte virodhāt praipārthe anyo bhavati |
prayojakaśca ya prayojyavyāpāre'pi kartṛtvaṃ na vihanyate ityubhayānugrahaḥ |
itarathā hi praipe atyantabādha eva syāt |
nahi sa tena kṛto nāpi kārito bhavet |
bhāṭṭa- tatrāpi bahuṣu pradhānabhūteṣu praipārtheṣu samākhyā- bādhe pramāṇābhāvādekasmin 'prokṣaṇīrādāya' ityādi- prepa eva adhvaryudhāvena anyakartavyam |
ata eva 'tiryyaṃ spayaṃ dhārayitvā saṃpreṣamāha yadanyaṃ dhārayet, spayo vajreṇādhvaryuḥ kṣiṇvīta' iti dhārayitṛbhirmamadhe darśayati |
iti prāpte, praipārtheṣu anyakartṛtve'pi prayo- jakāvenāpi adhvaryoḥ kartṛtvopapatteḥ samākhyāyāḥ |
kutrāpi aghādhāt praipārthān anya eva kuryāt, praipadhāraṇaṃ tu adhvaryuḥ |
sa ca somādāvasti viśeṣavacane pratiprasthā- trādiḥ |
bhāṣyam- atha evaṃ gate (preṣapraipārthayorbhinna- kartṛkatve avagate ityarthaḥ) idaṃ saṃdihyate kimadhvaryuḥ agnīdhaṃ preṣayet, uta abhīdhaḥ adhvaryumiti |
yadanyaṃ dhārayet vajro vai spayo vajreṇā- dhvaryuḥ kṣiṇvīta' iti |
spayena adhvaryuḥ kṣiṇvīta iti anyamadhvaryuṃ preṣakāt darśayati |
sa ca adhvaryuḥ kṣiṇvīta iti vadan agnīdhaṃ spayavantaṃ preṣakaṃ darśayati |
kā tu asya prāptiḥ ? 'aṅguṣṭhavirodhe ca tādarthyāt' ityanena adhvāt praipasya kartulepo yuktaḥ, na pradhānasya |
tena 'bhūyasāṃ syāt sadharmatvam' (1|2|1|22) ityapi praipārthe adhvaryu- riti, pariśeṣāt praipe agnīdha |
yatu liṅgam, tat yadi adhvaryuḥ anvayaṃ dhārayet tadā spayaḥ taṃ kṣiṇvīta itye'pi bādhakābhāvāt dhāraṇapraipayorācāryavat'pi upapannam |
spayadhāraṇamapi kalpasūtrepu ādhvaryavameva prasiddhamiti atattvārthikaṃ prauḍhivādaḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsādī sviṣṭakṛdādiśeṣakāryārtha- mavattasya dravyasya nāśe śeṣakāryalopaḥ |
bhāṣyam- atha sviṣṭakṛddharmavat yadi vinaśyati, tatra kiṃ śeṣādadeyam, uta neti |
śeṣābhājāṃ syālopaḥ (lopaḥ iti padasya sūtre adhyāhāraḥ |
viśiṣṭaṃ hi kāraṇaṃ tasmādavadāne, kathaṃ pratipādyateti |
tasya viviktakaraṇāya pratipādyamānasya niyamo'yaṃ 'sviṣṭakṛddhomena pratipādya- tavyaḥ' (iti) |
sa yadi homāya uddhṛto vipadyeta, kṛte viveke na punargrahaṇaṃ prayojayet |
ḍup- (pūrvapakṣamākṣipatti-) sviṣṭakṛt agni- prayuktasya (anyaprayuktasya iti ānandāśramīye pāṭhaḥ |
evaṃ cet saṃnihitaṃ parakīya graha- vyati (ataḥ nāśe lopa eva siddha iti) kimataḥ (adhikaraṇakṛtyam ?) ucyate |
(tataḥ ) yāhaśaṃ prayuktam, tat yādṛśyābhāvāt na punaḥ śiṣṭādadeyaṃ (syāt ) |

yat punaraindraṃ saṃskāryam, tasya ( kasmiścideśe vinaṣṭe'pi śiṣṭasya ) vidyamānatvāt punaradānena saṃskāraḥ kimiti na kriyate ? na cātra abhavayī upalakṣyārthaḥ : ( sviṣṭakṛdavadānopalakṣaṇārthaḥ ityarthaḥ :) |
1 viśiṣṭo deśaḥ ( sakalapuroḍāśottarārdhāvayavarūpaḥ, sviṣṭakṛdāgasya ) saṃskāryatvena apekṣitaḥ |
tasya ( ca deśasya ) abhāvāt kaḥ pratipattiṃ prayuṅkte ? apūrva- miti cet, tatra, dravyapratipādanānuniṣpādi ( eva ) atra apūrvam |
dravyapratipattiśca cikīrṣitā ( prayojikā ) na tu yāga- nirvṛttiriti |
( idaṃ ca sviṣṭakṛto lopavidhānaṃ nyāya- prāptam |
soma- pūrvavadiha nāsti avadeyābhāvaḥ, yena puna- radānaṃ na bhavet iti pratyavasthānāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrā- rthastu- punaradānanyāyattaḥ : adhivāsāt : lopaśab- daśrāpi adhyāhāraḥ |
tathā ca śeṣābhājāṃ svārthavattanāśe nāvadānam, kintu lopaḥ syāt pratipattirūpaviśiṣṭaprayo- janakāraṇatvāt tadanuṣṭhānasya pratipādyābhāve pratipatya- bhāvāditi |
vi-- 'iḍādyarthasya nāśe'nyaḥ śeṣādya ādyo na vā, 'ḍimaḥ |
bhāṭṭa- yatra tu tyāgāṃśyāni śeṣakāryāṇi yathā sviṣṭakṛdo, tattorārdhādināśe uttarārdhantarābhāvāt avaśiṣṭasya pratipatyantaragṛhītatvācca na sāvaccheṣeṇa karaṇam |
yājñikamate tu 'yadi praṣṭavyatam, ājyena śeṣa saṃkṣapayet' ityāpastambavacanādavaśyameva |
vidhāne tu śeṣaikadeśavināśo'pi avaśiṣṭenaiva avayavaśaḥ sarvapratipattiriyamiti dhyeyam |
bhā. 111|2|14-4. darśapūrṇamāsādiṣu juhādipātrāṇāṃ parṇatādidhiyāpi ulavaladādipāneṣu vāranavaikakṛtatvavidhivirodhaḥ |
bhā. 7|4|1|1. darśapūrṇamāsādiprakaraṇe vidhisaṃnidhau śrutānāṃ deśakālanimittaphalasaṃskārāṇāṃ na karmabhedakatvam |
su. pṛ. 1186. darśapūrṇamāsādi- saṃbaddhaphalaniyamatarkasamudāyesya sauryādiṣu nātideśaḥ |
bhā. 8|1|12|20-22. darśapūrṇamāsādirva- yajñārtha āghāne śrutaṃ vaikṛtadādipātram |
vi. 3|1|12. darśapūrṇamāsārambhatvaprasiddhiḥ yājñikānāṃ anya- nvādhānāditve prathamapadārthe |
bhāṭṭa. 9|1|11 pṛ. 67. darśapūrṇamāsāvṛttatvāpi anavārambhaṇīyāyāḥ ādau sakṛdevā'nuṣṭhānam |
bhā. 9|1|10|34-35. darśapūrṇamāsetikartavyatāyāḥ avihitatikarta- vyatākeṣu sauryādiṣu atideśaḥ |
vi. 8|1|3 varṇakaṃ 2. darśapūrṇamāsottarameva somavikārā gavādayaḥ ekāhā bhavanti na prāgapi |
4|3|15|13. darśapūrṇamāsopakārāya yadato yadūtaṃ praśasyate tanmatiṣedho vidhīyate |
tattathaiva yatkarmārthaḥ saṃdhadaḥ tatra sarvatra anṛtaṃ varjanīyam |
vā. 3|4|4|13 pṛ. 941. darśapūrṇamāsakarmaṇi yajamānaḥ utsargamātraṃ kuryāt, śeṣasya anya eva kartā adhvarvādiḥ |
bhā. 8|2|1|2 pṛ. 1528. darśapūrṇamāsagataṃ barhiḥ yūpavaṭsvaravahiṣo na prakṛtiḥ |
vi. 7|2|7. darśapūrṇa- māsagatayoḥ havirabhimarśanamantrayoścāhutaupaḍva- hotroḥ sauryādaye vikalpaḥ |
bhā. 8|2|1|5|26. darśapūrṇamāsagatāgneyadravyasya vikalpena śauryaṃ caro atideśaḥ |
bhā. 8|2|1|5|26. darśapūrṇamāsa- gatāgneyavidhivyantasya ekadevatākoṣadhadravyakavikṛtiṣu atideśaḥ, dvidaivate tu agnīṣomīyāderatideśaḥ, ājya- dravyake ca upāṃśuyājasyātideśaḥ |
vi. 8|1|16. darśapūrṇamāsagatājyanāmā paśūgataparvannidhini ajñanājye dharmāṇāṃ nātideśaḥ |
bhā. 7|3|7|18, darśapūrṇamāsagateḍā nigade yajñapatiśabdasya vikṛto nohaḥ |
vi. 8|1|14. darśapūrṇa- māsagatapeṣaṇamantre dhānyaśabdasya śakyānāmanyane 'māṃsamasi' iti ūhaḥ |
bhā. 9|1|2|38-39 varṇakaṃ 2, darśapūrṇamāsagatapraṇayanasya (apriyaṇasya) cāturmāsyagatapraṇaye (dvayoḥ praṇayanti) atideśaḥ, na saumikasya iti bhāṣyamam |
na dārśikam, na saumikaṃ kiṃtu apūrvameveti vārtikamatam |
bhāṣyam-- idamāmnāyate 'ekaraśme vā anyā iṣṭayaḥ kāmāyāhiyante, sarvebhyo darśapūrṇamāsau, ekasmai vā anye ṛtavaḥ kāmāyāhiyante sarvebhyo jyotiṣṭomaḥ' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimaṅgakāmaiḥ aṅgāṅkāmaiśca saha asyā- nuvādaḥ, athavā vidhiriti |
yathā 'āhāryapurīṣāṃ paśūkāmasya vediṃ kuryāt, lananapurīṣāṃ pratiṣṭhākāmasya' ityevamādayaḥ |
tathā, 'yadi kāmayeta varṣeta parjanya itye nīcaiḥ sado minuyāt' iti |
tadvi- hitamevedaṃ abhīṣṭaye ityanuvādaṃ nyāyyaṃ manyāmahai |
dup-- 'sarvebhyo jyotiṣṭomaḥ' iti vidhāyakā- bhāvāt sādhanatvābhāvaḥ |
sarvebhyo darśapūrṇamāsau, sarvebhyo jyotiṣṭomaḥ iti ca |
pradhānābhidhānena ca pradhānasya sarva- phalavattā vihitā |
atha aṅgakāmān aṅgāṅkāmāṃścāpekṣate, tathā lakṣaṇaśabdaḥ syāt |
kiṃ karmasādhyān kāmānapekṣya sarvakāmatā, uta yāvanta kecana kāmā iti |

aviśeṣāt yāvantaḥ kāmā iti anye ṛtavaḥ ekaphalasādhanakāḥ, ayaṃ tu ṛtuḥ sarvāṇīti ṛtugatāni phalānyapekṣya sarveteti cet, tan jyoti ṣṭomasya sarvaphalatve vidhīyamānasya arthavādo'yam tasmājjitaphalatayā nāsti pramāṇam |
yatrayaḥ kāmaśabdo hiraṇyakāmaḥ putrakāma iti, teṣvevātra sādhanatā |
tena ye eva vade kāmaśabdā uccāritāḥ, te'nuṣajyante |
śā -- 'sarvebhyaḥ kāmebhyo darśapūrṇamāsau' ityanu vādo darśapūrṇamāsastvarthaḥ |
tādarthyaṃ ca caturthyarthatvāt pramāṇaṃ na kenacit |
soma-- pūrvavat ihāpi nānekaphalārthatvaṃ iti pratyava- sthānāt saṃgatiḥ |

bhāṭṭa-- 'ekaikaraśme kāmāyānye yajñakratava āha- yante sarvebhyo jyotiṣṭomaḥ, ekaikasmai kāmāyānyai yajña- kratava āhiyante sarvebhyo darśapūrṇamāsau' iti śrutābhyāṃ vacanābhyāṃ saṃyogapṛthaktvavacanāyena sarvaphalārthatvam, na tu tattatprakaraṇasthaguṇakāmānāmāpi darśadiprayojyatvāt |
tadami- prāyeṇānuvādatvaṃ vaiyarthyāt, aupacārikatvāṅgīkāre tāda- rthyasya pramāṇābhāvāt |
na caivaṃ svargārthatvabodhakavidhivaiyarthyam, gobalīvardanyāyena mitraviśvajitkalpanā abhyudayaśiraskatvopapatte: |
na tu arthavādagatanyāyaśabdasya sahaśavācitvāt jyotiṣṭomadarśa- pūrṇamāsasadṛśasomayāgānantarajanyaphalamātrapara: tatratatra yathāyogaṃ sarvaśabda:; arthavādasya stutyarthatvenopapatte: |
ata eva sarvaśabdasya sarvanāmatvāt vaidikaphalamātraparatvamapi nāśakyam, vaidikānāmapi pūrvamanupasthitatvāt |
yāni tu śaśa- viṣāṇādīni pramāṇena kenāpi aprasiddhāni teṣāṃ na sarvaśabdena grahaṇam |

yattu atīndriyārthāparokṣajñātṛtva- lakṣaṇasārvajñadyerapi na sarvaśabdena grahaṇam, tasya loka- vedayo: kacidapi upāyantaranyatvadarśanādityuktaṃ tantra- sāratantratvādau, tat 'pravṛtyālokanyāsāt sūkṣmamyava- hitaviprakṛṣṭajñānam, bhuvanajñānaṃ sūrye saṃyamāt' ityādi- pātañjale 'cakṣussahasi saṃyojya tvaddāramapi cakṣuṣi |
māṃ tatra manasā dhyāyana viśvaṃ paśyati cakṣuṣā |
' ityādi- purāṇeṣu ca siddhimātre yogadhāraṇāviśeṣasya sādhanatvena uktatvādyapekṣitam, niratiśayasarvajñasya abhanyatve'pi bhuvanajñānāde: saṃbhavena grahaṇopapatte: |
na caivaṃ mantrādī- nāmapi sarvajñatvopapatte: smṛtīnāṃ vedamūlakatvāpatti:, aṣṭāsvargasādhanatvasya pramāṇāntareṇa asiddhau yogenāpi jñetumaśakyatvāt |
darśapūrṇamāsapadaṃ vidvadvākyadvayasiddhasamudāyadvayaparaṃ prasiddhārthakam, na ca tadākhyātparatantram |
(vidvadvākyaṃ ca 'ya evaṃ vidvān darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajate' ityādi |
) mīnyā. darśapūrṇamāsapadaṃ, yathā darśapūrṇamāsapadaṃ yāgaṣṭakatvāvacchedakaṃ tathā jyotiṣṭomadaṃ jyotirūpa- triṣṭadādiṣṭomatvacchayacchedakam (pūrvapakṣe sthitvā) |
saṃskārako hi mantra: ṣoḍasati saṃskārārthanarthaka: iti tatra nāyamiṣyate |
darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe ājyabhāgau prakṛtya 'na to paśo karoti na some' iti |
atra 'na some' iti vākyaṃ 'to na paśo karoti' ityasya arthavāda: |
bhā. 10|8| 2|5. darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe 'āryeyaṃ vṛṇīte' iti vacanaṃ yajamānapravaravināmakīrtanaparaṃ na tu ṛgvivayam |
saṃkarṣa. 3|4|1. darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe 'nivītaṃ manuṣyāṇām' iti śrutaṃ nīvītavākyaṃ upavītavidhai: arthavāda:, na vidhi: |
ke. 3|4|12-9. darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe piṇḍapitṛyajñe 'yat paśū paśi daṃta tadevanāma, yadantarā tanmanuṣyāṇām, yat samūlaṃ tat pitṛṇām' iti śrutam |
atra paśū iti daṃtam, yadantarā ityanuvāda: samūlastatstutye |
vi. 3|4|7. darśapūrṇamāsa- prakaraṇe pūṣādyanumantrāṇi asaṃdaṃśānyapi na purastāt prakaraṇaṃ vicchindanti |
vā. 3|1|121 pṛ. 733. darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe 'paurṇamāsyāṃ yajeta' ityādinā kālasaṃbandho vidhīyate na karmāntaram |
vi. 2|3|13. darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe 'śeṣaṃ sviṣṭakṛte samavayati' iti saṃskārasaṃbandhasya vidhi: na karmāntaram |
3|4|8. darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe śruta: 'mayi dakṣakratu' iti mantrapāṭha: kratuyuktajñamyamānapuruṣasaṃskāra:, na kevalapuruṣārtha: |
bhā. 3|4|6 14-16. darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe śruta: 'yo vidagdha: sa naiṛta:' ityādi: 'avidadhatā apayitavya: ' ityasya vidherarthavāda: |
3|4|16|17. darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe śrutasya pauṣṇeyasya pūrvakedatve niveśa:, na tu dvidevatve |
bhā. 3|1|129- 46, darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe śrutasya pauṣṇeyasya pauṣṇe carāveva niveśa: |
3|1|134-38. darśapūrṇamāsa- prakaraṇe śrutasya pauṣṇeyasya pauṣṇe yāge utkarṣa: |
3|1|134, darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe śrutasya malladagdhā: saṃvādaniṣedhasya kevalapuruṣārthatayā prakaraṇadātkarṣa: |
3|1|20-23. darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe 'saṃsthāpya paurṇamāsīṃ vaiṣamyanu- nirvapati' vaimuca: paurṇamāsaghnam, na tu darśapūrṇamāso- bhayāghnam |
bhā. 12|1|12|139. darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇapaṭhitānāmapi prayājānāṃ avāntarakaraṇaṃ atikramādhikaraṇe nyutpāda- yiṣyate |
vā. 2|4|13 pṛ. 627. darśapūrṇamāsaprayukto na bhavati pavamāneṣṭiṃsaṃskāra: kintu agniprayukta: |
bhā. 3|6|16|17. darśapūrṇamāsaprayoge yāvajjīvike prayājādīti- kartavyatā bhavati ityuktam ( 6|3|12 ) |
darśapūrṇamāsaprabhṛtyuttaraṃ nirvāpāt prāk candro- daye'pi asyuditethyanuṣṭhānam |

'tasmāt sadṛśīnāṃ rātrīṇāmamāvāsyāyāṃ ca paurṇamāsyāṃ ca devā ijyante' iti śrutau rātrīṇāmiti nirdharanapaṣṭhyā 'brāhmaṇānāṃ madhye yajñadatta: surūpa:' iti vākyena yajñadatte brāhmaṇasyeva paurṇamāsyāde: rātritvasya avagamāt |
iti prāpte divase eva yāga: kartavya: 'prātaryajñacamam' iti śrut 'parvaṇe yaścaturthāṃśa āghā: pratipadyahya: |
tatraprakrama rātrāvapi kadācit saṃbhavabhiprātyena rātrīṇāmiti śrutaṃ rūpapatte: |

rātriśabdasya 'dvādaśarātrīdīkṣito bhūti vannīta 'daśarātrāśaucam' ityādau ahorātraparatvadarśanācca yattu bhāṣye 'puṇyāhe devāni karmāṇi', 'te vā e pūte medhye ahanī yajanīye uttaramahadevatā yajate' ha śrutiṣu ahyāmeva kīrtanamiha hetukṛtam |
tattantraprakramādi prāyeṇa ahorātraparatvena ca anyathāsiddho rātriśabda iha vadataḥ sūtrakṛto vivaddham |
saṃkarṣa. 3|1|3. darśapūrṇamāsavikāro hi sārkapraśāyāya: bhā. 3|1|12|13. darśapūrṇamāsavikārāṇāṃ paśu amīṣomīya: paśu: prakṛti: prāṇidravyakasāmānāt |

ve darśapūrṇamāsavikāreṣu yajamānamantrāṇāmatideśa: saṃkarṣa. 2|4|4. darśapūrṇamāsavikṛtīnāṃ kāmyeṣṭivyatiriktā chājñānāṃ codakaprāptamantrādisarvatrayam, kāmyeṣṭīnāṃ kāmyaśabdavācye pradhāne 'yathāvarṇaṃ vai', ityādi viśeṣavacanena upāṃśutvavidhānāt aṣṭamātre svara yuktam |

darśapūrṇamāsavidhivyanta: amīṣomīyapaśau grā 'āgneyamahākalpam', 'amīṣomīyaṃ paśum' i vyaktaradravyadevatvam 'ekādaśa prayājān yajati' i prayājatvam, 'sucyamādhyārya' ityādyāvaravatvam, 'ju paśumantika' ityanyam, 'īśāmālabhate' ityālabhya: i
abhiṣecanīyadīkṣābhyaḥ pṛthak uttarasya daśapeyasya dīkṣāṇāṃ darśanāt tayorna tantram|

'tathā'bhiṣecanīyasya dīkṣā vardhayeyuryathā daśame'hani daśapeyaḥ saṃpadyate' 'sadyo dīkṣayati, sadyaḥ somaṃ krīṇāti' iti (atra satyāpāṭhasūtraṃ tu 'tathā dīkṣāḥ pravardhayanti abhiṣecanīyasya, yathā daśarātre śiṣṭe saṃvatsarasya daśapeyo bhaviṣyati' iti) tasmānna tantram|
yasmin saṃvatsare abhiṣecanīyaḥ tasmāduttare saṃvatsare tasminneva ṛtau daśapeyaḥ|
tathā ca kāla- sāmānyāt kraturrūpasya kālasya sāmānyāt samānatvāt abhiṣecanīyadaśapeyayoḥ; 'samāno vā eṣa yajñaḥ' ityane
tatra yadi tāvat śatasya aniyamaprasaṅge daśa iti vidhīyate, tataśca 'ekaikaṃ' ityanupapannam, ( ekaika- mityādi - ) vidhāne vākyabhedaprasaṅgeḥ |

vaṣaṭkartṛṇāṃ ca anekacamasaprāptau satyāṃ anuvādātsaṃbhavāt aṣṭeṣvāpi pūrveṇa ( 'śataṃ brāhmaṇāḥ somān bhakṣayanti' iti vākyena bhakṣaṇasya ) prāptatvāt camasaśabdaḥ anarthakaḥ, viśiṣṭaśca vākyaṃ bhindyāt |
na ca 'daśa daśa ekaikaṃ' ityanuvādaḥ saṃbhavati, śatasyāpi camasakārārthe upādīyamānasya prati- camasaṃ sāmastyena prāpteḥ |
kartṛsaṃskārārthe hi sati dakṣiṇā- vat vibhāgaprāptyā 'samaṃ syāt' iti 'daśa daśa ekaikaṃ' iti prāpnuyāt |
anekasminnapi vā daśa daśa bhakṣayitāraḥ prāpnuvanti |
ekasmin vā camase daśānaṃśānāṃ prāptaḥ, śatasyaiva daśadaśakairgeḥ sthitvā cama
kṛtā vedirbhavati' ityatra vediniṣpādanarūpasya dvārasya lopena niṣpādakānāmuddinānāṃ bādhaḥ |
kṛṣṇaleṣu vitubīkaraṇa- rūpasya dvārasya lopena avasthāsya bādhaḥ |
tadyathā prakṛtau gavāśvādi- dakṣiṇāyāḥ ṛtvikpari krayaḥ kāryam |
tathā vikṛtirūpe bhūtāgni ekāhe dhenurūpāyāḥ dakṣiṇāyāḥ tadeva kāryam |
tato venvā gavāśvādidakṣiṇā vikṛtau prāptā vādhyate |
caturthe nakṣatreṣṭivihitā upahomāḥ codakamāternātideśaḥmaiḥ saha samuccīyante ityādiḥ samuccayaḥ |
sa ca āmrayaṇapātrādeva mahītavyaḥ ityādiḥ bādhaprasaṅgato grahādivicāraḥ |
ṣaṣṭhe 'sāma te tubhyaṃ geyam' ityādirbādhaprasaṅgataḥ sāmavicāraḥ |
evaṃ ca sāmānyataḥ prāptamavagamya tadanantaraṃ padārthān svarūpeṇa ālocayati ' anena kathamupakṛtaṃ anena kathamupakṛtam' iti |
tatra avaghātasya dṛṣṭaprayojanadvāreṇa upakārakatvaṃ prakṛtau ālocya kṛṣṇaleṣu tathābhāvāsaṃbhavāt pūrvasaṃjātasya sāmānyajñānasya bādhaṃ manvate |

evaṃ pratyāmnāne'pi kāryadvāreṇa padārtheṣu prāpyamāṇeṣu bahiḥkāryaṃ havirāsādane pūrve prāpteḥ tatsādhanā- pekṣāyāṃ yāvat codakena kṛśā na prāpyante, tāvadeva pratyakṣeṇa vākyena taduddeśena śarāṇāṃ vidhānāt kuśādyavaḥ |
tathā pratiṣedhe sāmānyarūpasya codakasya viṣayaviśeṣāt ukālanaṃ ' nāpyaṃ vṛṇīte' iti |
tasmāt luptārtha- prayāmnāta-pratiṣiddhādvebhyaḥ samupakālānya anyeṣu codaka vyavasthāpyate iti siddho bādhaḥ |
tārtīyo hi aprāptatvāt; dāśamikastu prāptatvādha iti sthitiḥ |
tatra yadi codaka eva luptārthānāṃ nāśrayate, tato ityādīnāṃ prāpyabhāvāt prāptadhavācoyuktira

nahi sarvapadārthasādhāraṇopakāraprāptyaiva arthāt padārthaprāptirabhimatā, punarapi śāstreṇa padārthānāṃ vidhe- riṣṭatvāt, teṣāṃ ca sāmānyarūpātvāt pratyekametadiśata avaghātasyāpi śāstraṃ ananuṣṭhāne anarthakaṃ syāt|
atastasya anatideśo vā anuṣṭhānaṃ vā, nānya gatirasti|
kāmamanarthakaṃ bhavatu naitāvatā anavagato'rthaḥ śakyate kalpayitum|
nahi anupakāriṇaḥ tat bhavati, hantestu prakṛtivadacanāt anyayopakārakatvaṃ na saṃbhavati|
prakṛtitvat aṅgavamaghāttasya kṛṣṇaleṣu vidadhat vacanaṃ apramāṇaṃ syāditi|
kiñca prāpyabādhe kuśānāmaṭhasādhanāṃ kimiti anu (ananu) jñānām? iti cet na, tenāpi aṅgavānavalopāt|
yat anuṣṭhānaṃ bādhyate, na tat prāptam, iti na prāptatvāt asambhavaḥ|
yat kasmin- prāpī codako na kiñcit varjayitumahaṃtīti|
sa tu svabhāvaḥ prabalana hetunā pratibadhyate (3|6|12) 'na codakārthakāsyānt' (3|6|18)|
tasmādatra anyathā mudraṇaṃ lekhakapramādaḥ syāt ) ityapi svabhāva eva katipayaviṣayatvamāśaṅkaya nirākṛtaṃ iti veditavyam|
yadyapi cātra na kāraṇadoṣe mithyātvaṃ sāmānyaśāstrajñasya upalabdhuṃ śakyate, tathāpi bādhakena pratyayāntareṇa tadupalakṣaṇaṃ bhavati|
dravya- mapi hi tadupalakṣaṇatvenoktam 'yasya ca duṣṭaṃ karaṇam, yatra ca mithyeti pratyayaḥ, saḥ asīnmīnaḥ pratyayaḥ' : iti (bhāṣyaṃ 1|1|5 vṛttigrantho pṛ. 28)|
tatra vaidikeṣu sambhavāt bādhakapratyaya eva tadupalakṣaṇam, na kāraṇadoṣa- jñānamasaṃbhavāt|
āha ca 'yat kāraṇa- (karaṇa-) doṣajñānaṃ dvitīyamupalakṣaṇamuktam, tat lokaviṣayatvāt na vede saṃbhavati iti nopanyastam' iti|
kathaṃ punaḥ aduṣṭena mithyājñānaṃ janyate ? nahi bādhakena mithyājñānaṃ jāyate, jātasya tu mithyāstaḥ tattvamasī jñāpayati|
yadyapi asau apauru- ṣeyasya vedasya na svagataḥ kaścit doṣo vidyate, tathāpi pratipattureva sāmānyapahatabuddhitvāt apavādānirūpaṇācca nyāyābhāsebhyaḥ prasarat mithyājñānaṃ jāyate|
ata eva samyak nyāyanirūpaṇārthe mīmāṃsāśāstramarthavat bhavati|
na cāyaṃ doṣo bādhakāt prāk amutyavaṣṭambhādiva nirūpa- yituṃ śakyate iti bādhakakaupalakṣaṇīyatvaṃ mithyātvasya abhihitam|
tat siddhaṃ yat 'evamidaṃ' iti niścitaṃ jñānaṃ kāraṇā- ntareṇa mithyeti kathyate|
tu vākyaśeṣaḥ syāt' (10|8|14) iti ca sūtravināśāt arthāprayyāmnāpratiṣiddhebhyaḥ aṅgebhyaḥ codakasya samukālatvam|
tatra etat syāt, yadyapi kṛṣṇaleṣu hantiḥ dṛṣṭārtha na prāpyate, tathāpi niyamādṛsiddhayarthaṃ kiṃ na prāpyate iti|
evaṃ hi kalpyate 'ava- ghātanaiva niṣpādyamānāstaṇḍulāḥ apūrve sādhyanti' iti|
haḍprayojanenaiva tāvat svarūpe prāpte niyamamātraṃ tena prayujyate|
tena yadyapi caruṣu peṣaṇamapratiṣiddham, piṣṭasyāpi carutvāvidhātāt, tathāpi prayojanābhāvāt peṣaṇasvarūpasya aprāpteḥ tadadhīnatvānna niyamaprayukteḥ anuṣṭhānam|
satyapi ca prayojane prayojakā- bhāvāt puroḍāśapālādeḥ cavādiṣu bādha iti|
etena citraṣṭyāṃ taṇḍuleṣu prākṛtasya vrīhiyavaprakṛtidravyaniyamasya bādho vyākhyāyataḥ|
laikkikā eva tu māhāstaṇḍulāḥ prakṛtine tu |
nahi prakṛtau 'maidheyena haviṣā yajeta' iti śāstramasti, yadatideśāt taṇḍulānāpi tanmayatvaṃ syāt|
yagaṃ prati 'vrīhibhiryajeta' iti vrīhīṇāṃ karaṇatvaṃ śrūyate|
karaṇatvaṃ ca teṣāṃ utpattiviśiṣṭapuroḍāśavade yāge tatprakṛtitvena saṃbhavati, iti eṣa śāstrārthaḥ: 'vrīhīmupādāya tairhaviḥ saṃpādya yajeta' iti|
atra ca 'haviḥ saṃpādya yajeta' ityanūya 'vrīhibhiḥ' ityetāvanmātraṃ vidhīyate|
evaṃ ca sati ārthikaṃ havissaṃmatyanvayam, na śrautam|
nahi tat prakṛtyupādānena haviḥ saṃpādanīyaṃ (haviḥ saṃpādanaṃ) prāptam, yat 'vrīhibhiḥ' iti niyamyate, lokasiddhānaiva taṇḍulamupādāya yartu śakyatvāt|
nanu prakṛtāvapi laukikameva puroḍāśamādāya yāgasya kartuṃ śakyatvāt kathaṃ prakṛtyupādānena haviḥ-
iti cet, taducyate 'haviḥśrapaṇa- sādhyaṃ hi puroḍāśatvamiṣyate|
puroḍāśarūpaṃ hi haviḥ nāntareṇa śrapaṇaṃ sidhyati|

tat hi laukikameva upādeyaṃ svameva vā prakṛtyupādānena saṃpādayitavyamiti, yadyapi utpattivākyāt aniyamaḥ prāptaḥ 'aṣṭakapālina yajeta' ityasya ubhayathā'pi upapatteḥ, tathāpi 'kapāleṣu śrapayati' iti vacanāt nānyena arpitaṃ gṛhṇāti iti svayaṃ kartṛkatvameva tu asya vidheyam, sarvamevat utpatti- vākyasāmarthyasiddham|
kapālāni utpattivākyasiddhāni, śrapaṇamapi sāmarthyāt nāśrapitasya puroḍāśatvamasti iti śrapitadravyaviśeṣavacanatvāt puroḍāśatvādiśabdānām|
yathā āha bhagavān bhāṣyakāraḥ: 'kapāleṣu śrapayati iti vacanāt nānyena śrapitaṃ gṛhṇāti' (1|4|6|9 pṛ. 341) iti taddhalena prakṛtyupādānaṃ prāpnoti iti|
evaṃ prakṛtadravyopādāne prāpte kimavasthaṃ kiṃ rūpaṃ ca dravyamupādeyaṃ ityākāṅkṣāyām, vrīhiśabdena satuṣajāti- viśeṣavācinā tanniyamāt piṣṭataṇḍulāvasthayoḥ nīvārādīnāṃ ca vyāvṛttiḥ|
yadi tu anenaiva śāstreṇa 'prakṛtyupādāya haviḥ saṃpādyeta, bañca vrīhibhiḥ' iti vidhīyate, tato gauravam|
'kapāleṣu śrapayati' iti ca vidheḥ ānarthakyaṃ satyāṃ gatau syāt, tacca anyāyyam|
tena yatra śrapaṇam, tatra tasya svayaṃkartṛkatvam|
yatra ca tat, tatra prakṛtyu- pādānaprāptiḥ|
nivṛtte ca tasmin tatra svayaṃkartṛkatvasya kutaḥ prāptiḥ, kutastarāṃ ca prakṛtyupādānam, kutastarāṃ ca vrīhiniyamaḥ|

nahi 'vrīhinihanti' ityetat avaghātasya svayaṃkartṛkatvasiddhayarthaṃ aprāptatvāt vrīhyudeśena avaghāto vidhīyate iti na tasya prakṛtitvaṃ prāpnoti, that tadanuvādena svayaṃkartṛkatā vidhīyyeta svayameva avaghanāt nānyena avaghātaṃ gṛhṇīyāt iti nalanirvvanādibhyo'pi vitupīkaraṇasaṃbhavāt|
tasyāpi niyamena aprāpteḥ avaghātenāpi hi viklinnāstaṇḍulāścūrṇībhavanti|

prathamaṃ tāvat puroḍāśo viniyujyate tatastasya yathākathañcit upādāne prāpte śrapaṇavidhivaśāt prakṛtyupādānena svayaṃ saṃpādanam, tataḥ prakṛtiviśeṣepekṣāya 'vrīhibhiryajeta' ityanena anantarataprakṛtipiṇḍyudāsena piṣṭavyahitataṇḍuhyudāsena vyavahitataranīvārādidāsena- ca vrīhayo vidhīyante, tataḥ kathaṃ havikapāttham ityapekṣāyāṃ avaghātapeṣaṇādividhānam|
taṇḍuleṣu ha arthalopāt śrapaṇanivṛttau tanmūlaprakṛtyupādānaśrīhiniyamā- vaghātādīnāṃ krameṇa nivṛttiḥ; iti lokasiddhā|
yatra tu apuro ḍāśe'pi śrapaṇena arthaḥ: caru-dhānā-manya-lāja-pṛthuka- yavāgādiṣu, tatra bhavatyeva vrīhiniyamaḥ|
iti sūkṣmamidaṃ vyāvaraṇaṃ bhāṣyavārtikapari- cyopacitacetolalocanasaṃskāraiḥ: vivektuṃ śakyate, na sthūla dṛṣṭibhiriti|
tadevaṃ prākṛtānāmarthalopādinā bāghāt vaikṛtakāryā pattistyānāṃ āmanahomādīnāṃ abhyuccayābhidhānāca prayogayathā daśame cintiteti|
daśamādhyāpūrvapakṣanyāyena sāmasvarūpaṃ uttarayo prāpitaṃ avikṛtasvarūpameva ṣaṭ prākṛtaṃ aprākṛtaṃ dṛṣṭamadṛṣṭa vā kāryaṃ kuryāt |
sauryādau kathambhāvā- kāṅkṣatvāt upakārātideśaḥ': iti daśamādhyāsiddhānta atrāprasarāta |
dākṣāyaṇayajñe 'nānṛtaṃ vadeta, na māṃsamaśrīyāt' guṇaḥ prasiddhaḥ |
dākṣāyaṇayajñe paṭhitāni antarālavratāni aguṇā ca karmacodanā |
bhāṣyam— na cātra guṇa upadadhyate kaścid yadvi- |
bhāṣyam-- liṅgamapi etanmate darśayati 'triṃśataṃ varṣāṇi darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta |
dve hi paurṇamāsyau yajeta dve amāvāsye |
atra hyeva khalu sā saṃpadyati' iti |
yadi dākṣāyaṇasyo darśapūrṇamāsāveva, evaṃ tarhi triṃśatpadā prayojanam |
vā-- triṃśatpatvapūrṇa paurṇamāsāvāsāsyāsaṃkīrtanaṃ vā bhedaṃ bodhayati |
nahi darśapūrṇamāsikaḥ triṃśadvarṣapakṣaḥ karmāntareṇa purayituṃ śakyate |
na ca dākṣāyaṇayājñatvena nimittena darśapūrṇamāsayoreva pañcadaśavarṣapakṣa upajāyate, saṃbandhabhāvāt |
dve hi paurṇamāsyau dve amāvāsye iti cāsya anupapattiḥ |
yadi dākṣāyaṇaśabdo na kenacidapi prakāreṇa darśapūrṇamāsa-vacanaḥ śakyate kalpayitum, tata ucyeta karmāntaramiti |
śakyate cet darśapūrṇamāsayogurṇasaṃbandho vaditum, kimiti sa eva yāgaḥ pratīyamānaḥ anya ityucyate, kimiti vā prakaraṇaṃ bādhyate |
vā-- utpattisaṃyoge pūrvasaṃbandhe ca saṃjñā bhedī bhavati |
na ca ityamutpattisaṃyuktā 'athaiṣa jyotiḥ' ityādireva prakramābhāvāt |
saṃbhavati ca pūrvakamaśritaguṇa-vattvenaiva iti na bhinnati |
tena ca prakaraṇāt darśapūrṇamāsāśritanaiva phalaṃ sādhyate |
dakṣa iti utsāhī śīghrakārī yajamānaḥ, tadīyā ṛtvijo dākṣāḥ |
sāṃkaprasthāyīye'pi sānāyyamanudāya kumbhīmyāmeva sākaṃ prasthīyate ityevamabhidhīyate |
bhāṣyam-- yaduktaṃ phale vākyaṃ samāptam, prajā-kāmāderyāgānuṣṭhānaṃ vidhīyate iti |
yāni anyāni muktasaṃśayāni guṇe phalasya vidhāyakāni vākyāni guṇasya phalavacanāni paryavasitāni, yathā 'dadhnendriyakāmasya juhuyāt' ityevamādīni tairetadaviśiṣṭam |
tasmāt prakṛtadarśapūrṇa-māsayoḥ guṇāt phalamucyate, na yāgāntaraṃ vidhīyate iti |
vā-- yadyapi karmoddeśena na phalaṃ vidhīyate, tathāpi karmaphalasaṃbandhatvāt karmāntaratā |
yathaiva hi karmaṇaḥ phalamiti bhāvārthādhikaraṇe sādhitam, tathaiva 'atulyatvāttu' vākyayoḥ |
ityatra guṇaphalasaṃbandhaparyavasāyitvamapi ukta-miti saṃdehe sati padāntarānugrahārthaṃ guṇādeva phalam, na karmaṇaḥ iti siddham |
soma-- vasantādivākyeṣu ādhānamiva atrāpi karmāntaraṃ vidheyaṃ iti pratyavasānāt saṃgatiḥ |
prayojanaṃ pūrvapakṣe darśapūrṇamāsaprayogatvāt bahuḥ : sauryādivat dākṣā-yaṇayajñādeḥ prayogaḥ, tathā dākṣāyaṇasya pañcadaśavarṣa-prayogeṇa darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ : triṃśadvarṣaprayogabādhaḥ |
sūtrārthastu- agnayeṣu dākṣāyaṇādivākyeṣu saṃyogabandhāt karmāntaraṃ syāt iti |
bhāṭṭa-- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'dākṣāyaṇayajñena svargakāmo yajeta' iti śrutam |

tatra dākṣāyaṇādipadavācyasya guṇasya loke aprasiddhatvāt udvidādivat nāmadheyatvāvagataḥ saṃjñayā abhyāsādvā karmāntaraṃ vidhīyate phalasaṃbandhāt sārvakāmyavākyavaśādeva prāptatvena anyaparatvābhāvāt |

yadyapi loke guṇo na prasiddhaḥ, tathāpi dakṣasya yajamānasya ime dākṣāḥ ṛtvijaḥ, tatka-rtṛkaṃ ayanaṃ prayogo'gniṣṭomasya yakṣyate vyutpattyā āvṛtti-paratvāvagateḥ, saha prasthānaṃ yatraiti nyutpattyā ca sahatvapara-tvāvagatenātiriktāśaktikalpanā nāmadheyatvāvasānam |
ataḥ aprāptāvṛttirūpaḥ sahasrarūpaśca guṇa eva phaloddeśena vidhīyate |
āvṛttiśca kiyatītyapekṣāyāṃ 'dve paurṇamāsyau dve amāvāsye yajeta' iti vākyena viśeṣavidhānāt dvirāvṛttireva |
sahatvaṃ ca pradhāne kenetyapekṣāyāṃ 'saha kummībhirimāmeta' iti vacanāt kummībhyām |
anenaiva ca vacanena sahatvāvayamabhiprakramasya vidadhatā avāntaraprakaraṇābhāve'pi tasyāśrayasiddhiḥ |
ato'tra saṃjñātvā-bhāvāt guṇaphalasaṃbandharūpatvena ca abhyāsābhāvāt karmāntaram |

vastutastu 'pūrvapadāt saṃjñāyām' (pā0 8|1|13 pūrvapadāccinnimittāt parasya nasya ṇaḥ syāt saṃjñāyām, na tu gakāravyavadhāne duṇasaḥ, ṛgayanam) iti smṛtyā saṃjñābhāvāpatteḥ dākṣāyaṇaśabde saṃjñā-tvāvaśyaṃbhāve'pi avayavārthavatyā yogarūḍhisvīkārāda-vayavārthakalpanāpattiḥ |
aprāptatvāt phaloddeśena vidhīyate iti na virodhaḥ |
nahi darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ saṃnidhau dākṣāyaṇādividhiḥ, yena tatra guṇavidhānaṃ syāt |
kaupītakibrāhmaṇe hi tṛtīye'dhyāye darśapūrṇamāsau anukramya caturthe'dhyāye paurṇamāse saṃsthite
anunirvāpyaṃ vaimṛdham, darśa saṃsthite aditiyāgaṃ ca vidhāya abhyuditeṣṭiṃ abhyudayeṣṭiṃ ca vidhāya 'athāto dākṣāyaṇa-yajñaśca |
dākṣāyaṇayajñena eṣan phālgunyāṃ paurṇamāsāṃ prayuṅkte' ityādinā dākṣāyaṇayajñasaṃjñakaprasthāyādīni bahūni karmāṇi anukāntāni |
tatra athaśabdena prakaraṇa-vicchedāt 'athaiṣa jyotiḥ' ityādipat utpattiśiṣṭa-saṃjñā'ntarakatvāt prakṛtakarmaṇi saṃjñā'ntarasya samāveśā-saṃbhavācca karmāntarameva yuktam |
nāpi dākṣāyaṇa-śabdaḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ āvṛttiguṇo vartitumarhati, nahi dakṣasya ime dākṣāḥ ṛtvijaḥ, tatkartṛkamayanaṃ āvṛttiḥ |
'dakṣo vai pārvatīḥ etena yajñeṣṭvā sarvān kāmānavāpa' (kauṣī. 4|4), 'sa vai dakṣo nāma tat, yadenana so'jayata, tasmāt dākṣāyaṇayajña ityākhyā' iti kaupītakivākyasyaiva anyo'nya nirvacanāvagateḥ |
evaṃ śatapathābrāhmaṇe'pi iyavākāṇḍe darśapūrṇamāsau anukramya saṃbharakāṇḍe ādhānaṃ punarādhānaṃ agnihotraṃ cānukramya dākṣāyaṇayajñaḥ anukrāntaḥ |
yadyapi taitti-rīyadīkṣāyāṃ darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe dākṣāyaṇādiyajñaṃ śrutam, tathāpi dākṣāyaṇādiśabdasya guṇaparatvaṃ uttarīyatā anupapannam, iti karmāntarameva yuktam |
saṃkramayajñaviṣayakaṃ vākyaṃ yatrakacicchālāyāmanve-ṣaṇīyam, tathaiva ca saṃkramaśabdasya guṇaviśeṣaparatve vākyaśeṣaśca anveṣaṇīyaḥ |
kau. 2|3|12 pṛ. 44, indrikāmādhikaraṇasiddhasya guṇaphalasaṃbandhasya ākṣepasamādhānāt na tenāsya (dākṣāyaṇayajñādhikaraṇasya 2|3|4) paunaruktyam |
ca anyapakṣe tṛtīyāntena ( tasya vāyavyāsu ekaviṃśa- miṣṭemaṣṭāma kṛtvā brahmavarcasakāmo hatena yajeta iti) eta- cchabdena vilikhyate'nyathā revatīmātranirdeśānupapattiḥ |
tena revatīviśiṣṭavāravantīyanirdeśe'pi dākṣāyaṇayajña- nyāyena aprāpterevatīmātrasya phalasambandhopapatteḥ |
vāyavyaṃ śvetamālabheta', 'īṣāmālabheta' ityādī dākṣāyaṇayajña- nyāyena guṇamātravidhānaṃ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
jyoti- ṣṭome anujājotkarṣe'pi dākṣāyaṇikayoḥ piṣṭalepalī- karaṇahomayornirūpakatvam |
' viṣṭalepa: asti asmin karmaṇi tat piṣṭalepi |
