dveṣye ca dharmamātraṃ dānamiti caśabdena annādiyate |
na hi dveṣyaḥ ṛtvik bhavati, 'ṛtvigācāryo nāticaritavyo' iti |
pratīcīṃ manuṣyāḥ ityatra vidhirvā arthavādo vā iti vicāre siddhāntamāha|
'prācīnavaṃśaṃ karoti' ityanena vidhinā ekavākyatvāt sarve digvibhāgākyaṃ arthavādaḥ; na vidhiḥ |
tadvat pūrvoktanīvītavat yathā upavītavidhe- rarthavādaḥ tathā idamapi |
kutaḥ ? saṃvancasya manuṣyapratīcī- saṃbandhasya arthahetutvāt arthavādārthabhūtastu ālambana- tayā hetutvopapatteḥ |
athavā pūrvāhe nyāyapramāṇānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ ādityaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛte pratīcīsaṃbandhasya arthataḥ hetutvāt iti |
bhāṣyam-- jyotiṣṭomaṃ prakṛtya śrūyate 'prācīṃ devā abhajante dakṣiṇāṃ pitaraḥ pratīcīṃ manuṣyā udīcīmasurāḥ' iti |
vidhiḥ san kiṃ manuṣyadharmaḥ, uta karmadharmaḥ |
athavā prakaraṇe manuṣyapradhānaṃ karmaṇi niveśaḥ, kiṃvā ātithye iti |
ya eṣa digvibhāgaḥ, sa nīvītavat vicāryaḥ |
yo nīvīte pūrvapakṣaḥ sa iha pūrvapakṣaḥ; yo madhyamaḥ sa madhyamaḥ, yaḥ siddhāntaḥ sa siddhāntaḥ |
arthavatvāt vidhiḥ, manuṣyasaṃbandhanamanuṣyadharmaḥ iti pūrva- pakṣaḥ |
pratyaṅmukhā udaṅmukhā vā pṛṣṭhataḥ ādityaṃ prāśya padārthānuṣṭhitir manuṣyā ityanuvādaḥ |
vākyaprakaraṇagrahāya jyotiṣṭome manuṣyapradhānaṃ dakṣiṇāvyāpāre niveśa ityaparaḥ pakṣaḥ |
miśratvāt vākyānāṃ ātithye niveśaḥ ityaparaṃ matam |
'prācīnavaṃśaṃ karoti' ityanena vidhinā ekavākyatvasya pratyakṣa- siddhatvāditi siddhāntaḥ |
śā-- 'pratīcīṃ manuṣyāḥ' ityatra nīvītādhikaraṇavat sarve pakṣā racayitavyāḥ |
'vyabhajante' iti purākalpena pūrvapuruṣācaritatvena praśaṃsā gamyate, tayā ca vidhivat gamyate iti viśeṣāśaṅkā |
soma-- sūtrārthatu-- digvibhāgaḥ pratīcyāḥ diśaḥ manuṣyakartṛko vibhāgo'pi nīvītavat arthavādārthaḥ |
prāyeṇa pūrvāhe nyāyapramāṇānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ ādityaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kartuṃ pratīcīsaṃbandhasya arthataḥ prāptatvena tatra vidhiyogān iti |
atra 'saṃbandhasya arthahetutvāt' iti sūtrāvayavaḥ nīvītā- dhikaraṇasyaivārthavattvabodhakatvārthasārakatvena anatiprayojana- tvāt ācāryaiḥ noktaḥ |
bhāṭṭa-- some 'prācīnavaṃśaṃ karoti' ityetadvidhi- śeṣaḥ 'devamanuṣyā diśo vyabhajante prācīṃ devā dakṣiṇāṃ pitaraḥ pratīcīṃ manuṣyā udīcīṃ rudrāḥ' ityayaṃ śrutaḥ |

tatra manuṣyasaṃyukte nīvītādhikaraṇavat audumbarādhikaraṇa- vacca vidhiśca nirastamapi pūrvādhikaraṇavat manuṣyakartavya- vaidikakarmaṇi tāvat digantarasyaiva sāmānyaviśeṣādivacanena prāptatayā aprāpteḥ |

iti prāpte, iha pratīcyā manuṣyasaṃbandhamātropādāne'pi karma- viśeṣopādānāt sarvatra vidhānasya tathaiva nirastatvāt, yajñameva kriyānvī pratīcīdigbhimukhatvaṃ loke yacchyā siddham, tādṛśakriyāgatameva manuṣyapratīcīsaṃbandhaṃ gṛhītvā stutyupapattenātiriktavidhyantarakalpanā pramāṇavat |
'upari hi' ityatra tu devāgnihotrāvacchedena upari- māśvavaṇāt, tasya ca aprāptatvena vidhyantarakalpanā devāgnihotrāṅgasamiddhārānuvādena uparibhāvavidhiḥ |

) kutaḥ ? paramā- pūrvaprayuktatvāt dīkṣaṇīyāyāḥ, svayaṃ niṣphalatvāt |
tena tvarthena yajñasya saṃyogāt dharmasambandha- stasmād yajñaprayuktaṃ syāt saṃskārasya tadarthatvāt |
saṃbandhe lakṣaṇā aṅgasaṃbandhe tu śrutiḥ (aṅgisaṃbandhe vivakṣite lakṣitena aṅginā tadapūrvaṃ lakṣayitavyam, aṅgā- pūrvasaṃbandhe tu śrutyaiva dīkṣaṇīyā svāpūrvalakṣaṇā |
tadanena prakāreṇa pūrvapakṣe lakṣitalakṣaṇā, siddhānte tu lakṣaṇā ityetadeva pratipāditam |
pūrvapakṣe 'vaidhātavyā dīkṣaṇīyā bhavati' iti āgnā- vaiṣṇavakāryāpatyā (vaidhātavyā) taddharmairyujyate yathā nīvārāḥ prokṣaṇena (yujyante) |
siddhānte tu āgnāvaiṣṇavāpūrvaprayuktā dharmāḥ vaidhātavyāyāṃ ca apūrvāntaram |
tatra yadi mukhyatve'pi aṅgi pade gṛhyetāyāṃ (tataḥ) sāmānā- dhikaraṇyaṃ nopapadyate |
tasmāt ekamatra gauṇaṃ padam, anyat mukhyam |
tatra prāthamyāt avirodhācca vaidhātavyāpadaṃ mukhyam, dīkṣaṇīyāpadaṃ tu (jaghanyatvāt saṃjātavirodhaṃ ca) āgnīyaṃ ṛtūpakāraṃ lakṣayati |
tasmin lakṣite vaidhātavyā vidhīyate (vaidhātavyā dīkṣaṇīyākāryakāriṇī bhavatīti) |
siddhānte'pi yathā khalevālī yūpakārye vidhīyamānā taddharmāṃn (aṅganādīn) labhate |
athocyeta 'vaidhātavyā dīkṣaṇīyā bhavati' ityanena vaidhātavyāyāḥ yat kāryam, tat nivārya dīkṣaṇīyākārye (tasyāṃ) vidhīyate |
tacca (dīkṣaṇīyā- kāryam) ātmīyaireva (yathāsiddheḥ) dharmaiḥ ātmīyena cāpūrveṇa vaidhātavyā sādhyayiṣyati, na dīkṣaṇīyādharmān grahīṣyati siddhāntavādinaḥ |
(etat dūṣyati-) pūrva- pakṣe'pi yadi dīkṣaṇīyākāryaṃ (yathāsiddhe) vaidhātavyā vartata, tathā sati ātmīyaireva dharmaiḥ : tatkāryaṃ sādhyayiṣyati prasiddhadharmakatvāt |
aya na vartate (dīkṣaṇīyākāryaṃ vaidhātavyā, tadā) sutarāṃ ātmīyā eva dharmāstasyāḥ |
api ca paramāpūrvamuktayāmāpi vāṅniyamasya prakṛtau āgnāvaiṣṇavo viśiṣṭaṃ dvāramabhūta (āgnāvaiṣṇavāpūrva- mityarthaḥ :) |
nanu anena nyāyena nīvāreṣu prokṣaṇaṃ na prāpnoti (āgnāvaiṣṇavapadaṃ yathāśrutaṃ manvānasya codyam) |
iyāṃsu (nīvāraiścaitayoḥ) viśeṣaḥ, brīhayo dṛṣṭena (taṇḍula- nirvapya apūrveṇa) upakurvanti, nīvārāśca tatkāryaṃ pratyakṣataḥ sādhyanto dṛśyante |
iha tu (dīkṣaṇīyāyām) adṛṣṭaṃ dvāram (apūrvam) tasmin kārye naidhātavyā vartate iti nāsti pramāṇam |
(katham ?) vaidhātavyā yādī etadī evotpannā, tādṛśī eva (aśvamedhe dīkṣaṇīyātvena) codyate, vaidhātavyāśabdena saiva viparī- vartate |
tasmāt yādṛśī tatra vijñātā, tādṛśī (eva) aṅga (kartavyā) |
yadyapi ca karmāntaraṃ syāt tathāpi nāmna dharmān gṛhṇīyāt, na codakeneti |
śā-- phalavat paramāpūrvaṃ tacchepatvaṃ tato bhavet svāpūrvaṃ kratuśeṣatvāt svayaṃ phalavat yataḥ |
' soma-- pūrvatra hantipayarthye anarthakyā prokṣaṇasya apūrvārthatvavat ihāpi niṣphaladīkṣaṇīyā''pūrva ryethe anarthakyāt phalavajjyotiṣṭomāpūrvārthatvaṃ ityucyate saṃgatiḥ |
sūtre saṃskāraśabdena dīkṣālo yajamānasaṃskāra vivakṣitaḥ, tacchabdena ca paramāpūrva vivakṣitam |
vi-- 'mantrādikamapūrvaṃ parāyāvāntarāya vā phalādādho, no samātvākṣaṇā tu viśiṣṭaye |
tatra pradhānajanya pūrvameva lakṣyate uttāṅganyamapīti cintāyām, yatra tāva athaghātapeṣaṇādau na brīhādijanya madhye apūrvāntaram, pradhānajanyayoḥ pūrvaparyavasānatvalakṣaṇatvā avivādaiva |

āha, yadā savitrādayo yajamānaparāḥ, tadā sane kathamanūha iti |
anujñāpanaṃ pūrve guṇena kṛtam, tat adṛṣṭārthamāpadyeta |
apina 'juhaṃ nirvapāmi' iti joṣaṇakaraṃ 'nirvapāmi' iti bhāvaśabdenocyate |
'savituḥ prasave' iti anujñā nirvṛttā paraviśeṣaṇārthe kriyate |
anujñatāmapi nirvāpaśabdārthe kuryādeva, na tu ajoṣitena yāgaḥ śrūyate |
tasmāt joṣaṇārthatvāt parārthāḥ savitrādayaḥ śabdāḥ nohiṣyante iti |
abhinā vā vikalpena savitā māntra- varṇikaḥ |
bhāṣyam - atha yaduktaṃ pratyāyena śabdena prakā- śyante'tra devatāḥ, atrāpi aśrutānāṃ prakāśane na kiñci- dasti prayojanamiti, tat parihartavyam |
soma- upodghātaprasaṅgānuprasaktaṃ samāptu idānīṃ adhyāyārthaḥ ūhaścintyate iti saṃgatiḥ |

sūtrārthastu - mantrāṇāṃ arthābhidhānadvārā karmaṇi śeṣabhāvāt savitrā- dīnāmapi svārthābhidhānena śeṣabhāve samavetārthatvāt ūhaḥ iti 'arthābhidhānasaṃyogāmantreṣu śeṣabhāvaḥ syāt' ityanena pūrvapakṣaḥ pratipādyate |
tatrottaram, acoditaṃ acoditārthakaṃ savitrādi ūhapraptaṃ mantrasya coditābhidhāyakatvāt iti |
' savitu- aśni-ādi ūhanīyaṃ na vā iti saṃśayaḥ |
tatra 'phaladevatvayoḥ' (9|1|3|4) ityatra vākyā apūrvasādhanībhūtadevatādhi- prakāśakamantrapradānāṃ vikṛtī tatsthānāpadevatāntare śaktyā tatprakāśanārthe padāntarohaḥ |

tataśca yat mantrapadānāṃ na śaktyā apūrvasādhanībhūtadevatādhiprakāśa- katvam, api tu lakṣaṇyā tatprakāśakatvam, śakyārthasyaiva vā adṛṣṭārthamanyastathaiva yopādānam, tatrāsamavetārthatvāt ca adṛṣṭādakasaṃyogena svaśakyārthasya apūrvasādhanībhūta- saṃbandhitvam |
asti cedam 'devasya tvā' ityādimantre abhi- nirvāpapadayogyatāsyāhyagāmantrasya saṃbandhitvāt |
japastatra- śakdādimantrapradānāṃ na svaśakyārthe adṛṣṭadvārā tādṛśayāga- saṃbandhitve'pi na samavetārthatvam |
nahi devasaviśriprapaśabdānāṃ prakṛta- yāgīdevatāpratipādakatvaṃ saṃbhavati, uttapattiśiṣṭadevatā'va- rodhena māntravarṇikadevatākalpanā'nupapatteḥ |

na ca 'tvā juhaṃ nirvapāmi' ityetadanuṣaṅgeṇa 'devasya savituḥ prasave' tvā juhaṃ nirvapāmi, aśvinorbāhubhyāṃ 'tvā juhaṃ nirvapāmi, pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ tvā juhaṃ nirvapāmi, agnaye tvā juhaṃ nirvapāmi' ityeva mantramedāṅgīkāreṇa nirvāpamidameka- vākyatopapatteḥ |
caturthasyāmeye upayoge'pi āghānāṃ śrayāṇāṃ mantrāṇāmupāṃśuyāje devatāphalatvopa- patiriti vācyam |
ata eva ekatva- devatānāmantra niveśasaṃbhave'pi yāgāntarakalpakatvamiti |
śaṅkā'pi prayuktā, tathātve tadyāgāntarasya āgneyādyaṅga- tā''pattervikṛti tattvāt ūhaprasakteśca |

etena yā mūle savitrādipadānāmāgameyādiparatvaṃ lakṣaṇyā aṅgīkṛtya sama- vetārthatvañca kṛtvā, sā yena śakyasaṃbandhena agnyādi- paratvam, tenaiva śakyasaṃbandhena vaikṛtadevatāparatvasyāpi upapattau ūhaprasakterapekṣā |
ata eva samavetārthatva- lakṣaṇe śakyārthasyaiva viśeṣaṇam |
astu vā śakyapada- vṛttipratipādyaparam, tathāpi samavetārthatve'pi uktayuktyā ūhaprakalpanāprasakteraiva |
tasmāt kathammi samavetārthaprakāśakatvābhāvāt devasvatvādipadānāṃ yaḥ śakyo'rthaḥ, tadviśiṣṭanirvāpaprakāśanameva devasvatvā''di- sakalamantraprayojanam |
tatra yeṣāṃ padārthānāṃ dṛṣṭaprayojana- saṃbhavaḥ, tatprakāśanāsya adṛṣṭameva prayojanaṃ kalpyam |
yeṣāṃ tu tadasaṃbhavaḥ, tatprakāśanāsya adṛṣṭameva prayojanaṃ kalpyam |
ata eva tādṛśapadārthānāṃ nirvāpopari vaiśiṣṭyamapi āhāryatvañcaneveti dhyeyam |
tadiha nirvāpasya tāvat dṛṣṭameva pṛthakkaraṇaṃ prayojanam |
agnaye tvā padārthasya ca tadupayogeti svātantryeṇa caṃ smṛtidādarthyam |
juhapadasya tu vakṣyate, tadanveṣāṃ tu adṛṣṭārthatvamiti |
tathā vā astu, sarvathā devasvatvā''dipadāni asamavetārthāni nihitāni |

yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa gauṇyā arthaśabdaḥ āghāne aśradānakaraṇāt dampatīparaḥ, pūṣṇaśca poṣatvāt yajamānaparaḥ, adhvaryuvāhūṣṭatvasya tadatīyaṃ parikalpitatvāt, devaḥ savitā'pi lakṣaṇyā yajamānaḥ, tasya prasave anu-
śāyamityarthāṅgīkāreṇa nirvapaviśeṣaṇatvamupapāditam, tat vede āropakapuruṣābhāvāt anyārthavādo āhāyī- ropasyeha āropāpābhāvamabhipreta |

yadā tu adhvaryoḥ svātmanidhena āhāyīropasya vaiśiṣṭyaṃ saṃpādya svakartṛkaṃ nirvārpa prakāśituṃ laukikavākyaprayogavat vaidikavākya- prayoge'pi bādhakābhāva ityālocyate, tadā aprayukta- lakṣaṇāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt abhyurbrahmayajamānamatagrahaṇe niyamakābhāvācca pūrvoktapakṣaśravaṇameva yuktam |
kiñca, evaṃ satre devasaviśriṣapuṣpaśabdeṣu bahutvanohaḥ prajyate |

na ca yajñapativṛddhivadatra parārthatvamiti bhāṣyakārasamādhānaṃ yuktam, aśvipuṣpade tathā saṃbhave'pi yajamānānujñāyāḥ parakīyadravyaviṣaye'pi alīkādiparihārāyarthatvena dṛṣṭārtha- tvāt 'udīcīnānasya pado nidhattāt' ityādāviva devasavitṛpadoḥ |
na ca evaṃ bhava- nmate'pi devasya savitṛdaye prasave ityādyaṅgīkāreṇa tasya samevārthatvāt 'mahārātre havīṃṣi nirvapet' ityādiṣkṛtau aprasave ityāhūpati |
prasave jāte janiṣyamāṇe vā ityarthāṅgīkāreṇa bādhakābhāvāt |
ato na devasvatvā''dipadeṣu ūhaḥ iti siddham |
ke. 212|14|46. ‘devasya tvā savituḥ prasave’ iti mantre ‘amaye nirvapāmi’ iti padadvayasya anuṣṭheyārthaprakāśakatayā devasya tvādipadānāṃ sāvarthakatā iti sarveṣāṃ sārthakatā |
devātāṃ āmodeśana tyāgāsaṃbhavāt vigrahābhāvācca aśakteḥ anadhikāraḥ |
soma. 6|1|2. devānāṃ devatvaṃ kacit śrutyā kacid vākyena |
bhā. 2|1|923 pṛ. 523, devānāṃ vaidike karmaṇi nādhikāraḥ |
devapūjā candanādinā yathā cāhnāyaiṣu upa- diśyamāneṣu kaścid brūyāt devāya dhūpo deyaḥ puṣpāṇya- vakaritavyāni candanenānulepanebhyaḥ upahāro'sā upahartavyaḥ |
tamanyaḥ pratibrūte naitadevam, na prathamaṃ dhūpo dātavyaḥ, prathamaṃ puṣpāṇi avakaritavyāni iti |
bhā. 5|1|4|4. devayajanaṃ devāḥ ijyante yatra iti yajñabhūmiḥ |
deva- yajñādhyāyavacanam-- idaṃ yogyatvāt devayajanaṃ kartavyaṃ iti niścayaḥ |
ke. bāla. pṛ. 72. devasvādivyavahārasiddhayarthaṃ devatāyā api svīkārākhyasaṃkalpasya tṛtīye sādhitatvāt |
yadā anekasrotasaṃ nadīṃ tarati, tadā ādau sakṛdeva mantraḥ, na tu pratyekaṃ srotasi mantrāvṛttiḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 2|2|2. devatā ārādupakāriṇī, tasmāt barhirham (havistu antaraṅgam) |
bhā. 8|1|132, devatā āhūtā satī haviṣpayokte tarpayati ca |
10|1|1|2 varṇakaṃ 3. devatā indradayo vigraha--haviḥ svīkāra--taddrojana--tṛti--prasāda rūpaka- viśiṣṭā naiva santi |
vigrahādipañcakapratītyartha- vādayoḥ svārthe tātparyābhāvāt na cānyat kiṃcit pramāṇamasti |
na svāmini sthite kaścit dāśān prārthayate phalam ||
vā. 21|5|29 pṛ. 441. devatā karmaṇi guṇabhūtā yājyā''davākyādyena karmasiddhayarthamupa- lakṣyate |
bhā. 12|4|2|4, devatā tāvat uddeśena athai sādhyati |
6|1|1|18. devatā tu tadāśītvāt saṃprāptatvāt svāminya- narthikā syāt |

9|1|12|16 iti sūtreṇa 'āśāśānā meghapatibhyāṃ megham' iti medhākhyasya paśoḥ meghapatyartha- tvāśiṣaḥ devatāyāṃ paśusvāmisiddhayarthe upapatteḥ yaja- māne tu paśusvāmitvasya prāptatvāt tadāśāsanārthakyāpatteḥ devatāpara eva meghapatiśabdaḥ na yajamānapara iti siddhā- ntitam |
su. pṛ. 1534. devatā darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ upāṃśuyāje prākṛtīnāmamyatvā |
bhā. 10|8|16| 49-50 devatā dvitīyāntena śabdena na hi uddiśyate pramāṇabhāvāt |
nanu viṣṇuḥ stūyate, na ca viṣṇunā stutena kaściddro'sti |
12|4|1|1. devatā na saṃvodhya ‘yathābhāgaṃ nyāvartatām’ ityādi- vibhāgamantreṣu, kintu piṇḍayoreva |
saṃkarṣa. 2|1|16. devatā nāma punariyama ? ekaṃ tāvanmataṃ yā etā itihāsapurāṇeṣu agnyādyāḥ saṃkīryante nākasad : tā devatā iti |
uccate, tāsu devatāsu ahardīnāṃ śārdūladīnāṃ vā na saṃgrahaḥ |
smaryate ca kālavācināṃ devatātvaṃ kālebhyo bhavati 'māso devatā, saṃvatsaro devatā' iti |
aparaṃ matam, yeṣu devatāśabdo mantrādyabhāṇe śrūyate 'agnirdevatā, vāto devatā, sūryo devatā, candramā devatā' ityevamādiṣu te'tra devatāśabde nocyante iti |
tasmāt sūktabhājo jātavedase rayimiva saṃ mahemā manīṣā |
bhadrā hi naḥ pramatirasya saṃsadyame sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava ||
vā havirbhāk devatā, yāṃ prati tādarthya haviṣ : sūktasā- pyevameva |
evaṃ mūrtānāmamūrtānāṃ cetanānāmacetanānāṃ śrutyā kaṃcidartha prati tādarthyaṃ saṃkalpanīyānāṃ devatatvaṃ bhaviṣyati |
yasyāḥ vācakaṃ śabdamuddiśya smṛtvā vā havistyakṣyāmi iti saṃkalpaḥ kriyate sā devatā bhavati tatra |
bhā. 10|4|12|23 pṛ. 1927, devatā nāma yadyai kiṃcidyate |

nyāyasudhāgranthasāratvāt prāti- padikena arthavācinā'pi uddeśyātvānvayārthe padaviśiṣṭā- rthalakṣaṇā'maṅgīkṛtya tatra taddhitavācyadevatātvānvayādhikārāt śabdopaditaḥ artho devatā iti pratīyate, tat pada- viśiṣṭe'rthe ucyatārthevā'pyedeyatvasya bādhāt viśeṣaṇabhūta- padatvasya ca anyopasarjanaṃ anyena nānneti ' iti nyāyena anuṣaṅgatyāt upekṣaṇīyam |
ke. 2|1|16 pṛ. 90-91. devatā paurṇamāsyāṃ upāṃśuyāje prajāpatirvā viṣṇurvā agnīṣomo vā |
su. pṛ. 742. devatā yadyapi pratyakṣaṃ bhuñjīta, tathāpi haṃsa ivotdakāt kṣīraṃ paścāttaneva somaṃ vivicca bhuñjīta |
kimuta yadā uddeśamātropakāriṇī devatā punarabhyujyataiva uddiśyate na pūrvopadeśā |

bhā. 8|1|8|24. devatā vā prayojayetathivada bhojanasya tadarthatvāt ( 9|1|14|16 ) iti pūrvatantrādhikaraṇe atithibhojanasya atithiprādhānyavat devatoddeśena dravyatyāgarūpasya yāgasya devatāprādhānyamiti pūrvapakṣaṃ kṛtvā atithibhojanavaiṣamya-
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ : 'agnerahamujjitamanujjeṣam, soma- syāhamujjitamanujjeṣam' iti mantraṃ na devatā prayojayati kintu apūrva iti siddhānta uktaḥ pūrvādhikaraṇe |
devatā evaṃ mantraṃ prayojayet, bhojanasya tadarthatvāt devatārthatvāt |
bhojyaṃ dravyaṃ devatāye dīyate, sā bhokṣyate |
yathā yāvat kiñcit atitheḥ paricaraṇam, tatvadeva atithipyuktam |
devatāyā āryapatyāt arthapatitvāt yāge mantrādīnāṃ prayojakatā sidhyati |
tathā 'indro diva indra īśe pṛthivyā indro apāmindra it parvatānām |
indro vṛdhāmindra inmedhirāṇāmindraḥ kṣeme yoge havya indraḥ ||
tataśca tasmādeva hetoḥ devatāyāḥ prasādena tena svargādinā phalena saha yāgakratuḥ saṃbandho bhavati |
apivā śabdapūrvatvād yajñakarma pradhānaṃ syād, guṇatve devatāśrutiḥ ||
yāge na devatā pradhānam, kintu yajñakarmaiva pradhānam |
śabdaśca karmaṇā phalamāha 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' ityādiḥ |
tasmānna devatā prayojikā kintu apūrvameva mantrādeḥ prayojakaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
śabdaḥ pūrvaḥ pramāṇaṃ yasya tat yajñakarma śabdapūrve śabdapramāṇakamityarthaḥ |
tasya bhāvaḥ śabdapūrvatvaṃ tasmāt iti vigrahaḥ |
devatāśrutiḥ devatā- vācakaḥ śabdaḥ guṇatve karmaguṇatvasya yodhakaḥ ityarthaḥ |
atithau tatpradhānatvamabhāvaḥ karmaṇi syāt, tasya prītipradhānatvāt ||
yajñakarmaṇi devateva pradhānaṃ ityatra pūrvavādinā uktasya atithivat iti dṛṣṭāntasya vaiṣamyaṃ pratipādya siddhāntamupa- saṃharati |
atithau sati bhojanādidānasya tatpradhānatvaṃ atithipradhānatvaṃ syāt |
saḥ atithiḥ pradhānaṃ yasmin bhojanādidāne tat tattvadhānam |
tatra hi atitheḥ prītiḥ saṃtoṣaḥ pradhānam |
yāgadau karmaṇi tu tasya devatāprītipradhānatvasya abhāvaḥ syāt |
yāgādau hi karmaiva pradhānam, devatā tu guṇabhūtā |
atra sudhā-(pṛ. 750) dṛṣṭāntavaiṣamyābhidhānārthe sūtre vigrahādisadbhāve'pi yajeḥ pūjāvācitvābhāvāt yāgakarmaṇi devatāprādhānyābhāvaḥ iti madhyamāvayavena devatāprādhānye iti |
ke. devatāḥ vigrahadimatyo mīmāṃsakamate santi na vetyatra kutūhale vicāraḥ |

sa ittham - yeṣāṃ tu mate caturdhryantaśabda eva devatā, yeṣāṃ ca caitanyādirāhito'rtha eva devatā, teṣāṃ śabdasya arthasya vā acetanatvādeva anadhikāre siddhe 'devatā'ntarā- bhāvāt' iti prayatnavaiyarthyāpatteḥ sūtrabhāṣyavirodho duṣpariharaḥ |
yattu navame 'devatā vā prayojayet' (9|1|4|16) ityadhikaraṇe devatānāṃ vigrahadipañcakaṃ nirākriyate, tat prauḍhivādamātram |
'śabda eva devatā na tu arthaḥ' iti tu bauddhapralapitameva |
arthābhāve indrādiśabdānāṃ anarthakatayā prātipadikārthe- tadatkatamatvādhikārasaṃkhyāmidhāāyinyaḥ suvibhaktayo na syuḥ |
tathā vigrahadipañcakarahito'rtho devatā ityapi pracchanna- bauddhapralapitameva |
nahi vedaprāmāṇyamabhyupagacchadvaidikaiḥ devatānāṃ vigrahadipañcakaṃ nāstīti śakyamabhyupa- gantum |
yāgā hi devatā''rādhanarūpā, 'yaja devapūjāyām' iti smaraṇāt |
phalakāmīśca 'rājā phalaṃ dadāti' itivat yāge- 'rādhyamānānāṃ devatānāṃ phaladātṛtvaṃ gamyate |
na ca phala- jñānīśānānāṃ phaladātṛtvaṃ saṃbhavati |
na caitat sarvaṃ acetanānāṃ vigrahadvitānāṃ ghaṭate |
tasmāt yāgavidhisāmarthyadeva vigrahavattvaṃ, havirbhoka- tvam, prasādāvattvam, phalaiśvaryavattvaṃ, phaladātṛtvaṃ ca iti vigrahādipañcakaṃ devatānāṃ kalpyate |
'sahasrākṣo gotrabhidrajahurasāsu devo dviviṃga dadhātu' 'tṛpta eyanendraḥ paśūnāṃ paśūstarpayati' 'indro rājā jagataścarṣaṇīnāmi kṣami vipurupaṃ yadasti |

tato dadāti dāśuṣe vasni', 'iṣṭān bhogān hi ve devā dāsyante yajñabhāvitāḥ', 'te tṛptāstarpayantyenaṃ sarva- kāmaphalaiḥ śubhaiḥ' ityādimantrārthavādetihāsapurāṇeṣu devatānāṃ vigrahadipañcakasya spaṣṭamabhidhānācca |
teṣāṃ vidheyavākyatve'pi avāntarapadasaṃsargataḥ pratīyamāna- devatāvigrahāditye kāraṇābhāvāt |
ata eva bhagavatā jaimininā 'aviśiṣṭastu vākyārthaḥ' (2|1|4|12) arthe'nyathādekaṃ vākyam' (2|1|4|14) ityādibhiḥ sūtraiḥ mantrāṇāṃ vākyatvaṃ arthavattvaṃ ca darśitamupapadyate |
'barhirdevasadanaṃ dāmi' ityādi- mantrāṇāṃ laiṅgikaśca viniyogaḥ vidhayati |
arthavādānāṃ- marthavattvavirodhinaśca śāstrārthavirodhāyaiḥ arthavādādhi- karaṇe 'guṇavākya' (2|1|110) 'rūpāt prāyāt' (2|1|111) ityādibhiḥ sūtraiḥ : gauṇyā vṛttyā parihṛtāḥ |
'yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ' ityādī tatkāryakartatvā- diśuguṇayogāt arthavattvaṃ tassiddhipeṭikāyāṃ (2|1|121 23) nirūpitam |
kiṃ bahunā, kṛtsnamapi adhvara- mīmāṃsāyāṃ mantrārthavādaliṅgānujīvyaiva pravṛttaṃ teṣā- marthavattvābhāve vyākulaṃ syāt |
na ca vidheyavākyatayā tatra tātparyavaktā, mantrārtha- vādānāṃ devatāvigrahādirūpe'ye tātparyamācāt kathaṃ ta teṣāṃ prāmāṇyamiti vācyam |
yāgādividhibhiḥ vākyaika vākyatayā teṣu mahātātparyavattvāmapi mantrārthavādānāṃ pradhāna vidheyavākyatāpayājādivākyānāmiva svalāye'pi avāntaratātparyavattvāt |
' ityartha vādasya vidheyastutitātparyakatve'pi svargaśabdārthapratipādane 'pi avāntaratātparyaṃ sarvasaṃpratipannatā tadade- arthavādamātra asati virodhe svārthāntaratātparyakatvāt āśrayaṇīyatvāt |
na ca svargārthavādasya phalaviṣyapekṣitatvāt svā- avāntaratātparyaṃ nānyasya iti vācyam |
'devatā āvāhayati' iti āvāhanavidhiḥ dṛṣṭatvāt devatān āgamanamapekṣate |
tadāgamanaṃ ca haviṣāṃ svīkaraṇāya tasvīkaraṇaṃ ca bhojanāya |
phalakāme kriyamāṇaṃ ca devatānāṃ tṛptijananaṃ phaladātṛtvasiddhaye |
phala dātṛtvaṃ ca phalaiśvaryaṃ iti sākṣāt paraṃparayā vā devata ''gamanādīnāṃ āvāhanavidheyapekṣitatvāt tadvigrahā- tātparyamanivāyam |

kiñca viśvasṛjāmayāgasya satra phalaṃ śrutam 'brahmaṇaḥ sāyujyaṃ salokatāṃ yanti, etādṛśaṃ devatānāṃ sāyujyaṃ sārṣṭiṃ samānalokatāṃ yanti ya etadadu yanti' ityādi kaścit phalaṃ samānalokatā ekalokatā prāptiḥ, tataḥ sārṣṭiṃ samānadehabhogavattvam |
niratiśayabhogavanto na syuḥ tadā tatphalārthatvena vidhānaṃ unmattalalpitameva syāt |
tathā sāmavidhabrāhmaṇe 'ayājitametena kadanam 1' iti dvitīyaṃ prayuñjāno devān paśyati' iti devadarśanātsāma- viśeṣajapavidhisāmarthyādapi devānāṃ vigrahavattvaṃ sidhyati |
na ca devadarśanārthaṃ yugapadeva sāmajapaṃ kurvatsu anekeṣu yajamāneṣu vigrahavatāmapi devānāṃ kathaṃ darśanasaṃbhava iti vācyam |
evaṃ ca bahubhiryajamānaiḥ yugapadāhūtānāṃ devatānāṃ yugapata saṃnidhānaṃ iti nānupapannam |

'kasya vā ha devatā yamāgacchanti, kasya vā bahūnāṃ yajamānānāṃ, yo vai devatāḥ pūrvaḥ parityajati sa evaināḥ śrute yajate' ityarthavādastu 'agnihotraṃ hutvā prātaranavādi ' iti vidheḥ sвакḥ, na vivakṣitārthaḥ |

na ca vājasaneyake 'te vā eta āhutī uktamantaḥ, te antarikṣāmāviśataḥ, te antarikṣaṃ tarpayata, te divamā- viśataḥ, te divaṃ tarpayata : te āvartate imāmāviśataḥ, te puruṣamāviśataḥ, te kriyamāviśataḥ, tataḥ pano jāyate' iti śravaṇena 'agno prāstā''hutiḥ samyagādityamupa- tiṣṭhate |
' ityādismṛtyā ca hutānāṃ haviṣāṃ paralokāt krameṇa pratyāvṛttyagamanāt kathaṃ yajñavāte devānāṃ havirbhokatvaṃ iti vācyam |
hutasya haviṣaḥ kaścidaṃśaḥ tṛptiparyātaṃ deve- mujyate anyo'ṃśastu sṛṣṭyantādirūpeṇa pariṇataḥ pratyāvartate ityumayavidhavacananirvāhāt |
na ca 'triṃśadasyā yojanāni upastha indraḥ sthaviraṃ vibharti' iti atisthūladehānāṃ devānāṃ kathaṃ alpena haviṣā tṛptiriti vācyam |
'yāvadekā kāmayate devatā yāvadattā, tāvadāhutiḥ prathate' iti hutasya haviṣaḥ vṛddhiśravaṇena tadupapatteḥ |
yathāpi hutaṃ havirsībhavati tato nirgatasya tadīya- sūkṣmāṃśasyaiva hṛddhayupyamānaḥ doṣaḥ |
'athādṛṣṭvāni surabhīṇi kṛtvā' iti ca haviravasthāntaranayanasya śravaṇāt |
kuśakāśādaśakalatvādiṣvapi haviḥṣu kaścit bhakṣyāṃśaḥ tattadāsādanayogarūpeṇa pariṇamate, iti na teṣu anada- nīyatvadoṣaḥ |
atra ca liṅgam 'etadvai madhyaṃ yad ghṛtam' iti |
uktaṃ ca tantravārtike lokavedādhikaraṇe ( 1|3|130 varṇakaṃ 1) 'yaccaitad ghṛtamasākaṃ devānāṃ madhirvai' yadi |
yeṣu devatā''vāhanamasti teṣu āgatya mujyate ityā- gamanaśrutiḥ havirnayanaśrutiśca virudhyate |

yadyapi śrāddhe atītapitṛṇāṃ sthāvaratiryaḍmanuṣyanāraka- janmaprāptānāṃ āgamanasaṃbhavāt āvāhane na saṃbhavati, tathāpi yathā garbhasthadeye suhṛdgarbhatamamīṣṭamasaṃ garbhabatī bhuktvā tṛptā satī garbhe tarpayitvā poṣayati suhṛdabhyaśca pratyupakaroti tathā śrāddhīyamapi muktvā tadadhiṣṭhānadevāḥ tutāḥ śrāddhakartṛḥ pitrādīnapi tarpayanti śrāddhāde'pi phalaṃ prayacchanti 'vasudrudrādirūpāḥ pitaraḥ śrāddhadevatāḥ |
'jagummā te dakṣiṇamindra hastam' iti, he indra te dakṣiṇa hastaṃ rakṣastvena vayaṃ grahīṣyāmaḥ ityarthaḥ |
'oṣadhībhyaḥ svāhā, mūlebhyaḥ svāhā' ityādī tatta- dadhiṣṭhātryo devatāḥ iti na virodhaḥ |
na ca devatāprasādādeva yāgasya kālāntarabhāviphala- janananirvāhasaṃbhavāt kimapūrvakalpanāyā iti vācyam |
prasannānāmapi devatānāṃ kalpāntarabhāviphaladātṛtvasya asaṃbhavena apūrvadvārā devatāprasādasyāpi phalajanakatvasya vaktavyatayā anyā'pi tathā kalpanāt |
'taṃ vidyākarmaṇī samanvvārabhete pūrvaprajñā ca' iti vidyākarmaṇoḥ purvā'nubhava- janitasaṃskārasya ca jīvana saha utkrāntiśravaṇena karmaja- nyāpūrvasya avaśyamabhyupeyatvācca |
dravyadevatāsaṃyogastu na katha- bhirapratyakṣāmi: saṃlāpe na kaścidyajñopakāra: |
vā. 2|2|16 pṛ. 516. 2|4|132. devatāyai dātuṃ dravyaṃ tyajati |
vā. na ca śabdamātra devatā iti nacamadaśamayoramicāsyate |
3|4|14|41 pṛ. 979. devatāyai saṃkalpitaṃ yajamānena 2|1|5|16 pṛ. 417, na tu asmākaṃ devatā pivati, na svayamapyuktavyam |

na ca vidhivākye sūryadevatāyā bhāvanā- yāmeva saptamanavamādhyāyane anvayāt yāgamātre tasyāḥ vidhānābhāvena prayogānvitatvāccāteḥ sāṅgapradhāne tatrāsau āvāhinādau prākṛtatāpāttasya itarāṅgeṣu tatpariṣaṅgāttathatve- 'pi prakṛtau āvāhinādimantreṣu amipadaniyamavat vikṛtāvapi teṣu sūryapadaniyamopapattiriti mūlektaṃ śaṅkyam|
dravyadevatāyāḥ satyapi prāthamike bhāvanā- 'nvaye aruṇānyāyena uttarakālikānyasya yāgamātre evāṅgīkārāt āvāhinādau tadaprāpteḥ|
itarathā dravyasyāpi sāṅgapradhānasaṃbandhāpatteḥ deśakālakartṛbhinnānāṃ dravyadevatānāṃ utpannatvyavasthasya vakṣyamāṇatvācca|
kiñca, sāṅgaprāyabhāvanāyāṃ guṇatvena devatā'nyeṣe'pi āvāhinādevaitasaṃskārārthatvācca āgneyam, sauryamityāditadvitena āvāhinādau tadviniyogaḥ śakyate kartum|
ataḥ āvāhinādimantrasya liṅgādeva devatāsaṃskārārthatvapratīteḥ, vikṛtau ca amipadanivṛttau jātāyāṃ sūryavācivākyapramāṇau na kiñcit bādhakam|

iti prāpte, nāvāhanādimantreṣu prakṛtau liṅgakalpaḥ śrutiḥ ‘tattatprakṛtāparvasaṃndhinīṃ devatāṃ tattadganyādipadaiḥ prakāśa- yet’ iti evaṃvidhā, yena vikṛtau amipadasya lope sūryaprakāśakavākyapramāṇitameva, na tvetadasti, aneka- śrutikalpanā''patteḥ|
kintu ‘prakṛtāparvasaṃndhinīṃ devatāṃ vidhitaḥśabdena prakāśayet’ ityevaṃvidhā ekaiva|
ataśca tadarthe vikṛtāvapi vidhitaḥśabdaprayogaḥ evāvaśyaka iti na sūryaparyāyāṇāṃ prayogaḥ|
apiñca prakṛtāparvasaṃndhibhūtaṃ dravyaṃ vrīhipadena prakāśayet ityevaṃvidhā|
tataśca kṣaṇā''- diṣu vrīhipade nivṛtte yavapratipādakasakalaparyāyapada- prāptirivaddhā|
astu vā prakṛtāveva nāntarīya kasiddhatvāpi arthasya yāgāṅgatayā tathāprakāśanānveṣaṇāt yāgāṅgabhūtasya śabdasyaiva vinā'pi lakṣaṇāmāvāhanādimantragatānvādi- padena arthasmaraṇadvārā smaraṇam|
tathā caivaṃ liṅgakalpyā śrutiḥ vidhitaḥśabdena sannidhiśaktiprayojyaśabdāvabodhapā- yakṣaśaktiathayatvarūpasaṃndhidhapayo'styitadvārā apūrvasādhanī- bhūtadevatāyāśrayatvāvācchinnaṃ saṃskuryāditi|
saṃbhavati hi uktavidhaśabdānvodhaviṣayasya artharūpasyaivaikasya saṃndhidhanaḥ śabdo'dhamādhakena darśanena tādṛśabodhopadhāyakaśaktyā- śrayatvasaṃbandhena aparasaṃndhidhanaḥ śabdasya smaraṇam|
na vā ‘agraye pāvakāya’ ityādi vikṛtau śabdadvayasya āvāhinādimantreṣu aprayogaprasaṅgaḥ|
arthasyaiva uddeśyatāmaṅgīkṛtya prakāśakatvapade hi tasya ekaiveva smaraṇasiddheḥ itarathaivamevamiti śaṅkyate|
devatānāṃ savanīyapuroḍāśīyānāmapyutkarṣaḥ - āgne- mārutādūrdhvaṃ anuyājotkarṣeṇotkṛṣyamāṇe sūktavāke|
‘agniḥ’ ‘yadāhavanīyaṃ juhoti, tena ṣoḍaśā- mīṣṭaḥ prīto bhavati’ iti|
tatra saṃdehaḥ devatā- 'miśravakriyāṇāṃ apacāre pratinidhiḥ upādeyaḥ, uta neti|
kiṃ prāptam? pūrvādhikaraṇanyāyena pratinidhirāya anyat prayogaḥ kartavyaḥ iti|
na devatā'miśravakriyāṇāṃ apacāre pratinidhinā bhavitavya- miti|
pratinidhidyamānaṃ anyadevebhyaḥ teṣāmeva (vicalakarīyapāṭho'yam, ānandā- śramīye tu anyacca teṣām iti pāṭhaḥ) na śakyatvāt kartum|
kaśca teṣāmarthaḥ? 1 devatā taduddeśena arthe sādhayati|
agnimuddiśya aṣṭākapālaḥ paurṇamāsyāmamāvā- syāyāṃ ca tyajyate|
yacca anyeṣu haviḥṣu vihitam, na tato darśapūrṇamāsau bhavataḥ|
tathā ‘yadāhavanīyaṃ juhoti’ ilāhavanīyayāpacāre nānno'miḥ pratinidhitāmyaḥ, anyat vā dravyamiti|
āhava- nīyasya upari tyajyamāne yat bhavati, na tat anyasyo- pari|
nahi yadiśabdena sāmarthyāt tat gṛhyate, yasyopari tyajyate|
nahi upari tyajyamānasya deśaḥ kiñcitupakaroti iti|
mantrasya hi etat prayojanam, yat smārayati kriyā chādhanaṃ vā|
tat apacarite mantre yadi tasyārthe anyaṃ śabdamuccārayati (pūrayitum), pūrvapratītai' (pūrve ityānandāśramīye) śabdamuccārayet, na śabdenārtha pratī- yāt|
atha pratītampa punaḥ pratinidhiḥśabdadhāreṇa pratīyāt śabdataḥ pratītiṃ kuryāt|
(atra śabdāt ityādi, pratīyāt ityasyaiva vyākhyā syāt|
sā ca bahilikhitā satī kāyasthena granthe eva likhiteti pratītam|
nahi ‘śabdena pratyāyayitavyam’ iti kiñcit pramāṇa- masti|
yadi asti, tata viśeṣeṇa ‘anena śabdena barhi- rādinā’ ityevam|
tau anyasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ (vicalakarīya pāṭhaḥ) kriyamāṇāyāṃ na tadanto bhavataḥ|
dup-- (siddhāntamāha) - atho vācanikayā śrutyā uccamāno devatācate nānyathā|
tadāca- kāmāve ca kathamarthaṃ devatā syāt (dvārābhāvāt)|
nīvaratstaṇḍulanivṛttiḥ pratyakṣā, na tu devatātvam (pratya- kṣam)|
ato devatāśabdaṃ smṛtvā uttarakālaṃ (tasya daśāṃśadasya--) syādupādānam|
mantre'pi eṣa eva prakāraḥ (ḍupa-pustakeṣu tu prakṣaḥ iti pāṭhaḥ|
(ityāstu viśeṣaḥ: (devatāto mantraḥ-) arthena smṛtena-na mukhyena (mantreṇa) na (api tat-) sadṛśena (śabdāntareṇa) - prayojanamasti|
tadabhāvāt (tasya niyatasya mantrasyā- bhāvāt) upadraṣṭādi kena vāryate (tena asti śabdā- ntaraṃ pratinidhiḥ|
agnīnāṃ nāsti pratinidhiḥ ilāha- āhavanīyo yāgomāmyāmnāyasthitaḥ aṣṭopakāri- tvāt (dṛṣṭopakāritvābhāvāt|
āhavanīyaṃ juhoti iti-) vacanāt (adṛṣṭārthatayā) vidhīyate, (ataḥ) tayoḥ (yāgahomayoḥ āhavanīyasya-) amāve nāsti ākṣepaḥ|
(kriyāyāmapi darśayati--) yat pratyājādibhiḥ (ahadam) kriyate, tat anyā kriyā kariyati iti nāsti pramāṇam|
sūtroktaṃ hetumanu- saṃghatte-) anyārthasaṃyogāt iti kimuktaṃ bhavati? prati- nidhikāraṇasaṃyogāt iti yāvat|
bhāṣyam-- devatāyāmapi viśeṣe yena na prati- nidhīyate|
anyā tasyāḥ sthāne pratinidhimānā na devatā syāt|
yā yadarthe cocyate, sā tasyaiva devatā, nānyasya|
soma-- sūtrārthastu-- devatādikaṃ na pratinidhimyam, anyārthasaṃyogāt pratinidhidhyāyāt nyāyāntarasaṃyogāt iti|
' bhāṭṭa— evaṃ sarvatra pratinidhiṃ prakte devatāyāṃ sa na bhavati |

yadi hi arthamātrasya devatātvaṃ tyāgakālīno- ccāraṇakarmabhūtaśabdapratipādyarūpaṃ bhavet, tadā tasya śabdaviśeṣopadeśā pratipādakatvena vivigatasya upa- sthitasya śabdasya niyame'pi rogādinā tadyodhāraṇasaṃbhave tādṛśārthasya yāgādyatvānapāyāt tadyoghakaśrautalakṣaṇika- śabdāntaraprasaktyā bhavedipi pratinidhiḥ |
yadā tu dāśa- mikādhikaraṇavakṣyamāṇarītyā vivigataśabdaviśiṣṭasya tāhaśaśabdamātrasya vā devatātvam, tadā kaḥ prasaṅgaḥ śabdatarasya |
nahi havistyāgakālīnoccāraṇakarmatvaviśiṣṭa- vivigataśabdatvamabhaniyataṃ alaṇḍopādhirūpaṃ buddhavyavahāra- siddhaṃ devatātvaṃ śabdāntare sambhati |
yadi tu arthasyāpi devatātvaṃ kathañcidīkriyate, tatastatrāpi tādṛśavivigata- śabdapratipādyatvamityeva tadaṅgīkṛtya pratinidhimabhāvaḥ samarthanīyaḥ |
ata eva yāgasya devatātvakalpane'pi vidheyatvaghaṭitatadiṣṭe ākṣepatvāccāsaṃbhavāt devatāvidhira- pūrvavidhireva |
yadā tu devatā'pacāre prajāpatiriti vacanaṃ tadabhāve vidhividhayā prāmāṇikam, tadā tathaivānuṣṭhānam |
yatra tu laukikameveva vācanikamadhi- karaṇatvaṃ yatra vā padādeḥ, tatrāpi satyapi tasya prayoga- vidhiviṣayatve ahārthatvāt na tatpratinidhiḥ |
padādinā āhavanīyādivācastvaṃ patanapratibandhakatvātpū- dhikaraṇatayā evaṃ ahārthatvāt ekena tansiddhe; samuccayāyogādatuṣeyaḥ |
ataśca tatrāpi tatpratinidhiraṣṭo- tyādakatve pramāṇābhāvāt saḥ |
evamarthaprakāśanāyaiṣvapi mantreṣu na pratinidhiḥ śabdā- ntarasya mantrāntarasya vā |
sa hi upāyāntareṇa dhyānādinā arthe anavagate tatpratipādakaśvānābhāvādeva anāśaṅkyaḥ |
avagate tu tasmin smārakānapekṣādeva na tadupādānam |
na caivaṃ yatra svatra evārthaḥ smṛtaḥ, tatra vihitamantrapāṭhānā- pattiḥ; tatra niyamāhasiddhayarthaṃ mantranyastaireva abhyu- dayakāritvakalpanena mantrapāṭhāvaśyakatvāt |
pratinidhistu karmacodanā''kṣiptasya niyamāṣṭajanatve pramāṇābhāvāt na pāṭha iti vaiṣamyam |
evamanyasyāt tadaṣṭocchasya pramāṇābhāvena ahārtha- prayājādikriyāyā api pratinidhiḥ |
yattu atra kaiścidadṛṣṭārthasya ṣoḍaśigrahaṇābhāvādepi na pratinidhiḥ |
tena ṣoḍaśadyabhāvayuktaprayogasaṃkalpe kṛte yadi devādanaṅgampi tatra ṣoḍaśī kṛtaḥ, tadā ṣoḍaśadyabhāvābhāve tadaṣṭārthe nābhāvāttaraṃ pratinidhi- mityuktam |
tacca 'nātirātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' ityanena ṣoḍaśīgrahaṇābhāve'pi itarāṅgāmātradeva ṛtūpakārasiddhi- rityavagamāt ṣoḍaśīgrahaṇe'pyadṛṣṭārthatvāt pramāṇābhāvāt |
ata eva tatra ṣoḍaśīgrahaṇe dṛṣṭāceṣṭā- kṛtaprāyaścittamātram |
sarvā devatāḥ sarveṣāṃ dharmāṇāṃ prayojikā bhavitumarhanti |
bhojyaṃ dravyaṃ devatāyai pradīyate, sā bhokṣyate iti |
tasmāt guṇa- bhūtā devatā, devatā prati guṇabhūte dravyakarmaṇī |
yathā yāvatkiñcit atitheḥ paricaraṇam, sarvaṃ tadatithi- prayuktam |
nanvevaṃ bruvatā vigrahavatī devatā, bhukte cetyabhyupagataṃ bhavati |
'jagmamā te dakṣiṇamindra hastam' iti (ṛsaṃ. 10|47|1) puruṣavigrahasya hi dakṣiṇaḥ savyasya hasto bhavati |
tathā 'ime cidindra rodasī apāre yat saṃgṛbhṇā maghavan kāśirit te' iti (ṛsaṃ. 3|30|5) |
grīvā udaraṃ bāhū iti puruṣavigrahadarśanaṃ bhavati |
tathā caināṃ muñjānāmiba upacaranti, yadasye vividhānupacārān upaharanti |
tāyaca anyārtha- darśanaṃ bhuñjānāṃ devatāṃ gamayati |
'adīndra pitra ca prasthitasya' iti tathāca 'viśvā sannāni jaṭhareṣu dhatte' iti (ṛsaṃ. 1|95|10) |
'ekayā pratidhā pibat sākaṃ sarāṃsi triṃśatam' iti (ṛsaṃ. 8|77|4) |
yadi ca bhuñjīta devatāyai haviḥ prattaṃ kṣīyate |
katham ? devatāyai haviḥ prattaṃ nīrasaṃ bhavati |
dup— tatra yāgo devatā''rādhanārtha itimanyamānaḥ; pūrvapakṣaṃ karoti |
agnidevatā asyaśabdasya viśeṣa- ṇam, asyaśabdaśca dravyābhidhāyī itarāt tadviśeṣaṇam tat (dravyam) yadi agnuddeśena pradīyate, evaṃ abhiśabdo viśeṣaṇaṃ (bhavati) nānyathā |
yadā ca dravyaṃ (agnu- ddeśena) pradīyate, tadā agniḥ saṃpradānaṃ bhavati |
(katham ?) yajatikriyā dravyaṃ vyāpyate, dravyeṇa ca saṃpradānam |
apica devapūjāyā yajivartate iti smaranti (śabdāḥ 'yaja devapūjāsaṃgati karaṇadāneṣu' iti) |
tasmāt 'yajeta svargakāmaḥ' iti devatāṃ yāgena ārādhayet tataḥ (devatāyāḥ sakāśāt) svargo bhaviṣyati iti |
bhāṣyam— yadi kasyacidarthasya īśānā devatā upacaryamāṇā ca prasīdet, tataḥ tadārādhanārthe iyaṃ devatā pūjā abhiniveśyeta |
na caitadubhayamapi asti iti taducyate arthapattidevateti |
evaṃ hi smaranti 'arthā nāmīṣṭe devatā' iti |
tathā devagrāmo devakṣetraṃ ityupa- cāraḥ tāmeva smṛtiṃ draṣṭayati |
tathā anyārthadarśa- īśānāṃ devatāṃ darśayati 'indro diva indra īśe pṛthivyā indro apāmindra iṣṭa parvatānām |
indro vṛdhāmindra indro dhirāṇāmindraḥ kṣeme yoge hanya indraḥ ||
tathā 'īśānamasya jagataḥ svardṛśaṃ mīśānamindra tatyupaḥ' iti |
tathā upacaranti 'prasanno'sya paśupati puṇyo'sya jātaḥ' 'prasanno'sya vaiśravaṇaḥ dhanamane- lakṣmam' iti |
tathā anyārthadarśanaṃ bhavati 'āhutibhi- reva hutādo devān prīṇāti' iti, 'tasmai prītā iṣamūrjaṃ niyacchanti' iti |
bhāṣyam— tato devatāyāḥ tena phalena saṃbandhaḥ pari- carituṃbhavati |
yo devatāṃ ijyā. paricarati, taṃ sā phale saṃjñati |
smaranti hi 'devatā yahuḥ phalaṃ dadāti' iti |
tāmeva upacāreṇa smṛtiṃ draṣṭayati 'paśupatinena upacaritaḥ, putro'nena labdhaḥ' iti |
tayā anyārthadarśanaṃ imemevātra darśayati 'sa iñjanena sa viṣā sa janama sa putrairvājaṃ bharate dhanā nṛbhiḥ |
devānāṃ yaḥ pitaramāvivāsati śraddhā- manā haviṣā brahmaṇaspatim |
yena karmaṇā abhirārādhito yasya phalasya ipse, tat kathaṃ prayacchati |
yathā agnī vacanam, na tat sūrye |
adhiyā śabdapūrvatvād yajñakarma pradhānaṃ syād, guṇatve devatāśrutiḥ |
īśe' ityevamādīni, tat pratyakṣaṃ anīśānāṃ devatā- mupalabhya adhyavasyāmaḥ, bhākta eṣa śabdaḥ iti |
tatrāha vacanaprāmāṇyādeva asya īśānatā avagamyate, yadeva lokā arthān viniyuñjate, tat devatā'bhiprāyādeva iti adhyavasyāma iti |
ye'pi devatāmīśānāṃ varṇayanti, te'pi nāpahuvate paricārakāṇāmabhiprāyam |
kiṃ cāhuḥ ? tathā devatā karoti, yathā paricārakāṇāmabhiprāyo bhavatīti |
na ca sa īśāno bhavati, yaḥ parābhiprāyamanurudhyate yasya na svābhiprāyatvāt viniyogo bhavati |
stutivāde ca saṃbhavati na vacanaprāmāṇyāt īśitve iti gamyate |
na ca devatā phalena saṃbadhyatā, yā tadyai paricaryeta |
yaduktaṃ smṛtyupacārānyārthadarśanaṃ : dadāti prasīdati ceti, tatra smṛtyupacārayoktam |
yat anyārthadarśanaṃ 'tasmai śrītā iṣūje prayacchati' iti, tacca |
anyasya vidheḥ āmnānāt 'dakṣiṇataḥ saṃparihartavyā ityāha' iti |
ḍupa—(apivā śabdapūrvatvāt yajñakarma pradhānaṃ syād guṇatve devatāśrutiḥ |
) 'yajeta svargakāmaḥ' iti (atra) yajeta iti uttarārdhāt (bhāvanācacanāt) tisraḥ ākāṅkṣā jāyante |
tatra prathamaṃ tāvat bhāvya- mākāṅkṣate 'bhāvayet kim' iti |
tat (phalam) bhāvyamānaṃ kena (bhāvyate) iti dvitīyāmākāṅkṣāṃ pūrvārdho nirākāṅkṣī- karoti |
'katham' iti tṛtīyāmākāṅkṣāṃ abhyanvā- dhānādīni nirākāṅkṣīkurvanti, saṃnidhānāt |
tadevaṃ asmāt vākyāt yāgāt phalaṃ śrūyate, na devatāyāḥ |
yāgaḥ phalāya (phale iti ānandāśramīye ratne ca) nirvṛttimpeṣate |
apekṣyamāṇaṃ ca dravyadevataṃ kārakaśenaiva apekṣyate, na bhābhyāṃśena |
tatra tṛtīyāyā kārakaṃ bhavati, devatā (ca) taddhitana caturthyā vā |
tacca devatākārakaṃ yāgaṃ prati prādhānyaṃ yadi na pratipadyeta, tathā sati yāgo naiva nirvartate |
yadi ca yāgaḥ tasya guṇānāṃ na pratipadyeta ātmānameva na labheta |
tasmāt yāgena nāntarīyako guṇabhāvaḥ prati- pattavyaḥ |
na ca nāntarīyako vyāpāro guṇabhāve pradhānabhāve vā kāraṇam, acoditatvāt |
ahaṃ nānyathā phalaṃ sādhayāmītyevaṃ nāntarīyakamyāpāreṇa devatāṃ prati guṇabhūtena bhavitavyam |
śabdena ca pratyāsannasya yāgasya phalasādhanatvāt prādhānyam, devatāyāśca guṇatvaṃ vijñāyate |
kiṃ tarhi ? codanālakṣaṇaṃ tat iti sthitam |
kiṃ bhavati prayojanaṃ cintāyāḥ ? yadi devatā''rādha- nārtho yāgaḥ, tataḥ pūjyāmānā devatā, yāgaśca pūjā |
tatra yena prakāreṇa abhiḥ pūjyate, tenaiva sūryaḥ pūjyate iti ka āśvāsaḥ |
api ca sūryaḥ ekākī san abhipūjayā tṛpyati, devatā'ntarasahitastu agniḥ abhī- ṣomapūjayā iti naitat saṃbhāvyate |
nahi devadattaḥ atyanta- madhuramadhupayaḥ prabhṛtibhiḥ śrīyamāṇo yajñadasāhacaryāt sauvīrapriyo bhavati |
siddhānte bhāvyamānena dharmāḥ sambadhyante, tatra saurye bhāvyamānenaiva dharmā ākāṅkṣyante |
athavā yadā devatā''rādhanātho yāgaḥ, tadā yaduktam ' (vipratipattau haviṣā niyamyeta' ityatra-) dravyadevatā- viroghe dravyasāmānyāt vidhyantaḥ |
pūrvapakṣe tu) devatā''rādhanāthatvāt yāgasya devatā- sāmānyameva balīyaḥ, viprakṛṣṭatvāt dravyasāmānyasyeti |
atithau tatapradhānatvamabhāvaḥ karmaṇi syāt tasya prītipradhānatvāt |
yattasmai na rocate, na tadlāt kārayitavyamiti |
yāgaḥ pūjā tadaṅgaṃ syā- datitherbhājanaṃ yathā |
gṛhṇāti siddharūpā ca devatā tasya sādhanam |
soma-- prādhānye'pi prayojakatva na syāt iti pūrvakāpaparyaprayojakatvamākṣipya samarthayate iti saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu-- devataiva sarvān dharmān yojayet bhojanasya yāgasya idaṃ haviḥ devatā mokṣyate iti kriyamāṇatvāt yāgasya bhojanaśabdena nirdeśaḥ |
vi—'devaḥ prayojako'pūrve vā, sa'co'sya phala- dalataḥ |
iha tu tadanaṅgīkṛtya devatāprāsādaḥ eva prayojaka'stu ityāśaṅkā prasaṅgāccirākriyate |

tatra devatāyāḥ saṃpradānatvāt tasya ca karmakārakāpekṣayā'pi abhiprāyamāṇatvena prādhānyāt yāgasya pūjāpastaskāra- kātvāgateḥ, tasyāḥ śropayogāpekṣayā 'ma evainaṃ bhūti gamayati' 'tṛpta evainamindraḥ prajābhiḥ tarpayati' ityādyarthavādānusārāt pramnāyāḥ phaladāttve; yāga- syaiva phalajanakatve pramāṇābhāve apūrvasādhanatve sutarāṃ pramāṇabhāvaḥ |
astu vā devatāyā abhiprāyamāṇatvāpi tasya 'brāhmaṇāya gāṃ dadāti' ityādi brāhmaṇasya phala- dātṛtvā'saṃbhavena abhāvān prādhānyāsaṃbhavena prādhānya vyabhicāreṇa tatkalpanā''nupapatteḥ |
pratyuta bhāvārthādhikaraṇa- nyāyena yāgakaraṇikāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ bhāvyāpekṣāyāṃ svargasyaiva tatvenānvayāt, devatāyā api saṃskāryatve uddeśyatvāna kathañcinmitatvātmedyapatteḥ |
devatāyā eva yāgākhyasya tathāpi yāgasya phalajanakatve vyāpārāpekṣāyāmabhāvātpūrva kalpanā'pekṣayā rātrisatravat ārthavādikadevatāprāsādasya dvāratvakalpanāt taprayuktatvasiddhiḥ |

iti prāpte, prasādo hi yadi icchā rūpaḥ, tadā tasyecchātvena tatphale prati kāraṇatve atiprasaṅgapatteravarasya daśādikartṛtvāt phalatvaṃ ityeva- mākārakecchātvena tadvācyam, tathā ca kāraṇatā'vacchedake gauravam |
daśādijanyaphalabhogame jāte'pi tatkartṛtvānapāyāt anyakṛtadaśarpaṇātprasādasya anyasya phalapattiśca ataḥ phalavyakttitvāvacchinnaṃ prati tadvyaktiḥ |
sā phala vyaktirbhavatu ityevamākārakecchātvena kāraṇatvaṃ vācyam tathā cānekakāryakāraṇabhāvakalpane kāraṇatā'vacchedave gauravaṃ ca |
kiñca etādṛśaprasādo yadi brāhmaṇatarpaṇānte, tada yāgānāṃ nahatyādeva utpattyanāpattiḥ |

yadi tu tattayāgebhyo 'pi avāntaraprasādā āgneyayatkiñcittvadādijanyaṃ phalaṃ bhavatu ityākārikā iṣyante, tadā devatānāṃ amoghecchatvasya arthavādeṣu pratipādanāt daivādaprītīmīyākaraṇe'pi phalā- pattiḥ |

athaitadarthavādātmeva abhyupagamya tādṛśamahā prasādasya vijātīyacchatvenaiva apūrvavādena iva vijātīya- phalatvāvacchinnaṃ prati kāraṇatā, avāntaraprasādānāṃ ca vijātīyatacchidratvenaiva mahāprasādaṃ phalaṃ ca prati kāraṇatā, phāraṇatā'vacchedakasaṃścayaśca svajanakāyāgasyama- cāryatvam, kāryatā'vacchedakasaṃścayaśca phalaṃśe samavāyaḥ |
avāntaraprasāda mahāprasādayoḥ parasparaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāve pratyāsattiḥ ubhayatra svajanakāyāga samavāyitvameva |
eva pratyāsattirastu iti cet, saṃbandha- gauravasya doṣatvāt, yāganiṣṭhakāraṇatānirūpitakāryatā
manmate tu sarvakāryāraṇabhāvānāṃ samavāyaḥ eva saṃbandha iti lāghavam |
etena prasādo nāma sulaviśeṣa ityapi pakṣaḥ pratyuktaḥ |
na ca asya gauravasyārthādi ke prasādākhye vyāpāre siddhe phalamukhatvamiti vācyam |

arthavādasya stāvakatayā'pi upapattau svatastvātkalpakatvābhāvāt, vyāpārapekṣāyāṃ rātri- satranyāyena tadācakapadāntarakalpanāyā tasya vyāpāratvakalpane ca vyāpāratvasya kāraṇatāghaṭitatvena tasyāḥ saṃbandhavagama- pūrvakatvāt saṃbandhagauravasya phalamūlatvānupapatteḥ |
ato ye tāvat prasādādipratipādakāḥ, te devasyyādimantradeva prasādādiviśiṣṭadevatāprakāśanāthāḥ santo viśeṣaṇāṃśe prakāśanāya arthāthatvāt nānupapannāḥ |
vaiśiṣṭyaghaṭaka- saṃbandhaśca āhāyāṃ vā anāhāyāṃ vetyanyadetat |
artha- vādāśca tenaiva saṃbandhena stāvakā iti teṣvapi na stuti- lakṣaṇā, ato'nyā kācitkalpanā |
astu vā sā, tathā'pi vidhau gauravāpatte
devatā''vāhanārthaḥ nigadaḥ 'agnimama āvaha' ityādiḥ hotā sāmidhenīprayājayeormadhye paṭhyate |
vi. 10|1|1 varṇakam 3. devatā''vāhanakāle vaiśvadevacarau viṣṇorukramasyāvāhanaṃ na kāryam |
bhā. 10|1|1|1-3 varṇakam 3. devatā''śrayaṃ dravyāśrayeṇa bādhyate yathā aindrapuroḍāśe devatāsāmānyāt sāṃnāyyavidhyantaḥ prāsaḥ, sa tu dravyasāmānyāt pravṛttena āgneyavidhyantena bādhyate |
rahasya. pṛ. 102. devatātvaṃ nāma yasyaiva śabdenoktam, tasyaiva yogyasyāyogyasya vā bhavati, iti na jātinimittam |
nanu śabdamātrasya devatātvāt indrabhendraśabdayośca bhedāt kathaṃ devataikyaṃ ityāśaṅkayāha-- na ceti ( na ca śabdamātraṃ devatā iti navamadaśamayorbhāṣyate |

nanve 'apitvā śabdapūrvatvād yajñakarma pradhānaṃ syād guṇatve devatāśrutiḥ' iti sūtre ( 9|1|9 ) bhūtabhavyasamuccāraṇanyāyena devatāyāḥ yāgaṃ prati guṇatve abhihite, 'nanu kameṇe'pi aiṣṭitāda- bhipretatvaṃ devatāyā gamyate' ityāśaṅkaya 'nāsyā abhi- pretatāmapahunumahe |

taddhitaśabdena caturthyā vā saṃyuktāsya devatātvasya vākyādabhipretatā gamyate' ( bhā. pṛ. 1652 ) iti bhāṣye anarthakavarṇasamūhasya prātipadikatvābhāve taddhitacaturthīyogayogyatāt tatsaṃyogābhidhānena arthagrahaṇe (ca) śabdamātrasya devatātvaṃ nirastam |

daśame ca 'vidhi- śabdasya mantratve bhāvaḥ syāt tena codanā' (10|4|123) ityatra 'āvāhanādau yenakenacit paryāyeṇa devatā'bhi- dhānasiddheḥ vidhigatyāgnyādidānenādaraḥ' iti pūrvapakṣa- vidhyā 'āgneyo'ṣṭākapālaḥ' itividhivigatana agnidābdena devatāyā haviḥsambandhavidhānāt mantrakāryaṃ devatoddeśe vidhi- gatasya śabdasyoccāraṇaṃ kāryam' iti siddhānte, 'kā punarayaṃ devatā nāma' iti pṛṣṭvā indrādīnāṃ yuktānāṃ vede yā yatra 'agnidevatā vāto devatā' ityādidevatā- śabdaḥ prayuktaḥ, sā devatā iti pramatadvayaṃ ahaḥśārdūlādīnāṃ anupasaṃgrahāt nirasya, svamatena 'sūkṣmabāhyo havi- rmāṃjya devatāḥ' ( bhā. pṛ. 1927 ) iti bhāṣye 'agnidevatyaṃ sūktam' 'agnidevatyaṃ haviḥ' ityādiprayogāt 'āhutibhājo vā anyā devatā anyāḥ stomabhāja- śchandobhāvāḥ' iti liṅgācca sūktastutyasya tyajyamāna- haviruddeśatvasya ca devatābhidhānādarthasya stutyatvo- ddeśyatvāvagateḥ 'mūrtānāmamūrtānāṃ cetanānāmacetanānāṃ ca śrutvā kaścidyadi prati tādarthyaṃ saṃkalpanīyānāṃ devatātvaṃ bhaviṣyati' ( bhā. pṛ. 1927 ) iti ca bhāṣye mūrtānāṃ cetanānāṃ devatātvābhidhānāt 'yasya vācakaṃ śabdamuddiśya smṛtvā vā havistyāgami iti saṃkalpaḥ kriyate sā (devatā) bhavati ( tatra )' ( bhā. pṛ. 1927 ) iti ca bhāṣye uccāraṇārthatvāt diśaḥ uccāryamāṇena śabdena 'prajāpati manasā yajeta' ityādivāci vā sarvamāne vācyasya devatātvābhidhānāt, 'nanu evaṃ sati sutarāṃ yenakenacit agneḥ śabdena nirdeśaḥ karaṇīyaḥ' iti cāśaṅkaya 'bhave- detadevaṃ yadi agniśśabdo'pyasyatyāgārthamapyanyat artho'pi haviḥsambandhārthe prayājyeta' ityupakramya ( bhā. pṛ. 1927 ) 'devatāyāśca yajñasādhanabhāvo na rūpeṇa bhavati |
kena tarhi ? saṃbandhanā śabdena' ityādinā bhāṣye ( bhā. pṛ. 1928 ) śabdasaṃbandhitvādvyatiriktikābhidhānāt śabdasya devatātvaṃ nirastaṃ bhavati |
su. pṛ. 643, devatātvaṃ havi- rbhāktatvam, stutibhāktatvam |
pṛ. 669. artho vācikayā śrutvā uccyamāno devatātvaṃ pratipadyate, nānyathā |
sati 'maitrāvarunāya daṇḍaṃ prayacchati', 'āgneyāya hiraṇyaṃ dadāti' ityādī maitrāvaruṇāderapi dravyoddeśyatvasadbhāvena devatātvāpatteḥ |
kiñca uddeśatvamātrasya devatātve prati- nidhīyamānasyāpi devatātvasambhavāt paṣṭhe vakṣyamāṇo devatā- pratinidhitvabhāvo virudhyeta |
bhāṭṭa. 9|3|12. saṃpradāna- dvaividhyamabhyupagamya pratigrahaṇāmakasya saṃpradānasya devatā- tvābhāve'pi anirākaraṇāmakasaṃpradānasya devatātvamicchanti kecit |

kiñcidapi cet iha anyathā jātaṃ nivṛtta- vyāpārāyāṃ codanāyāṃ pramāṇāntaraṃ mṛgyam |
vā. 2|1|5 pṛ. 422, mantreṣu prādhānyābhidhānāt anyādyeyaḥ devatātvena prajñātāḥ |

2|3|15|4|601, devatātvasya dvidevatye nyātaṅki- tvāt ( vyāsājya vṛttitvāt ) 1|3|15|14. 'devatā- tvasya śabdanimittatvena' ityādinā ekadevatātvalakṣaṇamuktvā 'arthasya devatātvapade' ityādinā anyathā lakṣaṇamuktam |
pṛ. 775. devatātvabodhakāni ca devatāśabdaḥ, taddhitaḥ, caturthī, dvitīyā, mantravarṇaśceti |
devatātvaparyantaṃ prajāpatirdevatā devatāḥ' ityādi 'rātridevatāmeke, nakṣatra- devatāmeke' ityādau ca dravyadevatātvarūpadevatātvasya devatāpadavācyasya anvayaḥ |
evaṃ ca taddhitasya devatāviśiṣṭe buddhisyaprakāre aṣṭākapālatvādā tad- vyaktitvādā vā śaktiḥ |
teṣāṃ prakārāṇāṃ nānātve'pi buddhisyatvasya upalakṣaṇatvena śaktigrahasaṃbhavaḥ |
śaktigrahopalakṣaṇasya na śakyatāva- cedakatvaṃ iti dik |
maṇi. pṛ. 162-163. devatādvayena svakāryāṇi na kartavyāni |
bhāṭṭa. 8|1|8. devatādvayādīnāṃ prākṛtānāṃ vikṛtau uddiṣṭadevatātvādibhiḥ bādhaḥ |
2|3|15 12-15. devatādhyānaṃ vaṣaṭkārāt prāgeva hotā kartavyam saṃkarṣa. 4|3|6. devatādhyānaṃ vaṣaṭkārāt prāk 'tāṃ dhyāye- vaṣaṭkariṣyan' iti luṭprayogāt |

iti prāpte, 'jātamjñalinā gṛhṇāti' 'jāta- mabhiprāṇiti' ityādi jananānvayahitottarakālasya sāmarthya nāpi niyamadarśanāt devatā'rcanavidhau dhyānasya prā- pikdarśanād vaṣaṭkārāt pūrvameva devatādhyānam |
vastu 'yasya devatāyai havirgṛhītaṃ syātāṃ dhyāyedupakariṣya- sākṣādeva tadevatāṃ prīṇāti' iti vacanāntareṇaiva kā- niyamaḥ |
bha 9|1|4|6-10. pramāṇāntarāvirodhe eva devatātva- ( brū. ) pravartate |

saṃkarṣa. 9|1|14|16. 2|4|12. devatāprakāśena ca pratyakṣa upakāro yāgasiddhiḥ |

'aindramekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet' ityādi puroḍāśadharmā- tideśāḥ, na tu sāṃnāyyadharmātideśaḥ |

yathā devadatta- hananohatya hanane tu devadattasya bhavatyevo
deśalakṣaṇa oṃ deśapātrādīnāmupayuktānāṃ prayogāntare upā- dāne'pi na doṣaḥ ||
kiṃ pratiprayogamanyānyupādeyāni, uta tāni va'nyāni vopādāya prayoga iti |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? niriṭyakena punaḥ kriyāṃ śiṣṭā nācarantīti |
laukikeṣu yathākāmī, tāni vā'nyāni vā, aniyamaḥ |
atha yaduktaṃ niriṭyakena śiṣṭā yāgaṃ nācarantīti |
( niriṭyakena iti bhāṣyādau - ) nitarāṃ iha anena iti niriṭyam, niriṭyameva niriṭyakaṃ ekasmin karmaṇi upayuktam |
sūtrārthastu- laukikeṣu deśādiṣu pūrvaprayogakṛtasya prayogāntare upajīvyasya saṃskārasya abhāve anyopādāne'pi saṃskāralopābhāvāt anyairapi prayoganirvṛttyā arthalopābhāvācca yathākāmī iti |
, mukhyatve'parṇavat te'nye, vāsovat te syu- rnecchikāḥ ||
bhāṭṭa - samādideśanāmadhvanyādidhvijāṃ suvādi- pātrāṇāṃ ca pratikarma pratiprayogaṃ ca meda eva |
iti prāpte, 'kuśā daryādayo mantrā brāhmaṇaśca bahuśrutāḥ |
na te nirmālyātāṃ yānti viniyojyāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||
na ca 'ṛtvigācāryoṃ nāticaritavyo' iti vacanenā- ticāraniṣedhāt te eveti niyamaḥ śakyaḥ |
asthā- prakaraṇasthatā puruṣārtharūpasya kartavyatve pramāṇābhāvena anyakaraṇe kratuvaiguṇyānāpatteḥ |
na caivamekalapatte vyakterekatvena ātithyā- barhiḥprokṣaṇanyāyena sakṛtkṛtaireva varaṇasaṃmārjanādisaṃskāraiḥ sarvamaṃgasya kāryasiddheḥ |
ātithyāyāṃ upasatsu agnīṣomīye ca barhiḥḥ sāghā- raṇam |
tasya 'ūrṇāpradasya tvā stuṇāmi' iti staraṇasya mantraḥ |
ātithyāyāḥ prāgvaṃśaḥ upasadāṃ ca, agnīṣomīyasya tu uttaravedisamīpaḥ |

ke. deśabaddhamupāṃśutvaṃ (deśasaṃbaddha iti pāṭhaḥ) iti navamādhikaraṇanyāyena (9|1|6|20) prakṛtasya svarasya yajñabhāgadharmatā sthitatvāt yajñabhāgapatitasya apūrvasyāpi aṅgasya prākṛtasvarasyādharmatvāpatteḥ |
su. pṛ. 1182. deśabhāṣā'paṃśraddhapāni hi viṣphuṭitamūrddhāni na śakyante vivekatum |
pṛ 226. deśalakṣaṇā bhavati yathā 'agnī tiṣṭhati' 'kūpe tiṣṭhati' iti (agnideśe kūpadeśe ityarthaḥḥ ) |
deśasaṃbaddhamupāṃśut tilako me skandate' iti rāgābhāve tilakābhāve ca taddeśalakṣaṇayā bhavati vakkāraḥ |
vi. 4|2|9. deśavidhisarūpaḥ arthavādaḥ 'ṣaṭtriṃśatkramā prācī triṃśatpadena caturviṃśatiḥ purastāt' iti vidhau vākyaśeṣaḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 57. deśaviśeṣo lakṣyate 'ardhamantarvedi minoti, ardhe bahirvedi' ityanena |

deśasaṃbaddhamupāṃśutvam (deśabaddha - ityanyatra pāṭhaḥ) ityatra 'tvarā vā eṣā yajñasya tasmāt yatkiñcit prācīnamīṣomīyāt tenopāṃśu caranti' iti udāhṛtya yajñabhāgadharmo vā etadupāṃśutvaṃ padārthadharmo vā iti saṃdigdhe, yajñasya phalavatvena dharmaprayuktasāmarthyāt yajñasya yat prācīnaṃ iti vyavahitenāpi yaśaśabdena prācīnaśabdasya anvayapratīteḥ śrutvā ca prādeśavācinaḥ prācīnaśabdasya lakṣaṇayā taddeśapadārthaparatvāt yajñabhāgadharmatvaṃ pūrva- pakṣayitvā prācīnaśabdasya vīpsā kiñcicchabdasamabhi- vyāhṛtayacchabdānvayāt vīpsāyāśca bahuviṣayatvena eka- smin - deśe anupapatteḥ lakṣaṇāyā agnīṣomīyaprāgdeśa- padārthaparatvasyaiva nyāyyatvāt padārthadharmatā iti siddhā- ntitam |
su. pṛ. 730. deśasaṃbaddhamupāṃśutvaṃ teṣāṃ syācchutinirdeśāt, tasya ca tatra bhāvāt |
jyotiṣṭome 'tvarā vā eṣā yajñasya tasmāt yatki- ñcit prācīnamīṣomīyāt tena upāṃśu caranti' iti śrūyate |
agnīṣomīyāt paṣṭhoḥ prācīnaḥ yajñasya, sā vai tvarā chadmagatiḥḥ śanaiḥ padavinyāsaḥ śakunigrāhavat |
tasmāt tadānīṃ upāṃśunā svareṇa mantrā uccāraṇīyāḥ iti śrūyateḥ |
atra kiṃ agnīṣomīyāt prāktanāni yāni karmāṇi, tadyuktaṃ upāṃśutvam, uta parama pūrvaprayukta iti vicāre siddhāntamāha |
upāṃśutvaṃ deśa saṃbaddha śrutaṃ agnīṣomīyāt paśoḥ yat prācīnaṃ karmatām sa upāṃśutvasya deśaḥ |
agnī ṣomīyāt iti pañcamīśrutyā yeṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ nirdeśaḥ, teṣa karmaṇāṃ pañcamīśrutinirdeśāt upāṃśutvaṃ dharmaḥ |
atha 'yatkiñcit prācīnamagnīṣomīyāt' iti śrutaṃ vākyame śrutiśabdena gṛhyate |
athavā lakṣaṇayā agnīṣomīyaprāgbhāvādipadārtha pūrve śrutiśabdena grāhyam |
tādṛśamapūrve nirdiṣṭaṃ uddiśya upāṃśutvaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ tadarthe syāt |
tasya ca avāntara pūrvasya ca tatra teṣu agnīṣomīyaprāgbhāvādipayeṣu bhāvā sattvāt |
tasmāt paramāpūrvaprayuktameva upāṃśutvaṃ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
itaḥ paraṃ (21-24) sūtradvayaṃ prakṛtādhikaraṇaguṇatvena bhāṣyādau vyākhyātamapi antarāgarbhīṇatvena adhikaraṇā- ntaratvenāpi vyākhyātam |
tato'ssāmiḥ adhikaraṇāntara- svenaiva vyākhyāsyate pradeśāntare iti dhyeyam |
upāṃśutvaṃ na paramā- pūrvaprayuktam, kintu taddeśānām |
saḥ agnīṣomīyāt prākdhanaḥ deśaḥ yeṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ te taddeśāḥ |
teṣāṃ taddeśānāṃ karmaṇāṃ upāṃśutvaṃ prācīnapadārthaprayuktamupāṃśutvaṃ syāt, na grahyāgasaṃghātasyāyuktam, na grahyāgasaṃghātajanyaparamāpūrva- prayuktamityarthaḥ |
saṃghātasya grahyāgasaṃghātasya yo bhāgaḥ prācīnaḥ, tasya upāṃśutvasaṃbandhena acoditatvāt codanā- 'bhāvāt |
anubandhya''diṣu dikṣanyāyātideśo na yuktaḥ ityā- śaṅkaya |
su. pṛ. 1180. dikṣaprakaraṇe dāryapaurṇamāsikaprayājādiśadarśanāt dikṣe paurṇamāsadharmāti-(darśadharmāti-)-deśāvagateḥ sopakārasya svaprakaraṇe prākṛtapramāṇasiddhasya upalambhaḥ |
de. 6|5|123, daivāt ekasya svakālād aṃśo'pi tadanusāreṇānyāṃ aṃśo na kāryaḥ |
yathā cāturmāsyeṣu saṃtāpanyāḥ aṃśe'pi agnihotrasya svakālāt aṃśo na kartavyaḥ |
su. pṛ. 132. daive karmaṇi dharmāṇāṃ prāgagraṃ udagagraṃ vā, paitṛke karmaṇi tu dakṣiṇāgratvam |
vi. 3|4|4. daivatairavadāne: devatān sauviṣṭakṛtāḥ sauviṣṭakṛtāṃ aiḍaiśvadānāṃ anusamayaḥ ekadevatākapaśugaṇe vājapeye prājāpatyapaśuṣu |
bhā. 5|1|6|10-12. daivatavadānaṃ sauviṣṭakṛtāvadānaṃ aiḍāvadānaṃ iti padārthabhedaḥ 'daivatavyādātha' ityādikāt kramānyatva- vidhāyakāccanāt |
ataśca ekadaivye paśugaṇe devatādānādinā pratyekamanusamayaḥ; ante ca tantreṇa devatāhomaḥ |

vastutastu asaṃbandhpidārthāntaravyavadhāne'pi pañcāvattahomasaṃpādakatvena devatāvadānasyāpi pradānāyavalopapatteḥ viminnadevatāka- khale'pi devatāvadānādipradānāntena anusamayaḥ; eka- devatāke tu padārthatvayavānāmetrānusamaya iti na ko'pi virodhaḥ |
daivatakyavat 'agniṣomo devatā' ityatra yathā nyāsasyordhvaṃtvāt daivatakyam, tathā 'yajeta' ityatra daṃpatyorekameva kartṛtvam |
vi. 6|1|4. doṣo nānumite tsasau' iti nyāyena ārthike pratipattividhau dhāraṇaprayojakatvasya adoṣatvāt |
murāri. bhā. pṛ. 1173. mahāśaiva doṣo yacchiā varjayanti |
bhā. 6|5|120, yaśramoyo: pakṣayordoṣaḥ, na tamekaśco bhavati |
10|1|9|125, yatra doṣaḥ, tatra doṣavidhātayena bhavi- tavyam |
10|8|18|163. 'doṣātu lililekhike' ityādisūtreṇa aśrapratigrahedaiḥ laukikāśradānanimittā iti pūrvapakṣaṃ kṛtvā 'arthavādo vā' ityādisūtreṇa 'vaidikā- śradānanimittā' iti siddhāntitam |
parākramaḥ.2111-2. doṣātu lililekhike svācchyābdhi vaidike na doṣaḥ syāt |
'vakṣṇo vā etaṃ gṛhṇāti, yo'śvaṃ pratigṛhṇāti, yāvato- 'śvān pratigṛhṇīyāt tāvato vāruṇāṃścatukapālānnirvapet' iti aśrapratigraheṣṭimānā |
śa ki laukike aśrapratigrahe kartavyā, vaidike vā iti vicāre, pūrvapakṣamāha |
iṣṭiḥ aśrapratigraheṣṭiḥ laukike mitrāsipradānāke aśradāne syāt |
vaidike tu pauṇḍarīkādau aśradāne śāstrāt- dānavidhāyakaśāstrabalādeva doṣaḥ na syāt |
tasmāt laukike aśrapratigrahe dāne vā iyamiṣṭiḥ syāt iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
aśrapratigraheṣṭiḥ laukike aśrapratigrahe aśradāne vā iti pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtreṇa prāptaṃ vāśabdena pariharan siddhānta- māha |
'vakṣṇo vā etaṃ gṛhṇāti' ityādiḥ arthavādaḥ; iṣṭipraśaṃsārthavādaḥ; na tu doṣanirghātārthavādaḥ |
kutaḥ ? anupātāt 'sa etaṃ varuṇapāśāmuñcati' iti vākya- śeṣasya mukhyārthe samāveśāsaṃbhavāt |
nahi vastutaḥ aśva- pratigrahāt varuṇagrahasya jaloderūpasya prāptāḥ prāpti- rbhavati |
tataśca aśrapratigrahān jaloderasya anupapātāt aprāpteḥ arthavāda eva saḥ iṣṭipraśaṃsārthaḥ |
tasmādetoḥ yacce vaidike aśrapratigrahe vidhivalāt prāyaścitteḥ pratīyate, na laukike aśrapratigrahe |
ke. 'doṣātu lililekhike syāt' ityadhikaraṇe aśra- pratigraheṣṭiḥ aśrapratigrahataḥ karmaṇaḥ aṅgam, na svatantra- miti sthitam |
doṣārthastvatanyārthavādakalpam pratiṣedho yathā 'mithyāmidhāsane doṣo hiḥ samo bhūtavādinaḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 30. doṣanirghātārtha aniyatanimittakaṃ naimittikaṃ vaidikaṃ karma yathā 'yo'māvāsyāṃ paurṇamāsīṃ vā''tipātet, agnaye pathikṛte'ṣṭakapālaṃ nirvapet' iti |
'yo'māvāsyāṃ paurṇamāsīṃ vā''tipātet vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet' iti ca |
bāla. pṛ. 85. doṣanirghātārtha: naimittikaḥ kartavyaḥ adhikāravidhiḥ dvividhaḥ : vihitatikramanimittakaḥ niṣiddhācaraṇanimittaka- ceti |
doṣṇā: (doṣ-śabdasya doṣn ādeśaḥ :) pūrvā- rdhadameye'vati, gudasya madhyataḥ, śroṇyā avanataḥ ' iti aniyaśāśeṣeṣvadyaiḥ sviṣṭakṛt payo |
te dharmāḥ prātardohasyāpi bhavanti, na veti vicāre, anena sūtreṇa pūrvapakṣopanyāsaḥ kriyate |
śṛtaṃ prātardohaṃ payaḥ dohadharmāḥ asaṃyuktāṃ syāt saṃyuktaṃ na syāt |
kutaḥ ? dohayoḥ dvayoḥ yau dvau kālau tayorbhedāt |
dharmāṇāṃ ca sāyaṃdohasamīpe eva ca pāṭhāt |
'aindraṃ dadhi amāvāsyāyām, aindraṃ payo'- māvāsyāyām' iti ubhayaṃ sāṅgaṃ amāvāsyāyāṃ prakaraṇā- vibhāgena coditam |
tadidaṃ kālaśāstraṃ tatsaṃyuktasya umayapradhānasaṃyuktasya śākhātarādereva, na tu sāyaṃdoha- saṃyuktasya |
dohadharmāḥ sāyaṃdohasya krame 'āmnātā iti vaktuṃ na śakyate |
atra subodhinyām 'aindraṃ dadhi' ityādikāvyaṃ tatsaṃyuktasya pradhānasyaiva iti vyākhyātam |
tatsaṃyuktasya dadhigādhasaṃyuktasya dharmajātasya anuṣṭhāne pūrvaidhuḥ kālasya vidhāyakaṃ iti tatrānu- ṣṭhānam, na tu tāvatā dadhimātrārthatā iti kutūhale vyākhyātam |
ke. darśo sāyaṃdohadorayorhavirnāśe'pi pañcaśarāva odanaḥ prāyaścittam |
vi. 6|1|46. dohādhikāre agnihotraprakaraṇasye 'vatsamālameta' iti na yāgavidhiḥ kintu sparśamātravidhiḥ |
dohadharmāḥ śākhātaraṇam, gavāṃ prasthāpanam, go- prastāvanam, godohanaṃ ityevamādayaḥ |
bhā. 3|6|8|28, dohadharmāḥ sāyaṃdohadharmāḥ, na kevalaṃ sāyaṃ- dohārthāḥ |
3|6|8|28-29. dohanaṃ na tisṛṇāmeva gavām, kintu svagṛha- sthitasarvāsāmeva kārye havirbhūyasvārthe sāṃnāyyaviṣaye vatsāpākaraṇam, tadaṅgaṃ palāśaśākhāharaṇam |
bhā. pṛ. 111. 12|2|14|34. dyāvāpṛthivyasra abhī- draviḍānāṃ rājyādhikārayogyeṣṣu kṣatriyeṣu (rājan ṣomīyavikṛtitvaṃ pañcākṣaratvasāmyāt |
bāla. pṛ. 120. śabdasya ) prayogo na virodhyate |
vā. 2|3|2|3 dyāvāpṛthivyasa jaghanyatvena mukhyasyāccandrāmādeḥ pṛ. 584. prasūnabarhirniyamo virodhābhāvāt |
draviḍasañcāriṇaḥ praṇāmaṃ 'dyāvāpṛthivyāṃ dhenumālabheta, māsaṃta vastam, kurvantaḥ gotrapravādikaṃ sarve paṭhanti, tena praṇāmo dīrgho aindramṛṣabham |
atra loke 'drāviḍi prāṇāyāmaḥ' iti paṭhanti, vatsaśabdo bālam, ṛṣabhaśabdaḥ pumāṃsam |
ataste mukhya- draviḍaprasiddhestu mlecchaprasiddhatvena asādhaka- vṛttyā gāṃ viśiṣyantaḥ chāgaṃ bādhante |

vi. 10|2|29. dravyaṃ evaṃ viśiṣṭaśaktyupetaṃ vyāpāraśabdavācyaṃ dyāvāpṛthivyānurodhena aindrāmavaiśvadevayoḥ vaiśva- bhavati ityanena nyāyena kriyā''tmanoḥ atyantamedā- devatantrasya na niyamaḥ āgrayaṇe |
bhāvena ātmasamavetasya apūrvasya kriyātaḥ atyantamedā- 35-37. bhāvāt sādhyasādhanasaṃbandhopādādakatvaṃ saṃbhavati |
su. dyāvāpṛthivyādyekakapāleṣu sakṛdeva hotavyam, pṛ. 605. dravyaṃ kriyārtham, yadi prayojanavatī kriyā nāvadāttadharmaḥ |
tasyāḥ nirvṛtteḥ dravyā- cāturmāsyavaiśvadevisya vidhvantasya āgrayaṇate hate na bhavati iti tannirvṛttaye dravyameṣitavyaṃ bhavati |
dyāvāpṛthivyaikakapāle varuṇapraghāsādyaikakapāle ca tasmāt kriyārthe dravyam |
mā. 7|3|10|26-27. bhā. 2|3|3. oṃ gumbādyadhikaraṇanyāyena (2|3|12 brasū.) dravyaṃ cotpattisaṃyogāt tadarthameva codyeta |
ātmaśabdasya paramātmanyeva mukhyatvaṃ iti na ca vācyam |
( gumbādyadhikaraṇe 'yasmin dyauḥ pṛthivī cāntarikṣam' darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'spyaśca kapālāni ca' ityādinā daśa itimantragata ātmaśabdaḥ paramātmavācakaḥ iti yajñāyudhāni samāmnātāni |
kiṃ yena dyotakaḥ upasargaḥ ityekaḥ pakṣaḥ, vācaka ityaparaḥ |
iha śakyate ebhiḥ kartuṃ tabhaitasmai padārthāya etāni bāla. pṛ. 41. upayojyāni, uta yat yena saṃyuktaṃ tameva iti dyauḥ arthaḥ prādīnāmupasargāṇām |
su. pṛ. vicāre yat śakyate tasmi iti pūrvapakṣe siddhāntamāha |
vi. nādidharmavat spyādi dravya yena saṃyuktaṃ tadarthameva codyeta 1|4|20. dravyadravyāṇāṃ loke'pi kacit pānādau codanayā pratīyate |
ityādiṣu utpattividhavākyeṣu udvananādi kāryaviśeṣeṇa 314 pṛ. 323. dravyadravyādikaṃ suvādinā avadāta- saṃyogasya śravaṇāt |
dravya tyāgāṅgabhūtatvāt uddeśāṅgabhūtatvā'pekṣayā dravyāṇi tvaviśepeṇārthakyāt pradīyeran |
vā. 2|3|124 pṛ. 616, dravyaṃ tuśabdaḥ pūrvādhikaraṇoktaprajāpatitratebhyaḥ spyādi- prajñānocarakālamapi kriyāyāṃ vyāpyate |
3|1|6|12 pṛ. 692, 'spyaśca kapālāni ca' ityādivākyoktāni yajñāyudhāni dravyaṃ yat indravāyubhyāṃ dātavyamiti saṃkalpitam, nāma spyādīni dravyāṇi aviśeṣeṇa śrutāni |
aṅgatvena tasya tyaktaprāyatvāt anīśo yajamānaḥ kathamiva vakṣyati pradhānatvena vā viśeṣeṇa naitāni śrutāni |
2|2|6|19 pṛ. 520. dravyaṃ iti hi teṣāṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ vākye śrutam |
tathātve tu vyaktiḥ iti paryāya eva |
bāla. dravyaṃ sākṣāt etāni uddanādyudhāni vaktavyaṃ syāt |
śeṣeṇa śrutāni dravyāṇi vākyavadheyarthaprāptyā pradīyeran 6|12 pṛ. 695. dravyaṃ sākṣāddhi kriyāṃ pratyupakaroti, agnau pradeyadravyāṇyetāni syuḥ |
bhā. 3|1|6|12 pṛ. 699. yajñopasthityabhāvāt mā bhūvan katvarthāni |
spyādīni dravyaṃ spyakapāladim, tasya śeṣatvaṃ saṃbhavati |
tasmāt vi. 3|1|3. dravyaṃ hi pratyakṣaṃ cākṣuṣameva iti pradeyānīti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
darśanasparśanābhyāṃ hi guṇatyāgenāpi dravya- svena tvarthena saṃvandho dravyāṇāṃ pṛthagarthatvāt; grahaṇe anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ dravyasyāpi pratyakṣatā bhavati |
ṛju. pṛ. 253. dravyaṃ hi svabhāvata eva śeṣabhūtam |
tuśabdaḥ pūrva- vā. 3|1|3. kārye hi pravartamānaṃ dravyaṃ saṃskāraṃ pakṣavyāvṛttyarthaḥ |
dravyāṇāṃ spyādīnāṃ svena arthena sveyena gṛhṇā
athavā arthakarmaśabdena paridhānīyaṃ nāma anyeṣtikarma ādyam |
sphyādīnāṃ pradeyatve tu pretasya yajamānasya yajñapātrairdehanaṃ na syāt, tasmāt na tāni pradeyāni |

'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta', 'jyoti- ṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta', 'citrayā yajeta paśukāmaḥ' ityādivacane dravyāṇāṃ svargasādhanabhāvarūpe saṃba- ndhūyamāṇe dravyāṇāṃ karmajananasāmarthyāt guṇatvena abhi- saṃbandhaḥ syāt |
tathā ca svargadidvayaṃ sādhanam, yāga pradhānam |
... ‘svargakāmo yajeta’ ityuktam, tatra yāgaḥ pradhānaṃ svargo guṇaḥ |
svargaśabdaḥ sukhasādhanaparaḥ, dravyaṃ kriyāsādhanam, iti yāgaḥ sādhyaḥ, svargaḥ tatsādhanaṃ iti pūrvapakṣe siddhāntasūtram |
tādaryyāt yāgasya svargatvāt yāga eva svargasya sādhakaḥ |
pratyarthaṃ cābhisaṃyogāt karmato hyabhisaṃbandha- stasmāt karmopadeśaḥ syāt |
yāgaḥ svargārthaḥ, na tu svargo yāgārthaḥ |
ataḥ svargaḥ pradhānaṃ karma guṇaḥ, iti siddhānte ‘yajeta ityekapadaśrutyā yāgasya bhāgyatvena svargakāmapadopāttasya na bhāgyatvam’ iti śaṅkā |
arthe prati svargādikaṃ prati vidheḥ abhisaṃyogāt anvayāt, karmataḥ hi karmaṇā eva sādhanatvena abhisaṃbandhaḥ anvayaḥ |
tasmāt hetoḥ : ‘yajeta svargakāmaḥ’ ityatra svargādisādhanatvena karmopadeśaḥ karma eva yāgādeḥ upa- deśaḥ syāt |
tathā ca prītirūpasya svargasya bhāgyatvam, yāgādeśca guṇatvaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
evaṃ ca phalabhoga- saṃbhavena karmakartuḥ adhikāro'sti iti adhikārādhyāya ārambhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ |

yathā- ‘spyenodanti’, ‘kapāleṣu śrapayati’, ‘agnihotrahavaṇyā havīṃṣi nirvapati’, ‘śūrpeṇa vivanakti’, ‘kṛṣṇajinamakṣatādūlūkhalasthā- vastunāti’, ‘śamyāyāṃ dṛṣadupadadhati’, ‘ulūkhala- musalābhyāmavahanti’, ‘dṛṣadupalasyāṃ pinaṣṭi’ iti |
\ dravyāṇāṃ tu kriyāṇāṃ saṃskāraḥ ṛtudharmaḥ syāt |
agnihotre ‘payo vrataṃ brāhmaṇasya, yavāgū rājanyasya, āmiṣā vaiśyasya’ iti śrutam |
idaṃ vrataṃ puruṣārthaṃ ṛtvarthaṃ veti saṃśaye vākyena viniyuktatvāt puruṣārthe iti utsṛṣṭaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ tuśabdena nirasya siddhāntayati |
kriyārthānāṃ ṛtvarthānāṃ ṛtugatānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ brāhmaṇādirūpāṇāṃ idaṃ vrataṃ saṃskāraḥ syāt śarīradhāraṇārthaḥ balakaraṇārthaśca |
tathā ca ṛtugata- puruṣadvārā ṛtudharmaḥ syāt |
payoyavāgvāmiṣvāḥ dīkṣitānāṃ yajñe brāhmaṇarājanyavaiśyānāṃ krameṇa vratāni |
sa ca ṛtudharmaḥ na kevalapuruṣadharma iti siddhāntā ukte, tarhi puruṣasaṃyogaḥ ‘payo vrataṃ brāhmaṇasya’ ityādinā kimarthaṃ uktaḥ ? ityāśaṅkāyām uttaramāha |
brāhmaṇarājanyavaiśyakartṛkānāṃ prayogāṇāṃ pṛthakatvāt vrata- vyavasthātheṃ puruṣasaṃyoga uktaḥ |
brāhmaṇakartṛkasya abhihotrasya aṅgaṃ vrataṃ payaḥ, rājanyakartṛkasya yavāgūḥ, vaiśyakartṛkasya āmiṣā iti |
evaṃ prayogāṇāṃ pṛthakatvāt tatkartṛkatvaṃ agnihotre vrataṃ vyavasthitaṃ vyavasthitaṃ syāt iti puruṣa- saṃyoga uktaḥ |
ke. \ dravyāṇāṃ (syādiraḥ lavaḥ, parṇamayī juhūḥ, āśvatthī upabhṛt, vaikaṅkatī dhruvā i0) na phalaprayuktatvam |
bhā. 4|3|1|9-4, \ dravyāṇāṃ yeṣāmanagatottanāṃ bhāva eva lakṣyate, teṣāmapi keṣāṃcit anityatā gamyate, yeṣāṃ vināśakāraṇamupalabhyate yathā abhinavaṃ paṭaṃ dṛṣṭvā |
yathā homaḥ kriyātmakatvāt kimityapekṣamāṇaḥ pradhānakathambhāvena itthaṃnugrāhakatavena gṛhyate, nevaṃ dravyam |
\ dravye phalaśrutiḥ ‘yasya parṇamayī juhūrbhavati na sa pāpaṃ ślokaṃ śṛṇoti’ iti |
\ śrute dravye apacarati pratinidhimupādāya prayoktavyaṃ iti sthitam |
\ dravyeṣbārambhāmitvādarthe vikārasāmarthyam (10|4|14|29) (dravyeṣbārambhāmi- tvādarthevikāre sāmarthyam) ityanena ārambhameva svarūpeṇa dravyeṣu kriyāgāmitvāt vikārasahitatvapi śabdasya
dravyeṣu arthe sāmarthyamasti iti vaiṣamyaṃ vadatā dravyeṣu artharūpeṇa karmaṇi samanvāyābhyupagamāt vidhitaśabda- prayoganiyamo nāstītyarthaḥ |
tathā ‘somāraudraṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapecchuklānāṃ brīhīṇāṃ brahmavarcasakāmaḥ’ tathā ‘naiṛtaṃ caruṃ nirvapetkṛṣṇānāṃ brīhīṇām’ iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ śvetādibhirvidhīyate, utaanudyate iti |
vidhivat, pakṣe prāptasya varṇasya niyamārthaḥ iti |
\ dravyeṣu yajato ca yaḥ saṃskāraḥ so'pūrvaprayuktaḥ |
yajatedravyāṇāṃ ca tadīyatvena dharmairabhisambandho na svena ātmanā |
tatra samāmananti ‘spyaśca kapālāni ca agnihotrahavaṇī ca śūrpaṃ ca kṛṣṇā- jinaṃ ca śamyā ca ulūkhalaṃ ca musalaṃ ca dṛṣadupalā ca, etāni vai daśa yajñāyudhāni’ iti |
yo iha śakyate ebhiḥ kartum, tasmetasmai padārthā etāni samāmnātāni, uta yat yena saṃyukt tasmai eveti kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? yat yena saṃyukt iti |

tat yadi pūrvo vidhiḥ, tataḥ sākṣāt yāga- sambandhe caturthādhikaraṇena (3|1|4) nyāyatirte sapta- daśāratnavat ānarthakyāt tadanve've avataranti aṅgatvāviśeṣāt yathāsāmarthyaṃ sarvārthāni iti vijñāyante |
atha punaḥ uddanādisaṃyuktā eva viṣayaḥ, itaro'nuvādaḥ, tataḥ pūrvādhikaraṇanyāyenaiva yathāsaṃyogaṃ vyavastheti |
kiṃ prāptam ? apūrvabhedasaṃbandhābhāvāt dṛṣṭārthatvāviśeṣācca yathāsāmarthyaṃ viniyogaḥ |
evaṃ yajñāyudhasaṃyuktā vidhayo bhūtvā artha- vanto bhaviṣyanti |
bahutvavacanaṃ ca (bhāṣyasthaṃ) vidheyārtha- śabdabāhulyābhiprāyam (vidheyārthaśabdānāṃ spaṣṭaśca kapālāni ca' ityādīnāṃ bāhulyam |
) itarathā tu eka- vākyatvāt eka eva vidhiḥ |
'etāni vai daśa yajñāyudhāni iti vaiśabdasaṃyogāt asyānuvādarūpam |
na cātra bhāvanāvano vidhāyako'sti, yo viniyuñjīta vidadhyādvā iti |
bahutrāṇi ca vākyāni tvapye anarthakāni bhaveyuḥ |
sākṣācca etāni svāmidhānaiḥ uddanādiṣveva viniyujyante, parokṣaṣṭyā yajñāyudhavākye |
yajñaśabdasya aṅgalakṣaṇā'rthatvāt āyudha- śabdasya ca yuddhasādhanavacanasya kriyāntarāṇeṣu aupa- cārikatvāt |
nahi atra 'vājapeyasya' itivat saṃbandhamātrāmidhāyinī yajñaśabdāt parā ṣaṣṭhī dṛśyate |
satyapi ca ānarthakyāttadaṅgatvāvaraṇe sāmānyaśāstrāṇi viśeṣaśākhaiḥ uddanādisaṃyuktaiḥ upasaṃhiyamāṇāni na karmāntareḥ saṃbadhyante |
tasmāt uddanādāvevāprāpitānāṃ sarvā yāhaśaṃ vayaṃ yajñāyudhaṃ paśyāmaḥ, tādṛśam 'etāni vai daśa' ityanenānudyate |
yattu apūrvabhedaḥ prayojako nāstīti, tatra brūmaḥ |
tat yathā atha- ghātādayaḥ samānāpūrvanibandheneṣvapi sugādiṣu kārakāntara- tvāt na kriyante |
tasmāt eteṣāmapi yathāsaṃyogameva viniyoga iti siddham |
' soma- uddanādivākyasya vidhāyakatvābhāvāt mīmāṃsādīnāmavaghātādisaṃyogavat iha saṃyogāsatvāt na vyavasthāsthitiḥ |
sūtrārthastu- dravyamapi yena saṃyuktaṃ tadarthameva upapadyate 'spyenodanti' iti utpattau saṃyogāt iti |
vi- 'dravyasya spaṣṭaphalādeḥ sāṃkarye vā vyava- sthitiḥ |

' bhāṭṭa- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'spyaśca kapālāni ca' iti daśa dravyāṇyanukramya 'etāni vai daśa yajñāyudhāni' iti śrutena vākyena daśānamapi dravyāṇāṃ yajñasādhanatvena vidhānāt, upapattiścapuroḍāśāvarodhena ca sākṣādyāga- sādhanatvāyogān aṅgeṣu avatārāt prakṛtāpūrvasādhanī- bhūtadravyasākāṅkṣakriyatvāvacchinnena dravyāṇi vidhīyante 'spyenodanti' ityādiṣvaviniyogāt avyutpannānuvādaḥ |
iti prāpte, tenatena pratyakṣa- vidhinā tṛtīyāśrutihakṛtena spyādīnāṃ viśiṣyavini- yogāt yajñāyudhavākyameva ekamaśrutavidhikaṃ vaiśabdopa- baddhamanuvādakam, bahūnāmanvādānāṃ caiyarthyāt |
asya ca 'yajñāyudhāni saṃbharati' ityetadvidhyarthavādatvena sārtha- katvāt |
tasmāt uddananamātrajanyavyāpārakṛtāpūrva- sādhanatvāśrayameva uddananapadena lakṣayitvā taduddeśenaiva spyādividhiḥ |
dravyāntaraṃ astīti tatra gamyate, yatraikasmin- vayave gṛhītvā kṛṣyamāṇe kṛtsnaḥ kṛṣyate |
nahi abade kāṣṭhapullake kāṣṭhaṃ ekasminnākṛṣyamāṇe kāṣṭhāntarāṇi kṛṣyante |
yatra hi parasparavyatiṣaṅgajanitā ekā buddhi- rbhavati, nāvayavabuddhirdṛśyate, nāpi kenacidanumānenānu- mīyate tatra dravyāntaraṃ jātamityucyate |
yatra ekasminnavayave kṛṣyamāṇe kṛtsno'vayavī ākṛṣyate tatra yathādṛṣṭam |
yatraikasmin kṛṣyamāṇe ekaḥ kṛṣyate, tatrāpi yathādṛṣṭam |

rājasūye nānābījeṣṭau ekasmin bīje avahananasya kṛtārthatvāt tuṣavimokṣasya arthasya niṣpāditatvāt dvitīyadīvīje tasya avahananasya tuṣavimokārya punaḥ- prayogāt, mantrasya ca tadguṇatvāt avahananaśeṣatvāt tasyāpi punaḥprayogaḥ syāt |
