kiṃ tarhi ? prākṛtī saṃkhyā prākṛtaṃ ca dravyamanīyate |
dup. 12|1|14 pṛ. 2221. dravyabhede'pi karma na bhidyate ||
sa ca puroḍāśo brīhimayaḥ kartavya iti śrūyate |
tatraita- cintyate yadi nīvāramayena puroḍāśena yāgaḥ kriyeta, kiṃ sa eva yāgaḥ syāt utānya iti |
athavā 'vyatirekād rūpaśabdāvibhāgācca gotva- vadvaikamyaṃ syānnāmadheyaṃ ca sattvavat |
yadā kriyā bhavati calanaṃ patanaṃ vā, tadā'pi tāvāneva so'rthaḥ |
na ca kaścit tatra vyati- rikto viśeṣo dīno vā |
bhinnameva vayāmāśrayaṃ pratijānīmahe, na tu tabhedādāśritasya bhedaḥ, anyatvāt |
na hi khaji vāsi vā minne tabhedāt puruṣabhedo gamyate |
so'pi tasya ātmā bhinna iti cet, naitadevam |
nanu ayameva viśeṣaḥ, yat eko vinaṣṭaḥ eko vartate |
prāgasya upa- lambhanāt sattve pramāṇaṃ nāsti |
na ca pratyabhijñāyate (tadravyatiriktā, ityadhikaṃ kacit) medādupalambhanāt (vinaṣṭasya rūpāt medena sthirasya rūpāpalambhanāt ityarthaḥ |
) kathaṃ tarhi calatīti pratyaya iti cet, ucyate |
) tena gataḥ iti cocyate, āgataḥ iti cocyate |
yo'pi tu asāvanyaḥ, so'pi yajatiśabdāt vācya eva |
tasmāt yo'pi nīvārairyagaṃ kuryāt, tenāpi coditameva kṛtam |
coditaṃ ca kurvataḥ īpsitaṃ bhavati, nāpūrvakṛtam |
darśa iti vā pūrṇamāsa iti vā asyaiva sāmānyaṃ nāmadheyam, na vyaktīnām |
pūrvādhikaraṇaṃ tu yathā- śaktiprayogasyaiva atiprasaṅganidhirathayathā śeṣabhūtam |
darśapūrṇamāsau yathā kālāntaradeśāntarapuruṣāntareṣu kriyamāṇau nāti- ricyate, na (cāpi) nūnau bhavataḥ |
rūpāvibhāgaṃ vivṛṇoti—) na ca dravyāntare'pi ‘tāveva darśapūrṇamāsau’ ityasya pratyayasya pratyakṣāvagatasya bādho'sti, śabdāntarādīnām (bheda- kāraṇānām) abhāvāt |
nahi nīvāraiḥ kriyamāṇasya śabdāntarādi ( - nimitto - ) bhedaḥ avatarati, yena ‘tadevavedam’ iti (pratyabhijñā - ) pratyayo bādhyate |
(śabdāvibhāgaṃ vivṛṇoti—) dravyāntare'pi ca kriya- māṇasya (kriyamāṇe iti mudritaḥ pāṭhaḥ |
yathā naiva caitrīprayogāt vaiśākhī- prayogo bhidyate |
tena (medābhāvena) tau darśapūrṇamāsā- bhidheyatāṃ na jahīta |
tasyaiva sāmānyaṃ phale cocyate iti cet, tadayuktam |
nahi śāstrādivat (śāstrādimiva gotvam ) sāmānyaṃ atrābhivyajyamāna- mupalabhyate (tasmānna sāmānyaṃ phale vidhīyate) kiṃ tarhi ? ṣaṭ āgneyādayo vyaktiviśeṣāḥ utpannāḥ phale vidhīyante |
śā— ataḥ paraṃ atiprasaṅganirākaraṇena naimittike sthāpitasya yathāśaktiprayogasya śeṣatvena pratinidhirvicārāḥ prastoṣyante |
tatra ‘dravya- syaiva kriyā nāma rūpaṃ nārthāntaraṃ tataḥ |
tadātmanaśca tadbhede na bhaved bhinnatā katham ||
soma— sūtrārthastu— kriyāṇāṃ dravyātirekāta dravyāntare vibhāgo medaḥ syāditi |
’ bhāṭṭa— evaṃ yathāśakyupapanne nirūpite tacchepa- -tvena pratinidhivicāre kartavye upodghātatvedaṃ vicāryate |

tatra mūle tāvat dravyasya kriyāto'nyatamedābhāvāt dravya- mede karmamedāpatteḥ na nīvārādināne vihitakriyāsiddhi- riti pūrvapakṣe atyantamedābhede'pi atyantamedāsyāpi abhāvāt kartṛdeśakālādidava dravyabhede'pi tadevaiva calanaṃ yajanamityādipratyabhijñāvatvāt kriyaivopapatteḥ pratinidhi- -pādāne'pi na kṣatiḥ |
tatra ca jagatītalavartinī ekaiva karmavyaktiḥ abhivyaktikāmātra tu midyate |
athavā śabdā- ntarādipramāṇairaiva vyaklibhedaḥ, dravyadeśakālakartavyatvā- dimistu tasyā eva vyakteramidyamedāmātram |
śabdāntarādipramāṇaiśca āgneya- tvādijātaya eva bhidyante iti siddhāntitam |
tat dravyāśritatve'pi kriyāyāstadbhede vaijātyasya śaṅkitumaśakyatvāt vyaktyaikyasiddhānte cāpūrvapahvā- patteḥ |
ata evaṃ vicāro vācyaḥ— satyapi śabdāntarādi- pramāṇaiḥ āgneyatvādijātyai vigheyatvāvacchedakavijātīya- yāgatvāvacchinnaṃ prati brīhyādineva kāraṇatvāvagateḥ |
iti prāpte, satyapi tajjātyavacchinne prati tatrādinā kāraṇatve, na tasya pratyeke tajjātyabhi- vyañjakatvam, brīhitvādinā karmāntare'pi kāraṇatvena vyabhi- cārāt |
ataśca brīhyādi- nīvārāyupādāne'pi vijātīyayāgatvāpūrvatvaphalatvāvacchi- jāyate eva |
phalaṃ paraṃ nitye eva tāratamyena jāyate kāmye tu ārambhoracamaśaktasya śiṣṭavigarhaṇadoṣaparihārāya samāpane'pi na phalotpattiḥ |
karaṇe phalāntarā bhāvāt nāpūrvoparicarita iti kecit |
naimittikāviśeṣān tatrāpi pāpasyakalpane'pi tatrāpi tāratamyamiti dhyeyam maṇḍana— ‘karma nānyat pratinidhiḥ |
yathaikena ghaṃṭe udakāharaṇādikriyāṃ yugapadeko na karoti evaṃ prakṛte'pi bodhyamiti pratyāhārādihe iti |
evaṃ dānakāle saṃvādaḥ : ‘gharme cāgaṃ ca kāme ca nātiricyate’ iti bhāṣyam |
ke. dravyavikāraṃ tu pūrvavadarthakarma syāt tvatha vikalpe niyamaḥ pradhānatvāt |
dravyavikāraṃ dravyasya paśoḥ vikāraḥ avayavaḥ jāghanī yasmin tat dravyavikāraṃ panīsaṃyojanaṃ karma pūrvavat pūrvasmin iva prakṛtau darśapūrṇamāsayorvi arthakarma syāt na pratipatti karmaṃ |
evaṃ ca tathā prakṛtitva vikalpe ājyena saha jāghanyāḥ vikalpe prāpte 'jāghanyā patnīḥ saṃyojayanti' iti agnīṣomīye paśau punaḥśrutyā jāghanyāḥ niyamaḥ syāt |
tasmāt jāghanyā patnīḥ saṃyojanaṃ agnīṣomīye paśiva paśupaṇe'pi arthakarma |
arthakarmaṇi ca ekārthanāṃ jāghanīnāṃ samuccaya na yuktaḥ |
tasmāt paśupaṇe patnīsaṃyājeṣu jāghanīnāṃ vikalpaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
dravyatve'pi samuccayau, dravyasya karmanippatteḥ, pratipaśu karmabhedādevaṃ sati yathāprakṛti ||
patnīsaṃyāje karmaṇi jāghanī havirdravyam, iti jāghanī guṇabhūtā |
evaṃ paśugaṇe jāghanīnāṃ dravyatve'pi guṇatve'pi samuccayaḥ syāt |
dravyasya jāghanyāḥ karmanippatteḥ karmaṇā viśasanane niṣpatteḥ utpannatvāt prayojanāpekṣāyāṃ patnīsaṃyojanaṃ prayojanam |
paśupaṇe ca pratipaśu karmeṇa medāt tasyatasya paśoḥ viśasanena niṣpannā jāghanī patnīsaṃyājārthā syāt |
evaṃ sati yathāprakṛti agnīṣomīyapaśuvat kṛtaṃ bhaviṣyati |
tasmāt arthakarmatve'pi jāghanīnāṃ samuccayaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |

viśasanakarme niṣpannatvāt cet jāghanīnāṃ samuccayaḥ, tadā 'puroḍāśakapālena tuṣānupavati' iti prayogakarmaṇā kapālaṃ prayujyate tasmāpi tuṣopavanaṃ prayojanaṃ bhavitumarhati, iti puroḍāśagaṇe pratipuroḍāśaṃ kapālena tuṣopavanaṃ kartavyaṃ prāpnoti |
tatra yadi kapāle na samuccayaḥ, tarhi jāghanyāmapi māstu |
ākṣepaṃ ca pūrvapakṣaṃ cobhayaṃ pratipakṣiti siddhāntī |
tathā ca tuṣopavanārthaṃ kapālānāmupatterabhāvāt na teṣāṃ samuccayaḥ |
evaṃ ca jāghanīṣu viśasanakarmaṇaḥ parārthatvāt chadanādi niṣpannārthatvāt, tathā ca jāghanīrthe viśasanābhāvāt tāsāmanupannatvāt na jāghanīnāṃ samuccayaḥ |
jāghanyā patnīsaṃyājanaṃ na arthakarma, pratipattistu eṣā |
paśunā yāge nirvartite śeṣabhūtā jāghanī patnīsaṃyājeṣu nikṣipyate |
śrute'pi 'śrute carum', 'dadhiśrutam' iti śrute'pi dadhanyapi ca pratipattiḥ syāt |
tayoḥ candrodaye nimittena viṣṇuṃ śipiviṣṭaṃ prati gamanam |
yadi tadaniṣṭam, tadā jāghanyāḥ paśupayāgapūrvakātve'pi patnīsaṃyājeṣu na pratipattivam |
vikalpe tvarthakarma niyamapradhānatvācchepe ca karma-kāryasamavāyāt, tasmāt tenārthakarma syāt ||
atra sūtre dvau vibhāgau, tatra 'vikalpe tu' ityādinā 'pratipattistu śeṣatvāt' (14 sū.) ityasya nirāsaḥ |
sā kasyacit ekajātīyasya syāt iti pañcamaḥ pakṣa uktaḥ|
śabdārthaḥ śabdārthasya pratyayaḥ ekajātīyasyaiva bhavati asati bādhake|
lokavat yathā loke 'śatamābhyāṃ dīyatām' ityukte ekajātīyānāṃ śataṃ pratīyate na bhinna- jātīyānāṃ tadvat|
iyaṃ saṃkhyā kasyacit ekajātīyasya iti pūrvasūtrā- bhyāmavagatam|
ekajātīyasyāpi kiṃ paśūnām, uta dhānyānāṃ iti vicāre āditaḥ ṣaṣṭhaṃ pakṣamāha|
sā dvādaśādhikaśatasaṃkhyā gavādīnāṃ paśūnāṃ syāt, na tu vrīhādīnāṃ dhānyajānām|
svābhāvikene vibhāgena paśvaḥ vyavahāreṣu saṃkhyāyante pañcabhiraśvaiḥ prītaḥ, pañcabhirgobhiḥ krītaḥ|
tasmāt sā saṃkhyā paśūnāṃ syāt, na dhānyānām|
atha paśūnāmapi kasya paśuviśeṣasya saṃkhyā iti vicāre, āditaḥ saptamaṃ pakṣamāha|
aviśeṣāt viśeṣasya anuktatvāt aniyamaḥ syāt, gavāṃ vā aśvānāṃ vā ityādiḥ|
saptamaṃ pakṣaṃ sūtreṇa prāptaṃ vāśabdena nirasyan siddhānta- māha|
tasmāt gavāmeva dvādaśaśatasaṃkhyā pratyetavyā iti siddhāntaḥ|
'gauśca aśvaśca aśvataraśca' ityādidikṣāvākye ādau gavāmeva pratyayo jñānaṃ bhavati|
tasya tyāge kāraṇābhāvāt gavāmeva ' ' saṃkhyā pratyetavyā|
'tāṃ vā etāṃ śabalīṃ mamānanti iḍe rane
havye kāmye candre jyotiriti sarasvatī mahi viśruti etā te andhe nāmāni devebhyo mā sukṛtaṃ kṛtāt' iti gavāmetāni nāmāni|
sahasratamaṃ ca dakṣiṇāmevamāha etāni te nāmānīti|
ke. dravyaviśeṣā dvaite lī pumān napuṃsakamiti|
'vrīhīn prokṣati' iti prokṣaṇaṃ kiṃ vrīhirūpadravya- svarūpārtham, kiṃvā apūrvasādhanatvapratyuktam|
tathā 'trīn paridhīn, tisraḥ samidhaḥ' iti mantraḥ kiṃ paridhimātra- saṃkhyārthaḥ, uta apūrvasādhanatvārthaḥ|
tathā 'śūrpeṇa juhoti, tena hyannaṃ kriyate' iti homaḥ kiṃ annakaraṇa- saṃskārārthaḥ, kiṃvā apūrvārthaḥ|
tathā 'caturhotrā paurṇa- māsīmabhijuhot, pañcahotrā amāvāsyām' iti abhi- marśanaṃ kiṃ paurṇamāsyādimadravyasvarūpārtham, kiṃvā tadu- bhayāpārtham|
dravyaṃ vrīhādi ca, saṃkhyā paridhyādigatatritvādiḥ, śūrpagatāhetutvam, paurṇamāsyādigatasamudāyaśca eṣāṃ samāhāraḥ dravyasaṃkhyā- hetusamudāyaṃ prokṣaṇādeḥ prayojakaṃ syāt|
arthakārite ca dravyeṇa na vyavasthā syāt|
dravyasaṃkhyāhetusamudāyaṃ prokṣaṇādīnāṃ prayojakaṃ iti pūrvapakṣa uktaḥ|
prokṣaṇādidharme abhyupagamyamāne dravyeṇa vyavasthā na syāt|
dravyeṇa vyavasthā nāma maitrāvaruṇasyaiva payasā śrayaṇam, manthigrahasya saktubhireva śrayaṇam, ityādi|
apūrvaprayuktatve tu manthigrahasya saktubhiḥ payasā vā, maitrāvaruṇasya payasā saktubhirvā śrayaṇaṃ iti avyavasthā syāt, sarvatra apūrvasya sattvāt|
kiñca dravyeṇa vrīhādinaiva prokṣaṇādīnāṃ saṃbandhaḥ iti vyavasthā na syāt suvādiviṣaye prasajyeta|
tasmāt prokṣaṇādeḥ vrīhādidravyarūpameva prayojakaṃ iti dravyāntarādau nohi siddhiḥ|
prokṣaṇamantropādhimarśanānī krameṇa dravyasaṃkhyāhetu- samudāyaprayuktāni iti pūrvapakṣaṃ vyāvartayati vāśabdaḥ|
prokṣaṇādīnāṃ dravyādikaṃ na prayojanam, kintu arthaḥ|
itareṣāṃ dravyasaṃkhyādīnāṃ acodanā kartavyatayā na codanā|
arthe prati apūrve prati guṇabhūtā hote dravyādayaḥ|
yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā 'payasā maitrāvaruṇaṃ śriṇāti' iti payasā śrayaṇaṃ aindravāyavādāvapi prāpnoti apūrvaprayuktatve svīkṛte iti, tatrottaramāha|
apūrvatvāt maitrāvaruṇasaṃbandha- parvatvāt maitrāvaruṇasyāpūrvatvasya udedyatā'vacchedakatvāt vyavasthā syāt|
nahi maitrāvaruṇāpūrvatvaṃ grahāntarādyude'sti, yataḥ avyavasthā syāt|
prokṣaṇādidharmāṇāṃ vrīhidravyāprayuktatve svīkṛte doṣa- māha siddhāntī|
dharmasya prokṣaṇādeḥ tatprayuktatve vrīhi- dravyāprayuktatve svīkṛte sarvaviṣayatvaṃ syāt odanārtha
prokṣaṇādidharmasya vrīhyādidravyaprayuktatve odanādyartha- vrīhiṣvapi prokṣaṇaṃ prāpnuyāt iti yaduktaṃ siddhāntinaḥ tam|
tatayuktasya prakaraṇayuktasya yāgīyavrīhidravyasya prokṣaṇe svīkṛte sarvaviṣayatā doṣo na syāt|
aśrutitvāt yāgīyā eva vrīhayo nirvastavya iti nāsti śrutiḥ|
tādṛśānāṃ tu vrīhīṇāṃ devatārthatvena sucitavattvaṃ nirupyate|
tataśca udedyatā'vacchedakamatra na yāgīyavrīhiṣva kiṃtu vrīhisāmānyameveti prokṣaṇasya dravyaprayuktatve syādeva sarvaviṣayatvaṃ doṣaḥ|
prokṣaṇasya dravyaprayuktatve'pi sarvaviṣayatvaṃ na prāpnoti katham ? adhikārāt prakaraṇāt jñāsati adhvaryuḥ ime odanārthāḥ vrīhayaḥ, ime yāgārthā iti|
tatra ye yāgārthāḥ tān prokṣiṣyati iti na sarvaviṣayatvaprasaṅgaḥ|
pṛthak satāṃ yajñārthenābhisaṃbandhastasmāt yajñaḥ prayo- janam|
na kecit pṛthak karmārthā nāma nirvāpa- kāle|
tathā ca nirvāpakāle sarvaviṣayatvaṃ prāpnotyeva evaṃ tulyeṣu satsu vrīhiṣu adhikāraḥ prakāra nirvāpakāle nāsti|
pṛthak sata laukikakarmaṇyaḥ pṛthak kṛtānāṃ vrīhīṇāmeva yajñārthe-
yasmāt tulyeṣvadhikāre nāsti, saṃbandhaśca na coditaḥ, pṛthak kṛtānāmeva yajñā- yaina abhisaṃbandhaḥ, tasmāt prokṣaṇasya yajñaḥ apūrvameva prayojanaṃ na dravyasvarūpam |

'vrīhīn prokṣati' iti śrutvā dravyasaṃyuktaṃ prokṣaṇam, 'vrīn paridhīn' iti mantra- liṅgāt saṃkhyāsaṃyuktam, 'śūrpeṇa juhoti tena hyannaṃ ( hyannaṃ ) kriyate' itivākyāt hetusaṃyuktaṃ homam, 'caturhotrā paurṇamāsīmabhimṛśet' iti śrutvā āgneyādi- samudāyasaṃyuktaṃ mantraṃ codāhṛtya prokṣaṇādayo dravyādisarūpa- prayuktā apūrvaprayuktā vā iti sandehe śrutisaṃyogāt tadrūpa- lakṣitatvāt liṅgāt vākyasaṃyogācca dravyādisarūpaprayuktātvaṃ pūrvapakṣayitvā 'artho vā syāt prayojanamitareṣā- macodanārthasya guṇabhūtatvāt' ( 9|1|5|13 ) ityanena arthyamānamapūrva prayojanaṃ dravyādīnāmarthyamānamapūrva prati guṇabhūtatayā kartavyatvena acodanāt iti siddhānte bhāṣyakṛtā śrutyādigamyasvarūpānanyavirodhāt prākaraṇikā- pūrvānvayāyogamāśaṅkya ānarthakyabhayāt svarūpānvaya- vivakṣayā apūrvasādhanalakṣaṇayā vakṣyate |
su. pṛ. 1469. dravyasaṃkhyāhetusamudāyanyāya vā 'ityadhikaraṇanyāyena svarūpasaṃgato anarthakatvāt yadi jajñyamānaśabdena apūrvasādhanatvaṃ lakṣyate |
tanaiva 'vrīn paridhīn, tisraḥ samidhaḥ' iti mantram ( āmannati iti sarvatra anuṣaṅgaḥ ) |
cāturmāsyānāṃ dvitīye parvaṇi varuṇapraghāseṣu āmnāyate 'śūrpeṇa juhoti, tena hyannaṃ kriyate' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ dravyasaṃkhyāhetusamudāyaprayuktāḥ prokṣaṇādayo dharmāḥ, uta apūrvaprayuktā iti |
iha 'vrīhīn prokṣati' iti prakaraṇena apūrvaprayuktā syāt, vākyena dravyaprayuktā |
tasminnapi samabhivyāhāre dravyagatā dvitīyā vibhaktiḥ prokṣaṇasya dravyaprayuktā vadati |
tathā 'vrīn paridhīn' iti yat triṃśacchabdābhidheyam, tadiha mantrānnānasāmarthyāt vadita- vyamiti gamyate |
tathā hetunā dharmaḥ saṃyujyate vākyena 'śūrpeṇa juhoti' iti |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? yataḥ, tena annaṃ kriyate |
prakaraṇāt apūrvaprayuktā syāt yasmāt anena homena apūrve kriyate tasmādetat śūrpeṇa nirvartayitavyamiti |
prakaraṇāt vākyaṃ balīyaḥ, ataḥ prakaraṇaṃ bādhyate |
yenayena dravyeṇa darvipiṭharādinā'pi annaṃ kriyate, tenatena homeḥ kartavyaḥ ityevaṃ annaprakaraṇaṃ saguṇaṃ bhavatīti |
nanu prathame- 'dhyāye ( hetutvacintādhikaraṇe 1|2|3 ) pratiṣiddhā hetvarthatā, śūrpasyārthavādo'yaṃ ityuktam |
apūrvaprayuktā hi siddhāya naikasmin vākye home śūrpavidhānaṃ cāvakalpate, ityarthavādaḥ prakalpate nānyathā |
'caturhotrā paurṇamāsīmabhimṛśet, pañcahotrā amā- vāsyām' iti samudāyasamabhivyāhārāt vākyena tatrāya- kṛtā, prakaraṇasāmarthyāt apūrvasamabhivyāhārāt avagatāṃ apūrvaprayuktāṃ bādhate |
sa ca vākyasaṃyogaḥ śrautāśena nirākṛtaḥ ( śrutena hantirūpeṇa yo vākyāt prokṣaṇasya saṃyogaḥ, sa nirākṛtaḥ ) |
liṅgasaṃyogaśca śrautāśena ( svargānyādi- rūpeṇa ) nirākṛta eva |
śrutyā tu yeṣāṃ tādarthyam, te ihodāharaṇam |
vrīhīn iti dvitīyā ( vibhaktiḥ ) śrutvā vrīhyarthatāṃ prokṣaṇasya pratipādayati apūrvasaṃbaṃdhacaḥ prakaraṇataḥ syāt |
'paurṇamāsīm' ityatrāpi samudāyārtha- mabhimarśanaṃ śrutyaiva dvitīyā pratipādayati |
( atra tantraratnam - "nanu mantrāteyaṃ dvitīyā kathaṃ mantrasya tādarthyaṃ pratipādayet, svātmani kriyāvirodhāt |
sā hi triṃśadvyāprakāśanasamarthamantratvasāt kalpya- mānā īdṛśī kalpyeta 'mantreṇānaina vrīn prakāśa- yet' iti |
na caivaṃ liṅgaviniyogo'yaṃ syāt, sa ca nirākṛtaḥ |
satyam, udāharaṇāntaraṃ tu dātavyam, yatra pratyakṣeṇa īdṛśī śrutiḥ |
'śūrpeṇa juhoti, tena hyannaṃ kriyate' ityatra śūrpe tāvat anudāharaṇam, karaṇavibhaktinirdeśāt |
( nirā- karoti ) - tanna, śūrpasya vidhīyamānasya arthavādo'pa- mityuktam |
yasmādanena annaṃ kriyate, tasmādanena homaḥ kartavyaḥ iti ( na stutilakṣaṇaprasaṅgāt ) |
na ca homākṣarayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ avagamyate pramāṇa- ntareṇa, yathā kṛtakatvādityanayoḥ |
satyamevaṃ loke ( pramāṇāntareṇa saṃbandho'pekṣitaḥ ), vede tu hiśabda- śravaṇāt vākyamannīyate homākaraṇayoḥ saṃbandhakṛtaṃ ( 'yadyat annakaraṇam, tattat homena saṃbandham' iti ) |
sati ca hetuśravaṇe annakaraṇaṃ saṃkāryam, homaḥ saṃkārakaḥ |
yathā yacca yatra dhūmaḥ, tatrāgni vyāpyate |
tasmāt hiśabdaśrutyā annakaraṇārtho homaḥ iti manyamānaḥ pūrvapakṣaṃ karoti |
( yattu prathame'dhyāye arthavādatvaṃ sādhi ityuktam, tatrāha ) - iha apūrvārthe home sthite prathame 'dhyāye kiṃ annakaraṇaṃ vidhīyate, śūrpe padārthārthe ( eṣa deśānuvādaḥ ) |
uta śūrpe vidhīyate, ( tasya ) annakara stutiḥ |
arthakārite ca dravyeṇa na vyavasthā syāt |
12 bhāṣyam—apūrvaprayukte evaṃjātīyake dharme sā dravyeṇa ca dharmavyavasthā na syāt |
'payasā maitrāvaru- ṇaśrīṇāti, saktubhirmanthenam, dhānābhirhaviryojanam hiraṇyena śukam, ājyena pānīyatvam' iti |
yasya maitrāvaruṇaḥ apūrvasya ( sādhakaḥ ), tasyāpyasā śrayitavya iti |
tatra maitrāvaruṇādigrahaṇamavivakṣitaṃ syāt tasmādapi dravyādiyuktāḥ prokṣaṇādaya iti |
artho vā syāt, prayojanamitareṣāmacodanāt tasya ca guṇabhūtatvāt |
kiṃ tarhi ? artha eṣāṃ prayojanam artha ityapūrve brūmaḥ |
itareṣāṃ dravyādīnāṃ karta- vyatā na codanā |
a prati, apūrva prati guṇabhūtānāmeṣāṃ śravaṇam |
kima yadyevam ? akartavyānāṃ itikartavyatā nāsti saṃba- iti |
tvapade tu aprakṛtena phalavacane vākyatā syāt |
nanu prakaraṇaṃ vākyasya śrutervā bādhaka- satyamabādhakam |
phalābhāvāt bhavadīyaḥ pakṣo mucyate tasmin nānarthakyavivakṣite prakaraṇatā prayogavacane paripanthi prokṣaṇādi vidhīyate |
kimevaṃ bhaviṣyati ? dravyādisambandhaścaiva hi nāvatau bhaviṣyati |
vrīhīn prokṣatīti hi vrīhijātirnirdiśyate, vrīhidravya- lakṣaṇārthā vā, apūrvasādhanaviśeṣalakṣaṇārthā vā |
dravyalakṣaṇā vā, tatra ca lakṣaṇaiva doṣaḥ |
vrīhijātilakṣitaṃ yat sādhanam, kiṃ tat ? yatastaṇḍulā bhavanti, tat prokṣatavya- miti |
taṇḍulanivṛttirkaratā hi tatra sādhanatvam, na dravyatā |
ṭup-- yadi vrīhisarūpaprayuktaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ ( syāt ) tathā sati phalakalpanā ( syāt ) |
na hi svarūpāthaive paraṃparayā'pi ( prakṛta- ) apūrvaprayojanatvaṃ amidhāreṇa ādhānasya klṛptapūrvaprayojanatā saṃbhavati |
( naivaṃ śakyaṃ ityādibhāṣyaṃ nyāyye-) na ca vākyasya dvau arthau, yadi vā taṇḍulanivṛttipraṇatayā yat apūrva lakṣyate tasyāyaṃ dharmaḥ; yadi vā vrīhijātilakṣitasya dravyasya |
nahi sakṛduccaritaṃ vrīhipadaṃ svarūpaṃ ca tatsamavetaṃ ca sādhanaviśeṣaṃ pratipādayituṃ śakyam |
atra ( bhāṣya-) granthaḥ- vrīhijātilakṣitaṃ yat sādhanam- kiṃ tat ? yatastaṇḍulā bhavanti- tat prokṣatavyaṃ iti ( śāstrārthaḥ |
kutaḥ ?) taṇḍula- nivṛttirkaratā hi tatra sādhanatvam, na dravyatā |
( asya bhāṣyasya-) ko'bhiprāyaḥ ? ( uttaram-) taṇḍulanivṛttipraṇatayā yat sādhanatvaṃ lakṣyati, tadarthaṃ prokṣaṇam |
na cānyat dravyaṃ taṇḍulanivṛttirkaraṇaśena śakyate lakṣayitum |
bhāṣyam- atha yaduktam ' arthakārite ca dravyeṇa na vyavasthā syāt ' iti |
sādhanaviśeṣalakṣaṇārthaṃ jātiḥ ityevaṃ sati vyavasthā bhaviṣyati |
ato na maitrā- varuṇāpūrvāt aindravāyavasya dharmāḥ |
bhāṣyam- yaśca manyate ' dravyādiprayuktāḥ prokṣaṇā- dayo dharmāḥ' iti, tasya sarvaviṣayatā dharmasya prāpnoti |
ye'pi bhaktārthā vrīhayaḥ te'pyevaṃ prokṣitavyāḥ prāpnuvanti |
bhāṣyam- iti cetpadyasi, sarvaviṣayatā dharmasya bhaviṣyati |
na hi śrūyate, prakaraṇayuktā vrīhayo nirvatavyāḥ, prokṣitavyāśceti |
nahi vākyena bādhitaṃ prakaraṇamutsṛjate dharmān niyamatum |
adyāpi na bādhyate, tathāpi na prakaraṇasya viśeṣaṃ sāmarthyamasti |
kartavyatayā hi tat kriyamāṇaṃ śroyate, na prasiddhasaṃbandhamiva viśeṣaṇa- tvena |
tasmāt prakṛtayāgaviśeṣitānāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ nirvāpaḥ prokṣaṇaṃ vā codyate iti |
kartavyatayā hi tat kriyamāṇaṃ codyate, na prasiddha- saṃbandhamiva paraviśeṣaṇatvena iti ( bhāṣyam ) ko'- bhiprāyaḥ ? ( uttaram-) bhāvayet svargam |
yaśca nirdhātasvarūpa ucyate, sa paraviśeṣaṇaṃ yathā 'śuklaḥ paṭaḥ' iti |
iha yat kathambhāvākāṅkṣāyāṃ agnyādhānādi upanipatati, tadasya saṃbandhatve kāraṇam ( tat kathambhāvātmakaṃ prakaraṇaṃ agnyadhānādeḥ itthambhāvena saṃbandhatve kāraṇaṃ bhavati ) |
( na svarūpeṇa prakaraṇaṃ anyasya saṃbandhatve kāraṇaṃ bhavati ityarthaḥ |
ānandā- śramīye tu atra ' nānyasya bhavati, na cānyasya bhavati '
paraṃtu tat asyadīye likhite tannarane vā nāsti ) |
bhāṣyam- iti cetpadyasi, na prakaraṇaṃ viśeṣakaṃ vrīhīṇāmiti |
tulyepu nādhikāraḥ syādyoditaśca saṃbandhaḥ, pṛthak satāṃ yajñārthenābhisaṃbandhastasmādyaḥ prayo- janam |
ya eva bhaktārthāsta eva karmārthāḥ, na pṛthak kecit karmārthā nāma |
' tasmāt sarvaiṣābheva vrīhiṇāṃ viniyogānāṃ dravyādīnāṃ saṃskārāḥ apūrvabhāvāttvebhṛtāḥ |
soma- sūtrārthastu- dravyādi prayojakaṃ dvitīyāśruteḥ dviśabdaśca saṃyogāt |
' bhāṭṭa- atra mūle dravyasaṃkhyāhetusamudāyānāṃ yatra śrutyā uddeśyatā, tatra vrīhādineva, na tu apūrvasādhana- tvena, prakaraṇena śrutiṃkocāyogāt ityādyuktya svarūpe

tatra 'vrīhīn prokṣati' iti dṛṣṭodāharaṇasya 'caturhotrā paurṇamāsīm' iti samudāyādāharaṇasya ca kathañcit saṃbhave'pi saṃkhodāharaṇasya 'trīn parīdhīn' iti mantrasya 'agniṃ suvaḥ' iti mantratad apūrvasādhanībhūtaparīdhī- yatprākāśātārthatvasya siddhatvāt anudāharaṇatvamiti vārtikakāraiṇavoktam, tathā hetudvāhe'ṇe'pi |

yat 'śūrpeṇa juhoti, tena hyannaṃ kriyate' ityatrakaraṇahetunā tasya vyāpyatvāvagamāt, nyāyasya ca sarvatra prādhānyadarśanāt annakaraṇoddeśena homaḥ saṃskārakatayā vidhīyate iyā śaṅkya tṛtīyā homaṃ prati śūrpasya karaṇatvāvagateḥ 'teḥ hyannaṃ kriyate' ityasya cārthavādatvāt, homoṭya ārādu pakārakaḥ : apūrvārtha iti vicāritam, tat vyāpyasyāpi juhādeḥ kratuṃ prati prādhānyadarśanāt arthavādatvasya ca hetvadhikaraṇe sthāpitatvāt tadvicārasya ca uhānupayogi tvāccopekṣitam |
kiñca sarvasyaivāsya vicārasya ādhikāriṇena gatārtha tetyanyathā varṇyate |
yadyapi yajñakarmeti sūtreṇa (9|1|1) saṃnipatyopakārakamātre apūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇā siddhā saṃskāre ceti sūtreṇa (2) ca āntarālikānāṃ yāgatvā dikāraṇatā'

tāmyāmulakhalamusalābhyām' ityādi tatsamānajātīyavākyā- ntare vā, tatrāpi prokṣaṇaviśiṣṭasya vrīhiviśiṣṭasya ca vidheyakriyāviśeṣaṇatvena vidhau kṛte paścādaṇaikahāyanī- nyāyena parasparānavyāt prakṛtau tajjātīyasya prokṣaṇe'pi vikṛtau tajjātilope'pi tāsthānāpannadravyāntare eva prokṣaṇalābhāt sidhyati ūhaḥ |
prokṣaṇaṃ prati viśeṣaṇa- vidhivelāyāṃ apūrvasādhanatvasyaiva uddeśyatvā'vacchedakatvam, lakṣaṇā paraṃ (kevalam) na tatrāsti, vrīhipadena vrīhiva- syaiva abhidhānāt |

evaṃ yatrāpi saṃskāravidhyuttaraṃ tacchabdena saṃskṛtasya viniyogaḥ yathā 'tate payasi' ityādi tatrāpi saṃskāra- vākye payastvasamānādhikaraṇadhamavicchinnoddeśyenaiva dadhā- nayanavidhiḥ, na tu payastvāvacchinnena ānarthakyāt |
sa ca dharmaḥ uttitvācca iṣṭasāmānyamiva sāmānyataḥ
tathā 'somena yajeta' ityatrāpi haviḥprakṛtisomalatāvidhānāya yajinā aindravāyavādivākyeṣu dravyadevatāsaṃbandhānumita- yāgamudāyānuvādaḥ iti |
nanu 'hṛdayasyāgre'vadyati' ityādivākyeṣu na tāvad yajiḥ śrūyate |
hṛdayādisaṃbandhaścāvadānasya vatsālambhatvat yāga- mantareṇāpi saṃbhavācca yāgānumāpakatvam |
katham ? paśu- dravyāmīṣomadevatākayāgavidhānenaiva mukhyaguṇaśabdāpoṣatto dīkṣitavākye lakṣaṇayā paśusaṃbandhena hṛdayānuvādaḥ |
ata paśoḥ tāvat sarvathā pūrvapakṣo na saṃbhavati |

tathā 'somena yajeta' iti pratyakṣayāgavidhau sati kathaṃ aindravāyavādi- vākyeṣu dravyadevatāsaṃbandhānumitasya yāgasya vidhānam ? 'pratyakṣavidhisiddhatvāt labhyate lānumānikam' iti nyāya- virodhāt |
aindravāyavādivākyānāṃ candravāyadevatāśrauta- grahaṇavidhānenaiva upapannatayā nāśrutayāgavidhānākṣepa- padyate |

bhavatu vā dravyadevatāsaṃbandhena aindravāyavādipañca- yāgavidhānam, tathāpi 'somena yajeta' ityatra somadravya- yāgavidhānopapatteḥ kathaṃ yajetaḥ yacchandātparāgābhāve'pi yāgānuvādakatvaṃ saṃbhavati, ataḥ kathaṃ some'pi pūrvapakṣaḥ ? iti |
ucyate, paśo tāvat yadyapi hṛdayādisaṃbandhena avadānaṃ bhūyate, tathāpi 'sānnāyyaṃ vā tadābhyatvāt' (sū. 8|1|40) ityanenaiva nyāyena ayamavadyatiḥ sānnāyyavadyatiprakṛtiḥ |
tacca tadeva saṃbhavati, yadi hṛdayādīni yāgasādhanāni bhavanti |

tena yathāyāgasādhanakārasaṃskārasaṃbandhena pūtī- kānāṃ yāgasādhanatvaṃ kalpyate, yathā vā lakṣaṇasaṃbandhena phala- camasasya abhyamāṇamapi yāgasādhanatvaṃ kalpyate, tathe- hāpīti paśuśabdena hṛdayādīni anuyante, yajinā ca tatsaṃbandhinā yāgānnuya amīṣomau devatātvena vidhīyate |
na ca paśuśabdasya hṛdayādyanuvādatve lakṣaṇaiva doṣaḥ, yato vidhau hi lakṣaṇā doṣamāvahati, nānuvāde |
nanu yodīkṣitavākye devatāviśiṣṭayāgavidhirvāstu kathaṃ devatāmātravidhānam ? maivam |
evaṃ hi manyate, avaśyaṃ siddhāntādinā'pi hṛdayāditāvadānasaṃskārasya- rthāt paśuśabdasya lakṣaṇayā hṛdayādiparatvaṃ vaktavyam |
tadyadi yodīkṣitavākye yāgotpattiḥ, tadā vidhau lakṣaṇā, sā cāyuktā 'na vidhau paraḥ śabdārthaḥ' iti nyāyāt |
avacativākyānāṃ tu yāgotpādakatve anuvāde lakṣaṇā, sā na doṣāya |
tena paśuśabdena hṛdayādīni anuya yajinā tatsaṃbandhinā yāgānnuya amīṣomau devatātvena vidhīyate iti siddham |
tathā some'pi aindravāyavādivākyeṣu dravyadevatāsaṃbandhena tāvadavaśyaṃ yāgo'numātavyaḥ |
na hi dravyadevatāsaṃbandha- pratipādakasya yāgaṃ vinā svārthe paryavasānamasti |
nanu evaṃ śrutinimittadeyamevedaṃ vākyaṃ niṣpannam 'indra- vāyudevatyena yajeta' iti |
tathā sati somavākya- vihitayāgānuvādena amīṣomavākye iva hṛdayādyanuvādena devatāvidhānamevāstu, kimatra viśiṣṭavidhisvīkāreṇa ? maivam |
somavākyopapannayāgānuvādena aindravāyavākyai- devatāvidhau ekayāgasaṃbandhena tadiralakṣaṇāmiva ekasmin yāge vikalpaḥ syāt |
tathā sati 'āśvino daśamo gṛhyate, tṛtīyo hūyate' iti kramadarśanam |
tathā 'daśaitānagṛhyate' prātaḥsavanaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti samuccadarśanaṃ ca nopapadyate |
aindravāyavādivākyānāṃ tu yāgotpādakatve bhinnayāgasaṃbandhitvāt devatānāṃ samuccaye sati kramasamuccayadarśanamupapadyate |
tathā sati rūpābhāvena yāgavidhānābhāvāt yacchandādyabhāve'pi aindravāyavādi-
bhavedayaṃca yatra paurṇamāsīvat vākyāntararopaja- yāgapratyabhijñānaṃ bhavet |
na ca avaghaṭitagṛhātivākyeṣu yāgaḥ śrūyate, yenātra pratyabhijñānam |
tena yodīkṣitavākye eva dravyadevatāsaṃbandhānumitasya yāgasya vidhānam |
na ca vācyam, paśudravyakasomadravyakayāgotpattau hṛdayādīnāṃ rahasya ca aviniyuktatvāt tatsaṃbandhinoḥ avadānagrahaṇapuraskārayorvidhānamanarthakameva syāditi |
na hi paśuhomamātrapratītiḥ, yataḥ avaghaṭitagṛhātivākya- darśanena tayoravikṛtayordevatoddeśena yāgavidhānāt |
kiṃ tarhi ? hṛdayādiparvanto rasaparyantaśca, tena somaviniyogena tadantargatapaśuhṛdayasomarasayorvināyuktatvāt viniyukta- gocarameva saṃskāravidhānam |
yathā vrīhiṇāstra taṇḍulā- diparyantatvāt 'taṇḍulān pinaṣṭi' ityādisaṃskāra- vidhānam |
na caivaṃ vidhau paśusomaśabdaḥ saṃskāra- jñāpanārthaḥ, taduktam 'dravyeṇāyantabhinnaṃ saha cintyaṃ balābalam |
kiñca viśeṣataḥ paśudāharaṇe avaghaṭito yāgaḥ saṃbhavitumapi na śakyate |
yadapi hṛdayādyavadānasya sānnāyyāvadānaprakṛtitvena taddharmatvameva sati yāgīyadravyasaṃskāratvāt yāgānumānamityuktam, tadapi ayuktam |
bhavatu vā hṛdayādyava- dānasya tatprakṛtitvam, tathāpi na yāgasādhanasaṃskāratvaṃ tasya |
pūtīkāmivaphalacamasa- bhakṣaṇayostu yāgasādhanadravyasaṃskārayoreva prakṛtauyava- prakaraṇāmyāṃ pūtīkaphalacamasasaṃbandhena upādānamiti vaiṣamyam |

yadapi yodīkṣitavākye paśuśabdasya lakṣaṇayā hṛdayādiparatvamāpādya vidhau lakṣaṇā'bhāvāt bhāvadevatā- saṃbandhanirośena avaghaṭitavākye eva yāgānumānamityu- ktam, tadapi yāgavidhau paśuśabdasya hṛdayādiparyantatvena mukhyayāgasya uktatvāccirastam |
evaṃ 'somena yajeta' iti pratyakṣe yajo aindravāyavā- divākyeṣu yāgaḥ saṃbhāvayitumeva na śakyate |
na ca āgneyādivākyānāmindravāyavādivākyeṣu na yāga- mantareṇa svārthaparyavasānamastīti vācyam |
āgne- yādivākyeṣu tu puṃnyāpārasya vidhiviṣayatvāt bhavyarthasya ca apuṃnyāpāratvāt avaśyaṃ kalpanīye puṃnyāpāre dravyadevatāsaṃbandhena yāgaḥ eva kalpyate ityuktam |
nanu tajyamānaṃ haviḥ prati uddeśyatvaṃ na kiñci- jātyā samasta |
ucyate, na hīdaṃ grahaṇamarthāntarabhūtam, kiṃ tarhi ? yāgāvayavabhūtamevaitat |
na ca anyadeśena gṛhītasya anyoddeśena tyāge yāgaḥ saṃpadyate |
tena devatoddeśena gṛhītasyaiva haviṣastyāgo yāga iti na yāgāvayavabhūte agne devatoddeśo virudhyate iti |
evañca yāgāpekṣāyāṃ 'somena yajeta' ityayameva pratyakṣaśruto yāgo'stīti nātra yāgakalpanāprāptaḥ |
tathā ca sati imeva yāgadeśabhūtagrahaṇasaṃbandhinī devatā prakṛta- yāge devatāpekṣeṇa saṃbadhyate |
na ca evaṃ sati khādirapālāśadādināma ekabandhanārthatve devatānāmapi ekayāgārthatve vikalpaḥ syāt |
yato nātra khādirapālāśadādināma bandhane, devatānāṃ yāge vākyena vidhānam, yena vikalpaḥ āpadyeta |
grahaṇāni tāvat bhinnakāryāt yugapadeva prakaraṇinā gṛhītāni bhinnakāryāt samucceta-
paramayaṃ viśeṣaḥ, grahaṇayāgayorekā devatā, yena yaduddeśena gṛhītaṃ taduddeśenaiva tyaktavyam |
evaṃ ca sati trivaṇadaśagrahadaśacamasadānāṃ pratyabhyāsaṃ bhinno yāgaḥ |
'somena yajeta' ityanena śālena sakṛdutpādita iti mantavyam |
tathā sati 'āśvino daśamo gṛhyate, tṛtīyo hūyate' iti kramadarśanam, tathā 'daśaitānadhvaryuḥ prātaḥ savane grahaṇān gṛhṇāti' iti samuccaya- darśanamupapannaṃ bhavatīti somodāharaṇamapi anavadyam |
prayojanam--pūrvapakṣe hṛdayādīnāmaindrāyavādipāgānāṃ pṛthaktvāt svārthatvāt viśeṣacodanāliṅgāt tadarthātideśe sati na sakaladharmaprāptiḥ |
siddhānte tu paśyāgasya soma- yāgasya ekatvāt vikṛtau sakaladharmapiriti |
sūtraṃ tu--paśusomadravyasaṃyogāt paśuvākye somavākye ca yāgacodanā yāgavidhānam, yasmāt prakṛtayāgageṣu anarthako niṣprayojano dravyasaṃyogaḥ |
'nahi tasya guṇārthena' iti sunāyavayo bhāṣyākāreṇa somodāharaṇe somalatāyāḥ pradeyatvena guṇārthatvamāśaṅkya śrautasāvaśeṣena tannirā- karaṇaparatayā vyākhyātaḥ |
nahi guṇādhi- karaṇavibaddhā pradeyatvena guṇavāśaṅkā jaiminermanasi saṃbhāvyate |
atraike samādhānamabhidadhati--'āgneyo'ṣṭā- kapālo bhavati' iti atra agnidevatāsaṃbandhapuroḍāśa- pratipādakavākyaśeṣaḥ saṃbhavati |
'puroḍāśaṃ kūrmaṃ bhūtaṃ sarpantamapaśyan, tamabruvan, indrāya priyasva bṛhaspati priyasva viśvebhyo devebhyo priyasva' ityādi |
asya ca śrutiparatve'pi stutyapuroḍāśapratipādanāvarodhāt svavākya- khapuroḍāśe eva āgneyatvitparyavasānam |
tathā sati kiṃprakṛtikaḥ puroḍāśa iti prakṛtidravyapekṣāyāṃ 'vrīhibhi- yajeta' iti yuktaḥ prakṛtitayā brīhīṇāṃ vidhiḥ |

atra tu 'aindravāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti vākyaśeṣānavagamāt prakaraṇanirīkṣaṇena ca 'somaṃ punāti' iti saprakṛtitvetha rakhasya pratītastatraiva taddhitaparyavasānamiti prakṛtirūpāpekṣā- bhāvācca prakṛtitvena 'somena yajeta' iti somalatāvidhiḥ saṃbhavati |

na ca 'tvāṣṭraṃ pānīvattamalameta' ityatra yathā ālabhambha arthākṣiptasālamamātre taddhitaparyavasānam, tathā 'aindravāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti' ityatrāpi svavākye eva grahaṇākṣisa- grahamātre taddhitaparyavasānam |
anyavyatiśruteśca 'aṇvyā dhārayā gṛhṇāti' iti vākye gauṇaśabdasya anyabhi- cārigrahaṇaviśeṣāmidhāyakātvāt, anyabhiritopasthita- dravyasyaiva taddhitaparyavasānamiti vaktavyam |

yenānyapara- śabdo'nyato'prāptena arthākṣiptanyāyena abhidhānamiti vyutpatteḥ, paraṃmate ca nityaṃ śabdāśabdādisaṃbandhāt arthākṣiptasyāpi tadvācakaśabdakalpanātirekeṇa anvayāt prakaraṇe ca 'somaṃ punāti' iti anyaparaśabdonītasya somaśabdasyaiva pratītastatraiva paryavasānam |
na ca latāvacana- tvāt somaśabdasya 'somaṃ punāti' ityatra somaśabdo na rakhapara iti vācyam |
dravyadravyakalpanāparaṇāmidhāyakasyo- punātiśabdasya latāmamidhāyārānuṣapattau lākṣaṇikatva- prabhavasaraparatvasya avaśyamabhyupeyatvāt |
na ca prathamāva- gatasomaśabdānurodhena upunātiśabdaḥ eva lakṣaṇāśrayaṇāt somalatāṇārthatvaṃ vaktavyam |
somaśabde tu utpannasaṃbandhocitaprabhavasarasyaiva yogyatvādāsti vinigamanāyāḥ pramāṇamiti tadvaitava lakṣaṇeti |
evaṃ sati utpannapradhānakarmatve ca ubhayāpi somaśabdasya rakhaparatvāt kimandravāyava ityapekṣāyā anuṣaṅgāt somarasaḥ evaṃ saṃvadhyate |
na ca dhārāvākyavyavadhānanānuṣaṅgaḥ, tatrāpi kiṃ dhārayā gṛhṇītītyapekṣāyāṃ somarasasaṃbandhāt |
yathā 'yā te agnerajāśayā' ityanena saṃvaddhaṃ 'tanūḥ' iti padaṃ irāśayetaya na vyavadhīyate, tathaivāpi somarasasya na dhārāvākyena aindravāyavasaṃbandho vyavadhīyate iti |
tathāca sati somarase eva taddhitaśruteḥ paryavasānāt prakṛtidravyā- pekṣābhāvācca tatprakṛtitayā latāvidhiḥ saṃbhavati |
taduktam--'puroḍāśo hyanirūpitaprakṛtidravyatayā āgneyā- diṣu pratīyate iti yuktaṃ prakṛtidravyavinigamanā |
tu nirūpitaprakṛtikaḥ somarasa eva gamyate, nahi bhavati somarasaḥ kiṃ prakṛtika ityapekṣā' iti |
atrocyate--bhavatu somarase eva taddhitaśruti- paryavasānam, tathāpi niyamena krayaṇābhipavasaṃskṛtasoma- prabhavasarasavihvayāgasiddhayarthe akṣatatayā somavidhānaṃ artha- vaccaviṣyati |
itarathā tu anaṅgasya niyamena upādānā- bhāvāt pratigrahaṃ krayaṇādisyatenāpi yāgaḥ kriyeta |
na ca anaṅgatve'pi praṣakādeva krītādabhipavāt pūtāt tathābhiprāvitādapi somādadbhuta evāsau rasa aindravāyava iti vaktavyam |
kiṃ krayaṇādīnāṃ saṃskārakarmatvamāśrītyocyate ? pradhānakarmatvaṃ vā ? na tāva- dādyaḥ kalpaḥ, tasya viniyuktagocaratvena asaṃbhavāt |
nāpi dvitīyaḥ, tatrāpi yadyattu pānaṃ prabaṅgaḥ ( ? ), tadā krītasomāpacāre abhipavādināṃ radāpacāre ca pradhānasya lopa eveti |
kiñca, sāmānyaśāstraṃ hi prasaṅgena viśeṣaśāstraṃ apekṣā- vaśādupajīvati |
krayāmiṣavādiśāstrāṇāṃ tu lokasiddhasomagrāhitvena tulyatvāt 'tulyeṣu nādhikāraḥ syāt' iti nyāyena na prasaṅgaviṣayavamiti yuktaḥ prakṛti- tvena somavidhiriti |

na cāviniyuktatvena somasya anaṅgatvāt- saṃskāratvam, 'somaṃ punāti' ityatra saprakṛtitvena avagatasya aindravāyavavākyeṣu viniyuktatvāt, saviśe- ṣaṇānyasya kāyopayogitvena tatsaṃbhave sati pratītimātro- payuktasya upalakṣaṇasya anyāvyatvāt |
viśiṣṭavidhau ca viśeṣaṇānāṃ aupādānikāṅgabhāvasya sarvatra sthitatvāt |
na ca aupādānikasya somāṅgabhāvasya kalpanīyatvāt, pratyakṣāṃ ca śrutau kalpanā'natrakāśāt, 'somena yajeta' iti pratyakṣaśruteśca aṅgabhāvapratipādakatvamiti vaktavyam |

yāgābhivyaktiśca aindravāyavatadvitasya utpannavākyagata- somaviśiṣṭasaṃbandhapūrvikā, tatra viśiṣṭaviśeṣaṇaviśeṣa- yoraikyarūpyam, kintu ākāṅkṣāyogyatāvaśādevatā (tānvena) rasasyāṅgābhāvo na somāṅgabhāvamantareṇa saṃbhavatītyaupā- dānike somāṅgabhāve pṛthaksiddhe tadupajīvya somavidhiḥ pratyakṣo'pi akiñcitkara eveti |
na caivaṃ sati latāyāḥ api pradeyatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
nahi sarvatra viśiṣṭavidhau viśeṣaṇa- viśeṣayorekarūpyam, kintu ākāṅkṣāyogyatāvaśādevatātve- nodeśyatvameva |
tatrāpi rasasya pradeyatve'pi tatprakṛtitvenaiva somalatāsaṃbandha iti |

athavā somasya aviniyuktatve'pi aṅgabhūtaropakārakatayā abhipavāditānvena, vasta- syaiva viniyuktadopakārakatayā 'vatsamālameta' ityatra ālabhambhasaṃskāryatvam, ṛcāṃ vā yathā viniyuktastutyupa- kāritāyā sāmasaṃskāryatvam, svādhyāyasya vā paramata viniyuktatadupakārakatayā adhyayanasaṃskāryatvam |
nanu somasya aviniyuktatvena anaṅgatvāt anaṅgasya ca apratinidheyatvāt, 'yadi somaṃ na vindeyuḥ pūtīkā- nabhiṣuṇyuḥ' ityatra pūtīkānāṃbhāvavihitaṃ bhavet, na somapratinidhiniyamaḥ |
tathā sati pūtīkāpacāre tasya doṣopādānaṃ bhavet, na somasahasopādānam |

athavā anaṅgatve'pi somasya tatprakṛtikarasyaiva vihitatvena rasasyaiva rakhaprakṛtyai somasya śāstrārthatvāt, śāstrārthasya pratinidhitvayogāt somapratinidhiniyame'pi yukta eva, kimaṅgatā kariṣyati na ca guṇādhikaraṇanyāyena pradeyatvamapi āgneyatvam tatra hi 'vaiśvadevyāmikṣā' iti svavākyatatāmikṣā 'varodhāt punaḥ 'aindravāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti' ityādiṣūkti vākyeṣu rasasya apratītatvena vaiṣamyam |
atrocyate--yattāvaduktam, utpannavākye soma- rasasyaiva śabdatvāt taddhitaśrutiparyavasānam, tathā sati na tadupalakṣitatā somavidhānaṃ saṃbhavatīti |
saṃskāra- karmatve hi utpannasya latāyāmupanarupaskārāraṃbhavā- raso lakṣaṇīyaḥ |
tathā ca sati mukhyārtha- syaiva somasya dravyadravyakalpanāpaharūpatvenāsādhanatva- saṃbhavaḥ |
na ca dravyatvāntarasya kalpanīyatvāt somaśabdasyaiva lakṣaṇā rasoṣapākatat- miti vaktavyam |
iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ, ekatrotpavanāvinābhūta- dravyīkaraṇena mukhyasomaśabdārthasya utpavanasādhanatvam, aparatra ca utpavanāvinābhūtasādhanatvīkaraṇena somaśabde lākṣaṇikatvam |
athavā astu utpavanavākye śāndī rasāvagatiḥ, na tatra taddhitaparyavasānam |
na ca tathā sati homalatāyā- meva taddhitaparyavasānamiti vaktavyam |
varma vā etad yasya kriyate varma yajamānasya bhrātṛvyā- bhibhūtyai' iti prajādirūpe karmaṇi phalaśrutiḥ |
dravyeṣu saṃskāreṣu ayaṃ yeyaṃ phalasya śrutiḥ śravaṇam, saḥ arthavādaḥ syāt na vidhiḥ |
dravyasaṃskārakarmasu phalaśrutirvā iti siddhāntinā ukte, nanu puruṣasyaiva phalaṃ śrūyate 'na sa pāpaṃ ślokaṃ śṛṇoti' iti, kathamapyarthavādaḥ syāditi śaṅkāyāṃ siddhāntī uttarayati |
utpatteḥ parṇamayī iti vidheḥ utpattivākyasya atatpradhānatvāt tadpradhānatvābhāvāt phalaparatvābhāvāt puruṣapradhānatvābhāvāt iti vā |

kutūhalavṛttau ca tat evaṃ vyākhyātam -- nanu 'yasya parṇamayī juhūrbhavati na sa pāpaṃ ślokaṃ śṛṇoti' ityasya phalaparatvābhāve 'pratiṣṭhanti ha vai etā rātrīrupayanti' iti rātri satravākyamapi phalaparaṃ na syāt iti, ata āha |
pratiṣṭhanti ityasya vipariṇāmena phalaparatvābhāve rātrisatraviśeṣaṇārthakaṃ syāt akriyārtha- tvāt tatpakṣe ṛtūpasthāpakatvābhāvena ṛtvarthatvābhāvāt ṛtūpakāreṇa phalākāṅkṣāntarabhāvāt iti yāvat |
bhāṣye'pi 'arthavāde tu sati bhavati prayojanam, khādirādeḥ suvādiṣu karmārtheṣu prayojanavastu' iti vyati- rekeṇa vyākhyātamidam |
'yasya parṇamayī juhūrbhavati na sa pāpaṃ ślokaṃ śṛṇoti' ityādiḥ dravyasaṃskārakarmasu phalaśruterarthavāde 'khādiraṃ vīryakāmasya yūpaṃ kuryāt' ityāderapi arthavādatvameva syāditi cenna |
atra tadpradhānayāṃ vidhipradhānāyāṃ codanāyāṃ vīryādi phalaṃ anveti iti codaneveyaṃ nārthavādaḥ |
apāpaślokaśravaṇādikaṃ tu kami padābhāvāt na codanāyāṃ phalatvena anveti iti vaiṣamyam |
ke. asyāṃ prayojanākāṅkṣāyāṃ yadyapi kācit phale śrutirbhavet, sā'pi dravyasaṃskārakarmasu ityanena nyāyena arthavādatayā jñāyate |
(nyāyasvarūpaṃ tu) 'nahi samānādhvanoḥ parāsmin phalavati jñāte pūrvasyāpi phalavattvā jñāyate' iti varṇitametat |
vā. 1|3|8|24 pṛ. 257, kimetadevasya phalamiti ? (puroḍāśasya kapāleṣu 'ūru te yajñapatiḥ prayatām' ityatra ) netyāha |
1|2|4|135 pṛ. 193. gargatrirātrabrāhmaṇe 'śobhate'sya mukhaṃ ya evaṃ veda' iti naiṣa vidhiḥ, dravyasaṃskārakarmasu iti cintayiṣyati etadaparihāt |
bhā. 1|2|13, na ca tasya (vedasya) adhyayanamātrāt tatrabhavanto yājñikāḥ phalaṃ samānanti |
yadapi ca samānanti tatrāpi dravya... syāt iti arthavādatāṃ vakṣyati |
1|1|1|6 pṛ. 6, dravyasaṃskārakarmasu phalaśrutiḥ artha- vādaḥ ayaṃ nyāyaḥ parṇamayīnyāyaḥ |
teṣu saṃdehaḥ kimaṅgapradhānārthāḥ, uta pradhānārthāḥ iti |
yat dharmāṇāṃ sāmānavidhyaṃ aṅgapradhāneṣu pūrvoktam (3|7|1|9-5), tat vikṛtiṣu kathamiti vicāre prāpte sūtrametat |

) vi-- 'yūpavāṭastaraṇabarhirnyāyaḥ' ityatra niveśitaḥ ! yadyapi 'dravyasaṃskārasya aṅgapradhānārthatā' ityeva adhi- karaṇaśīrṣakamupamyastaṃ vistarapustake, tathāpi anyakāreṇa yūpavāṭavarhirviṣaye eva adhikaraṇaṃ nyāyyatām |
' 19. dravyasaṃskāravirodhe dravyaṃ tadarthatvāt ityadhikaraṇaṃ bhāṣyīyaṃ dravyasaṃskāravirodhadhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
paśukarmaṇi yūpārthe mahat kadaradravyaṃ takṣaṇādisaṃskāra- kṣamaṃ labdham |
khādiradravyamapi labdham, paraṃtu tat paśu- niyojanakṣamamapi takṣaṇādisaṃskāre akṣamam |
tasmāt ukte sthale saṃskārākṣamamapi paśurniyo- janakṣamaṃ khādiradravyameva svīkāryaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
saṃskārasahāt pratiniye : saṃskārāsaha'pi prayojanasamarthaśreṣṭha mukhya eva grāhyaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- pravṛtte paśukarmaṇi yūpakāle asti mahat kadaradravyaṃ takṣaṇādisaṃskāramam (kadaraḥ kadire site ityamaraḥ |
saṃskārāḥ na parilopyante iti kadara upādīyeteti |
evaṃ prāpte, brūmaḥ : dravyasaṃskāravirodhe dravyaṃ prati ādiyate, na saṃskārān |
tasmāt khādiramupādeyamiti śā - 'dravyārtho eva saṃskārāstato nānyat prayojanam |
' 19. soma - pūrvatra guṇānurodhe'pi iha tadanurodhaḥ iti pratyavasānāt saṃgatiḥ |
ādyo bahuguṇālepā, ja mukhyāyāstu (ya a a) lopanam |
' 19. bhāṭṭa - yadā niyojanādikāryamātrayogyau mukhyaḥ takṣaṇādisakalasaṃskārayogyavastu prati niṣiddhā mukhyasye- vopādānam |
saṃskārāṇāṃ tu 'guṇalope ca mukhyasya' iti nyāyena lope'pi na doṣaḥ |
na ca anyatra tathātve'pi yūpasya dṛṣṭādṛṣṭasaṃskārarūpatvatvāt saṃskārāṇāṃ kāṣṭhāśvamiti vācyam |
ata eva 'yūpaṃ takṣati' ityādi kāṣṭhasyaiva saṃskāratvāt kāṣṭha'pyanupapattiḥ |
saṃgraha: ) prathama pāde paśudharmāṇāṃ paśupuroḍāśe prasaṅga: |
yo hi dvaṃdvasya dharma: itaretarayogo nāma, sa eka- |
ṇīyā vikṛtiṣvapi syāt, na tu prakṛtāveva |
bhinnau, itaratrāyau bhinna: śabda eka eva |
dvaṃdvānte śrūyamāṇaṃ padaṃ pratyekaṃ saṃbadhyate iti |
niṣpannaṃ vā anyasya sādhanaṃ bhavati pratipādyaṃ vā, tatra |
yathā ca padaṃ akṣānnasya, vājinaṃ vājinayāgasya |
tuṣopavāpādinā na prayoktuṃ śakyate, iti aprayojakatvam |
vā yugapadabhidhātuṃ iṣyante tatra dvaṃdvasamāso bhavati |
viniyuktānipi prayājādīni na pṛthak anuṣṭhāpayati, ta |
ata eva ca ājyabhāgau paśau avidyamānaṃ |
yathaiva khadirau ca dhavau ceti nidarśanaṃ kriyate |
dvāda ddāni darśapūrṇamāsayo: ādhvaryavaṃ karmaṃ, na |
ca tādarthyaṃ nopakārā, a cātra sa: ||
yaduddeśena yat anuṣṭhīyate, tat tadartham, tadeva ca aṅga |
ca ukhāviśayaṇaṃ ca, 2 adhivāpaśva kapālopadhānaṃ ca, |
ca ājyādhiśrayaṇaṃ ca, 5 stāmbayajurharaṇaṃ ca abhighāraṇaṃ |
ca ājyāsādanaṃ ca, 8 spayaśca kapālāni ca, 9 agni- |
hotrahavaṇī ca sūrye ca, 10 kṛṣṇājinaṃ ca śamyā ca, |
11 ulūlakhalaṃ ca musalaṃ ca, 12 haṣaccopalā ca iti |
tataḥ kimasyāḥ bhāgyaṃ ityapekṣāyāṃ samānapadottamapi dhātvarthe ayonyatvādulhṛṣya padānta- ropāttaṃ svargādi svīkriyate |
tadabhāve ca arthavādastham, tadabhāve ca adhyāhriyate |
tataḥ karaṇāpekṣāyāṃ samānapadottamapi dhātvartheḥ eva karaṇatayā annīyate iti bhāvārthādhikaraṇa- gārthaḥ |

tasya ca karaṇatvaṃ kṣaṇikasya kālāntarabhāvi phalaṃ prati sākṣāt na saṃbhavati iti sthiradvārāpekṣāyāṃ devatā- ''rādhanakartṛsaṃskārayoḥ devatā'dhikaraṇe, karmaṇvārambha- bhāvyatvāt ( 1|1|4|20 ) ityatra ca nirākṛte tad- dvāratve apūrvameva āśrayitavyam, iti tacchabdamadhyāhṛtya yāgenāpūrvaṃ kṛtvā svarge bhāvayet iti, apūrvetikartavyatā- yukto yāgo jvālopetakāṣṭhādivat pākamima phala prati karaṇatayā viniyujyate iti apūrvādhikaraṇe'ke 'katha- manena apūrva kartavyam' iti punaḥ itakartavyatā''kāṅkṣā kāṣṭhādināmiva jvālāsiddhayartha jāyate |

tatra ṣaḍvidhena upadeśena, trividhena cātideśena, smṛtyācārabhyām, śrutyarthādimiśra yathāyathaṃ tena dvāreṇa samarpitaṃ jāti- dravya-guṇa-kriyā-kramātmaka majjātārthabhāvena śuṣka- svādivat (jvālā'rthe kāṣṭhe śuṣkatvaṃ yathā tadvat ) svīkriyate |
tathā prakalpite apūrve dīkṣaṇīyādivat akalpite cāvāntarāpūrve pradhānapūrve phalaṃ prati viniyujyate |
tena dīkṣaṇīyeva paramā- pūrvayuktā, phalaprayuktameva pradhānam |
aṅgaṃ tu kalpite apūrve tadaṅgatvena dīkṣaṇīyāṅgatvenavāvāntarāpūrvā- ṅgatvena viniyujyamāne tadadeva avāntarapūrvaprayuktam, na paramāpūrvayuktamiti veditavyam |
tataḥ sarvaviśeṣaṇa- viśiṣṭabhāvanā'nuṣṭhānaṃ prayojakatvāprayojakatvatatrāvāpa- prasaṅgatapadavādāvagataparamāṇaṃ śrutyarthāvagatakramasahitaṃ phalādhaṃna sakalāṅgā'nuṣṭhānaṃ kāmyeṣu |
nityanaimittikepu tu kiñcidaṅgā'nuṣṭhānāśakyamapi puruṣaṃ prati vidhinirvahate iti |
