samuddhatvāt 'aindravāyavāgrau prāvaṇīyodayanīyau daśamaṃ cāhe; ayetareṣāṃ navānāmahamāmendravāyavāgraṃ prathamamahaḥ, atha āgrayaṇāgre, athaindravāyavāgram, atha dve śukrāgre, athā grayaṇāgram, atha dve aindravāyavāgre' iti |
sūtrārthastu - dvādaśāhasya vyūhatvaṃ samūḍhatvaṃ ca rathaṃtara- bṛhatpṛṣṭhavat samānavidhānaṃ syāditi |
vi- 'vyūho'pi prakṛtiḥ kiṃvā vikṛtiḥ syādi, pṛṣṭhavat |

taṃ vidhāya 'atha vyūhaḥ aindravāyavādiṃ prāyaṇīyodayanīyau, athetareṣāṃ daśānamahāṃ aindravāyavāgraṃ prathamamahaḥ, atha śukrāgram, atha dve āgrayaṇāgre, athendravāyavāgram, atha dve śukrāgre, athāyagraṇāgram, atha dve aindravāyavāgre' ityanena vyūhātmakaḥ apratāsampūviśeṣo vihitaḥ |
atra ca apratāsampūviśeṣavācakatvakayopi samūḍhapadārthoddoda- śāhḍe'pi prayogaḥ |
tatra samūḍhasya tāvat phalāśavatvāt prakaraṇāt kratvarthatvaṃ nirvivādameva |
vyūhasya tu 'yaḥ kāmayeta bahu syāṃ prajā- yeyeti, sa vyūhena yajeta' iti vacanena dvādaśāhabhita- vyūhaprakārasya phaloddeśena vidhānāt kāmyatvam |
atra ca āśrayasya anekakartṛkatve'pi ekakāmatayā 'pi guṇā- nuṣṭhānaṃ bhavatīti sucayitumekavacanam |

vyūhasya ca kratvarthatvamapi asti na veti cintā- yām, indriyakāmavākyena dadhnaḥ puruṣārthatve'pi 'dadhnā juhoti' ityanena tasya kratvarthatvavat vyūhasya kāmavākyena puruṣārthatve'pi kratvarthatvasyāpi niruktavākyena upapatteḥ 'dadhnā juhoti' ityanena yuktaṃ kratvarthatvam |
prakṛte tu vyūha- svarūpasya tatpadavācyatvasya ca anyataḥ avagataḥ nirukta- vākyasya tadbodhakatvena ukthyādirūpabodhakavākyavat anyathaitat na kratvarthatvam |
atra ca apratāsampūviśeṣa grahaṇājñattayā kratvarthatve'pi tadānupūrvīpaṭhitasamūhaviśeṣasya vyūhapadavācyasya puruṣārthatvācca ataśca tasya vikṛtau aprayogaḥ |
vi. 10| 215. (trayodaśarātrādīnāṃ āsaṃvatsarāt yāni satrāṇi, teṣāṃ prakṛtitvād dvādaśāhaḥ iti satyāṣāḍhaḥ |
# 'dvādaśāhena yajeta' iti dvādaśānāmahnāṃ saha prayogo vihitaḥ |
tatra ca svasthānaviśuddhiḥ na daṇḍa- kalitavat |
bhā. 10|5|25| 83-87, # dvādaśāhasya ahīnabhūtasya tatra pravṛttiḥ, yatra āśane upādhiśca śrūyate |
vi. 10| 5|4. # dvādaśāhasya ādimasthānāmahnāṃ krameṇa janaka- satrātre dharmātideśaḥ |
bhā. 8|3|13-5. # dvādaśāhasya dvādaśasu ahaḥsu dīkṣāḥ, dvādaśasūṣaḍahaḥ, dvādaśasu sutyāḥ iti ṣaṭtriṃśatā ahobhiḥ samāptiḥ iti svasthānaviśuddhiḥ siddhāntaḥ |
vi. 21|4|15, # dvādaśāhasya yat dvitīya- mahaḥ, tat dvirātrasya prathamamahaḥ |
# dvādaśāhasya vyūhasamūḍhatvaṃ pṛṣṭhavat samāna- vidhānaṃ syāt |
dvādaśāhasya vyūhasamūḍhatvaṃ vyūhatvaṃ ca samāna- vidhānaṃ syāt |
pṛṣṭhavat, yathā bṛhadrathaṃtare pṛṣṭhe prakaraṇasya tulyatvāt samānadharmatvaṃ tadvat |
vyūhaḥ dvādaśāhaḥ samūḍha- vikāraḥ samūḍhasya vikāraḥ syāt |
'aindra- vāyavasya vā etadāyatanaṃ caturthamahaḥ' iti vyūhe śrūyate |
na ca vyūhe caturthe'pi aindravāyavāgratā, kintu āgrayaṇā-
yadi vyūhaḥ samūḍhavikāraḥ syāt tataḥ prakṛti- mapekṣya upapadyate vādaḥ |
aindravāyavasya etadāyatanaṃ prāptaṃ tatra āgrayaṇasya ucyate iti |
tasāt vyūhaḥ samūḍhasya vikāraḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
vyūhe dvādaśāhe kāmasaṃyogaḥ śrūyate 'yaḥ kāmayeta bahuḥ syāṃ prajāyeyeti' iti |
kāmyo vā naimittiko vā nityameva vikṛtya niviśate |
tasya dvādaśāhasya vyūhasamūḍha- rūpasya arṇageṣu aviśeṣeṇa pravṛttiḥ ekakammāt eka- rūpatvāt iti pūrvapakṣe phalam |
yatra vacanaṃ liṅgaṃ vā vyūhasya tatra vyūhasya pravṛttiḥ, anyatra tu aviśeṣeṇa samūḍhasya iti |
mā. 8|2|5|26-29, dvādaśāhasya satrātmakasya dharmānātideśaḥḥ pañcadaśarātrakuṇḍapāyināma- yanayoḥ, satrātvāt |
āsa upaveśane iti dhātunā upaupa- sargapūrvakeṇa iṇ gatau iti dhātunā ca yasya codanaṃ tat satram |
satraśabdā- bhisaṃyogāt 'ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaḥ satramāsate' 'ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaḥ satramupayanti' iti āsadhātoḥ upādhiyātorvā satraśabdena abhisaṃyogāt nityasaṃbandhāt |
'caturviṃśati- paramāḥ samadaśāḥ satramāsīran' iti yajamānabahu- tvasya ca nityasaṃbandhāt |
dvādaśāhasya dvirātrā- dīnāṃ ca yajaticodanāt yajadhātunā vidhānāt ahīna- tvam |
svāmināṃ yajamānānāṃ asthitaparimāṇatvāt ani- yataparimāṇatvācca adhīnatvam |
evaṃ ca yajaticodanatve sati yajamānānāyata parimāṇakatvaṃ ahīnasya lakṣaṇam |
arṇagasādhyatvātkatvamātre tu satre ativyāptiḥ iti dvayorapi niveśaḥ ; yajamānā niyataparimāṇakatvaṃ tu svarūpakathanaṃ na lakṣaṇaghaṭakam |
10|5|25, # dvādaśāhasya svarūpam 1 prāyaṇīyo'tirātraḥ, 2-7 pṛṣṭhyaḥ, 8-10 traya chandomāḥ, 11 ahīnavākyamahaḥ, 12 udayanīyo'tirātra iti dvādaśa ahāni iti |
# dvādaśāhahe adhika aikāhikaiḥ keciddharmā ucyante 'abhiplavaḥ anvā bhavati, gaurivītamanahaṃ bhavati' iti |
bhā. 7|4|3 13, # dvādaśāhe 'adhyurgṛhṇati dīkṣayitvā brahmā dīkṣayati' ityādiḥ kramavidhānāt śrutiḥ |
varṇakaṃ 1. # dvādaśāhe arṇage uttamāhāt prāk patnī saṃyājāntatvam |
vi. 10|6|18, # dvādaśa ātreyāya hiraṇyadānaṃ ṛtuyājayāvaraṇaṃ ca aṣṭāhaḥ kartavyam |
# dvādaśāhe āyasāho dakṣiṇa nayanakālādūrdhvaṃ vidhānātkaḍyanameva syāt |
bhāṣyam- upasatkālaṃ subrahmaṇyāhvānam 'catura sutyāmāgamant maghavan' iti dvādaśāhe codakena prāpyate
caturahe tithau nimantraṇasaṃskṛtasya devadattasya taduttaradinakartavya- āddhabhojane nimantraṇasaṃskṛtatvābhāvata ādyasutyā- māhūtasya indrasya sutyā'ntare upakārakatvānupapatteḥ|
na ca evamapi prākaśanīye sutyodeśyakābhāvene caturahādi- śabdānāṃ viśeṣaṇatvenopādānāt yajñapatiśabdavat parārtha- tvāvagateḥ nādaḥśabdasya abhyāsātmakauhavidhiriti vārti- koktaṃ yuktamiti vācyam|
'agraye juṣṭaṃ' ityādicat kriyāṃ prati viśeṣaṇatāmātraṃ parārthatvānupapatteḥ|
yajñapatipade tu yathā parārthatvam, tathā tadadhikaraṇe spaṣṭam|
ataḥ kartavyaiva trayodaśāhe caturdaśāhe ityevamahaḥ padāvṛttiḥ|
iti iti prāpte, itye ityatra itiśabdaḥ saṃkhyāparaḥ|
itye iti ca samāhāro'yam, tena tāva
navānāmahā aindravāyavāgraṃ prathamamahaḥ, atha śukrāgram, athāgrayaṇāgram |
tatra prathamadvitīyayoḥ ahoḥ aindravāyavāgratā śukrāgratā ca śrūyate |
sā codakanaiva tayoḥ prāptā, rathaṃtarasāmatvāt bṛhatsāmatvāt |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ uditaṃ anuvadituṃ punaḥ śrūyate, kimanyat parisaṃkhyātum, athārthavādārtham, athavā samānavidhvartham |
kutaḥ ? uditaṃ anuvadituṃ hi ucyamāne pravṛttiviśeṣakriyā nāsti |
kathamiva ? prathamadvitīyayoḥ ahoḥ aindravāyavāgratā (śukrāgratā) ca coditā, na tṛtīye ahani |
kathaṃ tarhi śakyam ? vākyenaiva jyotiṣṭome rathaṃtarasāma pravṛttaṃ codakena prāpyate |
yathā 'athāto'gnimagniṣṭomenaivā- nuyajati, tamukthyena, tamatirātreṇa, taṃ caturātreṇa, taṃ pañcarātreṇa, taṃ saptarātreṇa, tamaṣṭarātreṇa, taṃ navarātreṇa, taṃ daśarātreṇa, tamekādaśarātreṇa' iti |
tasya ca prayojanaṃ tattatkratuṣu asatyapi rathaṃtarabṛhatsāmatve aindra- vāyavaśukrāgratayoḥ siddhiḥ |
soma--pradānakramasya bādhābhāve'pi iha parisaṃkhyāyā aṅgāntaraṇāṃ bādhaḥ ityucyateḥ saṃgatiḥ |
anīkaśabdaḥ agratāvācanaḥ, loke śatāgre śatānikaḥ iti vyavahārāt, vede ca 'citraṃ devānāmudagādanīkam' iti prayogācca |
tryanīkā iti ajādeḥ ākṛtigaṇatvāt ṭāp, na tu dvīpa |
tryanīketi gaṇe kītyaiḥ : syādākṛtigaṇo hi saḥ |
na cātra gṛhamedhīyājyabhāganyāyena codakaparilepakatvena aprāptaparisaṃkhyābhavaḥ, agratāyāḥ saṃnipātagrahaṇadharmatayā sākṣāt upakārasaṃkhyavāda iti bhavanāthādayaḥ |
sūtrārthastu--tryanīkāyāṃ codakaprāpteṣu aindravāyavāgratvādiṣu yat punarāmnānam, tat arthavādāye syāt iti |
pari- saṃkhyā vā'rthavādo vā vidhirvā, nahi nayam |
bhāṭṭa--dvādaśāhe dvādaśapi ahassu grahāgratā vihitā 'aindravāyavāgro prāyaṇīyodayanīyau daśa cāhaḥ, athaitareṣāṃ navānāmahāmaindravāyavāgraṃ prathamamahaḥ, atha śukrāgram, athāgrayaṇāgram |
ataśca tatra ahannarantareṣu bṛhadrathaṃtara- sāmakalātvāt agratāvidhiḥ apūrvavidhiveva |
āgrayaṇestu rathaṃtarabṛhatsāmakatvāt tannaimittiko'aindravāyavāgrava- śukrāgranavyoḥ atideśenaiva parisaṃbhave punastatra tacchravaṇaṃ kimarthamiti bādhopayogitayā cintyate |
tatra āgrayabhāga- nyāyena aṅgāntaraparisaṃkhyārthe ityataḥ pakṣaḥ |
dvitīyastu sā hi gṛhamedhīyapañcamapakṣanyāyena prāptaparisaṃkhyā vā syāt, tadīyādyamahapakṣanyāyena apūrvavyapanādā aprāptaparisaṃkhyā vā ? nādyaḥ, traidoṣyāpatteḥ |
nānyaḥ, sati anyasmin laghubhūte prayojane parisaṃkhyāphalakatvasya anyāyyatvāt |
ataḥ ekatrākyatālābha 'ekaṃ vṛṇīte' 'dvādaśāhinas' 'upāṃśumagras' ityādipat āgrayaṇāgratāvidhereva ayamarthavādaḥ aucityena tastulyarthaḥ, na tu vidhayantarasya vākyabhedāpatteriti |
anyathā 'idaṃ tu āgrayaṇāgram' ityuktvāpatti -vā athaśabdājjñātvāt vākyatrayamevedaṃ anīkāntaravākye iva |
tatraprayojanaṃ ca atideśapravṛtteḥ pūrvaṃ etadvākyena aindravāyavāgravaśukrāgrayorivodhi atideśasya etadvidha- yatvātkalpanāt anaimittikatvasiddhereva |
tatphalaṃ ca tatta- dvikṛtiṣu asatyapi nimitte tattadgratāsiddhiḥ |
anyathā aniyamena yasyakasyacidgrahasya prāthamyaṃ prakṛtidṛṣṭapāṭhā- nurodhādvā aindravāyavasya syāditi pūrvapakṣe aṅgāntaraṇāṃ parisaṃkhyātvācca vācopayogitā |
' dvādaśāhe dīkṣāṇāmagrahaṃ dvādaśādhikaṃ śataṃ vibhajya dīyate |
vi. 10|6|18. dvādaśāhe daśa saumikāni ahaḥsaṃyuktāni karmāpyutpadyante |
tāni utpannāni sākṣādvā 'dvādaśāhaina prajākāmaṃ yājayet' iti phale vidhīyante |
ṭup. 11|4|15. dvādaśāhe daśamahasāho mānasa- graheṇa samāpanaṃ vācanikam |
[ atratyaṃ bhāṣyaṃ vārtikaṃ ca 'jyotiṣṭome ekādīnāṃ dīkṣāṇāṃ vikalpaḥ' (6|5|8-29 mī. ko. pṛ. 1790) iti grintho gṛhyatām |
] śā--dvādaśāhe 'ṣaṭtriṃśadaho vā eṣaḥ', yad dvādaśāhaḥ' iti liṅgāt dīkṣā dvādaśa iti gamyate |
' bhāṭṭa--dvādaśāheṣu 'dvādaśarātrīdīkṣitaḥ syāt' iti vākyena yavamayaśrutivat dvādaśadīkṣākatvasya niyama- nācca vikalpa iti pratyudāharaṇamātram |
ata eva 'ṣaṭ- triṃśadaho vā eṣa dvādaśāhaḥ' iti liṅgaṃ upasatsulānāṃ dvādaśasya pramāṇāntarasiddhatvāt dīkṣā api dvādaśa gamayati |
tathā 'amīṣṭe eva dīkṣābhiḥ' iti dīkṣā bahulaṃ vidhāya 'dvābhyāṃ lomāvahanti dvābhyāṃ tvacaṃ dvābhyā maskṛd dvābhyāṃ māṃsaṃ dvābhyāmistha dvābhyāṃ majjānam' iti tadākhyāśeṣe ṣaḍdīkṣākatvakramamapi |
vi. 9|19. dvādaśāhe dīkṣāṇā mupasadāṃ ca sasthānavivṛddhayā prayogaḥ |
vi. 5|1|1 varṣa 3. dvādaśāhe dīkṣopasatsulānāṃ pratyekaṃ dvādaśadinasādhyatvam, tena ṣaṭtriṃśadahatvam |

tatra vicāryate kimekaikaḥ dīkṣopa sadena (dvaṃdvasya dakārāntāt ac samāsāntaḥ : 'dvaṃdvañca dapahāntāt' ityanena ) ahaḥ saṃpāya dvādaśa pañcaviśa tirātraḥ kartavyaḥ (dīkṣāḥ 12, upasadaḥ 12, eva sulā iti ekaikam : pañcaviśatirātram), athavā dvādaśa sādhyasāḥ, ( ekaikasmin ahani ekaikaṃ dīkṣopasa sutyamiti ), athavā caturhe dīkṣāḥ, caturhe upasadaḥ caturhe sutyāḥ, athavā svasthānānāṃ dīkṣopasatsutyāna vicchidyeti |
kiṃ prāptam ? tat sūtreṇoktam : 'dvāda śāhe tatprakṛtitvāt ekaikamharapayujyate karmapṛthaktvāt ' apayujyate |
sadīkṣopasad ahaḥ apavarjitaṃ jyotiṣṭome yataḥ : tatprakṛtyanteni dvādaśāhāni pṛthagbhūtāni karmāṇi pṛthakvenaiva dharmānāhakantaḥ |
ṭup--prakṛtau upāṃśvadeḥ hāriyojanaparyantasya yāgasya ahaḥśabdo paricchedako dṛṣṭaḥ |
yacca tat karma lakṣyate, anena (vākyena) tadutpadyate|
evaṃ daśa saumikāṇi ahaḥsaṃyuktāni karmāṇi utpadyante, aparo praṇīyodayanīyau (atirātrau amito daśāhaṃ śrūyate), tāvapi lakṣaṇayā karma pratipādayataḥ|
tāni ca utpannāni (phalaṃ prati) sāṅgākṣṇā 'dvādaśāhrena prajākāmaṃ yājayet' iti (yajinā) phale vidhīyante tatra dvādaśāha- śabdaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyāt yāgena ayamapi karmavacano na laukikamahenartheti|
tatra ekaiko yāgaḥ phalasādhanatvāt jyoti- ṣṭomāt vidhayantaṃ gṛhṇāti|
' atideśināmupasadāṃ dīkṣāṇāṃ ca prākṛtasaṃkhyāvādhanāya pṛthak dvādaśatvaṃ śrutam |
tato dīkṣopasadayaṃ caturviṃśatidināni, sutyā'rthamekaṃ dinamiti pañcaviṃśatiḥ |
tathā sati ahāṃ dvādaśatvaṃ śrūmāṇaṃ bādhyeta |
tadā'pi dīkṣopasadabhyā- mupetasya ekaikasyāhaḥ sāṅgatvaṃ dīkṣopasadabhyāmeva— sadyaḥ eva kartavyam ( iti dvādaśa sādhyaskāḥ ) |
prakṛtau dīkṣopasadarthyupakālāt prāgeva anuṣṭhita- tvāt ihāpi tathaivānuṣṭhānaṃ prāptam |
tasmāt aṅgadvayasya pradhānasya ca dvādaśa dināni vibhajya anuṣṭhānam, iti pakṣāntaram |
' dvādaśaiva dīkṣāḥ, dvādaśopasadaḥ ' iti aṅgayoḥ mukhyavat pṛthak dvādaśatvabhṛtyā ṣaṭtriṃśat iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhāṭṭa— dvādaśāhe dvādaśadīkṣāḥ dvādaśopasadaḥ dvādaśasutyāśca vihitāḥ |

tatra ' dvādaśāhena prajākāmaṃ yājayet ' ityanena dvādaśānāṃ sutyānāṃ phalasaṃbandhe ava- gate pratyekadidaśaprāptadīkṣopasadṛvadādaśatvaparyantā- vidhau ekaikā sutyā pratyekaṃ dvādaśasaṃkhyākadīkṣopasadyuktā kartavyeti dvādaśa pañcaviṃśatirātrāḥ saṃpadyante |
na ca dvādaśāpadasya dvādaśadinātmakatvādidhāyitvāt katha- metāvaddinasādhyatveti vācyam |
ahaḥśabdasya sutyātmaka- ṛtuvācinvena dvādaśasaṃkhyākasutyātmakatvasya prāptatvena tasya nāmadheyatvāditi prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ |
na ahaḥśabdasya kratau rūḍhiḥ, api tu dine eva śakasya ṛtuviśeṣe niruḍha- lakṣaṇayā prayogāt |
ataśca sāṃtapanīyā- nyāyena ( 5|1|17 ) atideśikālatvādvā sāṅgānāṃ dvādaśasutyānāṃ dvādaśadinasamāptyavāptaḥ |
ekasminnahani dvādaśasaṃkhyākadīkṣopasadyuttaikā sutyāmapyeti dvādaśa sādhyaskāḥ kartavyā iti dvitīyaḥ |
sāhityena eka phalasādhanānāṃ dvādaśānāmapi sutyānāṃ tathācaiva tantreṇaiva niruktasaṃkhyākadīkṣopasadyutkaraṇopapatteḥ tadādyuccau pramāṇā- bhāvaḥ |
ataśca aupadeśikakālānurodhāt ādyadine eva niruktasaṃkhyākadīkṣopasadādikaṃ sasulyaṃ sarvaṃ samāpya dvādaśa sutyā ekaikasmindine kartavyāḥ |
yattu asmin pakṣe ' caturahe dīkṣāḥ, caturahe upasadaḥ, caturahe sutyāḥ ' iti mūle anuṣṭhānamuktam, tat pramāṇābhāvād- pekṣitam |

siddhāntastu— ahaḥpadasya kālaparatve dvādaśahamitāpatteḥ yāgasāmānādhikaraṇyena ahaḥśabdasya nirūḍhalakṣaṇayā yāgaparatvāvaśyaṃbhāvāt tasya ca sutyātma- katvena ahaḥsādhyatvasya pramāṇāntareṇaiva prāpteḥ nānena sāṅge kālavidhiḥ |
apitu sarvapradhānānāṃ dvādaśadinātmakakāla- sādhyatvāt tatprakhyanyāyena nāmadheyameva dvādaśāhaśabdaḥ |
ataśca atideśānurodhāt sutyāto bahireva dvādaśāhaṃ dīkṣāḥ dvādaśāhaṃ copasadaḥ kṛtvā dvādaśāhaṃ sutyāḥ kartavyāḥ |
evaṃ ca ' ṣaṭtriṃśadaho vā epaḥ yad dvādaśāhaḥ ' iti liṅgamanupapadyate |
' ṣaṭ ca trīṇi ca ahāni yasya saḥ ṣaṭtryahaḥ |
' aṅgānāṃ vāmato gatiḥ ' iti rītayā ṣaḍdaśasya ca niveśe 36 iti ṣaṭtriṃśadinātmakatvaṃ sidhyati |
ante sutyā, tasyā api tasthānāyā eva viśuddhiḥ |
dvādaśāhe dīkṣāvākye ' padārthoccāraṇāt yaḥ kramaḥ pratī- yate, sa eva vidhīyate ' |
atra prāguktamādahaḥ yānītarāṇyahāni teṣveva daśamavajai patnīsaṃyājāntatvaṃ vyavasthitam |
kintu tādṛśasya hāriyojanādeḥ barhiḥprahara- ṇāntasya dvādaśa'hani patnīsaṃyājānte anuṣṭhānam |
vi. 9|1|9. dvāda- śāhe purastāt paryāsāt āgantavo bhavanti bahiṣpava- māne |
dvādaśāhasya pāḍahike dvitīya'- hani stotriyānusapī paṭhitvā apūrvāttvāḥ paṭhyante, tata uttaraḥ paryāsaḥ paṭhitaḥ |
' stotriyānurūpau tuco bhavataḥ, vṛṣaṇvanta- stucā bhavanti, tuca uttamaḥ paryāsaḥ ' iti |
tatra ' vāyurasi ' ityādayaḥ daśa mantrāḥ pṛśrayo nāma, ' ayaṃ puro bhuvaḥ ' ityādayaḥ daśa mantrāḥ prāṇā nāma |
saṃkalpa. 3|2|19. dvādaśāhe pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍaha utpannaḥ, sa prakṛtirūpaḥ |
vi. 10|6|3. dvādaśāhe pratyahaṃ sutrahaṇayāmedhaḥ ' saṃkṣitesaṃvitsaha ahāni ' iti vīpsā- vacanāt |
bhā. 11|4|6|25. dvādaśāhe prathamamahaḥ prāyaṇīyam, uttamamahaḥ udayanīyam |
vi. 10|5|14, dvādaśāhe prathamamahaḥ prāyaṇīyam, gavāmayane ca prathamamahaḥ prāyaṇīyam, tayoḥ prakṛtivikṛtibhāvo nāsti |
vā. 7|4|13|9. dvādaśāhe mānaso grahaḥ ' anayā tvā pṛthivyā pātreṇa samudrasyatvā prajāpataye tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi iti mānasaṃ prājāpatyaṃ gṛhṇāti ' iti vihitaḥ |
ayaṃ mānasaḥ daśamasyāha'ṅgaṃ na bhinnaḥ iti daśame'nveva kartavyaḥ |
vi. 10|6|13. dvādaśāhe yogavimokau ' aharhayannakti, aharhavimuñcati ' iti prāyahikayoga- darśanaṃ pradhānamātrātharve tadbhedena medopapatterupapannam |
itarathā sarvārthatayoḥ sakṛdeva abhiyogavimokayoḥ prāpyā- patteḥ iti bhāṣyakāreṇa siddhāntitam |
dvādaśāhe vyūhe 'yanīkā ' aindravāyavāgrau prāyaṇīyo- dayanīyau, ayeteṣāṃ daśānamahā aindravāyavāgraṃ prathamamahaḥ, atha śukrāgram, atha dve āgrayaṇāgre |
tatra prathame dvitīye pañcame daśamekādaśa'hoṣu aindravāyavāgram |
tṛtīye saptamādyośca śukrāgra- m, caturthāṣṭamayordve ca āgrayaṇāgram |
dvādaśāhe vyūhe bhakṣapavamānaparidhikapāla- mantratānāṃ gāyatrādiśabdānāmeva vyatikramo nārthinām |
chandovyatikramād vyūhe bhakṣapavamānaparidhi- kapālasya mantrāṇāṃ yathottapattivanamūhavat syāt |

bhāṣyam— asti dvādaśāhaḥ, samūḍho vyūhaśca tatra vyūhaḥ ' aindravāyavāgrau prāyaṇīyodayanīyau, atheteṣa daśānamahāmaindravāyavāgraṃ prathamamahaḥ, atha śukrāgram, atha dve āgrayaṇe, athendravāyavāgram, atha dve śukrāgre, athā- grayaṇāgram, atha dve aindravāyavāgre ' iti |
tatra vyūha idaṃ samānamasti ' chandāṃsi vā anyonyasya lokamabhiyāyanti gāyatrī triṣṭubham ; triṣṭub jagatyāḥ ; jagatī gāyatryāḥ ' iti |

mahāstavāta ' bhakṣe ( omāloha eti pararūpam ) mā ( māṃ prati ) viśa dīrghāyutvāya śāṃtanuvāya, ehi vaso purovaso priyo me hudo'si, aśvinostvā bāhubhyāṃ sadyāsam, vasumdraṇas rudravadraṇas ādityavadraṇas ( iti padatrayaṃ savanatraye krameṇa yojyam ) soma deva te matividaḥ ; prātasvanasya mādhyandinasya savanasya tṛtīyasavanasya ( savanatraye yathāyathaṃ krameṇa yojanīyāni ) gāyatracchandasaḥ triṣṭupchandasa jagatīcchandasaḥ ( savanatraye krameṇa yojanīyāni trīṇi padāni ) agniṣṭa indrapītasya madhumata upahūtasyo pahuto bhakṣayāmi ' iti |
tathā pavamānaḥ ; ' iyeno'si gāyatracchandāḥ ; suparṇo'si triṣṭupchandāḥ ; saghā'si jagatīcchandāḥ ; anu tvā''gne svasti mā saṃpāraya ' iti ca |
tathā paridhayaḥ ; gāyatro madhyamaḥ paridhiḥ ; caitrame dakṣiṇaḥ ; jagata uttaraḥ iti |
tathā kapālāni, aṣṭā kapālaḥ prātasvana, ekādaśakapālo mādhyandinaḥ : dvādaśakapālastṛtīyasavanikaḥ iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ ; hi chandovyatikrame vyatikramo bhakṣamantrāṇāṃ bhakṣasya ca pavamānamantrāṇāṃ pavamānasya ca , tathā paridhīnāṃ kapālā- ca, athavā mantrāṇāṃ chandovyatikrama iti |
lokammidhyāyanti, gāyatrī triṣṭubhaḥ, triṣṭub jagatyāḥ, jagatī gāyatryāḥ' iti |
na viśeṣaḥ śrūyate mantrāṇāṃ vyatikrama iti |
ato madhyamaḥ paridhirdakṣiṇasthāne sthāpayitavyaḥ, dakṣiṇaḥ uttarasya, uttaro madhyameti |
aṣṭākapāle mādhyaṃdanīyaḥ kāryaḥ, ekādaśakapālastārtīyasavanikaḥ, dvādaśakapālaḥ prātaḥsavanīyaḥ iti |
tathā, prātaḥsavanīyo bhakṣo mādhyaṃ- dinasya bhakṣaṇasya sthāne bhakṣayitavyaḥ, mādhyaṃdinastārtīya- savanikasya, tārtīyasavanaḥ prātaḥsavanīyasyeti |
tathā, bahiṣpavamāno mādhyaṃdinasya pavamānasya loke, [ sthāne ] mādhyaṃdina ābharvasya, ābharvo bahiṣpavamānasyeti |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? śakyante mantragatāni viparya- sita
vacanāt yuktaḥ, na tu codakāt pratyakṣavacanasya saṃkocaḥ' ityabhyupagamaḥ |
vi-- 'madhvabhakṣyaṃ bhakṣyate vā satribhir, brahma- cāriṇaḥ |
' bhāṭṭa-- dvādaśāhe gṛhapativratāni 'na bahu vadet, saṃsthite ṣaḍahe madhvāśayet ghṛtaṃ vā' ityādīni |
atra āśayet ityasya ṇijantatvāt prakṛtān adhvarvādīniti saṃcayate |
ataśca adhvarvādibhirtkartṛkaṃ madhvaśanamapi ṣaḍa- hāṅgatvenādṛṣṭārthe vidhinā vidhīyate |

tacca teṣāṃ satrātmakadvādaśāhe bhavet na vā, iti cintāyām, satre adhvarvādīnāṃ yajamānatvena dīkṣitātvāt, dīkṣitānāṃ ca brahmacaryavidhānāt, brahmacāriṇaśca madhvabhakṣaṇapratiṣedhāt, ṣaḍahasya ca vratabhakṣaṇenāpi sāṅgatopapatteḥ, madhvaśana- viśeṣādhīnaviṣayatvenāpyupapatteḥ, na satre madhvaśanam |

iti prāpte, brahmacaryāśramapuraskāreṇoktasya madhvarjanasya gṛhasthādhikārake satre aprakteḥ, dīkṣitapuraskāreṇoktasya brahmacaryasya ca maithunavarjanarūpatvena madhvarjanarūpatvābhāvāt, tadupanve'pi vā rāgaprāptamadhvabhakṣaṇaviṣayatvena tasya madhvadha- bhakṣaṇaviṣayatvābhāvāt, tadviṣayatve'pi vā tasyehātideśa- prāptatvena aupadeśikamadhvabhakṣaṇe ahīnamātraviṣayatāyāḥ kalpayitumaśakyatvāt ahīnavat satre'pi madhvabhṛtayo- rvikalpaḥ |
' dvādaśāhe satrarūpe dīkṣāvākye ānupūrvyeṇa kīrtya- mānānāṃ dīkṣāṇāṃ vitativiśeṣaḥ pratīyate sa eva vidhī- yate |
anabhi- hito'pi prātisvikena vidhinā vidhīyamānatvāt śruti- krama ityucyate |
yadā tu paurvāparya kramaḥ tadā kvā- śabdena tadabhimānāt anabhidhānaṃ nāsti pratidīkṣaṃ ca tadbhedāt nānā vākyāni iti vivekaḥ |
dvādaśāhe samūhe tryanīkā 'aindravāyavāgro prāyaṇīyo- dayanīyau daśamaṃ cāhaḥ |
athetareṣāṃ navānāmahnāṃ aindra- vāyavāgraṃ prathamahaḥ, atha śukrāgram, athāyamagrāgram |
dvitīyādinavamā- ntāni aṣṭa ekādaśa ceti navasu ahaḥsu madhye dvitīye pañcame aṣṭame cāhani aindravāyavāgram |
prāyaṇīyaṃ udayanīyaṃ daśamaṃ cāhaḥ : aindravāyavāgrameva iti |
vi. 10|5|23, dvādaśāhe savanīyapaśvādikamapi medanenānuṣṭheyaṃ na tu sakṛt, mukhyakālanāṃ medāt |
bhedastu tadbhedāt, karmabhedaḥ prayoge syāt, teṣāṃ pradhānaśabdatvāt |
bhāṣyam-- atha yāni pradhānaiḥ apṛthakkānāni aṅgāni teṣu cintyate kiṃ tānyapi tantraṃ athavā bhedeneti |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? evaṃ sahavasya vaktā prayogavacano'nugṛhyate 'dvādaśāhena prajākāmaṃ yājayet' iti |
kathaṃ punarjñānāṃ kālamedo vijñāyate ? teṣāṃ pradhānaśabda- tvāt |
bhāṣyam-- 'patnīsaṃyājāntānyahāni saṃtiṣṭhante' iti medenāhnāṃ patnīsaṃyājāntā darśayati |
bhāṣyam-- 'saṃsthitesaṃsthite'hanmayīdāmīśrāgāraṃ praviśya subrahmaṇya subrahmaṇyamāhayati preṣyati' iti, saṃsthitesaṃsthite iti vīpsāvacanāt subrahmaṇyamedaṃ darśayati |
bhāṣyam-- paśvatirekhaḥ dṛśyate 'ya ekaḥ paśurati- ricyate, sa aindrāmaḥ kāryaḥ' iti |
na tāvadatiricyate, yathaikeko na bhavati ekādaśa ete paśavaḥ, dvādaśāhāni |
soma-- dīkṣādivat sutyākālanāmaṅgānāmapi tantratvaṃ ityucyateḥ saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu-- yataḥ kālamedāt pradhānakarmaṇāmanuṣṭhābhedaḥ, ataḥ proge aṅgānāmapi medaḥ syāt, teṣāṃ pradhānavidhiceyatvāt iti |
vi-- 'savanīyādikaṃ tantra sakṛt syād bhidyate- 'thavā, prayogaikyāt sakṛt, naivaṃ mukhyakāle vidhānataḥ |
' bhāṭṭa-- tadevaṃ sutyāvibhūtānāṃ dīkṣopasadādīnā- magnīṣomīyājñānāṃ tantratvāt, patnīsaṃyājottarakālīnānāṃ ca tantratvāt, ekopamāvasānatvena dīkṣāṇāmapi sutyānāmekaprayogatvaṃ tāvadavivādam |
ahīnātmake ca tasmin dakṣiṇaikatvasya sthāpitatvādi tathā |
ataśca sutyākālīnānāmapi ārādupakārakāṇāmaṅgānāṃ savanīya- paśusavanīyaherādīnāmapi tantratvameva |
na ca gṛhmāṇa- viśeṣatvāt teṣāmāvṛttiḥ, tajjanyopakārasya agnīṣomī- yādijanyopakārasya dvādaśāhaparamparāye yāvat avasthite- rāvaśyakatvena punaḥpunaḥ karaṇe prayojanābhāvāt |

yadi tu prakṛtau paramāpūrvasya atiriktasyābhāvāt, sarvābhyāsā- pūrvajanyatātparya pratyekaṃ sarveṣāmupayogatvāt, dvādaśāhe tatsutyāpūrvāṇāṃ medāt sutyākālīnāṅgānāmāvṛttirityacyate, tatastadakālīnānāmapi prakṛtau tadapūrvaprayuktatvāt tadbhedaina tadbhedaḥpattiḥ |
atha etanmede'pi prajādāviva antimāpūrveṇa agnīṣomīyādijanyopakārān sākṛtveda karaṇamityucyate, tataḥ savanīyajanyopakārasyāpi tenaiva nāśāt pratisutyaṃ karaṇe pramāṇābhāvaḥ |
nahi agnīṣomī- yādau paramāpūrvaprayuktatvaṃ savanīyasya ca sutyāpūrvamuktatvaṃ ityatra pramāṇamasti, prakṛtau ekāpūrve pratyekaṃ sarveṣāmupa- yogāt |

iti prāpte, 'prāyaṇīyaṃ prathamahaḥ' ityā- dyupattiyeṣu ahaḥpadena ahaḥsādhyasyā'bhidhānāt ahaḥkālaviśiṣṭasyāsyakarmaṇovidhipratīteḥ, kālavidhau satyapi mahāprayogaikye sutyāmātkālīnasyāṅgasya prayogaviśeṣāvaśyakatvāt tāvadayogaviśimedādeva tat kṣīnājñānāmāvṛttiḥ |
ata ca 'patnīsaṃyājāntānyahāni saṃtiṣṭhante, saṃsthitesaṃsthite'ha agnīṣomīyāgāraṃ praviśya subrahmaṇya subrahmaṇyamāhaye preṣyati' ityādidarśanānyapi ārādupakārakāṅgānāṃ upapadyante |
dvādaśāhe sutyākālīnasubrahmaṇyahvānasyāvṛttiḥ bhā. 11|3|11|12-32. dvādaśāhe somopāvahara dvādaśeḍani mānavāsaiva, na tasmin ahani vā pṛthak |
iteṣu ahaḥsu tu tat pratyekaṃ bhinnam |
dvādaśāhau ahargaṇe upasatkālīnaṃ subrahmaṇya hānaṃ pradhānamede'pi na bhidyate, kintu tantram |
dvi 11|3|10, dvādaśāhau ahargaṇe pratyahaṃ kriyamāṇa somopāvaharaṇasyaḥ upāvaharaṇakāle eva kartavyaṃ mānakāle |
10|6|12, dvādaśāhau ahargaṇe vahi ṣavamāne udgātrāpacchede sarvo'hargaṇe nāvartanīyaḥ |
bhāṭṭa. 10|6|19. dvādaśāhau ahargaṇe havirdhānaśakaṭai avasthitāt somāt pratya kriyāt somabhāgaḥ pṛthakkṛtyopāvaharaṇyaḥ |
tacca vāsaḥsaṃpāda upāvaharaṇakāle eva na mānakāle, uttamāhani tu māna vāsasyaivopāvaharaṇam |
bhā. 8|1|8|29, dvādaśāhagate pṛṣṭhe ṣaḍahe caturthe'hni naiśokaṃ nāma sāma uttaragranthapaṭhitayoruttarayoryuhayoreva geyam |
9|2| 5|21-24 varṇanaṃ 2. dvādaśāhagate pṛṣṭhe ṣaḍahe prakṛtirūpe, ṣaṭ‌su ahaḥsu krameṇa rathantara--bṛhat-vairūpa- vairāja-śākkara-raivatāni sāmāni vihitāni |
vi. 10|6|3, dvādaśāhagate pṛṣṭhe ṣaḍahe madhyasthānaṃ trayastriṃśo'hni kartavyam, gavāmayane uttare pakṣasi tu trivṛtsaṃnidhau kartavyam |
bhā. 7|3|15. dvādaśāhadharmāṇāṃ pañcoktha-śatoktha-śatāgni- ṣṭoma-śatātirātrādiṣu saṃsthāgaṇe atideśaḥ, parantu tatratatra tat-saṃsthatā |
sārasvate hi ( satre mitrā- varuṇayoranya nāma ) dvādaśāhanyāyena ubhayoḥ pakṣayoḥ ( darśanaṃ ) jyotiṣṭomapūrvattvāt |
vā. 4|4|28. dvādaśāhaprakaraṇe ' dvādaśopasadaḥ ' iti vihita- tvāt tanprakṛtivena sarvāhīneṣu tatprāptiḥ |
vā. 3|3|8| 16 pṛ. 814. dvādaśāhaprakṛtikeṣvapi satrāhīneṣu vṛṣaṇvatāmeva tṛcānāṃ codakavaśāt prāk paryāptānveṣaḥ, anyeṣāṃ tu paryāptottarameva bahiṣpavamāne |
8|1|4|18-9. dvādaśāhikasaptāharāṇāṃ janakasamarātre ati- deśaḥ, tatra agrimacaturhe tribhṛtā vidhīyate |
bhā. 8|2|13-5. dviravadānaṃ dadhno gṛhītvā payaso grāhyam |
kalpasūtre tu payaso dviravadānaṃ gṛhītvā paścāt dadhnaḥ ityuktam, taittirīya- śrutau tādṛśakramasya vācanikatvāt |
vasānaśabdataścārthaḥ: ādhānena saṃdhyate, na kṣaumaśabda- gataḥ |
āha, vasānau iti nāyaṃ kevalaṃ puṃliṅga eva strīpuṃsorapi abhidhāyako bhavati |
yathā kukkuṭaśca kukkuṭī ca kukkuṭau, śvarakaśca śvakarī ca śvakarau iti |
evaṃ vasānaśca vasānā ca vasānau khātāmiti |
yatra nārthaḥ prakaraṇaṃ vā viśeṣakam, vidhāyakam śabdo nāmuvādaḥ, tatra dvau pumāṃsau gamyete |
yathā 'dvau ānaya' ityuktaḥ pumāṃsau ānayati, 'dve ānaya' iti striyau |
tena striyo vācakamakārāntaṃ dvivacanaṃ iti gamyate, okārāntamapi dvayoḥ puṃsorvācaka miti |
yatra idānīṃ strīpuṃsayoḥ prayujyamānaṃ okārāntaṃ dṛśyate tatra kiṃ pumān dvitīyaḥ tasya nimittam, uta strī dvitīyatā iti |
puṃsi dvitīyate dṛṣṭaḥ, yathā 'brāhmaṇī ānaya' iti |
atrāha, prayogo yadi dṛṣṭaṃ pramāṇaṃ dvayoḥ puṃsordvahaḥ, kathamekasmin syāt ? atrocyate |
puṃsi ca dvitve ca dṛṣṭaḥ iti śakyate vaditum, na dvayordvayo- riti |
puṃbhāvaṃ dvitvaṃ ca eṣa śabdo na vyabhicarati, dravyaṃ punarvyabhicarati |
api ca yugapadadhikaraṇavacana- tāyāṃ dvaṃdvasmṛteḥ dvivacanabahuvacanopapatteśca |
itaretarayoge cārthe samāsa- vidhānāt dvaṃdvāpavādaśca ekaśeṣaśca |
yathaiva khadirau ca dhavau ca iti nidarśanaṃ kriyate, evamatrāpi draṣṭavyam |
tasāt puṃsi dvitve ca vartate iti gamyate |
atrāha, nanu atraiva darśanāt strīpuṃsorvācaka iti gamyate |
uktametat anyārthānekārtha- tvamiti, iti pumān dvitīyaḥ asyārtho bhaviṣyati
na dvau mitrau staḥ, na varuṇau, tatra (pratyekam) dvivacanaṃ nopapadyate, anyonyā- pekṣāyām (tu) ghaṭate (tataśca dvaṃdve yugapadvacanatā niśrīyate ) iti |
itaścaivamityāha- ) 'itaretarayoge cārthe dvaṃda- vidhānāt' (samāsavidhānāt iti bhā-pāṭhaḥ) iti cakāraḥ - samuccaya- anvācaya- itaretarayoga- samāhāreṣu vartate |
tatra samuccayānvācayayoḥ nāsti samāsaḥ, samā- hāretaretarayogayoreva (tu samāsaḥ) |
prakṛte kimāyātaṃ ityata āha-) dvaṃdvapāvatvācca ekaśeṣasya iti |
(tada vyācaṣṭe-) yo hi dvaṃdva dharmaḥ (anekeṣām) itaretarayogo nāma, sa ekaśeṣasyāpi |
iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ (dvaṃdaikaśeṣayoḥ) , ekatra (dvaṃdve) śabdaśca arthaśca dvāvapi bhinnau, itaratra (ekaśeṣe) artho bhinnaḥ, śabda eka eva |
(yatra śabdaśca arthaśca dvāvapi bhinnau tatra dvaṃdvaḥ : dhvavadirādau |
yatra tu anyatarasyāpi aikyam, tatra ekaśeṣaḥ akṣāḥ pādāḥ ityādī vakradaṇḍau ityādī ca) |
vasāno ityekaśeṣatvāt dvitīyena puṃsā bhi- nnaḥ |
sa itara- sabhyapekṣaḥ, tasya pumāneva dvitīyaḥ |
puṃsaḥ asti parya- pasthāpakam (okāraḥ) , na kriyāḥ |
yatra strīpuṃsau sahoccāryete, tatra pumān dvitīyaḥ iti okārāntaḥ prāpnoti, strī saddhitīyā iti ekārāntaḥ |
(vasāno ityatra tu-) okāraḥ prayujyamānaḥ (puṃditve) sādhuḥ, (tasya) na strīpuṃsau vācyau |
[ asyaiva sūtrasya ṭippaṇīkṛtaiva dvitīyā vyākhyā kṛtā |
sā ca ānandāśramīye pustake caturvidhasūtra- vyākhyottaraṃ mudritā'pi asāmiḥ yogyatā mayaiva likhyate |
sā ceyaṃ vyākhyā asmadīye likhite pustake nāsti |
ṭup- (etadeva sūtraṃ vispaṣṭīkaraṇāya vārtikakāreṇa punarvyākhyātām ) pūrvādhikaraṇe ekavacanaṃ mithunābhiprāyaṃ saṃsargābhiprāyaṃ (daṃpatīnidhrmāsañje'vṛttikametanvābhiprāyam ) vā ityuktam |
(de kārakaśaktī dve ca (vāśabdārthe caśabdeḥ) ) nipuṇe bravīti ityanena praśnaṃ ārabhyate |
(itaścaivamityāha-) 'vasānau ādadhī- yātām' iti sāmānādhikaraṇyata upapadyate saṃbandhaḥ |
(dopāntaramāha-) saṃbadhyamānaṃ ca ādhānasya adhikaraṇaṃ syāt (kṣaume iti saptamī syāt, tadadhikaraṇakaṃ ca atrādhānam, iti |
śakyate-) kṣaumavasānasaṃbandhe (sati) na sāmānādhikaraṇyam (bādhakam,) adhikaraṇadoṣaśca nāsti, iti cet |
(aya pradhānabhūtena kanaiva kṣaumaṃ saṃbadhyate, tatrā-) karmo'pi nāsti saṃbandhaḥ |
(atha-) vasanakriyā kartṛpasarjanabhūtā'pi punāvirparitya (kṣaumena) saṃbadhyate iti cet (uttaram-) na |
(kutaḥ ?) vidhīyamānā hi kriyā bhāvyamānatvāt (kartavyatvāt) kārakaiḥ saṃbadhyate |
(kasmāt iyata āha-) avidhīyamāne (vasane) kṣaumaṃ saṃbadhyamānaṃ laukike'pi syāt |
) kiñca (asmin pakṣe) kṣaumavasānayoḥ saṃbandhaṃ āda- dhīyātāṃ iti (vidhiḥ) kuryāt |
vādhamevāha-) pratyayaḥ upaśleṣa- lakṣaṇayā (ekadravyasācilakṣaṇayā) śrutyā dhātvarthe vidhatte, tadajñaṃ vā (kiñcit) |
iha dvayamapi na vidhatte dhātvartham, dhātvarthasya vā anyata, tatparāyāḥ śruteḥ (dhātvarthatadvyapaparāyaḥ) vidhiśruteḥ |
(maghne tu ādhānajñātvā) vasānau iti (puṃdvaye) vidhīyāne dhātvarthe kiñcidvidhānāt śrutiḥ anugṛhītā (bhavati |
kiñca) vasānaśabdasyāpi ekapadopāttatvāt okāreṇa śrutyā saṃbandhaḥ |
kṣaumeṇa (tu saṃbandhe) padā- ntaropāttatvāt vākyatā śrutiśca vākyat balīyasī |

(bhāṣyakāreṇa vasānau ityatra puṃdvayaṃ pratipāditam, tatra codayati-) kasmāt punaḥ pūrvapakṣavādinā anumānena dvitīyaḥ pumā- niṣpadyate, na punaḥ okāreṇa dvau pumāṃsau abhīdhīyate iti bravīti, yena siddhāntavādinaḥ paricodadaiva nottiṣṭhati |
yadi (dvau) pumāṃsau vācyau iti trayāt, ta
(vaidika- mapi liṅgaṃ pradarśayate-) 'pra mitayorvairaṇyayoḥ' iti darśanāt (iti bhāṣyam) iha miśrasya ekatvāt varuṇasya ca, dvivacanaṃ na prāpnoti (tena yugapadabhidhānatā gamyate) |
tatra samuccaye 'dhavamānaya, khadiramānaya' iti (nirapekṣayoḥ kriyānvayāt) samāso nāsti |
anvācaye (araṇyaṃ gatvā) kāṣṭhānyānaya, śākamapi āhartavyaṃ iti |
samuccayānvācayayorviśeṣamāha-) tatra kāṣṭhāni araṇya- gamanaprayojakāni itaradaprayojakam |
dvayoḥ saha ānīyamānayoḥ itaretarayogaḥ anuṣaṅgipādī bhavati |
cakārasya tat phalam, takte 'cārthe dvaṃdvaḥ' iti (nedaṃ tantrajñāne) |
tatra kadācit itaretarayogo vivakṣitaḥ, samāhāraḥ pracayādavagamyamānaḥ avivakṣitaḥ |
kadācit samāhāro vivakṣitaḥ : itaretara- yogo nāntarīyaḥ |
(tatra) samā- hāravivakṣāyām 'dhavakhadiram' iti prayogaḥ, itaratra 'dhavakhadirau' iti |
yathā dvaṃdva yogapadyena dvau abhidhīyate, vigrahaśca (yathā), tathā ekaśeṣe'pi vasānau iti ca ekaśeṣaḥ |
evaṃ bhāṣyaṃ vyākhyāya codayati-) nanu yadi dhavo dvividhābhidhāyī khadiraśca, tato bahutvaṃ syāt |
yadi hi dvayordvivacanayoḥ bahutvavacanaṃ syāt, 'brāhmaṇau śobhanau vijñātārau' ityatrāpi bahutvavacanaṃ syāt |
(punaḥśraddhayati-) saiṣā yugapadadhikaraṇatā duḥkhā (buddhau anārohāt) durupapādā ca (yuktyabhāvāt) |
yadi ca syātām 'uktārthānāmprayogaḥ' iti dhavasyaiva (dhavaśabdasyaiva) prayogaḥ syāt |
dhavaḥ ātmīyamidheyaṃ itarasahitaṃ bravīti evaṃ khadiro'pi |
(tatra) kataro dvitīyaḥ iti tatra khadiraśabdena dhavo viśeṣyate, dhavenāpi itaraḥ |
tantraratne atra viṣaye vistareṇa prati- pāditam |
nanu tatra (okārānte dvivacane) pāṇinisaraṇam 'pumān striyā' iti |
kiṃ tarhi ? yathā loke avasthito'rthaḥ, tathā'vasthitasya śabdānuśāsanaṃ kṛtam |
( ) akārānta paraḥ okāraḥ śrūyamāṇaḥ pumāṃsaṃ sadvitīyaṃ vadati |
yadā strī sadvitīyā, tadā okāraḥ ekārībhavati |
yadā punaḥ puṃsau abhī- gheyau, tadā ekāraukārau prāpnutaḥ; dvayorabhidheyorvidha- mānātvāt, tatra okāraḥ śiṣyate ityayaṃ niyamaḥ kriyate |
na tu puṃtā sadvitīyā strī abhidhīyate (tasmāt dvau pumāsau abhimādadhīyātāṃ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ) |
guṇasya tu vidhānatvāt patnyā dvitīyaśabdaḥ syāt |
eka evādadhīta 'vasante brāhmaṇo'gnimādadhīta' iti eka- vacanaṃ hi vivakṣitam |
nanu idaṃ vacanaṃ dvau pumāṃsau ādadhīyātāṃ iti |
śruti- gamyau ca pumāṃsau vākyagamyaṃ ca kṣaumaṃ nāveyātāmiti |
na pumāṃsau vidheyau, prāpta evātra sadvitīyaḥ pumān, so'nūdyate |
na ca tat prāgvacanā- dramyate tad vidheyaṃ bhavati |
nanu etat ādhānaṃ śrutyā vidhātuṃ samartham, nānyaditi |
śabdāntareṇa vihitatvādādhānasya na vidhāya- kam, vihitatvācca puṃvataḥ sadvitīyasya tasyāpi na vidhā- yakam |
atastadasaṃbhavāt kṣaumasya vidhāyikā liṅ- bhaviṣyati, vākyasāmarthyāt |
gattu asmin pakṣe atyantāya svārthe jahātīti, nātyantāya hāsyati |
asmin pakṣe tasya puṃsaḥ strīpuṃsayorvācyatvaṃ iti gamyate |
asti hi tatra tasya puṃsaḥ pumān sadvitīyaḥ |
evādi ca dṛṣṭvā bhagavatā pāṇinā sūtraṃ praṇītam 'pumān striyā' iti |
tasya viṣayaḥ puṃśabdaḥ śiṣyamāṇaḥ sādhurbhavati, na klībaśabda iti |
dup- kṣaumaśabdasya anuvādo na ghaṭate aprāpta- tvāt |
na lakṣaṇayā anuvādaḥ sādṛśyena vā (gauṇyā vṛttyā vā ityarthaḥ) |
nahi kṣaumaṃ malinatvena vinā ātmānaṃ na labhate, yena tallakṣyeta |
yathā śuklādiguṇaḥ dravyeṇa vinā na bhavati iti avinābhāvāt dravyaṃ lakṣyate, naivamiha |
atha vidhyate kṣaume malinateti, sā hi kārpāsādāvapi vidyate |
sāmānādhikaraṇyena hi bhavati sādṛśyaṃ yathā siṃho devadatta iti |
yaḥ prakaraṇagataḥ puruṣaḥ, tasya arthāvāse vasane kṣaumaṃ niyamyate |
sa prakaraṇagataḥ śaknoti apūrvaṃ lakṣa- yitum |
yathā vrīhayaḥ śakuvanti apūrvaṃ lakṣayitum, evamihāpi |
vasānau iti utpattivākye strīpuṃsayoḥ prāptatvāt anuvādaḥ |
(asyaiva sūtrasya vārtikakārīyā dvitīyā vyākhyā ina uttaraṃ nivedyate |
tantraratne tu sā vyākhyāteti atra udriyate |
na puṃdrayaṃ ādhānaṃ vidhātuṃ śakyate, 'vasante brāhmaṇo- 'gnimādadhīta' iti - ) utpattivākyeṇa ekavacanā- bahutvāt dvivyavācakābhāvāt (vājinavat) karmā- ntaraṃ prāpnoti |
tatra (anuvādapakṣe) śabdavatī vā kṣaume (syātām) maline vā |
(dvedhā'pi acyuktamityāha-) 'dusu śabde' iti (asmāt dhātoḥ :) avayavavyutpatyā vartate |
(taduktam) ruḍhyā (hi) kṣaumameva bravīti (atasī syādumā kṣumā ityamaraḥ |
ruḍhyā ca avayavavyutpattiścāpi vyupatto (kevalāyām) āśīryamāṇāyāṃ śabdādīnāmapi kṣaumaśabdavācyatā syāt (śabdavatvāt), na ca teṣu vartate (kṣaumaśabdaḥ |
nāpi malinatvapratipādakatvamityāha-) malinavacane (sati) kārpāsādīnāmapi malinatvasya vidyamānatvāt kṣaumaśabdā- bhidheyatā syāt, na ca teṣu kṣaumaśabdaḥ |
(kiñca evam-) amalina kṣaume (kṣaumaśabdasya) prayogo na syāt, asti ca prayogaḥ |
na ca upapadena saha anucaritatvāt kṣaumasadṛśaṃ kārpāsādi śaknoti avabodhayitum |
yathā 'siṃho devadattaḥ' iti siṃhaśabdāccāraṇe siṃhasādṛśyaṃ devadatte (avagamyate), evamihāpi |
tasmāt upapadābhāvāt sādṛśye gṛhyamāṇe sādhāraṇaśabdatā (anekārthatā) syāt |
na ca malinatvena vinā kṣaumaṃ nopapadyate |
(nanu puṃdrayapratipādakasya śabdasya kā gatiḥ ? ata āha-) vasānau iti puṃsatvaṃ dvitvaṃ ca vadati, tacca (dravyamapi) prakaraṇeṇa prāptātvāt anuyate |
ādhānaṃ kṣaumaṃ kuryāt iti vidhīyate (na tu vamane, tasmādadoṣaḥ iti codayati-) tat kathamādhānaṃ bhavati ? (uttaram-) tatsādhakasya (puruṣasya) bhavat tadartha bhavati |
ādhānaprakaraṇe samāmnānāt tadīyasya puruṣasya yat vasanam, tatra bhaviṣyati, yathā 'prakaraṇaviśeṣādvā tadyukta saṃskāre dravyatvat' (3|4|5| 16) evamatrāpi |
) śā— ki ādhānaṃ dvau pumāṃsau sakhīko saha kuryāta uta ekaḥ |
dvitvapuṃstve hi tadvācye niyamyate ca te mithaḥ |
tadvidhāne ca puṃdvitvaṃ vidhātuṃ naiva śakyate |
agrāma- tvācca vasane yadā kṣaumaṃ cīyate |
' soma— 'etena rājapurohito yajeyātām' iti ādhānaṃ puṃdvādhikāraṃ iti pūrvapakṣasūtrārthaḥ |
' bhāṭṭa— ādhānaprakaraṇe 'kṣaume naśānī āgnimāda- dhīyātām' iti śrutam |
tena na ādhānaṃ kartṛdvāva- vidhānāt dvau pumāṃsau strīkau ādhāne adhikāriṇau 'etena rājapurohito sāmrājyākāmo yajeyātām' itivat |

na cātra 'kukuṭāvānaya mithunaṃ kariṣyāmi' itivat 'pumān kriyā' ityādyanuśāsanena strīdvitīyatayā virūpaikaśeṣasyāpi upapatteḥ, vākyasya kṣaumavibhaktimātraparatve- nāpi upapattau utpattiśiṣṭaikatraikvādhānupapattiḥ iti vācyam |
tathāpi, aukārastāt dvitvaṃ puṃstvaṃ cābhiprete iti arūpaikahāyanatve dvitvācchinne puṃstvam, puṃstvavicchinne dvitvaṃ iti parasparaniyamāt puṃdvayapratītiḥ sulbhā |
virūpaikaśeṣe tu pitarau ityādī mātṛtvādeḥ, kukkuṭo ityādī strītvasya ca pratyākhyābhāvāt lakṣaṇā āvaśyakya iti tasya tato daurbalyam |

na ca bhavanmate'pi upakramaśabdopamade malinatvasādṛśyāt gauṇī, 'kṣauma śabde' ityanuśāsanādā avayavayogaḥ iti jaghanyatvaśrayaṇam, anuvādyavaiyarthyam, utpattivākyasthe- kavacanasya sādhutvamātrārthaṃ iti anekadoṣādavasthaṃ iti vācyam |
ata eva 'brāhmaṇaḥ' iti ekatvaṃ puṃstvaṃ cāvivakṣitam |
brāhmaṇe yadi śabdasaṃhita ādadhīta tadā vasante ityevaṃ kādācitkabrahmaṇādyekānuvādaḥ |
dvaṃdvaśca 'yugapadhikaraṇe dvaṃdvo bhavati' iti kātyāyanasmaraṇāt yugapadhikaraṇatā- vācī (atra 'siddhaṃ tu yugapadhikaraṇavacane dvaṃdvavacanāt' iti 2|2|29 pā0 sūne dvitīyaṃ vārtikam |
tatra mahā- bhāṣyapaddhatiḥ: 'yugapadhikaraṇavacane dvaṃdvo bhavati iti vaktavyam' iti |
adhikaraṇaṃ śabdapratipādyo'rthaḥ, sa yatra aneko yugapadekena padena bodhyate tatra dvaṃdvaḥ |
tathā ca dhavakhadirau ityatra dhavapadaṃ khadirasahitadhavaparaṃ itarasahitadhavaparaṃ ca |
cakārasya hi catvāro'rthāḥ: samuccaya- anvācaya- itaretarayoga- samāhārāḥ |
tatra vibhaktyarthānvaye parasparanirapekṣatve sati samatvaṃ samuccayaḥ |
ataśca na itaretarayoge, na vikalpe, na vā anvācaye ativyāptiḥ |
yathā 'aharaharnayamāno gāmaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ ca' [ ayuktaḥ pāṭho'yaṃ caśabdasya ] ityādi |
anvācaye tu ekasya prayojakatvam, aparasya na iti na sāmyam, yathā 'kāṣṭhānyāhara śākaṃ cāhar' iti |
itaretarayoge tu nyāsajyavṛttivibhaktyarthe parasparasāhityenānvayaḥ, yathā 'agni somaśca devatā' ityādī |
atra dhavaṃ ca khadiraṃ ca ityādī itaretarayogavivakṣāyāṃ yugapadhikaraṇavacanatā āvaśyakī |
anyathā pratyekaṃ vibhaktyarthānvaye itaretara- yogyasya samuccayā-drenāpatteḥ |
ata eva nirapekṣayoḥ ekakriyā'nvayitvaṃ samuccayaḥ iti tatraivoktamapāstam |
itaretarayogasamāhārayostu sāhityasya padārthān prati guṇatvapradhānatvakato viśeṣaḥ; itaretarayogaṃ tulyam |
ata eva arthānāmekatve'pi itaretarayogarūpatvaṃ eva dvaṃdvaḥ |
iti 'cārthe dvaṃdvaḥ' iti sāmānyasūtraṃ mahābhāṣyākārādibhiḥ viśeṣaparatayā vyākhyātam |
ataśca yugapadhikaraṇa- tāvācidvaṃdvapadāt ekaśeṣasyāpi tadvācivipratīteḥ 'vasāno' ityatra puṃdvayapratītiḥ |
virūpaika- śeṣādikāre'pi lītahitapuṃsaḥ puṃsahitastriyāḥ yugapada- midhānopapatteḥ |
na caivaṃ puṃdvayaṃ dvaṃdvayaṃ ca iti catuṣṭayā- pattiḥ, dhavalakhadiradvayavat strīpuṃdvayopapatteḥ |
dhavapade khadirapade ca lakṣaṇayāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt itaretarayogasya caśabdasyaiva tātparyaṃ sati troyopapatteḥ |
ata eva dhavaṃ ca khadiraṃ ca ityādī tātparya- nurodhena dhavalakhadirayorityādyasamarthatve lakṣaṇā ityapi dhyeyam |
dvaṃdve tu vibhakteraikāvādeva itaretarayoge lakṣaṇayāṃ vinaiva niravadyaḥ |
yattu 'pra mitrayorvarṇayoḥ' iti vede kācikaṃ vigrahapradarśanaṃ tacchandasyam |
ata eva vibhakte- ryāsajyavṛttidharmaparatve dvaṃdvaḥ eva tādṛśatve tātparyagrāhakaḥ ityapi bodhyam |
kiñca dvaṃdvapadādapi ekaśeṣasya na taduttaravibhaktyasyavṛttidharmaparatvam, vacanānvayasya |
vastutastu ekaśeṣānuśāsanamapi paribhāṣāmātrameva, sarūpadvaṃdvanirākaraṇārthaṃ evātipadi- kāryasya dvivacanādibalena anekatvapratīyupapatteḥ |
virūpaikaśeṣatve tu tātparyagrāhakanurodhena ānuśāsanikī aukāre lakṣaṇā iti viśeṣaḥ |
iti prāpte, vasantādivākye 'ādadhīta' ityekavacanasya pākṣikā- nuvādatvāpatteḥ, brāhmaṇadvayakartṛkādhāne vasantaprāptyāpatteśca vasantādivākye'pyeva ādhānavidhānam |
vasanavākye tu ekakartṛkavidhividhāne kartṛdvitvakṣaumabhayavidhayogāt ānuśāsanikī lakṣaṇāmāṅgīkṛtya paraṃ virūpaikaśeṣaḥ adhiṣṭhānalakṣaṇayā |
ata eva tatra kṣaumamātraṃ vasanakriyoddeśena vidhīyate |

yadyapi ca upattau puṃstva- śravaṇāt liṅgamātra dvitvaṃ na prāpyate, tathāpi viśiṣṭa- vidhau gauravaparihārāya vasanavākye vākyabhedaparihārāya ca brāhmaṇādeḥ adhikāritvena anvākhyākārāta, tasya chedatvena tadviśeṣeṇa puṃstvasyāvivakṣopapatteḥ |
ataḥ eka eva pumān strīdvitīyaḥ : ādhāne adhikārī |
' dṛṣṭānteṣu (adhvaryukāṇḍe yajamānakāṇḍe ca paṭhiteṣu ) sugyuhanādimantreṣu ubhau kartārau |
adhvaryuḥ etena prakāśitamanuṣṭhāsyāmīti, yajamāno na pramadi- ṣyāmīti |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'paśvānāṃ tvā vātānāṃ yantrāya marmatha gṛhṇāmi' ityādayaḥ ājyagrahaṇamantrāḥ, 'vājasya mā |
prasavena' ityādyau sugandhyuhanamantrau ca ādhvaryave yājamāne ca kāṇḍe iti dviprāptau |
iti dvyāmnāteṣu mantreṣu ubhau adhvaryuśca yajamānaśca dvāvapi adhikāriṇau |
tatra adhvaryuḥ, etena prakāśita- manuṣṭhāsyāmi iti saṃghāya, yajamānastu na pramadiṣyāmi iti saṃghāya brūyāt |
kasmāt ? dvyāmnāyasya arthavattvāt saphalatvāt hetoḥ dvābhyāṃ paṭhanīyau |
atra sudhā-- dviḥpāṭhastvanyāyya'nupapattyā dviḥ- prayogamātram bhinnaviṣayatvena sāmānyasamākhyāyā api bādhāyogaḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ ādhva- ryavayājamānakāṇḍayordvirāmanātā mantrāḥ ubhābhyāmapi prayoktavyāḥ ||
bhāṣyam-- sto darśapūrṇamāsau, tatra dvyāmnātā mantrā ādhvaryave kāṇḍe yājamāne ca |
ājyaṃ yairgṛhāte 'pañcānāṃ tvā vātānāṃ yantrāya dhartrāya gṛhṇāmi' ityeva- mādayaḥ |
'sucau vyūhati, vājasya mā prasavena' iti sandehaḥ kiṃ te ubhābhyāmapi kartavyāḥ, utādhvaryuṇaiveti |
kiṃ prāptam ? samākhyānā- dādhvaryavāḥ ? iti prāpte, ucyate |
vā-- ājyagrahaṇādimantreṣu sāmānyena ādhvaryave punarviśeṣeṇa yājamāne kāṇḍe paṭhyamāneṣu kimubhī prayo- kārau virūpena samuccayena vā, athānyataraḥ |
tatra ādhvaryave vikalpe vā prāpte, dācitlāt
asatyapi vacane arthāta dvau yajamānau bhaviṣyataḥ |
ya eko na śakyati, sasahāyaḥ sa upakraṃste |
ataeva yajye sati yathā yajyamiti vācitvā'pi kāṃcit prāpti yajamānaḥ sahāyamupādāsyate |
na ca taddvāreṇa ṛtusaṃbandho ghaṭate, lakṣaṇaprasaṅgāt |
nahi śrutyā upayuktānāṃ lakṣaṇayā upayogāntaraṃ yujyate |
dvitvā- disarūpatve'pi tu vidhiraiva anarthako bhavet |
yat nimittaṃ prakaraṇe nāstīti, taducyate arthādvidhivati |
nahi vihitamevaikaṃ nimittaṃ bhavati, arthāprasasyāpi upapadyamāna- tvāt |
satyāmapi ca vivakṣāyām 'api vā'pyekadeśe syāt' ityanena yathaiva aśakteḥ anyat kiñcidvaṃ dvāpyate, tatraiva yajamānaika- mapi kadācit parihāpya dvau bahavo vā yajeran, tatrāsti nimittam |
athavā etadeva pratipadihānaṃ dṛṣṭvā arthāta dvitvadvijamānakartṛśruti kalpayiṣyāmaḥ |
sā caitasminneva pakṣe bhavati, na pratipadantarapakṣeṣu iti naikavacanodanā virotsyate |
pratyakṣastatra dharmā āmnātāḥ, na kutaścit codakena prāpyante |
kimato yadyevam ? pratyakṣaśrutāḥ na śakyā bādhitum |
vikṛtau tu codakaprāptāḥ santaḥ ānumānikā bādheranniti |
vivakṣitaṃ hi jyotiṣṭome kartṛkatvaṃ pratyakṣaśrutaṃ na sāmarthyena bādhyate |
yatrāpi hi adhyakṣakartṛvyatā śrūyate, tatrāpi eka eva yajamānaḥ śrūyate 'vasantevasante jyotiṣā yajeta' iti |
ekasyāṃ patnyāṃ yajamāne ca 'yuvaṃ hi sthaḥ' iti, dvayorbahuṣu vā patnīṣu 'ete asamrindvaḥ' iti |
yathā 'kṣaume vasāno' abhimādadhī- yātām' iti kṣaumavasānaparaṃ vacanam, evamihāpi prati- padidhānaparam |
asaṃbhavatvāt tatra mukhyasya lakṣaṇāśabdaḥ puṃso vācakaḥ striyām |
iha tu dvitve bahutvace ca saṃbhavati, na lakṣaṇāśabdo bhavitumarhati bahutvyo yajamānebhya iti |
yadapi etat dvivacanaṃ dvaryajamāna- yoriti, atrāpi ya ekaśeṣaḥ, 'pumān striyā' (pā0 1|2|67) iti, asāvapi lakṣaṇaśabda eva |
apica 'upāsamai gāyatā naraḥ' iti pratipado niravakāśatvameva syāt |
prasravavihitaṃ tu etat kāmye nitye ca, yajeta ityekavacanaśravaṇāt |
na ca asya avi- vakṣāyāṃ kāraṇamasti |
yathā ca vivakṣā, tathā ṣaṣṭhe prati- pādayiṣyate (6|3|12) |
yadapi aśaktakṛtaṃ jñāpanam, tadapi eko yathā śaknuyāt iti upapandhāt ananyādviṣayaṃ vijñāyate |
śaknoti hi dakṣiṇāparimāṇaṃ parityajya eko'pi nirvartayitum |
tasmāt ekayajamāna- kāvāt prakṛtau nimittamasti iti utkṛṣṭe |
yattu idameva vacanaṃ sāmarthyādākṣipyastīti, tatra, anyathā- 'pi upapadyamānatvāt |
yadi hi etannimittaṃ anākṣiptaṃ anarthakībhavet, tata ākṣipyeta |
kathaṃ caitadanarthakaṃ bhavet, yadi prakṛtāviha anyatrāpi dvitvabahutve na syātām |
na tu te anyatra na staḥ, kulāyādau vidyamāna- tvāt |
iha ca vidvadvibhittena upādānāt vākya- bhedaprasaṅgāt nārthān ākṣepamarhataḥ |
bahutva iti ca virūpaikaśeṣaḥ (bahavaśca bahavaśca iti) svarasataḥ puṃbahutvapratītau satyāṃ vidhinirmāṇakaḥ kalpyeta |
'kṣaume vasāno' (vasānaśca vasānā ceti) ityatra tu agatyā patnyāṃ dvitīyaśabda iha |
ekadampatīprayoga- varodhācca nityāyāḥ pratipadaḥ ānarthakyaṃ bhavet |
yattu ṛtusaṃbandho nāmihita iti, naiṣa doṣaḥ, prati- pacchabdādeva ṛtugāmitvapratipattau satyāṃ dvitvādinā viśeṣapratipattisiddheḥ |
tainaikatvaṃ vihāya dvau bahavo vā yujyate ||
sūtrārthastu-- dvitvabahutvayuktaṃ ca pratipadyayaṃ vikṛtau utkṛṣyeta tasya dvitvabahutvasya prakṛtau acedanāt iti |
vi -- 'yuvaṃ hīti dvayoḥ karmorbahanā caita ityum (ete iti) |
, yaja- mānasya nānātvaṃ sākṣāt vikṛtiṣu śrutam |
bhāṭṭa -- jyotiṣṭome eva 'upāsamai gāyatā naraḥ' śruti nityāṃ pratipadaṃ vidhāya 'yuvaṃ hi sthaḥ' svarvatī iti dvayoryajamānayoḥ pratipadaṃ kuryāt |
ete aṣṭramindvaḥ iti vahvayo yajamānebhyaḥ' iti śrutam |
tatra ādya- vākye 'dvayoryajamānayoḥ' iti yadi saptamī, tadā sā nimittatvaparā |

yadyapi ca pṛthak vibhaktiśravaṇam, tathāpi havirādyadhikaraṇanyāyena (6|4|22) pākṣika- svābhāvena pratyekaṃ nimittatvārthavaśānāt pradhānabhūta- nimittatvānurodhena militayoreva dvitvabahutvayajamāna- svāvacchinnayoḥ nimittatvaṃ pratipādyate |

yadi tu ṣaṣṭhī, tadā adhikāritvākhyasaṃbandhānuvādikā satī svaiyarthyapari- hārārthaṃ padye'pi lakṣaṇāmaṅgīkṛtya lāghavāt dvitvaja- mānatvayoreka vyāsajyavṛttinimittatvaṃ pratipādyati, viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāve'pi vinigamanāvi rahāt |
evaṃ 'bahvayo yajamānebhyaḥ' iti tādarthyacaturthyā'pi adhikāri- svasaṃbandhānuvādikā uktavidhanimittatve lakṣaṇā |
nimitte ca pratipadudeśena mantravidhāne'pi vijātīyatvācca anekoddeśyatā |

prakara ṇādvā pratipattaṃsaṃbandhalābhaḥ iti pakṣadvaye'pi avivādam tadiha imau mantrau jyotiṣṭome eva niviśate, uta dvivahu yajamānake kulāyādīnādau iti cintāyām, prakaraṇā virodhāt prakṛte eva niveśaḥ |

na ca tatra nimittābhāvaḥ ākhyātena 'vasantevasante jyotiṣā yajeta' ityādina upādeyakartṛviśeṣaṇatvenoktasya ekatvasya vivakṣāyāṃ nityatvena jyotiṣṭome yathāśaktyapyanyasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt yadi eko na śakyatvāt, tadā dvitvabahutvamānakatvaprāpte pratipadidhānasaṃbhavāt |
athavā yajamānaśabdasya yāgakartṛ mātravacanatvaṃ patnyāmapi saṃbhavāt ādyavākye tāva- tstrīliṅgatve bādhakābhāvāt patnītve sa mantraḥ |
dvitīya vākye'pi pāśādhikaraṇanyāyena liṅgānurodhena prakaraṇa vādhānupapatteḥ |
yatyanuśāsane puṃliṅgasya strītvaratvā vagateḥ patnītve dvitīye mantraḥ |
iti prāpte, nityatve'pi jyotiṣṭome na ekatve yathāśaktyanyaviṣayatā, upatyādivākye samānābhidhānaśrutyā bhāvanānvitāstasya antarbhūtye aśaktau dakṣiṇāparimāṇāntaramācena asyaiva anu grāhyatvāt |
kiñca yat kṛtisādhyatvenānuṣṭheyatā prasaktam tathaiva yathāśaktyapyanyaḥ, na tu ananuṣṭheye kālādau ataśca tadeva asyāpi na tanvāyaviṣayatā, iti prakṛte yāge dvitvabahutve |

na ca yajamānaśabdaḥ patnīparaḥ puṃsyeva pracuraprayogeṇa śakyatvagamanena lakṣaṇāyāṃ pramāṇaṃ bhāvāt, yajamāneti puṃliṅgasya 'prāptam' ityatra meṣāmiva niṣiddhatvena adhikṛtatvayathā'nuśāsanāṅgīkāra nupapatteḥ |
ataśca vākyena prakaraṇabādhāt yatra 'ete rājapurohito sāyujyakāmo yajetām' 'eko ha vahavo vā yajeran' iti ādyarthe kulāyādīnādi dvitvabahutvavidhānam, tatraiva asyotkarṣaḥ |
na cā tatropasthāpākābhāvaḥ, pratipasaṃbandhenaiva sāmānyataḥ ṛtu saṃbandhavagate nimittatvena tadviśeṣopasthitau bādhaka bhāvāt |
' yuvaṃ hi sthaḥ svaṃpatī iti dvyarthenamānayoḥ pratipadaṃ kuryāt ' ete asyamabhidadhaḥ iti bahubhyo yajamānebhyaḥ ' iti jyotiṣṭome śrūyate |
etat dvitvabahutvayuktaṃ mantrajātaṃ rājapurohitomayakartṛke kulāyayajñe ca ahīne apakṛṣyate |
yathā dvādaśopasattā utkṛṣyate tathā idamapi utkṛṣyate |
pakṣeṇa kadācit vikalpena arthakṛtasya arthāt prāptasya dvitvabahutvayajamānakasya jyotiṣṭome saṃbhavat pratipadadvayasya notkarṣaḥ |
ekasya yajamānasya kadācit dakṣiṇādisaṃpādanāśaktau ekatvavacanenāpi dvitvabahutvayajamānakatvaṃ saṃbhavat iti bhāvaḥ |
kutaḥ ? prakṛteḥ nikhilasomaprakṛteḥ jyotiṣṭomasya ekasaṃyogāt ekenaiva kartrā saṃbandhāt |
' somena yajeta ' iti utpattivighātasya kartṛrekatvasya bādhāsaṃbhavāt |
tathā ca jyotiṣṭomasya ekamātrakartṛkatvāt pratipadoḥ utkarṣa eva iti |
ke. dvitvabahutvayuktaṃ (3|9|17-19) ityādidhakaraṇe tu yajamānasya ātmīyamekamapi anupādeyaṃ ityuktam |
vāla. pṛ. 97. dvitvabahutvayuktaṃ cācodanāttasya ityadhikaraṇe ya ekaśeṣaḥ ' pumān striyā ' iti, sa lakṣaṇāśanda eveti bhāṣyakāroktam |
vi. 3|2|13. dvivaitatvānaṃ śeṣāḥ āgrayaṇasyāhyāmupanītāḥ, tataḥ pānīvato gṛhyate |
vā. dvitvetye āgrayaṇavādādau agnīṣomīyapuroḍāśadharmāmatideśaḥ, dvivaitatvasāmā- nyāt |

tathathā caturthakaraṇa- indrapīta-pūpratiṣṭhābhāgavicāreṣu sāpekṣāmidevatyānāṃ aindrāma-agnīṣomīyādīnāṃ āgneyādiśabdaiḥ kevalānyādi- devatākaiḥ asāmarthyādagrahaṇaṃ iti vakṣyati ' iti vārtikam (pṛ. 420) |
atra sudhā- na kevalaṃ yājñikānāṃ dvivaitatvavyavahāraḥ kintu mīmāṃsāyām |
' āgneyaṃ caturdhā karoti ' ityāgneyaśabdena sāpekṣāmidevatyayoḥ aindrāgnīṣomīyayoḥ puroḍāśayoḥ agrahaṇaṃ ' vyavasthā vā ' (3|1|27) iti sūtre vakṣyate |
indrapītasamāsasthena indraśabdena sāpekṣendradevatyasya aindrāgneḥ somasya agrahaṇaṃ ' ekasmin vā devatāntarāt ' (3|2|41) iti indrapītavicārasiddhāntasūtre vakṣyate |
pūṣapratiṣṭhābhāgavicāre pūpadevatyasya aindrāpauṣṇṇāderagrahaṇaṃ ' ekasminn ekasaṃyogāt ' (3|2|19) iti pūṣapratiṣṭhābhāgavicāre vakṣyate |
dvivaitatvānaṃ dāśapaurṇamāsikadvaitatyāgaprakṛtikāvam ' aikādhyāṃ0 ' (8|1|28) iti sūtre vakṣyate |
' āśāsānā medhapatibhyāṃ medham ' iti agnipraipagatamedha- patiśabdena dvivacanāntamedhapatiśabdavācyaṃ agnīṣomākhya- devatārūpaṃ arthadvayaṃ āśrityasthite |
' tvaṃ hye prathamo manotā ' iti manotākhyo mantraḥ anyadevatyayau uhitayo na vā iti saṃdehamupanyasya ' nanu prakṛtau anyārtho'yaṃ nigadaḥ (anyānigado'yam ) agnīṣomau hi prakṛtau devatā |
asamavetāmidhānāt avikāreṇa prayoktavyaḥ ' iti iyāśaktike ' satyaṃ agnīṣomau devatā prakṛtau, tau tu amiśra somaśca ' iti bhāṣyakṛt vakṣyati (bhā. pṛ. 1938-39) |
' manotāyāṃ tu vacanādavikāraḥ syāt ' 10|4|2 iti ityatra |

' devatā- dvaṃdvaṃ ca ' (pā0 6|1|26) ityadhikṛtya ' idamaiḥ soma- varuṇayoḥ ' (27) iti somaśabde varuṇaśabde ca parabhūte agmiśabdasya devatādvaṃdvanimittaṃ ītvaṃ (agnīṣomau agnī- varuṇau iti) smṛtam |
stustomatomāḥ ' (pā0 8|3|82) ityatra agmiśabdāt parasya somaśabdasya mūrdhanyādeśena palasvamateḥ soma- śabdasya agmiśabdādvedāvagamāt arthāt dvaṃdvagavatiḥ |
pūrvapadaprakṛtisvarādhikāre ' ume vanaspatyādiṣu yugapat ' (pā0 6|1|140) ityanuvartamāne ' devatādvaṃdvaṃ ca ' (pā06|2|141) ityanena indrāgnī indrāvaruṇau ityādiṣu ubhayapadaprakṛtisvaratvaṃ uktam |
vṛddhayadhikāre ca ' dvaṃdvaga- sincyante pūrvapadasya ca ' (pā0 7|3|19) ityanuvartamāne ' devatādvaṃdvaṃ ca ' (pā0 7|3|21) iti āśāvaiṣṇavā- diśabde ubhayapadavṛddhiruktā |
' ānaha krato dvaṃdva ' (pā0 6|3|25) ityanuvartamāne ' devatādvaṃdvaṃ ca ' (pā0 6|3|26) ityānahādeśaḥ mitrāvaruṇau ityuktaḥ |
dvipatvādivikṛtau devatā'nusāreṇa medhapati- śabdasya vacane sahaḥ kartavyaḥ (medhapataye medhapatibhyāṃ medha- patibhyaḥ iti yathāyatham ) |
bhā. 9|3|12|33-41. dvipaśuyāge agnupeṣe ekadhāśabdasya abhyāsaḥ ' ekaikadhā anayossacya ' iti |
vi. 9|3|12, dvipaśuyāge pāśamantrayoḥ ekavacanāntabahuvacanānta- pāśaśabdasya dvivacanāntena ūhaḥ |
somāt prāk paurṇamāsī ekapuroḍāśā, somādūrdhvaṃ dvipuroḍāśā, agnīṣomīyapuroḍāśasyāpi sattvāt |
sa ca dvipuro- ḍāśāyāṃ āgneyāgnīṣomīyapuroḍāśadvayaṃ syāt antarārthatvāt antarāpadena uktasya dvayormedhasya arthasya dvipuro- ḍāśāyāmeva saṃbhavat |
iti somāt prāk ekapuroḍāśayāṃ upāṃśuyājo na syāt iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |

jāmi ālasyam, jāmikaraṇaṃ ālasyopādanam, ajāmikaraṇaṃ ālasyopacityarthayā na syāt tathā karaṇam ; ajāmikaraṇārthe puroḍāśayormadhye upāṃśuyājaḥ ityuktam ' jāmi vā etad yajñasya kriyate yadantyau puroḍāśau, upāṃśuyājamantarā yajati ajāmivāya ' iti vākye |
tasmāt dvipuroḍāśayāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ upāṃśuyājaḥ na tu somāt prāk ekapuro- ḍāśāyām |
tadartham, upāṃśuyājasya tadarthe puroḍāśayontarālārtha- tvasiddhayarthe dvipuroḍāśāyāmeva somottara paurṇamāsyāḥ upāṃśuyājaḥ syāt |
vicitrā hi sūtrakārasya kṛti- rbhavati iti pravādaḥ |
na dvipuroḍāśāyāmeva paurṇamāsyāṃ upāṃśuyājaḥ ; kintu ekapuroḍāśāyāmapi |
tasmāt asatyapi antarāle ekapuroḍāśāyāmapi upāṃśu- yājaḥ kartavyaḥ : iti siddhāntaḥ |
antarālasya āvaśyakatve tu aśiṣṭena avihitena antarālena vihitasya upāṃśuyājasya saṃbandhaḥ kartavyaḥ syāt |
na ca vihitasya aśiṣṭena saṃbandho yuktaḥ |
tasmāt ekapuroḍāśāyāmapi upāṃśuyājaḥ kartavyaḥ : iti siddhānte yuktyantaram |
utpattestu niveśaḥ syāt, guṇasyānuparodhenā- rthasya vidyamānatvāt, vidhānāntarā''rthasya naimi- ttikatvāt, tadabhāve'
mānatvāt upatteḥ utpattivākyādeva dvipuroḍāśāyāṃ anta- rāle upāṃśuyājasya niveśaḥ syāt |
tadabhāve antarālasya abhāve asaṃbhavame tu aśrutau antarālavattvena aśrutāyāṃ ekapuroḍāśāyāmāpi upāṃśuḥ syāt |
tasmāt naikapuroḍāśāyāmu- pāṃśuyāgaḥ iti punaḥ pūrvapakṣa āha |
siddhāntī āha ‘ ājyasyaiva nau upāṃśu paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan’ iti paurṇamāsīśabdena ubhayoḥ paurṇamāsyoḥ eka- puroḍāśāyāṃ dvipuroḍāśāyāṃ ca upāṃśuyājasya vidhānāt ekapuroḍāśāyāmāpi syāt |
ubhe api hi te paurṇamāsyā- veva |
guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvāt upadeśavat yadeti syāt |
guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvāt pradhānārthatvāt guṇaḥ antarālaṃ upāṃśuyājārthe sat ekapuroḍāśāyāṃ upāṃśuyājaṃ nivartayituṃ nāharti |
tasmāt antarālasya guṇasya śāstraṃ ‘yadā iti syāt’ yadā paurṇamāsyā dvipuroḍāśā, tadā antarāle iti syāt |
upaveṣavat yathā ‘upaveṣaṇa kapālānyupaddhāti’ iti yadā amāvāsyāyāṃ upaveṣaḥ, tadā tena iti gamyate |
ekapuroḍāśāyāmāpi upāṃśuyājasya anapāyaḥ na apāyaḥ abhāvaḥ |
antarālaṃ ubhayyāṃ lakṣyate aindrāyāt prāk, āgheyā- duttaraṃ ceti |
tatra aindrāyābhāve'pi āgheyāduttaratvena lakṣitaḥ upāṃśuyājakālaḥ jñāyate eva |
yathā śaṅkhavelā- yāmāgantavyamityukte khetakhaverādau śaṅkhābhāve'pi tadupa- lakṣitayā velāyāmāgamyate |
yathā ‘amṛtaṃ vā ājyaṃ martyaṃ haviḥ yadupastṛṇāti abhidhāra- yati amṛtāhutimevaināṃ karoti’ iti amṛtārthatvaṃ ājya- praśaṃsārthaṃ tadat |
tasmāt somāt prāk ekapuroḍāśāyā- mapi paurṇamāsyāṃ upāṃśuyājaḥ kartavyaḥ |
ke. dvibahupatnīprayoge ekavacanāntasya mantrasya (‘patnīṃ saṃnahya’ iti prathamantrasya ) prayogopapatteḥ na tatrohaḥ |
śeṣabhakṣe dvau bhāgau yasya sa dvibhāgaḥ syāt |
te dve karmaṇī yasya sa maitrāvaruṇaḥ dvikarmā |
dvikarmatvāt sa dvibhāgaḥ syāt iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
maitrāvaruṇaḥ paśau śeṣabhakṣe na dvibhāgaḥ syāt |
kintu ekabhāgaḥ eka eva bhāgo yasya tadat syāt |
maitrāvaruṇasya ekatvāt bhāgasya ca adhvaryubhāgasya hotṛbhāgasya ca maitrāvaruṇasya aśrutibhūtatvāt śrutibhūtatvābhāvāt aśrutatvādityarthaḥ |
kevalaṃ codakena prāptiḥ, tatrāpi maitrāvaruṇasya ekatvāt dvitīyaṃ bhāgaṃ codako na prāpayati |
myuṣṭiḥ, āṅgirasaḥ, kāpivanaḥ, caitrarathaḥ iti dvirātrā ahīnāḥ |
teṣu sarveṣu uttaramahaḥ atirātra iti sthitam |
dvirātrasya dvitīye ahani ṣoḍaśī graho gṛhyate ‘uttare'han dvirātrasya gṛhyate’ iti vākyāt |
vi. 20|9|19, dvirātre, aṅgirasāṃ dvirātrasya kratau eva, nānyeṣu dvirātreṣu iti parisaṃkhyāyate |
tu yadā agniḥ tadā guṇakāmāṇāṃ pravṛttiḥ iti |
dvirātrādau ahargaṇe codakaprāptaṃ kṛṣṇa- viṣāṇāprāsanaṃ vihitaṃ kaṇḍyanamahādhituṃ carame ahanyeva kartavyam |
dvirātrādau dvitīyādirūpe eva antime na pānīsaṃjñājāntavam |

dvirātrādivikṛtiṣu dvādaśāhikadaśarātragatānāṃ dvitīyādīnāmanyatve'pi yatrāprakṛti panīsaṃjñājāntayaivā- nuṣṭhānaṃ iti pūrvapakṣe noḥ; siddhānte tu dvitīyatayā panī- saṃjñājāntasyāpi iha anyatayā sakalānuṣṭhānaṃ iti prayoga- vikārāt ūhaḥ |
dvirātratrirātrādivikṛtiṣu dvādaśāhasya āditāḥ krameṇa (dvitīyamaharājasya) ahaḥ ahoḥ ahaḥ pravṛttiḥ |
teṣu hi kṛtsnasya dvādaśāhasya vidhyantaḥ pravartate, uta prāvaṇīyodanīyau varjayitvā daśa- rātrasyeti |
codanāsu tāsu prāvaṇīyodanīyayoḥ pūrva- tvena asaṃbhavat daśarātrasya vidhyantaḥ pravartate |
kiṃ liṅgaṃ bhavati ? evamāha ‘ yatrathayaṃ tadvitīyaṃ yadvitīyaṃ tattṛtīyam, jagatīmantargacchati’ iti |
evaṃ jñāpayati, yatrathayaṃ dvirātrasya, tadvitīyaṃ traidham |
jagatīmantargacchati paḍahatṛtīyaṃ jāgatamahaḥ antarīyāṇaṃ darśayan daśarātra pravṛttiṃ darśayati |
tattṛtīyamiti dvādaśāhasya, dvirātre tṛtīyābhāvāt apica idamaparaṃ liṅgam, gāyatrīṃ prathamamahaścaturthaṃ dvitaṃ jagatīmantargacchati, antarāye ṣaḍahatṛtīyaṃ jāga darśayati |
prakṛte tu prayojanāntarābhāvāt vaiyarthyaparihārārthe satyapi dharmāṇāṃ prakṛtau aharmātrāṅgatve vikṛtau gaṇatvasāmānye dharmapradeśakatā daśarātrasyaiveti vijñāyate |
ata eva prāthamyayogābhāve prāyaṇīyayodanīyayornāmādeśena dharma- prerakatve'pi na kṣatiḥ |
na caivaṃ daśarātrarūpavikṛtāveva daśarātrasya nāmātideśavidhayā codanāliṅgātideśavidhayaiva vā sārthaklopapatteḥ sarvatrātideśa pramāṇābhāvaḥ |
dvirātre ‘yadyamaṃ tad dvitīyam, yadvitīyaṃ tat tṛtīyam, jagato- mantraṃ gacchati’ iti liṅgopabṛṃhitāt rātrāntaśabdavatvā- cāntarasāhṛdayaviśeṣapādeva sārvatrikatvāvagateḥ |
dvirātre yat prathamamahaḥ tat dvādaśāhasya dvitīyasya vikāraḥ iti tideśe hi dvirātre ṣaḍahadvitīyasya hānī syāt, na tu jāgatasya ṣaḍahadvitīyasya |
tathā dvirātamāntare ‘gāyatraṃ prathamaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ dvitīyam’ ityapi liṅgam |
taṇḍulaiḥ balvajaiḥ iti ca prayoktavye yā dvitīyā prayujyate , tannūnaṃ tṛtīyāsāmānyārthā sā iti gamyate |
' yadā padārthāntara- bhūtaudanaśikhaṇḍasādhanatvena taṇḍulatvajāḥ vivakṣyante, tadā tṛtīyā'ntapadābhāyo bhavanti |
yadā tu bhojanayogyo- danātvavyāpāranimittatvena taṇḍulāḥ , mārdavopalakṣaṇe ca śilaṇḍakākāreṇa balvajā dṛśyante |
tathā vedavākyāvagata- guṇabhāvācca te dravyasādhanake agnihotre suvarṇadiṣṭāntaḥ ramaṇīyatvāt kasyāścit brāhmaṇyāḥ svakarmaśobhādarśanāyeṃ taṇḍulāḥ homasaṃbandhidhatvena abhipretāḥ |
sā evaṃ pradhyeti guṇakāmā vā 'yajamānaṃ taṇḍulān juhudhi' iti , tadā dvitīyārthābhāvaṃ bhavati |
guṇabhūte'pyevaṃ kenacit kāraṇena kaścit ādhānyāṃśo vivakṣyate , tathā pradhānabhūteṣu guṇāṃśaḥ |
na ca yat vivakṣyate , tat śabdenābhidhātavyaṃ ityasti pramāṇam |
kārakaṃ kriyā eva bhavati , na dravyasya |
9|2|2|3 prātipadikārthe carantī dvitīyā vibhaktiḥ prātipadikārtho viśeṣakaḥ 'ityāha' bhāṣye |
nyāyā. ekādaśādhyāyārthavicāre dvitīyā karmakārakavibhaktyā prādhānyamavagamyate karmaṇi |
vi 2|1|3, dvitīyā ( grahaṃ saṃmārṣṭi ) grahasya uddeśyatayā prayojanavattvā ca prādhānyaṃ gamyate |
' vāla. pṛ. 22, dvitīyāyāḥ īpsitānīpsitakarmaṇoḥ anugataṃ sādhayat śaktyā''cche- dakam |
'ghaṭaṃ paśyati' ityatra darśanajanyajñātatāyāḥ ghaṭaniṣṭha- tvāt lakṣaṇasamanvayaḥ |
nanu evaṃ 'caitro grāmaṃ gacchati' ityādau caitrasya karmatvāpattiḥ , kriyājanyasaṃyogaśālitvāt |
evaṃ 'caitro grāmaṃ gacchati' ityādau caitrasamaveta- vyāpārajanyadhātvarthatā'vacchedakasaṃyogaśālitayā grāmasya karmatā |
tyajateḥ vibhāgaphalakavyāpāre śaktiḥ iti noktadoṣaḥ ityāhuḥ |
' karturīpsitatamaṃ karma ' ( pā. 1|4|49 ) 'tathāyuktaṃ cānīpsitam' ( 50 ) iti vyākaraṇāt |
utpattirnāma yena kāreṇa kārakaṃ abhi- dhānopapattam , tasya asata evāpādanam |
yathā yūpaṃ chinatti , ghaṭaṃ kurute , payo dogdhi , brīhīnavahanti , brīhīna prokṣati iti |
etaduktaṃ vākyapadīye 'yasyajāyate saddhā janmanā yat prakāśate |
tannivartye vikāryaṃ tu dvedhā karme vyavasthitam ||
yathā tṛṇaṃ spṛśati , viṣaṃ bhuṅkte , gāṃ dogdhi , viṣamamanugacchati , agrimayujati iti ca |
yavānāmīpsitatvena apādānatayā īpsitatame gavi dvitīyā- prāptyarthatvāt ādyasya , 'viṣaṃ bhakṣayati' ityādau dvitīya- sthāpi sārthakyāt |
duhyādyādi- dvikarmakadhātūnāṃ apādānatvādi kārakeḥ asaṃbhavadanvayaṃ dhātvarthatā''cchedakaphalaśāli vyāpyamānaṃ dvitīyaṃ karma |
gāṃ payo dogdhi , rājānaṃ yācate vasudhām , ajāṃ grāmaṃ nayati |
( payaḥkarmakadohena gāṃ bhāvayati iti ) - viparītaṃ vā |
ata eva 'tate payasi dadhyānayati' ityatra dvitīyakarmā- pekṣayā payasaḥ karmatvenānvayaḥ |

'gatibuddhipratyavasānārthaśabdakarmakarmakāṇām kartā sa ṇau' ( pā0 1|4|52 ) gatyarthakabuddhyarthakapratyava- sānārthakānāṃ śabdakarmakāṇāṃ akarmaṇāṃ ca śayanādyarthaka- dhātūnāṃ aṇyantānāṃ samabhiva
spandatādeḥ naiva kiñcit phalaṃ dhātvarthatā'vacchedakaṃ iti noktātivyāptiḥ |
tena dhātvarthatā'vacchedakavyāpāratvāt vyāpāre, adhodeśa- mādāya adhodeśāvayave ca nātivyāptiḥ |
ata eva ‘narakaṃ patati’ ityapi prayogaḥ” iti kecit |
nanu ‘grāmaṃ gamayati caitro maitram’ ityatra maitre karmatva- lakṣaṇamapya adhyāstiḥ |
na ca ‘sanādyantā dhātavaḥ’ (pā0 3|1|32) iti vacanāt ṇijantya dhātusaṃjñātvāt |
ṇijanta- gamidhātvarthasya gamanānukūlavyāpārasya maitre abhāvāt nādhyāptiḥ ; tadarthatā'vacchedakasya gamanākhyaphalasya maitre sattvena viśeṣyadatvāt satvāt iti vācyam |
na ca ‘ṇijantyasya dhātutve'pi gamerapi dhātutvānnapātāt grāmasya tatkarmatvopapattiḥ |
tathātve ‘pācayati caitro maitreṇa’ ityatrāpi maitrasya karmatvāpatteḥ |

‘gatibuddhipratyava- sānārthaśabdakarmakākarmakāṇām kartā sa ṇau’ (pā0 2|4|52) ityanena sūtreṇa gadīnāṃ anyantānāṃ yaḥ kartā, sa ṇ‌ntānāṃ karma ityarthena gatyādibhinnadhātuyoge karmasaṃjñā niṣedhena tatrāpi iṣṭāpatteḥ kartṛ aśakyatvāt |
‘hṛkroranyatarasyām’ (pā0 2|4|53) iti sūtreṇa hārayati- kārayatidhātuyoge vikalpena karmasaṃjñāvidhānāt ‘hārayati kārayati kartṛ bhyena, hārayati kārayati kartṛ bhyalam’ iti prayogadvayāpatteḥ |
tatra bhavye dhātvarthatā'vacchedakī- bhūtaprayojyavyāpārarūpaphalāśrayatvasya sarvadā satvena karmatva- tadabhāvātḥ vaktumaśakyatvāt |
itarathā ubhayakarmasaṃjñāyogasthale caitrasya svabhinna- maitrasamavetakamanyasaṃyoga āśrayatvāt ‘caitro maitraṃ gacchati’ ityatra caitrasya karmatvāpatteḥ |
tathātve caitra- niṣkriyāyāḥ parasamavetatvābhāvādeva tatra nātivyāptiḥ |
tataśca yatkriyājanyadhātvarthatā'vacchedakaphalaśāli sat yat yatkriyānadhikaraṇam, tat tatkriyākarma iti viśiṣṭaiva karmatvaniruktiḥ |
parasamavetakriyājanyadhātvarthatā'vacche- dakaphalaśāli yat, tat tatkriyākarma iti vā niruktiḥ |
‘caitro maitraṃ gacchati, maitraścaitram’ ityatra tatkartṛniṣṭhakriyāmādāya gamayati ityādi ca gamikriyāmādāya grāmasya tadanukūla- vyāpārarūpanijadhāmādāya maitrasya karmatvaṃ nirvācyam |
‘ghaṭaṃ bhāvayati’ ityādi tu ṇijarthamādāyaiva, bhūdhātoḥ karmakatvāt |
pācayati ityādi ca pacyarthamādāyaiva odanasya, na tu anukūlavyāpāramādāya maitrasya, uktasūtrānurodhāt |
ata eva tatra ṇijarthaḥ akarmaka eva |
athavā tasyāpi odana eva karmaṃ, vikalyataanukūlatvāt viśeṣo'tā |
evaṃ ca hārayati- kārayatinirūpitakarmatvaniruktau tṛtīyā'ntapadanimittatva- mapi deyam |

evaṃ ca gamitapadavyā vivakṣā sammyantapadanimittatvaṃ vā deyam (parasamavetamikriyājanyaphalaśālitvena vivakṣitaṃ yat, tat gamikriyākarma iti vivakṣā lakṣaṇe deyā, parasamavetagamikriyājanyaphalaśālitve sati sammyantapada- midheyaṃ gamikarma iti sammyantapadamidheyaṃ vā deyaṃ ityarthaḥ) |
tena ‘grāme gacchati, narake patati’ ityādi- prayogasyāpi upapattiḥ |
na caivaṃ tatkarmatvanāṃ medāt dvitīyāyāḥ śaktigrahaṇāpattiḥ, lāghavena vṛttitve abhāve ca dvitīyāyāḥ |
‘grāmaṃ gacchati’ ityatra dvitīyārtho vṛttitvaṃ dhātvarthatā'vacchedake saṃyoge anveti |
yadi tu gamanātyantābhāvo'pi caitre kāli- kāvyāpyavṛttitvāt āśaṅkyeta, tadā parasamavetatvādi- anyonyābhāvaghaṭitalakṣaṇamādāya bhedo dvitīyārthaḥ |
vastutastu medābhyāpyavṛttitvamate caitre gamanavadbhedasa tulyatvāt tadāraṇāya prakṛtyartho grāmo mede pratiyogitāsaṃbandhena anveti |
ata eva ādheyatvāparaparyāyavṛttitvārthatvamataḥ vṛtti- svārthakadvitīyāyāḥ medaḥ, medārthasya avikatvāt |
yat dvitīyā'rtho vṛttitvaṃ dhātvarthatā'vacchedake phale evānveta, sasamyastha vṛttisvaṃ dhātvarthe nāmārthe vā iti |
evaṃ ‘caitreṇa grāmo gamyate’ ityādyamedena phalaṃ medaśca abhīyate |
sa ca dhātvarthagame sāmānādhikaraṇyasaṃbandhena, sa ca dhātvarthau gamanaṃ punaḥ ātmanepadārthe phale janyatva- saṃbandhena, tacca āśrayatvena nāmārthe grāme |
tataśca caitra- kartṛka - grāmabhinnasamavetasaṃyogajanakagamanajanyasaṃyogaāśrayo grāmaḥ ityevaṃ śābdabodhaḥ |
tatra tu ayaṃ viśeṣaḥ : kṛdarthaḥ pratiyogī medaḥ vṛttitvaṃ āśrayaśca |

odanaḥ abhedena pratiyogini, sa ca svaniṣṭhapratiyogitānirūpakasaṃvanadhena mede, sa ca sāmānādhikaraṇyena kriyāyām, sā ca svajanyaphaladvārā (phalavṛttitvasaṃbandhena) vṛttisve, tacca nirūpakatvasaṃbandhena āśraye, sa ca abhedena odane iti odanābhinnapratiyogikabhedavṛttiājanyaphalaniṣṭhādheyatā- nirūpakāśrayābhinnaḥ odanaḥ iti viśeṣabodhaḥ |

nanu evaṃ mede pratiyoginaḥ pratiyogitāmātreṇa vā anvayaḥ; anvayitā'vacchedakāvacchinnapratiyogitā- katvena vā ? nādyaḥ : vaiśiṣṭyavyāsajyavṛttidharmāvacchinnaprati- yogitākabhedasya caitre'pi sattvena ‘svaṃ gacchati caitraḥ’ iti prayogāpatteḥ |
tṛtīyā''dyekaraṇavādo, pācyati ityatra ṇijarthaviśeṣa- ṇībhūte pāke ca ativyāpteḥ |
ataḥ svarūpasaṃbandhātmakaṃ avacchedakatvaṃ padārthāntarameva vā kalpyam |
tacca dharmigrāhaka- pramāṇena yadāśraye dvitīyā prāmāṇikī, tatraiva kalpyate nānyatra iti vācyam |
na ca tatra śābdavyavahārātiriktaṃ kiñcit pramāṇamasti |
tadeva vakṣyamāṇavidhayā karmatvā- dikāraṇāṃ akhaṇḍopādhirūpāṇāṃ dvitīyādivācyatva- kalpanopapatteḥ na ādheyatvādeḥ anekavyutpattikalpanā''- pādikā vācyatvakalpanā yuktā samāśrayitum |
dvitīyāyāstāvatṛ vṛttibhede meda ca śaktiḥ ityanekaśakti- kalpanā |
dhātośca phalāvacchinnavyāpāre ekā, phale vyāpāre ca nānā śaktiḥ |
asamarthate tu pūrvoktavidhayā tattvaphalāvacchinnavyāpāravṛttipācakatvagamana- tvādimeva tattrātuśakyatāvacchedakaṃ iti na aneka- śaktikalpanā |
punaśca bhavanmate phalasya tattvena bodhe pūrvadeśavibhāga
evaṃ ca 'kartṛkaraṇayostṛtīyā' (pā0 2|3|18) 'karmaṇi dvitīyā' (pā0 2|3|2) ityādyanuśāsanamapi saṃgacchate iti kaściduktam- tanna |
saṃbandhavāciṣpaṣṭhītve prātipadikārthasya pratyayārthe saṃbandhamedena anvayāṅgīkārāt ihāpi nyupayantyantarakalpanāgauravaparihārārthaṃ medasaṃbandhacodyāya karmatvādāveva dvitīyādeḥ śaktikalpanāt |

na caivam 'aindraṃ dadhi' ityādau taddhitasya devatāviśiṣṭadravyavācino'rthe devatāyāṃ indraprātipadikārthasya indrasya abhedenāpi anvaya- darśanāt nyupayantyantarasyāpi āvaśyakatvam, taddhitasyāpi devatātvaviśiṣṭadravye eva śakyaṅgīkāreṇa tatrāpi indrasya ādheyatātva
yācca pañca daṇḍa ruci praccha ci brūñ śāsu (ji) mathi |
muṣ nīj hj kṛṣ vah -rūpadhātusamānārthakadhātūnāṃ yat |
‘ grāmaṃ samayā, grāmaṃ nikaṣā ’ ityatrāpi nirūpitatvaṃ |
dvitīyā''di yathā ‘ gāṃ dogdhi payaḥ’ ityādi |
kṣāyāṃ tu ‘ goḥ payo dogdhi ’ iti pañcamyantaprayogaḥ |
kiñcit pratibhāti tanna bubhukṣitam ’ iti vacanavyaṅgyī- |
vivakṣāyāṃ payasaḥ karmatvābhāvāt tatsaṃbandhinyā api goḥ |
na karmatvaṃ ityetadartham ‘ karmatvaṃniyata: ’ iti viśeṣaṇam |
ata eva ‘ gāṃ payaso dogdhi ’ iti na prayogaḥ |
tyajanopasarjanaṃ tyājanaṃ duherarthaḥ, tathā ca dhātvarthā''- |
kathamatra dvitīyāyāḥ saṃbandhe lakṣaṇā iti vācyam |
ata eva na ‘ akathitaṃ ca ’ ityādyanuśāsanavaiyarthyam |
ata eva vastutaḥ atra apādānatvāt eva goḥ saṃbandhaḥ |
‘ tvāṃ māṃ ityatra saṃbandhitvaṃ dvitīyā'rthaḥ, tava mama ca madhye |
evaṃ akarmakadhātuyoge ‘ deśaḥ kālo bhāvo gantavyo- |
upa prati pari abhi adhi su ati api ityādayaḥ |
lakṣaṇatve ca anvayaḥ, tayośca nirūpakatāsaṃsargeṇa varṣaṇe, |
sarvathā siddhaṃ sarvatra dvitīyā'rtho bhāvanānvayī iti |
ata eva 'odanaṃ pacati', odanaṃ kariṣyan, odanaṃ bhuṅkte' ityādau sarvatra dvitīyāyāḥ bhāvanānvayaḥ iti saṃkṣepaḥ |
