tataśca vidheyavākyaiḥ 'na hiṃsyāt' ityā- dibhiḥ anarthatvena lakṣamāṇānāṃ hiṃsādīnāmapi dharmatvaṃ syāt tadādyarthyaṃ ya eva artharūpeṇa pravartakavākyairdṛśyate tasyaiva dharmatvaṃ vaktuṃ arthagrahaṇam |
upariṣṭāt 'hiṃsā hi sā, sā ca pratiṣiddhā' iti vivaraṇāt |
yacca phalapadena saha saṃbadhyate tasyārthaṃ dharmaṃ apūrvasādhanaṃ ca manyante |
upāṃśuyājatvāt upāṃśuḥ, 'yat kiñcit prājāpatyaṃ yadya kriyate upāṃśudeva tat kriyate' iti vacanācca prajāpaterapi upāṃśutvam |
tatra 'prajāpati manasā yajet' iti vākye devatāyāḥ prajāpateḥ anirvacanaṃ turṇībhāvaḥ dharmaḥ ava-
paurṇamāsyāmeva upāṃśuyāja iti pakṣaṃ tuśabdo nyāya- tayati |
'upāṃśuyājamanantarā yajati' iti vākyena aviśeṣeṇa upāṃśuyājaḥ ubhayatra paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyāyāṃ ca vidhīyate |

'tāvanatratāmagrīṣomo ... upāṃśu paurṇa- māsyām' iti paurṇamāsyāṃ agnīṣomavidhānāt agnī- ṣomadevatyaḥ upāṃśuyājaḥ paurṇamāsyām, mantrāmnānāt vaiṣṇavaḥ ; upāṃśuyājaḥ amāvāsyāyāṃ iti devatāvikalpaḥ syāt |
paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāyāṃ ca upāṃśuyājaḥ itipakṣaṃ vāśabdo vyāvartayati |
pratiṣidhya amāvāsyāṃ varjayitvā paurṇamāsyāṃ upāṃśuyājasya vidhānāt |
viṣṇuḥ prajāpatinā agnīṣomābhyāṃ ca samānadeśaḥ syāt |
tayorvā deśaḥ paurṇamāsī sa eva deśo viṣṇorapi |
tasmāt paurṇamāsyāmeva upāṃśuyājaḥ tatraiva ca devatāvikalpaḥ iti siddhāntavādī |
'ājyasyaiva no upāṃśu paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan' iti prakṛtya āmnāyate 'jāmi vā etad yajñasya kriyate yadanavadyau puroḍāśau upāṃśuyājamanantarā yajati' iti |
tatraiva cedaṃ vacanam 'viṣṇurupāṃśu yaṣṭavyo'jāmivāya, prajāpatirupāṃśu yaṣṭavyo'jāmivāya, agnīṣomāvupāṃśu yaṣṭavyāvajāmivāya' iti |
tathā ca amāvāsyāyāṃ upāṃśuyājābhāve anyārthadarśanaṃ bhavati |
amāvāsyāyāmapyasattve caturdaśa āhutayaḥ syuḥ, na trayodaśa |
pañca prayājāḥ, dvau ājyabhāgau, agnīṣomīyau dvau, upāṃśuyāja ekaḥ, sviṣṭakṛt, trayo'nuyājāḥ, iti caturdaśa āhutayaḥ; paurṇa- māsyām |
amāvāsyāyāṃ tu āgneyaḥ sānāyyaṃ ceti dve viśeṣaḥ, upāṃśuyājaśca nāsti iti trayodaśa āhutaya na cānaṅgaṃ sakṛcchrutāvubhayatra vidhīyeta saṃbandhāt |
anaṅgaṃ agnī- pradhānaṃ upāṃśuyājaḥ sakṛt paurṇamāsyāṃ śrutau śravaṇe sa ubhayatra paurṇamāsyāṃ amāvāsyāyāṃ ca na vidhīyeta, sakṛt śravaṇe ubhayatra na syāt |
guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvāt pradhānasya pravṛttau vidhi- liṅgāni darśayati |
guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvāt pradhānasya pravṛttau vidhiliṅgā darśayati |
katham ? 'ap mantāvājyabhāgau yajati', 'ekādaśa prayājān yaja ekādaśadānān' iti |
i tasya pravṛttau vidhiliṅgaṃ na syāt, iti tasya ama vāsyāyāṃ na pravṛttiḥ |
amāvāsyāyāṃ vikāre sākaṃ prayāyīye upāṃśuyāja aśrutitvāt aśravaṇāt amāvāsyāyāmapi nopāṃśuyājaḥ idamuktam 'ānantarye ca' iti sūtre (56) |
tatraiva ca prajāpatiḥ viṣṇu agnīṣomau iti devatā vikalpena iti siddhāntaḥ kauṣītakibrāhmaṇe tu amāvāsyāyāmapi upāṃśuyāja uktaḥ prakṛtavicārastu śāstrāntaraviṣaye, kutnācintyā vā |
ve dharmasya agnihotrādilakṣaṇasya pratyakṣādibhirana- gatasya nimittaṃ (jñāpakaṃ) upadeśaḥ |
bhā. 1|1|1 pṛ. 23. dharmasyārthakṛtyatvāt dravyaguṇavicārasyati kramapratiṣedhe codanā'nubandhaḥ samavāyāt |
prākṛtaṃ vrīhiṣu prokṣaṇaṃ vājapeye 'vārhaspatyaṃ ca naivāraṃ saptadaśaśarāvaṃ nirvapati' iti nīvāreṣu bhavati vā |
'saṃsthite ṣaḍahe madhyāyet ghṛtaṃ vā' iti madhva yaśane 'na bahu vadet nānyaṃ pṛcchet nānyasmai brūyāt
rājasūye 'nairkataṃ caruṃ natvāvapūtānāṃ parivṛtte gṛhe' iti nakhebu prākṛtaṃ musalo- lūkhalayoḥ prokṣaṇaṃ bhavati na vā |
cāturmāsyeṣu 'paridhau paśuṃ niyuñjīta' iti paridhau paśudharmaḥ kartavyo na vā |
'na girāgirati brūyāt airaṃ kuruvadreyam' iti irāpade girāpadadharmo (āyībhāvaḥ) bhavati na vā iti vicāre siddhāntamāha |
dravyaṃ ca guṇaśca vikāraśca vyatikramaśca pratiṣedhaśca teṣāṃ samāhāraḥ tasmin |
tatra dravye nīvā- rādau, guṇe madyaśanādau, vikāre nakhebu, vyatikrame yūpaṃ vyatikramya niyojanasādhanatayā vihite paridhau, pratiṣedhe pratiṣiddha vihite irāpade ca codanā'nuvandhaḥ |
tādṛśaśca coyamānasya prokṣaṇādermasa anubandhaḥ atideśaḥ syāt |
dharmasya prokṣaṇādeḥ arthena apūrveṇa kṛtatvāt prayuktātvāt |
phalacamase somatvābhāvāt kathamanuṣṭhicchatvaṃ saṃbhavati ? na tveṣa doṣaḥ, snānāpatyā somadharmalābhāt |
sati indriyārthasaṃbandhe yā puruṣasya buddhirjāte tat pratyakṣam, bhaviṣye'pi'rthaḥ, na jñānakāle'stīti |
dharmasya prameya- sve'pi pratyakṣayogyatā nāsti, pratyakṣasya vartamānamātra- viṣayatvāt |
yastu dharmaḥ pratyakṣasya atyantamanaviṣayaḥ tatra anumānādīnāṃ kā kathā |
aṣṭakāḥ kartavyāḥ' ityādayaḥ smṛtayaḥ dharme pramāṇaṃ na veti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
dharmasya 'codanālakṣaṇo- 'rtho dharmaḥ' (1|1|2) iti lakṣitasya śabdamūlatvāt vaidikaśabdapramāṇatvāt asādhaṃ vaidikaśabdamidaṃ smṛtiḥ |
anapekṣyaṃ iti tu bhūyaḥsu minneṣu pustakeṣu pāṭhaḥ |
smṛtayo dharme na pramāṇaṃ iti pūrvapakṣaṃ vyāvartayati apivāśabdaḥ |
anumānaṃ mānaṃ pramāṇaṃ śrutirūpamanusmṛtya pramāṇatvāt smṛtiḥ dharme pramāṇaṃ syāt |
athedānīṃ yatra vaidikaṃ śabdamupalabhyante, atha ca smaranti evamayaṃ padārtho'nuṣṭhātavya etasmai prayojanāyeti, kimarthaṃ tathaiva syānneti bhavati vicāraṇā |
yathā 'aṣṭakāḥ kartavyāḥ,' 'gururbhagantavyaḥ,' 'taṭākaṃ khanitavyam' 'prapāḥ pravartayi- tavyāḥ', 'śivākarma kartavyam' iti |
atra prābhākareṇa saṃgatileomāt iyamadhikarupamupavarṇitam— atra sarvepāmeva smṛtitvāt yathāsaṃbhavaṃ vidhivyādavākyatayā pratīyate |
kiñca tathā sati viprakīrṇavedapatyāsenaiva nirvicikitsa- traivarṇikavyavahārasiddhau smṛtinibandhanaprayāsavaiyarthyāt ca |
ato dharmasya vedaikadeśamūlatvāt avidyamānamūlatvavedaśabda aṣṭādaśadiṃ dharmatvena anapekṣitatvam, na bhavatyeva dharmaḥ ityeva prāpte, abhi- dhīyate— apitvā kartṛsāmānyāt pramāṇamanumānaṃ syāt |
ayamiprāyaḥ— sarvathā tāvat sannidhadhanā manvādi- smṛtayaḥ pūrvavijñānapūrvikāḥ |
tatra na tāvat smṛterbhrānti- vijñānapūrvakatvaṃ saṃbhavati |
bhrāntirhi kalpyamānā nyāyā- bhāsanibandhanā vā vaktavyā, duḥśrutaśabdanibandhanā vā |
na ca sakalanyāyatattveṣu ṣaḍaṅgasakalavedavyāptiṣu tathā vidhānaikamunijanopadeśāmāneṣu tadupamapi saṃbhavati |
atha kiṃ nāma dharmatvaṃ adharmatvaṃ vā ? na tāvat vihitakriyātvaṃ niṣiddhakriyātvaṃ vā tat, vihita- niṣiddhadravyādau tadanāpatteḥ |
nahi phalārthaguṇāṇuṣṭhātṛṇāṃ yajñe rajatādyanuṣṭhātṛṇāṃ ca dhārmikaḥ adhārmikaḥ iti vyava- hārābhāvaḥ |
tasya dharmatvābhāve tajjanyasya dharmatvā- bhāvena kīrtanāsyatvanāpatteśca |
nāpi kriyātvarahitaṃ tat, vivāhāryānutatvavacanādau abhyanujñāvidhiviṣaye dharma- tvāpatteḥ, ṣoḍaśigrahaṇe adharmatvāpatteśca |
vedabodhitaśreyaḥsādhanatākatvaṃ dharmatvam, tadbodhitāniṣṭa- sādhanatākatvaṃ adharmatvaṃ ityeva lakṣaṇopapatteḥ |
jyoti- ṣṭomaklṛptabhakṣaṇādīnāṃ hi iṣṭāniṣṭasādhanatā vedabodhitā iti tatra lakṣaṇasamanvayaḥ |
aniṣṭavibhakṣaṇādeḥ iṣṭāniṣṭa- sādhanatve'pi tasya vedabodhitatvābhāvāt āyuḥ |
śyene ca iṣṭasādhanatāyā eva vedabodhitatvāt dharmatvameva |
tathaiva ca vedabodhitā- niṣṭasādhanatākatvāt adharmatvaṃ na tu śyenasya iti vyaktaṃ caturthe |
yatra tu 'vairimaraṇākāmo yajeta' iyevaṃ vidhiḥ tatrāpi vidhinā iṣṭasādhanatābodhanāt yāgāderdharmatvameva |
na ca tatra yāgasyaiva maraṇākulavyāpāratvena hiṃsātvāt 'na hiṃsyāt' iti niṣedhaviṣayatvam, niṣedhasya rāga- prāptahiṃsājīvanenāpi upapattau vihite apravṛtteḥ |
na caivaṃ tādṛśaśāstrale śyenavat paraṃparayā'pi pratyavāyānupatteḥ śiṣṭānāṃ tatra niṣkampapravṛttyāpattiḥ |

'paramyosādanārthaṃ yat (vā) tat tāmasasudāhṛtam' (bha. gī. 17|19) ityādivākyaparyāyalocanayā abhicārajanakatvavat abhi- cārasyāpi karmaṇastāmasatvena ninditatvāt taducitaniṣedha- balena phalārthe vihitasyāpi tasya aniṣṭajanakatvena adharma- tvasyāpi sattvāt taddharmādhamatvayoḥ |
yattu dharmalakṣaṇe bala- vadaniṣṭānanubandhitvasyāpi praveśāt śyenādau ca tadabhāvāt na dharmatvamiti |
tatravedha prayojanābhāvāt, aniṣṭagadadoṣītkaṭyarūpasya balavattvasya prācīnakarmā- dhīnatayā uktavidhānatunidhasya śyene'pi kadācit saṃbhavācca |
abhyanujñā- vidhinā ca doṣābhāvamātrasyaiva ākṣepāt iṣṭasādhanatā'- nākṣepeṇa rāgaprāpteṣṭasādhanatākasyāpi anutatvadanya veda- bodhitaiṣṭasādhanatākatvābhāvāt na dharmatvāpattiḥ |
ṣoḍaśi- grahaṇe ca niṣedhena nāniṣṭasādhanatā''kṣepaḥ pramāṇābhāvāt gauravācca |
apitu etadabhāve'pi itaratraiḥ ṛtumahoṣa- kārasiddhimaাত্রsyaiva tāvanmātreṇa puruṣasya nivṛttyupapatteḥ |
ata eva tatra pravṛttyarthe vidhinā phalādhikṣākṣepaḥ |
vedabodhitatvaṃ ca vedatirikta- pramāṇena svātantryeṇa abodhyatve sati vedabodhatvam |
tena tattvasākṣātkarūpabrahmajñānasya brahmaviṣayakavilāsājñāna- nivṛttirūpamokṣajanakatvasya pramāṇāntarasiddhasya upaniṣa- drodhyatve'pi na tasya dharmatvāpattiḥ |

yadā'pi prapañcasya satyatvena nājñānakāryatvam, mokṣaśca ekaviṃśatiduḥkha- dhvaṃsādirūpaḥ tattvajñānajanyaḥ iti matamapi prāmāṇikam, tadā mokṣajanakatvasya pramāṇāntarāgamyatvāt tatra dharmatva- parihārārthaṃ vedabodhitatvaṃ vihāya vidhivodhitatvaṃ deyam |
vastutastu 'ayaṃ tu paramo dharmo yad- yogenātmadarśanam' ityādi jñāne'pi dharmaśabdaprayogāt tasya dharmatve'pi na kṣatiḥ |
na ca tatrayadarśanaśabdo dhyānaparaḥ lakṣaṇāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt, dhyāne cittavṛtti- nirodharūpamyugyogajanyatvātsaṃbhavacca |
upāsanādivacca jñānasya dharmatve'pi brahmaṇo vedabodhitaśreyastvāttvaccha- sādhanatākatvābhāvena dharmatvābhāvāt dharmamīmāṃsāyāṃ brahma- mīmāṃsāyāṃ medopapattiḥ |
astu vā brahmaṇi dharmalakṣaṇasya ativyāptiparihārārthe puruṣakṛtivyāpyatvaṃ vedabodhitaśreyaḥ- sādhanatākatvaviśeṣaṇam |
jñānasyāpi ca svarūpeṇa kṛtivyāpyatvābhāve'pi samyagjarādivat tadanukūlamanaḥ- praṇidhānādeḥ kṛtivyāpyatvena paraṃparayā tadādivasya kṛti- vyāpyatvopapatteḥ nānnyāsti |
draṣṭavyaḥ' iti vidhipratyayo'pi etadabhiprāyaḥ ityapi etannate suvacam |
asādhāraṇaṃ vā kāraṇatā lakṣaṇe praveśanīyā, tallakṣaṇameva dharmādharmapadaśakyatā'vacche- dakam |
tasya ca kriyātajjanyadṛṣṭasādhāraṇyena ekayaiva śakyā dharmādharmaśabdau kriyātajjanyādṛṣṭaparī iti saṃkṣepaḥ |
ata eva 'dharmaḥ kṣarati kīrtanāt' ityādī vaiśeṣika- tantre ca kriyājanyādṛṣṭe dharmādharmaśabdasya prayogaḥ, tathāpi 'dharmaḥ khanuṣṭhitaḥ puṃsāṃ' (viṣṇusasenakathāsu yaḥ |
nopādeyad yadi rati śrama eva kevalaḥ |
rahasya. pṛ. 1, dharmādhamau dvādaśalakṣaṇayāṃ jaiminā anuṣṭhānopayogitayā vicāritau |
śā. 114|15 pṛ. 114 paṃ. 3. dharmādhamauḥ vidhi-arthavāda-mantra-smṛti-ācāra- nāmadheya-vākyaśeṣa- sāmarthyarūpāṇi aṣṭau pramāṇāni prathamādhyāye nirūpitāni |
pitāmahenoktaḥ- 'rājataṃ kārayed dharmādharmaṃ sīsakāyasam' iti pratimāvidhānam |
pakṣāntaramāha- 'likhed bhūrje paṭṭe vā''pi dharmādhamau sitāsitau |
gomayena mṛdā vā'pi piṇḍau kāryau samaṃ tataḥ |
tataḥ amiśrastaḥ abhimantrayet 'yadi pāpavimukto'haṃ dharmastvāyātu me kare |
dharmaṃ gṛhīte śuddhaḥ syādadharmaṃ tu hīyate |

' iti pṛ. 27. dharmārthaṃ sevakasya kṣudrasya viśvajiti na deyatvam bhā. 6|7|5|6. dharmajijñāsā iti 'dharmaśabdaḥ vedārthamātraparaḥ : ṛju. pṛ. 16. dharmajijñāsā 'ko dharmaḥ kathaṃlakṣaṇaḥ kānyasya sādhanāni, kānyasya sādhanābhāsāni, kiṃ paraśca iti caturvidhā prathamasūtreṇa upasthitā |
dharma jñānasya dharmatvāt dharmasyāpi icchā prati prādhānyam ato dharmāya jijñāsā |
evaṃ ca tādarthyasya pratīyamā- tvāt caturthītimāsa evāyam |
ṛju. pṛ. 13, dharma jijñāsā prārabhyate, tattvena aparijñāto'rthaḥ anuṣṭhīyamāne 'pi vihitaṃ anuṣṭhātāraṃ adhikārasiddhaṃ na prāpayati jñātvā ca anuṣṭhito niḥśreyasena adhikāriṇaṃ yojayā iti |

'dharme pāpamanuvadati' iti vākyena sāmānyato dharmajñāne tadukta tadanuvyavasāye dharmajñānasyāsāmānyapratyāsattyā sakaladharmajñāna- jñānam, tataḥ tadipyakecchā iti krameṇa sāmānyadharma- prakārakajñānasya viśeṣadharmaprakārakaccheprayojakam |
sā ceccha sapramāṇakaṃ dharmajñānaṃ jāyatāṃ ityādyākārā tādṛśecchādhana- tājñānajanyā ca |
pṛ. 2. dharmatvaṃ na tāvat yāgāpūrvabhayaniṣṭhā jātiḥ yāgasya kriyecchā'nyatararūpatayā kriyātva
yāgādikartari dhārmiko'yaṃ iti prayogān vedabodhitahetu- sādhanatvarūpaḥ |
vastutastu alaukikaśreyaḥsādhanatvena vihita- kriyātvaṃ vihitatvaṃ vā dharmatvam |
vivāhāryamidhyāvādasya vidheyatve'pi dharmatvaṃ nāsti, tasya vivāhādimātrādhanatayā alaukikatvābhāvāt |
upaniṣajjanyajñānasya avidyā- nivṛttidvārā mokṣajanakasya pramāṇāntaraprāptatvāt na dharma- tvam |
1|1|2|4. ⚑ dharmadharmivirodhe ca dharmiṇo balavattarāḥ iti nyāyena (vā. 1|3|16) ācamanādīnāṃ balava- tvāccāteḥ |
ci. 1|1|2. ✱ dharmaprāptiḥ (aṅgāprāptiḥ) upamānena yatra sādṛśyam, tatra dharmāḥ prāpyante, asati sādṛśye nāsti dharmaprāptiḥ |
ḍup. 8|1|2|2 pṛ. 1685, ✱ dharmaprāptiḥ sarvāstveva vikṛtiṣu upamānena |
10|1|2|1 pṛ. 1907, ✱ dharma- prāptiḥ sādṛśyāt bhavati, alaukikatvāt dharmāṇām |
9|1|5|9 pṛ. 1676. ✱ dharmaprāptau sādhanamātraṃ tantram, na tu vācanikatvam |
soma. 1|2|14. ✱ dharmabhedācca saṃjñāvyavasthā yathā brāhmaṇaḥ, parivrāṭ, vānaprasthaḥ iti |
bhā. 8|1|5|24, ✱ dharmabhedācca satraṃ ahīna iti saṃjñāvyavasthā |
8|1|5|24. ✱ dharmabhedakāni pramāṇāni śabdāntara-abhyāsa- saṃkhyā-nāma-guṇa-prakaraṇāntarāṇi iti ṣaṭ |
maṇi. pṛ. 13. (tatra yajati-dadāti-juhoti iti śabdāntareṇa karmabhedaḥ |
2|2|1, 'samidho yajati, tanūnapātaṃ yajati' ityādi yajatipadasya abhyāsena prayājabhedaḥ |
2|1|7, 'athaiṣa jyotiḥ, athaiṣa viśvajyotiḥ, athaiṣa sarvajyotiḥ' iti nāmabhedena (aindrāmedena) karmabhedaḥ |
2|1|8, 'sā vaiśvadevyāmikṣā, vājimyo vājinam' iti guṇabhedena karmabhedaḥ |

audumbaramulakhalaṃ sarvauṣadhasya pūrayitvā- 'vahanti atra tadupadadhāti' ityanenokte dharmamātre adṛṣṭa- mātraphalake avahanane tu dṛṣṭa taṇḍulaniṣpattayāḥ phalasya adarśanāt śabdārthena sakṛtkṛtanaiva apavargaḥḥ samāptiḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
tasmāt sarvauṣadhatvāt nāmnyāḥ niṣpattiparyantamāvatyamānāt vrīhyavaghātāt vaiṣamyāha |

ke. ✱ 'dharmamātre tadarśanāt śabdārthenāpavargaḥ syāt' (1|1|16|28) ityadhikaraṇe 'audumbaramulakhalaṃ sarvauṣadhasya pūrayitvā'vahanti ayanadupadadhāti' ityava- ghātasya taṇḍulasādhyapuroḍāśādiprayojanābhāvāt adṛṣṭā- rthatvāt sakṛdanuṣṭhāna vakṣyate |
su. pṛ. 626. ✱ 'dharma- mātre tadarśanāt śabdārthenāpavargaḥ syāt' ityanena nyāyena (prayājānāṃ) sakṛtprayogaḥ prāptaḥ |
'sucaḥ saṃmārṣṭi', 'agni saṃmārṣṭi', 'puroḍāśaṃ paryakti karoti' iti śrutaṃ saṃmārjanaṃ paryakiraṇaṃ ca pradhānakarma guṇakarma vā iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
dharma- mātre saṃmārgaparyakiraṇādirūpe sarvasmin karmaṇi karma syāt pradhānakarmatvaṃ syāt |
dṛṣṭopakāratvaṃ guṇakarmalakṣaṇam, tadatra nāsti iti saṃmā- rgādīnāṃ pradhānakarmatvaṃ syāt |
saṃmārgādi dharmajāta etaiḥ avaghātādibhiḥ guṇakarmabhiḥ sadharma samānadharmakaṃ syāt |
tulyaśrutitvāt yathā 'vrīhīnavahanti' iti dvitīyāśrutiḥ īpsitatama- svārthā, tathā 'sucaḥ saṃmārṣṭi' 'puroḍāśaṃ paryakti karoti' iyapi dvitīyā |
īpsitatamatvācca saṃmārgādi dharmajāta guṇakarma, vrīhihaviṣā dravyaṃ ca pradhānabhūtaṃ saṃskāryatvāt |
atra sadharmaḥ sadharmā iti pāṭho anyatra |
tathāpi anivṛttyantaḥ ya-ku- gataḥ napuṃsakapāṭha eva sādhīyān |
tathā sucaḥ puroḍāśaṃ ityādī dvitīyā nirdeśe'pi guṇabhūtatvaṃ syāt, tataśca saṃmārgādeḥ pradhānakarmatvam |
'anekāntikaṃ ca prādhānye dvitīyā guṇabhūtadravyo- padeśe'pi dṛśyatvāt saktūn juhoti iti vārtikāt dravyopadeśe iti saptamyantaṃ padam |
'saktudravyasya homaṃ prati sādhanatvena guṇabhūtasya dvitīyā upadeśaḥ |
'saktūn juhoti' iti dvitīyā guṇabhūtadravyopadeśe'pi dṛśyate iti yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā tanna |
saktūnāṃ tadarthatvā homāthatvāt guṇabhūtatvaṃ iti satyam |
dvitīyā tu ta lakṣaṇayā karaṇatvamāha iti dvitīyā na guṇabhūte |
ta saktuparoḍāśādeḥ śeṣabhūtatvāt adṛṣṭopakāraviśiṣṭatve saṃmārgaparyakiraṇādisādhayatvāt tatra dvitīyā prādhānyame bodhayati |
lokavat loke yathā grāmāntarādāgatānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ paryakiraṇe adṛṣṭa upakāraḥ kriyate ityucyate tadvat |
tasmā saṃmārjanaparyakiraṇādi guṇakarma, na pradhānakarma iti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. ⚑ dharmamātre tu karma syādanivṛtteḥ prayājavat |
'sucaḥ saṃmārṣṭi', 'parīcīna saṃmārṣṭi', 'agnī saṃmārṣṭi', 'puroḍāśaṃ paryakti karoti' iti śrūyate tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ paryakiraṇaṃ saṃmārjanaṃ ca pradhānakarma, u guṇakarmeti |
idānīṃ kaci viṣayaviśeṣe saṃmārgādī pradhānakarmapādeḥ kriyate tatrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇo'bhisaṃdhiḥ |
'yaistu dravyaṃ na cikī ṣyate tāni pradhānabhūtāni dravyasya guṇabhūtatvāt' i pradhānakarmalakṣaṇamuktam |
na ca sugādiṣu saṃmārgādijanya cikīrṣito vidhpekṣitaḥ kaścidrūpakāro dṛśyate |
tathā 'bhūta bhayasambucāraṇe bhūta bhavyāyopadiśyate' iti nyāye sugādidravyāṇāmeva saṃmārgādirūpakarmārthatvāt prayāja ditvat pradhānakarmatvameveti |
nanu mā nāma avahanya ditvat pramāṇāntareṇa dravyagataṃ cikīrṣitamavagamyatām tathāpi dvitīyāśritaiva īpsitatamārthābhidha
nanu vākyāntarakalpitaprayojanamātra lugādi- dravyam, aklaptaprayojanaṃ ca saṃmārgādi karma |
klaptaprayo- janayośca saṃbandhaḥ, klaptaprayojanārthatvenaiva aklaptaprayojanaṃ vidhīyate iti yuktam |

apekṣitavidhirapekṣitavidhānaṃ durbalam iti nyāyena dṛṣṭopakārābhāve'pi dvitīyāyā īpsitatamābhidhānamapi uktnyāyādeva klaptaprayojanalugā- didravyārthatvāt saṃmārgādīnāṃ (na) guṇakarmatvaṃ saṃbhavatīti |
sa hi svarasataḥ sādhyasya sādhanamitikartavyatāṃ cākāṅkṣat tadupāyabhūtaṃ dravyādikamapi ākāṅkṣati, tena vinā tadasiddheḥ |
yattu dravyagata saṃskārādikaṃ dṛṣṭārthadravyākāṅkṣayā saṃbadhyamānaṃ tadapi ākāṅkṣothāpanena anumanyate |
na ca 'sucaḥ saṃmārṣṭi' ityādiṣu lugādīnāṃ vrīhīṇāmiva dṛṣṭopa- kārārthamava
ata eva 'ṣaḍbhirdīkṣayati' itya- trāpi atrādhaṣṭaṃbhave sati nātideśikamantraḥ ṣaḍvāpakaḥ |
prakṛtau tu barhiṣāmaṅgapradhānahavirāsādanasaṃjñe'pi na kasya- cidvādha iti |
evaṃ sati svasyaiva nānājātikāryasya prakṛtau darśanāt yadi svarūpa- parṇatākāryeṣvapi śamyāḥ vidhiḥ, tathāpi saṃmārgasyaiva na śmīmītvam |

yataḥ anārambhādhītāyāḥ parṇatāyāḥ svargadvāreṇa aṅgapradhānāpūrvagṛhītāyāḥ pṛthageva apradhānā- pūrvakīyakaraṇopakārakasaṃndhidvārakakāryakalpanāt pradhānīya- karaṇopakārakasaṃndhidvārakakāryatvam, saṃmārgīyasvarūpaṃ parṇatā- kāryasyāpīti |
kiñca, aupasargikānvayahitabhāvātha- viṣayatvāt parṇatāṃ lakṣayitvā tatkāryatvena svāmyi lakṣya- māṇe lakṣitalakṣaṇaprasaṅgācca svakāryaṃ vidhirityucyate |
yadyapi parṇatākāryeṣvapi vidhiḥ, tathāpi saṃmārgasyaivajana- meveti na doṣaḥ |
yāvadupadeśo yogyānupalambho na bhavati, tāvat saṃdigdhatvāt tasyāṃ cāvasyāyāṃ balavatsa- ndigdhapramāṇena bādha eveti nāsti barhirmidrānaḥstaraṇam |
kiñca yathā aṅgapradhānasādhāraṇānugatenāpi vidhīya- mānasya prakṛtilabhyasādhananirākāṅkṣe aṅge pradeśo na bhavati, tāvat saṃdigdhatvāt tasyāṃ cāvasyāyāṃ balavatsa- ndigdhapramāṇena bādhāt |
'yo hotā so'dhvaryuḥ' ityatra aṅgākāryeṣu prākṛtaṛtvi- gadhvaryunirākāṅkṣeṣu yajamāne hotṛsaṃbandho na syāt |
tathā ca sati vartamānamanārthatvāt saiva (?) na syāt, 'vipratiṣedhe karaṇaṃ samavāyaviśeṣāditaramanyasteṣāṃ yato viśeṣaḥ syāt' iti nyāyavirodhaḥ syāt |
ata eva ātideśikādhabhayenāpi nopadeśasaṃkocaḥ, tatrāpi aṅgasaṃbandhini ṛtvigadhvaryukārye bādhabhayenaiva yajamānahotṛnivṛttiprasaṅgāt |
'vikarṣaṇā ca saṃyogāt' ityatra mahāvediḥ sarvā'pi etajjyotiṣṭomātha- tvasyaiva vārtikakārapādairuktatvāt |
na ca tanmate'pi atideśabādhabhiyā mahāvedividherdīkṣaṇīyā- ''diparityāgaḥ, kintu kvacit bādhakatvaṃ kvacit vādhānapekṣatvaṃ kvacit prāptakāryasyamityādividhaivairūpa- bhayenaiva |
kintu prākṛtapañcamakāryāsu dīkṣā''diṣu vaikṛtapañcamantrasaṃbandhe 'dvādaśa juhoti' iti vaikṛtābhyastāḥ ṣaḍ juhotyaḥ śrayante |
tatra kiṃ vaikṛtaireva mantrairabhyāsaḥ kriyatām, prākṛtairvā iti sandehe upadeśā- bhāvena kalpanīyo''dyamabhyāsasaṃbandhaḥ |
iha tu upadeśataḥ eva rūṅmāsaṃbandho nātideśabādhabhiyā saṃkocamarhatīti vaiṣamyam |

yattu kaiścit 'yasyobhayaṃ havirtimācchet, aindraṃ pañcaśarāvamodanaṃ nirvapet' ityatra vikṛtau atideśaprāptasya caturmuṣṭirnivāpasya anyataravādhanenopabhayabādhaḥ iti muṣṭimātravādhanamatra dṛṣṭāntatvena darśitam, tadayuktam |
tatropadeśiko bādhaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ubhayāvādhe caturmuṣṭihīnāṇāṃ pañcaśarāvodanāniṣpatteḥ |
arthāsaṃbhavena āvaśyakye anyatara- bādhe prāthamyāt saṃkhyā'nugraheṇa muṣṭimātrādho yukta eva |
atra tu aupadeśikatvāt bādhasya atulyatva- miti na kiñcidupapannamiti |
atha ajñānāmeva āti- deśikī prāptiḥ, anajñānāṃ tu saṃmārgasya vikṛtāvāpi aupadeśikī, itarathā patramāneterapi atideśaprasaṅgaḥ |
bena upadeśayostulyabalatvāt durbalatvādideśopapattipradhāna- stvāmeva bādha iti |
kimatidiṣṭākṣepebhya- tvāt ajñānāmaupadeśikatvam, atha saṃmārgoṃddeśena vihitānāṃ svacā prakṛtivikṛtisādhāraṇa evopadeśaḥ |
na tāvadādyaḥ phalapaḥ, atideśākṣepeṇamasya atideśa- to'pi jaghanyatvena sutarāṃ bādhyatvāt |
nāpi dvitīyaḥ, tathā ca sati vikṛtiśruto'pi praśājodeśena kṛṣṇalahomaḥ prakṛtau akṛtāvāpi prasajyeta |
na ca patramānetyatideśa- prasaṅgaḥ, prakṛtāveva 'yadāhavanīye juhoti' iti barhirniṣannasya āhavanīyasya aṅgatvavidhānāt vikṛtāvāpi tatasyaiva tathā prāptātvāt |
athocyeta ātideśikatve'pi asti prātikālavaidhamyam, yataḥḥ karaṇopakārasya ajñajanyatvena prathamaṃ saṃbandhaḥ, paścādaṅgāmisaṃbandhaḥ |

tathā sati barhirnidhirapi āhaprakaraṇāmyāṃ prathamaṃ prādhānīyahavirāsā- danasyaiva prāptatvāt upakāramātreṇa caramabhāvinīmaṅga- havirāsādanaprāpti atilaṅghyāt (atilaṅghyeta) barhiṣāṃ pradhānamātrasaṃbandhaḥ syāt |
yathā ca tatra tathā atrāpīti prātikālavaidhamye'pi na barhirnidhaḥ |
yato vena upakārapṛṣṭha- bhāvena hi aṅgasaṃbandho bhavan yathābhūtānāmeva upakāra- jananasāmarthye prakṛtau avagatam, tathābhūtānāmeva āti- deśikaḥ saṃbandho bhavaty |
svāṅgasahitasya prakṛtau upa- kārajanakatvātsvabhāvaṃ sahaiva prāpteḥ |
etacca sarvaṃ saṃmārgasucāṃ dīkṣaṇīyāvāṅni- yamavat saṃmārgārpūgṛhītatvamabhyupetyoktam |
dharmamokṣasaṃbandhi yat tadedaprabhavam, yat a sukhaviṣayaṃ tallokavyavahārapūrvakaṃ iti vivektavyam |
bhāṣyam— sa hi (dharmeḥ) niḥśreyasena puru saṃyunakti iti pratijānīmahe |
ācāryacoditaḥ karomi iti hi dṛśyate lakṣyate yena, tat lakṣaṇam, 'dhumo lakṣaṇamameḥ' |
tayā yo lakṣyate so'rthaḥ puruṣa niḥśreyase saṃyunakti iti pratijānīmahe |

codanā hi bhūtaṃ bhava bhaviṣyantaṃ sūkṣmaṃ vyavahitaṃ viprakṛṣṭaṃ ityenātītyakama śaknoti avagamayitum, nānyat kiñcana indriyam (atra vaidyanāthī— "nānyat kiñca iti padacchedaḥ tathā ca śabdasyaiva tādṛśārthabodhanasāmarthyam, na tadyatiriktapramāṇasāmānyāt |
atha 'nānyat kiñcana indriyam ityatra 'pradarśanārthamatroktamindriyaṃ sūtrakāravat nānyat kiñceti vā chedaḥ sāmānyārthaḥ prayujyate |
atra vārtike tredhā vyākhyātam 'nānyat kiñcana indriyam' samarthe iti |
yasmāt nendri samartham, tasmāt indriyapūrvakatvāt itarasya pramāṇasya tat samartham' iti-ke |
nanu atāthābhūtamatyai brūyāt codanā, yathā yatkiñca laukikaṃ vacanam 'nayāstīre phalāni santi' iti |
'bravīti' iti ucyate 'avabodhayati, budhyamānasya nimittaṃ bhavati' iti |
yadi ca codanāyāṃ satyāṃ agnihotrāt svargo bhavati iti gamyate, kathamucyate 'na tathā bhavati' iti |
na ca 'svargakāmo yajeta' ityetau sandigdhamavagamyate 'bhavati vā svargo na vā bhavati' iti |
na ca niścitamavagamyamānaṃ idaṃ mithyā syāt |
yo hi janitvā pradhvaṃsate 'netadevam' iti, sa mithyā pratyayaḥ |
na ca kālāntare puruṣāntare avasthā'ntare vā viparyaiti, tasmādityataḥ (pratyayaḥ) |
yattu laukikaṃ vacanam, taccet pratyayitāt puruṣāt indriyaviṣayaṃ vā, avitathameva tat |
atha aprayitāt anindriyaviṣayaṃ vā, tāvat puruṣabuddhi- prabhāvamapramāṇam |
aśakyaṃ hi tat puruṣeṇa jñātum, ṛte
kimpi upalabdhamasti iti śakyate kalpayitum, na svātantryaṃ vacanasya |
mūladvaye saṃbhavatyasmin pariṇitapramāṇa- vyatiriktaṃ na pramāṇāntaramasti iti śakyate vaktum |
ataḥ pramāṇāntaraviparyayāsaṃbhavāt na svataścārthasparśitā śakyate vaktuṃ codanāyāḥ |
kiñca puruṣavacanāddiṣṭārtho'yamenārthaḥ iti niścayo bhavati, na punaḥ pramāṇāntarabuddhirupajāyate |
taduktam “api ca pauruṣeyādacanāt ‘evamayaṃ puruṣo veda’ iti bhavati pratyayaḥ, na ‘evamayamarthaḥ’ ” iti |

kiṃ vā arthāntaravagatau pramāṇāntaravatirbhavati ? bādam, arthānusāri hi tadā pramāṇamavakalpate (kiṃ arthāva- gatyanumānāt pramāṇāntaraṃ śābdaṃ ityavagatirbhavati ? bādaṃ bhavati, kāraṇabhūtameva upasthāpayat śābdaṃ anu- mānāt
karmaṇi yāgādau karmabhūto niyogaḥ pratīyate, na punaḥ karmaṇyeva prerayati |
kasmāt ? yadyadupādīyate tattadityevaṃ iti tantravyavahāraḥ ( na punaḥ yadyat kartavyatayā jñāpyate tattat vidheyaṃ iti mīmāṃsāsiddhānte vyavahāraḥ ) |
yattu upādānahetutāṃ prati- padyate tadadhikṛtaṃ kāraṇam ( abhisāratvāt adhikāri- viśeṣaṇatayā adhikāre kāraṇam |

yataḥ evaṃ adhikāranimittabhūtaṃ vaiṣupadānaṃ nāsti ata eva ' na hiṃsyāt ' iti pratiṣedho'vatarati ) tasmāt adhikāranimittaṃ ( abhyabhicāraṃ ) aṅgīkṛtya etaduktam ' hiṃsā hi sā, sā ca pratiṣiddhā ' iti |

upādānagato hi pratiṣedhaḥ kṛtyaḥ syāt ( pratiṣedhyāyāḥ pravṛtteḥ kṛtapravṛttyadhīnatvena kṛtardhvatvāt ) nādhikāragataḥ ( svatantratvāt tatra pravṛtteḥ ) ' na hiṃsyāt bhūtāni ' iti ca adhikārato'yaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ puruṣārthaḥ |
tasmā- dabhicārasya anarthatāṃ pratipādayituṃ kṣamaḥ, nāśrīyomīyādeḥ kṛtyarthatvāt |
atha kasmādubhayataḥ pratiṣedho'yam ' na hiṃsyādbhūtāni ' iti ? ( uttaram ) na hi ekasya vidheḥ prayoktṛtvāprayoktṛtve bhavataḥ |
atha kṛtvaiva evāyam ( pratiṣedhaḥ prayuktilaghavāt ) kasmānna bhavati ? ( uttara- māha - ) prayoktṛtvaprayoktṛtvayoḥ prayoktṛtvaṃ śrautam ana- pekṣāvagamāt |
na ca ' na hiṃsyādbhūtāni ' iti vākyāntarā- vagatirbhavati anārabhyavidhānāt ( prathamaṃ hi liṅādayaḥ kārye bodhayanti, tacchāndaliṅākam |
saṃnihite adhikāravidhau vākyāntaratā liṅādyaśrānuvāda eva ) tasmāt adhikārāvagata evāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ ( nopādānagataḥ ) |
bhavati ca codanālakṣaṇaḥ ( śyenaviniyogaḥ ) tadviṣayatvāt śyenavidheḥ |
tasmāt ' ubhayamiha codanayā lakṣyate ' ityevamādi upapadyate bhāṣyam |
' nanu aśaktamidaṃ sūtram ' iti laukikavaidika- vākyayorvivekapradarśanārtham |
athavā arthasataḥ iti yathāvākyamapi ekārthatvaṃ saṃbhavati iti pradarśayitum ( vidhāvupattilakṣaṇo vākyabhedo nāsti |
, laukikā- kārahīnasya tasya kiṃ nāma lakṣaṇam |
ata eva pramāṇaṃ ca codanātra no kutaḥ ||
athaiva gurumatamāha - ' yadā jijñāsyevārthaḥ ki mantrāthavabodhitaḥ |
durlabhā sulabhā kārye vedārtho'taḥ sa eva hi ||
bhāṭṭa-- vicārayitavyasya dharmasya alaukikatvena pratyakṣaviṣayatvāyogān tanmūlakakṣamānādasya sutarā- mapravṛtteḥ |
iti prāpte, laukikapramāṇanāmapravṛttāvapi alaukikānāmekatritaśatāsahakṛtavidheraikatvasya vā pramāṇa- tvasaṃbhavāt aprāmāṇyasya parataḥtve'pi prāmāṇyasya svata- stvāt sapramāṇaka eva dharmaḥ |
ata eva vedaikajñāniṣṭa- sādhanatākatve dharmadharmatve tathātve sati balavadaniṣṭānu- bandhitvaṃ vā dharmalakṣaṇam |
balavadaniṣṭānubandhitve sati vastuto niṣidhyamānatvadharmatvam, vidhīyamānatvamātraṃ dharma- tvam |
tacca kṛtiyyāpyakaraṇetikartavyatāprabhṛtiṣu upādeya- tātparyaparyāyaḥ : preraṇā rūpaviśiṣṭaviṣayatāviśeṣaḥ |
' pañcame brahmavarcasakāmasya ' ityatra phalāya vidhīyamānasya kālasya dharmatvāme'pi na kṣatiḥ, tadāśrayasyopanayanasyaiva dharmatvāt |
abhisārārthamupādeyasya śyenādestu dharmatvamimeva, tāmasadharmatvena purāṇādiṣu tadvarṇanāt |
ṣoḍaśigrahaṇasyātirātre tu na niṣedhaḥ, tatrataliṅo doṣā- bhāvakratuvyutpānāpādākatvalakṣaṇatvena pravartanānivartanayoḥ
ata eva pūrvasūtre dharmapadena yāvatpīḍālakṣaṇagatavicāraviṣayo lakṣyate |
śaṃkara-- ' dharmaṃ mānaṃ ca codanā ' 2, ' dharmo'rtha- środanāgamyaḥ |
vāla. pṛ. 143. dharmavicāraśāstram ' codanālakṣaṇo'rtho dharmaḥ ' ityārabhya ' annāhāryaṃ ca darśanāt ' ityetadantaṃ jaimini- proktaṃ sūtrajātam |
vi. 1111, dharmavicāraśāstraṃ sākṣāt adhyayanavidhiyuktaṃ iti bhāṭṭāḥ |
adhyāpana- vidhiprayuktamadhyayanam, tadyuktaṃ dharmavicāraśāstraṃ iti prābhākarāḥ |
idānīṃ tasya nimittaṃ parīkṣyāmaha iti codaneti, anyadapīti |
tasmāt na tāvanniīśrayate codanālakṣaṇo'rtho dharma iti |
vṛttikāro'dhikaṃ vā''pi vā''pi bhūtādi dvāra- mabravīt ||
bṛhatī-- tasya nimittaparīkṣīḥ iti hetvabhidhānā- vasaraḥ kathyate |
kathaṃ punaḥ kārye'tha codaneva nimittam ? anyasya pratyakṣāderasaṃbandhāt |
ṛju-- codanālakṣaṇasūtreṇa śrutyābhyāṃ vedārtha- svarūpam, tatra ca pramāṇaṃ pratijñātam |

tatra kiṃ svarūpaṃ tāvat medābhedatvena kathyatām, uta pramāṇapratijñāyāṃ hetuḥ iti saṃśaye pradhānatvāt svarūpasya, tadeva medābhedāmyāṃ kathanīyaṃ iti prāpte, medābhedanirṇayasya anapekṣatasamba- pekṣatvāt prāmāṇye hetvapekṣāmadhunā kathanīyaṃ iti sūtreṇa kathyate |
tathā ca bhāṣyam ' idānīṃ tasya nimittaṃ parīkṣyāmaha ' iti |
tasmāt anapekṣatvarūpaprāmāṇya- hetvabhidhānāvasarakathanaṃ sūtreṇa kriyate iti |
śā-- anena sūtreṇa codanālakhyasya nimittasya parī- kṣaṇaṃ asmin pāde vakṣyamāṇam ' athataḥ śeṣalakṣaṇam ' ' atha viśeṣalakṣaṇam ' itivat sūtragrahaṇārthamanukīrtyate |
candrikā-- ayamatra sūtrārthaḥ : tasya dharmasya jñāne yannimittaṃ pramāṇaṃ codanā'bhidhānam, tasya parīkṣīḥ parīkṣā kartavyatā iti |
' iṣu gatau ' ityasmādātoḥ ' iperinicchārthasya ' iti yuci vihite ' parevā ' iti kitanucorvikalpasmaraṇāt yujividhau paryaṣaṇā iti rūpaṃ kitanuvidhau tu parīkṣīḥ iti rūpaṃ sidhyati |
atra dharma- pramāṇaṃ parīkṣyaṃ na veti saṃdehe, pramāṇopadeśenaiva prameya- siddheḥ kiṃ parīkṣayā iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
nātra siddhavat lakṣaṇakathanamātraṃ kintu vicāraśāstratvādya sarvathā pramāṇaparīkṣā kartavyā iti siddhāntaḥ |
vi-- ' dharmasya jñāpakaṃ mānaṃ yaduktaṃ codanātmakam |
etat kiṃ na parīkṣyaṃ kiṃvā samyak parīkṣyatām ||
SSdinā bhāṇyāntaraṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ yathā 'vrīhīnavahantyāt' 'odanaṃ pacati' ityādi, tatra dhātvarthasya karaṇatvameva |
yatra tu tādṛśasthale aprāptakaraṇāntarasattvam, dhātvarthasya ca prakaraṇaprāptā dhātvarthānuvādamātram |
na tu tadarthasya karaṇatvena anvayaḥ, na vā āśrayatvena, karmatvātirikta āśrayatvasya nirvaktumaśakyatvena bhāvanāyāṃ indrirūpakarmatvarūḍhāyāṃ homasyāpi karmatvena anvaye ekakarmakatvamaṅgāpatteḥ |
ata eva anekoddeśya-nimittakatvamede'pi ekakarmakatvañca dūṣakatābījamuktaṃ kaustubhādau |
ekakarmakatvaṃ ca na ekakarmakatvaṃ ekakarmakāśraya-karmakatvaṃ vā 'sarvebhyo darśapūrṇamāsau', 'ghaṭānaya' ānaya' ityādi tadanāpatteḥ |
nāpi ekakarmakatvāccheda-kakatvaṃ 'sarvebhyo darśapūrṇamāsau' ityādi 'vrīhīn prokṣati' ityādi ca tadanāpatteḥ |
tatra putravatputrādīnāṃ tadapūrva-sādhanatvānāṃ ca karmatā'vacchedakānāṃ bhedāt |
nirūpakatveṣu ca sarvatra karmatvaparyāptipi-karaṇatā'vacchedakadharmāṇāṃ ekena padena ekasya samūhā-lambanātmakasya bodhasya jananāt ekakarmakatvopapattiḥ |
'adhvaryuyajamānau vācaṃ yacchataḥ' ityatra ca adhvaryuya-jamānatvayoḥ karmatvādhikaraṇatā'vacchedakayoḥ ekabodha-viṣayatvābhāvāt dvikarmakatvāpattiḥ, ataḥ paryāptīti |

tatra dvaṃdvatvavibhaktyā devatātvāderiva karmatvāderapi nyāyasya-vṛttitvābhāyāt tatparyāptipyadhikaraṇatā'vacchedakadharmasya adhvaryuyajamānobhayatvasya dvaṃdvayaikabodhaviṣayatvena eka-karmakatvopapatteḥ |
evaṃ 'śuklaṃ ghaṭamānaya' ityādau śuklasya ghaṭe abhedānvayāt padadvayena ghaṭapadenaiva vā śuklaguṇaviśiṣṭaghaṭalakṣaṇāt eka-karmakatvopapattiḥ |
evaṃ 'ghaṭaṃ paṭaṃ cānaya' ityādau itare-tarayogārthakakārūpatānusāreṇa dvitīyā'nta-padadvaye lakṣaṇayā tadupapattiḥ |
dravyasthale uddeśyānekanimittakavākyamedesya dūṣakatābījaṃ ekakarmakatvabhaṅgāpattiḥ, tathā kaustubhe vyaktam |
tat siddhaṃ yatra dvitīyā''dinā bhāṇyāntaraṃ bhāvanāyāṃ anvaya-yogyamupāttam, tatra na dhātvarthasya karmatvam |
yatra tu tannimittam, dhātvarthasya ca ihasādhanatvaṃ pramāṇāntareṇa pratimitam, tatra svāśrayavidheyaguṇāntarasattve dhātvarthasya karmatvameva yathā 'dadhnā juhoti' ityādi |
na caivam 'juhvā juhoti' ityādi juhoteḥ sakarmakatvāt karmāntarāśrayasya-bhāvena bhāvanāyāḥ dvikarmakatvāpattiḥ, sakarmakasyāpi bhāvākhyāte iva karmāvacchedyopapatteḥ |
etādṛśe'pi viṣaye yadi tṛtīyā''ntanāmadheyaśravaṇaṃ tadā karaṇatvameva, yathā 'same darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta' 'uccaiḥ pravarṇayena' ityādi |
yatra tu tādṛśaguṇaśravaṇābhāvaḥ, tatra dhātvarthasyaiva karmatvena prayojanāntareṇa anuvādaḥ yathā vidvadākyayoḥ |
tadabhāve (prayojanāntarābhāve) tu 'tanunpātaṃ yajati' ityādi karmāntarameva ityādi prakāre vyaktam |

yatra tu neṣṭāsādhanatvaṃ pramitam, na vā svāśraye ca uddiṣṭādivat tṛtīyā''ntanāmadheyaśravaṇaṃ yathā 'somena yajeta' 'agni-hotraṃ juhoti' ityādi, tatra khavākye iṣṭaviśeṣaṇatvagame-'pi vidhitvena bhāvanāyāḥ iṣṭabhāvyatvamātrāt iṣṭa-sāmānyasyaiva tatra bhāvyatvamaṅgīkṛtya dhātvarthasya karaṇatva-meva |
'agnihotram' ityatra dvitīyā''pi tatra karaṇatva-lakṣaṇāthaiva iti sāṃpradāyikāḥ |
etādṛśe viṣaye samāna-padaśrutyā bhāvanāpekṣitaṃ karma dhātvartha eva sutarāṃ agnihotraṃ iti dvitīyā''ntaśravaṇe |
na ca iṣṭāsādhanatvena ajñātasya karmatvānupapattiḥ, anīpsitakarmatvena anvayopapatteḥ |
na ca vidheḥ pravartakatvavyāghātaḥ, vidhivagato'bhādhyatvajñānasya pravṛtti prati kāraṇatve'pi śābdabodhe iti akāraṇatvāt tadabhāve'pi homakarmakabhāvanā'vacchedānopapatteḥ |

na ca bhāvyatvena anvitasya tasya bhāṇyāntarānākāṅkṣatvāt phalavākye'pi svargasādhanatvenābhānāpattiḥ, sādhanatvena anvitasya arthāt vidhiyugatena kṛtisādhyatvajñānavat kṛtisādhyatvena buddhasyāpi vidheyapekṣā'nusāreṇa iṣṭaviśeṣa-sādhanatayā vākyāntareṇa viśvajinnyāyena vā bodhopapatteḥ |
sarvathā siddhaṃ dhātvarthasya karmatvaracanāyāntarasaṃsargeṇa bhāvanāyāṃ prakāratā iti |
tathātve 'prakṛtipratyayau pratyayārthe saha brūtaḥ' iti sāhityarūpānvayānuśāsana-vaiyarthyāpatteḥ |
ata eva jyoti-ṣṭomena iti tṛtīyā''pi padārthavidhayā bhāsamānakaraṇa-tvānuvādikā iti saṃgacchate |
tat siddhaṃ dhātvarthasya sarvatra bhāvanāyāṃ prakāratā |
sā paraṃ ākhyātopāttā kṛdāyupāttā ca liṅgānvayinī iti vakṣyate |
ākhyātārtheṣu yagādivikaraṇasthale karma śabdādivikaraṇasthale ca kartā |
akarmakadhātū- caraṇādivikaraṇasthale na bhāvarūpo dhātvartha eva, 'laḥ karmaṇi' (pā0 3|4|69) ityādyanuśāsanāt |
sarveṣāṃ ca dhātvarthe prati yogyasaṃbandhena guṇatvam |
'bhāvapradhāna- mākhyātām' iti smṛtyā (niruktam) bhāvapadavācya- dhātvarthasya ākhyātārthe prati prādhānyokteḥ |
phūtkāravāde; 'pacati' ityataḥ apratīteḥ; amāsa- mānasya śaktatā''vacchedakatvāt |
phūtkāravādika vinā- 'pi caitraniṣṭhakriyāntaratvāt svataḥ siddhajvalanā jāyamāne odane 'caitraḥ pacati' iti prayogācca |
tattvadvyāpārasya tattvenatattvena anubhave 'yāgaḥ icchā jñānaṃ vā' iti vādiviparītapatyanupatteśca |
ataḥ abhyupamamānaṃ pākatva- yāgādikameva tatphalapadhāyakatvāt vyāpārapacya- khaṇḍopādhirūpasāmānyā pacyādipadaśaktatā''vacchedakam |
phalopadhāyakavyāpāratvādeḥ pramāṇāntarato bodhaḥ, na tu śābdabodhaḥ |
ata eva phalasyāpi na dvitīyayā bodhaḥ |
pākatvādiphalaṃ ca viklittijanakavyāpāratveva, na tu tādṛśanādividhayapi |
'pākaṃ karoti' ityādinā yanādeḥ pākāt pṛthak vidriyamāṇatvāt |
na ca ghaṭādisamabhivyāhṛtadhātoḥ phale eva śaktikalpanāt pṛthak vivaraṇepattiḥ, anekaśakti- kalpane vyāpāraviṣayakaśaktipratītidhavakalpane vā gauravāt |
'grāmo gamanavān' iti pratītyāpattibhayena vyāpāra- pratīterapi āvaśyakatvāt |
ata eva viklittijanaka- vyāpārasamūha eva pākapadārthaḥ, na tu tajjanakatvanādirāpi, tasya pṛthak vidriyamāṇatvena parthyatvābhāvāt |
ata eva 'tejaḥsaṃyogāmātraṃ pacyathaḥ, na tu viklityanukūlavyāpāra- sāmānyam' ityapi pratyuktam |
ata eva pākāt pṛthak vidriyamāṇatvādeḥ bhāsamānasya bhānakāraṇajijñāsāyāṃ pariśeṣyāt ākhyātā- rthatvameva |
evaṃ ca pratyayārthādhānyasmṛtirapi na saṃkocitā bhavati |
rahasya. pṛ. 47-49. dhātvarthavidhānaṃ liḍā tāvat svapadenopāttatvāt śrautam |
vā. 2|3|14 pṛ. 593. dhātvarthaviśeṣapādinā bhāvanā itikartavyatāṃ na śaknoti grahītum |
' sarvatra hi adhiśrayaṇādau 'karoti' ityapi sāmānyavyāpārāṃśaḥ pratīyate |
pratyayena hi śrutyā dhātvarthaḥ sattā ucyate, viprakṛṣṭā upasargārthasya sattā arthaviprakarṣāt durbalā bhavati |
bhā. 10|4|6|1. dhātvarthasāmānyaṃ bhāvanā ityedāpancam, satyaṃ sādhyatā sāmānyam, na tu gotvādi rūpeṇa |
vā. 2|3|1|1 pṛ. 382. dhātvādīnāṃ pratyayabhinnānāṃ svarūpamātrābhidhāyitvaṃ ityabhihitānvayavādaḥ |
su. pṛ. 776. 'dhātullakṣitakaraṇatvādeḥ bhāvanāyāṃ prakāratā' iti matam |
karaṇatvādisaṃgatena dhātvarthasyaiva bhāvanāyāṃ prakāratā iti matāntaram |
'gaḍi vadanedeśe', 'śaki śaktau', 'viśi avayave' ityādī akriyāyāmapi dhātustṛteḥ gandādiśabdāca kriyā'nava-
su. pṛ. 396. dhātusāmyārtha (samarāyeṣu daśarāyeṣu ca) laukikaṃ somapānam |
bhā. 9|4|12|5-50. dhānānāṃ savanīyapuroḍāśeṣu vidyamānāmeva āśvina- pātre nidhānaṃ jyotiṣṭome, na tu nidhānārthapūrvadhānā- saṃpādanam |
dhānāsu athavāttasya na bādhaḥ iti bhāṣyamatena, manye peṣaṇasya na bādhaḥ iti vārtikamatena |
ke. 10|2|3|4|75. dhānāsu pūrvaṃ hanti kṛtvā pākaḥ kāryaḥ mahāpitṛyajñe |
tatra hi hantiḥ pākārtha bhaviṣyati, na dhānātvaṃ vihaniyate |
bhā. 10|2|3|374. dhānā''diṣu savanīyeṣu puroḍāśaśabdo bhāktaḥ saṃnihiteṣu pṛthakḥ jyotiṣṭome |
darśapūrṇamāsayorāmannanti 'dhānya- masi dhinuhi devān iti hapadi taṇḍulānāpatti' iti |
tatra dhānyaśabdaṃ prati saṃśayaḥ kiṃ samavetavacano na veti |
kiṃ prāptam ? yo'yaṃ guṇaśabda iva lakṣyate dhānyaśabdaḥ; nāsī samavetavacanaḥ syāt |
dhānyaśabdo hi dhānyamabhi- vadati, na tu dhānyamevopyate |
sa hi taṇḍuleṣu vartate tadvikāratvāt lakṣaṇayā |
yathā 'kāśikepu śālyo bhujyante' 'gāvaḥ pīyante' iti śrutyupādāne ahadaṃ kalpayitavyam, iti lakṣaṇaśabda parikalpyate |
prayojanaṃ asti śaktatāsāmanyena ṣaṭtriṃśatsaṃvatsara tatredaṃ samāmnāyate 'saṃsthitesaṃsthite'hani yahapatimṛgāya yāti, sa tatra yān mṛgān hanti teṣāṃ tarasāḥ savanīyā puroḍāśā bhavanti' iti |
tatra avikāreṇa 'dhānyamasi dhinuhi devān' iti prayogaḥ kartavyaḥ yathā pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
yathā siddhāntaḥ, ūhaḥ kartavyaḥ; 'māṃsamasi dhinuhi devān' iti |
prakṛtiśabde- (dhānyaśabdena) vikāraḥ (taṇḍulāḥ) prakāśitāḥ prakṛtau lakṣaṇayā, ihāpi (śākyānāmayane) codakaḥ tathaiva (lakṣaṇayā prakṛtiśabdena māṃsaṃ) prāpayati |
na śabdo vācakaḥ iti atraiva (tṛtīye pāde) vakṣyāmaḥ |
sa ca asyādacyate prayoge kimiti avācakena prakāśyate |
prakṛtau (dhānyapadasya āmansābhyena avācakena kenāpi śabdena vikāraprakāśana kṛtam |
tacca (dhānyapadaṃ iha) arthāt nivṛttam, na codakaḥ prāpayati |
na ca vacanamasti prakṛtyā vikāraḥ pratyāyya iti |
tasmāt māṃsaśabdasyaiva prayogaḥ (paramārthatastu māṃsasya adhivāpo nāstyeva) |
soma— idaṃ ca māṃsasyādhivāpo'sti iti kṛtvā cintyā uktam |
vastutastu peṣaṇārthatvādidhāpasya māṃsaṃ ca peṣaṇātvāt tadaryādhivāpaḥ tanmantraśca nivartate iti draṣṭavyam |
'gāvaḥ pīyante' ityatra mukhyavṛttyābhāve'pi nāma- vetārthatvaṃ lokā varṇayanti, kintu (gośabdena) dugdhaṃ lakṣayitvā artha samavetameva pratipayanti, tadat |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'dhānyamasi dhinuhi devān' iti mantraḥ śrutaḥ |
haṣadi taṇḍulānadhipati ' iti vacanena taṇḍulādhipāpe viniyuktaḥ |
tatra dhānyaśabdaḥ satupadravyavacanaḥ taṇḍulā- vasyāyāṃ prayujyamānaḥ dhānyatvāropeṇa stutyarthaḥ savitrādipada- vadeva asamavetārthaḥ iti māse'pi tadāropeṇa prayoktavyaḥ |

iti prāpte, ' śālayo bhujyante ' iti kārye prakṛtivācaka- padaprayogatāt prayuktalakṣaṇopapatteḥ asipadākṣitataṇḍularūpa- kartṛtvāmānādhikaraṇyatvācca lakṣaṇayā dhānyaśabdaḥ taṇḍulaparaḥ san samavetārtha eva |
nanu evaṃ samavetārthatve'pi māse'pi lakṣaṇayaiva dhānyaśabdaprayogopapatteḥ nopasaktiḥ |
dhānyapadasya prakṛtau taṇḍulasārakatvāt, vikṛtau māṃsa- sārakasya prokṣaṇādivat kathañcit ūhakṣaṇatvāttattve'pi vā dhānyapadatvena māṃsapadasyevopalakṣaṇatvāt |

yathaiva hi prakṛtau agnipadena śaktyā apūrvavādhanībhūtāṃ devatāṃ prakāśayet iti liṅgakatvaśrutyā mantravini- yogāt, vikṛtau agnidevatayā śaktyā agnipadenaiva uktadevatāprakāśanāpatteḥ na padāntaramakṣepaḥ |
tatra śaktyā agnipadena taprakāśa- nānupapatteḥ prakṛtau vṛttivivakṣāsattvāt |
vikṛtau ca śrutyevāpāretvena tanmukhatvena agnipadārthatāprateḥ na lakṣaṇayā vinā agnipadena tatprakāśanam |

tathaiva dhānyapadena lakṣaṇayā pradeyaprakṛtibhūtaṃ prakāśayet iti gauṇasāmarthyakalpita- śrutyā mantraviniyogāt vikṛtāvāpi māṃse upakārapṛṣṭha- bhāvena vṛtteḥ tattubhabhāvena ca dhānyapadasya atideśāt tadavādhyāya dhānyapadenaiva māṃsaprakāśanopapatteḥ na padāntara- prakṣepaḥ |
satyaṃ prākṛtaprakāśanarūpopakāra- pṛṣṭhabhāvena prākṛtavṛttitarūpārātideśaḥ tatpṛṣṭhabhāvena ca agnyādipadorūpapadārthatādiśaḥ |
ityatrā dhyṛtitadeśe prakāśānapṛṣṭhābhāvena atidiśya padasya vikṛtau lakṣaṇayā'pi prakāśakāvopapatteḥ padāntaramakṣepānapattiprasaṅgāt |
tathāpi prākṛtapadaniṣṭhāprakṛtitve vikṛtau atidiśyate, na tu vṛttimātram, pramāṇābhāvāt |
ata eva saurye prākṛta- padasyaiva prākṛtavṛtterapi vādhasattve'pi sūryapadapakṣe |

ataśca dhānyaprakṛtivarūpaśakyasaṃbandharūpatvāḥ prākṛtalakṣaṇatvātteḥ māse bādhe saṃdhandhātarūpalakṣaṇatvātkalpane pramāṇābhāvāt dhānyapadasya vādhāvadyambhāve māṃsaprakāśanarūpakāryānurodhena mantrapadāntarānurodhādeva māṃsapadakṣepaḥ |
ataḥ śakyānāmanyane ' tarasamayāḥ savanīyāḥ puroḍāśā bhavanti ' ityatra māse adhivāpe kriyamāṇe ' māṃsamasi ' ityūha- tavyam |
tṛtīye ( 3|8|23 mādra. ) savanīyodeśena haviṣṭhatvenaiva tarasavidhānasya sthāpitatvāt |
satyāpi vā padeyaprakṛtitve arthalopena tatra adhivāpasya carāviba vādhitatvāt |
vistareṇa caitat nyāyasudhā- kāramatanirāsapūrvakaṃ upapāditaṃ dvitīye ' dharmamāne tu karma syāt ' ( 2|1|9 sū. ) ityatra kaustubhe |
dhānyādhikaraṇaprayojanabhāṣye tu savanīyaśabda- vadākyodāharaṇamāhasta iti parihārasūcanārtham ' yathā ' ityāyuktam |
yathaitat svarūpam ' śāstrāndhīya medhāvī dhānyasya ca punaḥ punaḥ |
yathā kaściddhānyārthī śālikalāpaṃ satupaṃ sapalalamāharati nāntaroyakātvāt, sa yāvadādeyaṃ tāvadādāya tuṣapalālā- nyutsṛjati |
sa hi taṇḍuleṣu vartate tadvikāratvāt lakṣaṇayā |
yathā ' kāśikepu śālayo bhujyante ' ' gāvaḥ pīyante ' iti |
38-39, dhānyaśabdasya darśapūrṇamāsasyeṣaṇamantra- gatasya vikṛtau śākyānāmane ' māṃsamasi ' iti ūhaḥ |
' dhā ' pratyayaḥ prakāravācī san ekavāraṃ ityartham, bahūnāṃ sahabhāvaṃ vā brūte |
kṛṣṇaleṣu ' ekadhā brahmaṇa upaharati ' ityatra tu sahabhāvameva brūte |
ihe krame atīte saumā- raudrīṇāṃ anāgate mantroktaḥ sāmidhenīṣu dhānyā ityucyante |
taṃ sannāhaḥ ' iti dve dhānye sāmidhenīṣu kalpyete |
bhā. 3|2|120 pṛ. 773, kāḥ punaretā dhānyāḥ nāma ? nāma śabdasya prasiddhopalabhāmahe |
kutaḥ ? evaṃ hi bhagavataḥ pāṇinivacanam ' pāyasaānāya nikāyadhyāyānāmivi- vāsasāmidhenīpu ' iti |
dhānyānāṃ samidheyamānatve'simaddhavatyanta- rālaniveśaḥ ' iyaṃ vai samidhyamānavatī, asau samiddhavatī, yadantarā tadvāyā ' ityarthavādaprāmāṇyādhīnaḥ |
tatra ' samidhyamāno adhvare ' iti samidhyamānavatī, ' samiddho agne ' iti samiddhavatī |
dhānyaśabdaḥ sāmidhenīṣu nipātyamānaḥ tāsve- vetyavadhāraṇāt nānyaasu dhīyamānāsvapi dhānyaśabda- vācyatvaṃ bhavati |
dhānyaśabditvā eva ṛcaḥ madhye syuḥ, anyāstu āgantavyaḥ ante syuḥ, bādarāyaṇamatāt |

dhānyaśabdasya dhīyamānavācitva- nipātanāt ' yatrayatra te devā yajñasya chidraṃ nirajānaṃstad dhānyābhirapidadhuḥ tadvāyānāṃ dhāttvāvam ' ityarthavādāt chidrāpidhānanimittadhānyaśabdatvāvagateḥ pṛthupājavyā- dīnāṃ sāmidhenīnāmeva āvapanānnimittadhānyātvāva- dhāraṇavirodhaḥ |
dhyāyāsāmāravyatvaṃ manorṛcām ' ' agnirudre purohitaḥ ' ityādyānām ( ṛsaṃ. 8|27|1 ) ' pṛthu pājā ' iti dvayośca ( pṛthupājāḥ, taṃ savādho ) sāmi- dhenīṣu prakṣepyānām |
dharaṇaṃ prajāśeṣasya tanpātraṃ ca na kartavye vājapeyaprājāpatyapaśuṣu abhidhāraṇārtham |

atha dhāryo'smi ? yadā anugacchati, tadā jyotiṣmatīṣṭiḥ anu- gamanaprāyaścittaṃ kartavyaṃ na vā iti vicāre yathā paryukṣaṇaṃ parisamūhane tṛṇavattvayaḥ ityevamādayaḥ padārthā dhārye'yai ahanyahani kriyante, tathā anugamane prāyaścittamapi kriyate iti prāpte, ucyate |
dhāraṇe agneḥ kṛte sati prāyaścittaṃ na kartavyam |
nahi tada agnihotrārthamuddharaṇaṃ yasmin kāle bhavatyasau gataśrīḥ tatra anyārthamṛṣṭata'gniḥ sarvārthe dhāryate |
na ca dhāraṇe agnihotrārthe anugamane prāyaścittaṃ vihitam |
' trayo vai gataśriyaḥ śuśruvān brāhmaṇaṃ rājanyaḥ ' iti gataśrīpadārthaḥ : uktaḥ |

' āhatimāhavanīyamasuti arthāthārthāya agni praṇa yati, nityo gataśriyo dhārya āhavanīyaḥ ' ityāmnātam atra pūrvapakṣiṇā yaduktam ' paryukṣaṇaparisamūhanādivat homāt prāgevārthasya anugamane prāyaścittaṃ kartavyamiti tatrāha siddhāntī |
itareṣu prāyaścittāditeṣu paryukṣaṇādiḥ kriyārthatvāt saṃskārārthatvāt karma anuṣṭhānaṃ syāt |
tasmāt dhārye 'yau anugate jyotiṣmatīṣṭiḥ kartavyā iti siddhāntaḥ |
dhāraṇārthamanyanvādhānaṃ darśapūrṇamāsake saumike aiṣṭikeṣu na kartavyam |
some dīkṣaṇīyā''diṣu aiṣṭikeṣu karmasu codakaprāptaṃ agnyādhānaṃ na ciyate, na kartavyam |
tasmāt dīkṣaṇīyā''diṣu agnyādhānaṃ nāsti iti siddhāntaḥ |
dhārayeddhanaṃ daṇḍaṃ śubhe raukme ca kuṇḍale |
(ekadhanānāmapāṃ sādanaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ dadhi-aṃśu-adābhya-upāṃśu-antaryāmāḥ nāma grahā gṛhyante |
dhārāvāhikeṣu ye kālātirekeṇa prāmāṇyamāhuḥ te nirākṛtāḥ |
ye'pi tatra tadādyadarśanameva prāmāṇamiti bauddhā āhuḥ, te'pi sarveṣāṃ tulyatvena nirākṛtāḥ |
dhārāvāhikajñānasya gṛhītaviṣayakasya kathaṃ prāmāṇyam, kālasya ṣaḍindriyavedyatvena pūrvakṣaṇaviśiṣṭaghaṭasya viṣayīkaraṇe tādṛśasya uttarajñānāviṣayatvayā anadhigatārthaviṣayakatvāt |
yo yāgamanutiṣṭhati taṃ dhārmika iti samācakṣate |
saṃkalpa. 3|2|15. dhāryai'mau parisamūhya paryukṣaṇaṃ tṛṇāpacayaḥ ityevamādayaḥ padārthaḥ |
coditāni hi tāni saṃskārārthatvena, śakyāni ca, akṛtaprayojanāni ca |
dhāvanaṃ dantānāṃ jyotiṣṭome saṃskāraḥ na phalaprayuktaḥ |
dhiṣṇyānāṃ agnīnāṃ viharaṇaṃ āgnīdhrādeva, na auttaravedikāt |
saṃkalpa. 3|2|15, dhiṣṇyānāṃ ṣaṇṇāmagnīnāṃ savanatraye agnidhomāmbhākāle ceti caturvāraṃ viharaṇāt caturviṃśatirdhiṣṇyāmyaḥ |
dhurisāmāni nāma 'gītivikāro gāyatrasya dhuraḥ' iti vacanāt gāyatravikārātmakāni dhūrgānaśabdenocyante |
dhūrgānaṃ ekatrike nāma yāge 'āghṛṣṭaṃ dhūrṣu stuvate' ityādyuccā vihitam |
sa tādṛk bahurūpyo vā bahi gamayati dhruvam |
dhumādiyuktayo hi sāmānyena upādhinā agnisaṃbandhavyāptā agnivṛttimeva gamayati |
yathā coktam ' nirvikalpaṃ paraṃ brahma nirdhūlikalpanam |
dhṛtarāṣṭrasya aghasya ijyā pāṇḍuvarjitedhaneḥ iti anadhikṛtakriyā (dharmavyatikramaḥ) |
andhasya niraṃśatvena dhanābhāvāt yāgāsaṃbhavamāśaṅkya 'tasya vīrasya vikrāntaiḥ sahasraśatadakṣiṇe |
'suhṛdvāpi dharmātmā dhanena samatarpayat' iti ca pāṇḍunā dhṛtarāṣṭradibhyaḥ svārjita-dhanasamarpaṇāt nāpahāraḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ |
pāṇḍuvarjitadhanopajīvanaṃ jyeṣṭhasya dhṛtarāṣṭrasya anucitaṃ iti vyatikramāntaraṃ cānenoktam |
vārtikam-- dhṛtarāṣṭro'pi vyāsānumatyāt āścarya-parvaṇi putradarśanavat ṛtukāle'pi dṛṣṭavāneva |
tat yathaiva tadvacanāt asau ambho jāto vijñāyate, tathā yajñānuṣṭhānavacanāt tāvati kāle dṛṣṭavān ityarthā sujñānam |
yadya 'yaja-devapūjāsaṃgatikaraṇadāneṣu' iti dānārtha evāyaṃ yaji-rbhaviṣyati, ṛtuphalasamani ca dānatapaḥśaraṇādīnyapi śrūyante, tatkāraṇāt ṛtukriyopacāraḥ |
dhṛtimanyeṣu 'iha dhṛtiḥ svāhā, iha dhṛtiḥ svāhā' ityādiṣu dhṛtyādiśabdānāṃ caturthyantapāṭho na kartavyaḥ kintu yathāsāmnāyaṃ prayogaḥ |
ekā kṛtsnasya ṛtudakṣiṇasya kāryaṃ bhavati dhūrnāmake yāge |
sa ca yāgaḥ 'athaiṣa bhūyaiśvadevaḥ, trivideva sarvaḥ, tasya viśvavataḥ stotrīyāḥ; dhenurdakṣiṇā dhenurdakṣiṇā' iti vihitaḥ |

'gośvāśvaśvāśvatara gardabhajāśvāśvayatha trīyaśva yathāśva tvāśva māpāśva tasya (agniṣṭome) dvādaśaśataṃ dakṣiṇā' iti vākye caśabdena itaretarasahitasya gavādiśabdasya dakṣiṇaśabdavyānyavagamāt samudāitānāṃ gavādīnāṃ ekadakṣiṇatvāvateḥ 'dhenurdakṣiṇā' iti vikṛtau (bhūnāmake ekāhe) vihitāyā dhenoḥ samastadakṣiṇā-vikāratvaṃ daśame (10|3|14|56-58) vakṣyate |
dhenvādyaḥ śabdāḥ ubhayoḥ (gauḥ dhyantī ceti) asādhāraṇavacanā eva |
śoṇādaya iva anapekṣya ca padā-ntaraṃ ete padāvasyāyāmeva asādhāraṇamarthaṃ pratipādayanti |

yadyapi dhenuśabdo gopena dṛṣṭapravṛttiḥ, tathāpi abhidhānasāmānyāt aśvadhenvāmapi bhāgi iti kiśorana liṅgena aśvadhenvā vijñāyate bhāgitvāt tu 'guṇānāmabhidhānatvāt saṃbandha-dabhidhānavat yathā dhenuḥ kiśorana' |
tasya dhenuriti gavām, prakṛtau vibhaktaṃ coditaṃ tvāt, tatsāmānyāt tadvikāraḥ syāt, yatheṣṭi guṇaśabdena |
bhāṣyam-- idamāmananti 'athaiṣa bhūyaiśvadevaḥ trivideva sarvaḥ, tasya viśvavataḥ stotrīyāḥ; dhenurdakṣiṇā dhenurdakṣiṇā' iti |
(atra satyāpādaḥ - 'bhūḥ ūrdhvaḥ rathaṃtarasāmā bhūtikāmo yajeta, dhenurdakṣiṇā' iti |
17|3|24 bṛhaspatisavasyamapi śasyamityatra aśvalāyane 9|5|16) atra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ dhenuḥ gavāṃ nivartikā, uta kṛtsnasya dakṣiṇāyāḥ |
tatra idaṃ tāvat parīkṣyaṃ kiṃ prakṛtau vibhaktaṃ dākṣiṇyam, uta samastamiti |
kiṃ prakṛtau vibhaktaṃ dākṣiṇyam dhenurvā nivartikā, uta abhikaṃ kṛtsnāya dakṣiṇāya nivartiketi |
kiṃ prāptam ? 'tasya dhenuḥ' iti śrayamāṇe brūmaḥ |
tataḥ etattāvat vicāryate prakṛtau vibhaktaṃ dākṣiṇyamiti |
kathamaṃ gośvāśvaśvāśvatara dakṣiṇā, iti prakṛtau gavādīnāṃ dīkṣāṃśadaḥ pratyekaṃ parisamāpyate |
ca śabdaḥ samuccayārtho bhavati, tu samuccayasya nirdeśakaḥ |
'samuccayaḥ śobhanaḥ, samuccayo draṣṭavyaḥ' iti yathā bhavati evam, 'ca śobhanaḥ' 'ca draṣṭavyaḥ' iti vā bhaviṣyati |
tathā, yatheha samuccayayoḥ ṣaṣṭhī bhavati 'gavaldirayoḥ samuccayaḥ' iti, evaṃ ghavaḥ khadiraścetyāpyabhaviṣyat |
śrutvā nirdiṣṭena caikavākyatayā nyāyyā, na gavādilakṣitena samudāyena |
lakṣayitvā hi gavādīn teṣāṃ dakṣiṇātvaṃ vidhīyate |
caśabdaśca samarthito bhaviṣyati, 'gaurdakṣiṇā, aśvaśca dakṣiṇā' iti |
na gauravadāsahito gavādīnāṃ vā samāhāraḥ iti |
yadā vibhaktaṃ dākṣiṇyam, tadā prāptā gaurdakṣiṇe |
soma-- vṛttādhikaraṇatrayasya kariṣyamāṇatvāccodanāt- tvāt adhyāyasaṃgatiḥ, kariṣyamāṇavicārasya avasaralakṣaṇa saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu-- tasya dhenurtitha dhenuḥ gavāṃ nivartikā syāt, prakṛtau gavāśādīnāṃ pratyekameva dakṣiṇā- tvasya coditatvāt |
tatrāpi gomireva sāmānyāt, yathā guṇaśabdena nirvapatyādinā sāmānyāt iṣṭiḥ sauryādiḥ āgneyavikāraḥ, tadvaditi |
' bhāṭṭa-- 'athaiṣa dhruvaśradeva' ityanena vihite bhūsaṃjñake ekāhe dhenudakṣiṇā |

sā kiṃ aśvādīnāṃ nivartikā na veti cintāyām, yadyapi na mūloktarītyā gavādyadeśena prakṛtau dakṣiṇātvasya 'gauścāśva' ityanena vihitatvāt uddeśyaviśeṣaṇasya sāhityasya avivakṣitatvena pratyekaṃ gavādināṃ dakṣiṇātvāvagateḥ dhenvāmeva sthānāpatyā nivartiketi śaṅkituṃ śakyam, gavādināmaprāptatvena uddeśya- tvāyogāt, anekoddeśye vākyabhedācca, dakṣiṇātvasya ānatikaratvātiriktyasya durbacanatvena ānateḥ phala- rūpatayā vidheyatvāyogānca |
ata eva gavādidravyaviśiṣṭaṃ goduhitsaṃkhyāviśiṣṭaṃ ca dānameva dakṣiṇāpadavācyanāti- janakatvena vidhīyate |
niruktadānasya ca 'ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇā dadāti' ityanena ṛtvigudeśena viniyogaḥ |
ṛtvigviśeṣasya vā tasyānyatvena viniyogena vā ānarthakyasya prāptatvā dānavādena ṛtvigdāna- vidhirityādi pūrvamuktam |
tathāpi 'gauścāśva' ityatra gavādimānātijanakatvaṃ pratyekameva, na tu nyāsajya- vṛtti āgneyādivat, tathākalpane pramāṇābhāvāt |
na ca caśabdena itaretarayogapratīteḥ parasparasahitatvaṃ karaṇātvā- vagatiḥ, tasya samuccayapratipādakatvenāpi upapattau itaretara- yogāpratipādakatvāt |
ataśca yogyatāvalena pratyekameva gavādināṃ prakṛtau dakṣiṇātvam, tena dakṣiṇedeśena vidhīya- mānaṃ vikṛtau dhenutvaṃ vidheyasāmarthyānusārāt godvāreṇaiva niviśate iti nātra kasyāpi bādhaḥ |
dhenuśabdasya gomātra- dhṛṣṭiguṇaviśeṣe guṇaviśiṣṭasyaiva vā śaktivasya sthāpita- tvāt |
iti prāpte, na tāvat goranuvādena dhenuvidhiḥ, ekaprasaratābhaṅgapatteḥ |
nāpi dakṣiṇāvādena dhenuvidhiḥ, tathātve ekatvasyāpi aprāptatvā vidheyatve vākyabhedapatteḥ |
ato'vaśyaṃ dakṣiṇādānoddeśena dhenutvaikaviśiṣṭaṃ go- dravyameva vidheyam |
tacca yadyapi prakṛtau gavādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ dakṣiṇādānasādhanatā, tathāpi trivattvet dhenudhanatayā prākṛtasarvasādhanatānāṃ bādhāt sarvadravyabādha eva |
vastutastu gavādidravyāṇāṃ na prakṛtau pratyekasādhanatā, samuccayasya 'agre kṛttikāmyaḥ puroḍāśamaṣṭakapālam, tvāṣṭraṃ pānīyavantam' ityādidevavākyopādānādeva siddheḥ caśabdavaiyarthyāpātāt |
ataśca gavādināṃ caśabdena itaretarayogapratītervākyasyaivaikasādhanatvāt dhenu- sādhanatayā prākṛtadakṣiṇādānasādhanatābādha sarvadravya- nivṛttiḥ |

etena sādhanatāmevopye goduhitasādhanataiva atideśataḥ pūrvaprapañcīkāreṇa dhenutvādi viśiṣṭā vidhīyate iti nānyathā bādha ityapāsyam, sādhanatayā apekṣatvena godravyeṇa dravyāntaranivṛtterāvaśyakatvāt |
upahavya ekāhe 'aśvaḥ śyāmo (vo-bhāṣye) rukmalalāṭo dakṣiṇā' ityuktam |
tatra dakṣiṇāśabda- saṃyogāt dhenunyāyena kṛtsnasya ṛtudakṣiṇāsya aśvena bādhaḥ |
vi. 10|3|18. dhenuvatsādhadakṣaṇā, satrahaṇa iti puruṣapā- nayo yathā hiraṇyasya |
upahavye kṛtau 'ukthyo yataḥ samadaśastomo bṛhaspṛṣṭhaḥ aśvaḥ śyāmo rukmalalāṭo dakṣiṇā' 'sa brahmaṇa deyaḥ' iti śruteḥ |
kimatramaśvaḥ brahmabhāgamātrasya nivartakaḥ, uta kṛtsnasya ṛtudakṣiṇāsya iti vicāre kṛtsnasya nivartakaḥ iti pūrvādhikaraṇasiddhāntanyāyena utsune pūrvapakṣe siddhānta- māha |
aśvadakṣiṇā aśvarūpā dakṣiṇā kṛtsnāyāḥ prākṛtāḥ ṛtudakṣiṇāyā nivartikā |
'sa brahmaṇa deyaḥ' ityanena ca puruṣā- panayaḥ brahmabhitrānāṃ pañcadaśānāṃ ṛtvikpuruṣāṇāṃ apanayaḥ kriyate |
yathā hiraṇyasya yathā śatakṛṣṇalacarau śeṣa- bhakṣāṇāṃ hiraṇyānām 'sarve brahmaṇa pariharati' ityuktam (10|2|19-20) tadvat |
eke tu kartṛsaṃyogāt, tasya liṅga- viśeṣeṇa |
anayā aśvadakṣiṇāyā kṛtsnaṛtudakṣiṇāgatā eke kecit padārthāḥ brahmabhāgarūpā eva nivartante na kṛtsna- ṛtudakṣiṇāyā nivṛttiḥ |
'sa brahmaṇa deyaḥ' iti vākyena brahmasaṃśrava- jñānāt |
evaṃ tasya aśvasya kartṛsaṃyogāt liṅgaviśeṣeṇa karmakartṛbrahmasaṃśravarūpaviśeṣaliṅgena eke kecit padārthā brahmabhāgarūpā eva nivartante |
yathā daśapeye ‘sajambudrātre' ityudgātrābhāsyaiva nivartikā sakṛt, na kṛtsnāyāḥ : ṛtudakṣiṇāyāḥ : tadvat |
ayaṃ dvayāyo'śvaḥ hiraṇyavat śatakṛṣṇalacarauśeṣabhakṣaviṣaya- hiraṇyaśakalasyetareṣāṃ trayāṇāmapi ṛtvijāṃ vyāvṛttiḥ tathā vikāraḥ syāt kṛtsnaṛtudakṣiṇāyā bādhakaḥ syāt |
tasmāt kṛtsnaṛtudakṣiṇā- vikāraḥ athaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- kvacit śrūyate (paśuvikṛtau) 'dyāvā- pṛthivyāṃ dhenumālabheta, māstaṃ vatsam, aindramṛṣabham' iti |
tadatra saṃśayaḥ kimaśvaḥ dhenuvatsarvāḥ, uta gāva iti |
sa guṇaḥ codakena prāpte dravye āveśayitavyaḥ |
satyaṃ gavi āhuḥ ; na tu gauratra pratyakṣeṇa vacanena codakena vā |
sa eṣa guṇavacano yadyapi go'bhidhānaṃ guṇaṃ vadati, vākyena ālambhadravyaṃ āskandati, tathāpi go- dravyasya abhāvāt ālambhativākyameva gṛhyate na bhūtiḥ |
guṇāśca amūrta- tvāt na kriyā saṃbadhyante |
yathā 'avī dve dhenu dadāti' 'tasya puruṣī dhenudakṣiṇā' |
mautpattike etasmin utpatyaiva jātiviśiṣṭe guṇaśabde dravyato vikāraḥ syāt |
yadetat jātiviśiṣṭaṃ jñānaṃ vayaśca, na tat ajapaśuṃ śakyaṃ kartum, gopaśuṣveva tat bhavati |
nanu atra yadyapi syāt śakyamāveśayitum, tadāveśayiṣyate, yacca śakyam, tat pramādiṣyate yathā ajā dhenuvatsarvā iti |
iha codakena ajaśabdena virodha sati nājadravyaṃ prāpyati |
kārakavibhaktireṣā ālambhena saṃbandhaṃ karoti, gavi sā ca śrutiḥ |
dravyasaṃbandho vākyena syāt, tacca durbalaṃ śruteḥ |
tasmin jātiviśiṣṭe guṇe ālambhasaṃyukte sati na śakyaṃ ajādravye bhavitum |
na ca codakāpekṣayā pratyakṣā jātiḥ utsraṣṭuṃ śakyate |
dhenvādayaḥ śabdāḥ ubhayoḥ (api vādinoḥ) gavādīnām asādhāraṇa- vacanāḥ eva, śoṇadāya iva (nātra vivādaḥ) |
ana- paidyaiva padāntaraṃ ete (dhenvādi śabdāḥ) padāvasyāyāmeva asādhāraṇamarthaṃ pratipādayanti |
(tenāmī guṇaviśeṣa- vacanāḥ) : kecit padāntaramevaiva (arthe pratipādayanti) yathā śuklaḥ paṭa iti |

yadi asādhāraṇaguṇāvacchinnamivadām—) kathaṃ tarhi pūrve: pakṣa: ? ( uttaram ) śrutyā dhenuśabdo dhāne ( dugdha- dāne ) eva vartate, godravyaṃ tu asya ( ādhārabhūtam ) na śabdoktam, nāpi codakena ( kevalaṃ lakṣaṇayā gamyate) ajadravyaṃ tu codakena prāpnoti, tatra ānumānika: śabdo vidyate |
siddhāntastu, asādhāraṇaguṇa- vacano'yaṃ go'dhiṣṭhānamantareṇa naiva guṇa: saṃpādito bhavati |
soma— pūrveṇa codakaprāptasaṃkhyādravyaparime sapta- daśaśarāvaparimitacarusaṃpādanākṣatayā avaśyambhāvini bādhe jaghanyatvāt muṣṭerlopa: |
iha tu codakaprāptājadravya- parime'pi dhānādiguṇopapatte: nādravyabhāvāt : iyu- sthita: saṃgati: |
sūtrārthastu— aupayike svabhāvata eva dravyaviśeṣaguṇavidheyatve dhenvādī dravyasya vikāra: syāt gavādivadravyaviśeṣagatasya dhānādiguṇasya ajādi- dravye kartumaśakyatvāt |
vi— ' dhenuvatsarpabhācchāge gavi vā, guṇakīrta- nāt |
' bhāṭ— ' dyāvāpṛthivyāṃ dhenumālameta, vāyavyaṃ vatsam, aindramṛṣabham ' ityādi ātideśikasya ajasya na bādha: ; dhenvādidhānāṃ dhānādiguṇamātraśaktatvena ajatve satyapi upapatte: |
na ca gadhyaiva dhennādi- śabdānāṃ prayogāt goṣṭhiguṇepyeva śakti: |
tanmātravṛtti- guṇeṣu vaijātye pramāṇābhāvena gorapi śakyatā''svacchedaka- koṭipraveśe gauravāt, ' abhī dve dhenu dadāti, aja- muṣabham ' ityādi anyatrāpi dhenvādiśabdaprayogācca |

gavyeva pracuraprayogāt guṇaviśiṣṭāyāṃ tasyāṃ niruḍhalakṣaṇā pārthādiśabdavat ( śrayāṇāṃ pṛthāputrāde'pi arjune eva pārthaśabdasya niruḍhā lakṣaṇa ) paṅkajaśabdasya tu padama- minne prayogābhāvāt padamevoruḍhasvīkāre'pi adoṣa: |
ataśca lakṣaṇayāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt atideśānurodhena nirukta- guṇaviśiṣṭa ajadravyameva grāhyam |
evaṃ prāpte, padāntara- sambhinyāhārābhāve dhenupadamātraśravaṇe sarvatra govṛtti- dhānādiguṇasyaiva pratīte: dhenvādidhānāṇāṃ śoṇādiśabda- vat gomātravṛttijātīyānādiguṇe eva śakti: |
ataśca gorupadiṣṭa- guṇākṣisatvāt upadiṣṭatvādeva vā ajasya bādha: |
' 30. dhenuvatsarpabhādhikaraṇanaya: : ' asādhāraṇaguṇa- vacano'yama ( dhenvādiśabda: ) adhiṣṭhānamantareṇa guṇa: saṃpādito bhavati ' iti |
na te ājya- dohatāmagānakāle upanidheyā: gargātrirātre |
dhruva: graha: anupote sādhyate, anye grahaśca upote ( upotaṃ bhūmerupari mṛnmayaṃ sthaṇḍilam |
vi. 2|3|1. dhruvagopa: dhruvaṃ nāma somagrahaṃ gopāyati rakṣati sa rājaputra: |
dhruvā hi devatārthadravyāntarādadāne'pi upastaraṇāmidhāraṇepayogātvāt pratyabhidhāraṇamapekṣate eva |
tena prāk stridhakṛta: parastādapi dhrauvopayoga: asti ityavacchevate pratipūraṇayitavyā |
vā. 3|5|1|12. dhruvāyā: upāṃśuyājādyādhāravedapi asādhāraṇabhāvāt pradhāna- kālaviprakarṣān pradhānaviprakarṣa: |
su. pu. 626. dhruvā eva ( sakāśāt ) stridhakṛte avadīyate |
dhrauvamājyaṃ sādhāraṇam, darśayati ca ' sarvasmai vā etad yajñāya gṛhyate yad dhruvāyāmājyam ' iti |
sādhāraṇaṃ hi tat, upāṃśuyājāya anyebhyaśca prayojanamya: |
yasya yasya ājyam, tatastata eva prahītamya saṃskṛtaṃ ca ( pratyabhidhāraya- tavyam ) |
bhā. 3|5|1|6. dhrauvameva ājyaṃ darśapūrṇa- māsayo: upāṃśuyāje dravyam |
10|8|154-48. dhrauvājyāt sarvasādhāraṇāt upāṃśuyājārtha apātite pariśiṣṭaṃ anyadevatāyeṃ bhavati |
12|1|17. ' sarvasmai vā etad yajñāya gṛhyate yad dhruvāyāmājyam ' |
10|8|147-48. dhvaṃsa: nābhāvarūpa:, kintu caramakṣaṇasaṃbandha eva nāśa: |
ata eva ' naṣṭo ghaṭa: ' iti pratīti: |
maṇi. pṛ. 29. dhvaṃsa: ' nāstitvā yasya dadhna: pradhvaṃsābhāva iṣyate |
' śrotrā. abhāvaprāmāṇyavāde 2. dhvajanikhanananyāyena tattvabuddherdatāmupādayitu- mapi śāstre nāstikyataccirasanāyavatāra: |
siddhāntadarśane nirañjana- bhāṣye 3|4|22. dhvajino gacchanti ' ' chatriṇo gacchanti ' iti liṅgasabhavāt śabdapravṛtti: |
na vācyātmā taṃsaṃyogavibhāgātmā vā nāda:, kintu vāyuguṇa: śabdaviśeṣo nādo dhvaniriti coyate |
ratnākara: sphoṭavāde 38. dhvanaya: arthāntarabhūtā: śabdasya drutādidvipāramārthikīṃ kurvanti |
pṛ. 465. dhvanaya: nānā- deśā: yugapadāgacchantaḥ itaretaranirapekṣā eva yugapata saṃskārānārabhante śrotrasya |
pṛ. 170. dhvanidharmāṇāṃ asadaśeṣapi varṇeṣu abhivyaṅgyā- bhivyañjakatvasaṃbandhanimittāropadarśanāt sādṛśyādinā kena- cit saṃbandhena āropo bhavati iti jñāyate |
[ atra prathamaṃ na-śabdena svatantreṇa āruhyā laghu. siddhāntadayo niveśitā: |

tata: paraṃ nañ-śabdāravyā: tata: paraṃ nyāyasudhākāreṇa nahi iti niṣedhārthakamalaṇḍaṃ padamiti spaṣṭamevoktatvāt nahiśabdavattvā: niveśitā: tadanantaraṃ naśabdāravyasāmāsikapadaghaṭitā: nakārāravyāśca niveśitā: |
ke. ] ' nāmi manyet abhīpomīye paśau ' iti śata- pathe |
bāla. pṛ. 37. nājñātaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭabuddhiviśeṣyamupa saṃkrāmati iti nyāya: |
yathā viśeṣaṇajñānasya viśiṣṭa jñānahetutvāt tadantareṇa tasiddhi: |
nahi daṇḍajñānaṃ vina daṇḍati jñānaṃ saṃbhavati, na cājñātaviśeṣaṇaṃ tadviśeṣa vaśīkaroti tadartha: |
sāhasī. 187. nātirātre ityatra naśabda: pratiṣedhārthaka eva na paryudāsārthaka: |
prathame'dhikaraṇe naśabda: paryu dāsārya: ; dvitīye tu arthavādārtha: |
na tatra śakyaṃ vaktuṃ paryudāsa iti |
saṃbandha eva hi na syāt, atirātravarjitātirātre gṛhṇāti ṣoḍaśinamiti |
nanu parasparaṃ viruddhau vidhipratiṣedhau na saṃbhavataḥ |
vacanaprāmāṇyāt pratiṣedho vidhiṃ bādhiṣvā bhaviṣyati, vidhirapi pratiṣedham |
uktametat vacana- prāmāṇyādvirodhācca mithyāpratyayaḥ prayogacana ekaṃ kalpaṃ gṛhītvā na dvitīyamapi gṛhṇātīti |
yatra punaranya- vacanavyatiriktaṃ vākyasya, tatra na vikalpo bhavati |
dupū — ( prathame'dhikaraṇe paryudāsaḥ, dvitīye artha- vādaḥ ) tṛtīye pratiṣedhaḥ |
( tathāhi, ) yadi 'anatirātre gṛhṇāti' iti paryudāsaḥ syāt, tatra vidhānānarthakyam ( ṣoḍaśinaḥ ) |
atha aṣoḍaśinam ( atirātre gṛhṇāti ) iti tathāpi aya- meva ( vidhānānarthakyam ) doṣaḥ |
śā — sāmānyaviṣaye vidhau viśeṣaviṣaye naja- paryudāsatvena vidhereva vākyaśeṣaḥ ityuktam ( prathame ), aprāptaviṣayastu najarthavādaḥ iti ( uktaṃ dvitīye ) |
atha ko'yaṃ pratiṣedho bhavati iti tata ucyate ( iti saṃgatiḥ ) |
vi — 'nātirātre paryudāso vā''tha niṣedham', ādyo'nujāva, naivaṃ vidhyaikaviṣayatvataḥ |
paśusomavat ( na tau paśau karoti, na some itivat ) |
niṣedhaḥ syād vikalpo'tra śrīdhā- dāviva yujyate |
bhāṭṭa— yatra tu tasminnevārthe pratyakṣe vidhiḥ tasmin eva ca niṣedhaḥ; yathā 'atirātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti, nāti- rātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti, tatra vikalpasyāvaśyakatvāt pratiṣedha eva |

na ca tatra 'samidho yajati' itivat vidhinā ṛtusādguṇyajanakākṣepāt, niṣedhena ca 'nānṛtaṃ vadet' itivat ṛtuvaiguṇyajanakākṣepāt eka- syaiva ṣoḍaśigrahaṇasya ṛtusādguṇyavaiguṇyajanakatvaṃ viruddha- miti vācyam |
etādṛśaviṣaye niṣedhena ṣoḍaśigrahaṇā- bhāve'pi itarājñaiḥ ṛtusādguṇyapattiḥ ityarthākṣepāt |
vidhinā ca ṣoḍaśigrahaṇasyāpi ṛtusādguṇya sahakāritva- mityākṣepāt |
ataśca ṣoḍaśigrahaṇe pravṛttasiddhayarthe karaṇapakṣe phalabhūmā'pi kalpyate iti dhyeyam |
ata eva prathamatau vidhipravṛttyā pratiyogiprasiddhau jātāyām, niṣedhena niṣedhe kṛte paścāt vidheyasya phalabhūmakalpanamiti viśeṣaḥ |
bhāṭṭa. 10|8|3. nātirātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti ayaṃ kavyartha- mātraviṣayakaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ śrautaḥ |
vāla. pṛ. 32, nāti- rātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti ayaṃ kriyāpratiṣedhaḥ pratyakṣaḥ |
pṛ. 32, nātirātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti ayaṃ ṣoḍaśigraha- niṣedhaḥ vikṛtigata-upadiṣṭa-adṛṣṭārthasanipātikriyā- niṣedhaḥ |
pṛ. 37. na anañ pradhānamucyamānaṃ kasyacit prayojanāya kalpyate |
bhā. 7|4|2|9. nānupahala bhūtāni bhogaḥ saṃbhavati iti nyāyaḥ |
yā vṛttiḥ sa paro dharmastena jīvāmi jājale |
anu- mitapratipattereva dhāraṇaprayojakatvādikalpanādoṣaḥ : 'nānu- mite hyasau' iti nyāyāt anumānasya phalamukhatvācca |
anu anujābhrieṣu iti paryu- dāsāśrayaṇe anūyājaśabdena najaḥ samāsaḥ syāt |
'nañ' iti sūtreṇa nañ suvantena samasyate ityarthakena tasya samāsavividhānāt |
tataśca 'na lopo nañaḥ' iti naśabde ādyavarṇasya nakārasya lope pariśiṣṭāt akārāt 'tassānuṅi' iti tuḍāgame sati anañaḥ ityādi- vat anūyājeṣu iti syāt |
na ca pāṇinā sūtrakṛtā 'vibhāṣā' idhikṛtya tadvidhānāt samāsābhāva- pakṣe nānuyājeṣu iti na duṣyati iti vācyam |
kātyā- yananena vārtikakṛtā 'vāvacanārthakyaṃ svabhāvasiddhatvāt' ( samarthasūtre vārtikam ) iti vibhāṣā'dhikārasya pratyā- khyāyatvāt |
vigrahavākyasamāsayoḥ bhinnārthakatayā tadartha- pratipādanāya tadanvayoḥ svabhāvāsiddhatvāt vibhāṣā'dhikāro vyarthaḥ iti tadarthaḥ |
vāvacanaparyāyātmakaṃ vibhāṣāvacanaṃ hi samāsena vigrahavākyasya nivṛttiṃ bhūt ityevārthe pāṇinā kṛtam |
vyāsasamāsayorbhinnnārthatve tu svārthapratipādanāya vyāsavākyaprayogavattvyambhāvāt tanni- vṛttiḥ samāse na saṃbhāvyate |
tataśca vyāsasamāsayorekā- rthatve sati samāsena vyāsavākyasya nivṛttī prasaktāyāṃ vāvacanaṃ kartavyaṃ syāt |
tadarthakyavacanatvāt kātyā- yanasya ekārthatve vyāsasamāsayoḥ aniṣṭhamavagamyate |
sati ca tayoḥ bhinnārthatve tadarthapratipādanāya vyāsasamāsayoḥ svabhāvasiddhatvāt vibhāṣāvacanaṃ ( na ) kartavyaṃ ityupapannam |
ata eva 'ṛddhasya rājaḥ puruṣaḥ' ityatra samāso na prayujyate, bhinnārthatvāt |
vigrahavākye hi rājapadaṃ ṛddha- padārthasahiṣṇu, samāsavākye tu |
tataśca padāntara- sahiṣṇutvātsahiṣṇutvaprayojakaṃ vaijāyaṃ tatrā'nubhavasiddhaṃ ityasti vyāsasamāsayorbhinnnārthatvam |
ata eva ca rāja- puruṣa ityatra rājaḥ puruṣa iti vā rājñā puruṣa iti vā dvivacanabahutvayorapratīteḥ vṛttau ekatvamautsargika ityupa- pannam |
na ca nānuyājeṣu ityatra samāsābhāve'pi paryu- dāsaḥ kuto na pratīyate iti vācyam |
anāhmaṇaḥ ityādau hi samāse paryudāso gamyate ityatra na vivādaḥ |
yacca samāsagamyam, tat tadekalabhyaṃ ityabhyupeyam, anyathā vākyenāpi samāsagamyārthapratīto tayorbhinnnārtha- tvānupapatteḥ |
ataḥ paryudāsapakṣe samāsaprasaṅgāt anūyājeṣu iti syāt |
na ca evaṃ sati 'ṛddhasya rājaḥ puruṣaḥ' iti vigrahavākya iva samāse'pi rājñaḥ ṛddhaviśeṣaṇa. sahiṣṇutvaṃ syāt |
tathā ca 'ṛddhasya rājapuruṣaḥ' ityapi syāditi vācyam |

yadi ca 'rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ' ityādī vyāsasamāsayoḥ pratipādyabhedābhāve'pi rājādipadasya ṛddhapadādiviśeṣaṇasahiṣṇutvatadasahaṣṇutva- kṛtavaijatyakalpanāmātreṇa vailakṣaṇyamātritā tādṛśavailakṣaṇyā- vacchinnasvārthapratipādanāya vākyasamāsayoḥ svabhāvāsiddha- tvāt samāsena vākyanivṛtterabhyupagatatvāt tannivṛttyarthe vibhāṣādhikāraḥ pratyākhyāyate, tarhi vibhāṣā'dhikāra prāgvihitenāpi samāsena vākyanivṛttiḥ syāt |
tataśca 'avyayaṃ vibhakti' ityādibhirvidhīyamāne adhihari, upakumbham, yāvacchulekaṃ ityādi samāse vākyanivṛttiḥ syāt |
ityataḥ nityagrahaṇamanuvṛttaṃ 'upapadamatiṅ' iti vihitena 'ghaṭakāraḥ' ityādi samāsenāpi vākyanivṛttiḥ syāt |
astu vā vibhāṣā'dhikārapratyā- khyānam ; tathāpi na doṣaḥ |
