vā. 2|1|212 pṛ. 467. nāmapadasya nahi ākhyāta vā kṛtyaṃ vā antareṇa vidhiśaktirasti |

vā. 1|4|123 pṛ. 332. nāmaprayojananāmāthaviśeṣanāmāthaprakārakāmeda- saṃsargabodhavyavacchinnaṃ prati ekādhikaraṇaprātipadi- kāryatā'vacchedakanāmadvayasamabhyāhārasya dvaṃdvaminnāma- dvayasamabhyāhārasya vā tantratvam |
bhāṭṭa. 6|1|12. nāmayuktakarmavidhāne sāmānādhikaraṇyāt kadā- cit yathārthaviśeṣo nāmnā nirūpyate kadācinnāmārtho yajinā |
yo yatra pūrvataraprasiddho bhavati, sa itaraṃ svaviṣaye vyavasthāpayati |
yathā rājasūye ityatra nāma yāgāyāgaviṣayatvena upaplavamānaṃ prakṛtayāgaprasiddhena yajinā svaviṣayaṃ nīyate |
vā. 2|1|31 pṛ. 476. nāma-rūpa-dharmaviśeṣa-punarukti- nindā'- śakti- samātivacana- prāyaścittā- nyāyadarśanā- cchākhā'ntareṣu karmabhedaḥ syāt |
iha śākhā'ntareṇyudāharaṇaṃ kāṭhakaṃ kāṇvakaṃ paippalā- dakaṃ ityevamādīni |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kimapekṣā śālāyāṃ yatkiñcidagnihotrādi śrūyate, tacchākhā'ntare punaḥ śraya- māṇaṃ mriyate, uta na mriyate iti |
pūrva prayogabhedaṃ pratipādya idānīṃ bhedāpavādaḥ kriyate |
'ekatraivaṃ punaḥśrutiviśeṣaṇārthakaṃ hi syāt' iti nyāyena abhyāsāt karmabhedaḥ pratipādita eva |
na ca śākhā'ntare guṇa- phalāyārthāntara. thīṃ punaśrutirbhavet |
na ca karmaikye'pi mikṣādyetugodhanenaiva śākhā'ntarepunaḥśruterarthavattvāt nāmnā'sādeti iti vakta- vyam |

yadyapi 'svādhyāyamadhyedhīyata' iti svādhyāyagatamekatvaṃ śrūyate, svādhyāyaśabdena ca svadeśaśākhā abhidhīyate, tathāpi sāmarthyato'rthajñānārthatvena prāptasya svādhyāyasya adhyayanena saṃskāravidhau uddeśyatvāt, uddeśyaviśeṣaṇasya ca 'grahaṃ saṃmārṣṭi' iti avivakṣitatvāt ekasya nānāśākhā- 'dhyayanamaviruddham |
kiñca, yadi ekasya ekaśākhādhyayana- meva niyataṃ bhavet, tadā vedāntarīyāśākhā'dhyayanamapi na prāpnoti |
tathā ca sati 'vedāntarīya vedo vā vedaṃ vāpi yathākramam |

kiñca yatra ekasyāmeva śākhāyāṃ kathañcit vicchedābhāvena anupādeyaṃ prati upādānāt agnihotrādīnāṃ karmāntaratvam, tatra śākhā'ntareṣu sutarāmeva buddhi vicchedādanādeyaṃ phalaṃ prati upādānatvāt prakaraṇāntarādapi karmabhedaḥ |
tathā kāṭhakādi- karmanāmabhedādapi medaḥ, ekatraivāthai anekaśabdasyānyāya- tvāt |
tathaikasyāṃ kārīrīvākyamadhīyā- nāstaittarīya bhūmibhojanamācaranti, aparasyāṃ neti |
tathā kasyāñcit udita- homanindā, kasyāñcit anuditahomanindā |
tathā pratiśālaṃ nānādharmān saṃkalya na kaścidvirodhāt anuṣṭhātuṃ śaknoti, karmabhede tu śakno- tīti |
tathā kaścit anudita- homavyatikrame prāyaścittamāmananti, kasyāṃcit udita- homavyatikrame |
tadatra sarvatraiva parasparavirodhāt pūrvatra asaṃbhavadvidhaya bhedaḥ |
bhavedevaṃ yadi pratyabhijñānasiddhamatra karmaikyaṃ na bhavet |
tathāhi, śāstrā'ntare'pi saiva saṃjñā, tadeva dravyadaivatam, te eva guṇādayaḥ, tadeva na phalam, sa eva dhātvarthavicchinnabhāvanāviṣayavidhiḥ |
tadevaṃ pratya- bhijñāmūsasiddhe karmaikye "yadyapi kiñcidikaṃ nyūnaṃ vā pratīyate, tathāpi gomedhune jāte lāṅgale vā chinne pratya- bhijñāsiddhamekatvaṃ notkṣipyatīti |
ekaikā hi śāstrā svādhyāyaśabdavācyā pratipuruṣaṃ vyavasthāpya adhyayanavidhinā pramāṇīkṛtā |
na cobhayaśākhāgataṃ vākyamekasya pramāṇam, yenānarthakyamiyā karma bhindyāt |
nanu sāmarthyataḥ arthajñānārthatayā prāptaṃ svādhyāya- muddiśya adhyayanasaṃskāravidhau ekātmavivakṣitamityuktam |
ataḥ kathamekasmin puruṣe śākhā'ntarasya aprāmāṇya- mityucyate |
syādevaṃ yadi adhyayanavidheḥ prāk svādhyāya- syārthatvaniścayo bhavet, kintu lokānusāreṇa śaktya- vadhāraṇamātram |
adhyayanavidhistu uccāraṇatātparyādhīna- marthaparatvamiti arthavādādhikaraṇe eva prapañcitam |

tena lokānusāreṇa śakyavadhāraṇe jāte'pi uccāraṇatātparyama- ntareṇa svādhyāyasya arthaparatvaniścayāya sāmarthyaviniyukta- svādhyāyoddeśena adhyayanasaṃskāravidhiḥ; kintu svādhyāya- karmaikyaiva adhyayanasyārthajñānaṃ prati upādīyamānāt svādhyāyasyāpi upādeyatvamiti tadvatamekāvaṃ vivakṣita- meveti ekaiva śākhā ekasyādhyetuḥ pramāṇamiti nābhyāsāt karmabheda iti |
na caivaṃ vedāntarīyaśākhāvatagnihotrādikarmaṇāṃ abhyāsādvedaprasaṅgaḥ, samuccayāpādakavacanavaśena sutarām- bhedāvagateḥ |
tathāhi, karmāvabodhaṃ prati upādīya- māna eva samuccīyate ityekaḥ karmaprayogaḥ |
tadvatasāhityāthai trivedīmedo'tra ekasminneva karmaṇi vedabhedena samuccayā- bhagamāt |
kāṭhakādisaṃjñā tu na karmaṇaḥ, kintu kaṭhena proktamiti pravacananimittā hi sā |
na ca karma procyate, kiṃ tarhi ? grantha eva |
bhavatu vā karmaṇaḥ saṃjñā, tathāpi utpattisaṃyoginī hi saṃjñā meḍikā |
liṅgadarśanāni tu sūtrabhāṣyāvārtikānāṃ vāreṇa karmaikyā- virodhena vyākhyāsyeti |
taduktam 'tasmāttadeveti mate na karma bhinnaṃ kathañcittiśākhāmiṣṭam |
na kāraṇaṃ saptamamasti cānyato yathoktaiśca tu bhedasiddhiḥ |
sūtraṃ tu - ekameva karmaphala- saṃyogāt dravyadevatātparyabhāvāvavidhyisaṃjñānā- maviśeṣāt pratyabhijñāsphuṭatvādityarthaḥ |
uttarādhikaraṇe tu anyānyapi kānicit bhedakāraṇāni āśaṅkya nirā- karoti |
tasmāt kāṭhakaṃ kaṭhāśākhoktamagnihotraṃ kālāpakā- gnihotrāt bhinnaṃ syāt |
ekasyāṃ śākhāyāṃ abhī- pomīyamekādaśakapālamāmananti, anyasyāṃ dvādaśakapālam |
' ityādi kārīriṣṭimantrāśca adhīyānāḥ taittirīyāḥ; bodhā- yanasūtrānāusāriṇaḥ bhūmau bhojanamācaranti, bodhāyanīyebhyo- 'nye tu taittirīyāḥ kārīriṣṭimadhīyānā api bhūmibhojanaṃ nācaranti |
karmaikye tu iyaṃ pratiśālaṃ punaruktiḥ nopa- padyeta |
nityate 'prātaḥprātaranṛtaṃ te vadanti puro- dayājjuhati ye'gnihotram |
' iti anudite sūrye 'sūryo jyotirjyotiḥ sūryaḥ svāhā' ityamidhānaṃ anṛtaṃ saṃpadyate ityarthaḥ |
anyasyāṃ tu śākhāyāṃ anudita- homaprastāve uditahomo nindyate 'yadudite sūrye prātarjuhuyāt |
uyantaṃ vāva ādityaṃ agnirna samārohati' iti pūrvamuktam |
ato yajamānasya gṛhe sūryaḥ agni praviṣṭaḥ rātrau vasati |
tataśca yathā atithaye pradāya vaimukhyena gṛhāt dūrāt gatāya āhāryamannaṃ śūnyāya āva- sathāya atithigṛhe śūnye gṛhe samayarthaṃ caturthyau |
kiṃvā atithiśśūnyāya kevalayaiva jaḍāya gṛhāya dātavyam, tādṛk sa uditahomaḥ saṃpadyate |
tasmāt ubhaya- nindayā uditānuditahomau bhinnau bhavataḥ |
dātavyo vedaśākhāsu vihitānāṃ bhinnabhinnanāmantrāṇāmekasmin karmaṇi upasaṃhāre manuṣyasya na śaktiḥ |
maitrāyaṇīśākhāyāṃ agnicayanamantrasamāmnāye anyārohā nāma sthaṇḍilā- rohaṇamantraviśeṣā anyatra paṭhyante |
kacit śākhāyāṃ tu na te mantrāḥ santi |
tatra adhyetāro yājñikāśca itthaṃ vyapa- diśanti anyāroheṣu maitrāyaṇīyānāmagniḥ samāpyate, itareṣāṃ tu anyatra samāpyate iti |
kecit uditahoma- vyatikrame prāyaścittamāmananti 'yasyāgnihotramahutaṃ sūryo'bhyudiyāt' ityādinā |
na ca karmaikye ubhayathā vṛddhiḥ saṃbhavati |
yathā kaci- cchākhāyāṃ dvādaśāhasatre śrūyate 'yadi purā dīkṣāṇā etameva bṛhatsāmānamupeyuḥ upetaṃ hyeṣāṃ rathaṃtaram |
yadi purā pūrvai dīkṣāṇāḥ dīkṣāvantaḥ kṛtaprathamasomāḥ syuḥ, tadā etameva atirātraṃ bṛhatsāmānaṃ upeyuḥ |
yadi tu adīkṣāṇāḥ akṛtaprathamasomāḥ, tadā rathaṃtarasāmānamupeyuḥ |
tadidaṃ aniṣṭaprathamasomānāpi dvādaśāhasatravacanaṃ prati- śākhaṃ karmabhedagamayati |
taittirīyake yūpaikādaśinyāṃ śrūyate 'yat pakṣasaṃbhitāṃ minuyāt kanīyāsaṃ yaśakratumupeyāt, pāpīyasī asyātmanaḥ prajā syāt |
vedisaṃmitāṃ minoti, jyāyāṃsameva yaśakratu- mupaiti, nāsyātmanaḥ pāpīyasī prajā bhavati' iti |

pakṣaḥ agnicayanavederyaḥ pakṣaḥ, taṃ sagaśo daśā vibhajya madhye agniṣṭaṃ yūpaṃ pārśvayośca pakṣapañca iti ekādaśayūpapaṅkti yadi nilametat tathā kanīyāsaṃ alpataraṃ yaśakratuṃ prāpnuyāt, kiñca asya yajamānasya ātmanaḥ sakāśāt pāpīyasī daridratarā prajā bhavati |
tasmāt vedisaṃmitāt agniveda- pūrvādhaitaryakramaṇaṃ daśāśaṃ sama vibhajya pūrvavat yūpaikā- daśinīṃ minuyāt, tena yajñādeḥ jyāyastvasiddhiḥ |
seyaṃ pakṣasaṃmitāyāḥ nindā, vedisaṃmitāyāśca stutiḥ śākhāntare karmabhedaṃ gamayati |
ṣṭomātirātre 'dve saṃstutānāṃ virājo'tiricyate' iti, śāstrāntare tu 'tisraḥ saṃstutānāṃ virājo'tiricyate' iti śrūyate |
virāṭ iti ekamekaṃ vā daśakaṃ gṛhyate |
so'yaṃ dvayostisṛṇāṃ vā atirekaḥ śāstrā- ntareṣu karmabhede ekaḥ saṃbhavati iti |
atha caturthama- nyārthadarśanam- sārasvate satre śrūyate 'ye puroḍāśinaḥ te upavasanti, ye sānāyinaste vatsān dhārayanti' iti |
ye yajamānāḥ puroḍāśinaḥ aniṣṭhaprathamasomatayā kevala- ndrāmapuroḍāśadravyakadarśoddiṣṭavantaḥ |
te vatsān dhārayanti mātṛsakāśāṃ na gamayanti dohāya |
atha pañcamam- upahavye nāma some 'agniṣṭomo rathaṃtarasāmā, aśvaḥ śyāvo dakṣiṇā' ityekasyāṃ śālāyāṃ śrutam, śāstrāntare tu 'upahavya ukthyo bṛhatsāmā, aśvaḥ śveto dakṣiṇā' iti śrutam |
tacca śālābhedena karmabhede evopapadyate, na karmabhede |
tadeva nāmādibhiḥ kāraṇaiḥ śākhāntare bhinnāsu śākhāsu uktānāṃ karmaṇāṃ bhedaḥ syāt |
nāmarūpadharmaviśeṣadibhiḥ agnihotrādikarmaṇāṃ bhedaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaṃ bādhayate |
kintu sarvaśākhāpratyayaṃ sarva- brāhmaṇapratyayaṃ ca ekaṃ karma saṃyogasya rūpasya codanāyāḥ ākhyāyāśca aviśeṣāt amedāt |
ekasyāṃ śālāyāṃ agnihotrasya karmaṇo yat phalaṃ svargaḥ, tadeva anyasyāmapi śākhāyāmuddiṣṭam |
eva- mekaphalakatvāt sarvāsu śākhāsu ekamevāgnihotraṃ karmeti jñāyate |
evaṃ somarendrayāgvādindradevatākasya karma- rūpasya abhedo bhavati śākhābhede'pi |
evaṃ yajeta iti bātvarthāṃturūpabhāvanātmikāyāḥ codanāyāḥ sarva- śākhāsu viśeṣaḥ |
tasmāt śākhābhede'pi saṃyoga- rūpacodanākhyānāṃ bhedābhāvāt śākhābhede'pi agnihotrasya
yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā kāṭhakakālāpakādināmabhedāt karma- bheda iti tannāha siddhāntī |
bhinnaināpi īdṛśena nāmnā na karmabhedaḥ syāt |
ato na sā karma bhetuṃ śaknoti |
yadi śabdabhedāt bhedo bhavet, tarhi śabdaikyāt karmaikyaṃ syāt |
tathā ca kāṭhakakāṇḍasthānāṃ sarveṣāṃ agnihotradarśapūrṇamāsajyotiṣṭomānāṃ karmaṇāṃ aikakarmyaṃ syāt |
kāṭhakādināmabhedāt na karmabhedaḥ ityatra hetvantara- māha siddhāntī |
yataḥ prabhṛti kasya prakṛtaṃ vacanaṃ tataḥ prabhṛti kāṭhakaṃ iti nāma pravṛttam |
na ca kṛtakena anādīnāṃ karmaṇāṃ bhedaḥ kartuṃ śakyate |
rūpabhedāt karmabhedaḥ iti yaduktaṃ tatrottaramāha siddhāntī |
ekatve'pi karmakāle satyapi paramuttaraṃ karma- bhedakāraṇatvena pūrvapakṣiṇā uktaṃ saṃbhavati |
karmatve'pi vacanāt brīhiyavatvat vikalpena agnīṣomīyasya puroḍāśasya ekādaśakapālavadvādaśakapālayorupapattiḥ |
bhūmibhojanādidharmaviśeṣāt karmabheda iti yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā tatrottaramāha siddhāntī |
punaruktyā karmabhedaḥ iti yaduktaṃ tatrottaramāha siddhāntī |
punarvacanaṃ śākhā'ntare vihitasya sāṅkasya jyotiṣṭomādeḥ karmaṇaḥ anyasyāṃ śākhāyāṃ punaruktiḥ vidyamānāpi āgneyavat na karmabhedikā |
'yadāgneyo'ṣṭā- kapāle'māvāsyāyāṃ bhavati' iti punarvacanaṃ aindrāga- stulyatvāt yathā na karmabhedasya kāraṇaṃ tadvat |
punaruktyā karmabhedaḥ iti yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā tatra bhadvyantareṇottaramāha siddhāntī |
ekaṃ puruṣaṃ prati punaḥpunaḥ kathane syāt puna- ruktiḥ |
bhinnaṃ puruṣaṃ prati punarvacane tu naiva sā puna- ruktināma |
śrutisaṃyogāviśeṣāt bhinnaiḥ puruṣaiḥ saha tattacchākhāyāḥ saṃyogāt |
śrutisaṃyogasya bhinnaiḥ puruṣaiḥ saha tattacchākhāyāḥ saṃyogasya viśeṣatvāt |
tasmāt tatta- cchākhāsu agnihotrādikarmaṇaḥ bhinnaṃ puruṣaṃ prati uktiḥ na dvivacanaṃ na dviruktiḥ na punaruktiḥ |
atra vārtikam "atrāntare bhāṣyakārasya sūtraṃ aṣṭam 'vākyāsamavāyāt' iti |
edavaṃ vyākhyātavyam, 'naikasmin puruṣe śālā'ntaravākyaṃ samavaiti' iti |
tathā ca vākyasya śālā'ntaravākyasya ekasmin puruṣe asamāvāyāt saṃbandhābhāvāt paunaruktyam |
tasmāt paunaruktyābhāvādeva pūrvapakṣiṇā yaduktaṃ punaruktyā karmabheda iti tat mūlata eva nirastam |

tasya sarvasya aṅgākāṇḍasya ekasyāṃ śākhāyāmasaṃnidheḥ saṃnidhe- rabhāvāt ekaikasyāṃ śākhāyāṃ keṣāṃcideva aṅgānāṃ vidhānāt sarvāsu śākhāsu militvā ekaikaṃ karma ucyate iti sarvaśākhāpratyayamekaṃ karma |
tatra nāma punaruktā bhavati, yatra pūrvokto'rthaḥ tasyaiva puṃsaḥ saṃnihito bhavati |
na tu iha śākhā'ntaragatasya saṃnidhānaṃ ityapunaruktā' iti vārtikam |
śākhābhedeṣu ekasyāpi karmaṇaḥ punaḥpunarukteḥ karmabhedaḥ iti yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā tat nirasyati vidhāntareṇa siddhāntī |
agnihotrādi karma pratiṣṭhānaṃ naikameva puruṣaṃ prati śiṣyate vidhīyate |
kintu arthamātraṃ prati sarvaśākhāsu vidhīyamānaṃ ekamekaṃ puruṣa- mupatiṣṭhate |
tatra ekasya anekaśākhāśravaṇāt punarvacanataḥ pratiṣṭhānaṃ karmabhede ekārthatvāt samuccayānupapattau vikalpaḥ syāt |
tato varaṃ pratyabhijñā karmaikye sati śākhānāmeva puruṣavyavasthā tadāśrayaṇaṃ iti ekasya anekaśākhā- 'dhyayanāsaṃbhavāt na punaruktiḥ |
kvacit kānicidaṅgāni anyatra tato nyunāni vā adhikāni vā paṭhyante |
tatra yatra yāvat paṭhitam, tatraiva tacchākhāyāṃ tat karma samāptam |
na ca tāvatā tāvadeva tat karma iti niścetavyam |
aita- reyake hi dvādaśāhagatāni hotṛdevaya śastrāṇyukāni na maitrāvaruṇādīnām |
na ca tāvatā maitrāvaruṇādīnāṃ śākhāṇi naiva santīti vaktuṃ yuktam |
tathāca yathā samāptiḥ ani- yatā tathā saṃpraśna'pi aniyataiveti kramaprāptam |
sarvathā- 'pi samāptivat saṃpraśna'pi na karmabhediketi niścetuṃ śakyate |
( na caikaṃ prati śiṣyate samāptivat iti susaṃhitāyāṃ akārapraśleṣeṇāpi vicchedasaṃbhavaḥ |
pūrvapakṣiṇā karmabhedakāni yāni uktāni tatra nindā- 'śakti dvitrayaṃ karmabhedamādayoḥ samānatvāt nāhya bhedasādhaka-
parāṇi punarukaiḥ parastāt paṭhitāni nindā ca aśaktiśca samāptivacanaṃ ceti trīṇi karmaṇā- mekāve'pi upapannāni iti na bhedasādhakāni |
tathāhi, nahi nindā ninyaṃ nindituṃ prayujyate kiṃ tarhi ninditā- ditarat praśaṃsitum |
tatra na ninditasya pratiṣedho gamyate kintu itarasya vidhiḥ |
tatra ekasmin agnihotrahome prātaḥkālīne dvau kālau vihitau sūryodayāt prāk paścā- cceti |
tathā ekasminnapi vede asamarthānāṃ vihitaṃ kṛtsnamajñātāṃ upasaṃhartuṃ aśāktiḥ |
samarthānāṃ tu sarvaśākhābhyo'pi āgamitamadhikaṃ vidhiṃ upasaṃhartuṃ śaktirastīti |
tathā ekasmin karmaṇi kiñcidvastu samāptimiti kṛtvā samāptiśabdaḥ prayujyate |
yathā ācāryave samāse hautre vā ‘satiṣṭhate agnihotraḥ’ iti bhavati |
na ca tāvatā sarvo'gnihotraḥ samāpto bhavati |
nimittena uditānuditakālatikrameṇa yat prāyaści- muktaṃ tena karmabhedaḥ sidhyatīti yaduktaṃ tasya kaḥ parihāra iti |
athavā nimittena nimitta- viśeṣeṇa prāyaścittaṃ bhaviṣyati |
na ca tāvatā karmabheda- siddhiḥ, karmaikye'pi saṃbhavāt |
niyogena vaikalpikānāṃ padārthānāṃ prayogadau ekataranirdhāraṇenaiva prayogasya kramāt upakramāt udite hoṣyāmīti nirdhārita prakrānte prātaragnihotre udayāt prāgegānuṣṭhite sati doṣaḥ |
atra ubhayathā'pi prāyaścitta- vidhānaṃ karmaikye'pi upapadyate |
‘ekatve'pi parāṇi0’ iti sūtre (21) parāṇi iti sāmānyataḥ parihāryatvena upakṣitāni |
samāptiḥ maitrāyaṇī- yānāṃ anvārohaṇeṣu abhipramāptivacanam , yathājñāte yāvat padārthājātaṃ tacchālāyāmāmnātam , tadviṣayatayā pratīyate |
‘samāpticca saṃpraiṣā’ (20) ityatra karmaikye liṅgamupapāditam , iha tu karmaikye virodhaḥ parihṛtaḥ ityapaunaruktyam |
liṅgamevaviśiṣṭaṃ sarvaśeṣatvānnahi tatra karmacodanā, tasmāt dvādaśāhasyāhāravyapadeśaḥ syāt |
yat liṅgamuktaṃ aniṣṭaprathamomānāpi dvādaśāhasatravaditi , tat aviśiṣṭaṃ meva tathāpi anupapannam |
nahi tatra tāṇḍake aparasyāpi jyotiṣṭosya codanā upasthirasti, yena tatrajyotiṣṭomemātraviṣayaṃ prāyasyavipartha syāt |

tasmāt karmabhedapakṣe'pi aniṣṭaprathamomānāṃ dvādaśāhe darśanasya virodhāt taparihārārtham ‘yadi purā dvādaśāhrena dīdīkṣāṇāḥ , yadi purā dvādaśāhrena adīdīkṣāṇāḥ’ iti cādhyāhāreṇa dvādaśāhasya pakṣadvaye- 'pi āhārasya anubandhasya vyapadeśaḥ syāt |
dravye cācoditatvāt vidhīnāmavyavasthā syāt, nirdeśād vyavatiṣṭheta, tasmānnityānuvādaḥ syāt |
dravye vacanāmilpe vedisamitatvasya acoditatvāt codanāyā abhāvāt pakṣa- samitatvasya vidheḥ ārthikatvena, vedisamitatvasya vidheḥ sṛtikatvena avyavasthā vidhīnāṃ syāt saṃbhāvya- mānāṃ liṅ |
nanu rakṣāttarālavākyasya tarhi kāvakāśaḥ ? tatrāha- nirdeśād anabhividhye sarvastomādikṛtau yūpakā- diśinyāḥ nirdeśāt tatra vyavatiṣṭheta |
tasmāt vedisamitatvasya pāścātyantarālavyorvihita- tvāt pakṣasaṃmitāyāḥ nityānuvādaḥ syāt ‘nāntarikṣe na divi’ itivat |
atirātre vihitasya ṣoḍaśigrahaṇasya punaḥ pratiṣedhāt pakṣe grahaṇapakṣe tisṛṇām agrahaṇapakṣe ca dvayoḥ atirekaḥ syāt |
tathā ca atirātrakarmaṇaḥ amede'pi atireka- bhedaḥ saṃbhavati |

tathāhi, ṣoḍaśigrahaṇapakṣe, bahiṣpamāne nava stotriyā ṛcaḥ ; caturṣu ājyastotreṣu mādhyaṃdine pavamāne ca pañcadaśastomakātvāt militvā pañcasaptatiḥ ; pṛṣṭhastotreṣu caturṣu, ārbhave ca pavamāne saptadaśastoma- katvāt pañcāśītiḥ ; agniṣṭomastotre triṣu ukthaparyāyeṣu ṣoḍaśini ca ekaviṃśastomakātvāt pañcottaraṃ śatam , atirātrastomeṣu dvādaśasu pañcadaśastomakātvāt aśītyuttaraṃ śatam , rathaṃtare nava |
tatra sarveṣāṃ melane (9+75 +85+105+180+9=463 ) triṣaṣṭyuttaraśatacatu- ṣṭayojanatvāt daśakena bhāge datte tisraḥ avaśiṣyante |
ṣoḍaśigrahaṇābhāvapakṣe tu ekasyāḥ ṣoḍaśigrahaṇāyāḥ ekaviṃśateḥ agamane dvicatvāriṃśaduttaraśataḥ śatapajananāt daśakena bhāgadāne dve avaśiṣyete iti |
agniprathamomānāmāpi sārasvatamadarśanaṃ iti caturtha- manyārthadarśanaṃ ucchinnasti |

sārasvate sane mitrāvaruṇayo- ranāye vipratiṣedhāt, sarveṣāṃmeva jyotiṣṭomavikārāṇāṃ ṛtūnāṃ agniṣṭomapūrvatvena ‘ye puroḍāśinaḥ’ iti puroḍāśadarśanavirodhasya karmabhedamite'pi durvāratvāt sarvaireva tadbhedāvāraṇāya ‘yadā’ iti yadarthātyevaṃ syāt |
yadā paurṇamāsyāṃ puroḍāśinaḥ ; yadā amāvāsyāyāṃ sāṃnāyinaḥ ityartho vaktavyaḥ |
vārtikena natrahitaḥ pāṭhaḥ sūcitaḥ iti sudhā |
upahavye rathaṃtaravahasāmnoḥ śālādyavyavi- tayoḥ prakṛtitaḥ prāptatvāt karmabhede tattacchālādyopahavye vyavasthā tattatsiddhayarthaṃ pratiprasavaḥ punarvidhānaṃ iti pūrva- pakṣī brūte |
apratiprasavaḥ pratiprasavābhāvaḥ punarvidhānā- narthakyaṃ iti siddhāntī brūte |
yadā rathaṃtarāsāmā tadā aśvaḥ śyāvo dakṣiṇā, yadā bṛhatsāmā tadā aśvaḥ śveta uktha- lalāṭaḥ iti dakṣiṇāviśeṣarūpaguṇāyā guṇavidhānārthā punaḥśrutiḥ iti |
cāpi api iti nipātasamudāyaḥ pūrvoktaiḥ pramāṇaiḥ samuccayarthaḥ |
sarvāsvapi śākhāsu ekasyaiva karmaṇaḥ pratyayaṃ vidhānaṃ darśayati vedaḥ |
maitrāyaṇīyānāṃ samidādayaḥ prajāyā na samāmnāyante guṇāstu śrūyante ‘ṛtavo vai prajāḥ’ samānanīya hotavyāḥ |
iti tathā yeṣāṃ śākhināṃ ‘kuṭarusi’ iti asmādāmantraṇo nāmnātaḥ teṣāmapi ‘kukkuṭo'si ityaśamānamādatte, kuṭarusi iti vā’ iti |
śākhāntareṣu karmabheda eva iti pūrvapakṣī pratipādayati |
viśiṣṭaṣṭaḥ karmaṇyavasthā vidheyaparaḥ ; ekasyāṃ iti pade ca vīpsā vivakṣitā |
karmaṇāṃ krameṇa saṃyogān saṃbandhāt vidhipṛthaktvaṃ vidheyapṛthaktvaṃ karmapṛthaktvaṃ ca vyavatiṣṭheta |
mede tu svaśākhāvihitāmeva ajñānāṃ pāṭho'vihitaḥ kramaḥ |
virodhināṃ tvasaṃyogādekakarmatve tatsaṃyogād vidhīnāṃ sarvasaṃkhyeyatvam syāt |
ekakarmatve sati vidhīnāṃ sarvaśākhāsthānāṃ vidhidoktānāṃ vidheyānāmaṅgānāṃ tatsaṃyogāt tena ekena karmaṇā saṃyogā- camateḥ virodhināṃ pūrvapakṣāṇāṃ kramakālaparimāṇamānāṃ
nāmadheyaṃ śrūyamāṇaṃ lakṣaṇayā śaknoti itikartavyatāmava- nāmadheyam ' yeṣāmupacyate sve prayoge rūpo- |
codakastu upamitalakṣitaprāpaṇena ava- labdhistānī nāmāni ' ( sūtram ) |
dup. nāmadheyaṃ darvihomaśabdaḥ karmaṇaḥ, na utpattau uccāraṇotpattau sve arthe prayujyamānānām ( na tu |
bhā. 8|4|11,5-9, nāmadheyaṃ darvi- lākṣaṇikādīnām ) rūpamupalabhyate, ya

sūtraṃ tu- ekādaśadhye sukuduritaśabdānāmadheyatve parārthavat parasaṃkhyevat uddeśyatvamavamānatvaṃ pradhānatvaṃ ca svārthatvena upādeyatvaṃ vidheyatvaṃ guṇatvaṃ ceti ciddhatrikadvayāpattireva sūtritā iti pratipattavyam |
oṃ nāmadheye guṇaśruteḥ syād vidhānamiti cet |
'vājapeyena svārājakāmo yajeta' iti vājapeyaśabdaḥ kiṃ guṇavidhiḥ, karmanāmadheyaṃ veti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
nāmadheye nāmadheyatvena saṃbhāvyate vājapeyādiśabde guṇabhūteḥ guṇasya aṅgākhyasya vājasya śruteḥ tasyaiva vidhānaṃ syāt |
vājapeyaśabdo guṇavidhiḥ iti yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā tat na |

kriyayoḥ vājapeyaśabdalambyavāgādidravyakāyāḥ asyā vājapeyakriyāyāḥ darśapūrṇamāsakriyāyāśca tulyatvāt tulyatvaprasaṅgāt 'saptadaśopasatko vājapeyaḥ' 'saptadaśopasatko vājapeyaḥ' iti dīkṣopasadaśanaṃ nāmakalpet |
kutaḥ ? kriyayoḥ vājapeyakriyāyāḥ jyotiṣṭomakriyāśca tulyatvāt vājapeye dīkṣāṇāmupasadāṃ ca darśanamupapadyate |
'yajeta' iti ekādaśadhye sati tasya parārthatvaṃ uccāraṇaṃ na yukta iti tasyārthaḥ |

yajeta iti apūrvavidhicena upādeyatvena guṇatvena ca abhihitasya vāgasya, parārthavat guṇavidhānārthatvaṃ anudāttvena uddeśyatvena prādhānyena ca abhidhānaṃ na yuktaṃ viruddhatrikadvayaprasaṅgāt iti bhāvaḥ |
oṃ sarveṣveva karmanāmadheyeṣu arthamanvayena anuvādabhūto nāmaśabdo vartate na laukikārthatiraskāreṇa paribhāṣā- mātreṇa buddhiguṇavat |
evaṃ dvādaśāhaḥ iti arthānvayena nāmadheyaṃ nārthabhāvena |
oṃ nāmadheyādhikaraṇe vidhivismṛtivat nāmadheyamapi prāmāṇyadvāraṃ bhavati vā na vā iti cintyate |
oṃ vārtikakārāṇāṃ padārthopasthiteḥ padaśaktisādhatvāt tadarthaṃ sarvatra padādhyāhārāṅgīkāre'pi nāmadheyānvaye gyupapattyantarāśrayaṇamasyeva |

oṃ nāmadheyādhikaraṇa - siddhāntābhimānārthasyāpi sūtrasya ādyatvā 'tataśca anyathā kriyārthatvāsaṃbhavāt pāriśeṣyāt guṇavidhiḥ' ityādyudāhāreṇa etadadhikaraṇapūrvapakṣe'pi yojanā śakyā iti matvā tannirāsārthatvena aṣivaśabdo vyākhyātaḥ |
1 mattvarthalakṣaṇabhāvāt udbhida śabdo nāmadheyam 'udbhidā yajeta paśukāmaḥ' |
3 tātparyya- śāstrāt agnihotraśabdo nāmadheyam 'agnihotraṃ juhoti' 'samidho yajati' |
upattiśiṣṭaguṇavalī- yatvāt 'vaiśvadevena yajeta' iti vaiśvadevaśabdo nāmadheyaṃ iti kecit |
tatra hi vidhilito guṇo'nyataḥ prāptaḥ agnidevatā |
miśrāstu- yaḥ śabdo yatra karmaṇi guṇasaṃbandhaṃ bodhayati, sa cet saṃtradhaḥ śāstrāntarapratipannaḥ tadā tasya śabdasya tannāmadheyatvaṃ tadavyaśāstrāt |
oṃ nāmadheyatvena guṇavidhivaṃ bādhyate yaugika-prasaja- dvākyabheda-tanmapya-tadaṇyapadeśeṣu |
ke. nāmadheyapāde (1|4) nāmadheyānāṃ dharmapramopago'sti na vā iti iha vicārārthaḥ |
tassiddhadvaye ca eṣāṃ vidhyādiprayatnatayaḥ pāṭho'sti, uta neti cintanīyam |
ādye'dhikaraṇe (nāmadheyaprāmāṇyādhikaraṇe) guṇavidhivināmadheyatva- rūpāntaraprakaraṇe sarvapāmāpapadānāṃ prāmāṇyaṃ sādhitam |
oṃ nayanaśaktiḥ aṅgulminnā ekamapi bhinnamiva gṛhṇāti (candrādikam) |
nārikele jalaṃ kathamāyātaṃ iti na jñāyate tadvat |
yathā dṛḍhāvayavasaṃyoga- vati nārikelaphale kathaṃ jalamāyātamiti na tarkagocara- tāmeti, tathā āgatā lakṣmīrnaiva lakṣyate |
uktaṃ ca 'āgatā lakṣyate naiva nārikelaphalāmbuvat' iti |
abhiṣecanīye codakaprāpta- maṅgatvaṃ nāriṣṭhanyāyena prathamaṃ pañcāt videva- nādayaḥ kartavyāḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
oṃ nāriṣṭhahomaḥ prakṛtau pradhānahomādyarthaṃ vihitaḥ 'nāriṣṭhān homān juhoti' ityuktvāt 'daśa te tanuvo yajña yajñiyāḥ' ityādyastatra mantrāḥ |
oṃ nāriṣṭhahomāḥ sarveṣu sarvapṛṣṭheṣu pravartamānā dṛṣṭāḥ |
bhā. 8|4|1|18, nāriṣṭhahomebhyaḥ parāṅ upadromā nakṣatreṣṭhiṣu 1|2|19|19, nāriṣṭhahome'pi hi juhoticodanā 'nāriṣṭhān juhoti' iti |
8|4|1|19, nāriṣṭhahomeṣu prakaraṇena vaṣaṭkāraḥ prāpnoti tanmantra- padairaikvākyatvāt svāhākāraḥ |
oṃ nāriṣṭhahomādīnāṃ ātideśikānāṃ nakṣatre- ṣṭyādau upadiṣṭarūpahomādibhiḥ samuccayaḥ |
bhāṣyam- asti agniḥ 'ya evaṃ vidvān agniṃ cinute' iti |

tatra nakṣatreṣṭiḥ 'agnaye kṛttikabhyaḥ puroḍāśamaṣṭakapālaṃ nirvapet, so'tra juhoti agnaye svāhā, kṛttikabhyaḥ svāhā, abhrāya svāhā, nitantyai svāhā, abhrayantyai svāhā, meghantyai svāhā, varṣantyai svāhā, cupuṇīkāya svāhā' iti |
santi tu prakṛtau nāriṣṭhahomāḥ : 'nāriṣṭhān homān juhoti' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ nāriṣṭhahomānāṃ nivṛttiḥ, athavā anirvṛttiḥ samuccaya iti |
tathā iyene śrūyate 'lohitoṣṇīṣā lohitavasanā nivītā ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti' iti |
asti prakṛtau 'nīvītaṃ manuṣyāṇām, prācīnāvītaṃ pitṛṇām, upavītaṃ devānām, upavyayate devatvameva tat kurute' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kimupavītasya nivṛttiḥ, uta anirvṛttiḥ samuccaya iti |
tathā pṛṣṭhye ṣaḍahe śrūyate 'madhyādhayetaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā' iti |
asti tu prakṛtau 'payo vrata brāhmaṇasya, yavāgū rājanyasya, āmikṣā vaiśyasya' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ, kiṃ tasya nivṛttiḥ utānirvṛttiḥ samuccayaḥ |
pratyakṣaśrutā upahomādayaḥ codakaprāptānāṃ ānumānikānāṃ nivartakā iti |
apica prakṛtiliṅgasaṃyogo bhavati juhoti, nivītāḥ pracaranti, āśayet iti |
na bādhante, evaṃ nāriṣṭahomānapi na bādheran |
sa hi pratyakṣadarśanena vā bhavati yathā ‘naivāraścaḥ’ |
abhāve vidhānena vā bhavati yathā ‘juhvā vā etāīṃ vāg bhavati, yahiṃ puṣyaḥ padahaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate, na bahu vadet, nānyaṃ pṛcchet, nānyasmai pratibrūyāt, madhvāśayet ghṛtaṃ vā’ iti |
khaśabdena vā bhavati yathā ‘paridhau paśuṃ niyuñjīta’ iti |
pratiṣedhena vā bhavati yathā ‘na girāgiriti brūyāt, yada girāgiriti brūyāt ātmānaṃ taddātā giret, etaṃ kṛṇodveyam’ iti |
tatrakālatvāt atra śabdabalena pradhānottarabhāvināmeṣāṃ samānasthānakatvena ekakāryajanakatvāttaḥ upadiṣṭarūpomeḥ nāriṣṭhahomānāṃ atidiṣṭānāṃ śaravat bādhaḥ iti prāpte |

śarā hi barhiḥśabdalakṣitaistatkāryai vihitāḥ yuktaṃ yat tatkāryapṛṣṭhabhāvena prāpyamānaṃ barhirdharmāt, upahomāstu nāriṣṭhahomākāryatvenā ityatra na kiñcit pramāṇamasti, pratyakṣādestāvat adṛṣṭārtheṣu apravṛtteḥ |

na ca samāna- sthānakatvāt ekakāryatvāttaḥ upahomātrākye atideśa- prāpitanāriṣṭhakāryasya upasthāpakapadābhāvena anuddeśyatvāt taduddeśena upahomavidhivyapattīteḥ atideśena kāryadravyabhāvena nāriṣṭhanāmāpi prāpyapyapyatastat śaranyāyavailakṣyeṇa samāna- sthānakatvamātrasya aprayojakatvāt |
na ca upahomāvākye karmāntaravidhāveva pramāṇābhāvaḥ, nāriṣṭhānuvādenaiva mantra- vidhānopapatteḥ iti vācyam |
ekaṃ hīdaṃ vākyaṃ itikaraṇena taittirīyaśāstrājñātena mantrāṇāṃ juhotāveva anvayapratīteḥ |

ata eva svāhākārāntānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ liṅgādeva nāriṣṭhahome viniyogaprasaktau punaḥ viniyogāntaravaiyarthyaprasaṅgādapi karmāntaram, tacca eka- vākyopādānādavagatasahākārāntamantrasamuccayabalena anekaṃ āśaṅkate vā ityanyadetat |
na ca tathāpi upadiṣṭahomaireva vikṛteḥ nirākāṅkṣatvāt atideśakalpakatvābhāvena nāriṣṭhā- prāptiḥ |
upahomānāṃ aklṛptopakārakatayā upakārakā- kakṣiṇyā vikṛtyā prathamaṃ atideśikasyaiva grahaṇena nāriṣṭhānāṃ prāpyapyapyateḥ |
ata eva upahomādīnāṃ vaikṛtānāṃ anyatarākāṅkṣayaiva grahaṇaṃ anupasthitaphalāntarakalpane gauravāt |
ata eva yatra klṛptopakārakaprākṛtāne punaḥ- śravaṇaṃ vikṛtiprakaraṇe, yathā gameṣṭīyayājyādau tatraiva vikṛteḥ nirākāṅkṣatvāpādanena atideśalopaḥ |

yat atra bhāṣyakāreṇa śyene 'nīvītā ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti' ityāmnānena prayogāṅgabhūtakartṛsaṃskārakeṇa nīvītena atideśaprāptasya sarvakarmārthatvena vihitasya cogravītasya bādhamāśaṅkaya adṛṣṭārthatvāt samuccaya iti siddhāntitam |

tadasya adṛṣṭārthatve śrāddhādāvapi prācīnāvītena saha upavītasya samuccayapatteḥ yāvajjīvaikaśrutivattanavatakasyo- pavītadhāraṇāśritaprakāraviśeṣasya upavītatvānivītatvādeḥ tattatkarmajñatayā vihitasya samuccayasaṃbhavāt upekṣitam |
yadyapi 'saṃsthite baddhe madhyāśayet' iti vihita- madhyāśanena prākṛtaprayogavat tasminnahani nivṛttimāśaṅkaya adṛṣṭārthatvādeva samuccaya ityuktam |
ci. 1|4|120. nāśa: kāraṇalayaḥ' iti nyāyena pralaye'pi prapañcasya sadāmakatvena sthityupadeśāt |
idamadhikaraṇam 'darśapūrṇamāsādī svekṛtādiśeṣakāryārthamattasya dravyasya nāro śeṣakāryālopaḥ' ityatra (mīko. pṛ. 2073) draṣṭavyam |
'yasya puroḍāśau kṣāyataḥ ityatra ekadeśakṣaṇe tu prāktananāśādhikaraṇanyāyena (6|4|12) ājyena dagdhāvaśiṣṭena vā prayogasamāptimātram |
bhāṭṭa. 6|4|15. nāstikaiḥ 'agnihotraṃ trayo vedāstridaṇḍaṃ bhasma- guṇṭhanam |
su. pṛ. 135. nikāntaḥ nitarāṃ kāntaḥ nitāntaṃ priyaḥ |
ke. 2|3|16-17. nikāyaḥ iti saṃghātaḥ auttarādhreṇāvasthita ucyate |
bhā. 8|1|12|19. nikāyaḥ ekena śabdena yugapadāpādanalakṣaṇaḥ saṃghaḥ |
su. pṛ. 860. nikāyināṃ ca pūrvasyottareṣu pravṛttiḥ syāt |
(8|1|12|19) ityādimanyāyāt atidiṣṭa- pūrvāgniṣṭudharmakāṇām atra paśvarthamanuṣṭhānaṃ iti siddhānte prayojanam |
kastūri. 2|1|12|16. nikāyināṃ ca pūrvasyottareṣu pravṛttiḥ syāt |
sa yeṣāṃ te nikāyinaḥ sāhasrāḥ sādhyasrkāḥ |
tatra nikāyināṃ madhye pūrvasya pūrva paṭhitasya pravṛttiḥ uttareṣu nikāyiṣu syāt |
punarapi sāhasrāṇāṃ sahasradakṣiṇāsāmānyāt sādhyasrkāṇāṃ ca satyakaraṇasāmānyāt |

atha nigadā nāma kiṃ yajūṃṣi ? uta yajurmoḍanye ? iti ṛksāmayajuḥ śabdapadeṣu nirūpiteṣu nigadānāmanu- prasaṅgenaiva 'uccairnigadena' ityevamādidevavākyagata- nigadapadāryau nirūpyate |
atrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣo'bhisaṃdhiḥ: 'upāṃśu yajuṣā' iti yajuṣāmupāṃśudharmaśālitvaṃ pratīyate |
vidhivi sati 'upāṃśu yajuṣā' iti sāmānyaśāstraprāpta- mupāṃśutvaṃ 'uccairnigadena' iti viśeṣaśāstreṇa bādhanīyam |

tena 'brāhmaṇebhyo dadhi dīyatāṃ takraṃ kauṇḍinyāya' ityatra kauṇḍinyagatabrāhmaṇatvasya pramāṇāntarasiddhatvāt bhavat gatyantarāsaṃbhavena bādhaḥ; yajuṣaśca pramāṇāntarasiddhatvāt 'śepe yajuḥśabdaḥ' iti lakṣaṇasya ṛksāmanigadadoṣaparatvenāpi saṃbhavāt tribhyo'- nyatvenaiva upapatterna bādhasaṃbhavaḥ |
na ca yajuṣe'pi parasaṃjñārūpatvena nigadānāṃ arthaprāptamuccaistvam 'uccai- rnigadena' ityevamate |
yajuṣṭve sati vācanikanopāṃśutvena arthaprāpta uccaistvasya bādhitatvāt anuvādāsaṃbhavāt |
kiñca, vyapadeśabhedāt abhimuktānāṃ dṛśyate 'nigadā vartante na yajūṃṣi, atha yajūṃṣi na nigadāḥ' iti |
ato na yajūṃṣi nigadāḥ, kintu caturthameva nigadā iti mantranāmatviti |
ayamabhiprāyaḥ, bhavedevaṃ yadi 'uccairnigadena' ityatra anuvādo na saṃbhavet |
na ca yajuṣe sati arthaprāpta- muccaistvaṃ upāṃśutvavidhina bādhitāt nānucyate iti vācyam |
tathāhi, 'agnīn vihara barhistṛṇādi' ityevarūpā hi nigadāḥ |
na ca upāṃśutvena uccāryyamāṇāḥ tathā bhavanti |
ato'yamupāṃśuvidhiḥ nigadetarayajurviṣaya eveti na tena bādhitatvāt uccaistvasya saṃbhavaḥ |
'ahe budhniya mantraṃ me gopāya yamṛṣayalevidā viduḥ |
ṛcaḥ sāmāni yajuṣi' ityucce yajuṣi sāmānyetyameva vede triṣveva ṛgyajuḥsāmasu mantratvamupapannaṃ bhavati |
ataḥ apādabaddhatvāt agītitvācca pariśeṣasiddhayajurlakṣaṇayogāt yajuṣyeva nigadāḥ |
bhāṣyam-- asti ca taiḥ puruṣāntareḥ pratyāyitaiḥ prayojanam |
yāni ca yajūṃṣi uccairuccā- ryante, te nigadāḥ |
eṣa eva hi prakarṣaḥ; yadyuccaistvāvacchinna- tvam |
guṇo nāma sa bhavati, yaḥ svakāryaṃ kurvatāmupakāre vartate |
na ca parasaṃśodhanārthanāṃ yajuṣāmāpāṃśutvaṃ sāhāyye vartate |
irāṇiyāni yajūṃṣi na parasaṃbodhanārthāni, teṣu upāṃśutvaṃ niveśyate |
vā-- asti ca 'amīt amīn vihara' ityādi- vacanena arthaḥ anyathā anuṣṭhānānupapatteriti dharmaviśeṣa- prāptiḥ |
vācanikamapi na upāṃśutvamanupakāratvena anaṅgatvāt nigadavyatirekayajurviṣayaṃ vijñāyate |
bhāṣyam-- atha yaduktaṃ vyapadeśa iti, sa caikatve- 'pi guṇato bhavati |
evamuccaistvena guṇena tānyeva yajūṃṣi vyapadiśyante nigadā iti |
bhāṣyam-- yadi ya uccairgaicate sa nigadaḥ, ṛgapi nigadaḥ prāpnoti |
bhāṣyam-- na ṛco nigadā iti vyapadiśyante |
'ayājyaḥ vai nigadā ṛcaiva yajanti' iti pṛthaktda- nimittā hi vyapadeśā bhavanti |
apādabaddhe gaditarvartate, apādabaddho hi gadya ityucyate |
vā-- na tāvadatiprasaṅgo'sti, nigadaṃ ninditvā ṛco vidhānāt |
nahi tameva ninditvā tasyaiva vidhirava- kalpate |
'sarvāṇi yajūṃṣi' iti vācaḥ stome pāriplavaśaṃsane vini- yogaśca |
sūtrārthastu- nigadaśrutyai mantrajātaṃ syādeva uccaistvarūpadharmaviśeṣāt iti |
iti prāpte, 'ṛcaḥ sāmāni yajūṃṣi' iti vede śrayāṇāmeva mantrabhedānāṃ saṃkīrtanāt ' mantra eva khalvayaṃ nigadabhūto bhavati tasmāccaḥ' |
( patrā. 1-2) iti ca liṅgāt nigadānāṃ yajuṣṭvameva |
na ca dharmabhedāt bhedaḥ, viśeṣavihitena uccaistvena sāmānyavihitasya upāṃśu- tvasya anyaparatvātsyāt |
'upāṃśu yajuṣā' ityasya vedopakramānurodhena yajurvedavihitakarmārthe upāṃśuvidhāya- katvasya vakṣyamāṇatvena bhavante'pi saṃkocasyāvaśyaka- tvācca |
na caivamupakramatvena yajuḥpade vedalakṣaṇāt nigadapade'pi yajurvedalakṣaṇatvāpatteḥ |
ekasmin karmaṇi dharmadvaya- vikalpatvāt, 'vāyoryajurvedaḥ' ityupakramasya yajuḥpade eva lakṣaṇatvātparyāyagrāhakatayā |
ataśca 'uccairnigadena' iti svatantra eva niryathādako'uccaistvaniyamavidhiḥ viśeṣa-
teṣu hi parapratyāyanarūpakārya- vaśena upāṃśutvanivṛttāvapi mandānyanekasrapāto uccaistva- niyamo nānupapannaḥ |
' 16. nigadādhikaraṇe niyamavidhilāghavānusārāt 'upāṃśu yajuṣā' iti vākyaṃ nigadātiriktayajurviṣayaṃ ityaṅgī- kṛtam |

nanu yāva jīvādivākyeṣu nimitta- śrutyā tasmin sati avaśyakartavyatvāt akaraṇe ca tadirodhāt tadaṅgena aṅgīnasyāpi phalasādhanatvāt tathaivānuṣṭhīyate|
kāmye tu evaṃ virodhābhāvāt sarvāṅgo- pasaṃhāreṇa anuṣṭhānam|
'yo yāvanti upasaṃhartuṃ samarthaḥ, tasya tāvannidreva phalasiddhiḥ' iti yadi ucyate, tarhi kāmye'pi svargakāmānāmasya adhikārāvagateḥ tathaivānuṣṭhāna- prasaṅgaḥ|
yadi ca nimittatvena aṅgopasaṃhāraḥ syāt, tataḥ śuddhasya anāhitāgneḥ āhitāgnīnāṃ ca vidyāvihiṇāṃ tadyatiriktakāṅgānāṃ śālināmāpi adhikāraḥ syāt|
ata eva pañcamādhyāyāt paraṃ adhikāranirūpaṇam, śakyapekṣatvāt- dhikārasya, śakteśca śakyalakṣaṇayādhīnanirūpaṇatvāt, tasya ca adhyāyapañcakena avadhāraṇāt|
etena jñāpyajñāpakabhāvaṃ saṃbandhaṃ nirākṛtya avasaralakṣaṇaṃ adhikārasya ācakṣāṇāḥ|
tat ubhayatrāpi (nitye kāmye ca) sarvāṅgopasaṃhāraḥ iti|
tacca kṛtadhīnāmalabham, kṛtaśca evaṃvidhepu puruṣaprayatna eva|
yo hi 'madarthamidaṃ karma, ahamatra svāmī' iti vijānāti, sa tat anutiṣṭhati nānyaḥ|
taddhi karma tvaṃ bhavati, yat yasya kārye sādhayati|
tena 'mamedaṃ kāryam' ityevaṃ kāryamedhasya tatsādhane karmaṇi puruṣasya adhikārāvagamaḥ|
yaśca kārye svīkīyatvena budhyate, sa niyojyaḥ|
na ca apūrve kārye sukhaduḥkhaparihāratvaṃ kasyacit icchāgocaraḥ|
yataḥ pramāṇāntareṇaiva tadarthinaḥ kāryavāgamāttāhāne karmaṇi adhikāraḥ syāt|
tadevaṃ niyojyāpekṣaṃ kāryaṃ, sa ca anupādeyaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaḥ|
tatra phalamanupatthaṃ na svarūpeṇa viśeṣaṇībhavitumarhati iti svakāmamukhena niyojyaṃ viśinaṣṭi|
phalakāmaśca ucyate, yaḥ phala- mātmanaḥ sādhayitumicchati|
sa ca tadeva kārye budhyate, yat svakāma'nuguṇamiti|
('nanu apūrvasa phalaṃ prati janakatvena anvaye viśeṣaṇatā''pannasya niyogaḥ eva pradhānaṃ vākyārthaḥ iti siddhāntāsiddhiḥ iti|
pradhānasyāpi niyogasya svasiddhayartho yaḥ phalakāmanāvaśiṣṭaniyogena saṃbandhaḥ, tadarthaṃ phalānu- kulyamāstheya svīkāryamityarthaḥ|
tacca kāryaṃ pradhānasaṃpādyam, prayatnasya anavacchinnasya anirūpaṇāt tadavacchedakamapekṣate|
avacchedakaśca prāyeṇa bhāvārthaḥ, tathaiva svarūpeṇa tatsaṃbandhatvāt|
na khalu alpadhapākādibhāvāvarthaviṣayaḥ prayatno loke dṛśyate; kvacicca śabdavaśena dravyadevatāsaṃbandhatvādiḥ bhāvārthanirvāhahetūprayala- saṃbandhaḥ avacchedako bhavati|
tadevaṃ kāryasya kṛtyavacchinna- tvāt, kṛteśca bhāvāvārthavacchedakatvamantareṇa apratīteḥ kṛtipraṇāḍikayā kāryasya bhavati bhāvāvārthaḥ avacchedakaḥ|
anavacchinnaṃ ca kāryaṃ prayatetumaśakyamiti tadavacchedakaṃ tapradītyanubandhitayā bhavati viṣayaḥ|
sa ca bhāvārthaḥ kāmanā'nuguṇasya kāryasya viṣayābhāvāt puraskṛta- kāmopāyābhavaḥ śakyaḥ abhigantumiti upāyatvena rūpeṇa viṣayībhavati|

tadupāyatā ca nikhilāṅgāmaṃpratipāditopa- kārasya, iti ajñānuṣaṅgātikrame samastāṅgajyopa- kārasya asaṃpatteḥ upāyatvābhāve viṣayatvābhāvāt vipathi- go'pi kāryasya apratīteḥ na taddhalena hīnāṅgāmaṃnuṣṭhānaṃ bhavet|
nahi tatra phalakāmo niyojyaḥ, yena anupādyaṃ kāryatayā na budhyeta|
pratītasaviṣayakāryasya kṛti vinā kāryābhāvāt kṛteśca akaraṇikāyā asaṃbhavāt karaṇa- mapekṣamāṇaḥ saṃhitasya bhāvāvārthasya viṣayībhūtasya karaṇā- mupakalpayati|
kathaṃ punaḥḥ kṛtinirvarthya eva bhāvāvārthaḥ tāṃ prati karaṇaṃ iti cet, tadavacchinnāyāstasyāḥ tadapūrva- viśeṣakṛtitvāt tadvidhasya ca loke karaṇavaprasiddheḥ|
tathāhi, yathā hetuḥ udyamananipātalakṣaṇā kriyā paraśu; nyāyamāno'pi tāmeva prati karaṇam, tadvidhā- yāstasyāḥ dvaidhībhāvaphalatvāt|
nahi loheviṣaye udyamana- nipātane dvaidhībhāvaṃ phalataḥ|
evaṃ yadyapi kṛtvā bhāvāvārtho vyāpyate, tathāpi apūrvaviśeṣakṛtitaṃ tasyāḥ tadviṣayatvādhīna iti yukta eva karaṇabhāvo bhāvāvārthasya|

tadevaṃ nitye vidhīya- bhūtasya bhāvāvārthasya paścāt karaṇatvaṃ iti kartavyatāsāhityaṃ ca tasya pratīyate, iti nāṅgopale'pi viṣayābhāvaḥ, tataśca sādhane karmaṇi adhikārapratīteḥ taddhalena hīnāṅgamapi
karma anuṣṭhāpayati niyogaḥ vaikṛtaḥ iva pratyāmnātaprati- biddhasādhryātiriktāṅgānuṣṭhānaṃ iti siddhaḥ kāmya- nityaviśeṣaḥ |
tadetat āpātakalyāṇaṃ sūkṣmanāyadṛṣṭyā nipuṇaṃ nirūpyamāṇaṃ ārakūṭāyate |
viprakṛṣṭaṃ hi padāntaropapāṃ phalaṃ bhāvārthasya, saṃnikṛṣṭaṃ tu svapadopāttapūrvam |
tatra viprakṛṣṭena prathamaṃ sādhanatayā anvīya viprakṛṣṭareḥ vākyā- ntaropāttaiḥ saṃbadha tadanvitena rūpeṇa svapadapratipādya- mapūrvaṃ paścādavacchinatti iti kaḥ śrutivākyavallabhatvaḥ amidīta |
yadyapi kāmopāyasya kāryasya viṣayabhīmato bhāvārthasya tatsādhanatvamavaśyamabhāvi, tathāpi na tat prathamaṃ nirūpayitavyam |
nahi yena vinā yad vastu nopapadyate, tannirūpaṇaparaḥsameva tat vastu pratyetavyam, pratipanne'pi ca vastuni tadupapādakaṃ vastu paścādapi pratīyate eva dhūme iva dhūmadhvajaḥ |
'yathāśakti brīhīna saṃpādayat yathāśakti vā avahanyāt' iti|
āhavanīyādirūpaṃ tu na anena vidhinā upā- dīyate|
yadyapi homaṃ prāpyadāyete svarūpaṃ tu nopādīyate, tatra yadi āhitāmiḥ āhavanīye juhuyāt, itaraśca yatra- kacit iti vidhīyate, tato vairūpyaṃ prasajyeta|
naca 'yathā- śakti āhavanīyaṃ saṃpādya juhuyāt' iti ubhayasādhā- raṇyena vidhānaṃ saṃbhavati, āhavanīyādisaṃpādanasya atrā- rthādapi brīhmādisaṃpādanavat vidhānāt|
tena āhavanīya- manāhatyaiva homamātramanuṣṭhāpyeta, āhavanīyatāṃ vā adhikṛtya āhavanīye homaḥ|
yāvajjīvaśabdasya tadīya- jīvane'pi kṛtārthatvena atyantapīḍā'bhāvāt, 'agnimān jīvan juhuyāt' ityevābhipretam|
nanu evaṃ advāntare'pi kimiti jīvanaṃ no
akasmāt vinā kāraṇaṃ prāptaṃ dhāraṇa binā 'na.pratisamidhyet, yat pratisamidhyati bhrātṛvya- masmai janayati' iti śrutvā kṛtaḥ pratiṣedho nahi naiva syāt |
tasmāt nityadhāraṇādhāraṇayorvikalpaḥ syāt iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
gataśriyaḥ : nityadhāraṇāt 'ghāyoṃ vā na veti' iti śrutvā gataśriyaḥ nityadhāraṇavidhānāt ghāraṇaṃ prāptam |
evaṃ sati 'na pratisamidhyet' iti śrutvā pratiṣedha upapadyate |
nityanaimittikobhyārthaṃ dadhyādi, 'dadhnā juhoti' 'dadhnendriyakāmasya juhuyāt', 'khādire paśuṃ badhnāti' 'khādiraṃ vīryakāmasya yūpaṃ kuryāt' iti |
nityatve pāpakṣayasya bhāgyatvam 'dharmeṇa pāpa- mapanudati' ityādivākyebhyaḥ pratīyate |
na ca kasyācit vaidhaka- saṃhitāyāṃ laukikaḥ : apratigrahaḥ nidānaṃ śrūyate, nāpi pratyakṣānumānādibhirgamyate |
... (tatra) hīp iti vṛddhikāmāya nidhanaṃ kuryāt, ūrk ityannakāmāya, ū iti svargakāmāya' iti |
vā. 2|1|3|28 pṛ. 563. nidhanaṃ udgātṛstotupratihartṛbhiḥ sarvairgāṃtavyaḥ antima- sāmāvayavaḥ |
ke. nidhanaṃ nāma pañcabhiḥ saptabhirvā mārgeṇopetasya sāmnaḥ antimo bhāgaḥ |
'jyoti- ṣṭome puroḍāśaśakalaṃ aindrāvāyavyasya pātre nidadhāti, dhānā āśvinapātre, payasyāṃ maitrāvaruṇapātre' |
atra puroḍāśā- dayaḥ prakṛtā eva grāhyāḥ |
bhā. 3|8|28|134. ninayanamantarvedi, praṇītānāmapāṃ na prayojakam, kintu pratipattiḥ |

ke. 4|2|16|14-15. abhighāraṇasya kevalahaviḥsaṃskārārthatvāt ninayana- kālīnapuroḍāśakalpanāyena (4|1|12|26) śeṣopādānāprayojakatve'pi dhāraṇaprayojakatvopapattiḥ (puro- ḍāśakapālanyāya evāyaṃ ninayanakālīnate avivakṣitam- ke.) |
bhāṣyam-- darśapūrṇamāsayorāmnāyate, 'apaḥ praṇa- yati āpo vai śraddhā, śraddhāmevā''labhya yajate' iti |
ubhayatra ca praṇītānāmutthānāṃ vyāpāraḥ śrūyate, 'praṇītā- mirhavīṣi saṃyeti' iti, tathā 'antarvedi praṇītā ninayati' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ : kimubhayamāsāṃ prayojakaṃ saṃyavanaṃ ninayanaṃ ca, uta saṃyavanārthānāṃ ninayanaṃ pratipattiriti |
ki prāptam ? utpattyasaṃyogo nāsāṃ kenacit prayojane |
agamyamāne viśeṣe, ubhayārthānāṃ vibhāgo'yam, kaścidbhāgaḥ saṃyavane, kaścinninayane iti |
yathā 'sarvasme vā etad yajñāya gṛhyate yad dhruvāyā- mājyam' iti |
ḍup- śaṅkā : (kenacidapi prayojanena asaṃyuktāḥ) praṇītā utpannāḥ kairmyābhilāṣiṇī? vākyadvayena ( 'praṇītāmirhavīṣi saṃyeti', 'antarvedi praṇītā
nanu saṃyavane tṛtīyānirdeśāt guṇabhāvaḥ (atastadeva praṇītānāṃ prayojakam) ninayane tu dvitīyānirdeśāt prādhānyam (iti aprayojakaṃ ninayanam) |
vacanāntareṇa (anyatra pūrvam) śeṣabhāve avagate (sati, paścāt) anyatra saṃyoge (sati) bhavati prati- pattiḥ |
(kiñca kevala-) saṃyavanā- rthānāṃ ca tāvatīnāmeva grahaṇaṃ prāpnoti, yāvatībhiḥ saṃyacanaṃ niṣpadyate, kuto'nyatra prasaṅgaḥ |
nanu śrīvājyavat sarvārthatvaṃ gamyate, tat kathamubhayārthatvamucyate, tannāha-- ) sarvāyāṃ iti pakṣo na kṛtaḥ, niṣpannānatvāt |
) kalpyamāne'pi prakaraṇasaṃbandhāt tatra ca anyatra ca prāptāḥ, punaḥ (saṃyavananinayanayoḥ-) vacanāt (anyebhyaḥ) parisaṃkhyāyeva |
saṃyavane apāṃ guṇabhāvaḥ, dvitīyānirdeśācca ninayane prādhānyam |
cintāyāḥ prayojanaṃ puroḍāśābhāve praṇītānāmabhāvaḥ yathā payasyāyām |
yattu tāvatīnāmeva grahaṇaṃ prāpnoti ityu- ktam |
tasmāt atiriktasya pratipattiḥ, na tu atirekathitvaṃ iti śāstramasti |
(kutaḥ ?) alpe hi gṛhyamāṇe saṃyavanasya akṛtatvāt (sarvapiṣṭa- saṃyavanasya akṛtatvasaṃbhavāt) punaḥ praṇītānāṃ saṃskāraḥ kartavyaḥ iti gauravamapi |
soma- śākhāyā upayuktatvāt praharaṇasya prati- pattive'pi ninīyamānānāmapi anyatropayuktābhāvāt ninayanaṃ na pratipattiḥ iti pratyavasthānāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu- utpattau kāryaviśeṣāsaṃyogato praṇītānāṃ śrīvājyasyeva anekatra vibhajya viniyogaḥ syāditi |
apāṃ dve prāpte kiṃvā haviḥsaṃyavanaṃ tathā |
, atha : praṇayatītyukteḥ samātadvābhyārthatā, śrutvā saṃyavanā- rthatāḥ : ninītaiḥ pratipattiḥ |

bhāṭṭa- tatraiva 'apaḥ praṇayati' ityanena vihita- praṇayanasaṃskṛtānāmapāṃ 'praṇītāmirhavīṣi saṃyeti' iti vacanena saṃyavanārthatvavat ante 'antarvedi praṇītā ninayati' iti ninayanārthatvenāpi viniyogādubhaya- prayuktatvam |
na ca ninayanavākye'pi dvitīyānirdeśāt pratipattivākyād, kuśalenācāryeṇa vākyadvayena viniyoga- nāmeṣāṃ praṇayane śeṣābhāvāt pratipattitvānupapatteḥ |
ataḥ : saguṇanyāyena ninayanasya arthakatvānna prayojaka- tvam |
atra ca āgneyādihaviḥ pāka- stathaiva saṃyavanoderatā |
ata eva abhyuditaihau dadhipayasopi praṇītā vakṣyante |
vastutastu kapālaṃ prati śodhamajanyapākena piṇḍasaṃyavanatveva uddeśyatvā, atiprasaṅgadharmeṇa tadṅgīkāre pramāṇābhāvāt |
vidhiparā tu stutyārthā jāyate, tadupapādanasya dṛṣṭārthatvāt |
vā. 12|2|121. nindāyāḥ kasyā- ścit taditarastutau paryavasānam, kasyāścit vidhivṛtti- pūrvakamanindāyā api sahaiva vidhivṛttibhyāmitarastutau paryavasānam |
yathā 'devadattastāvadatīva vidvān' ityuktvā 'na tasya bṛhaspatirapi samānaḥ' iti ca stutvā 'so'pi yadyadatamapekṣya avidvān' ityukteḥ sarvasyā api yadyadastutau paryavasānam |
su. pṛ. 1|71. nindāpadavācyaṃ aprāśastyaṃ nāma kalavadaniṣṭhā- vandhitvayogyam |
tayo- rarthābhidhāne hi vyāpāro naiva vidyate |
yadarthadyotako to tu vācakaḥ sa vicāryate |
' vā. 1|3|133 pṛ. 306. nipātaḥ vācakaḥ ityekaḥ pakṣaḥ dyotaka ityaparaḥ |
rahasya. pṛ. 64-66. nipātasya upapadā- rthānvayyupapattiḥ siddhā |
su. pṛ. 311. nipātopasargeṣu liṅga- saṃkhyārāhityaṃ kāryatvaṃ ca |
rahasya. pṛ. 10. nima-ntraṇaṃ ājñāpanaṃ nīcasya pravartanam |
pṛ. 75. nimantraṇaṃ āvaśyaka śrāddhādau niyoga- karaṇam |
( āvaśyaka śrāddhabhojanādau dauhitrādeḥ pravartanam iti sa. kaumudī |
) maṇi. pṛ. 117. nimittamanupādeyaṃ tasya karmabhedakatvam, udāharaṇaṃ tu 'satrāyāgūrya viśvajitā yajeta' 'sāmudhyāne viśvajit' ityādi |
vā. 2|3|12|25 pṛ. 617. nimittamucyate saptamyā vā yadyuktena vā yadiśabdena vā |
ṭup. 4|4|121. nimittaṃ ca nāma taducyate, yasmin sati naimittikaṃ bhavatyeva |
kaṇikā. pṛ. 333. nimittaṃ deśaḥ kālaḥ phalaṃ saṃskārya ityanu- pādeyadhammakam |
bāla. pṛ. 88. nimittaṃ saptamyante- nocyate yathā 'minne juhoti' iti |
ṭup. 1|1| 1|12 pṛ. 2098. anupādīyamānaṃ hi nimittaṃ ityucyate |
yadi ca yasyāpi nimittam, so'pyudiśyeta, tatra dvayo- kadviśayamānayoḥ saṃścayaḥ eva na syāt |
bhā. 6|4|4|13. yaśca bhāvapratyayārthaḥ, sa prātipadikasya viśeṣye vartamānasya nimittam |
yacca nimittaṃ tat viśeṣaṇatvāt mukhyamabhidheyam, lākṣaṇikaṃ viśeṣyam |
vā. 3|6|12 pṛ. 674. nimittena pūrveṇa bhavitavyaṃ uttareṇa naimittikeneti naitanniyogataḥ |
bhavati hi bhaviṣya- dapi hi nimittam |
bhā. 2|3|12 pṛ. 577. nimittasya anuṣṭhāpakatvāttvoddeśyatve'pi īpsitatvādyeyatvā- bhāvā
janyadoṣanāśataraphalasaṃvalitapuruṣādhikāravidhiḥ 'vaiśvā- naraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet putre jāte' ityārabhya 'yasmin jāte etāmiṣṭiṃ nirvapati pūta eva tejasvī' ityādyantaḥ jāteṣṭividhiḥ|
pṛ. 15. nimittataḥ: vācaniko vyavasthitavikalpo yathā 'dantajāte ekāheḥ, anujātaṃ apatyaṃ yassāṣṭāhe vyahaḥ, kṛtacūḍe caturaheḥ, upanīte daśāheḥ' iti virodhāvi- karaṇe vārtikakṛttaḥ|
bāla. pu. 160, nimittataḥ: vācaniko vyavasthitavikalpo yathā 'daśāhaṃ śāvamaśaucaṃ sapiṇḍeṣu vidhīyate|
' pṛ. 160, nimittataḥ: vācanikī vyavasthā yathā 'yadi rathaṃtarasāmā somaḥ syādandra- vāyavāgrān mahān gṛhṇīyāt, yadi vṛhatsāmā śukrāgrān' iti|
pṛ. 19, nimittataḥ: viśeṣagrahaṇaṃ vaiśyanimittakaṣāṣṭadasyena nityapāñcadasyasya prasaṅgasiddhau|
pṛ. 147, nimittataḥ: vyavasthāpaḥ pratiṣedho yathā 'smārtakarmaparityāgo rāhorevanna sutake' iti|
pṛ. 35. yacca yat pratīya upajāyate tatra tasya nimittatvaṃ ityavadhāryate|
vi. 2|1|1 varṇakaṃ 3. prāk siddhi vinā nimittatvāyogāt|
'yāvajjīvaṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta' yāvacchabdaḥ sāmastyaṃ vadan nimittapakṣe patitaḥ 'nimitta0 nyāyena' jīvanagata- āmastyasya naimittikasaṃbandhatvena prāptatvāt svārthānuvādako bhavati|
nimittasaṃpāto yatra bhavati tatra kiṃ anya- nimittako bhakṣaḥ samuccīyate atha vikalpyate athavā bādhyate iti vicāraḥ|
soma. 1|2|1 pṛ. 2. yena vinā nimittapratītirna paryavasyati tadeva nimittasvarūpāntargatam, itarattu prathamāvagatamapi ana- pekṣitātvāt avikṣitam|
anyatra pravṛttasya janmā- ntarīyadhanānādirūpacitapravāhasya nimnagāpravāhenanyāyena anyatra nayane atileśaḥ|
yathā nadīpravāhitaḥ kīṭādyā āvartādāvartantaramāśu vrajantaḥ śarma na labhante, tathā janmatoṃ janma vrajanto jīvāḥ svakarmabhrāntāḥ sukhaṃ naiva labhante|
uktaṃ ca pañcadaśyām 'kurvate karma bhogāya karma kartuṃ ca bhuñjate|
vrajanto janmano janma labhante naiva nirvṛtim|
sāhasī. 151. nimnatvaka candanagandhatveva abhyadhikā, na tu gandhāntarāṇām|
ku. 1|1|6|13. niyatanimittakaṃ naimittikaṃ vaidikaṃ karma, yathā 'yāvajjīvamagnihotraṃ juhoti' 'vasantevasante jyotiṣā yajeta'|
bāla. pṛ. 85, niyatanimittakaḥ naimittika- puruṣādhikāravidhiḥ 'yāvajjīvamagnihotraṃ juhuyāt' iti|
niyamo'pi (yāvajjīvābhyāsa rūpaḥ) na karma- dharmaḥ, kartṛparvā'sau ityuktam 'karturvā śrutisaṃyogāt' iti (2|4|12) |

ṛtvigyākyena śuddhavaraṇavidhī ṛtvigadānadheyatvāpatteḥ ekenaiva ca carītyanena nairākā- ṅkṣatvāt ṛtvigvikalpena adhvardhvādivākyānāṃ varītamyasamarthaka- tvāpatteḥ ṛtvigviśeṣavidhidho tu 'niyamastu' iti nyāyena adhvardhvādīnāmeva ṛtviktvāvadhāraṇāt varītamyaviśeṣa- jñānasiddheḥ|
jyotiṣṭome ṛtvijaḥ saptadaśa iti samadhigataṃ prāk|
idānīṃ katame te saptadaśa iti cintyate|
saptaviṃśatau ye- kecit saptadaśa iti utsṛjya pūrvapakṣasya nirāsārthaḥ tuśabdaḥ|
sa tu dakṣiṇābhiḥ saha śrutīnāṃ amīdādiśabdānāṃ saṃyogāt sāmānyādhikaraṇyarūpāt saṃcanatvāt avagantavyaḥ|

'dvādaśa- śataṃ dakṣiṇā' iti prastuta 'ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti, prathamamagrīye dadāti, tato brahmaṇa, tato hotre' ityādinā 'pratihṛtre anantaḥ' iti dakṣiṇāvākye 'ṛtvigbhyaḥ; ityanena agnīye brahmaṇa, ityādīnāṃ sāmā- nādhikaraṇyaṃ śrūyate|
tena camasādhvaryuvarjitāḥ saptadaśaiva dakṣiṇābhiḥ saṃvaddhāḥ śrutāḥ|
tasmāt te eva saptadaśa ṛtvijo nāma|

satre 'ye ṛtvijaste yajamānāḥ' iti ṛtvijāmeva yajamānatva- muktvā teṣām 'adhvaryugṛhapati dīkṣayitvā brahmāṇaṃ dīkṣa- yati, tata udgātāram, tato hotāram, tatastaṃ pratiprasthātā dīkṣayitvā ardhino dīkṣayati, brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaṃ brahmaṇaḥ, prastotāramudgātuḥ, maitrāvaruṇaṃ hotuḥ|
tatastaṃ nehā dīkṣa- yitvā tṛtīyino dīkṣayati, agnīdhaṃ brahmaṇaḥ, pratihartāra- mudgātuḥ, acchāvākaṃ hotuḥ|
pādino dīkṣayati, potāraṃ brahmaṇaḥ, subrahmaṇyamudgātuḥ, prāvastṛtaṃ hotṛḥ |
tatsaptamyo brāhmaṇo dīkṣayati brahmacārī vā ācāryapreṣitaḥ' iti vākyena dīkṣāyāḥ vidhānāt teṣāmeva ṛtviktvamavagamyate |
tasmāt camasādhvaryu- varjitā brahmadayaḥ ṛtvijaḥ saptadaiva |
bhā. 10|8|16|49-50. niyama: parisaṃkhyā vā na nyāyādvād vinivartye |
nityatāmātra- kārī tu niyamaḥ kiṃ na labhyate |
vā. 1|3|8|27 pṛ. 282. niyamo bahudevate, vikāraḥ syāt |
'sa etān paśūna ādityebhyaḥ kāmāyālabhate' 'vaiśvadevaṃ dhūmamālabheta' ityādayo bahudevatāḥ paśavaḥ |
agnīṣomīye prakṛtipatho abhiguṇe medhapatiśabdaḥ ekavacanānto dvivacanāntaśca 'medhapatibhyāṃ medham' 'medhapataye medham' iti |
tatra dvivacanāntaḥ ('medhapatibhyo medham' iti ) bahuvacanāntena uhitavyaḥ |
ekavacanā- ntastu nivartyate, kiṃvā ubhāvāpi vikalpena niviśate iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
tatra ca vikāraḥ bahuvacanāntena jahaḥ syāt iti |
ekavacanānta- syāpi tu prakṛtivat prakṛtau iva vikalpaḥ syāt, so'pi vikalpena pravartata |
tasmāt dvāvapi vikalpena pravartate iti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. niyama: vaidikasya vaidikameva nimittaṃ iti |
bhā. 10|2|18|49. niyamena upasaṃhārasya upasaṃhāraviṣaye prāptau upasaṃhāraḥ vidhiḥ |
vāla. pṛ. 17, niyamana tatra cānyatra ca prāptau parisaṃkhyāvidhiḥ 'imāmagṛbhṇan raśanāmṛtasyetyaśvāmi- mādatte' |
pṛ. 26. niyamasya anyāśritasya anyā- rthatve 'khādiraṃ vīryakāmasya yūpaṃ kuryāt' ityudāharaṇam |
su. pṛ. 321. niyamasya abhipṛttattvotsarge ācāra- virodhaḥ syāt |
bhā. 11|3|16|14, niyamasya yāva- jjīvikatvasya darśapūrṇamāsikasya soryādau nātideśaḥ |
' vā. 1|3|8|27 pṛ. 283. niyamāṣṭārthena atyantādṛṣṭārthe bādhyate, aprāpta- bādhaḥ |
vā. 1|3|17|48 pṛ. 860. niyamāpūrvaṃ kriyākṛtaṃ na bhavati |
ke. 2|13. niyamārthaḥ eṣa vādaḥ 'yadāhavanīye juhoti' iti |
antareṇāpi ca vacanaṃ āhavanīye homaḥ anyatra ca prāptaḥ |
saṃkalpaṃ. 3|2|8. aprāpto vidhīyamāno na niyamārtho bhavati |
agniṣṭome 'yadi somaṃ na vindet pūtīkānabhiṣu- yāt' iti somasya pratinidhiḥ pūtīko nāma sākṣāt śruta eva |
sa pūtīkaḥ kiṃ somena samānavidhānī na veti vicāre neti pūrvapakṣe utsūtre prāpte siddhāntasūtra- midam |
niyamaḥ kutaḥ, pūtīka eva somasadṛśo grāhyo nānya iti |
sa ca pūtīkaḥ somatvena pratinidhīyate na yāgadravyatvena |
sarve somadharmāḥ ṛyādayaḥ codakena vinaiva ādita eva pūtīkasya vidhī- yante ityarthaḥ |
ke. niyamārthī śrutiriti cenna, śrutiprāptānāṃ niyamena nivartayitumaśakyatvāt |
sarva eva tāvat niyamaḥ anya- vyāvṛttiphalatvādanyāyyaḥ |
tathāpi tatra yatra arthākṣitā- vasthāni vastvantarāṇi bhavanti tatra ekatraśravaṇaśena itara- nivartate |
yatpakṣe vidhimantareṇa prāpnoti tat śrayamāṇaṃ aniyatāśe praviśat niyamo'bhidhīyate |

itaraparivarjanāviśeṣe'pi yatra prayoge samāderaprāptiḥ (same yajeta) tatrāpi prāpaṇasya śāstreṇa akaraṇe vidhyākṣepāt prāpnuvato viṣamādeḥ varjanālāmena prathamopasthitatvāt viśeṣasamāditatayā pratyāsannatvāt bhāvurūpatvena laghuśarīratvāt aprāptāṃśa- paripūraṇatvena phalam, viṣamadinivṛttistu tadaivaryyāt aprāptāṃśaparipūraṇarūpaniyamatānuṣṭhānādivā na phalam, parisaṃkhyāyāṃ tu ubhayorapi niprāptatvena aprāptāṃśapari- pūraṇasya phalatvā saṃbhavāt itaraparivarjanameva phalam, evaṃ ca 'same eva yajeta' iti evakāreṇa phalitavacanaṃ ayogavyavacchedārtham, na tu parisaṃkhyāyāmivā anyayoga- vyatracchedārthamiti, na tu parisaṃkhyāyāmivā anyayoga- vyatracchedārthamiti niyamaparisaṃkhyayoḥ; phalametāt avarja- nīyaḥ tṛtīyo vidhiprakāraḥ |
yathā- prakṛtau vaikalpikoḥ bṛhadrathaṃtaryoḥ adṛṣṭārthayoḥ anyatarasya kacidvikṛtau niyamaḥ śrūyate |
'paśuyajñasya yajñakratoḥ ṣaḍ ṛtvijaḥ' 'saumyasyādhvarasya yajñakratoḥ saptadaśa ṛtvijaḥ' iti |
'niyamaḥ pākṣika sati' yatra tu prāguktatvāt pākṣikī prāptiḥ saṃbhāvyate, tatra aprāptapakṣa pūrayan yo vidhiḥ pravartate, sa niyantu- tvāt niyama ityucyate yathā 'vrīhīnavahanti' iti |
taṇḍulanivṛttyarthatvādeveti tassidetaṃ tathā'prāptamātraṃ vigheḥ phalam, kiṃ tarhi aprāptāṃśapūraṇam |
purāṇe tu sati yā teṣāṃ nivṛttiḥ |
asau arthāttāṃ na vākyāt na ca tadarthaṃ niyamaḥ |
parākramaḥ 40|2. niyamavidhiḥ yathā vājapeye 'yajyuktaṃ rathamadhvarye dadāti' atra adhvaryave eveti |
ci. 10|3|20. niyamavidhiḥ vājapeyādi- vikṛtau vaikalpikānāṃ prākṛtānāṃ madhye anyatamapunaḥśrutau |
bhā. 10|1|6|51-57. niyamavidhiḥ vāyavyapaśu śveta- guṇasya 'vāyavyaṃ śvetamālabheta' |
yathā 'upāṃśu yajuṣā' iti vāla. pṛ. 182, niyamavidhinā parisaṃkhyāvidhividhāyate, yathā 'ṛtau bhāryāmupeyāt' iti |
ke. niyamavidhivivecanaṃ maṇikṛtam 'vidhiḥ trividhaḥ' iti vindī maṇagranthe draṣṭavyam |
soma. 6|7|9. niyamaśāsanaṃ yatra aniyamaprasaṅgaḥ, tadviṣayo vijñāyate |
bhā. 3|1|14| 24-25. niyuktavākyasya niyuktatvaguṇakavāyudevatāka- kṣetradvayakarmāntaravidhiparatvam (etameva santaṃ vācye niyuktate ālameta iti) |

ācāryā- divākyeṣu 'devadatta samidhamāhara' ityādiṣu pravartamāne devadatte pārśvastha evamavadhārayati 'buddhipūrvakaiyamasya pravṛttiḥ, yathāhaṃ buddhvā pravṛttastadadyapi madviśeṣāt, ahaṃ ca na kriyāmātraga pravṛttaḥ, nāpi phalamātratvagamāt, nāpi phalasādhanatvāvagamāt, kintu kāryatāvagamāt |
stanapānādi- kā''pi kriyā yāvanmayā kāryatayā nāvagatā, tāvadahaṃ na pravṛttaḥ |

śreyaḥ prati sādhanatvamanyat, anyacca kṛti puruṣaprayatnaṃ prati prādhānyaṃ sādhyalakṣaṇaṃ kāryatvam, kleśāmanastu karmaṇaḥ phala- sādhanatvānuvidhāyinī kāryatā, iti mandā na bhedaṃ prati- padyavantaḥ |
tathā sulabhya phalasādhanatāṃ vinā kāryāvagati- rasti, ataḥ phalasādhanatā'tiriktakāryabodhāt pravṛttirmama iti devadatto'pi tadavagāmādeva pravartate iti kalpayati |
tadavagamaścāsya śabdāntaraṃ bhavan śabdanincana eveti kāryābhidhāyatāṃ liṅādasya kalpayati |
tacca kārye anvitamabhidheyaṃ iti sthite 'agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svarga- kāmaḥ' ityādiṣu vākyeṣu ṣaṣṭhyantānusāreṇa svargakāma- kāmapadena niyojyatayā svargakāmaḥ samarpaṇīyaḥ iti sthitam |
svargakāmasya ca tasminneva kārye bodhatulyaḥ anvayaḥ, yadeva tasya kāmyamānasādhanatāmanubhavituṃ kṣamate |
na ca kriyā kṣaṇa- bhaṅginī kālāntarabhāvine phale heturbhavati |
tena sā kāryatayā niyojyena saha gandhīyate, yat kālāntarasyāpi kāryam, tadeva tena saha anvayaṃ gacchatīti, iti kriyā-
nanu tasyāpi kāryasya kutaḥ siddhiḥ ? yāgāderiti cet, anantara- bhāvitvā tarhi phalasya prasaktā, kriyā'nantarabhāvinastasya phalahetutvāt |
anantarabhāvitve'pi tasya na phala- manantaraṃ bhaviṣyati, sahakāriṇyapekṣāyā vilambanopapatteḥ |
kiṃ tat sahakāri iti cet, deśakālādikamiti brūmaḥ |
na ca phalajanaka- tayā guṇabhāvāt apūrvasya vākyārthatvahāniḥ, svānaguṇa- niyojyalābhāya phalānukūlatā'valambanāt |
yathā ātmana eva saṃvidadhānaḥ svāmī garbhadāsasyopakaroti, taddeta- dapi |
tataśca anvitābhidhāne sthite kāryābhidhāyitā loke niyogasya liṅāderavagateti |
niyogaḥ niyujyate anena iti niyuktyā niyoga- śabdābhidheyo liṅādiḥ |
ṛju. pṛ. 16. niyogaḥ vidhiḥ preraṇā śabdabhāvanā ityeko'rthaḥ |
vāla. pṛ. 75. ekakṣāyaṃ niyogaḥ anuvandhamedāt bhidyate |
bṛhatī. pṛ. 19. na ca kāmādhikāre niyogo yāgasya kartavyatāṃ vadati, phalata eva kartavyatāsiddheḥ |
ṛju. pṛ. 29, yasmin puruṣe niyujyate sa viṣayaḥ iti naiva karmaṇi prerakatayā viṣayabhāvaḥ |
kiṃ tarhi ? yatra karmeṇa puruṣo niyujyate kārya bodhyate iti |
etaduktaṃ bhavati, karmeṇa yāgādau kāryabhūto niyogaḥ pratīyate, na punaḥ karmaṇyeva prerayati |
pramāṇāntarāvagamye'pi hi laukike- 'rthe naiva niyogasya sādhyasādhanasiddhayapekṣā avasīyate |
tathāhi etadvākyaśravaṇānantaraṃ pravartamānaṃ samidāharaṇe māṇa- vakamupalabhya pārśvastho vyutpattirevamavadhārayati, buddhipūrvakaṃ asya pravṛttiḥ, svatantrapravṛttitvāt, madīyapravṛttivat |
ahaṃ ca na kriyāmātragavamāt nāpi phalamātratvagamāt, nāpi phalasādhanatvāvagamāt, kintu kāryatāvagamāt |
na khalva- nyato'bhekaḥ stanapānādikāmāpi kriyā yāvanmayā bhagavatavānasi na tāvat tasyāmapi pravṛttaḥ |
na ca yā śreyaḥsādhanatā saiva kāryatā, parasparaparihārasthitalakṣaṇa- virodhādhāratvāt |
nadyasti saṃbhavaḥ; yadeva samīhitaṃ prati sādhanatvam, tadeva kṛti puruṣaprayatnaṃ prati sādhyatvamiti |
kleśāmanastu karmaṇaḥ phalasādhanatā'nvayinī kāryatā iti kecit abhedaṃ pratītavantaḥ |
tathā sulabhya phalasādhanatāṃ vinā ca kāryatāvagatirasti |
ataḥ phalasādhanatā'ti- riktakāryabodhāt pravṛttirmameti māṇavako'pi tadava- bodhādeva pravṛtta iti niścinoti |
tacca kāryamanvitama- bhidheyamiti sthite 'agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāmaḥ' ityādiṣu vākyeṣu ṣaṣṭhyantānusāreṇa svargakāmapadena niyojyatayā svargakāmaḥ samarpaṇīya iti sthitam |
svargakāmasya ca tasminneva kārye bodhatulyaḥ anvayaḥ, yadeva tasya kāmyamānasādhanatāmanubhavituṃ kṣamate |
na ca kriyā kṣaṇa- bhaṅginī kālāntarabhāvine phale heturbhavati |
yakālāntarasyāpi kāryam, tadeva tena sahānvayaṃ gacchatīti kriyā'tireki mānā- ntarāvedyameva liṅādayaḥ kāryamidati |
tacca mānā- ntarāpūrvatā apūrvamiti ca kāryatayā avaśyamānaṃ ātmani puruṣaṃ niyuñjānaṃ niyoga iti ca vyapadiśyate |
na ca kriyā'nantaraṃ bhavadapi deśakālādisahakāryapekṣayā anantarameva svagādi bhāvayati |
na ca phalajanakatā guṇabhāvāt apūrvasya vākyārthatvahāniḥ, svānaguṇaniyojya- lābhāya phalānukūlatā'valambanāt |
yathā ātmana eva saṃvidadhānaḥ svāmī garbhadāsasyopakaroti, tadyeti |
na ca anekāryābhi- dhāyitā liṅādīnāṃ na pratīyate |
yadi hi māṇavaka ācāryacoditaḥ pravartitaḥ kāryamavabodhita iti yāvat |
yatastadevaṃ praiṣādīnāṃ loke pratīteḥ kāryāvabodhamantareṇa ca pravṛttyanupa- pattestatastasya saṃvandhagrahaḥ tadupagrahameva ca vede paryava- sānāt |
nanu praiṣādyo'pyavagamyante loke, tat kathaṃ kāryā- bhidhāyakāmeva liṅādīnām ? upādhaya ete, na tu śabdāthāḥ |
te eva copādhayaḥ ye tasyāḥ prayogadarśana- mātrācchandāya viśeṣaṃ vyavasthāpayanti, yathā haripadā- midheyasya paśutvamupādhiḥ |
tattathamevā- bhidhānāvineviśāditi haripadā iti hartuṃ paśau eva niyacchati |
evaṃ praiṣādyo'pi abhidhānāvineviśan eva kārya viśeṣe vyavasthāpayanti, na punarabhidheyā iti saṃbandha- grahaṇasaṃbhavādupapanne niyogabhidhānaṃ liṅādīnāmiti |
satyaṃ kartavyatābhidhāyino liṅādayaḥ, kartavyatā tu kriyā eva, nāpūrvasya, lokādhīnāvādhāraṇatvāt śabda- sāmarthyasya |
tasyā eva ca kāryatayā pravṛttihetutvena svātmani mānāntareṇa viditatvāt |

nanu apūrvasya tasya mānāntarāgocaratvaṃ kartavyatāmātraviditasattvānāṃ loke liṅādīnāṃ svargakāmapadasaṃbandhāt, vede apūrvaviśeṣaprati- lambha iti cet ? astu tāvat asyaiva tu kartavyasya liṅarthatā, na punaḥ kriyāyā api laukikyā iti kutastyam ? anekārthatvasya anyāyatatvāt |
lakṣaṇayā ca kartavyatāṃ kriyāyāṃ laukikasya liṅādīnāṃ prayogasyo- papatteḥ apūrvakartavyatāmāntarīyakātvāt |

atyantaprayogābhyāsāt lākṣaṇikasyāpi vācakatvābhi- mānāt apūrvābhidhānaniyogasiddhiriti cet ? nanu anekārthatvamanvāyaṃ ityetadeva kutaḥ ? anekaśaktikalpanā- gauravāt iti cet ? nanu apūrvamepi naikavidhapradhānāṅga- varti nāneti kathamekārthye liṅaḥ ? kṛtityāpyatāyāḥ pravṛtti- nimittasya sarvatrāviśeṣān rūpabhede'pi apūrvāṇāmeka- śaktirasthā liṅaḥ ekahāyādiṣvivadati cet ? hanta bhoktapastviha kriyā kimaparāddham ? yadasyāṃ kartavyatā- rūpāyāṃ abhidhāya na kaḥ patiriva liṅādiḥ śakyantara- sukocaṃ rocyate |
śabdasāmye'pi kartavyatāmedāt atha- madoṣa iti cet ? na |
yadi manyeta, yadyapi kartavyatāśabdāsāmyaṃ tathāpi kṛti iti īpsitatamatā kartavyatā apūrvasya taduddeśena puruṣaprayatnasya kṛteḥ pravṛtteḥ |
na caivaṃrūpā kriyākartavyatā, tasyā duḥkhatayā tāṃ prati pradhānabhāvāt apūrveḥ |
odanā''syarthapravṛttikṛti- vyāpyatallakṣaṇodanādihetoḥ tasyāḥ kartavyatā, sā tu anyathācca śakyantaramantareṇa liṅādigocara iti |
na ca khalu apūrvasiddhiśca kṛtiḥ pravartitumarhati |
yadicchākarma tadeva ca tasyāḥ karma yatsukham, sujānuśayitvādicchāyāḥ |

na ca apūrve sukha- miti kathamidam ? aniṣṭaṃ cet, kathaṃ taduddeśena kṛteḥ pravṛttiḥ ? śabdāttathāvagateḥ asukhamapi aniṣṭamapi apūrve kṛti prati pradhānamiti cet ? tanki śabdaḥ avagamyatīti anabhiprepsu dhūmaḥ ? 1 ānandasvabhāva vā vijñānam, 'vijñānamānandam' iti śruteḥ |
samidādi- viṣayasya apūrvasya anuṣṭheyasya anuṣṭheyādhikārārapūrva- paratvena kartavyatāyābhyupagamāt |
svargyānukūlatvāt apūrvasya asukhasyāpi icchāviṣayatvamiti kuto mānā- ntaravirodha iti cet ? na |
nimittavato niṣedhayamāna- kriyākartṛśca siddhaviśeṣaṇāvacchinnasya niyojyasya kriyā- kartavyatā'vagamāvirodhāt |
apica sādhasvargaviśiṣṭo'pi niyojyaḥ kasmāt kriyāmeva naiveti kartavyam ? tasyāḥ āśutaravināśinītvena tadanukūlatvā- bhāvāt ; taddhi tadupādānakūlaṃ yasmin sati yadupapadyate, nāsati |
na ca āmuṣmikaṃ svargādi sati karmaṇi bhavati ciravināśe |
tasmistadupapatteriti cet ? kimidānī- māgneyādiṣvapi na sāvanatvamadhikārāpūrvasya, bhakto vā sādhanavattveṣṭām ? nahi tasya bhaktatve itikartavyatā- saṃbandho ghaṭate |
teṣāṃ ca viṣayatvamekam, nānā ca kartavyaṃ bhavadbhirabhyupayete |
tatro- cāritāśca āgneyādayaḥ 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ sargāmo yajeta' iti sakṛdavamateḥ |
tathaiva viṣayamāvamanubhavanti ityeva eṣāmadhikārāpūrve prati viṣayavam |
bahūni ca asya karaṇāni śrūyante, iti naikopāyāsādhyatā bhavitumarhati |
anekakaraṇasādhyatvaṃ ca ekasyā api kriyāyā loke'pi dṛṣṭameva |
yathā akṣeṇa dīpikā khaḍgāpāṇibhirasairaiḥ saṃcarate rājā pradīpa iti |
avāntaravyāpārādedādīnāṃ sādhanānāṃ meda iti cet ? ihāpi upatyapūrvāṇyeva avā- ntaravyāpārāḥ |
te ca pratyāmeyādi bhidyante iti samānam |
paramāpūrva- prayuktāve'pi avāntaravyāpārotpatyapūrvabhedena sādhanabhāvasya medāt apūrvasādhananiveśitatvāt ca teṣām |
tasmāt yathaiva adhikārāpūrvatva- samaye āgneyādīnāmasatāpi śābdagatasādhanabhāvānāṃ
upatyapūrvāṇi avāntaravyāpārāḥ śakyo vā tathā, phalaṃ prati avagatasādhanabhāvāḥ |
kathamanvasamavetā anyasya śaktiḥ, asati vā vyāpāravatī |
avāntaravyāpāra iti cet ? āgneyādīnāmapi paramāpūrvasādhanānāmavāntara- vyāpāreṣu śaktiśca tathācapūrvatve tulyatvāt paryantayogasya |

anapekṣaśabdāvagatasādhanabhāvānāṃ āgneyādīnāṃ asambhavā- manyasamavetānyapi asamānakālānyapi upatyapūrvāṇi vyāpārāḥ sāmarthye veti cet ? tat kim 'darśapūrṇa- māsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' iti lokānusārataḥ sādhya- svargaviśiṣṭena kriyā kāryā nāvagamyate, svaviśeṣaṃ vā sādhyarūpaṃ pratyayasthānānukūlyam, yena tadaghaṭya avā- ntaravyāpāraḥ sāmarthye vā kriyāyā nāpūrvamāsīyeta ? phalasādhanasādhanaṃ na phalasādhanaṃ kriyeti mithyā, phala- pravṛttyā eva tasyāstatsādhanatvāt |
yathā paramāpūrva- sādhanapravṛttānāmāgneyādīnāṃ upatyapūrvasādhanatvam, sasthā- gamodeśena pravṛttasyaiva kṛṣikarmaṇo bhūpaṭanādisādhanatvam |
na ca paramāpūrve prati upatyapūrvāṇāmeva sādhanatvam, āgneyādīnāmiti sāṃpratam |
nahi 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyām' iti ca 'yajeta' iti cocyapūrvāṇāmabhidhānam, api tu paṇāmāgneyādīnāṃ kālaviśeṣasaṃbandhenopacānāṃ anu- ditānāṃ samudāyānām |
na caiṣāṃmupatyavyāpāreṇa yathārthaṃ upatyapūrvāṇi prati kāraṇatvamadhigamayitumīśate |
adhi- kāravākyasaṃnidhisāmāntānāṃ tadupatyatināyānāṃ adhi- kārāpūrvatvamabhidhāśaktyā drāgiva apa
syānmatam, liṅādeḥ śabdasyāṃ mahimā, yadanavasthitaśaktirapi svārthamavagamayatīti |
kriyāmātra- kāryavodhakāvyāṅgīkāreṇa liṅāderlokato nyutpattisaṃbhave śabdāntaravailakṣaṇyena agṛhītasaṃbandhasya vācakātvakalpanā- 'nupapatteḥ |
kriyaiva kāryatayā vedavākye- bhyo'vagamyata iti nyutpattibalena prāmāṇikam, manoratha- mātravijṛmbhitaṃ tu apūrve kārye pratīyate iti |
abhidheya eva hyaparo'bhidhayati (?) evam 'śabdāntarāṇyapi kathaṃ tenādṛṣṭena kutracit |
' tasminpratīpamāne tadanvitasyāpratīteḥ sūtrasaṃnbandhāvadhāraṇā- nupapatteḥ dūranirastaṃ śabdāntarāṇāṃ tadanvitasvārthabodhaka- tvamiti |
rāddhāntamupakramate 'atrocyate yadā nāma buddhenai- kena bhāṣite |
liṅadidhruvākyaśravaṇamātra- prayojyabuddhasya viśiṣṭārthaviṣayāṃ pravṛttiṃ dṛṣṭvā vyutpatti- māno bālaḥ : evamākalayati, 'yeyaṃ svādhīnā asya pravṛttiḥ, sā madabuddhipūrvikā' iti |
punaśca tasyāyaṃ vimarśo jāyate 'ahaṃ buddhvā pravṛtto yat tadepo'pi, yasyāḥ pravṛtterhetubhūtā buddhiḥ, sā yadviṣayā satī mama pravṛttihetuḥ, tadviṣayaivāsyāpi' iti nyutpattisoranumā jāyate |
tadevamanumānadvayamatat 'buddhasya svayameva pravṛttiḥ dharmiṇī, buddhipūrvikā iti sādhyo dharmaḥ |
tathā 'buddhasya pravṛttihetubhūtā buddhiḥ dharmiṇī, yadviṣayā satī mama pravṛtti- hetubhūtā, tadat viṣayaivāsyāpi sādhyo dharmaḥ |
padasya (yasya) tu śabdena bodhyate anena mama, mānāntareṇa tu yadviṣayā sā buddhiḥ pravṛttihetubhūtā, tadat svasthānena śabdena bodhyate, tadbhāve sati avagamāt |
mama tu mānāntareṇa tad bodhyate ityapa- māvayorviśeṣaḥ |
yena yat buddhyā pravṛttirmama, tadasthānena śabdena bodhyate iti śabdasya pravṛttihetubhūtātho bodhaka- tāmavadhārayati |
śabdābhidheyaḥ iti nirdhārituṃ svātmani pratipannaṃ pravṛttihetubhūtārthamanu- sandhatte - 'tatra buddhyā pravṛtto'haṃ kiṃ tāvat svayamanvayā' |
śabdanirapekṣaḥ svayamayaṃ pravartamānaḥ kiṃ buddhvā pravṛttaḥ iti jijñāsāste |
anutpannena bālena yat ātmani pratītikārayatayā pratītim, tadeva vyutpannasyāpi tena kalpyate, nānyadityarthaḥ |
tena 'śabda eva pravṛttihetubhūto- vidhisadavyāpāre vā' iti nirastaṃ bhavati |
atimandatayā cemī pakṣau na sākṣādupannasya nirasto |
liṅādi- śabdasvarūpa pravartakatve sarve eva tacchāviṇo niyamena pravartairan, na caivaṃ dṛśyate, kaścit kadācit pravṛttiḥ |
piśitacakṣuṣā mānuṣā vayaṃ netyeti pramāṇa- bhūmimavagāhtuṃ kṣamāḥ |
śabdabhāvanā liṅādidhyāpārarūpā puruṣapravṛttibhavanānukūlā svajñāpitakaraṇikā arthavādodita- prāśastyalakṣaṇā itikartavyatāyoginī preraṇā''tmikā kalpyate |
svādhyāyādhyayanavidhinā hi sarve vidhāyakāḥ svādhyāyaśabdavācyāḥ svātmā ca niyujyante bhāvayediti |
jñātā hi śabdabhāvanā pravṛtti prasṛte, yogyatayā eva arthavāda- samudyaprāśastyajñānaṃ itikartavyatātve niveśite |

avasī- dantī hi vidhivyāptiḥ prāśastyajñānena uttabhyate iti tasyāḥ puruṣavyāpārarūpagarbhādibhāvāvacchinnā bhāvārtha- karaṇikā śrautasārtācāraprāptapadārthārthagamajanitakaraṇopa- kāravatī arthabhāvanā samānapratyayavācyā viṣayabhūtā |
tatra liṅadesāhaśo vyāpāro vidyate ityatra na kiñcana
liṅadiśabdāntarabhāvinī pravṛttireva pramāṇa- miti cenna, tasminnacanatvena pravṛtteḥ anyatrādṛṣṭatvāt |
liṅādiśabdañca eva pramāṇamiti sāhasam, agṛhīta- saṃbandhasya śabdasyāvācakatvāt |
yat ca tatra svādhyāyādhya- yanavidhinā sarve vidhāyakā ātmā ca niyujyante, puruṣaṃ hi vidhiḥ prerayati yaśca yena preryate te acetanā na yujyante na cācetanānāṃ niyogyatvamapi saṃbhavati |
śabda- bhāvanā sarvaśabdānāṃ svataḥ eva sakartṛtvāt viniyogā- napekṣatvāt |
atha na puruṣapreraṇe viniyujyante kiṃ tvartha- vibodhane |
tathā cāhuḥ 'dravyādīnāṃ punaḥ kasmin svādhyāyo'ntargato bhavet |
svādhyāyo hi sphuṭaṃ karma sākṣātsaṃskriyate hi saḥ |
' iti saṃskāra- vidhiśca na saṃskārye niyujyate pramāṇāntarāvasitopayogasya śepitatvāt |
saṃskāraparyavasāyī tu saṃskāravidhirna saṃskāryasya kārye kalpyate |
ātmā cādhyayanavidhinā niyujyate viniyujyate veti pratipattidvayasyāpi asaṃbhavat anupapannam |
na ca kriyā svaphalaprathāya karaṇamapekṣate, na ca gamanaṃ saṃyoga- vibhāgārambhe karaṇāpekṣam |
śabdo vidhi- jñānaṃ janayitvā tatkaraṇānugṛhītaḥ preraṇārūpaṃ svavyāpāramā- rabhate iti karaṇabhāvāvaḥ kriyāniṣpattāveva karaṇatvāt |
nahi kasyacid vastunaḥ svajñāna- mutpādanahetuḥ iti pratītam |
evaṃ ca arthavādodita- prāśastyasyāpi itikartavyatātvaṃ vidhastām |
na ca preraṇetyau śabdakartṛkāyā- karaṇībhūtajñānānugrahayogyatā tasya śakyate'vagantum |
kriyāniṣpatyāthaiva phala- siddhiriti loke pratītam, ata eva tasmin pakṣe niṣphale- 'pi preraṇasiddheḥ pravṛttiḥ syāt |
atha phalamapi iti- kartavyatāpada niveśi prāśastyavat atastadabhāve preraṇā (na) niṣpadyate iti cet |
tarhi phalamevāstu itikartavyatāṃśa- paripūrakam, kiṃ prāśastyena |
satyametat, asti tāvat tadapīti na tyajyate |
evaṃ tarhi aśrutaprāśastye tadapekṣā mā bhūt |
tataśca tadapi deśādikalpanamaghaṭamānaṃ kenalpasya vidheḥ darvihomavat karaṇetikartavyatākalpanā |
kalpanā- mātrameva, darvihomavaditi ca siddho dṛṣṭāntaḥ |
nahi ekasyaiva vastunaḥ anugrāha- katā anugrāhyatā ca svāmyanupapadyate |
atha śabdaḥ preraṇā karotyeva pravṛttistu nāvanamātreṇa, kintu tajjñāne sati |
evaṃ tarhi jñānaphalameva pravṛttistattvaṃ, na preraṇāphalam, tasmin sati bhāvāt, asati cābhāvāt |
tathā ca sati śabdabhāvanā vidhiriti na siddham |

iti prāpyakārīndriyavādinā abhyupeyaṃ anyathā namasaḥ śrotrabhūtasya, śabdasya ca prāpyasaṃbhavāt saṃyogasamavāyayoranyatarasya prāptirūpatvāt saṃyogasya anya- tarakarmajasya ubhayakarmajasya saṃyogajasya (ca) dravyatve śabdasya nabhasā sahasaṃbandhatvāt tasya traividhyaniyamāt pāri- śeṣyāt samavāyaḥ |
yattat ātmani arthaviṣayajñānaṃ śabdaviṣayajñānamanānantaraṃ jāyate, tacchabdakarmarthatayā yadā viṣayate, tadā tat abhidhānamityucyate |
paramthe vyāpāre bhavatyeva kartṛtā parispanda ivātmanaḥ |
nanu ca sarvākhyātānāṃ bhāvanāvacanatā karotisāmanādhi- karaṇyāt adhyavasīyate |
tathāhi bhavatyarthasya kartuḥ prayo- jakavyāpāre bhāvanā |
‘kimakārṣīdapākṣīt, kiṃ karoti pacati, kiṃ kariṣyati pakṣyati’ iti praśnottara- darśanāt |
tatrāpi satyāmāpi prakṛtau ghañantādiṣu karotyarthānavabodhāt, ākhyātapratyayasaṃnidhāne ca tadavagamāt ākhyātānāmeva so'rtha iti niścīyate |
kiṃ karotītyasya praśnasya yadyamarthaḥ ‘yat karoti tat kim’ iti tatra cet pacatītyuttaraṃ syāt, tadā pākaṃ karotīti syāt tasminnarthe pacatīti vartate |
tathā ca sidhyet ākhyātānāṃ karotya- rthatā |
anavagate hi dhātuvācye vyāpāraviśeṣe tadviśeṣaḥ eva evaṃ pṛcchayate |
tathā ca na sidhyati dhātvatiriktakarotyarthavacanatā ākhyātānām |
sarvadhātvarthāśca kasyacit abhūtasya bhavane anukūlatāṃ bhajantaḥ karotyarthatāmāpannāḥ karotinā prabhuṃ nirdeṣṭuṃ ca śakyante iti tadarthapraśnaścaite evaite |
kiñca, dhātuvācyavyāpāraviśeṣavacanatvenāpi praśnottarayorupapattau tadatiriktakarotyarthavācakatā ākhyātānāṃ na śakyate vaktum |

api ca saprayatnākriyeṣu devadattādiṣu vyāpārabheda- saṃbhavāt ghaṭetāṃ praśnottare vyatiriktakarotyarthaviṣaye, ‘kiṃ karoti’ iti praśne gacchatīti cottare gamanātirikta- vyāpārābhāvāt anupapattireva syāt |
atha saṃyogavibhāgau dhātvarthaḥ, parispandastu vibhaktyartha iti, tatrāpi dhātvarthavyatirikta- vyāpārasaṃbhavāt nānupapattiḥ |
parispandasyaiva gamidhātvarthatvāt kevalaṃ saṃyoge vibhāge vā grāmeḥ prayogaḥ, syāṇau ityanena viyukte saṃyukte vā aprayogāt |
nāpi dvayoḥ, utpatya nipalite ityanena syāṇau prayogaprasaṅgāt |
na cākhyātānāṃ bhāvanāvacanatvamantareṇa kasyacit vṛddha- vyavahārasyānupapattiḥ |
katrādi- saṃkhyāmātravācitayā ākhyātaprayogopapattau nādhikaṃ vācyaṃ śakyaṃ kalpayitum |
api ca pākaṃ karoti devadatta ityatra tāvata pacyate pākaśabdo bravīti, tadanuguṇaḥ prayatnaḥ karotirācaṣṭe |
ākhyātaṃ tu kevalakartṛsaṃkhye vaktīti siddhaṃ tanmātrāvacitvam |
ataḥ anyatrāpi tatraiva vartate iti yuktam, evaṃ ca ‘pacati devadattaḥ’ ityasya yat vivaraṇaṃ pākaṃ karotīti, tadapyanupapannam |
pacatītyatra yaḥ puruṣa- prayatno yasaṃbandhena pacyarthaḥ sādhyabhūtaḥ, taṃ karotinā prakṛti- bhūtenopādāya vivaraṇeopapattiḥ |
yatrāpi prayogaḥ ‘gamanaṃ karoti’ iti na prayatnaḥ aparo'sti, tatrāpi gamanasya sādhyatāṃ darśayituṃ gauṇaḥ karotiprayogo draṣṭavyaḥ, pakṣadvaye'pi tulyatvāt |
yastu devadatta odanaṃ pacatītyādau vṛddha- vyavahāra eva prakṛtyarthātirike prayatne prayogāt ākhyā- tānāṃ tadarthatāmāha |
vāsa kiṃ na vetsi ‘ananyalabhyaḥ śabdārthaḥ’ iti |
iha ca prakṛtyarthā- kṣepeṇāpi prayatnapratītyupapatterna śakyate tadācakṣatā ākhyātānāmāśrayitumiti |
nanu prābhākarā api bhāvanā- vācakatāṃ kathamākhyātapratyayasyecchanti |
na sarvā- khyātāpratyayānāṃ bhāvanāvacanatvamabhyupagamaḥ, kintu kāryā- midhāyino liṅādayaḥ |
kāryasaṃbandhi hi kārye kṛtyāna- midhānenābhihitaṃ syāt |
nahyasti saṃbhavaḥ kṛtiśca nāmi- dhīyate kāryaṃ ca nāmi (ami) dhīyate iti |
yathā daṇḍītyatra pratyayena daṇḍo nāmidhīyate, atha ca tadviśiṣṭapuruṣapratītiḥ |
tatrāpi apratīte daṇḍe na tadasti pratyayaḥ |
asti ca tatra prakṛtibhūto daṇḍaśabdaḥ, sa ca tasya pratyayayitā |
na ceha tathā saṃbhavati, prakṛtīnāṃ puruṣavyāpārābhidhāna- niyamāt |
na cāsau prakṛtisaṃbandhi svayaṃ kāryaṃ boddhumalamiti tadīya- kulamabhidhānametadviṣayam |
tasya ca kṛtiḥ prayatnarūpā, na ca saṃbandhanubhave tadabhidhāvinaḥ (anubhavaḥ) iti na daṇḍiñyāyetyāyaṃ viṣayaḥ |
yathā liṅāṃ (liṅāṃ) katrādisaṃkhyāmātravacanatā kriyā'kṣepeṇa ca katrādīnāṃ pratītiḥ, tathaihāpi kriyā prayatnamākṣipatī mā bhūtasya liṅāvacyateti |
yadyapi prakṛtyartha- bhūtayā kriyā prayatnaḥ ākṣipyate |
na ca kasyanakvacit svarūpameva pūrvamabhi- hitaṃ kṛtimākṣeptumalama |
na ca śabdamantareṇa apūrvasya prayatnasaṃbandhāvagame kāraṇāntaramasti |
tasmādapūrvakāryābhidhāyinā prayatnamābhidhāna avaśyaśakya- ṇīmiti viṣayakaraṇīya nipuṇataramupapāditam, ilamalamatiprasaṅgena |
tatra na kriyāmātraṃ tāvadahaṃ buddhvā pravṛttaḥ, na nāpi phalamātram, na kriyāphalasaṃbandha- mātraṃ vā |
tanmihetorbhojane atīte vartamāne vā apravṛttirbhavatipya tāvatsāmuditāvāyete ivānu- ṣṭhānābhāvāt |
puruṣādyāvagamastu pravṛttihetutayā nāśa- ikitā'pi, svatantrapravṛttī vyutpattidaurbalyasāritatvāt |
kintu kāryatāṃ buddhvā pravṛtto mamedaṃ kāryamiti pratītya ahaṃ sarvatra pravṛttaḥ |
antataḥ stanapānādistattikāryāpi yā kriyā (kārī api) sā yāvannama kāryeyamiti naivāvadhāryate |
tāvat kadā'pi me tatra pravṛtti- rabhavannahi ||
atītasya vartamānasya ca iṣṭāsādhanatā'sti na ca tārkāyatvā ava- sīyate, tenānya kāryatā anyā cetsādhanateti |
tathā ca pravṛttirapi tanmātrāvagamayatā na bhavatīti |
phala- sādhanatā nāma yā, sā naiva ca kartavyā |
’ yadyapi eka- vastuniveśitā dvayoḥ, tathāpi svarūpabhedo'syeva |
tadeva hi vastu phalaṃ prati upāyabhāvāt phalasādhanamityucyate, kṛtyadhīnātmalābhavatayā ca kāryamiti |
kimiti iṣṭābhyu- pāyecaiva kartavyatā'vagamo'nyatra neti, tatrāha ‘kintu svayaṃ keśarūpaṃ karma kartavyatāṃ brūte |
kāryatā hi kṛtyadhīnasiddhimātrarūpā, kintu kṛti prati pradhānabhūta sat yat tadadhīnasattākaṃ tat kārya- mucyate |
tacca kṛteḥ pradhānam, yat adhikṛtya kṛtiḥ pravartate |
na ca duḥkhaṃ duḥkhahetumaṃtaṃ vā adhikṛtya kṛtyaṃ cirupapannā |
tatra na tāvat svayaṃ suvarūpaṃ karma |
sukhasādhanamapi cenna syāt, na tasya kṛti prati prādhānyā- bhyupagamo ghaṭate |
ataḥ karmasu kāryeāvagamaḥ phalasādhana- tā'vagamanivandhanaḥ, iti jñāpakakoṭiniviṣṭaṃ phalasādhanatāṃ kāryatāṃ anuṣṭhayate, na tvasau tadātmaiva |
sukhaṃ hi sarvaiḥ kārya- tayā avaiti, na tasya phalasādhanatā'pekṣate |
tena sādhana- toccīrṇakāryatā'vagamamena pravṛttiriti nipuṇaḥ vyutpanna- mānaḥ caitraṃ pravartamānaṃ dṛṣṭvā'numinoti, caitro'pi kārya- bodhāt pravartate iti |
caitrasya pravṛttirmī kāryabodhana- pūrveketi sādhyo dharmaḥ |
dhāvinaḥ kāryamevābhidhatte, tasyaiva avagatasya pratyaya- nantarakāraṇatvāt |
icchā yadyapi pravṛttihetuḥ, tathāpi sā liṅādivācyā na bhavati, tadavagamasya pravṛttau anapekṣita- tvāt |
nanu evamapi kathaṃ liṅādīnāṃ kārye vyutpattiriti, ata āha ‘śabdāntarāṇi svārtheṣu vyutpadyante yathaiva hi |
’ liṅā- diyuktāvākyaśravaṇe tadbhāvabhāvinyā pravṛttyā viśiṣṭārthā- vagatimanumāya vākyasya tāvat hetutāmavagacchati |

tatrāpi ko'rthabhāgaḥ kena śabdenābhihitaḥ iti vivecane liṅādyāvāpena kāryatvagatirdarśanāt, taddvāre cādadītāt te eva kāryatvagatiṃ kurvantīti śabdāntaravat liṅādīnāṃ kāryatvāvakāntyupapattisiddhiḥ |
nanu lokavyavahārāt liṅādyo vācakatayā vyutvāya- mānāḥ praiṣādiṣveva vāca
cātīte śaktirapyatīteti pramāṇāntarasiddhamiti na sāpi sthāyinī śakyā kalpayitum |
api ca āśraye nivṛtte kimāśrayā śaktiratiṣṭhatām |
astu saiva svargasādhana- māśrita iti cet, nānyadīyā śaktiranyatra vartate, pramāṇā- ntaravirodhādeva |
kiñca śaktimiti asati śaktiḥ phalaṃ na yuktam |
śaktimat hi sādhanam, na śaktiḥ, anyathā śaktisvaṃ na syāt |
nanu yāgādikkiyā devatā''rādhano- pāyabhūtā satī kāryatayā ucyatām, sā tatprayāsaścittadhāreṇa kālāntare'pi phalaṃ janayitumalameva |
sā ārādhitā prasīdati, prasannā ca kartuṃ kālāntare'pi phalena yojayatyeva |
nahi devatā''rādhanopāyahetubhūte yāga ityatra kiñcit pramāṇa- masti |
pramāṇāntarāpekṣā ca smṛtīnā- marthavarṇanam, tadanuvartitvāt tāsām |
ato devatoddeśa dravyatyāgo yāgaḥ iti gauṇaṃ devatāpūjātmakatvaṃ avagama- yitavyam, pūjā api pūjyoddeśenaiva hi pravartate iti |
api ca karmabhirādhyate, yā ārādhanaṃ pratipadyate |
nānādeśagāminā puruṣeṇa anuṣṭhīyamānātkapūjā''va- gamaśca devatāyā iti pramāṇāntaraviruddhameva, tasmānādi- tvānupapatteḥ |
devatā''dhikaraṇe ca pravakṣyamāṇaṃ grantho nirasta iti nātīva yatitavyam |
athāpi syāt puruṣasaṃskāra- hetubhūtaiva kriyā śabdena kāryatayocyate |
tataśca svarga- kāmādipuruṣasaṃbandhāt puruṣasaṃskārādeva kālāntare phalaṃ bhaviṣyatīti |
nahi pramāṇāntarataḥ śabdato vā puruṣasaṃskārahetutā yāgādīnāmavasīyate iti karmaṇyarambhatvāt (1|1|2| 4|20) ityuktam |

nanu kriyaiva kāryatayocyatām, phalasādhanatā ca tasyā evāśrīyatām, tadanyathānupapattyā tu kiñcidapi aparaṃ tajanyaṃ phalodayānaguṇaṃ kālāntarāsthāyi ātmāśrayaṃ parikalpyatām, mā bhūt tasya liṅgādi- vācyateti |
na ca kriyānyenānyena phalajanakena kalpitena kriyāyāḥ sādhanatopapāditā bhavati |
na ca ātmasamavāye arthā- ntaraṃ karmaṇāmanantaravyāpāre nāpi śaktiriti na tasyārtha- pattigamyatā yuktā |
kintu anvitābhidhāne sthite niyogyānuguṇyāt śabdavācyataiva ucitā iti sūktam |
ṣaṣṭhyā tathaiva kāryasya svasaṃbandhitayā svargaḥkāmādi- niyogya iti yugāditām |
tasya ca kāryasya niyogya- viśeṣaṇabhūtakāmyopahitahetutvamiti bādarāyaṇikaraṇe rāddhā- ntitam |
tacca tathābhūtaṃ kriyārūpaṃ na bhavati, tasyāḥ phalādhanatvāyogyāt, devatā''rādhanamukhena tāvat phala- puṇyasaṃskāramukhena nāstiti devatādhikaraṇe nyupāditam |
niyojyānyamukhena mānāntarāt apūrva- mātmasamavāye kāryaṃ liṅgādibhirabhidhīyate iti aneka- nyāyasādhyam |
na cāsau bhāvārthamevamantareṇāstīti tatsaṃbandha(dhya)niyoga evocyate iti bhāṣyādhikaraṇe sthitam |
sa ca bhāvārthaḥ saṃvadhyamānatvacchinnati śabdāntarādhikaraṇe nirṇītam |
kālāntarāvasthāyinaḥ kāryasya niyojyānyayogyatā- māha- ‘taddhi kālāntarātsyāccharkaṃ svargādisiddhaye |
’ nanu ‘bhāṣyākāraḥ pratyayārthatayā apūrvamityāha kriyā- ''dibhinnaṃ yat kāryaṃ veyaṃ mānāntaraiṃ tat |
niyogaśca vākyārtha iti prābhākarāmullakhā ityatrāha- ‘kāryatvena niyojyaṃ ca svātmani prerayasau |
’ evamapi kathaṃ vākyārthatva- mityāha- ‘kāryasyaiva pradhānatvādvākyārthatvaṃ ca yujyate |
vākyaṃ tadeva hi prāha niyojyaviṣayā- nvitam ||
’ uktaṃ hyetat yat pradhānatayā pratipādyate, tat vākyārtha iti, kāryaṃ ca pradhānatvocyate iti iha tasyaiva vākyārthatvam |
niyojyānvitābhidhānaṃ ca prāvikaṃ āghā- nādhyayanā''dipradhā notpattiḥ, niyogānāṃ niyojye'jñānāṃ abhidhānābhyupagamāt |
kratuniyogapratyabhijñānā- bhāvāt, asannidhāne hi tanniyogapratyabhijñānaṃ nopapadyate |
nāpi varṇanādividhivat abhyantaritakratusaṃbandhatvāt tanmukhena pratyabhijñopapattiḥ, prāgādhānāt āhnāyanīyādi- śabdānāṃ arthāpattijñāne kratusaṃbandhanāgamāt |
juhvā- dīnāṃ tu ākṛtivacanatvāt prāgeva viniyogāt pratyabhijñā- saṃbhavaḥ |
nanu agnīnāmapi sādhyatvāt sādhyadvayaṃ katha- mekasmin vākye anvīyate |

anīpsitakarmatā tu agnīnāṃ anīpsitakarmatve''pi tattadādhānajanyaṃ phalamabhisamāya tadyogini āhnāyanīyādiśabde prayogāt, āhnāyanīyādī ca kratuyogitvāt, tasiddhayarthatayaiva puruṣapravṛttyupapatteḥ |
tathā adhya- yanavidhe api ācāryakaraṇavidhiprayuktyā eva anu- ṣṭhānalābhāt niyojyatvyābhidhānamiti sthitam |
pradhāno- tpattiniyogā adhikāraniyogāstviṣayānuṣṭhānaineva labdhasiddhayaḥ, iti na tatra niyojyābhidhānamanveṣaṇam |
ajñotpattiniyogā api viniyuktaprājādiviṣayatvāt adhikāraniyogā eva sidhyantīti kiṃ teṣu niyojyā- nvitābhidhāne |
kathaṃ punaḥ prajājādividhīnāṃ viniyukta- viṣayatvam ? ucyate |
sādhikāraniyogasaṃnidhau prajājādivākyāni śrutāni, na tāvat svagāviṣaya- niyogāntaramavagamayitumīśate |
avaghātādidadanuvāda- katvasaṃbhavāt kintu svarūpamātrameva yogasya svapadārthe-
viśiṣṭamupapādayati, tacca prayojanākāṅkṣitayā prayojanī- bhūtena sādhikāraṇa niyogenaivādhīyate iti adhikāra- vākyata eva liṅgaśabdaḥ tadanvitaṃ svārthamabhidhatte |
karaṇopakārākāṅkṣasya ca apūrvasya yat karaṇopakāratva- parikalpanaṃ sa prakaraṇavyāpāra iti tatra yatteṣāṃ karaṇopa- kārajanakatvakalpanam, tadapādānikam |
na ca nāsti kṣaṇikānāṃ teṣāṃ saṃbhūyetikartavyatātvānupapattiḥ, niyogāntarasyānyathāśraya- ṇīyatvāt |
yo'sau liṅgādiḥ prāganumānārthatayā śaṅkitaḥ, sa idānīṃ niyogāntaramabhidhatte |
ata eva avaghātā- divedeṣāṃ yadyadiśadanāmeva aṅgavākyagatānāmadhi- kāraniyogānvitasvāmibhimānaṃ nābhyupagamyate |
tathāhi sati utpattau eva ajñatayā aṅgarūpasyānyatirakṣīnatvāt niyogāntaraviṣayatā na syāt |
upadiṣṭaśāyāṃ tu ananya- niṣṭhatvā''bhimānāt yuktaṃ niyogāntaraviṣayatvam |
nahyekaṃ santu yugapat kāryadvaya- saṃbandhaṃ śakyamavagamyatum |
yacca tat niyogāntaraṃ prayājā- diṣu, tat paścādabhidhīyamānaṃ adhikāraniyogāttayaiva śabdenābhidhīyate |
nanu niyogasya kāmyamānaphalasādhanatvamabhyupagamāt phalasyaiva prādhānyāt tasyaiva vākyārthatvamityata āha- ‘ātmasiddhayanukūlasya niyogasya prasidvaye |
’ yattada- pūrve kāryam, tasya niyojyānyaṃ vinā kāryyānupapattiḥ, anuṣṭhānaṃ vinā tadasaṃbhavāt, karma ca vinā tadupapatteḥ |
adhikāriṇā ca vinā karturabhāvāt, niyojyatvaṃ vinā tadayogāt akāmasādhane ca niyogānvagamāt ityātma- siddhayarthameva niyogaḥ kāmyamānaphalasiddhayetavamavalabhyate svāmitvat |
yathā ātmāna eva saṃvidvānaḥ svāmī garbhadāsasyopakaroti, tathā niyogo'pi niyogasyeti na prādhānyadaprayuktiḥ |
nanu niyogasya phalasādhanatvāt tasya ca setikartavyatākaraṇanyanasiddhitvāt tadupadānān-
nvaraṃ niyogasiddheḥ phalasiddhiḥ syāt, athā'nantaraṃ niyogo niṣpadyate, tarhi kriyāmātramītāyā kutaḥ tasiddhirityāha- 'vipyānuṣṭhitau satyāṃ siddho nahi vidhiḥ phalam |
' eṣā atra darśanasthitiḥ pradhānotpattiniyogā aṅgotpatti- niyogaśca yathāyathaṃ saṃnipatyopakārāṅgayuktasvaviṣayamātrātu- ṣṭhānenaiva sidhyanti |
tatra yānyaṅgāpūprāṇi, tāni saṃbhūya pradhānotpatyapūrvamupakurvanti, tassācca paramāpūrva niṣpadyate |
yānyapi nāṅgāni dīkṣaṇīyādīni teṣāmapi āgādupakārakādiviśeṣikāṅgābhājāṃ ekamupasaparvam, apamapyaṅgāpūrva pradhānavat veditavyamiti |
itthaṃ yapi karmānuṣṭhānatantrameva viniyogasiddhiḥ, tathāpi yatphalatvānantarābhavaṃ tat upa- pattyā kalpyate, asti kiñcid apekṣaṇīyamaparam, yadasaṃnidheḥ pha
' iti śrīśālikanātha- miśrakṛtāyāṃ vākyārthamātṛkāyāṃ dvitīyaḥ paricchedaḥ (niyogavividhādaḥ nāma, prakaraṇapañjikā pṛ. 25-27,
niyogaśabdena kriyātiriktampūrve kartavyatā ātmani puruṣaṃ niyujānamucyate |
12|7|25 pṛ. 288. niyojanaṃ upakāraṇāntarameva iti yathāprakṛti prājāpatyapaśuṣu anuṣṭhānam |
bhāṭṭa. 5|2|1. niyo- janam (agnīṣomīyasya paśoḥ vikṛtau) audumbare śrayate |
kevale ca lādire prakṛtau 'lādire badhnāti' iti |
10|1|18|63 niyojanaṃ paśoḥ uttaravedisthe khayiṣṭhe paridhau saumikeṣu cāturmāsyeṣu |
10|1|3. niyojanaṃ prākṛtamanudya vihitena paridhinā prākṛtasya yūpasya bādhaḥ saumikeṣu cāturmāsyeṣu |
bhā. 3|6|7|18. niyojanadayaḥ uttare saṃskārāḥ upakāraṇe svīkṛtena krameṇaiva kartavyāḥ |
na vyatyāsena, vājapeye prājāpatyapaśuṣu so'yaṃ pravṛttikramaḥ |
kimidaṃ niravadānamiti ? niṣkṛṣya tasmādaṅgāt avadānaṃ niravadānam, dviravacatīti |
(bhojana- pātrāt bahiṣkṛtaḥ, yasya bhojanapātre dvijo na bhuṅkte sa niravasitaḥ ityanyoktam |
) su. pṛ. 172. nirasanaṃ na lohitādiprayojakam 'lohitaṃ nirasyati' iti dvitīyayā tasya pratipattivācyamāt, kintu pratipattiḥ agnīṣomīye paśau |
ke. 4|1|2|27, nirasanasya lopaḥ lohitasyābhāve nāśo vā |
