lopa- nimittaṃ tu prāyaścittaṃ bhavatyeva agnīṣomīye paśau |
nirastapādape deśe eraṇḍo'pi drumāyate iti nyāyaḥ |
ṛju. pṛ. 102. nirākāṅkṣasya vidheḥ upasaṃhāraprabhāvena saṃkoco na yuktaḥ |
parākramaḥ. 43|2, nirākāṅkṣasya vidheḥ mantraliṅgātnusāreṇa saṃkocaḥ indrītādhikaraṇe nirākṛtaḥ |
bhāṣyam- nanu sarva eva nirālambanaḥ svapnavat pratyayaḥ |
pratyayasya hi nirāla- mbanatā svabhāva upalakṣitaḥ svapne |
jāgrato'pi stambha iti vā kuḍya iti pratyaya eva bhavati, tasmāt so'pi nirālambanaḥ |
stambha iti jāyate buddhiḥ sugari- niścitā kathaṃ viparyayasthitī svapne'pi evameva sugari- niścitā āsīt prāk prabodhanāt, na tatra kaścit viśeṣa iti |
yadi pratyayatvāt svapnapratyayasya mithyābhāvaḥ, jāgratpratyaya- syāpi tathā bhavitumarhati |
atha pratītiḥ tathābhāvāśca hetūḥ, na śakyate pratyayatvāt ayamanya iti vaktum ( vadituṃ iti vṛhatīpāṭhaḥ |
kuna iti cet, manidrasya manaso daurbalyāt, nidrā mithyābhāvasya hetuḥ, svapnādau, svapnānte ca suptasuptābhāva eva |
rūpapradarśanakāle'pi nāvagamyate iti cet, tatra prabuddho hyavagacchati nidrā''krāntaṃ me mana āsīditi |
bṛhatī- 'nanu sarva eva nirālambanaḥ svapnavat pratyayaḥ' |
kutaḥ ? tatsaṃpratyuktatvaṃ atasaṃpratyuktatvaṃ vā, yena viśeṣeṇa pratyakṣapratyayaviśeṣa upalabhyeta |
pṛ. 53. ṛju- yadi paramārthataḥ arthaḥ syāt tadā saṃpra- yogajaṃ pratyakṣaṃ iti śakyate vaktum |
sarvapratyayānāṃ tu nirālambanatve pāramārthikābhāve nedaṃ sidhyati iti pratyakṣa- lakṣaṇākṣepeṇa saṃgatirityārthaḥ |
bṛhatī- kathaṃ punaḥ 'sarva eva nirālambanaḥ pratyayaḥ' ? 'pratyayasya hi nirālambanatā svabhāvaḥ upalakṣitaḥ svapne' |
nanu ca śuktikāyāṃ rajatajñānam, 'sarāmīti pramoṣāt smṛtijñānamuktam |
tatra hi śuktikāyāṃ yat bhāsvaraṃ rūpaṃ cakṣuṣā paricchinnam, tat rajatasmṛteradroṣṭhakaṃ ityupapadyate |
svapnādiṣu punaḥ kasyacit agrahaṇāt arthāntare smṛtyudbhavaparihāraḥ śakya iva pratibhāti |
tasmāt vāsaneva nimittaṃ iti laghvī kalpanā, nārthāntaraśrayaṇam, ayāteḥ |
ataḥ kuḍyādiṣvapi jñānaṃ vāsanānimittameva, na kuḍyādyarthanimittaṃ iti sthitiḥ |
kāryasiddhayarthe hi kāraṇaṃ kalpyate, na punaḥ kāryavināśāya |
svapnādiṣu bahiravabhāsā saṃvit, sā ca bāhyārthamantareṇa na saṃbhavati |
yena ca vinā yanna saṃbhavati tat tasya kāraṇam |
tasmāt artha eva kāraṇaṃ iti yuktaṃ kalpayitum |
tasmāt akṣajñaṃ jñānaṃ na vāsanānimittaṃ ityuktam |
nanu svapnopalabdhaṃ mithyā iti pratibuddhasya jñānamupayate |
na ca akāraṇasya mithyā- pratyayasyāpi utpādo na ghaṭate |
satyaṃ na ghaṭate, na tu agatyanuguṇaṃ tat |
( yadyapi jñānotpādāya kāraṇaṃ kalpanīyaṃ tathāpi artha eva na kalpyaḥ; kintu vāsanāmāttram ) tasmāt bhyāmohahetavo mithyāpratyayāḥ |
ato vāsanānindhanamevedaṃ jñāna- mī. pṛ. 297 jālaṃ iti tattvavidbhirditam |
vāsanāto vyāmohaḥ, vyāmohāt vāsanā iti anāditvāt bījāṅkuravat adopaḥ |
na nu smṛteḥ udbodhakāraṇābhāvāt naitat saṃbhavati ityuktam |
ataḥ adṛṣṭamevameva svapnādijñānam, kiñciccintādihetukaṃ ityupapannaṃ śuktikādijñānatulyatvaṃ svapnavijñānasya |
tadida- muktam ( yadidamasminnucyate agrahaṇātmakaḥ pramoṣo mithyātvahetviti tadeva bhāṣyakāroktam ) 'stambha iti jāgrato buddhiḥ supariniṣṭhitā kathaṃ viparyayasthitī' |
kathamenaṃ idamuktam ? ( ityayuktaṃ ) niścitaṃ avacchinna- mityarthaḥ |

kathaṃ avacchinno'vacchinno bhavati ? ( nanu agrahaṇānimittye sarvajñānāni mithyā syuḥ, sarvātmanā arthasya kenacit jñānena agrahaṇāt iti pṛcchati -) kathaṃ tarhi prabuddho mithyeti jānāti ? ( uttaraṃ ) uktam, 'sarāmīti smṛtipramoṣāt ( smṛtivā- parāmarśān ) pratyakṣasaṃmitaṃ tat |
anumeyārtha ( agrahaṇātmako bhrama iti ) spaṣṭīkaroti- 'atha pratītitvābhāvāt hetuḥ, na śakyate pratyayādamaya iti vaditum' |
daurbalyaṃ ca kāryā- kṣamātvam, na kāryāntarautpattisamarthatvaṃ ityuktam |
ślokā- ( uttaragranthasya prayojanamāha ) 'pramāṇa- tvāprāmāṇatve, puṇyapāpādi, tatphalam |
arthasya sadasadbhāve yatnaḥ kāryaḥ kriyāṃ prati |

ratnākaraḥ-- yadi sarvā buddhayo bāhyārthāḥ svāṃśa- paryavasāyino bhaveyuḥ, tato yo'yaṃ (vyavahāraḥ), codanā dharme pramāṇam, anyadapramāṇam, taṃsaṃyogajaṃ pralakṣma, attaṃsaṃyogajamābham, jyotiṣṭomādi puṇyam, brahmahatyā pāpam, tadubhayavilakṣaṇaṃ abhyudayapratyavāyātmakaṃ teṣāṃ phalam, vidherarthaḥ pravartanam, arthavādasya prayojanamarthaḥ, mantrāṇāmanuṣṭheyaprakāśakatvam, nāmadheyānāṃ guṇaphalavidhānārtha- tvavicāraḥ, ādiśabdopāttaśca smṛtyācāraprāmāṇya- prāmāṇyavicāraḥ, tathā śabdāntaraśrutiliṅgaśrutyādibhiḥ karmabhedaśeṣatvakramaniyamāḥ, vacanavyaktibhedena vākyārtha- cintā, karmāṇi kānicit ānuṣṭhikaphalakaphalāni, kānicit aniyataphalāni, kānicit aihikavṛttyādi- phalāni ityādiḥ vyavahāraḥ sa sarvaḥ codanānāmabhāvāt ayuktaḥ syāt |
ataḥ avaśyaṃ dharmmābhiḥ puruṣaiḥ sugatāśīvopoṣasupramāṇāyāni kalpitaviṣayatvena bāhyārtha- sadbhāve lokasaṃmatapramāṇādau bādhanena yatnaḥ karttavyaḥ |
nivṛ- ttyā'sya, tato jñāne tadvat saṃyuktikalpanā |
jñānāpahavavādino'pi prathamaṃ arthamapya nirviṣayajñānā- nupapatteḥ jñānamapyabhavate |
tena arthāpaghavaḥ dvayasādhāraṇa- tvāt jñānāpahavasya ca tanmūlasya tannirākaraṇenaiva nirākaraṇasiddheḥ tadeva nirākriyate iti |
ratnākaraḥ. nirālambanavādaḥ pṛ. 217-221. nirālambanavāde bāhyo vipayo'pi nāsti saṃvidagatā nīlādyākārā api na santi |
vāla. pṛ. 6. nirālambanavādanirāsena bāhyārthasadbhāvaḥ aupa- tikasūtre eva bhāṣye uktaḥ |
vāla. pṛ. 6. nirālambanavādinaḥ sarvāṇi bāhyapratādiviṣaya- kāni savikalpakajñānāni mithyārthaviṣayakāni bāhyārtha- viṣayakajñānātvāt svaprapratyayavat |
svaprajñānānāṃ hi bāhyaghatrākāreṇa pariṇataṃ jñānameva viṣayaḥ, na ghaṭādi, tadānīmabhāvāt, manaḥpratyāsatyabhāvāt, svaśiraccheda- nādīnāmabhāvācca |
evaṃ sarvajñānānāṃ iti dṛṣṭāntena na kiñcidapi jñānaṃ pramā ityāhuḥ |
kiñca 'nīlo'yam' ityādisavikalpa- kānāṃ ātmaviṣayakatve 'nīlo'yam' ityākāratvā- pattiḥ |
vitarāmityumane iti nirihaṃ nirihameva nirihakam, ekasmin karmaṇi upayukkamityarthaḥ |
niriha- kānāṃ api ṛtvijāṃ deśasya ca punarupādānaṃ śiṣṭā na nivarttayanti |
niṣkāntaṃ iṣṭaṃ icchā vini- yogākāṅkṣā yasmāt tat nirihakam |
vā. 1114|4 pṛ. 156, niruktena tāvat lokavyavahāraprasiddhānye padāni
su. pṛ. 129. nigamaniruktavyākaraṇa- vaśena dhātuto'rthaḥ kalpayitavyaḥ |
candrābhyuditeṣṭiḥ, haviṣi niste syāt havirnirvapā- nantaraṃ candrodaye sati syāt |
'yasya havi- rniruptaṃ purastāt candramā abhyudeti' iti nirvāpasaṃyogena iṣṭeruktatvāt iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtreṇa prāptaṃ bādhaśabdena nirucya siddhānta- māha |
akāle karmaṇi pravṛtte eva candrodaye sati iṣṭi- reṣā syāt |
taccet nirvāpāt prāk jātam, tadā nimittasattvāt naimittikaṃ karttavyameva |
yadi nirvāpāt prāgapi pravṛttamātre darśakarmaṇi candro- daye sati abhyudayeṣṭiḥ syāt tadā 'yasya havirniruptam' iti nirvāpasaṃyogaḥ kimarthamiti cet, āha siddhāntī |
tathāca nirvāpāt prāgapi pravṛttamātre darśakarmaṇi candro- daye sati abhyudayeṣṭiḥ syāt ityatra anyārthadarśanaṃ bhavati 'sa yadi agṛhītaṃ havirabhyudiyāt tadā evaiva vratacaryā' iti |
tasmāt pravṛttamātre karmaṇi candrodaye sati abhyu- diteṣṭiḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
agṛhītaṃ haviḥ abhilabhya sa candraḥ yadi udiyāt, tadā nirvāpottaraṃ vā vratacaryā uktā, evaiva karttavyā iti śrutyarthaḥ |
ke. niruktāni nāma padāni saviśāyāni ityu- cyante, teṣāṃ cintā tadupadeśādhikaraṇe |
ke. niruktādayaḥ paśavaḥ somāt prāgapi karttavyāḥ |
varuṇapraghāseṣu prājahitādeva praṇayanavat nirudapaśāvapi saṃbhavātra śālāmukhīyo bhavet |
iti prāpte, prakṛtau śālāmukhīye saumikasya kasyāpi kāryasyā- bhāvāt pāśukakāryārthameva tadupādānena pañcāṅgāvācodaka- lambhaḥ śālāmukhīyo nirudādiṣvāpi syādeva |
ke. nirudapaśau asatyapi dīkṣite daṇḍasaṃpādanasya daṇḍadānaṃ prayojakam |
nirdejanaṃ hi ubhayaṃ karoti kambalaśuddhiṃ pādyośca nirmalatām |
nirdeśa: darśapūrṇamāsayo: caturdhākṛtasyāgneyapuroḍāśasya 'idaṃ brahmaṇa:' ityādinā kriyate |
kṛṣṇaleṣu tu brahmaṇa eva sarvasya samarpaṇatyānna nirdeśa: kartavya: |
'āsīnā japati' iti brīhipadasyamabhi-vyāhāreṇa 'nirdeśādanya:' itinyāyena bādhita: adhvaryu-kartṛkatvotsarga: , tādṛkpadābhāvāt gargasya vileṃ vidhayati ityatra anuvartate |
ajhīṣomīye paśau khādira: pālāśo rohitakaśca yūpo vikalpena śruta: |
vikalpe sati yat pravṛttam, yamuddiśya prayoga: pravṛtta: tatsadṛśa eva pratinidhirādeya: , na tu vaikalpikaṃ dravyaṃ pratinidhirbhavati |
nirdeśāt mukhyadravyavācakaśabdena mukhyasadṛśasyāpi katipayāvayavānuvṛttitvād nirdiṣṭatvāt nirdeśasaṃbhavāt |
vaikalpikasya tu na tathā nirdeśa: śakya: |
tasmāt khadirāpacāre kadara: nāma śvetakhadira:, brīhyapacāre nīvārāśca grāhyā: |
pūrvapakṣe yadi brūyāt aśvadaṃ khadirasadṛśaṃ śabdavattvāt vaikalpikameva grāhyaṃ iti |
nāsti pratipādaka: śabdo yasya tat aśvadaṃ iti bahuvrīhi: |
anajñtvāt khadira-saṃkalpayukte prayoge vaikalpikasya palāśade: aśvatvābhāvāt na tasya grāhyatā |
sahaśasya sākṣāt mukhyaśabdāvācyatve'pi gauṇyā vṛttyā mukhyasadṛśa: mukhyaśabdena bodhyate eva |
tasmāt pratinidhi: mukhyasadṛśa eva, na vaikalpikaṃ dravyam |
agnīṣomīye paśo 'barhiṣā yūpavattvamasti' iti 'ājyena yūpamankti' iti ca śrutam |
yūpaājye ca ājya-dharmā: kartavyā: iti pūrvapakṣe utsūtre prāpte siddhāntayati |

nirdeśāt vikṛtau prākṛta-kāryamukhenaiva dharmāṇāṃ atideśāt agnīṣomīye paśau apūrvasya aprākṛtasya yūpavattvaraṇabarhiṣa: yūpa-jñānāpasya ca saṃskāra:, tasya anadhikāra:, na adhikāra:, nānuvṛtti:, nātideśa: |
tathā cātra laukikaṃ asaṃkṛtameva barhi: ājyaṃ ca grāhyaṃ iti siddhānta: |
nirdeśācca vikṛtau (3|8|16|32) ityadhikaraṇa-nyāyasya svarūpam 'klṛptopakārakāsaṃbhave kalpanā-gauravāpādākalaptopakārakājñānā nākāṅkṣā' iti |
su. pṛ. 634, nirdeśācca vikṛtau ityatra barhirājyādhikaraṇasya (1|4|7) prayojanaṃ spaṣṭīkariṣyate |

pṛ. 469, nirdeśācca vikṛtau ityatra 'barhiṣā yūpavattvamasti' iti aprākṛtayūpavattvaraṇasyākāryadharmārthaṃ prākṛtānāṃ barhidharmāṇāṃ asti nāstīti cintāyā: prākṛtavaikṛtāṅga-prāptiparvāparyecintāthīnāṃ dharmasādhāraṇyaśāstrātideśa-yogaśca, pratyakṣatvena prākṛtaikāprāpte: paścādatidiśya-māne 'barhirlanā' ityādinā sarvaprākṛtavaikṛta-barhirlanādidharmavidhividharmāt yūpavattvaraṇa-barhiṣo'pi dharmavattvā iti pūrvapakṣe klṛptopakārāsaṃbhave kalpanāgauravāpādākalaptopakājñānāt vikṛtau prākṛtānāmajñānāṃ pūrvanirdeśāt vaikṛtasya
yūpavattvaraṇarhiṣa: prākṛtadharmavidhau adhikāra: iti siddhānto vakṣyate |
tena prākṛtānāmajñānāṃ vaikṛtebhya: prāk prāpti: syāsyati |
nirdeśācca'nyadāgamayet (6|4|12) iti siddhāntasūtre prasegāt prāk dāvadānasya nāśadoṣāpahārahetu 'puroḍāśāntatopahāraṃ vakṣyate |
yadi ca nirvāpavelāyāmeva yāganivṛttirbhavet, tathā sati taduttarakālaṃ nāśadoṣā-pahārahetu dravyāntaraṃ nopādeyeta, tatra 'nirdeśācca' ityādi 'vidyate |
'nirdeśācca' vaidikānāṃ syāt (1|2|1|213) ityatra vakṣyamāṇena agnīnāṃ laukikaidisarvārthatva-nirāsanāyena drakṣyati |
ke. nirdhoraṇaṃ jātiguṇakriyāsaṃjñāmiḥ samudāyāt ekadeśasya pṛthakkaraṇam |
rahasya. pṛ. 155. nirvananthyaḥ abhicayanagateṣvāpākāryaḥ manthanasādhyaḥ śāstrīyadharmarahitaḥ laukiko'miḥ |
ke. 1|4|9|12. nirvananthyaḥ agnīpomīyapaśugataḥ sadhamaikaḥ śāstrīya- saṃskārasahito'miḥ |
nirvananthyena iṣṭakāḥ pacanti' iti nirvananthyaśabdaḥ paṅkajā- diṣadāvat yogaladaḥ |
abhicayana sadya eva laukika- mayanena jātaḥ aciranirmeyitaḥ |
nirvananthyayoḥ abhicayanagateṣṭakā- pākārthasya agnīpomīyapaśugatasya ca prakṛtitvikārabhāvo nāsti iti nāsti dharmatideśaḥ |
abhicayanye paṭhitaḥ 'nirvananthyeṣṭakāḥ pacanti' iti nirvananthyaśabdo yaugikaḥ |
bhāṣyam— abhicayana 'nirvananthyeṣṭakāḥ pacanti' iti saṃskṛte darśanāt saṃskārādiho nirvananthya iti |
asaṃskāre'pi dṛśyate 'nirvananthyaṃ ānaya odanaṃ pacyamaḥ' iti |
yathā 'nāvanītena bhuṅkte' iti acira- nirdeṣṭena iti gamyate |
vā— nirvananthye'pi pūrvādhikaraṇavat jātisaṃskāra- nimittapakṣau ubhyāva anantareṇa yaugikatvaṃ sādhanīyam |
'loke kamārthalakṣaṇam' ( 1|1|2|4|26 ) iti aśabdārthenāpi vyavahārāt bhavet aciranirdagdhaghṛta- pratītiḥ |
iha tu śabdapramāṇake anyakriyājanitanivṛttimātracaritārtho nirvananthyaśabdaḥ ciraviśeṣopādānāsamarthaḥ |
nahi atra aciratvamapi yoge antargatam, kriyāyogamātranimittatvāt |
' yathaiva lohitoṣṇīṣādiṣiviṣu viśeṣaṇāṃ prāptātvāt viśeṣaṇa- paratvam, evamihāpi viśeṣānuvādena viśeṣaṇabhūtā kriyaiva pākāñtvena vidhīyate |
ajñānāṃ ca pradhānena eka- deśakālakartṛkatvaṃ vakṣyate ( 1|1|2|1 ) |
tena acira- nirmeyitena adūranirvananthyitena ananyakartṛnirmeyitena iti vaktavye pradarśanārthamicagrahaṇam |

' bhāṭṭa— 'nirvananthyeṣṭakāḥ pacanti' ityatra nirvananthya- śabdasya pūrvavat saṃskāravācitve 'nirvananthyamānaya pacyamaḥ' iti laukikaprayogeṇa niraste, mayanakarmatvasya pākādhanībhūtābhrī abhāvena mayanaprayojyatvasya pāka- navanītādāvapi sattvena atiprasaṅgāt araṇiprayojyāmiṣa- nyāpyajātivācitve prāpte, mayanaprayojyatvenaiva upa- pattau rūḍhikalpane pramāṇābhāvāt atiprasaṅgasya pākā- dāvapi prācīnaprayogabhāvenaiva atrodhakatvopapatteḥḥ nirākartuṃ śakyatvāt navanīte vākyavyavasthāpi vaktuṃ śakyatvācca yaugika eva nirvananthyaśabdaḥ |
evaṃ ca 'nirvananthyeṣṭakāḥ pacanti' iti ameḥ pākasāmarthyādeva prāptatvāt mayana- mātravidhiḥ iti tasyāpi prayogamadhye karaṇaṃ siddhānte prayojanam |
tathā darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ barhiḥ ājyaṃ ca sadharmakamāmnātam, paśau ca 'barhiṣā yūpāvaṭamavastunāti' iti 'ājyena yūpamankti' iti ca vihitam |
yathā vaiṣṇavaśabdande na dharmātideśakatā, evaṃ nirvananthyādipu nirvananthya-barhirājyaśabdeṣvapi na dharmāti- deśakatā |
paśugatau barhirājyāśabdhau darśapūrṇa- māsagatabarhirājyadharmān na gṛhṇītaḥ |
tataśca nirvananthya- barhirājyaśabdāḥ na dharmātideśakā iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhāṣyam— paśau agnīpomīye dharmān nirvananthyo- 'mirāmnātaḥ 'sādhyā vai devāḥ' ityārabhya |
tathā darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ barhirājye dharmavatī, paśau śrūyate 'barhiṣā yūpāvaṭamava- stunāti' iti, 'ājyena yūpamankti' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ nirvananthyādayaḥ śabdāḥ dharmāṇāṃ grāhakāḥ, neti |
te trayo'pi svārthe vidhāya kṛtāthī bhavanti, dharmān grahītuṃ na śaktuvanti |
paśau 'ayejainitramasi ityabhimanthanaśakala nidadhāti' ityā- dinā nirvananthyasya dharmā āmnātāḥ |
tathā darśapūrṇa- māsayoḥ ājyasya upavanādayaḥ barhiṣa lavanadayo dharmā āmnātāḥ |
tṛtīye ( 8|8|16 ) 'barhiṣā yūpāvaṭa- mavastunāti' ityatra barhidharmā lavanadayaḥ paśau codaka- prāptāḥ |
dharmā na bhavanti ityucyate iti vivekaḥ |
atideśo na sā, SSco'ṣṭu dharmāye, tacca pūrvavat ||
paśau 'barhiṣā yūpāvaṭamavastunāti' 'ājyena paśu- mankti' iti ca śrutam |
tataḥ pūrvavadeva nirvananthyaśabdo manthanakriyāvidhāyakatvena gauṇatvāyogyāt na pākukānāṃ mathanadharmāṇāṃ atideśārthaḥ |
na ca trikapālasya nāmātideśena dharmaprāpyabhāve'pi aiṣṭikadharmātideśena nirākāṅkṣatvāt na gauṇatvāṅgīkāraḥ, prakṛte tu dharmākāṅkṣatvena gauṇatvāṅgīkārān nāmāti- deśopapattiḥ iti vācyam |
' nirvananthyaśabdaḥ abhicayanagataḥ paśugataḥ paśugata- nirvananthyadharmān na gṛhṇāti |
maṇi. pṛ. 12. nirvanaparṇa prokṣaṇaṃ avahananaṃ ityevāmadayaḥ auṣadha- dharmāḥ |
bhā. 1|1|4|14|48. nirvanapallavanayaḥ vrīhīṇāmeva dharmāḥ, upavanādayaḥ ājyasyaiva, dohanādayaḥ sānāyasyaiva iti dharmāṇāṃ vyavasthā |
'nāmāsi' iti mantraḥ, tasya ki sakṛtprayogaḥ, uta āvṛttiḥ iti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha|
nirvāpaṇaṃ nirvāpaḥ, lavanaṃ darbhāṇāṃ chedanam, sāraṇam, ājyagrahaṇaṃ ca teṣu eka- dravyavata vrīhiṣva mantrasya sakṛt prayogaḥ syāt|
nirvāpaṇe haviṣpāṇāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ sūpe āvāpanaṃ phalam|
evaṃ phalaikatvāt mantrasya sakṛtprayogaḥ syāt iti|
pratimuṣṭi pratilavanaṃ pratyāstaraṇaṃ pratyājyagrahaṇaṃ ca tāsaṃ- skārāt tattatsaṃskārārthe mantrasya āvṛttiḥ syāt iti|
nirvāpaṇaśabdena aihiko vidhyanto niyamyate 'saurye caruṃ nirvapet' ityatra|
vi. 10|1|15. nirvapatitvedeṣa prakṛtiliṅgasāhacaryeṇa prākṛtapari- māṇātideśasiddhayarthe asmin (savanīyayūpasya) pari- māṇe trivṛttvānuvādaḥ|
bhāṭa. 4|4|9. nirvapatiśabdaḥ śrayamāṇo darśapūrṇamāsavidhyantaṃ niyamayati punaḥśravaṇāt|
dup. 10|1|15|25. nirvapatiśabdena dāśapūrṇamāsikavidhyantayoginā liṅgena tadīyo vidhyantaḥ prasajyate 'saurye caruṃ nirvapati' ityatra|
bhā. 8|1|2|2. nirvāpaḥ amīṣomīyapuroḍāśasya pūrve kāryaḥ paścāt upāṃśuājyanirvāpaḥ, paurṇamāsyāṃ pāṭhakramasya mukhyakramāt balīyastvāt|
ke. 5|1|8|16, nirvāpaḥ adhvarakalpāyāṃ pūrve barhistyasrcordharmāḥ, tataḥ sārasvatasyāsya aupadeśikamukhyakramāpekṣayā ātideśikapāṭhakramasya balīyastvāt|
1|1|1|17-18. nirvāpaḥ adhvarakalpāyāṃ prathamaṃ āgneyavasya tato bārhaspatyayoḥ, vaikṛtamukhyakramānurodhāt|
bhāṭa. 5|1| 10, nirvāpaḥ avaśiṣṭaḥ tūṣṇīṃ kartavyaḥ ardhaniṣṭe candrābhyudaye sati|
bhā. 6|5|18-20, nirvāpaḥ gārhapatyāt paścime deśe agniṣṭe nāma śakaṭe prakṛtau|
jyotiṣṭome'pi aihiko nirvāpaḥ tataiva kartavyaḥ, na havirdhānaśakaṭayoḥ|
vi. 12|1|17. nirvāpaḥ catuḥ- saṃkhyāviśiṣṭa ekaḥ padārthaḥ|
ke. 5|1|4|4. nirvāpaḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ caturbhirmuṣṭibhirarbhavati 'caturo muṣṭīn nirvapati' iti vidheḥ vājapeye saptadaśaśarāve caruṃ caturbhiḥ kuḍavaiḥ śarāvapūraṇaṃ kāryam|
vastutastu śarāvaireva sākṣāt satadaśabhinirvāpaḥ kartavyasyaiva śravaṇāt|
ke. 10|2|8|165-68. nirvāpaḥ paśupuroḍāśasya sava- nīyapuroḍāśānāṃ saumyacarośca havirdhānaśakaṭyāṃ bhinne śakyete, na tu havirdhānaśakaṭyoranyatarasmin|
bhā. 12| 1|17|4-16, nirvāpaḥ prāta:kālikasya yāgatrayasya adhvarakalpāyām 'purā vācaḥ pravaditornirvepet' |
ke. 11|2|4|19, nirvāpaḥ vaikṛtīmya eva devatābhyaḥ abhyuditeṣṭau darśapravṛttaśca nirvāpāt prāgapi candrā- myudaye|
vāla. pṛ. 112. nirvāpāt prāgapi darśapravṛttaścaraṃ candrābhyudaye abhyuditeṣṭyanuṣṭhānam|
5|1|2|4-5, nirvāpasya deśaḥ, apareṇa gārhapatyaṃ prāgīṣaṃ anaḥ avasthitaṃ bhavati, tasya dakṣiṇakramāruhyā anaso'dhi nirvapati' iti|
ke. 10|2|17|64, nirvāpayoḥ āgneyā- gnīṣomīyayoḥ padārthānusamayaḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ|
5|1|2| 4-5, nirvāpe aṃśataḥ kṛte tataścandrodaye, śeṣa- nirvāpaḥ tūṣṇīmeva kartavyo na prākṛtamyo devatābhyo nāpi vaikṛtībhyaḥ|
6|5|18-20, nirvāpa 'agnīṣomā- bhyām' ityatra 'devasya tvā0' ityādi; 'juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi' ityasya ca agniḥ mantrapūrvottarabhāgayorubhayataḥ kartavyaḥ, tena mantravākyapūraṇaṃ bhavati|
bhā. 5|2|13|4-5. nirvāpe darśapūrṇamāsādo 'caturo muṣṭīn nirvapati' tatra pratimuṣṭi 'agnaye juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi' iti mantrāvṛttiḥ|
nirvāpe caturmuṣṭiparimāṇasyā aniyamena yasyakasya- cit muṣṭī prāpte, asādvāśermuṣṭimādattveti preritasya caitrādeḥ svamuṣṭiparimatasyaiva ādānadarśanāt adhvaryoreva muṣṭiḥ|
10|2|12|14-11. nirvāpe vājapeye naivārasya saptadaśaśarāvasya caro- nirvāpe catuḥsaṃkhyānugrahaḥ muṣṭilopaḥ kartavyaḥ (kuḍavā- vimiśritairbhiḥ śarāvaṃ pūrayitvā nirvāpaḥ evaṃ saptadaśa- vāram)|
ke. 10|2|8|164-67. nirvāpānuṣṭhānaṃ āghāne pavamāneṣṭisu agnihotra- havaṇīlope'pi kenacit pātreṇa|
vi. 6|1|18. nirvāpādidharmāḥ citrāyāge caturpañcamayorvibhoḥ sārasvatayormadhye sarasvataḥ prathamaṃ tataḥ sarasvataḥ, 'pra ṇo devī' iti khridevatayā yājyā''nuvākyayoḥ prathamaṃ hautra- kāṇḍe pāṭhāt|
sā ca dṛṣṭārtheṣu pratyakṣena adhvaryave tu śrutvā|
upanayanādayaḥ ājyasyaiva dharmāḥ, na vrīhīdharmāḥ, avaghātādayo vrīhīṇāmeva dharmāḥ nājyasyeti|
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ nirvāpa-barhirlavana-vedirastaraṇa- ājyagrahaṇepu pratinirvā- pādi tattanmantrasyāvṛttiḥ |
yadi viśeṣaṇamiṣyate tato dāśapūrṇamāsika- nirvāpālambhanyāyena kartavyatvavacanena liṅgena viśeṣyadhamam|

vā. 3|8|1|21 pṛ. 775. nirvāpottaraṃ adhvaryuṇā pracaraṇīhomādayaḥ adhva- ryaiṣāt prākṛtanāḥ saumikāḥ padārthāḥ ādau na kartavyāḥ, kintu ādau aihikāḥ prokṣaṇādayaḥ alaṃkārān prākṛtanāḥ kartavyāḥ, tataḥ saumikāḥ|
# nirvāpakāle 'agnaye dāsye' iti yajamānasya mantroccāraṇaṃ tu devatodeśena tyakṣyamāṇatvasaṃkalpanāt yatheṣṭa- viniyogo'yatvalakṣaṇa-svānivṛttirūpatvāgātmakāyārtham|
tatraiva ca darbhāṇāṃ lavanamantraḥ: 'barhirdevasadanaṃ dāmi' iti|
ājyagrahaṇamantraḥ; 'ghānāmāsi' iti; teṣu saṃdehaḥ kiṃ mantrasya sakṛtprayogaḥ; athavā pratimuṣṭi pratidānaṃ pratighāta prati- grahaṇaṃ ca āvṛttiriti|
kiṃ prāptam ? nirvāpaplavana- staraṇaājyagrahaṇepu caikadravyavata prayojanaikatvāt|
nirvāpaṇā- diṣu ekadravyavata syāt, sakṛtprayoga ityarthaḥ|
lavane vedirastaraṇayogyasya barhiṣa upasādanam, staraṇe vedyācchādanam|
yāvatā prayojanaṃ tat tikīrbitam, tadyo mantra ityuktam|
ye vrīhayaḥ ekena muṣṭinā nissāste saṃskṛtāḥ|
tatra yadi mantro na prayujyeta, mantrakṛtena saṃskāreṇa teṣāṃ varjanaṃ syāt|
soma- pūrvasya pratyudāharaṇam: tatraiva pūrvataraśeṣatvāt tena saṃgatiḥ|
sūtrārthastu- nirvāpaplavaṇepu ekadravya- ghāvaghātayat sakṛt prayogaḥ syāt caturmuṣṭirnirvāpādeḥ ekaprayojanatayā yugapat cikīrṣitatvāt iti|
' bhāṭṭa— darśapūrṇamāsayoścaturmuṣṭiparimite vihita- nirvāpasya 'devasya tvā' ityādimantraḥ |
tathā 'ayugmā- yugman muṣṭīn lunāti' iti vihitasya lunanasya 'barhi- devasadanaṃ dāmi' iti |
tathā 'tridhātu pañcadhātu vā vediṃ stuṇāti' iti vihitasya staraṇasya 'ūṇāmadasaṃ tvā stuṇāmi' iti |
'caturjuṣṭhā gṛhṇāti' iti vihitasya ājyagrahaṇasya 'śukaṃ tvā śukāyām' iti mantraḥ samāmnātaḥ |
te kiṃ pratimuṣṭyādi nirvāpādyāvṛttau āva- tainne, na vā iti cintāyām, na tāvada nirvāpādi- bhedaḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ muṣṭyādivṛttitvena pratīteḥ; abhyāsamātraṃ tu nirvāpādeḥ |
iti prāpte, yuktamavaghāte saṃskāradvayasyaikatvāt te eva hi vrīhayaḥ pratiprahāramavahanyante, atastatra sakṛdeva yukto mantraḥ |
prakṛte tu saṃskāradvayamedāt satyapi nirvāpādi- karmaṇyeva pratyabhyāsaṃ mantrabhedaḥ |

na ca nirvāpalavanā- jyagrahaṇādiṣu saṃskārabhede'pi staraṇasya dvitīyā vediṃsaṃskārārthatvāt barhirghātnāṃ ca tatra guṇabhūtatvena kathaṃ saṃskārabhedaḥ ? śatapathabrāhmaṇe 'barhiḥ stuṇāti' iti vidyau barhiṣo'pi staraṇasaṃskāratvāvagateḥ |
'barhiṣaḥ' 'barhiṣi' irvīhyāsādyati' iti vacanena havirāsādana upayuk- tatvācca |
yattu 'vedyāṃ havīṣyāsādayati' iti vacanam, sat vederapi paraṃparayā havirādhāratvāt nānupapannam |
na ca vedirbarhiṣvilapāśāt, 'vedirasi barhiṣe tvā svāhā' iti mantravarṇaina vedeḥ barhiryatvasya bhagavamena vikalpāpādakasākṣādādhāratāvidhāyakatvānupapatteḥ |
ata eva tridhātu pañcadhātu vā ityatra barhiṣa etra saṃskāratā |

astu vā saṃyogapṛthaktvān staraṇasya barhiḥsaṃskārakatvavat vedisaṃskārakatvamapi, vedirbarhiṣoḥ parasparasaṃskāre parasparasambandhasya satvāt, vikalpā- sambhavena 'vedyāṃ havīṣyāsādayati' ityasya paraṃparāsaṃbandha- nuvādakatvam |
saṃkāratvācca 'yoṣā vai vediḥ tāmanamāṃ karoti' iti staraṇārthatvādasya upapattiḥ |
na ca pratyabhyāsaṃ saṃskārabheda'pi sakṛtpaṭhitamantrajanasmṛtera- vicchedāt avaghātamantravat anāpatteḥ |

uttamantreṣu sarvatra yuṣmacchandasaṃbuddhyādiśravaṇena liṅgātsāhasraṇāḍyā apūrvaghātībhūtayuṣmadarthaviṣayanirvāpādi-prakāśanārthatvena mantravidhivagataiḥ, tādṛśasmṛtyā yuṣmadarthaviṣayībhūta- nirvāpādiviṣayasaṃskārājananāt |
evaṃ ca staraṇe barhiṣo'pi mantrasya viśeṣaṇī- bhūtayuṣmadarthādiprakāśanārthatvena viniyogāt mantrā- vṛttirapīti śakyaṃ vaktum |
15. tvāpadanirdeśya ātmana eva kaṇḍujanitacitta- vikṣepaniṣṭṛttidvārā saṃskāryatvāt tasya caikatvena nirvāpa- nyāyānupapatteḥ |
ke. 11|4|144. nirvāpamantre 'agraye juṣṭam' ityatra sauryādivikṛtau 'sūryāya juṣṭam' 'indrāgnibhyāṃ juṣṭam' ityādyūhaḥ kartavyaḥ; karmasamavedevatāvācakatvāt |
vi. 9|1|13. nirvāpa- mantre aindrāgnipadaṃ citreṣṭigate aindrāgnipadoṣe |
ke. 9|1| 1-8, nirvāpamantre 'devasya tvā' ityādau aindrāgdi- vikṛtāvi savitṛ-aśvi-pūṣaṇdreṣu nohaḥ |
'devasya savituḥ prasave-devena savitrā yajamānena prasūte udite vā savitari |
aśvinau hi tau agnyādheye aśvadāne, aśritavanto vā tayasaphalamadatvāte |
'nirvāpeṇa agnaye sevanāhaṃ yathā bhavati tathā tān karomi' iti |
ke. 11|4|144. yadā tu ekākale eva ekānekājñaviṣayaṃ kaṇḍuyanam, tadā smṛtvicchedadāt ( mantrasya ) anā- vṛttiḥ |
na ca tadā'pi tvāpadayuktvāt nirvāpamantra- nyāyena ( 11|4|144-48 ) tattadaṅgamedena āvṛttiḥ; ajñānāmupayuktātvābhāvena asaṃkhyārthatvāt tvā- padena tannirdeśānupapatteḥ |
bhāṭṭa. 11|4|16. oṃ nirvāpamantrasyo'gniśabdaḥ samavetavacano vikṛtau ūhitavyaḥ |
idamadhikaraṇaṃ 'ūhaḥ agni- śabdasya vikṛtau nirvāpamantre' ( mīko. bhāga: 3 pṛ. 1225-26 ) ityatra draṣṭavyam |
nirvāpavelāyāṃ 'etasya dāsyāmi' ityetāvanmātraṃ saṃkalpa tyāgaḥ kevalaḥ kriyate na yāgaḥ |
bhāṣyakāreṇopanyāsaḥ kṛtaḥ, sa kṛtvācintānyāyeneti draṣṭa- vyam|
nahi vidhitvamanuṣyatve manuṣyadharmādipakṣa upa- padyate iti|
vidhiriti kṛtvā prathamaṃ prastutaṃ paścāt lakṣaṇānurūpaṃ vicārya ante pūrvāvasthitameva arthavādatva- mupasaṃhariṣyati|
teṣāṃ khatvena tanmatī- yate, na manuṣyāstadaṅgatvena|
arthadeva ca tanmātau satyāṃ naiva manuṣyagrahaṇaṃ kriyate|
sa eṣa na vidhiḥ, anuvāda eṣaḥ|
nivītaṃ hi manuṣyāḥ prāyaśaḥ svārthe kurvanti|
tatra galaveṇikābandho yuddhā- danyatra na prāpnoti|
parikarabandhastu sarvakarmasu anyatrākaratvāt prāpta iti tadāśrayeṇānuvādamāha|
kutaḥ ? pūrvavatvāt hi anuvādo bhavet atyantaprāptāvityarthaḥ|
kaṇṭhabandhaḥ punaḥ prāyaṇa aprāpta evetyasti niyamavidhiravakāśaḥ|
vā-- sati vidhitve karmadharmaprāyapradeśājñānāt kathaṃ- mātrasparśatvāt karmadharmaḥ|
bhāṣyam-- nivītaṃ manuṣyāṇāmityasya vākyaśeṣaḥ samākhyā, ādhvaryavamiti|
vā-- dvedhā saṃbhave tādṛśī pramāṇagatirāśrayaṇīyā, yā pramāṇāntaraṃ na bādhate|
tatra yadi karmadharmo- 'yam, tataḥ kartṛviśeṣapekṣāyāṃ satyāṃ samākhyāyā adhvaryuniyamāt samākhyā arthavatī bhaviṣyati|
manuṣya- dharmāṇāṃ tu na samākhyā niyāmakitti vakṣyāmaḥ|
katham ? yat darśapūrṇa- māsayormanuṣyapradhānam, tatra nivekṣyate anvāhārthakarmaṇi|
vā-- prathamaṃ tāvat manuṣyadharmasyetyatvena karmadharmatvaṃ nirākaroti|
śrutvā hi prakaraṇasamākhye bādhivā manuṣyadharma eva prāpnoti|
manuṣyāṇāmiti tanpradhānakarmavyatirekajanitā ṣaṣṭhī na nivītaṃ gṛhṇāti|
tadapi ca prakaraṇāt anvāhārthadānādi pratīyate nānyat|
ata eṣa vākyarthaḥ: 'yadi manuṣyāṇāṃ karma, tatra nivyātyam' iti|
yattāvat 'upāvītaṃ devānāmupavyate' iti, tat prakṛta- yordaśapūrṇamāsayopavītaṃ vidadhāti|
yat, prācīnāvītaṃ pitṛṇāmiti, tat, pitṛdhāne karmaṇi prācīnāvītaṃ vidadhāti|
yadapyetat, nivītaṃ manuṣyāṇāmiti, tadapi ātithye nirapekṣaṃ vidadhāti|
kathaṃ gamyate manuṣyapradhāne vidadhātīti, manuṣyāṇāmiti ṣaṣṭhyantena saṃbandhāt, manuṣyāṇāmeva prāpnoti, na manuṣyapradhāne|
manuṣyapradhāne punaḥ ṣaṣṭhī bhaviṣyati, saṃbandhaścaivamavakalpiṣyate, phalaṃ caivaṃ na kalpanīyam|
saha ekavākyatāṃ prāpmaya, punaḥ prakṛtābhyāṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmekavākyatāṃ yāsyati|
nahi dvau saṃbandhau ekasmin vākye vidhīyete|
itarasya manuṣyagrahaṇasya nivītasaṃbandhāt tenaiva sahaikavākyatā bhaviṣyati pratyayena śabdena|
tadeka- vākyatāyā arthavattve sati na prakṛtenaikavākyatā aca- kalpyate|
tasmāt prakaraṇaṃ bādhivā ātithye nivekṣyate iti|
yathaiva 'upavītaṃ devānām' 'prācīnāvītaṃ pitṛṇām' iti ca paraspara- nirapekṣadevapitṛpradhānakarmaṇeṣa vidhiḥ|
kathaṃ gamyate iti pṛṣṭhe manuṣyāṇāmiti ṣaṣṭhyantena saṃbandhāt-- ityetāvati uttare datte manuṣyāṇāmeva prāpnoti iti punaśrdayati|
na ca tasmin sati prakṛtenaikavākyatā ghaṭate|
bhāṣyam-- naitadasti, vidhiḥ, sa ca manuṣyapradhāne karmaṇīti|
manuṣyāṇāmiti manuṣyasaṃbandho'tra śrūyate, na manuṣyapradhāne karmaṇā saṃbandhaḥ|
ātithyakarmaṇā tu anirdiṣṭena apra- kṛtena anumeyena saṃbadhyate|
tatra ko doṣaḥ ? prakaraṇa- duṣkṛtyeta saṃbhavastatra|
kathaṃ saṃbhava iti cet ? arthavāda eṣaḥ|
sa prakṛtaṃ subantaṃ prakaraṇe saṃbhavyati, vidhiḥ san utkṛṣyate|
vā-- sarvathā nātra eko'pi pakṣo nidoṣaḥ|
prakaraṇasaṃbandhe vākyasaṃbandhatvāt, annāhārthadisaṃbandhe dvisaṃbandho'pi atyantanirmūla eva|
ṣaṣṭhībhirapi śrutyādi- bhirasaṃsparśatā manuṣyasaṃbandhena tadanumīyate, tacca na yuktam, tasyā api ṣaṣṭhyāḥ nivītapadasaṃbandhavyatirekajanitatva- pratīteḥ|
(anupāttāḥ: saṃbandhino yeṣāṃ saṃbandhavyākhyānaṃ vyatirekāṇām, taiḥ iti vigrahaḥ ) vibhaktayaḥ utpadyante|
sati ca gatyantare na yuktaṃ tadāśrayaṇam|
kutaḥ ? vidhinaika- vākyatvāt 'upanayate devalakṣmeva tatkurute' ityeṣa vidhiḥ|
nahi vidhīvidheyasya eka- vākyatā bhavati, vacanavyakkibhedāt|
kathamupavītastutiḥ ? nivītayogaṃ deva- karmaṇi darśapūrṇamāsasaṃjñake, manuṣyāṇāṃ hi tat|
yathā yāhyo'sya veṣatādṛśo natānām, yāhyo devadattasya tādṛśo brāhmaṇā- nāmiti devadattasyapraśaṃsāyāmitaraveṣakīrtanam|
nāsyatra vidhāyakaḥ śabdo nivītaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ kartavyamiti|
stutyarthena arthavatte sati na śakyaṃ kalpa-
paricche tu ānarthakye iha punarna kiṃcit kalpanīyam |
evaṃ ca vākyena aviruddhaṃ prakaraṇamatha- vadati |
vā-- ' upanayate ' ityanena ca vidhinā eka- vākyatvaṃ nīvītaprācīnāvītayordṛśyate |
nahi ajñāṅkitvarahitayo- ramayoḥ svatantrayoḥ parasparasaṃbaddhayorvidhīyamānayoreka- vākyatā bhavati, vacanavyakteimedāt |
anyā hi pradhāna- vidhestānmātropasaṃhāriṇī vacanavyaktiḥ, anyā ca śruteḥ |
sa yadi vā adhyātavyaḥ athavā ātithyādigatasthāpi aṅgatvāya parikalpyeta |
na ca tatkalpanaṃ yuktam, avihitasyānajñātvāt, anajñasya ca prayogavacanenāgraha- ṇāt |
vakṣyati hi ' na cāvihitamaṅgaṃ bhavati ' iti |
tatra ajñātvāt vidhiḥ, vidheśca aṅgatvaṃ kalpyeta itītare- tarāśrayaṃ prāpnotīti |
pratyakṣeṇa ca vidhinā yathākatha- ñcidekavākyatāyāṃ saṃbhavatyāṃ na parokṣaikavākyatā yuktā |
yathā nīvītaprācīnāvīte manuṣyāṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca praśaste, tathopavītaṃ devānāmiti |
loke'pi caivaṃ dṛśyate yathā vasiṣṭhasyārūpadhatī, yathā śaśāṅkasya rohiṇī, yathā nalasya damayantī, tathā devadattasya yajñadatteti |
tayoḥ pitṛmanuṣyaviṣayatvena devān prati ayogyatāt upavītameva devānāṃ praśastam |
soma-- yadyapi atrāpi prakaraṇasya śrutyādirodhā- virodhavicāra eva kriyate, tathāpi atra prakaraṇena kṛtyarthatvaṃ prāyeṇa pratipādyate iti pādāntaramityāhuḥ |
sūtrārthastu-- ' nīvītaṃ manuṣyāṇām ' iti vākye nīvītaṃ manuṣyadharmo vidhīyate, ṣaṣṭhyantamanuṣyaśabdasya tatrādhānyā- vagamattvāditi |
prāptaṃ nīvītaṃ māyaiṣu prāyeṇaitasya darśanāt, upavītavidhervākyatvā- darthavādatā |
' bhāṭṭa-- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ; ' nīvītaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ prācī- nāvītaṃ pitṝṇāmupavītaṃ devānāmupanīyate devalakṣameva tat kurute ' iti śrutam |
tatra sarvo'pyayam ' upanayate ' ityasya upavītavidheḥ śeṣaḥ; na tu svatantro vidhirityodu- mbarādhikaraṇenaiva sthitam |
yadā vidhiḥ, tadā kṛtvā- cintayā nīvītavākye vicāraḥ |
tatra prakaraṇāt śuddha- kṛtadharmaḥ, manuṣyagrahaṇa tu saṃbandhasāmānyāvacchinnā ṣaṣṭhyā arthāśrayakartṛtvākhyasaṃbandhasyānuvādatvāviruddhamiti āyaḥ pakṣaḥ |
manuṣyagrahaṇasya vaiyarthyāpatteḥ ṣaṣṭhyā aṅgāṅgibhāva- saṃbandhaparatvasākṣāttvāt nīvītasya manuṣyābhilaṣitaphalajana- katvāṅgīkārāt śuddhamanuṣyadharmaḥ ṣaṣṭhyā prakaraṇādvā- diti dvitīyaḥ |
atrādhenopapattau bādhāyogāt, phala- kalpanā''patteśca, saṃnipatyopakārakatvābhāvāt, prakaraṇasaha- kṛtayā tathā jajñyamānamantravat ṛtuyuktapuruṣadharma itya- paraḥ |
atra pūrvapakṣakramako mūle anyathākṛto'pi anu- ṣṭhisahatvādepekṣitaḥ |
tatsambandhihārātmakavākyānurodhāt ṣaṣṭhyāḥ manuṣya- saṃpradānakaprākaraṇikānyāhyārthadānapādidāpyopakārakatva- rūpasaṃbandhaparatvasākṣāt uktavidhasaṃbandhena manuṣyārthatvam |
saṃbhavati hi prācīnāvītāsya pitṛdevatyaprakaraṇaprokṣaṇī- śeṣaninayanajñātvāt pitṛdevatyaprākaraṇikakarmāṅgatvam |
itarathā tasyāḥ guṇa- bhūtakartṛprāptāveva niyāmakatvasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt ṛtuyukta- puruṣadharmatve tadanupapatteḥ |
na ca bhavanmate'pi dānasya yājamānatvāt kathaṃ samākhyopapattiḥ; nīvītasya ārā- dupakārakatvena adhvaryukartṛkenāpi tena dānopakāra- siddheḥ |
yattu mūle pakṣāntaraṃ siddhāntatvena upanyastam, tathāhi ' vākyādayaṃ śuddhamanuṣyapradhāna- kātithyādikamaṅgatvayā vidhiḥ |
na ca tadupasthāpakā- bhāvaḥ, manuṣyapadasya lakṣaṇayā sanakādimanuṣyaparatvena
eva na phalakalpanā''pi ' iti tat vākyādvādhasya |
amāvāsyātāntra prasajyate, uta neti cintāyām, pakṣaḥ |
tastu nāyaṃ vidhiḥ vākyamedāpatteḥ, apitu upavīta- |
vijñāyate svatantrā iyamupajñā na kasyacit karmastantra- |
yathā ca vaiṣṇavo veśvadevasya ' yadadho''vamyeta yacca |
sphaya āśiṣyeta, tad viṣṇava urukramāyāvayet ' iti |
( avadānakāle sucaḥ adhobhāve yat amṛditaṃ saṃlagnaṃ |
syāt yat kiñcit sphaye āśiṣṭhaṃ syāt, tat viṣṇave |
ityādi ityarthaḥ :) nanu ' amāvāsyāyām ' iti nāmā- |
vāsyasya karmaṇo madhye śrutā, na amāvāsyāśabdaḥ karma- |
karmaṇo madhye śrūyate, kasya tantraṃ grahīṣyate |
camasa eva bhaviṣyati ( na godohanam ) tathā aṣṭame |
stāvata amāvāsyāyāṃ rātrau niśīṣṭaḥ, pratipadi ahani |
caite vākye 'amāvāsyāyāṃ yajeta' 'amāvāsyāyāṃ niśi yajeta' iti |
kimataḥ ? yadi samānadeśo syātām, tataḥ 'amāvāsyāyāṃ yajeta' iti yo'sau amāvāsyāyāḥ karmaṇi kāla upapātaḥ, tasminneva ca niśīthasya coditaḥ, iti gamyeta |
atha punardeśabhede sati yathā 'amāvāsyāyāṃ yajeta' ityupātaḥ kālaḥ upādeyatvena codyate, evamihāpi |
na ca tulyakālatve prasaṅgo bhavati yathā vaikṛtyaḥ iṣṭayaḥ darśapūrṇamāsabhyāṃ tulyakālā api satyaḥ, na darśapūrṇa- māsikaṃ tantramupajīvanti |
bhāṣyam-- kimeṣa evotsargaḥ sarvaṃ tantraṃ bhinnam ? na khalu |
vedyudvananaṃ mataṃ ca syāt tadeva yat darśyā- vederuddhananaṃ kṛtam, tena ucyatām : punaruddhanane nahi kiñcit kāryamasti, kevalaṃ kṛtadūṣaṇaṃ bhavet |
upeyamānaṃ ca piṣṭa- peṣaṇavat akiñcitkaraṃ syāt |
amā- vāsyā tantram iyam, na svatantrā |
amāvāsyātantramadhye iyaṃ vihitā 'amā- vāsyāyāṃ niśi nirvapet' iti |
nanu kālavacanato'yaṃ amāvāsyāśabdo na karmavacanaḥ ityuktam |
satyaṃ kāla- vacanaḥ, sa tu kālastantramadhye |
tatra vidhīyamānā tantra- madhye vihitā bhavati sanīyatvat |
tathā sanīyavyāḥ puroḍāśāḥ : na tāvat paśu karma uddiśya vidhīyante, atha ca paśutantramadhye vihitā bhavanti |
yasmin sthāne vihitāḥ tat sthānaṃ paśutantramadhye iti |
iyampi tantra- madhye patitā cet sanīyadeva na svatantrā bhavitumarhati |
idhmaḥ agni- sammidhnārthaḥ : sa pratipadi āhūtaḥ amāvāsyāyāṃ niśi vartamānasya niśīthasya abhimukhimanaṃ na sādhayet |
te yadi prasajñyetām, viguṇo niśīthasyaḥ syāt |
yadi devatāpari- grahāthe agnyanvādhānam, tadapi medena kartavyam |
prākṛtena agnyanvādhānena amāvāsyādevatāḥ parigṛhītāḥ, na ca rakṣo'gniḥ (rakṣo'gniḥ ) |
taparigrahāthamapi agni- dhāraṇārtham, tataḥ prākṛtena dhāritatvāt agneḥ, na kartavyam |
devatāparigrahāthatā vākyaśeṣe śrūyate 'mamāye varco vihevadhastu' iti pūrvamapi parigṛhṇāti, devatā eva tapūrvayaḥ parigṛhītāḥ, śobhūte yajete iti |
soma-- savanīyapaśoḥ savanīyapuroḍāśānāṃ ca eka- saumikaprayogavacanaparigṛhītatvāt pāśukrasya puroḍāśeṣu prasaṅgasambhave'pi bhinnaprayogavacanaprāmāṇyaicchī na dārśikā- jñaprasaṅgaḥ |
nanu āghānānantaraṃ yadā paurṇamāsyāḥ pūrvameva amāvāsyā prāpnoti, tadā tasyāṃ na darśa tantrapravṛttiḥ; darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ pūrṇamāso- pakramatvena tadā darśaṃ karmānuṣṭhānapurutteḥ |
tataśca tasyāṃ niśīthasyānuṣṭhānasambhavāt niśīthakālasya pravṛttā- māvāsyātantratvaniyamaḥ anupapannaḥ |

na ca prakṛtya- nārambhe nimitādivāśāt āpatantyā vikṛterapi anuṣṭhānaṃ ityatra pramāṇamasti, yena niśīthasyānuṣṭhānaṃ darśapūrṇa- māsopakramāt pūrvaṃ na saṃbhavet, tathā sati somāt pūrvaṃ sānāyyāgrīṣomīyarūpaprakṛtyanuṣṭhānābhāvādeva taddhikārāṇā- mananuṣṭhāne sati somā
asmin niśihye prākṛtasya amāvāsyātantrasya apravṛttiḥ pravṛttiḥ syāt |
tatra apa- vṛttiḥ nivṛttiḥ ityarthāt apravṛttiḥ ityeva tātparyam |
bhāpustake tu mūle 'na prasajyate' iti mudritam |
tatra 'na prasajyate' ityuktvā apravṛttiḥ ityeva pāṭhaḥ spaṣṭo bhavati |
kālabhedastatrāt amāvāsyāyāṃ rātrau niśi- yajñaḥ pratipadi ahani amāvāsyāyām |
vākyabhedo'pi bhinnadeśe naite vākye 'amāvāsyāyāṃ yajeta' 'amā- vāsyāyāṃ niśi yajeta' iti |
pariharati-) 'yadāhavanīye' ityanārabhyavādaḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ khādiravat, na sarvārtheḥ |
āhavanīyo'pi homo- deśena prakṛtāveva upadiṣṭaḥ iti khapatīṣṭau codakenaiva prāpnuyāt iti yuktameva bhāṣyamiti ) traivarṇikānāṃ yeṣu karmasu adhikāraḥ, na teṣu āhavanīyādi vidhiprayuktiḥ |
vicinte hi teṣāmādhāna- śrutayaḥ, (yāmiḥ anyathā'nupapattiḥ kṣīyate ) |
evaṃ tu (sati khapatīṣṭiḥ vidhiyantarasaṃpādita-) agnimato niṣādasthapaterabhāvāt (svayaṃ ca ) agniatvāt agni prayukte, amayo'pi ādhāna sāmarthyāt (prayujyate ) ata idamadhānaṃ khapatīṣṭiprayuktam |
(tadevaṃ khapatīṣṭyanyathā'nupapatyā vasantādivākyavihitādhāna- vyatiriktaṃ ādhānāntaraṃ svārthameva prayukte ) |

(kimidamevamapavargābhidhānam, tadāha-) yadi tādarthyānnāpadyate, abhimatvāt (khapatīṣṭiḥ ) samarthaḥ iti itarairapi karmabhiḥ adhikāraḥ, syāt (iti mandadhiyaḥ saṃbhāvayeyuḥ, tadabhramāpanuttaye apavargābhidhānam ) |
śrutyādīnāmāvāt na karmaprayuktā ādhānasya, vākyasāmarthyāt agniprayuktatvāt |
yacca darśapūrṇa- māsaprayuktam, tacodakena prāpyate, na dravyayuktam |
dup- ādhānaṃ anaṅgatvāt (darśapūrṇamāsatvāt ) na codakena prāpyate, na ca khapatīṣṭiprakaraṇe āmnāyate |
'tasmin gṛhṇāni' (iti gautamasmaraṇāt 5|8 ) gṛhayā hitāni ityarthaḥ (gṛhaśabdaśca daṃpatyorvartate |
tatra yeṣu nāhavanīyaḥ, teṣu sarveṣu laukiko'gniḥ |
tasmin gṛhṇāni ityādi- granthaḥ tantraratnamiti bhāṭṭadīpikā ) |
soma- (upanayane ādhānāsaṃbhave'pi ) iha ādhānaṃ saṃbhavati iti pūrvapakṣe'pyeṣana pratyavasthānaṃ saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu- khapatīṣṭiḥ yathā prayājaṃ prayojayati, evamagnyādheyamapi prayojayet |
evaṃ sati agnimatvāt itareṣvapi karmasu adhikāraḥ syāt iti kaścit śaktet syāt iti mantrā āha- tādarthyācāpadyeta iti |
tena ādhānasya saṃskāraparvāt agnimatvābhāvāt na karmāntaraivadhikāra iti |
bhāṭṭa- niṣādeṣṭeḥ darśapūrṇamāsavikṛtitvāt deśena āhavanīyādiprāptau teṣāmādhānādhīnatvāt asatyapi tasya svatantrādhānavidhī niṣādeṣṭereva ādhānaṃ prayojayet |

iti prāpte, satyapi tasya agnijanakāttve'pi syādhānasya brāhmaṇādikartṛkatvena upapannatvāt niṣādakṛte- nāgniṣṭau pramāṇābhāvāt prakṛtau paraprayuktānujīvanena ihāhavanīyādiprāpterabhāvāt na teṣu sā |
vidyāyāstu tadyatirekeṇa niṣādeṣṭereva asaṃbhavattvāpāyasya laukikatvena ākṣepopapattiriti vaipamyam |

tena āhavanīyādyākṣepaka- katve'pi 'yatra kacana hoṣan syāt pañcabhūsaṃskāraṃ kṛtvā laukikāni pratiṣṭhāpayet' iti smṛtivacanena agmyantarā- bhāve homamātroddeśena laukikāgnividhānāt tameva taddeśe sthāpayitvā teṣṭiḥ kāryā |
'tasmin gṛhṇāni' iti gautamavacanaṃ laukikāgniprāpakatvena tantraratne udāhṛtam, tat gautamasmṛtau tacchabdena parāmarśāt
nahi gṛhaśabdavācya- daṃpatyorhitamiti nyupapatyā asyāpi gṛhapadavācyatvam, abhiyuktaprasiddhyā gṛhapadasya gṛhasthoktakarmatvena rūḍha- tvena yogasyāprayojakatvāt |
rājatvādestu kartṛviśeṣaṇatvāt, tasya ca prakṛtau aṅgatvāt vikṛtau atideśaḥ iṣṭa eva |
bhāṣyam- 'vāstumadhye raudraṃ caruṃ nirvapet, yatra rudraḥ prajāḥ śamayet' ityetāmiṣṭiṃ prakṛtya ucyate 'etayā niṣādasthapatiṃ yājayet' iti |
niṣādasthapati iti saṃdehaḥ kiṃ adhikṛtānāṃ anyatamaḥ; uta anya eva eveti |
sa hi samarthaḥ vidvatvāt agni- matvācca |
evaṃ prāpte, brūmaḥ : niṣāda- eva khapatirbhavitumarhati |
niṣādaṃ hi niṣādaśabdaḥ śaknoti vadituṃ śravaṇenaiva |
śrutilakṣaṇā- viśaye ca śrutinyāyyā, na lakṣaṇā |
dvitīyā ca vibhaktiḥ tantreṇa ubhayyāṃ saṃbadhyate |

(kutaḥ ?) evaṃ (hi sati ) pada- dvayam (api ) svārthavṛttam (bhavati ), itarathā (ṣaṣṭhīsamāse ) niṣādaśabdo lakṣaṇayā khapatī adhyā- ropitaḥ syāt (kimiti lakṣaṇā ityata āha-) sāmā- nādhikaraṇyasamāsapratipatyartham |
(nīlotpalasamāse'pi ) utpalaśabdasyāpi tadevadhikaraṇam (pratipādyam ) nīla- śabdasyāpi (tadeva ) ataḥ : (aikādhikaraṇyasya ekārthī- bhāvalakṣaṇam ) sāmarthyam (sidhyati ), sāmarthyācca samāsaḥ |
anyathā (yadi ca niṣādaśabdena niṣāda evocyate, khapatiśabdena ca khapatireva arthā- ntarabhūta ucyate, tataḥ ) bhinnādhikaraṇatvāt sāmarthyā- bhāvaḥ, sāmarthyābhāvācca samāsābhāvaḥ |
tasmāt (samāsa- siddhayartham ) niṣādaśabdena khapatiṃ yāvat gantavyaṃ ityeṣā lakṣaṇā |
yadi atra aśravaṇena (kāraṇena ) lopaḥ (ṣaṣṭhyāḥ : kalpyate, tataḥ ) syādayaḥ (śabdāḥ ) luptāḥ iti kimiti na kalpyate (aśravaṇāviśeṣāt ) |
tato rājapuruṣa ityādinā rājā cāsau puruṣaśca itīhaśo vigrahaḥ kartavyaḥ |
kintu svasvāmisaṃbandhāt (rājapuruṣayoḥ, rājaśabde ) ṣaṣṭhyarthamāropya tadā (ṣaṣṭhīsamāsavelāyām ) samāso bhavati |
rājaḥ puruṣaḥ iti (vigraha-) vākyaṃ artha- pradarśanārtham (spaṣṭīkaraṇārthamiti yāvat ) |
tasmāt khapatiśabde yā (dvitīyā-) vibhaktiḥ, sā itaratra (niṣādaśabde ) anuṣajyate (niṣāda khapati iti ) |
athavā samudāyāt (samastāt niṣādasthapatiśabdāt ) utpannatvāt (dvitīyā ) vinaiva anuṣaṅgeṇa ubhayatrāpi draṣṭavyā |
bhāṣyam-- liṅgaṃ dṛśyate 'kūṭa dakṣiṇā' iti niṣādasya dravyaṃ darśayati |
kūṭaṃ hi niṣādānāmeva upa- kārakaṃ nārthāṇām |
śā-- 'aindraṃ vāstumayaṃ caruṃ nirvapet' iti prakalpya śrūyate 'etayā niṣādasthapatiṃ yājayet' iti |
āhitā- meśca, yadi tu karmadhāraya iṣyate |
nahi ṣaṣṭhī śrutā, yena tatsambandhī vidhi- rbhavet |
ata eva āpastambācāryaiḥ 'haviṣkṛdāhvaya iti śūdrasya' ityaṃ niṣāda eva śūdraśabdena vyavahṛtaḥ |
evaṃ ca śūdrajanasya niṣiddhatvāt atikrāntaniṣedhānāmeva yājakatvaṃ bodhyam |
vi-- 'dvijaḥ sthapatirayo vā, dvijaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsamā- sata: |
' bhāṭṭa-- 'raudraṃ vāstumayaṃ caruṃ nirvapet' iti prakalpya 'etayā niṣādasthapatiṃ yājayet' iti śrutam |
tatra yadyapi niṣādaḥ sthapatiśca iti bahuvrīhau padadvaye'pi anyapadārthalakṣaṇā iti sa nāśrīyate |
tathāpi niṣādānāṃ sthapatiḥ iti ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣe tadabhāvāt, vidyā''kṣepaśakti- kalpanābhimā karmadhārayāṅgīkāreṇa sa evāśrīyate |
na ca tatrāpi pūrvapade niṣādatvanidhani lakṣaṇā, kāraṇābhāvāt |
yadyapi hi klaptāvayavārthayogenaiva upapattau na samāse viśiṣṭārthaśakti- kalpanā prāmāṇikī |
tathāpi karmadhāraye abhedasyaiva ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣādapi svasvāmibhāvādibheda- sambandhasya saṃsarganidhayaiva bhānopapatteḥ lakṣaṇāyāmanupapatti- bhāvaḥ |
na ca naiyāyikavat asmākaṃ nāmārthayorbhedānvaya eva ityatra pramāṇamasti |
rājā puruṣo'sti ityādau sarvatra nāmārthasya vibhaktyarthe, tasya ca ākhyātādyarthe anvayāṅgī- kāraṇa parasparānvayasya samāsātirikte kāpi apramatta- tvāt |
ataḥ samāse eva prasaktasya tasya saṃsargavidhayaiva bhānopapatteḥ na lakṣaṇā |

iti prāpte, samānādhikaraṇapadasthale rājā puruṣo'sti ityādi kriyā''nvayottaraṃ pārśvikānvayasya abhedasambandhenaivānubhavatvāt rājñaḥ puruṣo'sti ityādi vyadhikaraṇapadasthale ca bhedasambandhenaiva anubhavāt lāghavena nāmaprayojyatadarthānvayabodhasya abhedaviṣayatvameva iti niyamakalpanāt svasvāmibhāvādidisambandhasya ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣādau saṃsargavidhayā bhānopapatteḥ avaśyaṃ pūrvapade svārthasambandha- lakṣaṇāmaṅgīkṛtya tasya uttarapadāda abhedenānvayaḥ ityaṅgī- kāryam |

ata eva nāmaprayojyanāmārthaviśeṣakanāmārtha- prakārakābhedasaṃsargabodhatvāvacchinne prati ekādhikaraṇa- vṛttiprātipadikārthatā'vacchedakanāmadvayasamabhivyāhārasya dvaṃdvabhinnanāmadvayasamabhivyāhārasya vā tantratvaṃ ityapi bodhyam |
tena dhavakhadirau, nīlaghaṭau ityādau nāmevodha ityapi bodhyam |

na caivaṃ samāse saṃbandhinaḥ abhedena anvayāt vigrahe ca rājñaḥ puruṣa ityatra ṣaṣṭhyarthasambandhasya bhedenānvayāt vṛttivākyayoḥ bhinnārthatvāpatteḥ eka-vidhānena itaranivṛttyanāpattau vibhāṣāsūtravaiyarthyāpattiḥ iti vācyam |
ataśca ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣe lakṣaṇayā''patteḥ niṣādasthapati iti sthapati iti karmadhāraya evāyam |
ata eva 'kūṭa dakṣiṇā' svaṃ hi tanniṣādānāṃ' iti liṅgampi saṃgacchate |
tatra ca paraprayukto'pi tvāt āhavanīyānākṣepe'pi 'yatra kacana hoṣyan syāt sa pañcabhūtasaṃ-(bhrasaṃ-) skāraṃ kṛtvā laukikāni pratiṣṭhā- payet' iti smṛtivacanena agmyantarābhāve homamātroddeśena
laukikāgnividhānāt tameva taddeśe sthāpayitvā tasmin iṣṭiḥ kartavyā iti dhyeyam |
'vāstuśākaḥ vāstukaṃ candanavadhuvā (iti uttarapathe) candanavaṭavā (iti dakṣiṇāpathe) iti amaraṭīkāyām |
'vāstumayaṃ raudraṃ carum' iti, 'vāstuśabdaḥ kiñcitprakṛtikadravyaviśeṣa- gāi' iti ca vistaraḥ |
caśabdena brahmaloka ityatra niṣādasthapatyinyāyo'pi karmadhārayasamāsagrahaṇe sūcitaḥ |
13|15 brasū., niṣādasthapatyinyāyena śūdrasya aupaniṣadabrahmavākya- śravaṇādhikāro'stītyāśaṅkya nirākaroti |
ityatra niṣādasthapatyinyāyena klṛpta- samāhāradvaṃde aparanimittakatvena antaraṅgatvasya bādhakatva- kalpanāyāmeva dīrghanirdaiśaḥ upapadyate |
pṛ. 170, nanu śuddhānāmapi purāṇaśravaṇādinā jñānopatteḥ niṣāda- sthapatyinyāyena mahāvākyagrahaṇādhikārasambhavāt |

13|14 brasū. yat śrīhaviścāvacchinnedeśenaiva prokṣaṇādividhiḥ śabdabodhe lakṣaṇayā anaṅgīkārāt, paścācca niṣādasthapatyinyāyena prokṣaṇādiviśiṣṭahīnāṃ vākyāntarakalpanā apūrvārthaikatvakalpanāṃ ityuktaṃ tantra |

9|12, śrīhādīnāṃ ānarthakyaparihārārthaṃ prokṣaṇādiviśiṣṭahīnāmeva kalpitatvātkathaṃ yāgārtha- tvasya apūrvārthatvasya vā bodhopapattau niṣādasthapatyinyāyena trīhipade yavādisādhāraṇyena apūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇāyā pramāṇābhāvāt tu |
aṅgīkṛtaṃ ca phalamukhaṃ adhyayanaprayuktaṃ gaurava ityāha |
maṇī. pṛ. 152. niṣādasthapatiśabdasya ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣe kṛte naivarṇiko'pi saṃbhavati tādṛśaḥ |
karmadhāraye kṛte tu niṣāda- jātīyo dhanikaḥ saḥ |
niṣiddhasya pratiprasavavidhiḥ, yathā grahaṇe sūtake- 'pi śrāddhavidhiḥ 'syātarkarmaparityāgo rāhoreranyatra sūtake' iti ayaṃ svārthaḥ |
śrauta'pi 'na hiṃsyāt sarvabhūtāni' iti niṣiddhasya 'agnīṣomīyaṃ paśumālabheta' 'vāyavyaṃ śvetamālameta' iti |
10|8|47, niṣedhaḥ pravargyasya anuṣṭhāna-vyatiriktakartṛke agniṣṭomaprathame prayoge eva |
3|1|17. niṣedhāḥ anarthahetukarmaṇaḥ sakāśāt puruṣasya nivṛtti- karatvena puruṣārthānubandhin |
4|48 pṛ. 318. niṣedhasya anyārthāśritasya, anyārthatve 'tadaha- mausamaiṣune varjayet' iti darśāpūrṇamāsaprakaraṇādhīto niṣedha udāharaṇam |
su. pṛ. 321, niṣedhasyāpi vidhivat vākyārtharūpā bhāvanā viṣaya eva, na tu dhātvarthasyaiva viṣayiṇī |
pṛ. 1041, niṣedhasya prāpyapekṣatvāt durbalatayā api prāpteḥ niṣedhena atyantābādhāyogaḥ : daśamādhikaraṇapūrvapakṣa- sūtre vakṣyate (10|8|119) |
pṛ. 264, katrtavyatvapuruṣārtha-kṣapyayoḥ dvayorapi śrautasya niṣedhasya katrtavyaguṇaparihāra-phalakatvam |
pṛ. 1395, niṣedhepu narakādītyādi-kāraḥ, na tu svargakāminaḥ |
cāla. pṛ. 8. niṣedhaphalaṃ pradarśanamātreṇa saṃbhavyate na vidhi- phalavat kāmapadepyanartha apekṣate |
vā. 3|4|6|17. niṣedhaphalavidhiḥ arthavādaḥ 'tasmād brāhmaṇāya nāyudhayet' iti niṣedhe 'yo brāhmaṇāyavayudheta taṃ śatena yātayāt' |

vā. pṛ. 53. niṣedhavidhiśrvārthavādo yathā aitareyabrāhmaṇe 'hiraṇya- kaśipāvāsīna ācaṣṭe' iti hotṛkartṛkasya ṛtavasya 'putrakāmā hāpyākhyāpayeran' iti ca puruṣārthasya śaunaḥ- śepākhyānavidheḥ vākyaśeṣe 'niyoktāraṃ na vividuḥ', 'vistāritaṃ na vividuḥ' iti śāmitrakarmalābhaktā 'mahānparaṃ śataṃ datta, ahamenaṃ viśiṣyāmi' iti ca lobhāt pradhṛṣyatvā śāmitre doṣavagateḥ nindayā tanniṣedhaḥ kalpyate |
yadyapi cātra 'na hikṣāt' iti sāmānyaniṣedhaḥ ṛtvijāṃ svādhikārikāḥ prādhikārikeṇa sāmānyādhikena kartṛvamātratayā ṛtvijaḥ svaśatā'pi anādhitāḥ pradhuṣṭo'sti |
ata eva tṛtīye (3|7|13| 28-29) 'śamitā ca śabdamedāt' ityadhikaraṇe vārtikakṛtā uktam 'ata evātrijyaṃ nindati' iti, tathāpi viśeṣaniṣedhaḥ doṣaviśeṣārthatvena arthavādena iti |
niṣedhajñānāniṣedhasya bādho bhavati, nānyathetyartha- vipaye''śa pracāra iti śaṃkaravinaye |
sāhasī. 893. niṣkāsaḥ nāma āmiṣāyāḥ pātraliptaḥ kiyā- ścit bhāgaḥ |
vi. 7|3|4, niṣkāsaḥ varuṇapraghāsāvabhṛthe, arthakarmaṇā hyasya guṇabhūtasya saṃyogo vijñāyate |
bhā. 11|2|15|56. niṣkāsāvabhṛthye tadekadeśatvāt paśuvat pradānaviprakarṣaḥ syāt |
varuṇapraghāseṣu 'vāruṇyā niṣkāsena tṛṣaiṣa avabhṛtha- mabhyavayanti' iti śrūyate |
vāruṇī varuṇadevatākā āmiṣā, tasyāḥ niṣkāsaḥ bhāṇḍalipto bhāgaḥ |
eta- dyonotkasya avabhṛthe niṣkāsasya pradānaviprakarṣaḥ syāt |
āvāpasthāne āmiṣāyā eko bhāgaḥ yavapiṣṭamayameṣa- sahitaḥ pradattaḥ |
niṣkāsasya tu bhāgasya viprakarṣeṇa samidhayuruccai vihāre eva pradānaṃ kartavyam |
'vapayā prātaḥ- savane caranti, puroḍāśena madhyadine, aṅgaistṛtīyasavane' iti paśorbhāgānāṃ yathā kālato viprakarṣo bhavati tadvat |
niṣkā- sasya pūrvasmāt karmaṇaḥ sakāśāt apanayaḥ kartavyaḥ |
avabhṛthākhye apūrve eva karmaṇi niṣkāsasya viniyogaḥ syāt |
prasiddhena avabhṛthaśabdena niṣkāsasya abhi- saṃyogān saṃvandhāt, tādṛśasaṃjñakasya vacanenoktatvāt |
tathā ca niṣkāsādeḥ na pradānaviprakarṣaḥ kintu karmāntaro- padeśo'yam |
niṣkāsasya āmiṣāśeṣatvāt upa- yuktaśeṣatvāt avabhṛthagamanaṃ pratipattiḥ syāt, nārthakarma iti cet |
kutaḥ ? karma- saṃyogāt arthakarmaṇā hi asya guṇabhūtasya niṣkāsasya saṃyogān saṃyogavijñānāt niṣkāsena iti tṛtīyāsama- dhyāt |
dravyādeśe tadravyasyaḥ śrutisaṃyogāt puroḍāśa- stavanādeśe tatprakṛtitvāt |
bhāṣyam- vāruṇaprāghāsiko'vabhṛthaḥ saumikāt avabhṛthāt dharmāṇāṃ grāhakaḥ ityuktam |
satyaṃ pratyakṣaśrutam, na tu śakyate vidhātum |
yadi tupanikāsaṃ aparaṃ vidhīyeta, tato vākyaṃ bhidyeta, avabhṛthaṃ yanti, tacca tupanikāsena iti |
dravyādeśe etasmin 'tupa- niṣkāsena avabhṛthaṃ yanti' iti, tadravyaḥ syāt tupa- niṣkāsadravyaḥ |
api ca lakṣaṇayā puroḍāśo gamyate, śrutyā tupanikāsam |
atha yaduktaṃ na saṃjñayate avabhṛthena tupanikāsam, vākyabhedaprasaṅgāditi |
yadi avabhṛthaṃ vihāya tupanikāsena vidhīyeta tato vākyabhedaḥ syāt |
yadi atra pratyakṣa- śrutaṃ na dravyaṃ syāt tataḥ puroḍāśaḥ tadravyatvāt syāt |
atra tu pratyakṣaśrutaṃ tupanikāsam, tasmānna puroḍāśaḥ |
śrutvā hi tupanikāsaṃ viśeṣeṇa ca codyate ||
' avabhṛthaśabdena tu gauṇena sarvāvabhṛthadharmādharaṇena ca puroḍāśasya prāptiḥ, tasmāttasya bādhaḥ |
tupa- niṣkāsaśabdasya mukhyātvāt viśeṣaviṣayatvena niravakāśa- tvāt, gauṇena dharmāntare sāvakāśena avabhṛthaśabdena prāptasya puroḍāśasya bādhāt na tasya dravyatvam |
sūtrā- rthastu- dravyasya tupanikāsasya ādeśe tadeva dravyaṃ grāhyaṃ śrutisaṃyogāt |
dravyopadeśabhāve hi saumikāvabhṛthaprakṛti- tvāt tataḥ puroḍāśāptiḥ iti |
bhāṭṭa- atideśe'pi ca na tadīyadravyasya eka- kapālasya atideśaḥ |
aupadeśikena viśeṣavihitena ca tupanikāsadravyeṇa lākṣaṇikasya sāmānyavihitasya ati- deśaprāptasya dravyasya bādhāt |
anuṣaṭkārayāgasya pratipattirme'pi niṣkā- sāvabhṛthavājinayāganyāyena itikartavyatā SS kāṅkṣāyāṃ somajanyayāgasāhacaryeṇa atideśopapatteḥ |
kau. 3|2| 16|38 pṛ. 297. niṣkāsaśabdaḥ śeṣavacana eva, yat ulāyāṃ lagnaṃ tadanenocyate |
bhā. 11|2|16|67. niṣkavetyaṃ śaṃsati iti śastraṃ pradānakarma na guṇa- karma |
bhā. 2|1|5|13-29. niṣkrayaḥ parakīyasya dravyasya mūlyārpaṇena ātma- sātkaraṇam |
vā. 9|1|2|2. niṣpakaṃ śirasi prakṣeptuṃ īṣad‌līnaṃ navanītam |
vi. 3|4|7. niṣprayojanaṃ saprayojanaṃ bādhyate yathā nigadeṣu ujjaisvena 'upāṃśu yajuṣā' iti prāptamupāṃśuvam |
yathā jaladugdhe saṃmiśrite na pratīyate, tathā tathyaṃ brahma, vitathaṃ mithyābhūtam‌jñānādi, te ca samyaṅ‌milite tādātmyaṃ prāpte sto na pratīyate |

yathā saṃmiśrite nīrakṣīre hi idaṃ nīramidaṃ kṣīramiti pṛthak‌kartuṃ ke'pi pakṣiṇe vinā haṃsaṃ na śaknuvanti, tathā cedaṃ tathyamidamittha-miti jñātuṃ vivekajñaṃ paramahaṃsaṃ vinā na ko'pi śaknoti paṇḍita iti bhāvaḥ |
'uttarayogāyata' iti uttarāśabdaḥ saṃkhyāvācakaḥ iti pūrvapakṣī manyate, tacca |
kintu uttarāgranthapaṭhite yoneḥ uttarabhūte eva ṛcau uttarāśabdena grāhye iti siddhāntaḥ |
agnihotre 'uttarayogāyata' iti uttarāśabdena uttarāgranthapaṭhite eva dve ṛcau grāhye |
tādṛśe eva ca tuce tasya rathaṃtarādisāgnaḥ abhyāsaḥ tadabhyāsaḥ syāt |
na tu anyānyatra paṭhitāsu tisṛṣu ṛkṣu |
tasmāt uttarā- śabdena uttarāgranthapaṭhitayoreva grahaṇaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
'naimittikaṃ tu prakṛtau tadvikāraḥ saṃyoga- viśeṣāt' ( 6|3|1|10 ja. ) ityanena nyāyena kāmyo'gnirnityasya vikāro bhaviṣyati |
naimittikaṃ tu prakṛtau tadvikāraḥ saṃyoga- viśeṣāt |
darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe 'godohanena paśukāmasya praṇayet' iti, abhīṣṭomīye paśau yuktaṃ prakṛtya 'caillo brahmavarcasakāmasya' iti ca śrūyate |
nityāgnihotrārthe darśa sānāyyārthe yasmin pātre gaurduhyate tat pātraṃ godohanaṃ nāma |
tatra godohanaṃ vilvaśca camasakhyena pātreṇa khadirādinā ca nirākāṅkṣatvāt anvayahitatvena nyāyena vikṛtau niveśaḥ iti utsūtre pūrvapakṣe prāpte siddhāntayati sūtram |
naimittikaṃ pañcakrameṇa nimittena nirvṛttaṃ prakṛtau prakṛtau darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ tadvikāraḥ camasavikāraḥ namasya vācaṃka syāt |
naimittikena nityaṃ viśeṣeṇa ca sāmānyaṃ bādhyate |
tasmāt godohanaṃ vilvaśca prakṛtau eva niveśete na vikṛtau |
naimittikaṃ viśeṣe tu tasmāt tad balavat- ram ||
kartṛsaṃyogāt ityasya prathama- śabdasya prayoga eva kartṛsaṃyogopapatteḥ ityarthaḥ |
naimittikaṃ hi karma svarūpamātre na samavaiti, kintu yasmin prayoge nimittamupajanitaṃ tasminneva prayoge |
bhāṣyam-- asti jyotiṣṭome naimittikam 'bārha- drirbrāhmaṇasya brahmasāma kuryāt, pārṣadyaṃ rājanyasya, rāthovājīyaṃ vaiśyasya' iti |
tathā agnī naimittikam 'sāhasraṃ prathamaṃ cinavānaścinavīta, dvisāhasraṃ dvitīyaṃ, trisāhasraṃ tṛtīyam' iti |
tathā darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śrūyate 'godohanena paśukāmasya praṇayet, kāsyena brahmavarcasa- kāmasya, mārtikena pratiṣṭhākāmasya' ityetāni naimitti- kāni |
teṣu sandehaḥ kimetānyeva naimittikāni nityārthe, uta anyat tatra nityārthe, iti |
coditāni hi tāni, saṃnihitāni sādhanāni ākāṅkṣanti |
taiḥ prakṛtaiḥ saṃnihitairetāni nirākāṅkṣī- kriyante ityennyāyāyam |
katham ? naimittikaṃ hi saṃni- hitaṃ vākyādavagamyate, nānyat śrūyate |
yāvāṃśa śruta- stathorge doṣaḥ tāvāneva aśrutakalpanāyām |
yathā śāsyarthe kumbhāḥ praṇīyante, tāmyaśca pānīyaṃ pīyate, upaspṛśyate ca |
yo'pyayaṃ paśukāmasyeti śabdaḥ, sa paśukāma- saṃśraddhaṃ śakyatvāt kartum, nāvāntaravākyasyārthe nivāra- yitum |
na ca gamyamānaṃ vinā kāraṇe avivakṣita- miti śakyaṃ vaditum |
yastu nānyeṣāṃ vihitaṃ sādhanamiti, sāmānyavihitaṃ bhaviṣyati na doṣaḥ |
kiṃ tat ? abhīvatro brahmasāma, aṣṭādaśamantragato'gniḥ, vāruṇaṃ praṇayanapātram |
atha yaduktam, saṃnihitaiḥ prakṛtai- naimittikairbrahmasāmādīni saṃbhansyante iti |
yadyapi prakṛtāni nityāni stotrādīni, tathāpi vākyena nimittasaṃyoge śrūyante bārhadridīnāmeva |
atha yaduktam- avāntara- vākyena godohanamapi prāptaṃ na śakyamullaṅghyam, ṛte kāraṇādavivakṣitaṃ kalpayitum |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? na hīdaṃ yugapadbhavati, paripūrṇena cārthamidhānaṃ avāntaravākyena ceti |
katham ? praṇayatīti prapūrva nayato vidhivibhaktiḥ svapadagatamartha śrutyā vidadhāti |
yastu phalasya godohanādeśa saṃbandhaḥ sa hitvā śrutyarthe kevalena vākyena |
atha praṇayasya godohanādeścanmam, godoha- nādeśca phalena saṃbandhaṃ vidadhātiḥyujyate |
yadi godoha- nādeḥ kriyāsaṃbandho vivakṣyate, kamipadaṃ pramādo bhavet |
godoha- nādikamisaṃbandha eva atrābhidhīyate, na nityārthe bhavitumarhatīti |
dupa-- kṛtvārthāni camasādīni adṛṣṭvā pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
pūrvapakṣamāha-- ) yadyapi godohanā- dīni phalārthāni (śrutāni) tathāpi (saṃnihitatvāt) viparivartamānāni, tānyeva (anuṣṭhānaṃ saṃvadhyamānāni) ṛtvarthānyāpi |

(vinā'pi kṛtvācintayā vacanamapi dṛṣṭvaiva punaḥ pūrvapakṣayamāha--) 'athavā godohanena praṇayet' iti 'godohanena paśukāmasya' iti (ca) vākyāt (ubhayasmāt) dvāvapi artho gamyate kalpyate puruṣār- rthatā ca |
athavā paśukāmapadāvivakṣayā 'godohanena praṇayet' iti śrutyanugraheṇa pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
evaṃ prāpte, brūmaḥ: naimittike vikāratvāt iti |
yat yasmin vikāre (viśeṣe iti mudrite pāṭhaḥ) śrūyate, tat tasmin satyeva bhavitumarhati ( nāsati ) ato vinā phalena na yujyate |
'naivajātīyako vākyārthaḥ sāmānyapadārtha bādhitumarhati' (iti bhāṣyaṃ vyācaṣṭe)-- 'apaḥ praṇayati' ityasya sāmānyena yā pātrākāṃkṣā, na tāṃ godohanavākyaṃ samarthaye nivartayitum |
katham ? phala- sādhanatvena nirākāṃkṣaṃ godohanaṃ kathaṃ tasya pātrākāṃkṣāṃ nivartayet |
tasmāt sāmānyākāṃkṣāyāṃ athādhya- mānāyāṃ camasena saha (praṇayam) saṃbhanasyate |
na ca dviṣṭhāni (dravyarthāni) vākyāni, (kintu) eka evārtho vākyasya |
(iyāstu śveto dhāvati ityādi--) ekasya (cakṣuḥ) vivakṣā śvetaguṇe dhāvati (śvetaguṇe nirṇa- jako dhāvati) nirṇayetki (vāsāṃsi iti) aparasya vivakṣā śrā ito dhāvati (drutataraṃ gacchati) iti |
(bhāṣya- kāreṇa tu jyautihaumikaṃ bāīdvirādīni udāhṛtāni, tat anādaroktam |
jyautihaume hi naudhanaṃ brahmasāma--) śā-- 'brāhmaṇe nimittena bāīdviramiti śrutam |
mumyaṃ ca pratiṣṭhāyāṃ nitye syātāmato na te |
sūtrārthastu-- nimitte sati tato'nyadeva kyathartha syāt |
naimittikasya vikāratvāt viśeṣabhūtatvāt asati viśeṣe tadyogāt iti |
' bhāṭṭa-- kāmyaṃ godohanādi kāmābhāve nityaprayoge upasthita-ve'pi na prāpmam |

tathā 'bāīdviraṃ brāhmaṇasya brahmasāma kuryāt, pārthurśamaṃ rājanyasya, rādhovājīyaṃ vaiśyasya' iti brāhmaṇādyādhikārakatve nimitte dvādaśāha- saṃtribhdhadaśāmastotroddeśena vihitam (dvādaśāhapedena bhāṣyoktaṃ jyautihaumikatvaṃ nirastam ) bāīdvirādi naimi- ttikaṃ ca nimittābhāve anulomādhikāre prayoge na grāhyam, nimittābhāve'pyanuṣṭhāne nimittasaṃbandhasya vaiyarthyāpatteḥ |
na ca kāmābhāve tassādhananuṣṭhāne phalānu- spattāvapi kṛtaśadaguṇopapatterna kaścidvirodha iti vācyam |
tasya kyatharthatve pramāṇābhāvena tadanuṣṭhānanityatve pramāṇā- bhāvāt |
ata eva prabalapramāṇenāṅgattve avagate'pi prākṛtājñānāṃ vikṛtyaṅgyatvavadasya nitya- prayogārthatvamityapāstam |
yadā tu kāmanimittasaṃvandharahitaṃ vāraṇābhīvatrādīnmātmeva, tadā kaḥ prasaṅgaḥ kāmya- naimittikagrahaṇasya |
yatra tu tannāmnātm, tatrāpyakṣisya yasyakasyacit grahaṇam |
siddho'dhyāyadharmaḥ: prayojyatva- rūpaprayojanakathanārthamucyate iti na virodhaḥ |
3|6|136, naimittiko vā kāmyo vā nityamarthe niveśite |
10|3| 5132, naimittiko vā nilo vā nityamarthe vikalya niveśite |
10|5|24|8, naimittikaḥ vaiśvānaro dvādaśa- kapālaśrayaṇe, na nityaḥ |
naimi- ttikaḥ sadya odanidhārtāthaḥ kyatharthaḥ: adhikāraviśiḥ, yathā-- aśrapratigraheṣṭiḥ jajñabhyamānamantrikṣi |
vāla. pṛ. 14, naimittike nityasya bādhāḥ; yathā vaiśyasya sāmidhenīsātādayena pāśvadasya |
naimi- ttikāt kāmyaṃ balavat 'āsannapuruṣārthatvāt viprakṛpa- phalāt tathā |
naimittikesya kāmyena bādhaḥ: vaidyasāmidhenīsātādasya ekaviṃśativena pratiṣṭhādyena |
bhāṭṭa. 6|5|1 pṛ. 287, naimittikasya phalāpekṣā na bhavati |
vi. 4|31, naimittikānā- mapi kāmavacanena punarvivadhāne kāmyatā'pi |
yathā jyautiṣṭome 'bāīdviraṃ brāhmaṇasya brahmasāma, pārthurśamaṃ rājanyasya, rādhovājīyaṃ vaiśyasya' iti naimittikameva |
agmau ca prathamaṃ sāgrahaṃ dvitīyaṃ dviṣāhasaṃ tṛtīyaṃ triṣāhasaṃ cinvīteti naimittikameva |
darśapūrṇamāse ca 'godohanena paśukāmasya praṇayet, kāsyena brahmavarcasakāmasya, mārtikena pratiṣṭhākāmasya' iti naimittikameva |
naimittikānāṃ pāthiktā- dīnāṃ karmaṇāṃ nimittānusāreṇānuṣṭhānam, na tatra pāṭhakramo niyāmakaḥ |
naimittike tu kāryatvāt prakṛte syāt tadā- patteḥ |
atra śvetaguṇaḥ: kaścidāllabdhavyaḥ uktaḥ, sa kaḥ iti vicāre siddhāntamāha |
naimittike guṇanimittake śvetaśabde śrūyamāṇe prakṛteḥ sakāśāt prāsasya ajasyaiva paśoḥ grahaṇaṃ syāt |
kāryatvāt aje eva śvetaguṇasya saṃpādayituṃ śakyatvāt |
tadāpatteḥ tasya ajasyaiva śvetaguṇena pari- cchedyatvopapatteḥ |
tasmāt vāyavyaḥ śveta aja eva nānyaḥ paśuḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
pūrvasūtre ajaminaḥ paśuktaḥ atra tu aja evocyate iti pūrvavaiṣamyaśabdaḥ |
'naimittike tu kāryatvāt prakṛte syāttadāpatteḥ' ityadhikaraṇe bādhayādipaśo upadiṣṭaśvetaguṇasya prākṛtā- jādijāteśca samuccaya uktaḥ |
naimittike tu prakṛtau taddhikāraḥ saṃprayoga- viśeṣāt |
( 3|6|1|10 ) iti tṛtīyādhikaraṇa- vakṣyamāṇanyāyamāha-- ('puruṣārthasamāsateḥ kāmyaṃ nityasya bādhakam' puruṣārthasiddhayartho hi sarvaḥ prayāsaḥ iti tatprayāsannaṃ vastu balīyo bhavati |
naimittike punarādhāne śatadakṣiṇyā sāmānya- vihitaikaikādaśadakṣiṇāyā bādhaḥ |
agnyādheyasya naimittike guṇavikāre dakṣiṇā- dānamadhikaṃ syāt, vākyasaṃyogāt |
'yo'gnīnādhāya māghya- jyāni putrajyāni vā jīveta, sa punarādadhīta' iti |
tatra śrūyate 'punarasyūtaṃ vāso dakṣiṇā, punarasyūto'naḍ‌vān' iti |
tathā, ādhāne dakṣiṇā-- 'ekā deyā ṣaḍ‌ deyā dvādaśadhruviśatideyāḥ śataṃ deyaṃ sahasraṃ deyama- parimitaṃ deyam' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ punarādhāne'nyā- dhānadakṣiṇāmanivṛttiḥ, samuccayaḥ, agnyādheya- dakṣiṇānāṃ nivṛttiḥ |
kiṃ prāptam ? agnyādheyasya naimittike punarādhāne dakṣiṇādānamadhikaṃ syāt |
śiṣṭa- tvāditarāsām, prākṛtīnāṃ vacanaprāmāṇyāt yathāsthānaṃ samuccayo bhaviṣyatīti |
pratyakṣaṃ hīdaṃ śāsanam, āgnyā- dheyikīrdattvā punarādheyikīrdadātīti |
bhāṣyam-- tuśabdaḥ pakṣaṃ vyāvartayati, na samuccayaḥ, vikāra iti |
tadasati prākṛte prakaraṇe, āmnāyamavakalpate, na sati |
yattaccocyate vaikṛtam, tat prākṛtaṃ bādhate ityarthaḥ |
kāmyo vā naimittiko vā'thau nityamarthe vikṛtya niviśate |
yathā adhyāmaye mudagodanabhojanaṃ nivātaśayyā ceti, nityaṃ śayyāsanaṃ bhojanaṃ ca vikaroti |
dup-- ( siddhāntamāha-) punarakhyeso'naḍvān ityetasmāt vākyāt samuccayo na gamyate, samuccayaśabdā- bhāvāt (tasmāt bādhaḥ) |

'aprakaraṇe hi kāmyāni' ityasya sūtrārthavatsya ayam (bhāṣya-) granthaḥ, tat (kāmyānām) asati prākṛte prakaraṇe punarakhyesānaṃ yadi bhavet, tato na bādheta ādhānadakṣiṇām, prakaraṇāntarāt (ubhayo- rapi tulyaprakaraṇatvena bādhāsambhavāt) |
avati tu ādhāna- prakaraṇāt yat tat naimittikam (punarakhyesāt) vidhīyate tat prākṛtaṃ nityaṃ bādhamānameva niviśate kāmyānām |
kutaḥ ? nivṛttyākhyādarśanāt, śaṅkate hi nivṛttiriti gamyate |
yadekatīrdadāti dakṣiṇā ubhayo'pi tena dakṣiṇāḥ pattā bhavanti |
nanu ubhayo'pi pradīyante, yata ubhayo'pi pattā bhavantītyāha |
soma-- pūrvatra yathā 'dvādaśa śṛṇoti' iti vacanā- nusāreṇa samuccayaḥ; evamihāpi vacanādeva samuccayaḥ ityucyateḥ saṃgatiḥ |

'dadhnā juhoti, dadhrendriyakāmasya juhuyāt' 'tyādire vadhnāti, tyādire vīryakāmasya yūpaṃ kuryāt' |
oṃ naimittikapratipadoḥ 'yuvaṃ hi śvaḥ svarpatī iti dvayoryajamānayoḥ pratipadaṃ kuryāt, ete asugramindavaḥ iti bahumyo yajamānebhyaḥ' iti jyotiṣṭomāt kulāyādau utkarṣaḥ |
oṃ naimittikāyāḥ 'agraye pathikṛte puroḍāśa- maṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet, yo darśapūrṇamāsayājī san amā- vāsyāṃ vā paurṇamāsīṃ vā'tipātayet' ityādayaḥ |
